title: Surveillance Optimization - AVP
description:
Join us as "Surveillance Optimization - AVP" to support the ongoing development, optimisation and effectiveness of the Market Surveillance programme by assessing surveillance model scenarios, analysing their performance and identifying opportunities to improve surveillance coverage, data quality and alert productivity.
  
  
The role will work closely with Surveillance Operations, Compliance Technology, Business Oversight Compliance, Product Compliance and other stakeholders to ensure surveillance scenarios remain effective, risk-based and aligned with regulatory requirements. The role will also support surveillance model inventory management, optimisation initiatives, documentation, governance forums and regulatory or audit requirements.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  
  

* Conduct regular and ad-hoc assessments of market surveillance scenarios to evaluate their effectiveness and efficiency.
* Perform ongoing monitoring and testing of surveillance models to ensure scenarios are operating as intended.
* Identify opportunities to optimise scenarios through improved data quality, risk coverage and alert productivity.
* Monitor market activity including order flows, prices, trading volumes, transactions and, where relevant, communications to identify potential market misconduct.
* Support investigations into potential market manipulation, insider trading and other forms of market abuse.
* Support surveillance coverage assessments and development of new or enhanced surveillance requirements.
* Assist with the management and delivery of the Surveillance Optimisation book of work and model inventory.
* Prepare and maintain supporting documentation explaining surveillance assessments, findings and recommendations.
* Present or support the presentation of optimisation recommendations to relevant Surveillance governance forums and Product Compliance stakeholders.
* Work collaboratively with teams developing surveillance models, analytics capabilities and optimisation tooling.
* Identify emerging surveillance risks and issues and support investigation and escalation where appropriate.
* Provide support for regulatory enquiries and internal or external audit requests.
* Produce accurate and timely reporting on surveillance activities, issues, trends and optimisation outcomes.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with Surveillance Operations, Product Compliance, Compliance Technology and Change Management teams.
* Execute appropriate controls and reviews in line with the Barclays control framework and applicable standards.

**Required Skills**

* Market Surveillance: Proven experience supporting the maintenance, assessment or optimisation of a Markets Surveillance programme.
* Surveillance Models & Scenario Optimisation: Strong understanding of surveillance scenarios, model performance, alert generation, scenario testing and optimisation techniques.
* Market Abuse Risk & Trading Data: Strong knowledge of market surveillance risks and typologies, including market manipulation and insider trading, with an understanding of how these risks appear within transaction, order and trading data.
* Data & Analytics: Good understanding of how data analysis and analytics can be used to assess surveillance effectiveness, improve risk coverage and reduce unproductive alerts.
* Regulatory Knowledge: Detailed understanding of relevant market conduct and surveillance regulations, including MiFID II and MAR, and how regulatory requirements influence surveillance programmes.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Relevant experience within Market Surveillance, Trade Surveillance, Compliance Surveillance, Market Conduct Risk or a related Compliance/Financial Crime function.
* Experience working with surveillance scenarios, alerts, trading or transaction data and surveillance controls.
* Understanding of financial markets, traded products, order flows and market conduct risks.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret surveillance data and scenario performance.
* Ability to document findings clearly and communicate recommendations to Compliance, Technology and business stakeholders.

Critical Skills
  
  
You will be assessed on key critical skills required for this role such as, Market Surveillance, Scenario Optimisation, Surveillance Model Testing, Market Abuse Risk, Trade & Transaction Data, Data Analytics, MiFID II / MAR, Risk & Controls, and Stakeholder Management.
  
  
This role is based out of Pune
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To monitor and analyse market activity for potential signs of abuse or manipulation, verifying that there is adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies and taking action to mitigate market misconduct.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Monitoring market activities continuously, including order flows, prices, trading volumes and communications to identify potential irregularities or market misconduct.
* Conducting in-depth investigations to gather evidence and assess the risk of market manipulation, insider trading, or other misconduct.
* Business support in projects related to the firm’s market surveillance framework.
* Regulatory query and internal/external audit support.
* Provision of accurate and timely reports to regulatory authorities, internal stakeholders, and management regarding market surveillance activities, incidents, and trends.
* Execution of appropriate controls aligned to the Barclays control framework and related firm-wide standards.
* Control environment support in relation to data quality, model effectiveness and efficiency.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
description:
Bring your energy to Aggreko as
**Specialist - Accounts Payable**
. The role is responsible for ensuring the accurate, timely, and controlled processing of supplier invoices, employee-related payments, vendor reconciliations, and payment activities. The role will work closely with Procurement, Supply Chain, Tax, Treasury, General Ledger, business stakeholders, and suppliers to ensure liabilities are recorded accurately, payments are processed on time, and Accounts Payable activities comply with company policies, tax requirements, and internal controls.
  
  
Power without pause. Heating, cooling and oil-free air without end. We keep our customers’ worlds on. From world-class events that last a few weeks to mining operations and remote communities who rely on us for decades.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Invoice and Intercompany Transaction Management: Accurately process all supplier and intercompany invoices, credit notes, and debit notes. This includes validating against purchase orders and receipts, performing matching, coding to appropriate general ledger accounts, resolving discrepancies with stakeholders, and maintaining thorough audit trails.
* Supplier Payment Processing: Prepare and execute supplier payment proposals in line with agreed terms, ensuring proper approvals and managing payment holds and exceptions. This also involves supporting urgent payments and following up on any rejected or unsuccessful transactions while maintaining segregation of duties.
* Vendor Account Reconciliation: Conduct periodic reconciliations of supplier statements against company records, investigating and resolving discrepancies such as missing invoices, unallocated payments, or duplicate transactions. This also includes escalating significant disputes and maintaining reconciliation documentation.
* Tax Compliance Support (GST & TDS): Validate key tax information on supplier invoices, support the correct application of TDS/withholding tax, reconcile AP records with GST-related information, and coordinate with the Tax team to resolve any invoice-level tax discrepancies, escalating complex matters as needed.
* Month-End Close and Financial Reporting: Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close activities by reviewing unprocessed invoices, assisting with accrual identification, reconciling AP sub-ledger balances with the General Ledger, and providing necessary AP schedules and reports for management and cash-flow forecasting.
* Internal Controls, Compliance & Process Optimization: Ensure all Accounts Payable activities adhere to company policies, internal controls, and segregation-of-duties requirements. This includes supporting internal and external financial audits, remediating control deficiencies, identifying opportunities for process improvement, and promoting automation and electronic invoicing solutions.

**You Are**

* Educational Background: B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance or equivalent accounting/finance qualification. CA Inter / CMA Inter or similar professional qualification would be an advantage.
* Experience in Accounts Payable & Finance Operations: Minimum 4-5 years’ experience in AP, P2P or broader finance operations. Experience in GL Accounting would be a plus.
* Proficiency in ERP & MS Excel: Experience with major ERP systems like M3 (Infor), SAP or Oracle. A good working knowledge of MS Excel is also preferred.
* Strong accounting fundamentals and attention to detail.
* Effective communication, problem-solving skills and stakeholder management.

**What You’ll Get**

* A full-time role based in Pune.
* Competitive Compensation & Benefits
* Dynamic & Supportive Work Environment: Thrive in an innovative and forward-thinking culture that values your expertise and will foster professional growth.
* Accelerate your career with dedicated pathways for advancement, access to specialised training programs and ample opportunities for skill enhancement.

Our people are can-do, positive, resilient and persistent. If that feels like you, apply now and build your career with the people bringing energy to the world.
  
  
**Equal employment opportunity**
We welcome people from different backgrounds and cultures, and respect people’s unique skills, attitudes and experiences. We encourage everyone to be themselves at work because we know that’s how we do our best, for each other, for our customers, for the communities where we work, and for our careers.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer. If you apply for a role at Aggreko, we will consider your application based on your qualifications and experience, and not on your race, colour, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: FS-RISK CONSULTING-FSRM - Credit Risk Modelling_QBB-SENIOR
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Business Consulting QAS- Quantitative Banking Book (QBB)**
**Profile: Senior Consultant**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading book market risk & counterparty credit risk, banking book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
As part of the Quantitative Banking Book (QBB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk management within the banking portfolio. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk estimation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision making for clients with lending activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high impact capital markets engagements across banks, including large domestic and global financial institutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and industry knowledge of financial products, in particular lending products
* Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business
* Monitor progress, manage risk, and effectively communicate with key stakeholders regarding status, issues and key priorities to achieve expected outcomes
* Play an active role in mentoring junior consultants within the organization
* Required to review, analyse and concur with tasks completed by junior staff
* Flexibility to work across projects involving model audits, validation and development activities

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Complete, end-to-end understanding of credit risk model development or validation for the banking book portfolio (PD/LGD/EAD)
* Should have hands on experience in data preparation, manipulation and consolidation
* Expertise in Stress Testing models and/or PD/LGD/EAD models
* Solid grounding in statistics and econometrics, especially logistic regression, linear regression, fractional response, decision tree
* Strong documentation skills. Required to be adept in quickly grasping key details and summarizing them in a presentation or document
* Strong knowledge in regulatory modelling (ECB/PRA/HKMA/Regulators) with model development/validation experience
* Strong technical skills, highly proficient in Advanced Python (Pandas, Numpy, ScikitLearn, Object Oriented Programming, Parallel Processing), SAS (SAS Certified Preferred), SQL, R, excel
* Should be able to take initiative and work independently with minimal supervision, if required
* Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in risk management, model validation, and quantitative workflow automation (experience in AI/ML will be preferred)
* Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills

**Ideally, You Will Also Have**

* Good to have knowledge in Machine Learning models and its applications
* Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have.
* Previous project management experience

**What We Look For**

* Postgraduate (master’s in accounting, finance, economics, statistics or a related field) with at least 3 years of related work experience
* Regulatory knowledge in IFRS 9, IRB, CCAR, CECL, Stress Testing, DFAST
* Professional certifications (FRM, SCR, RAI, CFA, PRM are a plus)
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and support engagements with global financial institutions

title: Senior Manager Business Planning
description:
The role will have end-to-end responsibility for footwear business planning, production planning, commercial governance, factory capacity planning, vendor management, merchandising coordination, tooling planning, and delivery performance across the India business.

The footwear business is increasingly dependent on an optimal combination of imports and local manufacturing to meet changing business, compliance, quality, cost, and availability requirements. In this environment, the role will be responsible for developing a clear understanding of current and future production capacity, identifying potential supply constraints, and proactively aligning production plans with business requirements.

The position will work closely with Category, Merchandising, Planning, Sourcing, Finance, Supply Chain, Quality, Product Development, Operations, and manufacturing partners to ensure that the business has the right product, at the right cost, in the right quantity and at the right time.

The ideal candidate should bring strong footwear industry experience, commercial acumen, analytical capability and a strong understanding of production planning, factory operations, vendor management, and business planning.

**Designation:**
Senior Manager

**Department:**
Category – Footwear

**Function:**
Business Planning & Commercials

**Reports To:**
Director – Category (Footwear)

**Experience:**
12+ Years

**Qualification:**
FDDI / NIFT preferred; Post-Graduation in Footwear, Business Planning, Supply Chain, Production Planning, Merchandising or a related discipline preferred

**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Planning & Commercial Governance
* Drive the overall business planning for the Footwear Category across India, ensuring alignment with business strategy, channel requirements, and financial objectives.
* Develop and maintain the annual, seasonal, and monthly footwear business plans in alignment with category and channel requirements.
* Understand the business dynamics and commercial requirements across Retail, MBO, Distribution, E-commerce, and other relevant channels.
* Translate sales plans and business requirements into actionable buying, production, and supply plans.
* Drive OTB planning and governance, ensuring that all buying decisions are aligned with approved budgets, business plans, and commercial objectives.
* Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained before commitments or buys are placed.
* Define and govern the Annual Footwear Buy Plan, including import and local production requirements.
* Monitor business performance against planned buys, sales, inventory, margin, and cost objectives.
* Partner with Finance and Category teams to ensure alignment between business plans and financial targets.
* Identify commercial risks and opportunities and provide timely recommendations to the leadership team.
* Margin, COGS & Commercial Management
* Drive governance of agreed Gross Margin (GM%) deliverables for the Footwear business.
* Plan and monitor COGS as a percentage of MRP for each season and across relevant product/channel segments.
* Analyze cost structures and identify opportunities for improving product economics and overall business profitability.
* Work closely with sourcing, merchandising, and manufacturing teams to identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality, product standards or delivery timelines.
* Monitor cost movements arising from local manufacturing, imports, production efficiencies, tooling, and other commercial factors.
* Evaluate the financial impact of production and supply decisions and provide recommendations to the Category leadership.
* Track commercial deviations against approved plans and ensure timely corrective action.
* Support scenario planning for changes in demand, production capacity, cost, lead times, and business requirements.
* Production Planning & Factory Capacity Management
* Own the production planning framework for locally manufactured footwear.
* Develop a clear view of current and future factory capacity, production output, and available manufacturing capability.
* Align factory capacity with seasonal business requirements, sales orders, and agreed production plans.
* Monitor factory production output against the agreed plan and proactively identify capacity constraints.
* Work closely with factories to optimize production schedules based on business priorities.
* Manage production planning challenges arising from changing demand, quality requirements, compliance requirements, raw material availability, and factory constraints.
* Develop alternate production scenarios where planned output is at risk.
* Ensure production plans are realistic, achievable, and aligned with required delivery dates.
* Establish regular production planning reviews with manufacturing partners.
* Drive weekly and monthly production planning and dispatch reviews.
* Factory & Vendor Performance Management
* Establish and maintain vendor/factory performance scorecards covering key operational and commercial parameters.
* Track and improve key KPIs including:
* OTIF – On-Time In-Full delivery
* On-time production completion
* Dispatch adherence
* Production output
* Capacity utilization
* Quality performance
* Production lead time
* Plan adherence
* Commercial compliance
* Identify underperforming factories/vendors and develop corrective action plans.
* Work with vendors to resolve production and delivery challenges and escalate critical issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Conduct regular factory reviews to evaluate production performance, capacity, constraints, and upcoming requirements.
* Undertake visits to production facilities as required to review production planning, manufacturing progress, and dispatch readiness.
* Ensure factories have clear visibility of business requirements and agreed production priorities.
* Drive accountability among vendors for committed timelines and deliverables.
* Merchandising & Product Planning Coordination
* Partner closely with the Footwear Merchandising and Category teams to translate assortment and sales requirements into actionable production and buying plans.
* Ensure production planning is aligned with seasonal assortment requirements and approved sales orders.
* Monitor product-level requirements and identify potential supply gaps.
* Coordinate with merchandising teams on product availability, production status, and delivery timelines.
* Ensure that changes in product requirements, quantities or timelines are communicated to factories in a timely manner.
* Support business decisions related to local production versus imports based on capacity, cost, lead time, quality, and business requirements.
* Provide commercial and operational inputs into seasonal planning and range-building discussions.
* Tooling Planning & Management
* Own the planning and governance of footwear tooling requirements in alignment with sales orders and production plans.
* Ensure tooling requirements are identified and communicated sufficiently in advance to avoid production delays.
* Track tooling development and readiness against agreed production timelines.
* Coordinate with relevant product development, merchandising, sourcing, and factory teams to ensure tooling availability.
* Identify tooling-related risks and escalate potential impact on production or delivery timelines.
* Establish visibility of tooling requirements across seasons and future production plans.
* Imports & Local Manufacturing Planning
* Develop an optimal planning approach for the import and locally manufactured footwear portfolio.
* Evaluate business requirements and recommend the appropriate sourcing/manufacturing mix.
* Consider factors such as:
* Factory capacity
* Production lead time
* Product availability
* COGS
* Quality requirements
* Compliance requirements
* Tooling requirements
* Demand and sales plans
* Delivery commitments
* Proactively identify situations where local production capacity may not be sufficient and recommend alternate supply solutions.
* Support the Category leadership team with data-driven recommendations on production versus import decisions.
* Business Analytics, Reporting & MIS
* Develop and maintain robust business planning and production tracking tools to provide timely visibility to the Category and leadership teams.
* Prepare detailed and actionable analytics covering:
* Business plan vs. actual
* Buy plan vs. actual
* OTB utilization
* Production plan vs. actual
* Factory capacity
* Production output
* OTIF performance
* Dispatch status
* COGS and margin
* Vendor performance
* Tooling readiness
* Supply risks
* Ensure all reports are supported by accurate, timely and reliable data.
* Provide clear insights, risks, and recommended actions, rather than only reporting historical performance.
* Establish weekly and monthly reporting mechanisms for leadership review.
* Develop dashboards that provide forward-looking visibility on production and supply risks.
* Highlight deviations early and ensure ownership and closure of action points.
* Process, SOP & Governance
* Develop and strengthen SOPs, processes and governance mechanisms for business planning, production planning, factory reporting and vendor management.
* Standardize planning and reporting practices across factories and business stakeholders.
* Ensure factories follow agreed reporting formats, timelines, and planning processes.
* Establish clear escalation mechanisms for production, capacity, quality, and delivery risks.
* Drive process discipline and ensure adherence to agreed procedures.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and increased planning efficiency.
* Align factory processes with relevant global requirements, processes, and best practices.
* Facilitate effective communication between India factories and the global team.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration

**Work Closely With Internal And External Stakeholders Including**

* Category – Footwear
* Merchandising
* Planning
* Sourcing
* Supply Chain
* Finance
* Quality
* Product Development
* Retail
* E-commerce
* Distribution
* Operations
* Global/Regional Teams
* Local Manufacturing Partners
* Vendors and Factories

Ensure that all stakeholders have timely visibility of business plans, production requirements, risks, changes, and delivery commitments.

* Team Leadership & Capability Building
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 4 direct reports.
* Establish clear goals, responsibilities, and performance expectations for the team.
* Build strong analytical, planning, and commercial capabilities within the team.
* Encourage ownership, accountability, and proactive problem-solving.
* Review team performance through structured business reviews and KPI tracking.
* Develop succession capability and ensure adequate functional coverage.
* Create a culture of urgency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Key Performance Indicators**

The role will be measured against a combination of business, commercial, operational, and planning KPIs, including:

**Business & Commercial**

* Annual/seasonal business plan adherence
* OTB utilization and governance
* GM% achievement
* COGS% to MRP
* Buy plan adherence
* Commercial savings/optimization initiatives

**Production & Supply**

* Production plan adherence
* Factory capacity utilization
* On-time production completion
* OTIF performance
* On-time dispatch percentage
* Production lead-time adherence
* Reduction in production-related business risks

**Vendor Management**

* Vendor/factory scorecard performance
* Improvement in underperforming vendor performance
* Timely closure of corrective action plans

**Planning & Governance**

* Accuracy and timeliness of business/production plans
* Timely identification of capacity constraints
* Tooling readiness against production requirements
* Compliance with planning SOPs
* Accuracy and timeliness of management reporting

**Candidate Profile**

**Educational Qualification**

* Graduate/post-graduate qualification from FDDI, NIFT or another reputed institution preferred.
* Candidates with a strong Footwear Production Planning / Manufacturing / Supply Chain / Merchandising / Business Planning background may also be considered.
* Post-Graduation in Business Management, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related discipline would be an advantage.

**Experience**

* 12+ years of relevant experience, preferably within the footwear industry.
* Strong experience in business planning, production planning, footwear manufacturing, and/or commercial planning.
* Experience working with footwear factories, vendors, and manufacturing partners.
* Strong understanding of footwear production processes, capacity planning, and delivery management.
* Experience managing multiple stakeholders and leading a team is essential.
* Exposure to both local manufacturing and import planning would be highly desirable.

**Functional Competencies**

**The Candidate Should Demonstrate Strong Capability In**

* Footwear Business Planning
* Production Planning
* Factory Capacity Planning
* Commercial Planning
* OTB Planning & Governance
* COGS & Margin Management
* Vendor Management
* Factory Performance Management
* Merchandising Coordination
* Tooling Planning
* Supply Planning
* Business Analytics
* MIS & Dashboard Development
* Cost Optimization
* Process & SOP Development
* Risk Identification & Mitigation
* Cross-functional Stakeholder Management

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Dynamic and versatile with the ability to operate in a fast-paced business environment.
* Strong analytical and planning orientation.
* High level of commercial acumen and business understanding.
* Strong decision-making and problem-solving ability.
* Highly detail-oriented with strong process discipline.
* Strong sense of urgency and ownership.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Team player with the ability to work effectively across functions and cultures.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage stretched timelines when business requirements demand.
* Strong execution focuses with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, including data analysis, reporting and business planning.
* Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint for management presentations.
* Working knowledge of MS Word.
* Experience with ERP/Planning/Business Intelligence systems would be an advantage.
* Ability to build and maintain analytical dashboards and production/business tracking tools.

**Key Role Expectations**

**The Successful Candidate Will Be Expected To**

**Own the Footwear business planning agenda**
and ensure alignment between business requirements and supply capability. Maintain strong forward visibility of
**production output, factory capacity, and delivery commitments**
. Ensure the right balance between
**imports and local manufacturing**
. Protect and improve
**commercial outcomes through OTB, COGS and GM governance**
. Ensure factories and vendors deliver against agreed plans and timelines. Identify production, capacity, tooling, and delivery risks
**before they impact the business**
. Provide leadership with accurate, timely and actionable business intelligence. Establish robust planning processes, SOPs, and governance mechanisms. Build a high-performing and commercially oriented planning team. Act as a key link between
**Category, Merchandising, Factories, Vendors, Finance, Supply Chain and Global Stakeholders**
.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate will be a
**footwear industry professional with strong business planning and commercial expertise**
, who can operate across both strategic planning and day-to-day execution. The person should be equally comfortable analyzing business numbers, reviewing factory capacity, challenging production plans, managing vendors, driving cross-functional alignment and presenting clear recommendations to senior leadership.

The role requires an individual who can
**anticipate business requirements, translate them into executable production and commercial plans, identify risks early and drive stakeholders towards timely closure**

You will also work on asset management, financial analysis, NAV workings and exit related strategies for such funds. The candidate will support the growth of the Fund Solutions and Restructuring business in the Asia & EMEA region.

* Coordinating and working with multiple teams across Kroll to ensure deadlines are met and proactively communicate progress/updates with external stakeholders.
* Understanding public and private databases like Pitchbook, Preqin and Capital IQ is a plus.
* Review fund documentation (LPAs, IMs, governing documents) to identify constraints and obligations.
* Draft and present liquidation strategy memos, investor updates, and board-level communications.
* Communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
* Understanding of valuation concepts

title: Grants Payments Data Analyst
description:

Where You'll Work

* Understanding of accounting principles and revenue recognition standards.

* Ability to influence, collaborate, and challenge stakeholders constructively across cross-functional teams.
* Experience supporting audit requirements, financial reporting, and compliance-related activities.
* Proficiency in English.

title: RateGain - Director - Financial Planning & Analysis - CA
description:
**Location:**
Noida / Delhi NCR.
  
  
**Function:**
Finance.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a strategic and commercially oriented Director - FP&A to lead Financial Planning & Analysis, business finance, financial modelling and strategic finance initiatives.
  
  
The role will partner closely with the CFO, CEO, business heads and cross-functional leadership to drive data-led decision-making, optimise capital allocation and support the company's revenue and EBITDA objectives.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine strong FP&A fundamentals with business acumen, financial modelling, M&A exposure and strategic thinking, and should be able to translate complex financial and business data into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership.
  
  
**Key Planning & Analysis**

* Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting and long-range financial planning process across the organisation.
* Own monthly P&L reporting, management reporting and Budget vs. Actual / Forecast vs. Actual analysis.
* Partner with business and functional leaders to drive revenue, EBITDA, margin and cost-efficiency targets.
* Identify key business drivers, risks and opportunities and provide actionable recommendations to the CFO and senior management.
* Monitor departmental OPEX, CAPEX and resource utilisation to ensure adherence to approved budgets.
* Track business performance through relevant financial and operational KPIs.

**Business Finance & Strategic Partnering**

* Act as a strategic finance partner to business heads and leadership teams.
* Support business decisions through market, product, customer and profitability analysis.
* Develop business cases and financial models for new products, markets, investments and strategic initiatives.
* Support pricing strategy, commercial analysis, sales productivity and margin optimisation.
* Evaluate ROI and cost-benefit implications of key business initiatives and investments.
* Translate complex financial information into concise, business-relevant insights for decision-making.

**Financial Modelling & Strategic Finance**

* Build and review sophisticated financial models for business planning, investment decisions and strategic initiatives.
* Conduct scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis and financial impact assessments.
* Support capital allocation decisions and evaluate optimal deployment of company resources.
* Analyse business performance, unit economics, margins and key SaaS/business metrics as applicable.
* Develop dashboards and analytical tools to improve visibility into business performance.

**M&A And Corporate Finance**

* Partner with the M&A / Corporate Finance team on potential acquisitions and strategic transactions.
* Develop financial models and valuation analyses for acquisition targets and new investment opportunities.
* Support financial due diligence, including assessment of revenue, costs, profitability, working capital and business drivers.
* Identify financial risks, revenue leakages and improvement opportunities during due diligence.
* Support post-merger integration through financial planning, reporting, synergy tracking and performance monitoring.
* Work closely with external advisors, bankers and other transaction stakeholders.

**Cash Flow & Capital Management**

* Monitor the company's cash flow position and provide visibility into sources and uses of cash.
* Support working capital optimisation and cash-flow forecasting.
* Analyse capital requirements and support capital allocation decisions.
* Partner with the CFO on fundraising, banking relationships and strategic financing initiatives, where required.
* Maintain strong financial controls and ensure integrity of financial information used for decision-making.

**MIS, Analytics & Automation**

* Own and enhance monthly/quarterly MIS and management reporting for the CFO and CEO.
* Build dashboards and automated reporting solutions using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Excel or similar platforms.
* Drive the adoption of advanced analytics and automation across FP&A processes.
* Improve reporting accuracy, timeliness and quality through technology and process improvements.
* Establish standardised reporting frameworks and performance dashboards across functions.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with the CFO, CEO, business heads and functional leaders on strategic and financial priorities.
* Present financial insights, forecasts, scenarios and recommendations to senior management.
* Collaborate with Sales, Commercial, Operations, Engineering, HR and other functions to improve financial performance.
* Lead and mentor the FP&A team and build a high-performing, data-driven finance organisation.
* Manage relationships with external stakeholders including bankers, consultants, auditors and transaction advisors.

**Key Deliverables**

* Accurate and timely annual budgets, forecasts and long-range plans.
* Strong visibility into revenue, EBITDA, margins, OPEX, CAPEX and cash flow.
* High-quality MIS and dashboards for CEO/CFO decision-making.
* Robust financial models for investments, new products, markets and M&A.
* Improved cost efficiency and capital allocation.
* Identification of revenue leakage and profitability improvement opportunities.
* Strong business partnering across commercial and functional teams.
* Automation and continuous improvement of FP&A processes.

**Candidate Profile**
We are looking for a finance leader who is commercially minded, analytically strong and comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels.
  
  
**Required Experience**

* 12 - 16+ years of relevant experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Business Finance, Strategy Finance or CFO Office roles.
* Experience in a high-growth, technology, SaaS, digital or multinational organisation will be preferred.
* Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, P&L management and management reporting.
* Proven expertise in financial modelling, business case development and scenario analysis.
* Exposure to M&A, financial due diligence and post-merger integration.
* Strong understanding of capital allocation, cash flow and corporate finance.
* Experience partnering with senior business stakeholders and CXO-level leadership.
* Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial CA / MBA (Finance) / CFA or equivalent qualification.
* Strong proficiency in Advanced Excel and financial modelling.
* Exposure to Power BI, Tableau or other BI/analytics platforms will be an advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic & commercial mindset.
* Financial modelling & analytical thinking.
* Business partnering.
* FP&A and P&L management.
* M&A / Corporate Finance.
* Capital allocation.
* Pricing & profitability analysis.
* Cash-flow management.
* Data analytics & automation.
* Executive communication & presentation.
* Stakeholder management.
* Problem solving and decision orientation.

**What Success Looks Like**
The successful candidate will evolve FP&A from a reporting function into a strategic decision-support function, providing the CFO and business leadership with timely insights on growth, profitability, investments, costs, cash and capital allocation.
  
  
This is a high-impact role for a finance leader who can combine strong technical finance expertise with commercial understanding, strategic thinking and the ability to influence business decisions.
  
  
(ref:iimjobs.com)

title: Compensation Advisor
description:
**Role Overview**
**Compensation Adviser – Global Compensation, Market Pricing & Analytics**
The
**Compensation Adviser**
will support the
**Global Compensation, Recognition and Tools COE**
through compensation analytics, market intelligence, market pricing, survey administration, and project support across NTT DATA's global organization.
  
  
The role will work closely with Global Reward COE colleagues, Regional and Country Total Reward Partners, and external compensation survey providers to support compensation initiatives across Consulting, Specialty Businesses, Business Services, and corporate functions.
  
  
A key focus of the position will be translating complex compensation and market data into
**clear, actionable insights**
. The successful candidate will be expected to go beyond data reporting by identifying anomalies, testing assumptions, assessing market relevance, and highlighting issues requiring further review.
  
  
The role requires strong analytical capability, advanced Excel and data-management skills, attention to detail, and a solid understanding of compensation fundamentals. The individual should be comfortable working with broad direction, managing multiple priorities, and progressively taking ownership of defined analytical and operational activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Market Pricing & Benchmarking**

* Conduct market pricing and benchmarking for jobs across multiple countries, job families, and business areas using approved compensation survey sources.
* Analyze job content, responsibilities, organizational scope, talent group, and career level to support appropriate survey job matching.
* Compare market data across multiple survey providers and identify material differences, anomalies, or questionable observations.
* Support the development and validation of market reference points, salary range midpoints, and supporting range analytics.
* Perform level-to-level progression, range-width, internal-pay, and market-positioning analyses.
* Document market-pricing recommendations, assumptions, data sources, and rationale to maintain a clear audit trail.

**Compensation Surveys & Market Intelligence**

* Coordinate annual and ad hoc compensation survey activities, including data preparation, submission, validation, and quality checks.
* Work with compensation survey providers such as Mercer, Aon Radford, WTW, and other relevant market-data vendors.
* Analyze survey participant populations, peer groups, industry cuts, and other market segments to assess relevance for NTT DATA.
* Maintain survey inventories, participation information, effective dates, aging assumptions, and supporting documentation.
* Monitor relevant compensation-market developments and identify insights that may influence benchmarking or market-pricing decisions.

**Compensation Analytics & Quality Assurance**

* Analyze large compensation and employee datasets to identify trends, anomalies, inconsistencies, and data-quality issues.
* Develop structured analyses supporting compensation decisions, market competitiveness, and internal consistency.
* Build and maintain Excel-based analytical tools, dashboards, review files, and management reports.
* Perform quality assurance across compensation outputs, including job matches, market values, salary ranges, and progression relationships.
* Investigate unusual results and determine whether issues arise from data quality, survey matching, methodology, or genuine market conditions.

**Project & Stakeholder Support**

* Support global compensation projects through data analysis, documentation, project tracking, and preparation of stakeholder materials.
* Prepare structured review packs for Total Reward Partners and consolidate market-pricing feedback and exceptions.
* Conduct first-level analysis of compensation questions raised by Total Reward Partners and escalate complex methodology or policy matters to the appropriate COE lead.
* Collaborate with global and regional colleagues to resolve data issues and ensure consistency of analysis.
* Coordinate with external vendors on survey participation, data requests, and analytical requirements.

**Technology & Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive compensation processes and improve data quality, reporting, and analytical efficiency.
* Use advanced Excel, analytics tools, and approved AI technologies to support analysis, quality assurance, documentation, and reporting.
* Support the development and testing of compensation tools and standardized analytical processes.
* Maintain clear process documentation and version-controlled working files.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* 8-10 years of relevant experience in Compensation, Total Rewards, HR Analytics, Workforce Analytics, or a comparable analytical role.
* Demonstrated experience working with compensation data, salary benchmarking, or market-pricing analysis.
* Strong Microsoft Excel capability, including:

+ Pivot Tables
+ XLOOKUP and INDEX-MATCH
+ Advanced formulas
+ Data validation and reconciliation
+ Large dataset manipulation
+ Power Query
+ Reporting and dashboard development

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify data anomalies and investigate root causes.
* Ability to interpret data and develop meaningful conclusions rather than simply producing reports.
* High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work with broad direction.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience working across countries, regions, or business units.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within Technology, IT Services, Consulting, or Professional Services.
* Exposure to global compensation programs and multi-country market pricing.
* Experience with compensation survey platforms such as Mercer, Aon Radford, WTW, Comptryx, Remchannel, or equivalent providers.
* Experience with Power BI or comparable data-visualization tools.
* Exposure to AI-enabled analytical tools, automation, or workflow improvement.
* Familiarity with job architecture, career frameworks, and salary-range design.

**Key Success Factors**
The successful candidate will:

description:
Designation will be Manager/Assistat Manager - Supply Chain Analyst
  
  
About the Client: Its one of the world’s leading footwear manufacturers and retailers, with over 20,000 employees and more than 3,000 stores across 50+ countries.
  
  

* This role is responsible for analyzing, monitoring, and improving end-to-end supply chain performance across demand and supply planning, sourcing, production, logistics, supplier management, and order fulfillment. The analyst transforms supply chain data into actionable insights to improve delivery performance, identify risks, support business decisions, and drive continuous improvement.

Role & Responsibilities
  
  

* Monitor end-to-end supply chain performance, including purchase orders, production progress, supplier performance, forecast accuracy, delivery performance, lead time, shipment volume, and logistics performance.
* Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc management reports and dashboards.
* Identify trends, bottlenecks, delays, performance gaps, and key supply chain risks.
* Conduct root-cause analysis, quantify business impact, recommend corrective actions, and follow through to resolution.
* Monitor purchase orders from issuance through production, shipment, receipt, and final delivery.
* Track key PO milestones, including requested, original, revised, and actual ex-factory dates, shipment dates, expected arrival, and actual receipt.
* Identify overdue, delayed, or at-risk orders and coordinate with suppliers and internal teams on recovery actions.
* Analyze delays by supplier, 3rd party, brand, country of origin, and region.
* Monitor order amendments, cancellations, shortages, and quantity changes.
* Monitor supplier and factory KPIs including on-time ex-factory performance, production lead time, capacity utilization, order confirmation, delivery reliability, and order accuracy.
* Maintain supplier scorecards and performance dashboards.
* Analyze supplier capacity against forecasted and confirmed demand and support supplier allocation and sourcing decisions.
* Identify underperforming suppliers and track improvement actions.
* Support demand and supply planning through forecast, order, capacity, and shipment analysis.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and demand changes and highlight potential shortages or capacity constraints.
* Support S&OP/IBP processes and balancing of demand and supply across suppliers, factories, and markets.
* Monitor shipment performance, freight cost, transit time, container utilization, forwarder performance, and delivery delays.
* Identify shipment consolidation and transportation cost-saving opportunities.
* Collect, validate, consolidate, and reconcile supply chain data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
* Standardize supplier, country, date, KPI, and reporting information and investigate missing, duplicate, or inconsistent records.
* Develop and maintain dashboards covering key KPIs such as OTD, OXF, OTIF, delayed orders, supplier performance, forecast accuracy, freight cost, shipment volume, lead time, order fulfillment, and capacity utilization.
* Automate recurring reports and reduce manual or duplicate data entry.
* Support development of SOPs, reporting standards, data governance, system improvements, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Work closely with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Logistics, Finance, Merchandising, Product Development, Suppliers, Freight Forwarders, and Country Teams.
* Ensure supply chain information, risks, and actions are communicated clearly and resolved in a timely manner.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or related discipline preferred.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Experience with Power BI and management dashboard development is preferred.
* Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively across suppliers, factories, logistics partners, country teams, and senior management.

This role is split evenly between two areas. 50% is Purchasing Category Management: about 30% laptops and about 20% mobile telecom. 50% is IT Finance Management, covering capital expenditure requests and IT budgeting: about 30% North America budget and capital expenditure, and about 20% shared between Asia Pacific and Europe, Middle East, South America and Africa budget support and capex creation for the new SAP integration. You will work on mobile telecom cost analysis, invoice control and reporting, working alongside the team that manages mobile carrier contracts, manage laptop orders and spend in line with the strategy set by the hardware category team, and ensure the IT budget and capital expenditure process is accurate, consistent and well controlled across regions.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities Include**
Laptops and End User Devices Purchasing (approx. 30%)
  
  

* Partner with the team that leads laptop category strategy and vendor selection, and handle the financial and order coordination side of the agreed approach
* Plan and coordinate hardware orders for refresh, new hire and replacement demand in cooperation with local IT and global asset management
* Review and approve laptop quotations, and ensure orders follow negotiated pricing, standard models and approved budgets, and escalate exceptions to the category lead
* Track hardware spend, volumes and commitments against budget and capex, and forecast upcoming order needs
* Maintain hardware order and spend reporting in Power BI, plus related knowledge base articles and process documentation

Mobile Telecom Purchasing (approx. 20%)
  
  

* Partner with the team that manages mobile carrier contracts and vendor relationships, and with the telecom expense management provider, including support on renewals and requests for proposal as required
* Analyze historical cost data and usage trends, and recommend cost reduction strategies
* Control and dispute invoices, and monitor usage and costs for compliance with company policy
* Design, deploy and standardize processes across offices with the telecom expense management provider, and work with local IT to improve new hire, internal transfer and departure workflows
* Run service reviews with carriers and drive efficiency and automation with the telecom expense management provider
* Maintain Power BI reporting and knowledge base articles for mobile telecom

Worldwide IT Budget and Capital Expenditure (approx. 50%)
  
  

* Partner with local and regional finance teams, local IT managers and regional directors to manage the North America IT budget and forecast
* Drive line level budgeting and consistency across the region, and prepare the IT budget for all North America offices
* Consolidate North American regional inputs into a coordinated view of IT spend and capital expenditure, and provide budget variance analysis
* Support the Asia Pacific and Europe, Middle East, South America and Africa IT budget and forecast cycles with regional finance and IT leads, using consistent templates and charge code logic
* Consolidate regional inputs into a coordinated view of IT spend and capital expenditure for Asia Pacific and Europe, Middle East, South America and Africa
* Improve reporting integrity by ensuring alignment of charge codes
* Ensure proper forecasting of large-scale IT projects regionally and globally
* Act as main point of contact for IT budget and capital expenditure inquiries, and provide ad hoc information and analysis as required
* Gather, create and submit capital expenditure requests for all regions, and ensure proper approvals
* Maintain the Global IT expense detail, plan and capital expenditure dashboards to enable IT managers to monitor actual spending against budgeted plans and approved capital expenditures.
* Document the capital expenditure creation process and train regional IT teams on the new way of working

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, IT management or supply chain, or comparable knowledge and experience
* 10+ years of experience in IT procurement, category management, IT finance or budget management
* Experience in IT sourcing and contract negotiation, including the request for proposal process
* Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting and capital expenditure processes, including approval workflows and variance analysis
* Working knowledge of SAP (purchasing and finance) and experience supporting an enterprise resource planning (ERP) migration or integration
* Advanced Excel skills and experience with Power BI or similar reporting tools
* Familiarity with mobile telecom and telecom expense management is an advantage
* Proven ability to solve problems creatively
* Experience in developing and executing budgets and plans aligned with organizational objectives

Who You'll Work With
  
  
Additional info
  
  
Key competencies
  
  

* Demonstrate strong ability to identify, analyze and solve problems
* Attention to detail, well-organized, and excellent time management skills
* Able to work independently, self-motivated, exercising sound judgment and initiative
* Deliver high-quality work by collaborating cross-functionally to achieve the best results for the organization
* Reliable and cooperative team player; display consideration and respect for others
* Solid communication skills, both written and verbal
* Ability to influence others and move toward a shared vision or goal
* Demonstrate competence and character that inspires trust
* Display tact, patience and the ability to handle stressful situations
* Focus on excellent customer service and the needs of the end-user community
* Ability to establish and maintain strong and effective working relationships across the organization
* Strong understanding of the BCG culture, organizational structure and processes
* Able to treat all BCG information as personal and confidential

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
  
  
**Our Pillars**

* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
* Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
* AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.

For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.

Using secure data, networks and partnerships, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments and businesses realize their greatest potential. The Services team is the professional services arm of Mastercard, providing cutting-edge services that address key issues facing our customers. Focused on thinking big and scaling fast, this team is responsible for end-to-end solutions for a diverse customer base. We combine traditional management consulting with our rich data assets and in-house technology / security platforms, to provide powerful strategic insights and execution capabilities. Centered on data-driven technologies, these services include consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, security products, business experimentation, and data-driven information and risk management services.
  
  
The Asia Pacific, Market-wide Initiatives Team
  
  
The market-wide initiatives team focuses on advancing our payment ecosystem’s development priorities at the country/regional level, by identifying pain-points that cut across multiple clients in a geography, designing market-wide services solutions in close collaboration with the Product organization.
  
  
The Position Will Be Expected To Lead Strategy And Analysis That Supports The Wider Organization. This Will Encompass Many Programs Remit (mandates, Funds, Optional Programs), Including
  
  

* Opportunity identification / origination at the market / regional level
* Key analysis to support proposal development
* Value quantification analysis for in-flight & pipeline programs
* Socialization with key stakeholders, integrate feedback, iterate proposal structure and secure approvals
* End-to-end execution and successful launch of strategic programs and initiatives

You will have the opportunity to own specific programs, prepare relevant documentation for strategic internal client engagements across a range of topics, countries and types of products. Working with data, you will generate key hypotheses and structure workstreams covering market problems. Overseeing ongoing business opportunities that are in-flight, program opportunity pipeline and closures, you will also create creative and useful analyses to address pain point, synthesize analyses into clear, sound recommendations, and create effective, impactful storylines.
  
  
You will be part of Services team (erstwhile Advisors segment), partnering with product, A&CS, legal, finance, controllership, account managers, customer success etc. to design the right thematic product bundles for the markets. Market wide initiatives and events will be done in partnership with other teams of Advisors.
  
  
Core competencies
  
  

* Strong foundation in consulting – structured problem-solving, hypothesis-driven analysis, and crafting executive-ready narratives.
* Deep expertise in analytics and data-driven decision-making – highly skilled in financial modeling and translating complex data into actionable insights.
* Proven stakeholder management capabilities – experienced in influencing, challenging, and aligning senior leaders across diverse functions.
* Exceptional communication skills – articulate and persuasive in both written and verbal formats; able to convey value propositions, foster alignment, and inspire confidence among internal and external stakeholders.
* Self-motivated and proactive – thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments with a high degree of autonomy.
* Comfortable with ambiguity – adaptable and innovative in navigating complex challenges and evolving priorities.

**Qualifications**

* Top tier management consulting firm experience, preferably in payments or retail banking
* Proven track record of leading complex, cross functional initiatives and driving measurable business outcomes
* Experience working with senior leadership (C-Suite/ regional/ functional heads and influencing key decisions
* MBA or relevant Graduate degree required
* Strong Analytics and financial modelling capabilities (Excel) and proficiency in structuring content into compelling narratives (PowerPoint)

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Delivery Consultant - Product Development & Procurement
description:
**Who You'll Work With**

The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

**Your Impact**
You will spend about 80% of your time working at a client location as part of a consulting team, helping to solve complex problems in the domains of product development and procurement.
  
  
This work includes, but is not limited to: end-to-end margin transformation, product- and organization-level EBITDA improvement, rationalizing product design based on competitive teardown analysis and customer insights and building and implementing sourcing strategies.
  
  
You will also help client teams estimate product should-costs using clean sheet costing, enabling the design of low-cost products. Your work may extend to new product development, where you will focus on reducing development time, cost, and improving quality attributes. You may also conduct surveys to identify improvement areas within organizations to support effective and efficient product development, ultimately helping clients build sustainable R&D capabilities. Other focus areas may include design-to-cost, design-to-value, global sourcing, commodity strategy, cost structure optimization, clean-sheet costing, supplier development, negotiation, strategic sourcing, cost-saving idea identification and leverage, cost reduction, spend analysis, and procurement transformation.

By combining customer insights, advanced analytics, engineering excellence, and procurement expertise, we enable clients to accelerate innovation, unlock sustainable value, and create lasting competitive advantage.
  
  
You will work directly with client leaders and front-line operators on topics where implementation issues are important and where driving changes are critical to successful realization of organizational goals. You will be staffed to projects or engagements, working closely with clients. You will work closely and in partnership with clients' senior management and their specialist departments.
  
  
You will be based in one of our India offices - Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Kolkata or Mumbai - as a part of Delivery Assurance Path in the Operations practice.
  
  
Delivery Assurance (DA) focuses on value creation - turning strategy into execution. Our work demands a dual toolkit: deep delivery and process expertise, combined with the content and problem-solving strength of McKinsey consultants. This blend makes DA work unique, demanding, and has a high impact. You will be a part of a rapidly scaling global community of 700+ DA consultants, with presence across all regions of the globe and hubs in 34 countries (and counting). We service clients across the public and private sector and industries.
  
  
Our Operations practice sits at the intersection of strategy, technology, and transformation to deliver sustainable and inclusive growth. It assists our clients in solving complex operational challenges.
  
  
**Your Qualifications and Skills**

* A bachelor’s degree is required, with preference in engineering domain
* 2+ years of experience in product development and design or product cost optimization or strategic sourcing/purchasing or supplier development or spend analysis or commodity strategy, or cost reduction, negotiations, etc.; preferred industries: automotive.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to independently structure and design the solution
* Strong desire to learn and develop within a dynamic, self-led organization
* Open to extensive travel to client sites.
* Ability to work under pressure and deliver to tight deadlines.
* Ability to work effectively with people at all levels in an organization and to collaborate within a team
* Language fluency skills & ability to communicate complex ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, in English

title: Audit Executive
description:
About HNS Gold

HNS Gold Pvt. Ltd. operates in the gold and silver buying and financial services sector, offering gold and silver buying, gold loan settlement, and monthly gold investment plans. With branches across multiple locations in India, the company focuses on transparent transactions, customer service, and operational excellence.

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Audit Executive to conduct onsite and offsite audits, strengthen internal controls, monitor branch operations, and ensure compliance with company policies.

Key Responsibilities

**Branch Audit & Compliance**

* Conduct scheduled and surprise onsite audits at company branches.
* Perform offsite audits through MIS reports, transaction records, and internal systems.
* Verify branch transactions, approvals, supporting documents, and adherence to SOPs.
* Identify operational discrepancies, policy deviations, and internal control weaknesses.

**Financial & Expense Audit**

* Audit branch expenses, vendor payments, petty cash, and supporting invoices.
* Verify compliance with expense limits, approval matrices, and budgetary controls.
* Review financial reconciliations and identify unauthorized or unsupported transactions.

**Transaction & Stock Verification**

* Verify gold and silver purchase records, valuation details, customer KYC, and payment documentation.
* Review gold loan settlement and investment plan transactions.
* Conduct physical stock verification and reconciliation of precious metal inventory.
* Examine stock transfers, registers, and supporting records.

**Risk Management & Vigilance**

* Identify suspicious transactions, potential financial irregularities, and process violations.
* Conduct independent verification and report findings with supporting evidence.
* Recommend corrective actions to strengthen internal controls and prevent financial losses.

**Audit Reporting**

* Prepare audit reports highlighting observations, risk levels, and corrective recommendations.
* Maintain audit checklists, compliance registers, and observation trackers.
* Coordinate with branch teams and management to ensure timely closure of audit findings.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* 2– 5 years of relevant experience in internal audit, branch audit, financial audit, or operational audit.
* Experience in NBFCs, gold loan companies, banking, jewellery, or financial services will be preferred.
* Working knowledge of financial reconciliation, internal controls, KYC, and compliance.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MIS reporting, and audit documentation.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently while maintaining confidentiality and professional integrity.

Travel Requirements

The position is based at our New Town, Kolkata office. The selected candidate must be willing to undertake frequent official travel for branch audits, including outstation visits to West Bengal, Assam, Punjab, and other company locations as required.

* Official travel expenses will be reimbursed according to company policy.
