title: Consultant – Climate Finance & Credit Integration
description:
**ABOUT SKYQUEST**

**﻿**

SkyQuest Technology Consulting is a rapidly expanding global advisory firm specialising in market intelligence, innovation management, and commercialisation strategy. We partner with corporates, governments, and development organisations to turn insights into implementation.

Learn more: https://www.skyquestt.com

**THE ROLE**

As Consultant –
Climate Finance & Credit Integration
you will lead the climate-finance and credit-integration workstream for a technical assistance programme supporting a national agricultural development finance institution in Nigeria.

The role combines climate-fund readiness and funding proposal development with the practical integration of climate considerations into credit appraisal, portfolio monitoring, risk management, and agricultural financial products.

You will work closely with the Institution's credit, risk, and technology teams to strengthen climate-finance capabilities and embed sustainable climate-risk management practices within institutional processes.

**THE PROGRAMME**

SkyQuest is delivering a technical assistance programme to strengthen a national agricultural development finance institution in Nigeria.

The programme aims to improve the mobilisation and deployment of finance to agricultural enterprises and organisations serving smallholder farmers, particularly women and underserved producers.

The embedded Technical Support Unit (TSU) works alongside the Institution's teams, focusing on transferring sustainable capabilities and embedding validated systems, processes, and practices within the Institution.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

SkyQuest is seeking an experienced climate-finance specialist for a 24-month technical assistance programme supporting a national agricultural development finance institution in Nigeria.

The programme aims to strengthen the Institution's access to climate finance and integrate climate considerations into agricultural lending and risk management, improving financial support for climate-resilient agricultural value chains and smallholder farmers.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

• Assess the Institution's climate-finance readiness and identify priority institutional improvements.

• Develop a climate-finance strategy and pipeline of funding opportunities aligned with the Institution's agricultural-finance priorities.

• Prepare funding proposals and support accreditation or engagement with multilateral climate funds and development-finance partners.

• Design climate-smart and adaptation-focused financial products for smallholder-oriented agricultural value chains.

• Integrate climate-risk screening, assessment, and monitoring into credit appraisal, risk management, and portfolio processes.

• Strengthen environmental and social safeguards and climate-related reporting standards.

• Work with credit, risk, and technology specialists to embed climate data and risk-assessment tools into institutional processes.

• Pilot and refine relevant frameworks, train Institution teams, and facilitate the transfer of ownership to designated counterparts.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

**Education**

• Master's degree in Climate Finance, Environmental Economics, Development Finance, Agricultural Economics, or a related field.

**Professional Experience**

• 12+ years of experience in climate finance, sustainable finance, or climate-risk management, including experience within or alongside banks or Development Finance Institutions (DFIs).

• Demonstrated experience preparing funding proposals or supporting accreditation processes for multilateral climate funds such as the Green Climate Fund (GCF), Global Environment Facility (GEF), or Adaptation Fund.

• Hands-on experience integrating climate risk into credit appraisal, risk management, or portfolio monitoring.

• Strong understanding of environmental and social safeguards and climate-related reporting standards.

**DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE**

• Experience in climate-smart agriculture, agricultural adaptation, or index-based insurance in Sub-Saharan Africa, particularly Nigeria.

• Familiarity with climate data, geospatial analysis, and climate-risk modelling.

• Previous experience working on development-partner-funded programmes.

title: Assistant/ Deputy Manager - Material Planning
description:
**About Group Bayport**

Group Bayport is a rapidly growing global e-Commerce B2B2C, B2B and B2C organisation that has re-defined the business of delivering high-quality custom products through a unique blend of innovative digital technologies, robust manufacturing capabilities, and a global supply chain. An industry leader in print technology, Group Bayport operates in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the UK, and India through its family of brands — Banner Buzz, Covers & All, Vivyx Printing, Circle One, Giant Media and Neon Earth.

From full suites of trade show and small business marketing solutions to sophisticated outdoor living covers, signages and shades, to eclectic personal accents and home decor, we help our customers, clients and partners make a personalised statement through customisation.

While our advanced technology and customer focus are certainly our salient attributes, our true strength comes from our team of 1,450+ people. We are seeking exceptional talent across the board to join us in our exciting growth journey.

Learn more: https://groupbayport.com/about-us/

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/

**About the Role**

We are looking for an analytical and initiative-taking Assistant/ Deputy Manager – Material Planning to own material planning for a defined set of brands and strategic accounts.

Group Bayport operates a predominantly made-to-order custom manufacturing model across a high-SKU environment. That makes material planning the difference between an order shipping on time and a production line standing idle. The role is accountable for having the right materials available when production needs them, for holding inventory at the agreed norms, and for working closely with Procurement, Production Planning and Operations so that plans translate into actual availability on the floor.

**Position details**

Designation: Assistant/ Deputy Manager – Material Planning

Function: Supply Chain Management – Centralised Material Planning

Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat

Experience: 6 – 10 years

**Key Responsibilities**

**Planning ownership**

* Own the material plan end to end for assigned brands and strategic accounts.
* Build material requirement plans from sales orders, customer forecasts, and production schedules.
* Convert requirements into purchase requisitions and release them to Procurement with the correct priority and timing.
* Maintain planning parameters in the ERP — reorder levels, safety stock, lead times, and material master data.

**Material availability and risk**

* Ensure availability of all production inputs — textiles, printing media, inks, hardware, packaging, and consumables.
* Review material availability against the production plan daily and flag risks before they affect output.
* Track supplier lead times and escalate slippage to Procurement early enough to act on it.
* Identify shortages and build contingency plans — alternate material, alternate source, or re-sequencing with Production Planning.

**Inventory management**

* Hold inventory at agreed norms — neither short nor in excess.
* Analyse consumption trends and recommend stocking strategy for fast-moving and critical materials.
* Review inventory ageing and slow-moving or non-moving stock and drive corrective action.
* Lead inventory optimisation initiatives without compromising service levels.

**Coordination and reporting**

* Work closely with Sales, Production Planning, Procurement, Stores and Operations to ensure seamless material flow.
* Participate in the S&OP cycle and support demand planning.
* Publish daily, weekly, and monthly planning reports and KPIs.
* Improve planning processes through data analysis and better use of the ERP.

**Scope boundary**

This role plans, triggers and tracks material requirements. Purchase order placement, supplier negotiation and vendor follow-up sit with Procurement. The planner is accountable for raising the right requirement at the right time and for escalating risk; Procurement is accountable for the buy.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.
* MBA or PGDM in Operations or Supply Chain Management preferred.

**Experience**

* 6 to 10 years in material planning, production planning, supply chain, or inventory management.
* Manufacturing background preferred — signage, printing, textiles, packaging or similar.
* Experience in a high-SKU or made-to-order environment is a strong advantage.
* Experience planning across multiple brands or business lines is an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of Material Requirement Planning (MRP).
* Firsthand experience with an ERP system — SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or equivalent.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel — pivot tables, lookup functions, dashboards, and modelling.
* Comfortable analysing consumption patterns and demand data to reach a recommendation.

**Competencies**

* Analytical, with a bias for working from data rather than assumption.
* Organised, and able to carry several priorities without dropping any of them.
* Communicates clearly across functions and manages stakeholders well.
* Takes ownership of outcomes rather than of tasks.
* Strong diligence and comfortable working at pace.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

* Signage manufacturing
* Digital and large format printing
* Textile manufacturing
* Packaging
* Custom or made-to-order manufacturing

title: Senior Risk Manager, INFORM Act, Account Compliance Risk
description:
**Description**
We are looking for an experienced compliance professional to join the Account Compliance Risk & Quality (ACRQ) team within Amazon's 1st Line of Defence, providing dedicated, independent risk oversight of the INFORM Consumers Act program. The INFORM Act requires online marketplaces to collect, verify, and disclose information about high-volume third-party sellers to protect consumers from fraud and illicit goods.
  
  
Sitting within Account Compliance Risk, the role operates independently from the teams responsible for day-to-day execution of INFORM requirements and controls. You will provide senior-level regulatory risk judgement and an independent view of compliance and risk exposure to senior leadership and governance forums. You are the person who sees the full picture across Legal, Technology, Program, and Operations, connects the dots across workstreams, and raises red flags when the program's risk posture is trending in the wrong direction. The team is actively building AI-powered risk assessment tools and automated monitoring frameworks, and you will be expected to engage with and help shape how these capabilities are applied to oversight work.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own and maintain the INFORM Obligation Register and Compliance Requirements Document (CRD), ensuring all regulatory requirements are mapped, current, traceable to controls, and translated into actionable compliance requirements for programme teams.
* Provide independent, evidence-based assessment of the end-to-end INFORM risk and control environment, covering seller identification, verification, certification, disclosure, enforcement, and reporting. Review and challenge control design and operating effectiveness using monitoring results, operational metrics, incidents, and complaints.
* Identify emerging risks, systemic weaknesses, and concentrations of regulatory exposure. Lead regulatory horizon scanning, translate changes into impacts for the control environment, and maintain risk appetite thresholds and escalation mechanisms in partnership with Legal.
* Produce clear, decision-oriented risk reporting for senior leadership and governance forums covering current exposure, control effectiveness, issue health, and direction of travel. Support regulatory enquiries and examinations where required.
* Drive continuous improvement of the oversight framework through data and automation, manage dependencies with adjacent domains such as KYC, seller experience, and data privacy, and hold programme teams accountable for timely remediation through structured escalation.

A day in the life
  
  
Your morning starts with a question you return to every day: does the compliance picture people believe match the evidence underneath it? Before the US comes online, you use the quiet hours to look past the dashboards, not to read the green, but to test whether it is real or whether a control is quietly drifting behind a reassuring number.
  
  
Mid-morning you are building the oversight framework itself, defining how obligations map to controls, how risk is assessed and calibrated, and how a signal travels from a monitoring exception to a decision in front of leadership. After lunch the work turns live. You join Program, Technology, and Legal partners across time zones, often as the only person on the call holding the regulatory-risk lens, and you challenge whether a change lands cleanly against an INFORM obligation before it ships.
  
  
**About The Team**
The ACRQ team provides independent risk oversight of some of Amazon's most significant regulatory compliance programs. We are a small, senior team operating across multiple entities, jurisdictions, and regulatory regimes, working closely with Legal, second line of defence, programme teams, and senior leadership. Over the past year we have invested heavily in AI-powered risk assessment and automated monitoring, and that investment is accelerating.
  
  
This role is a genuine springboard. The combination of regulatory expertise, independent oversight, and senior stakeholder engagement prepares you for compliance leadership or broader risk positions. The INFORM space is still evolving, so you will have the opportunity to shape the framework rather than inherit a settled one. If you want to do work that matters at a global scale and grow while doing it, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience within financial services and payment institutions
* Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
* Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
* Master's degree or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Product Compliance & Risk Manager - India
description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money. Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
  
  
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. For everyone, everywhere.
  
  
**Job Description**
More about our mission and what we offer.
  
  
The Product Compliance & Risk (PC&R) team sits at the centre of Wise’s product development function, supporting our cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional compliant-by-design products for our customers.
  
  
We’re seeking a highly motivated, customer-centric individual to join our team to leverage their deep understanding of India regulatory requirements and expectations to launch new products, grow our presence and manage compliance risks in India.
  
  
This hands-on first line of defence (1LOD) role will involve working closely with product teams in APAC and globally to ensure our controls strike the right balance between meeting compliance requirements whilst maximising customer experience.
  
  
**This is a hands-on role, with high levels of ownership over:**

* Designing and continuously improving our products and controls: Leverage your deep understanding of the Wise product and regulatory requirements and risks to support new product launches. This includes communicating requirements in clear, practical terms, and taking a risk-based, scalable approach with the customer experience front-of-mind when designing, uplifting and implementing controls.
* Regulatory and financial crime risk management: Stay ahead of trends and the regulatory agenda in India, identify, assess and present risks quantitatively and qualitatively in clear and understandable terms, and work collaboratively to define and execute on risk mitigation plans.
* Regulatory change and remediation: Conduct regulatory gap analyses, define and scope actions to remediate gaps, and ensure implementation plans are executed in a timely manner. Collaborate with global teams to identify synergies with programs of work already completed or underway across the Wise Group, and ensure Wise Product teams are aware of the most recent regulations and guidance.
* External engagements: Represent Wise through external engagements such as audits and regulatory inspections, including explaining and defending our controls, and developing and executing remediation plans.

**This Role Will Give You The Opportunity To**

* Grow your hands-on Fintech knowledge at full speed, with high levels of ownership and autonomy.
* Collaborate with our amazing teams both locally and globally to build state-of-the-art products for our customers that are compliant-by-design.
* Be empowered to identify problems and opportunities, and take a lead in the solution design and implementation.

**About You**

* Expert in regulatory and financial crime compliance and risk management in India, with 10+ years experience in financial services (banking, fintech or consulting) and a deep understanding of the expectations of local regulators/policymakers.
* High levels of ownership and autonomy, with the ability to proactively identify improvement opportunities or areas of elevated risk, prioritise, and drive work from inception to completion at pace with limited oversight. This includes anticipating risks and roadblocks, and demonstrating resilience to work through them.
* Problem solving attitude, with the ability to not only analyse and interpret complex regulatory and risk management frameworks, but to exercise sound judgement in proposing and implementing customer-centric and scalable solutions, using data to drive decision-making and quantify risks.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with different audiences (from Product & Engineering teams to external auditors and regulators such as the RBI).
* Strong collaboration skills, to work effectively with different stakeholders globally (such as Product, Risk and Compliance), and to influence without authority.
* Challenge the status quo, thinking outside-the-box and questioning how we can achieve an optimal balance of achieving compliance whilst delivering the best outcomes for our customers.
* Previous experience working directly with product and engineering teams, including effectively translating regulations into actionable business requirements.
* Willingness to travel, as Wise offices are located across different countries.
* Legally authorised to work in India or Singapore.

**Nice To Have But Not Essential**

* Previous experience in working in a fintech or a similar fast-paced environment.
* Previous experience working with a PA-CB and/or ADII licensee.
* Experience working in cross-border teams.

Additional Information
  
  
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
  
  
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
  
  
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Company Secretary
description:
**Job Description – Company Secretary (CS)**

**Department :**
Company Secretary – ROC & Corporate Compliance

**Experience**
: 1–5 Years

**Location**
: Hyderabad

**Department**
: Legal & Secretarial / Corporate Affairs

**Reporting To:**
CFO / CEO

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Company Secretary to manage ROC filings, MCA portal activities, corporate statutory compliances, shareholding and capital structure, and company secretarial documentation.

The candidate should independently handle routine corporate compliance activities and coordinate with management, directors, auditors, and external consultants on corporate governance and regulatory matters.

**Key Responsibilities**

1
**. ROC & MCA Compliances**

. Handle all ROC filings and MCA portal activities.

. Prepare and file annual returns, financial statement filings, and event-based forms.

. Maintain statutory registers, records, and compliance calendars.

. Monitor due dates and ensure timely statutory filings.

. Handle DIN, DSC, director KYC, and other director-related compliances.

. Coordinate with ROC and regulatory authorities for queries, notices, and approvals.

**2. Share Capital & Corporate Structure**

. Maintain company shareholding patterns and capital structure records.

. Handle authorised capital increases, paid-up capital changes, and share allotments.

. Assist with share transfers, share certificates, and dematerialisation compliance.

. Prepare documentation for preferential allotments, rights issues, and other capital transactions.

. Maintain cap tables and promoter shareholding records.

. Support restructuring of group companies and subsidiaries.

**3. Board Meetings & Corporate Governance**

. Prepare board meeting notices, agendas, resolutions, and minutes.

. Assist in organising Board and shareholder meetings, including AGMs and EGMs.

. Maintain statutory registers and minute books.

. Ensure compliance with the Companies Act, 2013 and applicable Secretarial Standards.

. Coordinate with directors and promoters for statutory approvals and documentation.

**4. Corporate Legal & Statutory Compliance**

. Track applicable corporate regulatory requirements.

. Assist in preparing shareholder agreements, resolutions, and corporate documents.

. Coordinate with statutory auditors, legal advisers, practising company secretaries, and consultants.

. Support company incorporation, changes in directorship, registered office changes, and modifications to company objects.

. Assist in maintaining compliance records across group entities.

**5. Fundraising & IPO Readiness**

. Support corporate documentation required for fundraising and investment transactions.

. Maintain accurate promoter shareholding and historical capital records.

. Assist with corporate due diligence and investor documentation.

. Coordinate with external advisers for IPO preparedness and corporate restructuring.

. Support implementation of corporate governance processes as the company expands.

**Qualifications & Experience**

1. Qualified Company Secretary (ACS / ICSI member) preferred.
2. CS Executive / Professional candidates may be considered for junior compliance-support roles.
3. 1–5 years of experience in company secretarial, ROC, and MCA compliance activities.
4. Practical experience with MCA V3 portal and statutory e-filings.
5. Working knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013.
6. Experience in share allotments, capital structure changes, and board documentation.
7. Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and compliance tracking.
8. Experience with multiple group companies is an advantage.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

1. Hands-on experience rather than only theoretical knowledge.
2. Capable of independently managing routine ROC and MCA compliance work.
3. Good understanding of shareholding, share capital, and promoter-related transactions.
4. Organised, detail-oriented, and capable of following up with multiple stakeholders.
5. Comfortable working in a growing company with multiple business verticals.
6. Prior experience in manufacturing, infrastructure, renewable energy, or an IPO-oriented company is an advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

1. 100% on-time ROC and MCA statutory filings.
2. No avoidable penalties due to delayed or incorrect filings.
3. Accurate and updated statutory registers and shareholding records.
4. Timely preparation of board resolutions and minutes.
5. Updated corporate compliance dashboard for all group companies.
6. Effective coordination with auditors, legal consultants, and management.
7. Compensation: Commensurate with qualifications, experience, and demonstrated practical knowledge.

title: Manager Indirect Tax Compliance
description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
At Amgen, if you feel like you are part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission - to serve patients living with serious illnesses - drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas - Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease - we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**Manager Indirect Tax Compliance**
**What You Will Do**
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. For this new role, we are seeking an Indirect Tax Compliance Manager to assist establishing a Center of Excellence (CoE) focused on VAT and GST compliance across multiple regions and managing Amgen’s VAT/GST compliance. This role is pivotal in shaping the future of indirect tax operations and driving compliance efficiency.
  
  
The successful candidate will be a strong team player with a passion for technology, automation, and process excellence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Compliance & Risk Management

+ Ensure accurate and timely VAT filings and reporting in line with global and regional regulations.
+ Monitor VAT/GST changes and assess impact on compliance processes and technology set-up.
+ Proactively manage risks and establish strong internal controls.
+ Partner with regional finance and tax to ensure local compliance requirements are met consistently.

* Technology & Process Transformation

+ Assist with implementation of automation tools and maintenance of an indirect tax engine to streamline VAT compliance processes.
+ Work on process improvements
+ Collaborate with IT and external vendors.

* Team & Stakeholder Collaboration

+ Act as a trusted collaborator to tax, finance, and business partners on VAT/GST compliance matters.

As Manager Indirect Tax Compliance you will be reporting to the Senior Manager Indirect Tax Compliance.
  
  
**Outputs**

* VAT / GST compliance filings and related payments
* Maintain indirect tax technology set-up
* Roll out process

**Qualifications**
The knowledge and skills necessary to perform the duties of this position are typically acquired through the following combination of education, experience and knowledge, or the equivalent.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* Doctorate degree and 5+ year of tax experience OR
* Master’s degree and 8+ years of tax experience OR
* Bachelor’s degree and 10 +years of tax experience

**Preferred Requirements**

* Academic degree or equivalent diploma in Accounting / Finance, Tax Law or Tax Economics
* A minimum of 5-6 years of experience in a VAT compliance and/or advisory role with an emphasis on supply chain/manufacturing within the Big Four accounting firms or within a financial/tax department of a large multi-national company
* Experience of EU VAT alongside a working knowledge of cross-border VAT/GST outside of EU is required
* Demonstrated capability to learn quickly, being open and flexible to changes, in a multi-national environment
* Attention to detail
* Pro-activeness in approach to problem solving and technical research
* Strong interpersonal skills, team player, and highly customer focused
* Strong computer skills with emphasis on SAP, S/4 Hana DRC and Vertex
* Experience in VAT and GST within an international VAT compliance team
* Experience in Pharmaceutical Industry
* High level in local language or any other major language

**Competencies**

* Demonstrates written and oral communication and collaboration skills
* Is results oriented and reliable
* Applies a customer focus to the compliance related activities
* Routinely analyses and solves problems
* Works accurately and detailed within a given deadline

title: Legal Associate
description:
**In-House Attorney**

**Company Overview**

Houzeo is a leading technology-driven real estate platform revolutionizing how homes are bought and sold across the United States. Our platform empowers homeowners with user-friendly tools, streamlining the property transaction process. We are seeking an In-House Attorney to join our legal team, focusing on compliance, legal research, and contract management.

**Position Overview**

The In-House Attorney will be responsible for overseeing compliance with U.S. real estate regulations, managing legal agreements, conducting legal research, and supporting day-to-day legal operations. The role demands strong analytical, drafting, and communication skills, along with the ability to collaborate across departments and engage with regulatory authorities.

**Key Responsibilities & Required Skills**

**1. Legal & Taxation Research**

• Conduct legal research on taxation and other laws.

• Analyze and interpret case law, statutes, and legal precedents relevant to real estate and corporate law.

• Ability to skim through large volumes of judgments efficiently and extract key insights.

• Demonstrated willingness to learn and adapt to new tax and compliance concepts.

**2. Contract Review & Risk Assessment**

• Review and draft corporate agreements, ensuring clarity, consistency in terminology, and legal soundness.

• Identify potential risks and liabilities in contracts, advising on necessary modifications.

• Ensure compliance with contract law principles and risk mitigation strategies.

• Maintain version control of agreements and track revisions for accuracy.

**3. Legal Drafting & General Legal Support**

• Draft and edit internal agreements such as employment contracts and company policies.

• Draft responses to regulatory authorities, MLS authorities, and external stakeholders using AI-driven legal prompts for precision and clarity.

• Apply general legal principles to internal legal operations and decision-making.

• Support various internal teams by providing legal guidance and ensuring compliance in business operations.

**4. Compliance Management**

• Maintain thorough documentation and audit trails for all compliance-related processes.

• Develop and implement compliance checklists for regular audits and reviews.

• Communicate effectively with MLS authorities via email, ensuring Houzeo adheres to all MLS compliance requirements.

• Manage and track compliance-related tasks across departments using task management tools.

• Conduct compliance meetings and coordinate with different teams on flexible schedules.

**5. Cross-Functional Coordination & Communication**

• Work directly with the CEO and collaborate across teams to ensure alignment with company policies and legal frameworks.

• Provide training and guidance on legal and compliance matters to internal stakeholders.

• Exhibit strong interpersonal skills to facilitate cooperation between departments.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

• LL.B. degree from a reputed law school (active bar membership is a plus).

• Fresh graduates with strong academic records are encouraged to apply.

• Proficiency in legal research databases.

• Strong drafting, analytical, and risk assessment skills.

• Understanding of contract law and real estate regulations.

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines.

• Technological proficiency in managing legal documentation and research.

• Prior corporate internship experience is highly preferred.

• Willingness to learn, adapt, and take a proactive approach to compliance and legal operations.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work in a fast-paced legal and compliance environment within a tech-driven real estate company. If you are looking for a challenging yet rewarding career, we invite you to apply.

Interested candidates kindly share your updated resume at
**yogini.alawani@houzeo.com**

Google's infrastructure needs go far beyond server computers. As Google's products and services scale the globe, the Strategic Negotiation team works behind the scenes to secure infrastructure for Google's future -- everything from underwater cables to physical data center space. Legal & Corporate Affairs

Mumbai

Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented
**Company Secretary**
to manage corporate governance, statutory compliance and transaction-related corporate documentation for our Capital House.
  
  
The role will involve working closely with the management, investment team, legal advisors, portfolio companies and other professional advisors to ensure that all corporate actions and investment transactions are properly structured, documented and compliant with applicable laws and regulations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities Corporate Secretarial & Compliance
  
  

* Manage all statutory and regulatory compliances under the Companies Act, 2013 and applicable regulations.
* Handle incorporation, alteration, share transfers, allotments, preferential issues, rights issues, private placements and other corporate actions.
* Prepare and maintain statutory registers, records and corporate documentation.
* Draft notices, agendas, minutes and resolutions for Board and General Meetings.
* Coordinate and assist in conducting Board Meetings, General Meetings and other corporate meetings.
* Ensure timely filing of statutory forms with the Registrar of Companies and other regulatory authorities.
* Maintain proper corporate records and documentation.

Investment & M&A Transactions
  
  

* Support the investment team on the legal and corporate secretarial aspects of investments and M&A transactions.
* Review corporate structures, shareholding patterns and capitalization tables of target companies.
* Conduct/coordinate corporate secretarial due diligence of target and portfolio companies.
* Review constitutional documents, shareholder agreements, investment agreements and other transaction documents from a corporate compliance perspective.
* Assist in structuring investments, acquisitions, share purchases and exits.
* Coordinate with external legal counsel, auditors, consultants and other transaction advisors.
* Ensure that required corporate approvals and filings are completed before and after transactions.
* Assist with documentation relating to acquisition, investment, divestment and restructuring transactions.

Portfolio Company Support
  
  

* Monitor corporate compliance of portfolio companies.
* Coordinate with the management/CS teams of portfolio companies regarding corporate actions and statutory matters.
* Track important compliance deadlines and corporate governance requirements.
* Assist the investment team in monitoring key corporate and governance matters within portfolio companies.

Governance & Risk
  
  

* Ensure appropriate corporate governance practices across the organization.
* Identify potential compliance and governance risks and escalate them to management.
* Maintain a compliance calendar and ensure timely completion of obligations.
* Keep management updated on relevant changes in corporate laws and regulations.

Candidate Profile
  
  

* Qualified Company Secretary (CS).
* 3–8 years of relevant experience in corporate secretarial, legal, investment, M&A, private equity, venture capital or corporate advisory environments.
* Strong knowledge of the Companies Act, SEBI regulations and applicable corporate laws.
* Experience with corporate actions, private placements, share transfers and investment transactions.
* Experience in M&A / investment transactions will be strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of corporate governance and transaction documentation.
* Excellent drafting, documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with management, investors, lawyers, auditors and external advisors.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple transactions simultaneously.

title: Senior Compliance Specialist
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
At Medtronic, we push the limits of what technology, therapies, and services can do to help alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. As a Senior Compliance Specialist, you will serve as a strategic compliance business partner responsible for supporting the development, implementation, and oversight of an effective compliance program that promotes ethical business conduct and mitigates compliance risks across commercial operations.
  
  
You will provide expert compliance guidance to business leaders and employees, support risk assessments and monitoring activities, oversee channel partner compliance programs, and help ensure adherence to company policies, industry codes, and applicable laws and regulations. The role requires the ability to influence stakeholders, balance business objectives with compliance requirements, and drive a strong culture of integrity throughout the organization.
  
  
This is an individual-contributor role and the position will be in Mumbai in India and has responsibility mainly for India Subcontinent (subject to changes). The position will report directly to the India Subcontinent Compliance Officer.
  
  
**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**
**Strategic Business Partnership**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to commercial and functional stakeholders on compliance and data privacy matters. Understand business strategies, operating models, commercial priorities, and emerging initiatives to provide timely and practical compliance guidance.
* Advise on Global Business Conduct Standards/Compliance Policy such as HCP/HCO interactions, sponsorships, educational grants, consulting arrangements, and promotional activities, in adherence with applicable laws, codes, regulations, and company policies.
* Clearly document compliance advice, risk assessments, approvals, exceptions, and agreed mitigation actions.
* Monitor regulatory and industry developments and support the implementation of relevant changes in policies, processes, systems, training, and business practices.
* Support the integration of privacy principles into business processes, digital initiatives, customer programs, vendor arrangements, and projects involving personal or sensitive data.
* Promote privacy-by-design principles by encouraging teams to consider data minimization, purpose limitation, appropriate access, retention, security, transparency, consent, and individual rights at the beginning of an initiative.

**Data Analytics and Risk Insights**

* Develop dashboards, metrics, and reports for management and compliance leadership to analyse trends.
* Translate analytical findings into clear risk insights, recommendations, and action plans for business and compliance stakeholders, for continuous improvement of the compliance program.
* Utilize data analytics to identify opportunities for process and control enhancements.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators supporting continuous improvement.
* Track remediation activities and evaluate whether implemented actions have appropriately addressed identified risks.

**Compliance Monitoring and Process Reviews**

* Support in developing and executing risk-based compliance monitoring plans aligned with country, business, and program priorities.
* Conduct risk-based compliance reviews and assessments, analyse findings, root causes and risk trends.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve compliance concerns and track timely closure.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, strengthen controls, improve documentation, and enhance the effectiveness of the Compliance Program.

**Third-Party Compliance**

* Support the third party compliance program for India SubCon such as due diligence, training, monitoring, remediations and lifecycle-management processes.
* Review third-party due-diligence / screening results, red flags, design appropriate remediations and supporting documentation.
* Conduct or support audits/monitoring, remediations, process assessments, and other risk-based oversight activities.

**Training**

* Support in design, develop, and deliver engaging compliance training for employees, managers, Business Units, functional teams, distributors, dealers, and other third parties.
* Tailor training and communication to the specific risks and promote awareness of compliance requirements, culture of integrity and ethical decision-making.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Requires advanced knowledge of job area combining breadth and depth, typically obtained through advanced education combined with experience. May have practical knowledge of project management.
* 7 to 10 years of relevant professional experience in ethics and compliance, legal, audit, investigations, risk management, data privacy, finance, internal controls, or a related discipline.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in the healthcare, medical-device, pharmaceutical, life-sciences, or another highly regulated industry.
* Knowledge of Indian healthcare compliance requirements, UCMPMD, data-protection requirements, and applicable anti-bribery and anti-corruption laws.
* Experience managing distributor, dealer, channel-partner, consultant, vendor, or other third-party compliance risks.
* Experience conducting investigations, monitoring activities, and compliance risk assessments.
* Proficiency in Excel and experience with Power BI, data visualization, dashboards, or other analytical tools.
* Relevant professional qualification or certification in compliance such as CCEP, law, audit, privacy such as CIPM, fraud examination, risk management, accounting, or data analytics.

**Physical Job Requirements**

title: Regulatory Capital Risk Sr. Lead Analyst, Senior Vice President
description:

In this role, you will lead independent review and challenge of ICAAPs and recovery plans for legal entities across Asia North and South, while also driving the governance framework that keeps the review function consistent and well controlled. Your assessments and credible challenge will directly inform how senior leaders and regulators view the capital strength of Citi's international legal entities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead independent review and challenge of ICAAPs and Local Recovery Plans for a portfolio of legal entities across Asia North and South, assessing capital adequacy and resilience against local regulatory expectations.
* Evaluate core ICAAP components, including risk identification, capital planning, economic capital, stress testing and recovery planning linkages, to identify emerging regulatory and capital risk themes.
* Present review conclusions and challenge findings to senior management and governance forums, and track remediation of identified issues through to completion.
* Own the governance framework for the regulatory capital review function, including the annual review plan, operating procedures and quality standards.
* Coordinate review planning and execution tracking across a global regulatory capital review portfolio to support consistent, on-time delivery.
* Manage issue tracking, recommendation follow-up and management reporting to support timely escalation and transparent governance.
* Partner with regional leads to coordinate regulatory examinations, internal audit reviews and quality assurance activities, maintaining a strong control environment.
* Build trusted relationships across Legal Entity CFO, Risk, Treasury and Capital Management teams to influence remediation plans and strengthen capital management practices.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* 12+ years of experience in regulatory capital, ICAAP, capital management, treasury, enterprise risk, internal audit or regulatory policy.
* Working knowledge of Basel regulatory capital frameworks, ICAAP requirements, stress testing and legal entity capital management.
* Background conducting independent review and challenge, regulatory examinations, internal audit reviews or second-line risk oversight.
* Experience managing governance, controls, issue tracking and regulatory engagement processes.
* Capability to assess complex capital adequacy frameworks and deliver credible challenge to senior stakeholders and governance forums.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills combined with proven project and stakeholder management capabilities across a global organization.
* Bachelor's degree and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

**Beneficial Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience applying data analytics techniques to support regulatory capital and risk assessments.
* Familiarity with reporting automation tools that streamline governance and management reporting.
* Exposure to data visualization platforms that enhance the presentation of review findings to stakeholders.

**What We Offer**
Join a global team at the center of Citi's regulatory capital risk oversight, where your judgment and expertise will directly influence how the firm safeguards capital resilience across international markets.
  
  

* Work in a hybrid model with three days in the office and two days working remotely each week.
* Collaborate with regulatory capital, treasury and risk colleagues across multiple regions and time zones.
* Shape governance standards and decision-making processes that influence legal entity capital strategy.
* Access ongoing learning and development opportunities to deepen expertise in regulatory capital frameworks.

title: Legal Executive (Real estate/construction/property)
description:
Company: Onecrest Infra
  
Job Title: Legal Executive
  
Location: Golf Course Road, Gurugram, India (On-site)
  
  
About OneCrest Infra
  
OneCrest Infra develops commercial and mixed-use real estate across Delhi NCR and North India. We acquire land, build, lease to corporate occupiers, and sell the completed pre-leased assets to investors. Our portfolio includes multiple Commercial and Healthcare developments mainly in North India . Every one of those transactions runs on paper — title chains, land records, agreements to sell, lease deeds, contractor agreements. This role is the in-house owner of that paper.
  
  
What This Role Actually Is
  
  
This is a property-focused role, not a general corporate compliance job. You will spend most of your time reading land records, assembling document sets, drafting agreements, and coordinating with our external counsel. Formal title opinions on acquisitions are issued by our external law firm. Your job is to do the first pass — pull and read the records, build the chain, spot the obvious problems early so we do not waste time and fees on a bad plot, and give external counsel a clean, complete file to work from. You will also draft and manage the bulk of our routine documentation in-house.You will work directly with the Chairman and with our project, finance, and site teams.
  
  
What Your Ideal Day Would Look Like
  
• Title & Land Records Research: Conduct property title searches, review revenue records, and demonstrate strong working knowledge of Khata, Khatauni, and Khasra numbers to trace land ownership and lineage.
  
• Due Diligence: Collect, organize, and read the property document set for land and built properties—prior deeds, approvals, mutation entries—building the chain of title and flagging gaps, encumbrances, pending litigation, and missing documents.
  
• Regulatory & Technical Compliance: Track and verify regulatory approvals including Completion Certificates (CC), Occupancy Certificates (OC), drawing approvals, Floor Area Ratio (FAR), zoning regulations, and filings like CLU, licences, HRERA, mutation, and EDC/IDC.
  
• Risk Mitigation: Identify obvious deal-breakers early and escalate them before spending further time or money on a site.
  
• External Counsel Coordination: Prepare the complete file for external counsel, brief them clearly, and follow through on their queries until the title opinion is issued; support legal notices, recovery correspondence, and dispute matters.
  
• Transactional & Corporate Drafting: Draft and review Agreements to Sell, Sale Deeds, MOUs, and Development Agreements using firm-approved formats (buyer and seller side).
  
• Leasing: Draft and review commercial lease deeds for corporate tenants covering lock-in, escalation, security deposit, fit-out, exit, and renewal terms.
  
• Contracts & Vendor Documentation: Draft and review contractor agreements, works contracts, consultancy agreements, and vendor documentation.
  
• Financials & Registration: Handle stamp duty computation, land duties, registration, and coordination at Sub-Registrar offices across Haryana, Delhi, and Punjab.
  
• Record Keeping & Fieldwork: Maintain an organised, retrievable record of every contract, deed, notice, approval, and ongoing matter; visit tehsil record rooms, Sub-Registrar offices, and project sites when required.
  
  
Eligibility
  
Education
  
\* LLB from a recognised institution
  
• Enrolment with a State Bar Council preferred (useful for searches and Vakala Namas, not mandatory)
  
  
Experience
  
\* 2–4 years in property, real estate, or construction legal work — with a developer, a real estate group's in-house team, or a firm with a property practice
  
• Hands-on exposure to title document review and property transaction drafting. General corporate or litigation experience alone will not be a fit.
  
Must-Have Skills
  
Land Records and Title
  
• Ability to read and interpret Revenue records: jamabandi, fard, mutation (intkal), khasra–khatauni, aks shajra, girdawari
  
• Working knowledge of Delhi/NCR property documentation: conveyance deeds, GPA/SPA chains and their limitations, freehold vs leasehold, L&DO and DDA processes, MCD mutation
  
• Ability to trace a chain of title across successive transfers and identify breaks, gaps, and unexplained transfers
  
• Ability to obtain and read encumbrance certificates and run Sub-Registrar index searches
  
Regulatory - Haryana and NCR
  
• Working familiarity with all the Authorities including DDA, Noida Authority, the Haryana Development and Regulation of Urban Areas Act, 1975 — licensing, CLU, EDC/IDC
  
• Working familiarity with HRERA registration, disclosures, and ongoing compliance
  
• Basic understanding of DTCP approvals and building plan sanction processes
  
Drafting and Documentation
  
\* Excellent written English. You will draft documents that go to institutional buyers, banks, and corporate tenants. Grammar, clause construction, and precision are non-negotiable and will be tested.
  
• Ability to draft a complete agreement from a standard format and adapt it accurately to the facts of the deal
  
• Sharp eye for clauses, risks, ambiguity, and inconsistency in documents drafted by the other side
  
• Stamp duty and registration procedure across Haryana and Delhi
  
Working Style
  
• Organised and reliable — you will be the single point of custody for our documentation
  
• Able to run a matter to completion and follow up with external counsel without being chased
  
• Comfortable raising a concern early rather than discovering it late
  
• Willing to travel within NCR and to Punjab for site and record-room work
  
What Will Make You Stand Out
  
• Experience on the seller side of pre-leased or investment-grade asset sales
  
• Experience in the know-how of working online with the Govt portals
  
• Experience in Lease deeds, sale deeds , ATS and other drafts
  
• Prior work on due-diligence in Delhi/NCR
  
• Experience with hospital, hotel, or retail chain occupier lease deeds
  
• Prior work on land aggregation or acquisition from multiple co-owners or legal heirs
  
  
What's In It For You
  
You will be the in-house legal function for a company that transacts constantly. Direct access to the Chairman, visibility on every acquisition, and exposure across the full lifecycle — land purchase, construction contracts, leasing, and exit. You will work alongside a reputed external law firm and learn from their opinions on live deals. As the company grows, this role grows with it.
  
  
Apply
  
If you are a property lawyer who reads land records comfortably and drafts cleanly, we would like to hear from you.Join OneCrest Infra as a Legal Executive.

title: Indirect Tax Specialist
description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
The Indirect Tax Specialist will support the organization in managing indirect tax compliance, audits, litigation, advisory, research and tax risk management activities. The role will involve coordinating with internal stakeholders, external consultants, and tax authorities to ensure timely compliance with applicable GST and other indirect tax laws while supporting business operations through effective tax guidance.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* GST Compliances: Collate and assess the data for GST return filing and coordinate with tax consultants and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate filing of GST returns and compliance with statutory requirements.
* GST Audits, Assessments & Investigations: Support GST audits, departmental inquiries, assessments, investigations and information requests from tax authorities. Coordinate collection, validation, and submission of data and documents required during audits and assessments. Track audit observations and ensure timely closure of action items.
* Litigation Management: Assist in handling GST disputes and litigation matters, including preparation of responses to notices, show cause notices, audit observations, and departmental communications. Coordinate with internal teams, consultants, and legal counsels for representation before tax authorities. Maintain litigation trackers and ensure timely submission of responses and appeals.
* Tax Advisory & Business Support: Provide day-to-day GST guidance to business, finance, procurement, logistics, and commercial teams on indirect tax matters. Support tax impact assessments for business transactions, contractual arrangements, supply chain changes, and new business initiatives. Assist in evaluating indirect tax implications of business decisions and recommend compliant solutions.
* Tax Research & Technical Analysis: Conduct research on GST laws, notifications, circulars, advance rulings, and judicial precedents. Analyze changes in tax legislation and assess their impact on business operations. Prepare technical notes, tax positions, and management updates on significant indirect tax developments.
* Process Improvement & Risk Management: Identify indirect tax risks and opportunities for process improvements. Support implementation and enhancement of tax controls and compliance processes.
* Training & Stakeholder Management: Support delivery of GST awareness and training sessions for internal stakeholders. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure tax requirements are appropriately considered in business processes.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in GST audits, litigation, compliances and indirect tax advisory.
* CA Inter or LLB qualification will be an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of GST law, e-invoicing, e-way bill, input tax credit provisions and audit/litigation procedures.
* Strong preference will be given to candidates with prior experience at a Big Four accounting/advisory firm.

title: VP-Risk Management
description:

* Expertise in regulatory frameworks, including Federal Bank regulators, global supervisory authorities and industry guidance
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders across risk, procurement, legal, cybersecurity, compliance, finance and technology
* Strong data governance and reporting skills, including establishing authoritative sources, defining quality standards, and building dashboards and key risk indicators
* Excellent communication, relationship building, and change leadership capabilities with the ability to drive adoption across global teams
* Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree required
* Advanced degree in business, risk, compliance or related field preferred

**Responsibilities**
Work alongside the Third Party Risk Management Program Office Lead within the Procurement function to drive a centralized Third Party Risk Management capability enabling consistent risk-aware oversight of Moody's global third-party relationships.
  
  

* Assist in designing and implementing the enterprise third party risk management operating model, integrating policies, standards and controls across the third-party lifecycle
* Help build the Third Party Risk Management Program Office team by supporting recruitment, onboarding, and team development efforts
* Develop workflows, dashboards, and service level agreements, ensuring stakeholder adoption to drive operational efficiency
* Assist in defining roles, responsibilities, and handoffs across first line and second line teams to ensure accountability and consistent execution
* Prepare materials, metrics and insights for the Third Party Risk Management Steering Committee, senior leadership and audit committees, aligning priorities and reporting progress

**About The Team**
Our Third Party Risk Management Program Office team sits within the Procurement function and is responsible for building and maturing a centralized, enterprise-wide third party risk management capability at Moody's. We drive consistent risk-aware onboarding, oversight, and monitoring of global third-party relationships, ensuring alignment with regulatory expectations and internal risk frameworks across multiple jurisdictions. By joining our team, you will help shape the strategic vision of a best-in-class Third Party Risk Management function, working across risk, legal, compliance, cybersecurity, finance and technology to deliver transparency, operational resilience, and responsible governance of Moody's global third-party ecosystem.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. * Risk Assessment & Management – Conduct regular risk assessments to identify potential areas of non-compliance; recommend and monitor preventive and corrective actions.

* Investigation & Remediation – Investigate potential compliance breaches, implement corrective measures, and ensure preventive actions are in place.
* Management Assurance – Provide periodic assurance to senior management on the overall compliance status, highlighting key risks, corrective actions taken, and areas requiring attention.

Secondary duties and responsibilities:

* Collaboration with Departments – Coordinate with internal teams and external consultants to ensure compliance adherence across all business operations.
* Training & Awareness – Facilitate training sessions and awareness programs for employees regarding regulatory requirements and internal policies.
* Monitoring Regulatory Changes – Track updates in laws and regulations; ensure timely amendments to policies and procedures.
* Audit Support – Assist in internal and external audits, ensuring compliance issues are addressed and audit recommendations implemented.
* Continuous Improvement – Identify trends, recurring issues, or process gaps; recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce risk exposure.

Qualification & Experience:

* Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

title: Executive - Finance
description:
About us Holiday Tribe is a Great Place To Work Certified travel-tech company headquartered in Gurugram. Backed by leading VC firms like Powerhouse Ventures and GSF, and having recently raised pre series A funding, we are growing rapidly and setting the stage for the next phase of scale. We specialize in curated leisure travel experiences across 30+ global destinations, combining deep human expertise with a bold vision of building cutting-edge AI and technology that will transform how Indians plan and experience their holidays. Recognized as the Emerging Holiday Tech Company at the India Travel Awards 2023, we ve also partnered with international tourism boards to bring world-class experiences to Indian travelers. At our core, we are a fun, performance-driven workplace on a mission to build the next big thing in travel - making holiday planning faster, smarter, and unforgettable. 
 Role Overview We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Finance Executive to join our Finance & Accounts team. The ideal candidate will have strong accounting fundamentals and hands-on experience managing Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), reconciliations, and statutory compliance. This role requires excellent organizational skills, accuracy, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Accounts Payable (AP) - Process vendor invoices, purchase orders, and payment runs accurately and on time. - Verify supporting documents, tax applicability, and approval workflows. - Monitor vendor outstanding balances and ensure timely payments. - Perform vendor reconciliations and resolve discrepancies proactively. 
 Accounts Receivable (AR) - Generate sales orders and invoices and track customer collections. - Follow up on outstanding receivables and prepare aging reports. - Reconcile customer accounts and ensure accurate receipt allocation. - Support credit control processes to minimize overdue payments. 
 General Accounting & Reporting - Record journal entries, accruals, and accounting adjustments in compliance with accounting standards. - Perform bank, vendor, and customer reconciliations on a periodic basis. - Assist in month-end and year-end closing activities. - Prepare MIS reports and dashboards related to AP, AR, and overall financial performance. 
 Compliance & Audit - Maintain accurate documentation and records for audit readiness. - Support internal and external audits by providing schedules, reconciliations, and relevant financial information. - Ensure compliance with GST, TDS, TCS, and other statutory requirements. 
 Required Qualifications 
 - Bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field. - Minimum 2 years of accounting experience with a strong focus on Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable. - Hands-on experience with Zoho Books or similar accounting software. - Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. - Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting. - Good working knowledge of GST, TDS, TCS, and statutory compliances. - Strong attention to detail and accuracy. - Good communication and stakeholder management skills. - Ability to collaborate effectively with vendors, customers, and internal teams. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) - Accurate processing of invoices with zero errors in GST, TDS, and TCS application. - Timely execution of vendor payments and resolution of vendor queries. - Consistent tracking and recovery of outstanding receivables. - Completion of bank, vendor, and customer reconciliations within defined timelines. - Timely preparation and submission of MIS reports and financial data. - Compliance with statutory and audit requirements without delays or discrepancies.

title: Accounting Manager (CA / CFA)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Accounting Manager, a CA or CFA with 8 to 9 years of experience, to build and run the finance function of OmniDEL.ai, a fast-growing AI startup in New Town, Kolkata. This role goes well beyond bookkeeping and compliance. 
 You will set up financial systems from scratch, prepare reports for investors, manage budgets across projects, and make sure all statutory work is done correctly. You will work directly with the founders, external auditors, and board members. 
 You should also be comfortable using AI in your work. We use AI for everything, including finance. You will be expected to try out and bring in AI tools for things like automatic reconciliation, expense classification, cash flow forecasting, and live dashboards. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Financial Planning and Strategy Run the yearly budget and the rolling forecast for the whole company Compare actual spending against the budget for each department and project, and share monthly variance reports with clear suggestions for leadership Build financial models for fundraising, scenario planning, and key decisions Work with the founders on unit economics, pricing, and cost control 
 Accounting and Operations Handle the full accounting cycle: invoicing, receivables, payables, bank reconciliations, and month-end close Maintain the chart of accounts and make sure revenue, costs, and expenses are recorded correctly Set up and enforce internal financial controls suited to a growing startup Manage vendor payments, employee expenses, and reimbursements 
 AI in Finance Lead the use of AI tools in finance, such as automatic data extraction, smart matching, error detection, and automated reports Work with the engineering team to connect financial data with our internal platform where needed Keep finding and using AI tools that reduce manual work and improve accuracy 
 Compliance and Statutory Work File all statutory returns on time and correctly: GST, TDS, Income Tax, Professional Tax, and ESI/PF where applicable Keep complete records ready for audits and inspections Track changes in regulations and explain their impact to leadership Coordinate with external auditors for the yearly audit and ensure clean results 
 Investor and Board Reporting Prepare monthly, quarterly, and yearly financial reports for the board and investors Keep financial records clean and well organised for Series A due diligence Answer investor questions on finance, covenants, and reporting 
 Cash Flow and Treasury Forecast and track cash flow every week and every month Manage working capital, receivables ageing, and payment schedules Plan fund requirements for project spending with the team 
 Team and Collaboration Work closely with the founders to keep financial plans in line with business goals Work with project leads to keep budgets on track and close project finances on time Guide and manage junior finance staff as the team grows 
 Requirements 
 CA or CFA is mandatory 8 to 9 years of experience after qualification 2 to 3 years in a startup or fast-growing company is strongly preferred Strong knowledge of Indian GAAP, GST, TDS, Income Tax, and company law compliance Good working knowledge of Zoho Books, QuickBooks, or Tally, and advanced Excel or Google Sheets Hands-on experience with financial modelling and budgeting Real interest in AI tools, for example using Python for financial analysis, making reports with AI assistants, or using AI for data extraction and reconciliation. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be curious and willing to try things yourself. 
 Good to Have 
 Experience in an AI, SaaS, or technology company Experience with investor reports, board packs, and fundraising due diligence Experience setting up or moving to a new ERP system Experience working with multiple entities or a group structure 
 What We Look For in You 
 You understand why a process exists and improve it, instead of just following it You take full ownership of your work. No task is too small for you You are open to new ideas but strict about accuracy You learn new tools and business models quickly You are curious about how AI can make your work smarter and less manual 
 Why Join Us 
 Build from scratch: You will create the finance system, not inherit an old one Right timing: We are past seed and heading to Series A, so your work will directly shape investor confidence and company value Direct access: You will work with the founders, investors, and board members Learn AI every day: AI is our product, our culture, and our toolkit Real impact: Your decisions affect thousands of informal sector workers who earn their living through our platform 
 Salary and Benefits 
 80,000 to 1,00,000 per month, based on experience and qualifications Performance-linked incentives Possible equity (to be discussed) Office in New Town, Kolkata Chance to grow into a leadership role as the company grows

description:
The Role We are looking for a Senior Manager to own and lead three connected disciplines: Cloud Security, IAM, and the Security Operations Center (Detection & Response) . You will manage and grow engineers and leads across these areas, set technical direction, and be the accountable owner for how Harness secures its cloud infrastructure, controls access to it, and detects and responds to threats against it. This is a player-coach role. You are expected to go deep technically, make architecture calls, and also build the team, the operating cadence, and the metrics that show security maturity improving quarter over quarter. What You Will Do Cloud Security Own the security architecture and posture of Harnesss multi-cloud and Kubernetes-based production environments, including network segmentation, workload isolation, secrets management, and hardened baselines. Drive secure-by-default infrastructure through policy-as-code (e.g., OPA), guardrails in CI/CD, and continuous posture management. Partner with Platform and SRE on dedicated-tenant and customer-hosted deployment models, including the controls that make those models safe at enterprise scale. Support the security of customer-facing runtime components such as the Harness Delegate, including token scoping, least-privilege execution, and containment of compromised components. Identity & Access Management Own the workforce and workload identity strategy: SSO, MFA, privileged access, just-in-time access, service-account and machine-identity lifecycle, and access reviews. Advance Zero Trust principles across internal systems and production, using a central authority model with human-in-the-loop approvals for high-risk actions. Reduce standing privilege and credential sprawl; make least privilege measurable and auditable. Security Operations & Detection Engineering Lead the SOC and Detection Engineering function: detection coverage, alert quality, triage, incident response, and on-call readiness.  Role: Sr Manager/ AD- Product Management, Bangalore

 Job Summary 
 We are seeking an experienced product leader to drive the strategy and development of technology-enabled learning products. The role will focus on understanding user needs, shaping product experiences, defining roadmaps and validating innovations through research and data. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the individual will translate insights into scalable, user-centric products that improve learning experiences and outcomes. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 1. Product Strategy, Discovery & Problem Framing Lead product discovery and problem definition, drawing on user research, programme insights and field realities. Identify user needs, pain points, constraints and opportunities across learners, educators and other stakeholders. Conduct user interviews, stakeholder consultations and field immersions to validate problem statements. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into clear product opportunities and solution directions. Ensure product strategy is aligned with organisational priorities, user needs and intended learning outcomes. 2. Product Experience & Journey Ownership Own end-to-end user journeys, from exploration and decision-making to learning and career transitions. Define experience principles, product flows and interaction requirements across digital platforms and supporting touchpoints. Work closely with UX and Learning Experience Design teams to create intuitive, engaging and accessible experiences. Identify friction points affecting user engagement, retention, completion and learning outcomes. Champion learner- and educator-centric design, particularly for users in low-resource and diverse learning environments. 3. Product Definition & Execution Translate product opportunities into clear product requirements, PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria. Define feature scope, expected outcomes, dependencies and success measures. Collaborate with Engineering and Design teams to assess feasibility and ensure effective product delivery. Guide teams through product trade-offs while maintaining focus on user value and strategic priorities. Ensure alignment between product requirements, content experiences, technology and programme implementation. 4. Product Roadmap & Prioritisation Develop and manage the product roadmap in alignment with strategic objectives and user needs. Prioritise initiatives based on user value, learning outcomes, organisational priorities and evidence from research and experimentation. Balance immediate product improvements with long-term product vision and scalability. Continuously review and refine priorities based on user behaviour, performance data and emerging insights. Build stakeholder alignment around product direction, timelines, priorities and trade-offs. 5. Product Analytics, Experimentation & Validation Partner with Analytics and Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) teams to define product success metrics, behavioural indicators and learning outcomes. Drive data-informed product decisions through user behaviour analysis, feedback and performance insights. Design and oversee A/B testing, usability studies, pilots and other product experiments. Establish hypotheses, validation criteria and measurement frameworks for new features and initiatives. Interpret experiment findings and translate them into actionable product recommendations. Identify whether challenges are related to product design, content quality or implementation, and use evidence to determine appropriate interventions. 6. Innovation & Product Governance Lead product-related contributions to innovation frameworks, validation processes and stage-gate reviews. Define MVP assumptions, learning questions and validation criteria for new product opportunities. Work with Programme, Product Operations, Analytics and Knowledge Management teams to assess and validate innovations. Use evidence from pilots and experiments to determine whether initiatives should be scaled, refined, redesigned or discontinued. Contribute to portfolio reviews, innovation assessments and strategic product decisions. Ensure that product innovations are supported by clear adoption, engagement, learning and impact measures. 7. Experience Quality & Continuous Improvement Establish and maintain standards for usability, accessibility, consistency and overall product experience. Monitor product health indicators and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Work with Design, Engineering and Learning Experience Design teams to improve product quality and user satisfaction. Ensure product experiences remain simple, relevant and effective across different user groups and operating contexts. 8. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Provide strategic direction and functional leadership across product experience initiatives. Build strong working relationships with cross-functional teams, senior stakeholders and external partners. Facilitate collaboration between Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics and Programme teams. Drive clarity, accountability and alignment in complex and evolving product environments. Mentor team members and contribute to building a culture of user-centricity, experimentation and evidence-based decision-making. 
 
 Required Experience & Skills 
 6+ years of relevant experience in product management or product development, preferably within learning applications, EdTech or digital learning platforms. Demonstrated experience in product discovery, product strategy, UX-driven development and end-to-end product ownership. Strong understanding of user research methodologies, journey mapping, problem framing and experience design. Experience designing, conducting and interpreting A/B tests, usability studies, pilots and product validation experiments. Proven ability to take products, features or innovations from concept through validation, iteration and scale. Experience developing product roadmaps, defining requirements, writing PRDs and prioritising product initiatives. Strong analytical skills and the ability to use behavioural, engagement and learning data to inform product decisions. Experience working with cross-functional teams across Design, Learning Experience Design, Analytics, Engineering and Programme functions. Ability to distinguish between product, content and implementation challenges through research and evidence. Familiarity with MVP development, innovation frameworks, experimentation methodologies and stage-gate processes. Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities and drive outcomes in dynamic environments. Prior experience in education, skilling, employability, youth development or social impact is preferred.
