Powered by advanced tech tools and unique data-gathering approaches, 1Lattice is an integrated product suite to make decisions smartly, right from Inputs to Validation to Execution to Measurement. 1Lattice works with clients and partners globally, helping clients solving a wide variety of organizational and business challenges through actionable research-led insights. The foremost responsibility of this role is to drive account growth, client retention, and project profitability. You will be expected to seamlessly own and nurture existing client accounts for repeat and continued business, identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing accounts, and ensure sustained client engagement. In addition, you will support the Director in business development activities, including proposal development, solutioning, and other pre-sales initiatives. Apart from ensuring account continuity and growth, you will also be responsible for the profitability of your projects by effectively managing direct and indirect costs. You will further contribute towards the development and enhancement of product offerings and capabilities within 1Lattice. This role will be expected to develop close connections and relationships with senior level executives across the BFSI (Wealth & Investment Management) space. This will require building and developing a wide network in the industry and leading interactions with them, playing a significant role in influencing their thinking, identifying potential project leads / opportunities / proposals and driving them to closure. This will also involve ensuring high quality project delivery through your teams to ensure high client satisfaction and repeat business. This position will lead and drive delivery teams of 10+ members in the BFSI (Wealth & Investment Management) department for 1Lattice, including senior members who will be responsible for project delivery, and mid-junior levels for execution. This will involve supervising and guiding the research process and generating insights that help clients make critical business decisions across key sub-verticals within BFSI - Wealth & Investment Management. You will also play a very important leadership role internally - to grow and engage your team and align them to the 1Lattcie culture. As such, your teams success will also enhance your own personal results. You will support and promote the 1Lattice culture by motivating your team members, train them and help them develop their skills, showcase their talents, make them feel part of the 1Lattice family, and overall helping them grow professionally. As such, you will be responsible for both their growth as well as overall happiness. Roles and responsibilities: Ensuring sustained growth and profitability of existing accounts through effective account farming, client retention, and identification of expansion opportunities within key accounts. Driving business continuity with existing clients, ensuring repeat business and long-term engagement from key accounts. Supporting the Director in business development activities, including proposal development, solutioning, client discussions, and other pre-sales initiatives. Driving sectoral marketing, industry visibility, representing the 1Lattice brand, and supporting lead generation and conversion initiatives. End-to-end ownership of project scoping and delivery by leading high-impact teams and ensuring overall client satisfaction and engagement. Driving thought leadership in projects and coming up with compelling approaches, frameworks, and solutions to client problems. Managing team growth and satisfaction - be responsible for their success as well as build a strong team culture. Play an active role in recruitment and build project delivery teams in your vertical. Competencies and skills: Deep understanding of the BFSI (Wealth & Investment Management) domain, including wealth management, asset management, and capital markets-linked segments. Proven experience in business research / consulting / data services, with a minimum of 8+ years of experience leading and managing teams in the BFSI, Wealth Management, Asset Management, or Investment Management industry. Strong and credible industry relationships with the ability to manage senior stakeholder conversations, drive account growth within existing clients, understand client needs, and develop trusted relationships. Ability to create impactful proposals for specific projects with a tailored approach and support business development initiatives for maximum conversions. Demonstrated ability to execute and project manage large-scale projects from beginning to completion, with a strong orientation to planning work, defining scope and approach for assignments, and driving work through teams with high efficiency. Strong team management skills: building a strong team culture, driving high impact and efficiency, and ensuring team growth and happiness. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, deriving insights from data and conversations. Excellent communication skills, both written (slide / text output) and verbal (client presentations).

title: Head Procurement And Supply Chain
description:
Head Sourcing, Procurement & NPD 
 Reports to: Chief Operating Officer 
 Function: Sourcing, Procurement & NPD 
 Type: Full-time, Senior Leadership 
 
 Location- Okhla phase 2 
 About the Role 
We are looking for a senior leader to own and build our Sourcing & Procurement function, with a strong focus on domestic sourcing, vendor development, supplier relationships, cost optimization, and supply-base strategy.
 This is a 90% Sourcing & Procurement and 10% New Product Development role. The primary mandate is to build a strong, competitive, reliable, and scalable domestic vendor ecosystem that can support the companys growth while delivering the right balance of cost, quality, capability, capacity, and speed.
 You will own the vendor ecosystem end-to-end from market discovery and vendor identification to qualification, negotiation, onboarding, contracting, performance management, and long-term relationship building.
 The role will also require you to develop a deep understanding of the domestic supplier market, manufacturing capabilities, emerging vendors, cost structures, materials, and competitive landscape. You will work closely with R&D, Design, Business, Marketing, and Operations teams to bring market and sourcing intelligence into product and business decisions.
 The ideal candidate will have an engineering foundation, strong commercial instincts, deep domestic sourcing experience, and a proven track record of building and managing vendor ecosystems in consumer products / hardgoods / durables.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Domestic Sourcing & Procurement Core Responsibility 
Own the end-to-end domestic sourcing and procurement function across product categories, components, packaging, materials, and other business requirements.
 Develop and execute a domestic sourcing strategy aligned with business growth, cost, quality, capacity, and supply continuity.
 Identify and develop new domestic suppliers and manufacturing partners across relevant product categories.
 Build a strong understanding of the Indian supplier and manufacturing ecosystem including clusters, capabilities, capacities, technologies, material availability, and cost structures. Continuously benchmark the market to identify better suppliers, alternate sources, new manufacturing capabilities, and cost-efficient opportunities.
 Develop a robust and diversified supplier base to reduce single-vendor dependency and supply-chain risks.
 Own supplier qualification, commercial evaluation, capability assessment, audits, trials, pilot runs, and onboarding.
 Lead commercial negotiations covering pricing, MOQ, payment terms, lead times, tooling, quality standards, SLAs, warranties, and other commercial terms.
 Drive year-on-year cost optimization through supplier negotiations, alternate sourcing, value engineering, localization, and volume consolidation.
 Develop long-term strategic relationships with key suppliers rather than operating purely through transactional purchase orders.
 Ensure critical vendors have appropriate capacity planning, backup arrangements, and business continuity plans.
 Monitor vendor performance across cost, quality, delivery, responsiveness, capacity, and service levels.
 Establish vendor scorecards and conduct regular supplier performance reviews.
 Work closely with Finance and Operations to improve working capital, payment terms, inventory efficiency, and landed cost.
 Ensure timely availability of materials and products while balancing cost, quality, inventory, and working capital.
 2. Vendor Management & Relationship Development 
Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with strategic domestic vendors and manufacturing partners.
 Act as the senior escalation point for critical vendor issues and commercial negotiations.
 Develop a structured vendor segmentation and relationship-management framework based on strategic importance, spend, capability, and risk.
 Regularly visit vendor and manufacturing facilities to understand capacity, processes, quality systems, infrastructure, and scalability.
 Identify opportunities to jointly improve cost, quality, productivity, lead time, and product capability with strategic suppliers.
 Develop a strong network of manufacturers, component suppliers, material suppliers, packaging partners, and other ecosystem players.
 3. Market Intelligence & Competitive Mapping 
Develop a strong understanding of the domestic market, supplier ecosystem, manufacturing trends, materials, technologies, and competitive developments.
 Continuously map the market to identify new vendors, emerging manufacturing capabilities, alternate materials, and cost opportunities.
 Conduct competitor and category mapping to understand product offerings, specifications, pricing, materials, features, sourcing patterns, and market gaps.
 Work closely with Business and Marketing teams to translate market intelligence into sourcing and product opportunities.
 Track competitor launches and product developments to identify potential white spaces and sourcing opportunities.
 Build and maintain a database of vendors, manufacturers, capabilities, pricing benchmarks, materials, and market intelligence.
 4. R&D, Research & Product Intelligence 
Work closely with the R&D and Design teams to evaluate the feasibility, manufacturability, cost, and sourcing implications of new product concepts.
 Support R&D teams in identifying appropriate materials, components, technologies, and manufacturing partners.
 Engage with external research agencies, market research firms, testing agencies, and technical partners wherever required to gather consumer, category, product, or technical intelligence.
 Coordinate with research agencies for market studies, competitor research, product benchmarking, consumer insights, and category mapping.
 Bring external market and supplier intelligence into internal product and sourcing decisions.
 Identify new technologies, materials, suppliers, and manufacturing processes that can create a competitive advantage.
 5. New Product Development Supporting Responsibility
Partner with R&D, Design, and Engineering teams to support the transition of products from concept to prototype to production.
 Identify suitable vendors for prototyping, sampling, tooling, pilot production, and eventual scale-up.
 Provide sourcing and commercial inputs during product development, including cost, MOQ, lead time, manufacturability, material availability, and supplier capability.
 Participate in DFM discussions and help identify opportunities for cost-effective and scalable manufacturing.
 Support the NPD calendar by ensuring vendor development, sampling, tooling, and sourcing activities are completed within committed timelines.
 Ensure products are developed with a clear understanding of commercial viability, supply availability, and production scalability.
 6. Procurement Strategy, Systems & Governance 
Build scalable procurement processes, systems, SOPs, approval mechanisms, and dashboards.
 Establish clear procurement controls around vendor selection, quotations, negotiations, purchase orders, contracts, and supplier performance.
 Develop procurement MIS covering spend, savings, supplier performance, lead times, quality, risks, and open requirements.
 Establish clear benchmarks for cost, quality, delivery, and supplier performance.
 Identify opportunities for vendor consolidation, localization, alternate sourcing, and strategic buying.
 Ensure procurement decisions are data-driven and aligned with overall business objectives.
 7. Leadership 
Build, mentor, and lead the Sourcing & Procurement team.
 Create a high-performance culture focused on commercial ownership, vendor relationships, market knowledge, and execution.
 Establish clear ownership and accountability across sourcing, procurement, vendor development, and NPD support.
 Work cross-functionally with R&D, Design, Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, and Marketing.
 Bring commercial and supply-side thinking into business and product decisions.
 What You Bring 
 B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial, or a related engineering discipline; MBA is a plus. 
 1015 years of experience in Sourcing, Procurement, Vendor Development, Strategic Buying, or Supply Chain, preferably within consumer products, hardgoods, durables, lifestyle, home, kids, or similar categories.
 Strong hands-on experience in domestic sourcing and supplier development in India.
 Proven experience in building and managing a large domestic vendor ecosystem.
 Strong understanding of Indian manufacturing clusters, supplier markets, materials, production capabilities, and cost structures.
 Demonstrated expertise in vendor negotiation, commercial contracting, cost reduction, supplier qualification, and vendor performance management.
 Strong vendor relationships and the ability to identify and develop new suppliers and manufacturing partners.
 Ability to understand products from both a technical and commercial perspective.
 Strong market intelligence and competitor-mapping capabilities.
 Experience working with R&D, Design, Engineering, Marketing, and external research agencies will be highly valuable.
 Strong understanding of landed cost, COGS, MOQ, payment terms, lead times, tooling, capacity, quality, and supplier economics.
 Willingness to travel regularly across India to vendor and manufacturing locations.
 A builder's mindset hands-on, commercially sharp, structured, relationship-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-growing environment.
 What Success Looks Like 
A strong and diversified domestic supplier ecosystem with minimal critical single-vendor dependency.
 A continuously expanding network of qualified and competitive domestic vendors.
 Strong, long-term relationships with strategic suppliers.
 Measurable year-on-year improvement in procurement costs and COGS without compromising quality.
 Improved vendor performance across cost, quality, capacity, and delivery.
 Better visibility into the Indian supplier and manufacturing market.
 A structured database and intelligence system covering vendors, capabilities, costs, materials, competitors, and market opportunities.
 Faster identification and onboarding of new vendors for capacity, cost, capability, and innovation.
 Strong collaboration between Procurement, R&D, Design, Business, and Marketing.
 New product initiatives supported by real-time sourcing, cost, feasibility, and market intelligence.
 A procurement function that is scalable, process-driven, commercially disciplined, and capable of supporting the company's next phase of growth.

title: Delivery & Release Coordinator (UAT and Quality) - IFS Logistics
description:
Job Description About IFS Logistics IFS Logistics is an AI enterprise logistics platform that helps shippers and logistics businesses connect transport data, manage carrier spend and automate execution. Originally launched as 7bridges, the product is now part of IFS and is developed by a small, dedicated team. The role We are looking for a Delivery & Release Coordinator to manage user acceptance testing, release activity and day-to-day delivery coordination across the product team. The team is preparing for its first IFS Cloud customer go-live, bringing a new API into production and recruiting a significant number of new colleagues. As the pace of delivery increases, we need clear ownership of test cycles, defects, release readiness and communication. You will coordinate UAT with customers and internal stakeholders, maintain release plans and checklists, track defects through to resolution and support go/no-go decisions. You will work closely with Lorraine Hassall, our Quality Manager, allowing her to focus on quality standards and strategy while you manage the practical coordination required to apply them consistently. Most of the role is focused on UAT, releases and delivery. It also includes a smaller amount of team coordination, particularly onboarding, in-person sessions, travel planning, and financial coordination. What youll work on UAT and release management Plan and coordinate UAT cycles with customers and internal stakeholders. Confirm scope, participants, test windows, evidence and sign-off for each cycle. Track defects from identification through triage, ownership, resolution and closure. Support on the release calendar, release notes, readiness checklist and go/no-go process. Coordinate with other teams in IFS as the product is integrated with IFS Cloud. Support the UAT and release plan for Project Oliver and the first IFS Cloud customer go-live. Supporting the quality function Work with the Quality Manager on test processes, evidence and audit trails. Help apply standards such as clear acceptance criteria, merge-request review and controlled production releases. Support the move from periodic manual QA towards per-ticket quality assurance and more frequent releases. Delivery coordination Keep Jira accurate, with current statuses, acceptance criteria and links to relevant merge requests. Maintain useful documentation and decision records in Notion. Prepare concise delivery and release updates for product and engineering leads. Identify risks early, clarify ownership and follow actions through to completion. Team coordination Organise onboarding logistics for new starters and monthly in-person sessions in Staines. Coordinate team travel, expenses and purchase orders. Qualifications What were looking for Strong organisation and follow-through, with a habit of identifying and addressing issues early. Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders. The ability to work constructively with engineers and maintain agreed standards when priorities are competing. A practical, accountable approach to moving work forward without waiting for detailed direction. Experience coordinating UAT, software releases or delivery within a product or engineering team. Familiarity with release notes, test cycles, defect tracking, go/no-go decisions, acceptance criteria and regression scope. Experience managing a defect list through triage and resolution rather than only reporting its status. Confidence using Jira and a documentation platform such as Notion or Confluence. Relevant backgrounds may include delivery coordination, release coordination, junior delivery management, QA coordination, scrum mastery or project coordination. We are more interested in what you have managed than in your previous job title. Nice to have Experience with enterprise software involving customer UAT and formal sign-off. Exposure to regulated or audited environments, ERP products or supply-chain software. ISTQB, Agile or delivery certification. Experience working within a large organisation with established procurement and HR processes. Experience using AI tools to draft release notes, summarise defect lists or prepare status updates. Tools The team uses Jira, Notion, GitLab, Slack, Microsoft 365 and Outlook, along with IFS systems for travel, expenses and purchasing. You do not need to write code, but you should be comfortable working with engineers and understanding their delivery processes. What success looks like in the first six months Releases follow a predictable cadence and include clear, accurate release notes. Each UAT cycle has an agreed owner, schedule, defect list, evidence and sign-off. Customer and support defects receive clear ownership and a visible route to resolution. The Project Oliver go-live is supported by a well-managed UAT and release plan. Acceptance criteria, review and release controls are applied consistently. Product and engineering leads spend less time on routine coordination and administration. Why were hiring now The product team is growing and preparing for several important releases. The Quality Manager currently carries much of the practical coordination associated with testing and releases. This role will provide dedicated support of that work, helping the team increase delivery frequency while maintaining clear quality and release controls.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities Project Intake & Coordination Serve as the single point of contact for all project requests coming from the various US marketing divisions, replacing ad hoc requests to individual designers or developers with one controlled intake process. Gather complete requirements, assets, and approvals from US stakeholders before work is assigned, catching gaps before they become downstream delays. Route, prioritize, and assign incoming projects to the appropriate India team member(s) based on scope, skill set, and available capacity. Project Planning & Management Build and maintain project plans, timelines, and status trackers for all active work, and proactively flag risks to deadlines. Manage capacity and workload across graphic designers, web developers, and marketing admin staff to prevent bottlenecks and burnout. Set and manage realistic expectations with US stakeholders on turnaround times, revision cycles, and capacity constraints. Proactively identify and close communication and time-zone gaps, rather than waiting for missed handoffs to surface as problems. Quality Control & Proofing Conduct thorough proofing of all content, design, and copy deliverables prior to submission to US stakeholders checking grammar, messaging accuracy, brand consistency, design fidelity, and overall fluency and appropriateness for a US audience (idiom, tone, cultural nuance, and formatting conventions). Maintain and enforce quality checklists and standards so proofing is consistent regardless of who is on a given project. Partner with US marketing leads to close the loop on recurring quality issues and build fixes into the team's working process. title: Global Buildings Tender Excellence Support Team Administrator - Mumbai
description:
Main Role Responsibilities Assume full responsibility for the governance, control and ongoing maintenance of the Global Buildings Tender Excellence Hub SharePoint site, ensuring that all hosted information is accurate, current, relevant and aligned with organisational standards. This includes routinely reviewing site content, validating document versions, and implementing updates to maintain a high-quality and reliable central resource for bid and sales teams. Proactively identify, source and collect new and updated material by collaborating closely with Service Line and Spearhead G&S Leads, geographic tender teams, Bid Managers and other sales-focused stakeholders. Ensure the Hub comprehensively reflects the full breadth of expertise, capability and collateral required to support successful bid development, proposal writing and sales activities across the business. Manage the upload, cataloguing, tagging and archiving of content—including exemplar bid submissions, capability materials, boilerplate text, project summaries and sales collateral—provided by subject matter experts and other contributors. Ensure all documents follow correct naming conventions, metadata requirements and store in appropriate libraries to facilitate efficient search and retrieval by users. Provide support for the development of bid- and sales-related content, such as capability statements, exemplar project descriptions, standard responses and other supporting documentation. Assist in formatting, refining and organising materials to ensure consistency with corporate branding and quality expectations. Continuously enhance the structure, usability and functionality of the SharePoint site, identifying opportunities for improved user experience through layout refinements, navigation simplification, and application of SharePoint features or workflows. Where appropriate, explore and pilot alternative digital tools or platforms to optimise information sharing and collaboration. Produce and distribute usage, activity and engagement reports on a regular or ad-hoc basis, analysing user metrics to understand patterns, highlight issues, and inform future site improvements or training needs. Qualification Required qualifications, skills and knowledge Bachelor's degree in business administration, Construction Management, Project Management or 4–6 years of experience in a support, coordination, or administrative role—ideally within: Tendering / bidding / proposals Construction or buildings sector Engineering or technical services environment Global/multinational corporate teams Experience supporting end-to-end tender processes (RFI, RFQ, RFP stages) is a strong advantage. Excellent understanding and experience of SharePoint and other complementary systems/software such as Microsoft Dynamics CRM, PowerBI,Aconex CoPilot/other AI tools, all Microsoft Office Software (ie PowerPoint, Excel, Word) and Adobe Suite (preferred but not essential) Excellent organisational skills. Excellent communication / interpersonal skills Experience with ISO standards (especially ISO 9001 for quality management). Fluent English as a minimum. Additional Information We are looking for an experienced administrator with excellent organisational skills to be part of our Global Buildings Central Enablement Support Team in Mumbai, India.  You will work with the Global Buildings Commercial Team Head of Sales and Tender Excellence, along with your colleagues in the Central support team in India and Ramboll staff across all geographic regions.  Your primary role will be focussed on maintaining the Global Buildings Tender Excellence Hub SharePoint site, which is a centralised library of proposal and sales material for the use of all Buildings GBA staff specifically working on proposals and work winning activities. You will be the main point of contact for uploads, updates and development of the site to provide the best value to our business.  You may also assist in generating data or content directly for the site, working with the commercial team and/or technical specialists as required.  This role provides a critical interface to ensure the SharePoint site contains all best practice material including exemplar bid and sales material, that is easily accessible from across the Global Buildings business.  Our vision for bidding Our vision is to create a central team who work together to deliver bidding excellence and help us win more, better. The team will work directly on our most important strategic bids, but at the same time help manage and build the Tender Excellence hub - the ‘go to’ place for all our bids where we have access to our best material.  How to apply Apply online. Attach your CV, cover letter and relevant documents showcasing why you are the right fit for the role, and when you are available to start. We look forward to receiving your application.

description:

We are working on multiple SaaS solutions to help tech companies manage the following aspects of their AWS cloud infrastructure: Cost Optimization: Reducing their monthly cloud bills (finance dept loves us), thereby reducing emissions (helping the planet). After all, there is no Plan(et) B. Security: Continuously monitor their cloud security posture to eliminate external attack vectors and provide Intrusion Detection mechanisms for complete peace of mind and customer trust. Reliability: Ensure a consistent customer experience at any scale by improving cloud infrastructure reliability through configuration tuning across the stack. We provide a unique customer experience with an E2E single-click deployment experience. This aspect makes the problem super interesting for Engineers and Product & UX ninjas. Product website : CloudVictor Website About the Role & The Setup Role: Founders Office – GTM Analyst Experience: 3–5 Years Location: Bengaluru, India (Residential at our Hacker House) Employment Type: Full-time We are looking for a high-ownership professional to work closely with the founder to build and operate CloudVictor’s revenue growth engine. The role sits at the intersection of revenue operations, process engineering, and customer delivery. You will design the internal systems & SOPs that drive lead generation and outreach, maintain the revenue funnel, and continuously operate and optimize them.
This is a unique, high-velocity residential role based out of our Hacker House in Bangalore. You will be living in our Hacker House and working alongside the founder, offering unprecedented, daily 1-on-1 mentorship, rapid decision-making, and direct exposure to startup strategy, product, and enterprise deal closing.
If you think in systems and processes, enjoy implementing them by interfacing with different teams, then measure their efficiency with data and reports to come up with improvements (rinse & repeat), this high-impact role is built for you. Key Responsibilities Lead Funnel Management : Design, maintain & continuously optimize the end-to-end lead funnel, from lead generation to deal closure, for both inbound & outbound channels. Coordinate outreach campaigns across Email, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp. Pipeline Reporting : Create reports for tracking pipeline stages, lead statuses, and conversion metrics. CRM Ownership : Full ownership of data accuracy and automations inside the company CRM to ensure consistent lead tracking. Systems Design : Conceptualize, implement, and maintain internal systems for lead sourcing, lead enrichment, outreach messaging workflows, CRM integrations, and campaign tracking & reporting. Integration & Automation : Integrate multiple tools such as CRM, outreach platforms, analytics tools, and internal databases. Use AI to put together lightweight scripts or automations (API integrations, workflow/process automation, data pipelines), and continuously improve the operational stack for efficiency and scalability. Founder’s Office Operations : Work directly with the Founder on strategic initiatives, process design, and operational improvements. Who You Are Experience : 3 - 5 years of experience in operations, growth, consulting, or founder’s office roles in a tech company. CRM & Pipeline : Strong understanding of CRM systems and revenue pipeline management. Ability to coordinate between technical teams and business stakeholders. AI, Automation & Tool Savvy : Experience integrating tools through AI, APIs, automation scripts, or low-code workflows. Familiarity with AI agents like OpenClaw/Claude Code to automate workflows or analyze data. Data & Communication : Extremely comfortable building & analyzing data, reporting, and structured documentation. Excellent written communication and organizational skills. Hacker House Fit : Eager to live and work in an immersive, fast-paced startup house environment alongside the founder and core builders. Preferred (not mandatory) : Familiarity with AWS, cloud infrastructure, or DevOps environments; experience with CRM (Zoho preferred), outreach automation (Lemlist preferred), analytics or workflow automation tools; basic Python, Deluge, or similar scripting. How to Apply: Please fill out this form: http://s.cloudvictor.com/apply-gtm 
We review submissions on a rolling basis and reach out quickly to shortlisted candidates. Queries: For any questions or queries regarding the role, feel free to contact us at +91 8585924494.

title: Liquidity Risk Reporting - Analyst
description:
Join Barclays as Liquidity Risk Reporting - Analyst where the role holder will support wider team with the completion of their reporting and control activities, assisting them with the investigation and resolution of more complex issues. At Barclays, we dont just anticipate the future - were creating it. 
 To be successful in this role, you should have: Must have good communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work collaboratively with the Reporting teams across the different locations. Good presentation skills. Very good Microsoft Excel skills. Understanding of Balance Sheet and Finance processes. Understanding of Control and Governance frameworks. CA / CWA / CS / MBA / Finance / Commerce / Economics background. 
 Some other highly valued skills may include: Experience supporting the roll out of controls frameworks. Understanding of Treasury and/or Risk systems in Barclays. Reporting work experience in a Bank / Financial Institution. 
 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. 
 This role is based in our Chennai / Noida office. Purpose of the role To verify that the bank has sufficient funds to meet its short-term and long-term obligations, and the development and implementation of strategies to manage the banks liquidity position. Accountabilities Development and implementation of funding and liquidity strategies to efficiently manage the bank s liquidity position within regulatory requirements and risk appetite at favourable commercial outcomes with respect to funding costs. Analysis and quantification of the regulatory and behavioural liquidity risk impact of transactions undertaken by business units. Maintenance of strong relationships with key business units and working with the business units to manage liquidity to within constrains. Monitoring of key liquidity metrics and trends and advising on actions to be taken to maintain funding and liquidity levels within tolerance. Managing intra-group funding arrangements to ensure subsidiaries are adequately funded and managed within balance sheet, large exposure and capital constraints. Design and implementation of stress testing methodologies to assess the banks liquidity resilience under various financial shocks, economic downturns, and sector-specific crises, and analysis of stress testing results and development of mitigation strategies to address potential liquidity shortfalls. Development of new tools, models and data analysis to support and enhance the bank s funding and liquidity management capabilities. Analyst Expectations To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement. Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources. If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L - Listen and be authentic, E - Energise and inspire, A - Align across the enterprise, D - Develop others. OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate. Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area. Partner with other functions and business areas. Takes responsibility for end results of a team s operational processing and activities. Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately. Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation. Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise. Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct. Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function. Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function. Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail. Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents. Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information. Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

title: Senior Demand Planner Global Water Equipment
description:
Senior Demand Planner Global Water Equipment Pune, India | Global Equipment Supply Chain Planning LOCATION 
Pune, India SCOPE 
Global Nalco Water Equipment 
 KEY PARTNERS 
 Global Commercial Teams, Third-Party Contract Manufacturers, Regional Assembly Facilities Our Global Supply Chain is a network of more than 300 manufacturing plants, distribution centers and other facilities designed and located to support our direct sales, marketing and distribution activities. We enable company growth by delivering savings through more efficient operations and high levels of service that create competitive advantage while earning and keeping customers' trust. The Senior Demand Planner Global Water Equipment will join the Supply Chain Planning team and play an integral role in advancing demand forecasting and Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) processes for Nalco Water equipment worldwide. Based in Pune, India, this role will report into the North America Planning team while operating with a global scope. The planner will partner with commercial teams across regions, third-party contract manufacturers, and regional assembly facilities to create an aligned, accurate, and executable demand plan that supports customer service, capacity decisions, and business growth. 
 What's in It for You 
 Opportunity to influence a global equipment planning network and build relationships with commercial and supply chain leaders across multiple regions. High visibility to the North America Planning team and cross-functional stakeholders in Sales, Marketing, Finance, Operations, Procurement, and Manufacturing. Opportunity for a long-term career path with exposure to all areas of the company's global supply chain. Access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology. Thrive in a company that values personal and professional development, sustainability, a safety-focused culture, and ethical business practices. 
 What You Will Do 
 Lead the global monthly product demand forecast cycle for Nalco Water equipment, integrating regional inputs into one aligned demand plan. Partner with commercial teams across North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia Pacific to incorporate current and long-term market intelligence at the product, customer, and market levels. Develop, document, challenge, and update the assumptions supporting regional and global demand plans, particularly when demand outlooks differ from business plans or historical trends. Collaborate with the North America Planning team to align planning standards, governance, calendars, metrics, and Executive S&OP requirements. Engage third-party contract manufacturers and regional assembly facilities to translate demand signals into actionable capacity, material, and production requirements. Identify demand and supply risks across contract manufacturing and regional assembly networks, escalate constraints, and support scenario planning and mitigation actions. Improve forecast accuracy by validating data inputs, leveraging the existing statistical forecasting application, and refining statistical forecasts with commercial and regional business input. Use exception management and root cause analysis to identify forecast deviations, demand volatility, data issues, and corrective actions with relevant stakeholders. Own demand plan performance, including forecast error, accuracy, and bias, by measuring actual versus planned volume at multiple planning levels and across regions. Prepare and present global and regional performance metrics, insights, risks, and recommendations to commercial, planning, and operations stakeholders to drive continuous improvement. Partner with Marketing and regional teams to incorporate new product introductions, product conversions, phase-ins, phase-outs, and product deactivations into the global plan. Support Executive S&OP processes and meetings by providing a consolidated demand perspective, key assumptions, regional variances, opportunities, and risks. Coordinate effectively across time zones and cultures to maintain a consistent global planning cadence and timely decision-making. Conduct additional business and supply chain analyses for equipment products as needed. 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, Marketing, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in supply chain planning, demand planning, finance, marketing, manufacturing, or a related analytical discipline. Experience collaborating with commercial and supply chain teams across multiple countries, regions, or time zones. Significant experience with ERP systems, advanced planning systems, statistical forecasting applications, analytical tools, or equivalent software. High proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel and Word. Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with regional and global audiences and to present complex information clearly. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to drive decisions and build consensus among cross-functional stakeholders. Ability to navigate complex policy, process, cultural, and people-related organizational dynamics. Track record of delivering against key performance indicators and business objectives. Demonstrated strategic mindset, ownership, and ability to work independently within a globally distributed team. Ability to accommodate periodic meetings outside standard local business hours to support global stakeholders. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience in demand planning, manufacturing, or supply chain operations for engineered equipment or configured-to-order products. Experience working with third-party contract manufacturers and regional assembly or manufacturing facilities. Experience supporting global or regional S&OP / Integrated Business Planning processes. Experience with statistical forecasting applications and forecast performance management. Proficiency in SAP, particularly Materials Management (MM) and Production Planning (PP) modules. Experience in a matrixed, multinational organization.

Key Skills: Senior,Equipment,Demand forecasting,Global,Water,Planning,Forecasting,Business planning

title: Automation Quality Analyst
description:
Job Summary Role: Automation Quality Analyst Location: India, Remote Experience: 2-4 Years Role Overview We are looking for a detail-oriented and enthusiastic Android QA Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team. The candidate will be responsible for validating Android applications across devices and operating system versions, executing functional and regression tests, identifying defects, and contributing to automation and continuous quality improvement. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in software testing concepts, basic Android and Linux knowledge, and an eagerness to learn automation tools and modern Quality Engineering practices. Key Responsibilities 1. Testing & Quality Assurance Understand business requirements and user workflows and convert them into test scenarios and test cases. Perform functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing. Execute test cases and report defects with sufficient evidence and reproduction steps. Participate in release validation and quality certification activities. Apply test design techniques such as Equivalence Partitioning, Boundary Value Analysis, Decision Tables, and State Transition Testing. 2. Android Application & Device Testing Test Android applications on emulators and physical devices. Validate application behaviour across different screen sizes and Android OS versions. Capture screenshots, logs, videos, and test evidence. Perform installation, upgrade, and compatibility testing. Use Android Debug Bridge (ADB) for basic troubleshooting and diagnostics. Review Logcat outputs and assist in defect root cause analysis. 3. Automation Engineering Develop and maintain automated test scripts. Build reusable and data-driven automation test suites. Contribute to automation framework development using industry-standard tools. Execute automated test suites and analyse failures. Create utilities and helper scripts for test data preparation and validation. 4. CI/CD & Reporting Trigger and monitor automated test executions through CI/CD pipelines. Analyse execution results and prepare quality reports. Participate in release-readiness and quality-signoff activities. Generate concise test execution summaries and release recommendations. 5. Continuous Learning & Collaboration Learn modern Quality Engineering practices. Explore AI-assisted testing techniques and tools. Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and senior QA engineers. Participate in training programs, hackathons, and technical knowledge-sharing sessions. Required Technical Skills & Competencies Software Testing Fundamentals Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), and Software Defect Lifecycle. Understanding of functional and regression testing concepts. Familiarity with test case design techniques. Android Fundamentals Basic understanding of Android applications and Android architecture. Familiarity with APK installation and testing. Understanding of Android emulators and mobile application testing concepts. Linux Fundamentals Basic Linux command-line knowledge. Familiarity with file system navigation, log inspection, basic shell commands, and process monitoring. Database Fundamentals Basic understanding of relational databases. Ability to write simple SQL queries using SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, and GROUP BY. Version Control Basic knowledge of Git. Understanding of clone, commit, push, and pull request concepts. Must-Have Skills Software testing fundamentals. Functional and regression testing. Android application testing. Test case design and defect reporting. Basic SQL queries. Git fundamentals. Analytical and problem-solving skills. Good to Have Skills Python programming. Robot Framework. Appium. CI/CD exposure. AI Foundation. Desired Attributes Passionate about software quality and testing. Strong analytical and problem-solving thinker. Curious and eager to learn new technologies. Detail-oriented and quality-focused. Good team player with strong communication skills. Self-motivated and willing to take ownership. Interview Process 2-3 rounds of discussion.

title: Senior Manager - Internal Audit
description:
We are seeking a qualified and experienced Chartered Accountant to lead and oversee the Company's various audits like Concurrent Audit, Internal Audit, Outsourcing Audit, etc across its NBFC and FinTech businesses. The role requires strong expertise in risk-based auditing, RBI regulations, financial reporting, accounting, and operational processes. The selected candidate will be responsible for driving audit planning, execution, reporting, stakeholder management and strengthening the internal control framework. 
 Key Responsibilities: Lead and oversee various audits & regulatory assignments across the NBFC and FinTech businesses. Develop and execute risk-based audit plans covering financial, operational, regulatory and technology-driven processes. Evaluate the adequacy and operating effectiveness of internal controls and recommend improvements to strengthen governance and risk management. Review the lending lifecycle including sourcing, underwriting, disbursement, collections, treasury, finance, accounting, vendor management and customer servicing processes. Evaluate compliance with RBI Master Directions, Digital Lending Guidelines, Outsourcing Guidelines, Fair Practices Code, colending and other applicable regulatory requirements. Review accounting processes, financial reporting, taxation, books of accounts and financial controls to ensure accuracy and compliance with applicable accounting standards. Assess compliance with Internal Financial Controls (IFC), Risk Control Matrices (RCMs) and enterprise risk management practices. Review outsourcing arrangements, vendor governance and third-party risk management processes. Identify process gaps, control weaknesses and regulatory non-compliances and recommend practical corrective actions. Prepare high-quality audit reports, present audit observations to senior management and monitor closure of audit findings. Coordinate with business functions to ensure timely implementation of agreed action plans. Liaise with statutory auditors, internal auditors, concurrent auditors and regulatory inspectors during audits and inspections. Mentor and supervise audit team members while ensuring timely completion of audit assignments. 
 What we're looking for: Chartered Accountant (CA) Mandatory. Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience in field of Audit. Mandatory experience in NBFC and FinTech audits. Prior experience in Bank Audits is essential. Experience in treasury, lending operations, accounting, finance and regulatory audits will be preferred. Strong planning, leadership and team management capabilities. Experience in leveraging AI tools for audit execution, data analysis and process automation will be an added advantage. Good understanding of lending operations, treasury, financial statement closure process and investment accounting.

description:

Join our global Impact Assessment team and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future. Your new role : You will bring your knowledge of Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) into play as you participate with our European colleagues in conducting EIA s for a wide range of our projects across the energy, infrastructure, industrial, data centre and property sectors in Europe. In the energy sector as an example our work includes onshore and offshore wind, solar, hydrogen, carbon capture, storage & utilization, transmission and energy storage. You will support our European projects and collaborate primarily with our experienced EIA departments in the United Kingdom and Denmark with all aspects of impact assessments. You will have a good understanding of the EIA process and relevant regulations, and you will have the opportunity to support projects at various stages in the project lifecycle from early-stage feasibility/risk appraisal, through EIA, to consent condition compliance. A structured in-house training and development program will provide this knowledge and help personal career development. Responsibilities Supporting the United Kingdom and Danish teams with all aspects of impact assessment from Ramboll s office in India as parts of our EIA team. Identifying, reviewing, and summarizing relevant data. Identifying data gaps and planning data collection. Supporting with preparing reports in English. Supporting with applications for environmental permits for the European market. Assisting with coordinating inputs from internal teams and external specialists. Supporting senior consultants with project tasks and project management. Demonstrating the ability to present complex technical concepts effectively both orally and in writing so clients, regulatory agencies and legal groups can easily comprehend them is a key requirement. Your Team You will be part of our Impact Assessment team in India, which forms part of our global Impact Assessment organization. The global organization has been established to drive further growth in Impact Assessment, building on our existing successes through a continued focus on key clients and high-quality impact assessment work. From the moment you start at Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you can continue to grow with the company. Whilst we look forward to supporting your continued learning and development, for this role we have identified some qualifications, skills, and capabilities that will set you up for success. Qualifications & Experience Master s degree in Environmental Engineering, environmental sciences, earth sciences or a closely related environmental discipline 5 to 10 years of experience on EIA projects. Experience in the energy sector would be advantageous but is not essential. Preferred work experience with impact assessments either in industry or consultancy across the globe. Experience with adopting and applying national and international environmental regulations. Working knowledge of ArcGIS, experience with field work and data analysis is beneficial. Familiarity with environmental permitting processes. Knowledge of sustainability/ and environmental management practices is beneficial. Experience supporting/leading project workstreams and coordinating with multidisciplinary teams. Professional Skills Able to produce clear, concise, and correct written documents in English. Fluent verbal communication in English. Highly organized, able to work efficiently and effectively to deadlines on designated tasks. Demonstrate attention to details, high level of accuracy, and academic rigor. Self-motivated, reliable, and dedicated. Ability to interpret complex environmental data and regulations. Capable of presenting technical information to clients, regulators, and stakeholders. Willingness to support the senior Environmental Consultant and to work as a team. Client-focused mindset with the ability to build and maintain professional relationships. Adaptability to work in a company with an international work culture. International work experience, preferably including European experience, would be considered an advantage.

Working knowledge of Docker, CI/CD pipelines (for example GitHub Actions) and a major cloud platform (AWS or GCP). You can interact confidently with stakeholders, clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences, and manage expectations. Good to Have Experience with Go monorepos and tooling such as Bazel. Experience with API gateways (such as KrakenD) and centralized configuration management. Exposure to the fintech, payments or e-commerce domain. Experience with OpenSearch or Elasticsearch. Experience with clean architecture or domain-driven design. Experience with high-volume, high-concurrency systems (1000+ concurrent users, high TPV). Prior experience mentoring engineers or leading small teams. Soft Skills Strong ownership and accountability. Proactive communication with stakeholders and cross-functional teams, including product, business, QA and operations. Ability to break down ambiguous problems and drive them to closure. Collaborative, with a habit of sharing knowledge through documentation, design reviews and code reviews. Basic qualifications Expert-level Python proficiency is a must Experience preparing and analysing large, real-world datasets, including structured time-series data containing thousands of variables is required Demonstrated experience applying AI methods-including LLMs, knowledge graphs and agentic architectures-to generate insights and support decision-making. title: LEAD DATA PRODUCT ENGINEER
description:
Job description: Lead Data Product Engineer 
 1. Role overview 
 The Lead Data Product Engineer will provide technical direction, hands-on engineering leadership, and stakeholder leadership for the project. The role combines the responsibilities of a Technical Lead and Data Architect with active, hands-on data engineering. The Lead will guide the engineering delivery team in line with technical standards. 
 The Lead will use deep technical knowledge to guide delivery teams, challenge assumptions, assess design quality, manage dependencies, identify risks, and support informed decision-making. They must be able to explain processes, issues, and Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) to stakeholders from a business-outcome and KPI perspective, not only from a platform or engineering perspective. 
 Role type: Lead role leading the engineering delivery. This is not a line-management role. 
 Experience: 8-10 years as a Lead Data Product Engineer in the Life Sciences / Pharma Commercial domain. 
 Expected balance of the role: 
 The Lead Data Product Engineer is expected to perform all three of the following areas and must demonstrate a strong balance across them: 
 Technical leadership and hands-on engineering: design, build, review, and optimise data products and pipelines, and lead engineering delivery. Stakeholder management: act as the primary point of contact and engage confidently with business stakeholders at a KPI and business-outcome level. Governance, documentation, and transition support: provide oversight to ensure the solution is documented, governed, and supportable. 
 2. Technology and domain context 
 Platform and tooling: 
 Orchestration: Apache Airflow Cloud: AWS Data platforms: Databricks and Snowflake Source control: Bitbucket Reporting: Power BI (primary visualisation layer) Architecture: Medallion Architecture (bronze, silver, gold) is already implemented. The Lead is responsible for owning, maintaining, enhancing, and, where required, redesigning it. Business domain: 
 Claims data and commercial performance data, including PP and NPP KPIs and their business context Field team data, and how commercial stakeholders use it for reporting 3. Key responsibilities 
 Technical leadership and engineering delivery 
 Provide technical leadership and direction across the project and lead engineering delivery in line with AZ technical standards. Hands-on design, development, and optimisation of data pipelines and data products on Airflow, Databricks, and Snowflake. Own the Medallion Architecture, ensuring the purpose and boundaries of each layer are clear and consistently applied. Review and challenge proposed architecture, data flows, integration approaches, data models, and reporting solutions. Design and manage Airflow workflows, including orchestration, scheduling, dependencies, refresh mechanisms, and operational management of pipelines. Define and apply data partitioning strategies to improve scalability and performance. Review delivery plans and technical designs to confirm that data movement from source systems to reporting layers is feasible and appropriately controlled. 
 Data modelling, business rules, and reporting 
 Review proposed data models using knowledge of facts, dimensions, data grain, relationships, KPIs, and aggregation logic. Confirm that business rules and metric definitions (including PP and NPP KPIs) are clearly understood, consistently applied, and traceable to agreed requirements. Review data lineage, dependencies, ownership, and downstream consumption of Gold-layer datasets in Power BI. Assess the impact of changes to source systems, pipelines, transformation logic, Gold-layer datasets, semantic models, and reports. 
 Issue investigation and RCA 
 Coordinate the investigation of data discrepancies, refresh failures, performance issues, and delivery concerns. Create RCA documents for issues identified across source, transformation, and reporting layers. Ensure technical issues are assigned to the correct owners and progressed to resolution. Stakeholder management 
 Act as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders and the business. Build effective relationships with business representatives, commercial and field stakeholders, product owners, delivery leads, data engineers, architects, Power BI teams, suppliers, and support teams. title: Data Scientist
description:
Position Summary The Data Scientist owns the statistical methodology behind a new customer-facing benchmarking capability in Onits AI-driven legal operations platform. Drawing on data from multiple source systems across enterprise legal management, matter management, and spend management, this role determines which organizations are genuinely comparable, decides where the line sits between a defensible comparison and one that is not, and ensures the product communicates confidence honestly to end users. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and the Data Architect on a Databricks-based platform, the Data Scientist sets the evidential standards, data quality targets, and governance for pooled, anonymised cross-customer analytics. Key Responsibilities Benchmarking Methodology: Own the statistical methodology behind customer-facing benchmarking, end to end. Comparability Modelling: Build and validate a model that determines which organizations are genuinely comparable, using features such as service mix, pricing, scale, and geography. Defensibility Thresholds: Decide where the line sits between a comparison Onit can defend and one it cannot, and design the products behaviour on both sides of it. Data Quality Programme: Profile data quality across multiple source systems and lead a measurable improvement programme against a defined target, partnering with Data Engineering on remediation. Entity Resolution: Define the approach for resolving duplicate and conflicting records across systems that were never designed to reconcile with one another. External Data Assessment: Assess whether missing attributes can be responsibly supplemented from external sources, and set the evidential bar for doing so. Governance & Privacy: Work with Product on methodology and governance for pooled, anonymised cross-customer analytics, including aggregation thresholds. Communicating Uncertainty: Explain uncertainty clearly to non-statisticians and help the product communicate confidence honestly to end users. Required Skills 7+ years in applied data science, analytics engineering, or a closely related quantitative role, including ownership of methodology for externally facing analytics. Strong applied statistics: sampling, variance, confidence intervals, and sound judgement about small samples (e.g., able to explain why a three-item average may or may not be publishable). Practical, production experience with entity resolution, record linkage, deduplication, or master data management. Strong SQL, and Python or Ruby for analysis and modelling; hands-on experience working in Databricks (notebooks, Spark/PySpark, Delta tables) or a comparable cloud data platform. Experience diagnosing and remediating data quality problems at scale, including reasoning about why data is missing before deciding what to do about it. Rigorous validation habits: defines baselines and success metrics before building, and reports honestly against them. Ability to communicate uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders without overstating confidence or being unhelpfully vague. Working proficiency with AI tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate analysis, code, and documentation, with the statistical judgment to critically validate AI-generated output. Preferred Qualifications Experience building benchmarks, rate comparisons, scoring models, or indices intended for external consumption. Experience with anonymisation, aggregation thresholds, or privacy-preserving analytics. Experience working with a cloud data warehouse or lakehouse (Databricks preferred). Experience in a regulated or commercially sensitive domain, ideally legal. Experience defining data quality SLAs or acceptance thresholds with business stakeholders.

Assess borrower creditworthiness using the 4 Cs methodology (Character, Capacity, Capital, Collateral) to ensure sound lending decisions. - Income Calculation & Financial Analysis: Evaluate and calculate borrower income from various sources including salaried, hourly, commission, bonus, rental, and self-employment income. Analyze documents such as paystubs, W-2s, tax returns, and business financials (Schedule C, K-1, 1065, 1120S) to determine qualifying income accurately. - Collateral & Property Evaluation: Review appraisal reports, AVMs, and residential valuation documents to validate property value and ensure compliance with lending guidelines. Analyze title reports, lien positions, and ownership details. - Underwriting Decision & Documentation: Prepare detailed underwriting summaries, identify red flags, and document conditions and stipulations within the Loan Origination System (LOS), preferably Encompass. Recommend appropriate loan structures based on risk assessment. - Condition Management & Borrower Follow-up: Issue clear and comprehensive condition requests to borrowers and processors. Track condition fulfillment, verify document receipt, and manage timelines to ensure expedited loan progression toward clear-to-close status. - Workflow Management & Communication: Collaborate with processors and internal stakeholders throughout the underwriting lifecycle. Provide clear communication on loan decisions, required conditions, and final clear-to-close (CTC) status. Escalate complex issues to senior management when necessary. - Risk Identification & Compliance: Identify discrepancies, inconsistencies, and potential risks in loan files. Ensure all underwriting decisions comply with internal policies and regulatory requirements including Fair Lending, TRID, and other applicable regulations. - Quality Assurance & File Review: Conduct thorough quality reviews of underwritten files to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to company standards. Identify opportunities for process improvement and best practice implementation. - Reporting & Reconciliation: Handle reconciliation of complex borrower accounts and prepare daily aging and pipeline reports to track loan progress and turnaround times. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide metrics to management. - System Utilization & Process Adherence: Utilize LOS platforms (Encompass preferred) and adhere to underwriting workflows, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and compliance with company standards. Maintain organized file documentation and audit trails. - Exception Handling & Complex Case Management: Manage non-standard loan scenarios, unusual financial situations, and exception cases requiring enhanced analysis. Develop creative solutions while maintaining regulatory compliance and risk mitigation. - Training & Knowledge Sharing: As a senior-level associate, mentor junior underwriting staff and processors on best practices, policy updates, and complex underwriting scenarios. Contribute to team development and process documentation. - Performance Metrics & KPI Tracking: Monitor individual and team performance against established benchmarks including loan turnaround times, accuracy rates, and productivity metrics. Analyze performance data to identify trends and opportunities for continuous improvement. - Regulatory Updates & Compliance Training: Stay current with evolving lending regulations, compliance requirements, and industry updates. Participate in ongoing training and communicate regulatory changes to team members to ensure organizational compliance. - Stakeholder Coordination & Escalation Management: Coordinate with loan officers, real estate agents, appraisers, and other external stakeholders to facilitate smooth loan processing. Manage escalations and resolve conflicts professionally while maintaining positive client relationships. title: LEAD DATA PRODUCT ENGINEER
description:
Job description: Lead Data Product Engineer 
 1. Role overview 
 The Lead Data Product Engineer will provide technical direction, hands-on engineering leadership, and stakeholder leadership for the project. The role combines the responsibilities of a Technical Lead and Data Architect with active, hands-on data engineering. The Lead will guide the engineering delivery team in line with technical standards. 
 The Lead will use deep technical knowledge to guide delivery teams, challenge assumptions, assess design quality, manage dependencies, identify risks, and support informed decision-making. They must be able to explain processes, issues, and Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) to stakeholders from a business-outcome and KPI perspective, not only from a platform or engineering perspective. 
 Role type: Lead role leading the engineering delivery. This is not a line-management role. 
 Experience: 8-10 years as a Lead Data Product Engineer in the Life Sciences / Pharma Commercial domain. 
 Expected balance of the role: 
 The Lead Data Product Engineer is expected to perform all three of the following areas and must demonstrate a strong balance across them: 
 Technical leadership and hands-on engineering: design, build, review, and optimise data products and pipelines, and lead engineering delivery. Stakeholder management: act as the primary point of contact and engage confidently with business stakeholders at a KPI and business-outcome level. Governance, documentation, and transition support: provide oversight to ensure the solution is documented, governed, and supportable. 
 2. Technology and domain context 
 Platform and tooling: 
 Orchestration: Apache Airflow Cloud: AWS Data platforms: Databricks and Snowflake Source control: Bitbucket Reporting: Power BI (primary visualisation layer) Architecture: Medallion Architecture (bronze, silver, gold) is already implemented. The Lead is responsible for owning, maintaining, enhancing, and, where required, redesigning it. Business domain: 
 Claims data and commercial performance data, including PP and NPP KPIs and their business context Field team data, and how commercial stakeholders use it for reporting 3. Key responsibilities 
 Technical leadership and engineering delivery 
 Provide technical leadership and direction across the project and lead engineering delivery in line with AZ technical standards. Hands-on design, development, and optimisation of data pipelines and data products on Airflow, Databricks, and Snowflake. Own the Medallion Architecture, ensuring the purpose and boundaries of each layer are clear and consistently applied. Review and challenge proposed architecture, data flows, integration approaches, data models, and reporting solutions. Design and manage Airflow workflows, including orchestration, scheduling, dependencies, refresh mechanisms, and operational management of pipelines. Define and apply data partitioning strategies to improve scalability and performance. Review delivery plans and technical designs to confirm that data movement from source systems to reporting layers is feasible and appropriately controlled. 
 Data modelling, business rules, and reporting 
 Review proposed data models using knowledge of facts, dimensions, data grain, relationships, KPIs, and aggregation logic. Confirm that business rules and metric definitions (including PP and NPP KPIs) are clearly understood, consistently applied, and traceable to agreed requirements. Review data lineage, dependencies, ownership, and downstream consumption of Gold-layer datasets in Power BI. Assess the impact of changes to source systems, pipelines, transformation logic, Gold-layer datasets, semantic models, and reports. 
 Issue investigation and RCA 
 Coordinate the investigation of data discrepancies, refresh failures, performance issues, and delivery concerns. Create RCA documents for issues identified across source, transformation, and reporting layers. Ensure technical issues are assigned to the correct owners and progressed to resolution. Stakeholder management 
 Act as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders and the business. Build effective relationships with business representatives, commercial and field stakeholders, product owners, delivery leads, data engineers, architects, Power BI teams, suppliers, and support teams. Translate technical considerations into clear impacts, risks, options, and recommendations. Communicate complex topics clearly to audiences with varying levels of technical knowledge. Manage expectations by explaining what is known, what remains uncertain, and what decisions are required. Identify technical risks, cross-team dependencies, assumptions, and delivery blockers early. Governance and transition to business-as-usual (BAU) 
 Assess whether the solution is technically and operationally ready for transition into BAU support. Maintain full knowledge of the required transition artefacts: architecture diagrams, data lineage, runbooks, monitoring, SLAs, support models, ownership, and data quality rules. Identify readiness gaps and agree remediation plans with delivery and operational stakeholders. Provide a clear recommendation: ready for transition, ready with agreed risks, or not ready for sign-off. 
 4. Required knowledge and skills 
 Data architecture and engineering 
 Medallion Architecture (bronze, silver, gold) and the implications of each layer Data lineage, source-to-target dependencies, ownership, and downstream consumption ETL and ELT patterns, ingestion, transformation, orchestration, scheduling, and refresh mechanisms Apache Airflow: workflow design, orchestration, and operational management Databricks: architecture, engineering practices, and hands-on implementation Snowflake: architecture, platform capabilities, and data engineering best practices Data partitioning strategies for scalability and performance optimisation Common pipeline failure points, data quality issues, integration risks, and operational dependencies End-to-end data flow from source systems through transformation layers to reporting and analytics AWS cloud services and Bitbucket-based code management Data modelling and reporting 
 Fact and dimension tables, data grain, relationships, keys, measures, and aggregation logic KPI definitions, business rules, semantic models, and consumption of Gold-layer datasets by Power BI Investigating data discrepancies, refresh failures, and performance issues Producing RCA documentation across source, transformation, and reporting layers Domain knowledge (life sciences / pharma commercial) 
 Claims data and commercial performance data, including PP and NPP KPIs and their business context How field teams operate and how commercial stakeholders use field data for reporting Ability to engage at a business outcome and KPI level Technical leadership and governance 
 Experience reviewing solution documentation, delivery plans, operational models, support arrangements, and transition artefacts Understanding of risks from incomplete documentation, unclear ownership, insufficient monitoring, weak data quality controls, and unsupported dependencies Ability to make balanced recommendations based on technical evidence, business impact, delivery constraints, and operational risk Stakeholder and delivery management 
 Proven experience working with senior stakeholders and multidisciplinary delivery teams Ability to influence outcomes without direct line management responsibility Experience managing expectations, resolving ambiguity, facilitating decisions, and communicating risks Strong written and verbal communication, including presenting technical information to non-technical audiences 
 5. Desired abilities 
 Fact-based approach and an eager-to-learn mindset Credible technical direction, acting as the businesss point of contact Ability to explain bronze, silver, and gold architecture implications to both technical and business audiences Effective challenge of data engineering, modelling, reporting, and integration proposals Early identification of risks and dependencies before they become delivery or operational issues Clear understanding and assurance of business rules, KPI definitions, data lineage, and ownership Coordination of stakeholders and technical teams to reach timely, well-informed decisions Confidence-building that the solution is supportable, governed, documented, and transition-ready Clear communication of readiness recommendations at each project stage 
 6. Qualifications and experience summary 
 Experience: 8-10 years as a Lead Data Product Engineer 
 Industry: Life Sciences / Pharma Commercial domain 
 Core platforms: Airflow, AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, Bitbucket 
 Reporting: Power BI 
 Architecture: Medallion Architecture (existing; ownership and evolution required) 
 Role type: Lead engineering delivery, hands-on, no line management 
 Role balance: Strong balance across technical leadership and hands-on engineering, stakeholder management, and governance and transition support

The Data Analyst will apply their technical skills and business understanding to develop analytics that enhance risk assessment, provide deeper audit insights, and support continuous monitoring. BFSI, GCC, Shared Services : Demonstrable experience working within a large Banking & Financial Services (BFSI) entity or a Global Capability Centre (GCC), showing a strong understanding of its data environment. Technical Tooling Proficiency : Hands-on proficiency in writing complex queries and building solutions using Python and SQL. Extensive experience in developing interactive dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI and Tableau. Mastery of Advanced Excel for data manipulation. Automation & Emerging Tech : Experience working with Robotic Process Automation (RPA) tools and BOTS to automate data extraction and testing routines.

 Knowledge of Governance Standards Data Governance & Privacy : Strong understanding of data governance principles, data quality management, and data privacy concepts, with awareness of regulations like GDPR. Risk & Control Concepts : Foundational knowledge of internal control concepts (e.g., COSO) and risk management principles to understand the context and purpose of audit analytics requests. Banking Processes & Risks : Familiarity with underlying banking processes (e.g., payments, trade finance, lending) and associated risks (e.g., fraud, operational, credit) to provide relevant analysis. 
 Technical Decision Areas Data Extraction & Transformation (ETL) : Determines the most efficient methods to extract, transform, and load large datasets from various source systems into a usable format for analysis. Visualization & Dashboarding : Designs and develops user-friendly, insightful dashboards in Power BI/Tableau that allow auditors to explore data and monitor key risk indicators effectively. Tool & Technique Recommendation : Recommends the appropriate tools and analytical approaches to solve specific audit problems, balancing complexity, speed, and reusability.
