Analytical & Problem-Solving : A strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate audit or business questions into specific data requirements and analytical steps. Business Acumen (BFSI) : Ability to understand the business context behind the data in a Banking GCC context, recognize what "good" vs. "bad" looks like, and identify data patterns that signify risk. Communication & Visualization : Excellent ability to communicate complex analytical findings in a simple, clear, and visually compelling manner to non-technical audit stakeholders.

title: LEAD DATA PRODUCT ENGINEER
description:
Job description: Lead Data Product Engineer 
 1. Role overview 
 The Lead Data Product Engineer will provide technical direction, hands-on engineering leadership, and stakeholder leadership for the project. The role combines the responsibilities of a Technical Lead and Data Architect with active, hands-on data engineering. The Lead will guide the engineering delivery team in line with technical standards. 
 The Lead will use deep technical knowledge to guide delivery teams, challenge assumptions, assess design quality, manage dependencies, identify risks, and support informed decision-making. They must be able to explain processes, issues, and Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) to stakeholders from a business-outcome and KPI perspective, not only from a platform or engineering perspective. 
 Role type: Lead role leading the engineering delivery. This is not a line-management role. 
 Experience: 8-10 years as a Lead Data Product Engineer in the Life Sciences / Pharma Commercial domain. 
 Expected balance of the role: 
 The Lead Data Product Engineer is expected to perform all three of the following areas and must demonstrate a strong balance across them: 
 Technical leadership and hands-on engineering: design, build, review, and optimise data products and pipelines, and lead engineering delivery. Stakeholder management: act as the primary point of contact and engage confidently with business stakeholders at a KPI and business-outcome level. Governance, documentation, and transition support: provide oversight to ensure the solution is documented, governed, and supportable. 
 2. Technology and domain context 
 Platform and tooling: 
 Orchestration: Apache Airflow Cloud: AWS Data platforms: Databricks and Snowflake Source control: Bitbucket Reporting: Power BI (primary visualisation layer) Architecture: Medallion Architecture (bronze, silver, gold) is already implemented. The Lead is responsible for owning, maintaining, enhancing, and, where required, redesigning it. Business domain: 
 Claims data and commercial performance data, including PP and NPP KPIs and their business context Field team data, and how commercial stakeholders use it for reporting 3. Key responsibilities 
 Technical leadership and engineering delivery 
 Provide technical leadership and direction across the project and lead engineering delivery in line with AZ technical standards. Hands-on design, development, and optimisation of data pipelines and data products on Airflow, Databricks, and Snowflake. Own the Medallion Architecture, ensuring the purpose and boundaries of each layer are clear and consistently applied. Review and challenge proposed architecture, data flows, integration approaches, data models, and reporting solutions. Design and manage Airflow workflows, including orchestration, scheduling, dependencies, refresh mechanisms, and operational management of pipelines. Define and apply data partitioning strategies to improve scalability and performance. Review delivery plans and technical designs to confirm that data movement from source systems to reporting layers is feasible and appropriately controlled. 
 Data modelling, business rules, and reporting 
 Review proposed data models using knowledge of facts, dimensions, data grain, relationships, KPIs, and aggregation logic. Confirm that business rules and metric definitions (including PP and NPP KPIs) are clearly understood, consistently applied, and traceable to agreed requirements. Review data lineage, dependencies, ownership, and downstream consumption of Gold-layer datasets in Power BI. Assess the impact of changes to source systems, pipelines, transformation logic, Gold-layer datasets, semantic models, and reports. 
 Issue investigation and RCA 
 Coordinate the investigation of data discrepancies, refresh failures, performance issues, and delivery concerns. Create RCA documents for issues identified across source, transformation, and reporting layers. Ensure technical issues are assigned to the correct owners and progressed to resolution. Stakeholder management 
 Act as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders and the business. Build effective relationships with business representatives, commercial and field stakeholders, product owners, delivery leads, data engineers, architects, Power BI teams, suppliers, and support teams. Translate technical considerations into clear impacts, risks, options, and recommendations. Communicate complex topics clearly to audiences with varying levels of technical knowledge. Manage expectations by explaining what is known, what remains uncertain, and what decisions are required. Identify technical risks, cross-team dependencies, assumptions, and delivery blockers early. Governance and transition to business-as-usual (BAU) 
 Assess whether the solution is technically and operationally ready for transition into BAU support. Maintain full knowledge of the required transition artefacts: architecture diagrams, data lineage, runbooks, monitoring, SLAs, support models, ownership, and data quality rules. Identify readiness gaps and agree remediation plans with delivery and operational stakeholders. Provide a clear recommendation: ready for transition, ready with agreed risks, or not ready for sign-off. 
 4. Required knowledge and skills 
 Data architecture and engineering 
 Medallion Architecture (bronze, silver, gold) and the implications of each layer Data lineage, source-to-target dependencies, ownership, and downstream consumption ETL and ELT patterns, ingestion, transformation, orchestration, scheduling, and refresh mechanisms Apache Airflow: workflow design, orchestration, and operational management Databricks: architecture, engineering practices, and hands-on implementation Snowflake: architecture, platform capabilities, and data engineering best practices Data partitioning strategies for scalability and performance optimisation Common pipeline failure points, data quality issues, integration risks, and operational dependencies End-to-end data flow from source systems through transformation layers to reporting and analytics AWS cloud services and Bitbucket-based code management Data modelling and reporting 
 Fact and dimension tables, data grain, relationships, keys, measures, and aggregation logic KPI definitions, business rules, semantic models, and consumption of Gold-layer datasets by Power BI Investigating data discrepancies, refresh failures, and performance issues Producing RCA documentation across source, transformation, and reporting layers Domain knowledge (life sciences / pharma commercial) 
 Claims data and commercial performance data, including PP and NPP KPIs and their business context How field teams operate and how commercial stakeholders use field data for reporting Ability to engage at a business outcome and KPI level Technical leadership and governance 
 Experience reviewing solution documentation, delivery plans, operational models, support arrangements, and transition artefacts Understanding of risks from incomplete documentation, unclear ownership, insufficient monitoring, weak data quality controls, and unsupported dependencies Ability to make balanced recommendations based on technical evidence, business impact, delivery constraints, and operational risk Stakeholder and delivery management 
 Proven experience working with senior stakeholders and multidisciplinary delivery teams Ability to influence outcomes without direct line management responsibility Experience managing expectations, resolving ambiguity, facilitating decisions, and communicating risks Strong written and verbal communication, including presenting technical information to non-technical audiences 
 5. Desired abilities 
 Fact-based approach and an eager-to-learn mindset Credible technical direction, acting as the businesss point of contact Ability to explain bronze, silver, and gold architecture implications to both technical and business audiences Effective challenge of data engineering, modelling, reporting, and integration proposals Early identification of risks and dependencies before they become delivery or operational issues Clear understanding and assurance of business rules, KPI definitions, data lineage, and ownership Coordination of stakeholders and technical teams to reach timely, well-informed decisions Confidence-building that the solution is supportable, governed, documented, and transition-ready Clear communication of readiness recommendations at each project stage

title: Business Analyst - BA4
description:
Join us as Business Analyst, where you will: Act as the Techno-Functional Business Analyst for the trade execution platform, providing functional and technical analysis across the trade execution lifecycle. Work closely with Dealers, RMS, Broking Operations, Technology, Infrastructure, Information Security, exchanges and external vendors to understand requirements and translate them into implementable solutions. Understand and document end-to-end flows covering order capture, order validation, order routing, exchange connectivity, trade confirmation and downstream hand-off to post-trade systems. Gather and analyse business, regulatory and technology requirements and translate them into BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, process flows, interface requirements and acceptance criteria. Perform As-Is/To-Be and gap analysis, assess solution impacts and identify dependencies across upstream and downstream applications and interfaces. Analyse application and interface issues using SQL/data analysis, logs, files and system flows, working with development and vendor teams to identify root causes and drive resolution. Support integrations and connectivity with relevant NSE/BSE trading infrastructure and downstream broking systems. Own functional analysis for regulatory/exchange-mandated changes, business enhancements, technology upgrades and control remediation impacting the trade execution platform. Define test scenarios and acceptance criteria and support SIT, UAT, regression testing, production sanity validation and business sign-off. Support production releases, incidents and problem investigations, including impact analysis, root-cause analysis and remediation tracking. Coordinate with development, QA, production support and vendor teams throughout the full SDLC, from requirement definition through to production implementation. Maintain appropriate documentation and evidence to support risk, control, audit and governance requirements for a regulated trading platform. 
 To be successful in this role, you should: Have a strong understanding of capital markets and equity broking, particularly front-office order and trade execution. Have a good functional understanding of the order-to-trade lifecycle, including order placement, validations, routing, exchange execution, trade confirmations and post-trade interfaces. Be able to bridge the gap between business users and technical teams, translating trading requirements into detailed system requirements. Have strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to investigate data, interfaces and application behaviour rather than limiting the role to documentation. Have working knowledge of SQL, databases, file/interface-based integrations, application logs and data reconciliation. Have a good understanding of APIs/interfaces, batch and real-time integrations, Linux/Unix environments and application architecture. Demonstrate strong stakeholder and vendor management skills, with the ability to work across Front Office, Operations, Technology, Risk and Control. Be able to operate effectively in a regulated, business-critical trading environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Have strong written and verbal communication skills, with disciplined documentation and attention to detail. 
 Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications: Bachelor s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Finance, Business Management or a related discipline. Relevant experience as a Business Analyst/Techno-Functional Analyst in Capital Markets, Securities, Broking or Trading Technology. Hands-on experience working with trade execution, Order Management Systems (OMS) or trading platforms. Strong knowledge of the equity trading lifecycle and Indian capital markets. Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, with the ability to analyse transactional data. Experience preparing BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, process flows, test scenarios and acceptance criteria. Experience supporting SIT/UAT, production releases and incident/problem analysis. Effective stakeholder management across business and technology teams. 
 Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications: Prior hands-on experience with NEST/Omnesys NEST or a comparable broker trade execution/OMS platform. Knowledge of NSE and BSE trading environments, exchange connectivity and trading terminals. Familiarity with NEAT/BOLT or equivalent exchange trading systems. Understanding of RMS controls, trading limits, margins and pre-trade validations. Exposure to FIX/API-based exchange or trading-system integration. Understanding of Cash Equity and Equity Derivatives (F&O) products and workflows. Experience with Linux/Unix, Oracle/SQL databases, logs, interfaces and production troubleshooting. Understanding of downstream trade settlement/back-office systems and interfaces between front-office execution and post-trade platforms. Exposure to SEBI and exchange-driven technology/regulatory changes, audit requirements and control frameworks. Experience working with third-party product/vendor teams and managing requirements through implementation. 
 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as: Capital Markets & Broking Domain Knowledge: Ability to demonstrate an end-to-end understanding of order and trade execution. Techno-Functional Capability: Ability to analyse a business problem at both functional and system/data levels. NEST/OMS Expertise: Understanding of front-office trading platforms, order workflows, exchange connectivity and RMS. Business Analysis: Quality of requirements, process mapping, impact analysis, functional specifications and acceptance criteria. SQL & Data Analysis: Ability to query and analyse transaction, order and trade data to investigate issues and validate changes. Problem Solving: Ability to investigate production issues, establish root causes and translate findings into sustainable remediation. Testing & Delivery: Effectiveness in defining scenarios, supporting SIT/UAT, managing defects and validating production releases. Regulatory & Control Awareness: Ability to translate regulatory/exchange requirements into system changes while maintaining appropriate controls. Stakeholder Management: Ability to communicate effectively with Dealers, RMS, Operations, Technology, vendors and senior stakeholders. Ownership: Ability to take a requirement or issue from analysis through implementation and production validation. 
 Job location is Mumbai Purpose of the role To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities. Accountabilities Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation. Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities. Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations. Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions. Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions. Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget. Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope. Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation. Analyst Expectations To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement. Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources. If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L - Listen and be authentic, E - Energise and inspire, A - Align across the enterprise, D - Develop others. OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate. Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area. Partner with other functions and business areas. Takes responsibility for end results of a team s operational processing and activities. Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately. Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation. Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise. Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct. Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function. title: Developer - Data analytics and engineer
description:
Job Description At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you ll love from top to bottom - we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals. We are seeking a Microsoft Fabric and Power BI Developer to join our Information Solutions team. You will build and support data pipelines in Microsoft Fabric and the Power BI semantic models, dashboards and reports that sit on top of them. You will work daily with onsite business analysts, data engineers and stakeholders, and you will own the development and support of the solutions you deliver, with direction from onsite leads on architecture and priorities. What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper: 
 You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance You will join a culture that has received multiple top Places to Work awards o We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create innovative solutions o We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation o Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work What Work You Will Be Responsible For: 
 Microsoft Fabric & Data Engineering 
 Build and maintain data pipelines, Dataflows Gen2 and notebooks in Microsoft Fabric to ingest data from cloud and on-premises sources into Lakehouse and Warehouse. Implement transformations across a layered (medallion) architecture, applying agreed source-to-target mappings and business rules. Build data quality and cleansing checks so reporting data is accurate and reconciles to source. Monitor pipeline runs and refresh schedules and troubleshoot failures and data discrepancies. 
 Power BI Development & Reporting 
 Design, develop and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Power BI. Build and optimize semantic models using star schema design, DAX measures, Power Query, incremental refresh and row-level security. Develop paginated reports (Power BI Report Builder or SSRS) where formatted, print-ready output is required. Tune report and model performance using Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio and refresh optimization. 
 Collaboration & Support 
 Work with onsite business analysts, data engineers and stakeholders to understand reporting needs. Support requirement gathering, iterative development and user acceptance testing. Provide support for production reports and dashboards, including timely updates and defect fixes. 
 Automation & DevOps 
 Manage Power BI and Fabric assets in Git and promote changes through Azure DevOps or Fabric deployment pipelines. Automate report refresh, subscriptions and distribution using Power BI Service. Build and maintain Power Automate flows to trigger dataset refreshes and pipelines, distribute reports, send data alerts and route approvals. Document data flows, models and support procedures. 
 Basic Requirements 
 3+ years of hands-on Power BI development, including DAX, Power Query, semantic modeling and Power BI Service (workspaces, gateways, row-level security). 1+ years of hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Pipelines, and Dataflows Gen2 or notebooks). 3+ years of SQL (T-SQL) experience, including complex queries, stored procedures and performance tuning. Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines with Fabric, Azure Data Factory or SSIS. Hands-on experience building Power Automate flows (cloud flows, connectors, triggers and error handling), including integration with Power BI and Microsoft 365. Strong knowledge of data warehouse architecture and dimensional modeling. Ability to connect Power BI to cloud and on-premises data sources. Strong problem-solving skills, with experience tuning BI solutions for performance. Clear written and spoken communication, with the ability to work with onsite teams remotely. 
 Preferred/ Desired Skills 
 Microsoft certifications such as PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) or DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer). Python, PySpark or Spark SQL for data transformation in Fabric notebooks. Experience with SSRS paginated reports and Power BI Report Server setup and administration. Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices for BI and data assets. Familiarity with Tabular Editor and DAX Studio. Experience with finance or professional services data. 
 About EisnerAmper: 
 EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with nearly 5,000 employees and more than 450 partners across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow. Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start-ups, global public firms, and middle-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not-for-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, and investors who serve these clients. 
 About EisnerAmper India: 
 EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. ( EA India ) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC ( EA Group ), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of Eisner Amper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP. EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Ahmedabad, Bangalore and Hyderabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 900 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities. Preferred Location: Mumbai

title: Consultant - Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA)
description:
Job Summary Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Consultant Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative and empowering culture Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature Are you our new Experienced Environmental Impact Assessment ConsultantIf this sounds like you, or you re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our global Impact Assessment team and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future. Your new role You will bring your knowledge of Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) into play as you participate with our European colleagues in conducting EIA s for a wide range of our projects across the energy, infrastructure, industrial, data centre and property sectors in Europe. In the energy sector as an example our work includes onshore and offshore wind, solar, hydrogen, carbon capture, storage & utilization, transmission and energy storage. You will support our European projects and collaborate primarily with our experienced EIA departments in the United Kingdom and Denmark with all aspects of impact assessments. You will have a good understanding of the EIA process and relevant regulations, and you will have the opportunity to support projects at various stages in the project lifecycle from early-stage feasibility/risk appraisal, through EIA, to consent condition compliance. A structured in-house training and development program will provide this knowledge and help personal career development. Your key responsibilities Supporting the United Kingdom and Danish teams with all aspects of impact assessment from Ramboll s office in India as parts of our EIA team. Identifying, reviewing, and summarizing relevant data. Identifying data gaps and planning data collection. Supporting with preparing reports in English. Supporting with applications for environmental permits for the European market. Assisting with coordinating inputs from internal teams and external specialists. Supporting senior consultants with project tasks and project management. Demonstrating the ability to present complex technical concepts effectively both orally and in writing so clients, regulatory agencies and legal groups can easily comprehend them is a key requirement. Qualifications & Experience Master s degree in Environmental Engineering, environmental sciences, earth sciences or a closely related environmental discipline 5 to 10 years of experience on EIA projects. Experience in the energy sector would be advantageous but is not essential. Preferred work experience with impact assessments either in industry or consultancy across the globe. Experience with adopting and applying national and international environmental regulations. Working knowledge of ArcGIS, experience with field work and data analysis is beneficial. Familiarity with environmental permitting processes. Knowledge of sustainability/ and environmental management practices is beneficial. Experience supporting/leading project workstreams and coordinating with multidisciplinary teams. Professional Skills Able to produce clear, concise, and correct written documents in English. Fluent verbal communication in English. Highly organized, able to work efficiently and effectively to deadlines on designated tasks. Demonstrate attention to details, high level of accuracy, and academic rigor. Self-motivated, reliable, and dedicated. Ability to interpret complex environmental data and regulations. Capable of presenting technical information to clients, regulators, and stakeholders. Willingness to support the senior Environmental Consultant and to work as a team. Client-focused mindset with the ability to build and maintain professional relationships. Adaptability to work in a company with an international work culture. International work experience, preferably including European experience, would be considered an advantage.

In regulatory risk compliance at PwC, you will focus on confirming adherence to regulatory requirements and mitigating risks for clients. You will provide guidance on compliance strategies and help clients navigate complex regulatory landscapes. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team member s unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. Responsibilities Analyse and identify the linkages and interactions between the component parts of an entire system. Take ownership of projects, ensuring their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. Partner with team leadership to ensure collective ownership of quality, timelines, and deliverables. Develop skills outside your comfort zone, and encourage others to do the same. title: Data Architect
description:
Position Summary The Data Architect owns the technical foundation of a new data-intensive benchmarking and analytics capability embedded in Onits enterprise legal operations platform. This is a hands-on, engineering-focused architecture role at the start of a multi-phase programme, and the work is front-loaded: within the first quarter, the Data Architect will select the data platform, design the canonical data model that several product surfaces depend on, define the service contracts, and set the performance and multi-tenant data-isolation guarantees the team builds against. Working closely with the Lead Engineer, Lead Designer, Product Management, and Data Engineering, this role stays in the code, the query plans, and the review conversations rather than handing designs over a wall. Key Responsibilities Architecture Ownership: Own the end-to-end architecture for a data-intensive analytics capability embedded in an existing enterprise product. Data Platform Selection: Evaluate and select the data platform for large-scale analytical queries, with a documented cost and performance basis for the decision. Canonical Data Model: Design a canonical data model that multiple source systems feed and multiple product surfaces consume, ensuring figures reconcile consistently across every surface. Service Contracts & APIs: Define and publish service contracts and API specifications using a contract-first approach. Non-Functional Requirements: Set and defend latency targets, refresh cadence, and availability requirements, and make them measurable rather than aspirational. Multi-Tenant Data Isolation: Design tenant data isolation so that it is enforced structurally, not by convention. Architecture Decisions & Reviews: Write architecture decision records that explain trade-offs honestly, including what would change the decision, and review designs and code across the team. Cross-Functional Translation: Translate technical constraints into terms Product and Design can act on, and translate their requirements back into architecture. Required Skills Typically 10+ years in software engineering, including substantial time in an architect, principal, or staff-level role owning system-level decisions. Demonstrable experience designing data-intensive applications: systems where query performance over large datasets is the central problem. Experience evaluating and selecting data platforms for large-scale analytical workloads, with a documented cost and performance basis for the decision. Strong SQL and relational data modelling; practical experience with analytical or columnar data stores and a clear view of when each is appropriate. Experience designing canonical data models that multiple source systems feed and multiple product surfaces consume, with figures that reconcile consistently. Experience designing and operating multi-tenant SaaS systems, including data isolation enforced structurally rather than by convention. Hands-on performance engineering: able to profile a slow query, decompose a latency budget, and define what to measure and at which percentile. Writes decisions down clearly (e.g., architecture decision records that explain trade-offs honestly) and can defend them to both engineers and non-engineers. Working proficiency with AI tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate design exploration, query analysis, and documentation, with the judgment to critically evaluate AI-generated output. Preferred Qualifications API design experience with a contract-first mindset. Cloud platform experience (AWS), including infrastructure as code. Experience retrofitting analytics or reporting capability into an existing transactional product. Experience working with incomplete or inconsistent source data, and designing systems that stay trustworthy despite it. Background in enterprise B2B SaaS or the legal technology domain. Experience with data anonymisation or aggregation where privacy guarantees matter.

 Entity: XpertDox India Private Limited (XIPL)
 Department: Human Resources
 On-site or remote: On-site, Monday through Friday
 Reports to: CEO 
 About XpertDox XpertDox, Inc. is a physician-founded, venture-backed healthcare AI company headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with a global delivery team in India. Our platform, XpertCoding, autonomously codes outpatient medical claims directly from clinical documentation using neural networks, machine learning, and natural language processing. We serve outpatient healthcare organizations in almost all 50 states, with deep expertise in Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), womens health and OB/GYN practices, and behavioral health providers. 
 Position Summary You will own all hiring for XpertDox, Inc. in the United States and XIPL in India, reporting directly to the CEO. Half of this job is senior and US hiring: you will personally run LinkedIn Recruiter searches for US leadership, finance, engineering, and clinical roles, write your own search strings and outreach, and close candidates who were not looking. The other half is India hiring across engineering, medical coding, and operations, run through job portals, referrals, and structured screening. You will lead a small recruiting team and set the hiring process both entities follow. Onboarding is owned by a separate HR team; your work ends when an accepted candidate is handed off. This role is not for someone who has moved away from hands-on sourcing; you will do the searches yourself every week. 
 Key Responsibilities In this role you will: Own every open position at XpertDox, Inc. and XIPL from intake to signed offer. Personally source senior and US candidates in LinkedIn Recruiter, including search strings, outreach messages, and follow-up. Run India hiring across engineering, medical coding, and operations through Naukri, LinkedIn, referrals, and direct outreach. Set role requirements, interview panels, and evaluation criteria with hiring managers in Noida and the United States. Screen candidates against written criteria, and verify employers, titles, dates, and credentials before candidates reach final interviews. Negotiate and close offers, and hand accepted candidates to the HR team for onboarding. Maintain the hiring tracker and report weekly to the CEO on open roles, pipeline health, time-to-fill, and offer-to-join ratio. Lead and develop the recruiting team. Build and maintain the hiring process, templates, and standards used across both entities. 
 Required Qualifications Personal, hands-on sourcing of US-based candidates in LinkedIn Recruiter within the last two years, including writing your own search strings and outreach. Experience at a US companys India center or at a US-focused recruiting firm. 10 or more years in recruiting, with at least 4 years leading a recruiting function. A track record of closing both technical roles (engineering, data, IT) and volume roles (operations, medical coding, or BPO/KPO). Strong written and spoken English for working directly with US executives and candidates. Comfort with applicant tracking systems, job portals, and reporting hiring metrics. 
 Preferred Qualifications Hiring experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, medical coding, or revenue cycle. Experience closing US Director, VP, or C-level candidates. LinkedIn Certified Professional: Recruiter certification. Experience building a recruiting function or hiring process from scratch. 
 Location and Schedule This is an on-site role at the XIPL office in Noida, Monday through Friday, 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST. The schedule overlaps with US business hours. Candidates must live in Noida or the NCR region, or relocate there before the start date. This role is not remote or hybrid.

title: Staff/ Sr Staff/Principal Engineer, STA
description:
We are seeking a seasoned Backend Design Expert specializing in Static Timing Analysis (STA) and Logic Synthesis . You will own the RTL-to-Gate conversion, constraint development, and final timing closure, ensuring our chips deliver maximum performance at the lowest possible power and area. Key Responsibilities Physical-Aware Synthesis and PPA optimization: Own and execute hierarchical synthesis flows to translate SystemVerilog RTL into optimized gate-level netlists. Execute physical-aware and floorplan-driven synthesis flows to minimize post-layout congestion and achieve PPA targets, identify bottlenecks and drive optimizations (e. g. , critical path restructuring, datapath optimization). Conduct flat and hierarchical synthesis, ensuring seamless interface timing budgets. Manage formal verification (LEC) to ensure logical equivalence between RTL and netlist. UPF management for multiply power domains. Timing Closure & STA: Perform block-level and full-chip STA across multi-mode and multi-corner (MMMC) scenarios using industry-standard tools. title: Opportunities For IBM MQ Engineer / Architect (Containerization & EKS
description:
Role & responsibilities Seeking an experienced IBM MQ Engineer / Architect with strong containerization and Kubernetes knowledge to lead the migration of IBM MQ workloads from Amazon EC2 to Amazon EKS. The role will own assessment, target-state design, migration planning, build, testing, cutover, and post-migration stabilization for a secure, highly available, and observable IBM MQ platform running on Kubernetes. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Assess the current IBM MQ estate running on EC2, including queue managers, channels, clustering, HA/DR setup, storage, security, monitoring, and dependencies. Define the target architecture for IBM MQ on EKS, including container strategy, namespace design, networking, persistent storage, secrets handling, and high availability. Design and implement IBM MQ containerization patterns using Docker/OCI images and Kubernetes-native deployment approaches. Build and manage deployment automation for IBM MQ on EKS using Helm, Kubernetes manifests, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code where applicable. Plan and execute migration from EC2 to EKS with minimal disruption, including environment setup, data persistence strategy, queue manager migration, rollback planning, and cutover support. Configure persistent volumes, storage classes, backup, restore, and disaster recovery for stateful IBM MQ workloads on Kubernetes. Implement security controls including TLS, certificate management, IAM integration, secrets management, encryption, and platform hardening. Partner with application, middleware, infrastructure, cloud, and security teams to validate connectivity, performance, and production readiness. Establish monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability for IBM MQ on EKS using enterprise tooling. Tune performance, capacity, and resilience characteristics for containerized MQ workloads. Produce architecture documents, runbooks, SOPs, migration plans, and operational handover materials. Support hypercare and post-production stabilization after migration. Required Skills 7+ years of hands-on experience with IBM MQ administration and engineering. Strong experience with IBM MQ queue managers, channels, listeners, clustering, client connectivity, SSL/TLS, and troubleshooting. Hands-on experience containerizing middleware platforms, ideally IBM MQ. Strong knowledge of Kubernetes and Amazon EKS, including pods, StatefulSets, services, ingress/network policies, volumes, config maps, secrets, and RBAC. Experience migrating stateful enterprise workloads from virtual machines or EC2 to Kubernetes. Strong understanding of AWS infrastructure, including EC2, EKS, VPC, IAM, EBS/EFS, load balancing, Route 53, CloudWatch, and security controls. Experience with CI/CD and automation tools such as Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Terraform, Ansible, or similar. Knowledge of Linux administration, shell scripting, and container runtime concepts. Experience with monitoring and logging platforms such as Splunk, ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, or AppDynamics. Strong troubleshooting skills across middleware, OS, networking, storage, and cloud layers. Preferred Skills Experience with IBM MQ Operator or similar Kubernetes-native operational models. Prior experience designing HA/DR for IBM MQ on Kubernetes. Experience with service mesh, certificate automation, and secrets platforms such as HashiCorp Vault. Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns involving IBM MQ, APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems. Exposure to regulated environments with strong audit, security, and resiliency requirements. Experience with OpenShift is a plus. Looking Only immediate joiner if interested pls share resume on uk00753470@techmahindra.com

title: Manager - Manufacturing Intelligence
description:
Use Your Power for Purpose 
 At Pfizer, technology impacts everything we do. Our digital and data first strategy focuses on implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions, from research to manufacturing. By digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying solutions, or making our work easier and faster, you will be making a difference to countless lives. Your dedication and hard work will be instrumental in helping Pfizer achieve new milestones and make a positive impact on patients worldwide. 
 Role overview The Manufacturing Intelligence and Technology Transformation (MITT) team within Pfizer s Global Technology, Engineering and Launch organisation develops and deploys advanced manufacturing capabilities across Pfizer Global Supply. These capabilities include artificial intelligence and machine learning, soft sensors, advanced process control and agentic AI solutions. The Data Science Manager will develop and implement advanced AI and process-modelling solutions in complex pharmaceutical manufacturing environments. This individual contributor role will focus on large language models, agentic systems, real-time soft sensors and advanced process control to generate actionable insights and support continuous improvement across manufacturing and quality operations. Responsibilities Contribute technical expertise to high-impact analytics, modelling and optimisation projects. Identify high-value applications for advanced analytics, advanced process control, AI, machine learning, large language models, agentic AI and the Industrial Internet of Things. Design and deploy fit-for-purpose solutions for pharmaceutical manufacturing environments. Develop mathematical models, machine-learning systems and LLM-enabled agentic workflows, and support their implementation in GMP environments. Apply engineering principles, modelling tools and experimental methods to data-rich laboratory, pilot and manufacturing systems. Improve process understanding and enable real-time process monitoring and control. Collaborate with cross-functional teams and key stakeholders, communicate progress clearly and drive projects to timely completion. Basic qualifications Expert-level Python proficiency is a must Experience preparing and analysing large, real-world datasets, including structured time-series data containing thousands of variables is required Demonstrated experience applying AI methods-including LLMs, knowledge graphs and agentic architectures-to generate insights and support decision-making. Proven ability to develop autonomous agents or AI copilots for manufacturing or scientific workflows. Strong collaboration skills and experience working in diverse, cross-functional teams. Knowledge of pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences. Adherence to best practice software engineering principles eg PEP8 Preferred qualifications A PhD with at least 2-3 years experience or Masters with 5-6 years experience in engineering, mathematics, computer science, or related discipline. Expertise in first-principles modelling, including thermodynamics, reaction modelling and heat and mass transfer. Experience developing hybrid and practical process models for real-time applications. Experience with cloud-based development platforms such as AWS SageMaker. Familiarity with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake or Redshift and relational databases using SQL. Hands-on experience with deep learning and latent variable models for time-series monitoring, anomaly detection, and automated root-cause analysis. Experience integrating LLMs into real-time decision-support systems or user-facing agentic applications. Proficiency with visualisation and dashboard tools such as Streamlit, Plotly or Spotfire. 
 
Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

description:
Job Summary Role: Automation Quality Analyst Location: India, Remote Experience: 2-4 Years Role Overview We are looking for a detail-oriented and enthusiastic Android QA Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team. The candidate will be responsible for validating Android applications across devices and operating system versions, executing functional and regression tests, identifying defects, and contributing to automation and continuous quality improvement. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in software testing concepts, basic Android and Linux knowledge, and an eagerness to learn automation tools and modern Quality Engineering practices. Key Responsibilities 1. Testing & Quality Assurance Understand business requirements and user workflows and convert them into test scenarios and test cases. Perform functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing. Execute test cases and report defects with sufficient evidence and reproduction steps. Participate in release validation and quality certification activities. Apply test design techniques such as Equivalence Partitioning, Boundary Value Analysis, Decision Tables, and State Transition Testing. 2. Android Application & Device Testing Test Android applications on emulators and physical devices. Validate application behaviour across different screen sizes and Android OS versions. Capture screenshots, logs, videos, and test evidence. Perform installation, upgrade, and compatibility testing. Use Android Debug Bridge (ADB) for basic troubleshooting and diagnostics. Review Logcat outputs and assist in defect root cause analysis. 3. Automation Engineering Develop and maintain automated test scripts. Build reusable and data-driven automation test suites. Contribute to automation framework development using industry-standard tools. Execute automated test suites and analyse failures. Create utilities and helper scripts for test data preparation and validation. 4. CI/CD & Reporting Trigger and monitor automated test executions through CI/CD pipelines. Analyse execution results and prepare quality reports. Participate in release-readiness and quality-signoff activities. Generate concise test execution summaries and release recommendations. 5. Continuous Learning & Collaboration Learn modern Quality Engineering practices. Explore AI-assisted testing techniques and tools. Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and senior QA engineers. Participate in training programs, hackathons, and technical knowledge-sharing sessions. Required Technical Skills & Competencies Software Testing Fundamentals Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), and Software Defect Lifecycle. Understanding of functional and regression testing concepts. Familiarity with test case design techniques. Android Fundamentals Basic understanding of Android applications and Android architecture. Familiarity with APK installation and testing. Understanding of Android emulators and mobile application testing concepts. Linux Fundamentals Basic Linux command-line knowledge. Familiarity with file system navigation, log inspection, basic shell commands, and process monitoring. Database Fundamentals Basic understanding of relational databases. Ability to write simple SQL queries using SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, and GROUP BY. Version Control Basic knowledge of Git. Understanding of clone, commit, push, and pull request concepts. Must-Have Skills Software testing fundamentals. Functional and regression testing. Android application testing. Test case design and defect reporting. Basic SQL queries. Git fundamentals. Job Summary Role: Automation Quality Analyst Location: India, Remote Experience: 2-4 Years Role Overview We are looking for a detail-oriented and enthusiastic Android QA Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team. The candidate will be responsible for validating Android applications across devices and operating system versions, executing functional and regression tests, identifying defects, and contributing to automation and continuous quality improvement. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in software testing concepts, basic Android and Linux knowledge, and an eagerness to learn automation tools and modern Quality Engineering practices. Key Responsibilities 1. Testing & Quality Assurance Understand business requirements and user workflows and convert them into test scenarios and test cases. Perform functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing. Execute test cases and report defects with sufficient evidence and reproduction steps. Participate in release validation and quality certification activities. Apply test design techniques such as Equivalence Partitioning, Boundary Value Analysis, Decision Tables, and State Transition Testing. 2. Android Application & Device Testing Test Android applications on emulators and physical devices. Validate application behaviour across different screen sizes and Android OS versions. Capture screenshots, logs, videos, and test evidence. Perform installation, upgrade, and compatibility testing. Use Android Debug Bridge (ADB) for basic troubleshooting and diagnostics. Review Logcat outputs and assist in defect root cause analysis. 3. Automation Engineering Develop and maintain automated test scripts. Build reusable and data-driven automation test suites. Contribute to automation framework development using industry-standard tools. Execute automated test suites and analyse failures. Create utilities and helper scripts for test data preparation and validation. 4. CI/CD & Reporting Trigger and monitor automated test executions through CI/CD pipelines. Analyse execution results and prepare quality reports. Participate in release-readiness and quality-signoff activities. Generate concise test execution summaries and release recommendations. 5. Continuous Learning & Collaboration Learn modern Quality Engineering practices. Explore AI-assisted testing techniques and tools. Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and senior QA engineers. Participate in training programs, hackathons, and technical knowledge-sharing sessions. Required Technical Skills & Competencies Software Testing Fundamentals Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), and Software Defect Lifecycle. Understanding of functional and regression testing concepts. Familiarity with test case design techniques. Android Fundamentals Basic understanding of Android applications and Android architecture. Familiarity with APK installation and testing. Understanding of Android emulators and mobile application testing concepts. Linux Fundamentals Basic Linux command-line knowledge. Familiarity with file system navigation, log inspection, basic shell commands, and process monitoring. Database Fundamentals Basic understanding of relational databases. Ability to write simple SQL queries using SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, and GROUP BY. Version Control Basic knowledge of Git. Understanding of clone, commit, push, and pull request concepts. Must-Have Skills Software testing fundamentals. Functional and regression testing. Android application testing. Test case design and defect reporting. Basic SQL queries. Git fundamentals. Analytical and problem-solving skills. Good to Have Skills Python programming. Robot Framework. Appium. CI/CD exposure. AI Foundation. Desired Attributes Passionate about software quality and testing. Strong analytical and problem-solving thinker. Curious and eager to learn new technologies. Detail-oriented and quality-focused. Good team player with strong communication skills. Self-motivated and willing to take ownership. Interview Process 2-3 rounds of discussion.

title: Delivery & Release Coordinator (UAT and Quality) - IFS Logistics
description:
Job Description About IFS Logistics IFS Logistics is an AI enterprise logistics platform that helps shippers and logistics businesses connect transport data, manage carrier spend and automate execution. Originally launched as 7bridges, the product is now part of IFS and is developed by a small, dedicated team. The role We are looking for a Delivery & Release Coordinator to manage user acceptance testing, release activity and day-to-day delivery coordination across the product team. The team is preparing for its first IFS Cloud customer go-live, bringing a new API into production and recruiting a significant number of new colleagues. As the pace of delivery increases, we need clear ownership of test cycles, defects, release readiness and communication. You will coordinate UAT with customers and internal stakeholders, maintain release plans and checklists, track defects through to resolution and support go/no-go decisions. You will work closely with Lorraine Hassall, our Quality Manager, allowing her to focus on quality standards and strategy while you manage the practical coordination required to apply them consistently. Most of the role is focused on UAT, releases and delivery. It also includes a smaller amount of team coordination, particularly onboarding, in-person sessions, travel planning, and financial coordination. What youll work on UAT and release management Plan and coordinate UAT cycles with customers and internal stakeholders. Confirm scope, participants, test windows, evidence and sign-off for each cycle. Track defects from identification through triage, ownership, resolution and closure. Support on the release calendar, release notes, readiness checklist and go/no-go process. Coordinate with other teams in IFS as the product is integrated with IFS Cloud. Support the UAT and release plan for Project Oliver and the first IFS Cloud customer go-live. Supporting the quality function Work with the Quality Manager on test processes, evidence and audit trails. Help apply standards such as clear acceptance criteria, merge-request review and controlled production releases. Support the move from periodic manual QA towards per-ticket quality assurance and more frequent releases. Delivery coordination Keep Jira accurate, with current statuses, acceptance criteria and links to relevant merge requests. Maintain useful documentation and decision records in Notion. Prepare concise delivery and release updates for product and engineering leads. Identify risks early, clarify ownership and follow actions through to completion. Team coordination Organise onboarding logistics for new starters and monthly in-person sessions in Staines. Coordinate team travel, expenses and purchase orders. Qualifications What were looking for Strong organisation and follow-through, with a habit of identifying and addressing issues early. Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders. The ability to work constructively with engineers and maintain agreed standards when priorities are competing. A practical, accountable approach to moving work forward without waiting for detailed direction. Experience coordinating UAT, software releases or delivery within a product or engineering team. Familiarity with release notes, test cycles, defect tracking, go/no-go decisions, acceptance criteria and regression scope. Experience managing a defect list through triage and resolution rather than only reporting its status. Confidence using Jira and a documentation platform such as Notion or Confluence. Relevant backgrounds may include delivery coordination, release coordination, junior delivery management, QA coordination, scrum mastery or project coordination. We are more interested in what you have managed than in your previous job title. Nice to have Experience with enterprise software involving customer UAT and formal sign-off. Exposure to regulated or audited environments, ERP products or supply-chain software. ISTQB, Agile or delivery certification. Experience working within a large organisation with established procurement and HR processes. Experience using AI tools to draft release notes, summarise defect lists or prepare status updates. Tools The team uses Jira, Notion, GitLab, Slack, Microsoft 365 and Outlook, along with IFS systems for travel, expenses and purchasing. You do not need to write code, but you should be comfortable working with engineers and understanding their delivery processes. What success looks like in the first six months Releases follow a predictable cadence and include clear, accurate release notes. Each UAT cycle has an agreed owner, schedule, defect list, evidence and sign-off. Customer and support defects receive clear ownership and a visible route to resolution. The Project Oliver go-live is supported by a well-managed UAT and release plan. Acceptance criteria, review and release controls are applied consistently. Product and engineering leads spend less time on routine coordination and administration. Why were hiring now The product team is growing and preparing for several important releases. The Quality Manager currently carries much of the practical coordination associated with testing and releases. This role will provide dedicated support of that work, helping the team increase delivery frequency while maintaining clear quality and release controls.

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
International Aerospace Manufacturing Pvt. Ltd (IAMPL) is a 50/50 joint venture between Rolls-Royce and Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), established in 2010 to manufacture high-precision aero engine compressor and gas turbine parts. Over time, IAMPL has become a fully accredited benchmark facility within the global aero engine supply chain, supplying around 200 different parts for advanced civil aero engine programs across Europe, Asia, and North America. The purpose-built facility in Bangalore uses modern machine tools, CMMs, metal spray booths, and NDT lines to complete all manufacturing processes in-house, supporting competitive development and lead times. IAMPL follows global quality standards, digital production systems, and advanced manufacturing techniques to deliver a broad spectrum of aero engine components. The company operates from a 50,000 ft² facility with room for expansion and holds AS 9100, NADCAP, ISO 14001, and OHSAS 18001 accreditations.

**Role Description**
The Senior Quality Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Hosur, responsible for ensuring that aero engine components meet stringent quality and regulatory requirements. This role involves developing, implementing, and maintaining quality engineering processes, performing inspections and audits, and leading root cause analysis and corrective actions for product and process non-conformities. The Senior Quality Engineer collaborates with cross-functional teams in manufacturing, design, and supply chain to drive continuous improvement, reduce defects, and optimize quality performance. Daily tasks include monitoring quality metrics, reviewing documentation, supporting customer and certification audits, and ensuring adherence to global standards and internal procedures.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated expertise in Quality Engineering and Quality Management, with experience in developing and improving quality systems and processes.
* Strong skills in Quality Control and Product Quality, including inspection methods, measurement systems, and defect analysis.
* Experience in Quality Assurance, including audits, compliance with aerospace standards, and documentation control.
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering (or related discipline); advanced certifications in quality (e.g., ASQ CQE) are an advantage.
* Background in aerospace or precision manufacturing environments, preferably with familiarity with AS 9100, NADCAP, ISO 14001, and OHSAS/ISO 45001 requirements.
* Proficiency in problem-solving tools (e.g., FMEA, 8D, Root Cause Analysis), statistical quality methods, and continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications, work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, and communicate clearly with internal and external stakeholders.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Robotics Hardware
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
  
  
**Senior Mechanical Engineer — Robotics Hardware**
**Location**
- Bangalore
  
  
Instawork Robotics Labs is building Instacore, our proprietary five-camera and IMU wearable capture rig. Hundreds of units operate across India every day, collecting real-world data used to train frontier Physical AI models.
  
  
We are looking for a senior, mechanically focused engineer to own the complete hardware lifecycle for Instacore and future hardware products. This person will independently lead design, prototyping, manufacturing, testing, deployment, logistics, maintenance, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the mechanical design and development of Instacore and other robotics hardware from initial requirements through production and field deployment.
* Create detailed CAD models, assemblies, engineering drawings, bills of materials, and manufacturing documentation.
* Rapidly prototype and validate designs using 3D printing, machining, fabrication, and off-the-shelf components.
* Design durable mounts, enclosures, fixtures, wearable components, packaging, and protective systems.
* Own design for manufacturability, assembly, serviceability, reliability, and cost.
* Improve cable routing, connector retention, strain relief, thermal management, ingress protection, and resistance to vibration and impact.
* Design packaging and logistics processes that prevent damage during storage and transit.
* Establish verification, stress-testing, quality-control, and acceptance-testing procedures.
* Investigate field failures, determine root causes, and implement corrective improvements across the fleet.
* Own the maintenance and repair strategy for deployed hardware, including spare parts, repair documentation, and technician procedures.
* Manage vendors, fabricators, component suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
* Own component sourcing, inventory planning, hardware logistics, and deployment readiness.
* Work closely with robotics, electrical, firmware, software, operations, and field teams to deliver complete systems.
* Build repeatable processes that allow the hardware fleet to scale reliably across India and APAC.
* Mentor technicians and junior engineers while remaining deeply hands-on.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Product Design, Robotics, or a related discipline.
* \*\*Five to seven years of hands-on experience\*\* designing and delivering physical products or robotics hardware.
* Advanced proficiency with CAD, including complex parts, assemblies, drawings, tolerance definition, and revision management.
* Strong experience with rapid prototyping and 3D printing, including material selection, print orientation, tolerances, and design limitations.
* Experience taking products from early prototypes through low-volume or scaled production.
* Strong understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, fasteners, tolerances, load paths, fatigue, vibration, and impact resistance.
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose mechanical failures and implement robust, practical solutions.
* Experience working with vendors and managing manufacturing, sourcing, inventory, packaging, or logistics.
* Ability to independently prioritize work, make engineering decisions, and own outcomes with limited oversight.
* Willingness to travel across India and APAC for vendor visits, deployments, and field investigations.

**Good to have**

* Electrical engineering knowledge, particularly wiring, connectors, sensors, cameras, power systems, printed circuit board integration, and basic electronics troubleshooting.
* Experience designing electromechanical or wearable products.
* Programming proficiency in Python, C++, or another relevant language.
* Experience writing scripts for test automation, hardware validation, data analysis, or manufacturing workflows.
* Familiarity with Raspberry Pi, embedded systems, computer vision hardware, or IoT devices.
* Experience managing engineering documentation and product data using version-control or product-lifecycle-management systems.
* Experience building or leading a small hardware engineering function.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Instacore has a clear, reliable, and scalable hardware architecture.
* New designs move efficiently from requirements through prototype, validation, and deployment.
* Field failures, wire breakages, and transit damage decline measurably.
* Manufacturing, repair, inventory, and logistics processes are documented and repeatable.
* Junior engineers and technicians can assemble, test, and repair units using the systems you establish.
* Hardware development no longer depends on day-to-day involvement from the broader team.

**Our Values**

* Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**
Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
  
  
Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
  
  
Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

Since Shield AI's mission is to protect service members and civilians, The Hivemind Solutions Test Department makes this a reality by validating the reliability, safety, and performance of our world-class autonomy software.
  
  
You’ll lead simulation-driven testing, automation, and software quality efforts for Hivemind, building and executing test frameworks that ensure our autonomy software performs reliably across simulated and real-world mission environments.
  
  
Shield AI is growing quickly, and we're looking for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, embraces learning, and brings a high-ownership, mission-driven mindset. This is a chance to have a real impact—advancing autonomy that protects lives—while working with a collaborative, high-performing team.
  
  
**What you'll do:**

* Develop automated regression, integration, and system-level tests to ensure Hivemind software quality and stability across releases.
* Identify, reproduce, and diagnose software issues—collaborating closely with development teams to drive fixes and improvements.
* Create and execute test plans and documentation for autonomy software in simulated environments, ensuring mission and safety requirements are met.
* Design, implement, and maintain simulation-based test frameworks to validate Hivemind autonomy behavior and performance.
* Build tools and utilities in Python to automate testing, data processing, and analysis workflows.
* Develop test harnesses and data validation tools for Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) / Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) / Vehicle-in-the-Loop (VIL) and simulation environments.
* Contribute to the definition of testing methodologies, metrics, and performance benchmarks for autonomy software validation.
* Support the scaling and reliability of simulation infrastructure used for large-scale software validation.
* Maintain detailed and accurate test documentation, ensuring traceability and knowledge sharing across teams.
* Work with developers to integrate test coverage directly into the development pipeline (CI/CD).

**Required qualifications:**

* Typically requires a minimum of 3-5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 2-4 years and a Master’s degree; or 2 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience.
* Proficiency in Python.
* Experience in robotics, small UAS, or related hands-on engineering projects.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
* Passionate about intelligent aircraft systems.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional software. hardware and mechanical engineering teams.
* Adaptability and a willingness to learn new technologies and methodologies quickly in a fast-paced environment.

And we can do the same for you. Whatever your aspirations, Vialto can help you find your way.

The Operational Excellence Manager will drive the Operational Excellence agenda across VVN global mobility operations in India. A key priority will be to identify, adapt, and scale proven improvement practices from across Vialto, ensuring successful approaches are consistently embedded within local operations. The role will build organizational capability through continuous improvement training, methodologies, and tools, while partnering with operational leaders to standardize processes, establish governance, and implement performance measurement frameworks that enable sustainable improvements and measurable business outcomes.
  
  
The role will support broader process improvement and automation initiatives by identifying opportunities to simplify workflows, improve efficiency, and enhance service delivery. Working closely with operational and functional stakeholders, the successful candidate will assess opportunities, develop business cases, define requirements, and coordinate the delivery of improvement initiatives. While experience with automation is advantageous, this is primarily a business-facing role focused on opportunity assessment, solution design, stakeholder engagement, and benefits realization rather than hands-on automation development.
  
  
Reporting to the Operational Excellence Lead, this role is part of a broader enabling functions team that combines expertise in process improvement, automation, analytics, and other support capabilities.

* Lead process improvement initiatives using structured Operational Excellence methodologies and project management disciplines.
* Design and deliver training on Operational Excellence methodologies, tools, and best practices, and coach teams in their practical application.

* Experience driving change adoption and influencing stakeholders across multiple levels of an organization.

* Experience supporting clients or stakeholders across EMEA and/or the Americas.
