title: Design Engineer | CTC Upto 15-20LPA
description:
**Design Engineer | Rekise Marine**

**Location**
: Bengaluru

**Employment**
: Full-time

**Experience**
: 4–10 years

**Company Description**

RekiSe Marine is a marine robotics company building autonomous ships and submarines for defence. It has raised $9.7M in a round led by Accel and Nikhil Kamath's NKSquared, and was founded by a naval architect and a retired Indian Navy Rear Admiral. Rekise builds everything end to end, from vessel design to autonomy software. Its flagship project is the Jalkapi XLAUV, India's first unmanned submarine, on order from the Indian Navy. Jalkapi weighs over 20 tons, can travel 5,000+ km autonomously and can stay at sea for 30+ days.

Role DescriptionAs a Design Engineer at RekiSe Marine, you'll design the components and subsystems of some of the largest autonomous robots in the world. That includes pressure vessels that operate at 300m depths. You'll take parts from CAD through prototyping, testing and production, working with the R&D, manufacturing, electrical and software teams. The team moves at startup speed and keeps the engineering discipline that defence work needs. We're looking for someone who has built complex hardware hands-on, not just drawn it.

**Qualifications**

* 4–10 years of hands-on experience in mechanical design, ideally at early or mid-stage robotics, hardware or physical AI startups.
* Proven experience designing complex subsystems end to end, from concept and CAD to prototype, testing and production.
* Exposure to robotics or Formula Student / formula racing teams in college is highly preferred.
* Strong proficiency in NX CAD (preferred). SolidWorks, CATIA or AutoCAD also work.
* Experience creating detailed 2D/3D models and engineering drawings for manufacturing and assembly.
* Familiarity with simulation tools like ANSYS or Abaqus for stress analysis and feasibility studies.
* Strong knowledge of materials, manufacturing processes and prototyping techniques.
* Hands-on experience applying DFM, DFA and DFMEA principles.
* Ability to find and fix design issues during testing and validation.
* Comfortable working with mechanical, electrical and software engineers, and writing clear technical documentation.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities against tight deadlines.
* B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design or a related field.

**Not a fit:**
Candidates whose experience is only at large MNCs or IT/engineering services companies.

**Why Join**

Your work will directly strengthen India's underwater defence capabilities. You'll take on extreme-environment engineering problems that few engineers in India have tackled. You'll get a lot of ownership, a flat culture, and access to top design tools and software licences.

title: Head BD & Distribution Alternates AIF - South
description:
SOUTH – BENGALURU

Vantrock Investment Managers LLP

**Vantrock is a multi-product real assets platform. Not a warehousing fund.**
Logistics and industrial is the first strategy. Office, plotted sales, land, pre-leased and yielding assets, private credit, data centres and senior living follow behind it. This seat builds the distribution network for all of it in Bengaluru, Hyderabad and the wider Karnataka, Telangana and Andhra markets.

**THE SEAT**

**Employer:**
Vantrock Investment Managers LLP, the investment manager within Vantrock Ventures

**Reports to:**
Chief Business Officer, Fundraising and Investor Relations. Until that seat is filled, directly to the Founder & CEO, who will build the franchise with the zonal team hands-on

**Direct reports:**
None at launch. A senior single-contributor seat with a very large number attached

**Location:**
Bengaluru, in office, with twelve to fifteen travel days a month across the zone

**Experience:**
10 to 16 years

Team structure, reporting lines, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the current plan and may change. Compensation is confirmed in the offer.

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

Vantrock is an operator-led real assets platform, and it is multi-product by design. Real assets only. Warehousing and industrial parks are
**the first strategy, not the platform**
, across the full chain: first mile, last mile, city-centre, dark-store and self-storage formats, and logistics-anchored mixed-use with distribution below and office above.

Behind that first strategy sits the rest of the platform, launched in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back-office space, where our expertise transfers directly; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living. Each is a strategy in its own right, with its own pipeline and its own distributor relationships behind it.
**A candidate who reads this as a warehousing platform has read the first line and stopped.**

Three parts, kept separate. The founder's balance sheet takes the first risk: land is acquired, de-risked and approved on his capital before any investor commits. Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited develops and operates; Vantrock Investment Managers LLP underwrites every asset independently and answers to an independent Investment Committee. Assets enter at cost, with no founder premium. The platform earns only after its investors have.

Founded by
**Anshul Singhal, Founder & CEO**
. Three institutional platforms built from zero, and the fourth now on his own capital. Across that career: India's largest industrial real estate exit, Rs 5,250 Cr to Blackstone; a fund platform taken from zero to about USD 1.4 billion in peak AUM in six years, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, Rs 2,775 Cr from roughly 1,000 investors through the channel, on India's first domestic warehousing AIF; 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor; 2,000+ acres acquired, all litigation-free; 200+ buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.

**Warehousing is where the founder is best known. It is not where this platform stops.**
That record is the anchor that opens the door in the channel. The mandate you would be selling is considerably wider than it.

We hire number twos who want to become number one.

**THE PRODUCT SET YOU WOULD BE SELLING**

This is the part most candidates get wrong. You would not be carrying one product into the channel. You would be building a channel that carries a succession of products across real assets. The proposed set, built out in sequence as each is delivered and as approvals are obtained:

– Industrial parks, logistics and warehousing

– Office: suburban campuses, GCC and back-office space, starter and strata office

– Plotted and industrial plot sales

– Pre-leased and yielding assets

– A land strategy

– Private credit

– Data centres and senior living

– In time, listed or pooled vehicle formats including InvIT and REIT structures

**Multiple product lines, one channel.**
That is why this is a franchise-building job rather than a product-selling job. An RM you certify on the first strategy sells the second, third and fourth without being recruited again.

The intended route is a seeded AIF alongside deal-by-deal co-investment through CIV, co-investment PMS and other structures, subject to approvals. Seeded is the point: the operator puts assets in place before a fund launches, so much of the pipeline is de-risked on day one and no blind pool is raised. Two sales in one: a fund commitment into a visible pipeline, and larger co-investment tickets into named assets.

**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**

**Own the zone.**
Build the distribution and IFA network across Bengaluru, Hyderabad and the wider Karnataka, Telangana and Andhra markets. Activate the RMs and advisers inside it, and convert that network into committed capital for the first strategy and into a channel that is ready when the office, plotted, land, credit and yielding strategies arrive behind it.

**Not a cold start.**
The platform brings an existing investor base, anchor commitments in place, and a founder known in the channel from two prior funds. The channel will take the meeting. What does not yet exist is the franchise: the empanelments, the certified RMs, the joint calls. There is no team to delegate that to in Year 1. Seniority here means credibility and judgment, not a desk.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

– The network. National distributors' regional offices, regional distributors, IFAs and MFDs, DSAs, RIAs, multi-family offices and wealth-platform desks. Target 6 to 8 firms empanelled and live.

– The full empanelment cycle, locally. First meeting to product committee to go-live, for both the fund and the co-investment routes. Empanel the platform, not a single product, so the next strategy does not start the cycle again.

– Activation. Branch meetings, huddles and desk conversations until 40 to 60 RMs and IFAs have each placed at least one ticket.

– Conversion. Joint client meetings as the core of the job. The pipeline from interest through contribution agreement to funds received.

– The map, in the CRM, weekly. Investor relations in the zone after the close, with Fund Operations. The face of Vantrock in Bengaluru and Hyderabad.

**THIS IS A FRONT-FACING SEAT**

You do not sell to the distributors and stop. You sell with them. Accompany partners and their RMs to their clients and pitch yourself. Tell the story so an RM can repeat it under pressure. Host investor evenings, partner meets and site visits, speak where the channel meets the asset class, and be a named voice of the platform on LinkedIn.

**Approved material only. Nothing bespoke, nothing verbal-only, no return promises, ever.**

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Essential**

– 10 to 16 years in financial services, at least five in B2B or B2B2C distribution of PMS, AIF or mutual-fund products from the manufacturer's side, an AMC, alternatives manager or fund house. You have carried a distribution number and been paid against it.

– Verifiable relationships with distributor product heads, national and regional distributors and the top IFA and MFD firms in Bengaluru and Hyderabad. You can name them, and they will take your call.

– You have launched a product into the channel from scratch at least once, not only carried an established brand.

– Third-party capital raised through the channel, stated as capital drawn, not assets influenced.

– Graduate. MBA, PGDM, CA or CFA or equivalent. NISM as applicable.

– Appetite for the road. Twelve to fifteen travel days a month is the job, not an exception to it.

**Advantageous**

– A real assets fund background. Not mandatory: a strong alternatives channel salesperson from equity, credit or PMS is often the superior hire, because channel sales is harder to teach than an asset class.

– Experience carrying more than one product line into the same channel. This platform will ask you to do it repeatedly.

title: CCTV & NETWORKING TEACHNICIAN (ELV / Field Service)
description:
About the job
  
  
We are looking for a CCTV and Networking Engineer to take ownership of surveillance and ELV installations from site survey through commissioning and long-term support. • Conduct site surveys and recommend camera placement, cabling routes, and network design.

• Complete installations to drawings and BOQ, and prepare as-built documentation.
  
  
2. Network Integration & Configuration
  
• Configure IP addressing, VLANs, routing, and basic switching for surveillance networks.
  
• Integrate CCTV with access control, fire alarm, intercom, and other ELV systems as required.
  
• Set up remote viewing, port forwarding/VPN, and mobile/VMS client access.
  
• Troubleshoot bandwidth, latency, packet loss, and PoE issues.

• Perform scheduled preventive maintenance (PM) visits and health checks.
  
• Diagnose and resolve faults on cameras, recorders, storage, switches, and cabling.
  
• Handle service tickets within SLA and maintain accurate service reports.
  
• Manage firmware updates, backups, and storage/retention checks.
  
  
4. Site Ownership & Coordination
  
• Act as the single point of contact for assigned sites.
  
• Coordinate with clients, IT teams, civil/electrical contractors, and OEM/vendor support.
  
• Manage material requirements, site stock, and RMA/warranty claims.
  
• Brief and guide junior technicians and helpers on site.
  
  
5. Documentation & Reporting
  
• Maintain IP schedules, network diagrams, asset registers, and handover documents.
  
• Submit daily/weekly progress and service reports.
  
• Obtain client sign-offs for commissioning and closure.
  
  
Required Skills & Qualifications
  
Education: Any class / Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, IT, or a related field (ITI with strong experience may be considered).
  
  
Technical skills:
  
• Hands-on experience with IP CCTV brands (Hikvision, Dahua, CP Plus, Axis, Hanwha, etc.).
  
• Solid understanding of TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs, DHCP, NAT, and PoE.
  
• Experience with managed switches (Cisco, D-Link, TP-Link, Netgear, or similar).
  
• Knowledge of structured cabling (CAT6, fibre splicing/OTDR basics) and testing tools.
  
• Familiarity with VMS platforms, NVR/storage sizing, and video analytics basics.
  
• Comfortable using laptop, crimping/testing tools, and network diagnostic utilities.
  
  
Good to have:
  
• CCNA, CompTIA Network+, or OEM certifications.
  
• Exposure to access control, biometrics, fire alarm, or PA systems.
  
• Experience with ticketing/CRM tools.
  
• Basic understanding of cybersecurity hygiene for IP cameras (password policies, firmware, port hardening).
  
Soft skills:
  
• Strong troubleshooting and ownership mindset.
  
• Clear communication with clients and vendors.
  
• Ability to work independently and manage multiple sites.
  
• Willingness to travel and handle on-call or after-hours support.
  
Key Performance Indicators
  
• SLA adherence and mean time to resolve
  
• First-time-fix rate
  
• Installation quality and timely commissioning
  
• Client satisfaction and repeat-call reduction
  
• Accuracy of documentation and reports

title: Customer Experience Engineer, L1
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
  
  
Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.
  
  
People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
  
  
**About The Role**
Customer Experience Engineering is where customers, product, and engineering meet. As a CXE 1, you’ll investigate real technical problems across our platform, APIs, integrations, data, and customer workflows. You’ll learn to trace issues to root cause, communicate clearly with customers and internal teams, and build the judgment to own increasingly complex work independently.
  
  
This is not a traditional support role built around scripts and handoffs. You’ll work in one shared CXE queue, use AI as part of your everyday engineering toolkit, and contribute to the knowledge, automation, and product improvements that prevent repeat problems. CXE 1 is designed as a transition into CXE 2 as your depth, independence, and customer readiness become consistently visible.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own standard and moderately complex customer issues from first investigation through resolution and closure.
* Debug web application, API, integration, authentication, configuration, and data issues using logs, developer tools, SQL, and established investigation patterns.
* Communicate clearly and empathetically across tickets, calls, incidents, and internal channels; ask precise questions, set expectations, and close every loop.
* Work with CXE 2 engineers on complex, high-risk, or enterprise cases, taking on greater ownership as your readiness grows.
* Create structured escalation reports for confirmed product issues and stay accountable for progress and customer closure when Engineering is involved.
* Use AI tools safely to accelerate investigation, validate hypotheses, improve responses, correct support-agent outputs, and strengthen team knowledge.
* Turn learning from customer issues into better documentation, runbooks, product feedback, and small automation or tooling improvements.
* Protect shared queue health by prioritising accurately, meeting service levels, documenting work cleanly, and helping rebalance work across shifts.
* Participate in rotational shifts and on-call coverage, including occasional evenings or weekends, to support global customer needs.

**Who You Are**

* A recent graduate or early-career engineer with up to 3 years of relevant experience. Strong freshers are encouraged to apply.
* Strong programming fundamentals and comfort reading code; experience with Python, JavaScript, Java, or a similar language.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, HTTP, web applications, and how software systems communicate.
* Working knowledge of SQL and an interest in using data to investigate and validate behaviour.
* Curious and systematic: you want to understand why something failed, not just make the error disappear.
* Clear written and verbal communicator who can explain technical ideas in plain language to customers and engineers.
* Comfortable asking for review when risk or uncertainty is high, then applying the feedback quickly.
* Open to rotational shifts and occasional on-call coverage across a global customer base.

**Even better if you have**

* Built a project, script, bot, or automation that solved a real problem.
* Worked with logs, observability tools, cloud platforms, SSO/SAML/OAuth, or third-party integrations.
* Used AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar and can explain how you validated their output.
* Contributed to an open-source project, hackathon, internship, or production codebase.

**You will thrive here if**

* You enjoy ambiguous technical problems and are persistent enough to find the real cause.
* You care equally about technical correctness and how the customer experiences the resolution.
* You learn fast, seek feedback, and turn new knowledge into repeatable practice.
* You solve rather than route and take pride in leaving no loose ends.

title: Fundraising Assistant
description:
**About Genietrox Foundation Trust**

**Genietrox Foundation Trust is committed to creating meaningful social impact through charitable initiatives across education, healthcare, skill development, women empowerment, child welfare, agriculture, rural development, environmental sustainability, and community welfare.**

**We are looking for enthusiastic individuals who are passionate about social service and capable of mobilising resources to make a meaningful difference in society.**

**My recommendation: Keep this as a target-oriented role rather than a general administrative assistant position. The candidate should be measured primarily on the actual donations and funds generated, not merely the number of calls or meetings conducted.**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position: Fundraising Assistant**

**Organisation:**
Genietrox Foundation Trust

**Department:**
Fundraising & Donor Relations

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time / Part-Time

**Location:**
As per organisational requirements

**Reporting To:**
Fundraising Manager / Trustee / Management

**1. Job Purpose**

**The Fundraising Assistant will be responsible for identifying, approaching, engaging, and securing donations and financial contributions from individuals, corporates, philanthropists, NGOs, institutions, and other potential funding sources.**

**The primary objective of this role is to actively generate funds and donations to support the charitable initiatives, community development programmes, and social welfare activities undertaken by Genietrox Foundation Trust.**

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Fundraising & Donation Generation**

* Actively identify and approach potential donors to generate financial contributions.
* Bring in donations and funds from individuals, corporates, philanthropists, and institutions.
* Promote the Trust's fundraising campaigns and charitable initiatives.
* Achieve assigned monthly and quarterly fundraising targets.
* Explore individual donations, recurring donations, sponsorships, and institutional funding opportunities.

**B. Donor Acquisition & Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain relationships with existing and prospective donors.
* Contact potential donors through phone calls, emails, WhatsApp, social media, and personal meetings.
* Follow up with prospective donors and convert enquiries into actual contributions.
* Maintain donor databases and ensure regular engagement.
* Share updates on the impact of donations with contributors.

**C. Corporate & Institutional Fundraising**

* Identify companies and explore Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) funding opportunities.
* Approach corporate houses, business owners, foundations, and charitable institutions.
* Support the preparation of fundraising proposals, presentations, and sponsorship requests.
* Identify grant opportunities and funding partnerships.

**D. Campaigns & Outreach**

* Support online and offline fundraising campaigns.
* Promote donation initiatives through social media and other communication channels.
* Participate in fundraising events, awareness programmes, and donor engagement activities.
* Encourage individuals and organisations to contribute towards the Trust's charitable programmes.

**E. Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain accurate records of donor details, fundraising activities, and commitments.
* Track donations received and pending follow-ups.
* Coordinate with the finance team to ensure proper donation documentation and acknowledgements.
* Submit regular fundraising performance reports to management.

**3. Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 0–3 years of experience in fundraising, sales, business development, telecalling, or donor relations.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to convince, influence, and build relationships with potential donors.
* Proactive approach towards generating donations and securing funds.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets, email, and social media.
* Willingness to travel for donor meetings and fundraising activities, if required.

**4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Performance will be evaluated based on:**

* Number of new donors acquired.
* Total donations and funds generated.
* Achievement of monthly and quarterly fundraising targets.
* Number of corporate and institutional funding opportunities identified.
* Donor conversion and retention rates.
* Timely reporting and maintenance of donor records.

**5. Important Expectations**

**This is a target-oriented fundraising position. The selected candidate is expected to proactively approach potential donors, generate genuine fundraising opportunities, secure donations, and contribute directly to the financial sustainability of Genietrox Foundation Trust.**

**The primary responsibility of this position is to BRING DONATIONS AND GENERATE FUNDS for the Trust's charitable activities.**

title: Senior Consultant - Strategic Transport & Mobility Advisory
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
Jacobs are seeking a Senior Consultant to join our Strategic Transport & Mobility Advisory team to support high-impact transport and mobility advisory projects across the region. If you are passionate about rethinking mobility, advising clients, and solving complex urban transport challenges through delivery transformation and innovation, this role offers an exciting platform to accelerate your career.
  
  
As a Senior Consultant, you will support the delivery of multidisciplinary transport and mobility advisory services, working alongside project leaders and cross-functional teams. Your responsibilities will include
  
  

* Supporting the delivery of strategic transport and mobility advisory project, including urban mobility strategies, public transport policy, EV/AV deployment plans, freight and logistics advisory, and transport-related feasibility studies.
* Supporting project tasks, developing client-ready outputs, and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. Supporting the development of policy frameworks, business cases, and implementation plans for public and private sectors.
* Conducting research and analysis on emerging mobility trends and technologies (e.g. smart mobility, MaaS, low-carbon transport, ITS)
* Support the management of stakeholder consultation activities and preparing reports, presentations, and briefing materials for high-level government and private clients.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in transport planning, urban planning, economics, engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in transport or mobility consulting, with exposure to strategic advisory projects.
* Ability to work across a variety of transport topics, such as urban mobility, integrated transport planning, policy development or freight and logistics.
* Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in developing high-quality reports, presentations and strategic insights for clients.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: CX Product Operations Analyst
description:
**About Ethos**
**Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE)**
is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
  
  
**About The Role**
Product Operations builds the connective tissue between product and user-facing teams so Ethos can ultimately deliver more value to more users, faster. As a Product Operations Analyst, you’ll work cross-functionally with both customer-facing teams and product and engineering teams to ensure a seamless customer experience. You'll play a key role in strengthening the feedback loop between the field and our product teams, helping surface and resolve issues efficiently. This is a high-impact individual contributor role that is essential to delivering on our mission.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Triage and investigate technical and product issues raised by customer-facing teams using backend tools and data platforms like Datadog, FullStory, Amplitude, and Snowflake
* Act as a product quality advocate by fielding feature requests, triaging surfaced issues, and partnering with engineers and product managers to identify, scope, and resolve bugs
* Serve as the primary liaison between product/engineering and customer-facing teams, clearly communicating product updates and issue resolutions to relevant stakeholders
* Collaborate with product and engineering to collect, quantify, and prioritize bugs and pain points for upcoming development sprints; use SQL or other data analysis methods to size issues and assess impact
* Enhance product and engineering teams’ understanding of customer behavior and usage patterns
* Champion the voice of the customer during the development of new features, product launches, and enhancements to the user experience
* Build strong relationships with subject matter experts across the organization to surface insights, drive alignment, and contribute to a more consistent and streamlined customer journey

**Qualifications And Skills**

* 3+ years of experience in operational or analytical roles supporting product and technology teams1+ years of experience with JavaScript, Java, or SQL
* Strong analytical mindset, technical aptitude, and business acumen with a proactive approach to ownership and problem-solving
* Deep customer-centric mindset with an understanding of how user experience should shape product and process decisions
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and taking initiative in environments with limited structure
* Highly organized and responsive, with a strong sense of accountability when following up on stakeholder requests
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to various audiences and stakeholders
* Experience working in a high-growth technology company
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.
  
  
To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.
  
  
***Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos.com or @getethos.com.***
***We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.***

  build reliable ingestion from internal and third-party REST and GraphQL APIs. Handle authentication (API keys, OAuth 2.0), pagination, rate limits, retries with backoff, incremental extraction and schema changes.
* **Integrate APIs:**
  connect the data platform with source systems, SaaS platforms and partner endpoints using APIs, webhooks and event-driven flows (EventBridge, SQS, Lambda).
* **Build APIs:**
  design, build and deploy data APIs that serve curated datasets to applications and other teams, using Amazon API Gateway, Lambda and FastAPI. Own versioning, authentication, documentation (OpenAPI) and monitoring.
* Bring data from internal systems, APIs and files into the S3 data lake. Manage partitioning, schema changes and Apache Iceberg tables.
* Turn raw data into curated, documented layers (raw → staging → mart) that analysts can query directly in Athena.
* Use SageMaker Unified Studio to develop, catalogue and publish data assets: projects, SageMaker Lakehouse, SageMaker Catalog, notebooks and query editors.
* Make governed data available to AI agents. Build MCP servers or tool endpoints on top of curated datasets, and support Amazon Bedrock agents, knowledge bases and RAG use cases.
* Use AI coding agents (Amazon Q Developer, Claude, Kiro, Cursor or similar) to develop, refactor, test and document code. Code review and testing are still required before anything goes live.
* Orchestrate workflows with Airflow (MWAA), Step Functions or Glue Workflows, including retries, backfills and alerting.
* Set up data quality checks for schema, freshness, row counts and reconciliation with source systems. Trace issues to their root cause.
* Apply security and governance: least-privilege IAM, Lake Formation / SageMaker Catalog permissions, encryption, secrets management for API credentials, PII handling and retention.
* Tune Athena and Glue for performance and cost through partition design, file compaction, columnar formats and workgroup limits.
* Keep all code in Git with CI/CD, and deploy infrastructure as code.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
* 3+ years of hands-on data engineering on production pipelines.
* **Python (strong):**
  production-quality code, pytest, PySpark, pandas, boto3.
* **SQL (strong):**
  window functions, CTEs, incremental logic, tuning queries on large partitioned tables.
* **APIs:**
* **Building APIs:**
  has designed and built REST APIs with FastAPI or Flask, and deployed them on AWS (API Gateway + Lambda, or containers)
* **Fetching data from APIs:**
  has built production ingestion from REST/GraphQL APIs with requests/httpx. Handles pagination, rate limits, retries and incremental loads
* **API integration:**
  OAuth 2.0 and API-key authentication, JSON/XML payloads, webhooks, and OpenAPI/Swagger specs
* **AWS data stack:**
* **AWS Glue:**
  ETL jobs, crawlers, Data Catalog, Glue Studio
* **Amazon Athena:**
  query authoring, workgroups, federated queries, cost controls
* **Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio:**
  projects, Lakehouse, Catalog, unified notebooks and query editor
* **Amazon S3:**
  data lake layout, partitioning, lifecycle policies
* **Supporting services:**
  Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, Lake Formation
* **Agentic and AI tools:**
  has used AI coding agents in real work, and understands Amazon Bedrock (agents, knowledge bases), Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool and prompt design, and RAG.
* Workflow orchestration with Airflow, Step Functions or an equivalent tool.
* Data modelling (dimensional and event-based), plus Git and CI/CD practice.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience running Apache Iceberg in production (compaction, time travel).
* Streaming with Kinesis, MSK (Kafka) or Spark Structured Streaming.
* Amazon AppFlow or managed connectors for SaaS ingestion (e.g. Salesforce, Google Analytics).
* GraphQL API development; async Python (asyncio, aiohttp) for high-volume API extraction.
* Redshift / Redshift Serverless or EMR.
* dbt; Terraform or CDK.
* Has built AI agents with Bedrock AgentCore, Strands Agents SDK, LangGraph or custom MCP servers.
* Vector stores and embedding pipelines (OpenSearch Serverless, pgvector).
* AWS certification: Data Engineer Associate or Machine Learning Engineer Associate.
* Experience with a BI tool such as QuickSight or Power BI.

**Competencies**

* **Delivery focus:**
  ships working pipelines and sees operational issues through to resolution.
* **Rigour:**
  checks numbers before publishing them.
* **Judgment with AI tools:**
  uses agents to move faster, but reviews, tests and owns everything that goes to production.
* **Curiosity:**
  keeps up with the fast-changing AWS data and AI stack.
* **Collaboration:**
  communicates clearly with analysts and the business, and documents work so others can reuse it.

description:
**Description**
When you attract people who have the DNA of pioneers and the DNA of explorers, you build a company of like-minded people who want to invent. And that’s what they think about when they get up in the morning: how are we going to work backwards from customers and build a great service or a great product” – Jeff Bezos
  
  
Amazon.com’s success is built on a foundation of customer obsession. Have you ever thought about what it takes to successfully deliver millions of packages to Amazon customers seamlessly every day like a clock work? In order to make that happen, behind those millions of packages, billions of decision gets made by machines and humans. What is the accuracy of customer provided address? Do we know exact location of the address on Map? Is there a safe place? Can we make unattended delivery? Would signature be required? If the address is commercial property? Do we know open business hours of the address? What if customer is not home? Is there an alternate delivery address? Does customer have any special preference? What are other addresses that also have packages to be delivered on the same day? Are we optimizing delivery associate’s route? Does delivery associate know locality well enough? Is there an access code to get inside building? And the list simply goes on. At the core of all of it lies quality of underlying data that can help make those decisions in time. This role will serve as the face of the organization to global stakeholders. title: Associate Marketing Manager
description:
**Bring more to life.**
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
  
  
At Leica Microsystems, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
  
  
You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
  
  
Shape the Future with Us!
  
  
Leica Microsystems has helped shape the future for over 175 years by developing groundbreaking optical and digital solutions. As a global leader, we’re driven by continuous improvement to excite our customers and to create the best work environment for our people. Customer focus, innovation, and teamwork are at the core of our culture and the foundation of our success.
  
  
Want to be part of a company whose products are part of cutting-edge research around the world? Join Leica Microsystems in our commitment for brilliant solutions and insight.
  
  
Leica Microsystems is proud to work alongside a community of nine fellow Danaher Life Sciences companies. Together, we’re pioneering the future of science and medicine, developing products that enable researchers in the fight to save lives.
  
  
Job Title: Associate Marketing Manager
  
  
**Purpose Of The Position**
The Associate Marketing Manager will be responsible for planning and executing strategic Field Marketing initiatives to drive business growth, customer engagement, brand awareness, and demand generation for Leica Microsystems in India. This is an onsite role based in Bangalore.
  
  
A key focus of this position will be developing and managing relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), healthcare practitioners, leading hospitals, academic institutes, and clinical stakeholders, particularly in specialties such as Neurosurgery, ENT, Plastic & reconstructive, Ophthalmology, and related disciplines. Also work closely with the Principal Scientists, Researchers and Investigators in Life Sciences to drive engagement. The incumbent will lead the execution of Continuing Medical Education (CME) programs, clinical workshops, hands-on training sessions, scientific meetings, symposia, congresses, and product demonstration programs to promote scientific engagement and adoption of Leica Microsystems solutions.
  
  
In addition, the role will support digital marketing initiatives, lead generation activities, customer engagement programs, and marketing campaigns in close collaboration with Sales, Service, Customer Care, and Global Marketing teams. The position reports to the Marketing Head/Manager, India.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain relationships with KOLs, neurosurgeons, healthcare practitioners, hospitals, and medical societies.
* Develop and execute KOL engagement plans by building and maintaining the annual KOL pipeline to drive clinical advocacy, scientific collaboration, and product adoption.
* Coordinate KOL participation in CMEs, workshops, congresses, webinars, speaker programs, and advisory boards.
* Support development of clinical testimonials, case studies, and customer success stories.
* Plan and execute CME programs, surgical workshops, hands-on training sessions, scientific meetings, and conferences.
* Partner with healthcare professionals, scientists and researchers from institutions across India to deliver impactful educational programs.
* Manage end-to-end program execution including faculty coordination, logistics, budgets, and post-event evaluation.
* Execute field marketing initiatives aligned with business objectives across all the divisions for Medical and Life Sciences.
* Drive demand generation through congresses, exhibitions, product launches, webinars, workshops, and customer engagement events.
* Manage event planning, vendors, agencies, logistics, budgets, and ROI tracking.
* Execute and optimize digital campaigns across LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, and other platforms.
* Integrate digital and field marketing activities to generate and nurture leads.
* Monitor campaign performance and provide insights to improve marketing effectiveness.

**Our Expectations**

* Candidate should have 4-5 years of sales experience in the healthcare, medical device, life sciences, diagnostics, or pharmaceutical sectors, along with 8-10 years of marketing experience, preferably in medical devices, implants, or healthcare capital equipment.
* Strong background in KOL engagement, physician relationship management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Experience working with healthcare practitioners, preferably Neurosurgeons, ophthalmologists or other surgical fraternity.
* Proven ability to organize CMEs, workshops, training programs, scientific meetings, and conferences.
* Excellent communication, networking, project management, and stakeholder management skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Marketing, Science, or related field; MBA preferred.
* Hands-on experience in KOL management, physician engagement, CME planning, workshops, and scientific events.

Leica Microsystems, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.
  
  
Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
  
  
For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Sr Web Developer- Webflow & Marketo
description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.
  
  
Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
  
  
**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
Candescent is seeking an experienced Senior Web Developer to lead our Webflow development efforts from one of our India office locations. This role combines hands-on technical work with technical leadership. You will set technical direction, own the build quality, performance, and scalability of our web presence, and oversee the work of other developers and designers.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. You will personally build and troubleshoot complex work while also raising the standard of everything the team produces through review, documentation, and shared practices.
  
  
In addition to individual craft, this role carries senior leadership responsibility for the India-based web development team, including accountability for the team’s collective output and close coordination with the US-based Digital Experience lead.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
**Technical Ownership & Architecture**

* Own the technical architecture of our Webflow sites, including CMS structure, custom code integrations, and third-party API and app integrations.
* Lead the design-to-development process, translating Figma mockups into responsive, accessible, high-performance pages.
* Manage Webflow site settings, hosting, staging environments, versioning, and publishing workflows.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, including custom interactions and animations built with Webflow native tools or GSAP.

**Standards, Quality & Performance**

* Establish and enforce best practices for site structure, SEO markup, page speed, accessibility (WCAG), and cross-browser and device compatibility.
* Conduct code and design reviews and lead QA before launches.
* Optimise pages for Core Web Vitals and overall site performance.
* Maintain documentation of site structure, components, integrations, and workflows so knowledge is shared rather than held individually.

**Marketing Systems Integration**

* Own the integration of Marketo forms, landing pages, and tracking within the website, ensuring accurate lead capture and clean data flow into marketing automation.
* Oversee implementation of tracking and analytics tags including GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Marketo Munchkin.
* Support experimentation by ensuring test variants and experiment code can be implemented reliably.

**Team Leadership & Oversight**

* Serve as the senior technical lead for web in India, overseeing the day-to-day work of other developers and designers and setting the quality bar.
* Be accountable for the collective deliverables of the India web development team, including prioritisation, workload balancing, timelines, and consistent quality.
* Coordinate closely with the US-based Digital Experience lead on priorities, intake, status, escalations, and technical direction.
* Coach and develop team members on Webflow craft, standards, and production discipline.
* Manage relationships with external agencies or freelance contractors when needed.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.

**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*

* 6–9 years of web development experience, including at least 3 years building and maintaining production sites in Webflow.
* At least 2 years in a senior, lead, or management capacity, overseeing the work of other developers or designers.
* Proven portfolio of complex Webflow builds, such as CMS-driven sites or app-like interactions.
* Strong command of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including custom code embeds within Webflow.
* Experience integrating and troubleshooting Marketo or a comparable marketing automation platform on a website.
* Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility standards, and cross-browser and device testing.
* Experience implementing tracking and analytics tags such as GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
* Solid understanding of SEO fundamentals as they relate to site markup, structure, and performance.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

**Qualifications & Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Web Development, Design, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio will be considered.
* Familiarity with version control such as Git for managing custom code is preferred.
* Experience with A/B testing and optimisation tooling is preferred.
* Experience with project management tools such as Smartsheet or Jira is a plus.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.

**What Success Looks Like**

* The website is fast, stable, accessible, and free of recurring defects.
* Builds match design intent closely and require minimal rework.
* Forms and tracking reliably capture and pass lead data into Marketo without errors.
* Webflow CMS and components are organised, documented, and maintainable by others.
* The India web team delivers consistently, with quality that does not depend on one individual.
* Technical standards are clear, followed, and improving over time.

**What Will Make You Successful**

* Genuine technical depth paired with the willingness to review, teach, and unblock others.
* Pragmatism about when to build custom and when to keep things simple and maintainable.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* A collaborative, low-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.
* Strong organisation, follow-through, and accountability in a global, fast-paced environment.

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Software Engineer - AI Accelerated Development
description:
**About Signant Health**

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

**About The Role**

Signant Health is looking for a Software Engineer – AI Accelerated Development to build AI-powered, agentic features into our clinical trial platforms. Working across the .NET stack, you will take AI capabilities from backend LLM integration through to a usable front-end — designing agents and agentic workflows, not just prompting a model. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who works with agentic tooling every day and wants to ship production AI in a regulated, high-impact environment. We weigh the depth of your AI and agentic build experience more heavily than years of general experience: a developer with one to three years of substantive, hands-on agentic work is exactly the profile we are targeting.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES – Function**

* 1-4 Years of experience in AI, .NET and Fullstack.
* Design and build AI agents and agentic workflows — tool-use/function calling, multi-step task orchestration, and agent loops — that power Signant Health's clinical trial platforms.
* Integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI) into .NET application code, handling authentication, streaming, error handling, and cost/latency tradeoffs.
* Deliver AI features end-to-end, taking them from backend integration through to a usable, production-ready front-end.
* Build custom agents and tools with the Claude Agent SDK, wiring and steering agent loops.
* Author custom skills and slash commands for Claude Code to codify team-specific workflows.
* Implement RAG pipelines and integrate vector stores (e.g. Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone) to ground agent outputs in trusted data.
* Instrument agents for evaluation and observability so their outputs can be verified, measured, and audited.
* Apply AI-specific risk controls appropriate to a regulated clinical environment, addressing hallucination, determinism, and auditability of agent decisions.
* Use Claude Code (or an equivalent agentic CLI) daily as a primary development tool, reviewing and steering AI-generated diffs.



**Knowledge, Skills & Attributes**

**Essential:**

* Full-stack .NET development — C#/ASP.NET Core on the backend paired with a modern front-end framework.
* Hands-on agentic development experience — building AI agents or agentic workflows (tool-use/function calling, multi-step task orchestration, agent loops); not just prompting an LLM, but building systems around one.
* Practical LLM API integration (Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI), including authentication, streaming, error handling, and cost/latency tradeoffs.
* Proven full-stack delivery of AI features — able to take an agentic/AI feature from backend integration through to a usable front-end, not just a notebook prototype.
* Daily, hands-on use of Claude Code (or an equivalent agentic CLI) as a primary development tool — comfortable working through multi-step agentic sessions and reviewing and steering AI-generated diffs, rather than occasional autocomplete-style use.
* Prompt engineering — designing and iterating on system prompts as production software contracts, not one-off experiments.
* Python proficiency as the preferred language for AI/agent tooling; comfort with async patterns a plus.
* Evaluation and observability literacy — able to reason about whether an agent's output is correct and instrument it to prove so.



**Desirable:**

* Claude Agent SDK experience — building custom agents, defining tools, and wiring agent loops.
* Working knowledge of agent primitives: hooks (deterministic pre/post-tool-call controls), skills (progressive-disclosure, load-on-demand instructions), subagents/multi-agent delegation, and session/state management.
* Experience authoring custom skills or slash commands for Claude Code to codify team-specific workflows.
* Exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) for connecting agents to internal tools and data sources.
* Working knowledge of RAG patterns and vector store integration (e.g. Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone).
* Awareness of AI-specific risk areas relevant to a regulated environment (OWASP LLM Top 10, hallucination/determinism concerns, and auditability of agent decisions).



**Why Signant Health?**

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all candidates are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.

Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

title: Sr. Principal Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
We're looking for a tech leader ready to focus on Data governance, authorization, and data-mesh architecture — with regional technical leadership across the India team
  
  
As a Senior Principal Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial & Investment Bank's Markets - Markets Data Lake (MDL) team, you will be the technical authority for how data is governed, secured, and authorized across this mesh, and you will provide regional technical leadership across the India team — one of MDL's primary engineering hubs. You will set direction, grow senior talent locally, and act as the senior technical anchor in-region, while staying hands-on with the platform's most critical governance and authorization components.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Serve as the senior technical leader in-region for the India-based MDL engineering team, setting technical direction and ensuring alignment with the global platform roadmap. Grow and mentor senior, staff, and up-and-coming engineers in India; establish a strong local engineering culture, review practices, and career-development pathways.
* Own regional delivery of major platform initiatives end-to-end, coordinating across time zones with global stakeholders and partner teams. Build in-region depth in governance, authorization, and data-mesh capabilities so the India team owns critical platform domains, not just execution.
* Represent MDL locally — interviewing and hiring, onboarding, and raising the engineering bar across the India hub. Bridge global and regional priorities, ensuring the India team's work is visible, influential, and tightly integrated with the broader organization.
* Architect the data-mesh platform: define what a "data product" is on MDL — its contracts, SLAs, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, and interoperability standards — and build the self-serve platform capabilities domain teams use to publish them. Establish federated computational governance: design the policies-as-code framework that lets central standards (security, quality, entitlements, retention) be enforced automatically across independently-owned domains.
* Build the data-product substrate: catalog, discovery, lineage, versioning, and distribution across the platform's query engines, so consumers can find and query products through the semantic layer and NL-query interfaces without bypassing controls.
* Keep the architecture engine-agnostic — design governance, entitlements, and data-product contracts to work uniformly across current and future storage and compute engines rather than being tied to any single technology. give domains freedom to model and evolve their products while guaranteeing platform-wide consistency and safety.
* Own the governance model end-to-end: data classification, metadata management, lineage, data quality, retention, and audit across every MDL data product. Codify governance as code — schema/contract validation, quality gates, and policy checks embedded in publishing and CI/CD pipelines so governance is enforced, not advisory. Drive lineage and auditability: every query and every distributed dataset must be traceable, correlated, and reproducible for regulatory and internal audit needs.
* Partner with data owners, risk, compliance, and privacy to translate regulatory and firm obligations into automated platform controls. Own the authorization architecture for MDL: fine-grained, row- and column-level entitlements enforced consistently across every query engine and the query/agent layer (nl\_query/execute\_query).
* Design a scalable entitlements model — attribute/role/policy-based access control, entitlement propagation from source systems, and least-privilege by default. Guarantee "no query bypasses entitlements": ensure NL-generated and raw SQL alike are planned and executed within the caller's entitlement scope, with credentials brokered securely.
* Harden identity and access: integration with enterprise IdP/OAuth2, token lifecycle, secrets handling, and full access audit trails. Set technical direction across multiple teams via design docs, RFCs, and architecture reviews focused on governance, security, and mesh interoperability. Stay hands-on — personally build reference implementations for the highest-risk governance/authorization components and set the pattern others follow. Mentor and grow senior and staff engineers globally and in-region; establish best practices for secure-by-design data engineering.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 10+ years applied experience
* Software engineering experience with significant time architecting large-scale data platforms.
* Demonstrated regional/site technical leadership — anchoring a distributed engineering team (ideally in India), growing senior talent, and delivering across time zones.
* Deep expertise in data governance and authorization at scale: fine-grained entitlements (row/column-level security), ABAC/RBAC/policy-based access control, data classification, lineage, and audit.
* Demonstrated experience designing and scaling agentic AI-enabled development patterns (using enterprise-authorized tools within the work environment) across teams/functions, including establishing governance for human-in-the-loop validation, traceability/auditability, and secure handling of sensitive inputs/outputs.
* Strong understanding of responsible AI use and control expectations at scale, including security/resiliency implications, data sensitivity, and risk-based governance; ability to advise senior leaders on safe adoption, reuse, and measurable outcomes.
* Strong experience designing secure, governed data platforms on the cloud, including identity/OAuth2 token-based authorization — applied in an engine-agnostic way rather than tied to a single warehouse or lake technology.
* Data-mesh or federated data-platform experience — designing data products, data contracts, and federated/computational governance.
* Strong SQL and data modeling; experience with a semantic/metrics layer.
* Proficiency in a primary backend language (Python, Java, Go, or similar) and policy-as-code tooling.
* Excellent cross-time-zone communication, design-doc, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Capital markets / financial services data experience (FX, rates, credit, equities, reference data) and familiarity with the associated regulatory and data-privacy landscape.
* Experience building and scaling engineering teams within a global delivery / India hub model.
* Experience with data catalogs, lineage, and governance tooling (e.g. OpenLineage/DataHub, Collibra, Immuta/Okera-style policy engines).
* Experience securing natural-language / LLM-agent data access (MCP) — ensuring generated SQL is entitlement-safe and deterministic.
* Familiarity with a range of storage/compute engines and lakehouse formats (e.g. Iceberg, Delta, Hudi) and streaming/batch pipelines (Kafka, Spark, Flink), with the judgment to choose the right tool per use case.
* Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and mature CI/CD with embedded policy gates.

title: Staff Sales Operations Analyst - Demand Planning
description:
**Description**
Enphase Energy is a global energy technology company and a leading provider of solar, battery, and electric vehicle charging products. Founded in 2006, our innovative microinverter technology revolutionized solar power, making it a safer, more reliable, and scalable energy source. Today, the Enphase Energy System enables users to make, use, save, and sell their own power. Enphase is also one of the most successful and innovative clean energy companies in the world, with more than 80 million products shipped across 160 countries.
  
  
Join our dynamic teams designing and developing next-gen energy technologies and help drive a sustainable future!
  
  
This role at Enphase requires working onsite 3 days a week, with plans to transition back to a full 5 day in office schedule over time.
  
  
**About the role:**
We are looking for a Staff Sales Operations Analyst to join our Sales Operations team in Bangalore, India, reporting to the Senior Manager, Sales Operations. You will lead demand planning and the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process for the US solar business, partnering across Sales, Finance, Operations, and Business Units to align executive priorities, market trends, customer demand, and supply plans.
  
  
The ideal candidate is highly analytical, understands sales processes and supply chain planning, and can translate complex data into clear business recommendations. Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development and automation tools, such as Claude Cowork, Devin, and Copilot, to build practical internal tools and web applications is important for success in this role.
  
  
**What you will be doing:**

* Lead the end-to-end S&OP process for the Americas region, including the monthly and quarterly cadence, agenda, and executive-level reviews.
* Translate market trends, customer demand signals, and executive direction into actionable SKU-level demand forecasts.
* Build, maintain, and continuously improve statistical and analytical forecasting models to increase forecast accuracy across product lines and regions.
* Partner with Sales, Finance, Operations, and Business Unit leaders to reconcile demand signals, supply constraints, and strategic priorities into one operating plan.
* Analyze large and complex datasets to identify demand and supply gaps, risks, and opportunities, and present clear recommendations and executive summaries to senior stakeholders.
* Track key S&OP metrics, including forecast accuracy, inventory health, and service levels, and drive continuous improvement across the planning cycle.
* Design and build internal tools, dashboards, and web applications using AI-assisted development platforms such as Claude Cowork, Devin, and Copilot to automate demand-planning workflows.
* Identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone Sales Operations processes and develop AI-assisted or automated solutions from problem definition through working prototype.
* Use AI-assisted workflows to accelerate data analysis, scenario modeling, forecast generation, and reporting.
* Stay current on emerging AI tools relevant to Sales Operations and analytics, and recommend solutions that deliver measurable efficiency or accuracy gains.

**What you bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (B.Tech) or a Master's degree from a Tier-1 institution, with a CGPA of 7.0 or above or equivalent academic performance.
* Approximately 8-10 years of experience in sales operations, demand planning, supply chain, analytics, or a related function.
* Strong knowledge of supply chain planning and analytics, preferably within the solar or high-tech industry and a multi-tier channel environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading S&OP or demand-planning processes and building SKU-level forecasts.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and data-manipulation skills; experience with AI tools, Incorta, SQL, and Salesforce (SFDC) is preferred.
* Ability to work confidently with large datasets, maintain high accuracy, and turn analysis into practical business insights.
* Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, process-design, and business-judgment skills.
* A structured, detail-oriented, metrics-driven approach with a strong work ethic and bias toward accuracy.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present recommendations to senior stakeholders.

title: Partnerships & Growth Associate
description:
**Location**
: Bengaluru

**Type**
: Full time | Hybrid

**ABOUT NAZR**

Nazr is India's first integrated women's safety ecosystem, built for the modern woman who wants to move freely. We make safety tools that look good and work hard: On Me (a bag-clip pepper spray), Sip Check (a seal that stops drink spiking), and the Nazr app (live trip tracking, Trusted Circle and SOS). We're a small, women-led team in Mumbai, and our brand is about confidence, never fear.

**THE ROLE**

You'll help bring Nazr to companies, colleges, and hospitality and event partners across India and beyond. You'll find the right people, open conversations, pitch Nazr, and see deals through to close. You'll report to our Co-founder & COO, work closely with our operations team, and learn directly from the founders.

This role is for someone who enjoys talking to people, thinks fast on a call, and doesn't let a good lead go cold.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

- Research and build lead lists of companies, colleges, hostels, venues and event organisers

- Reach out by email, LinkedIn and phone to set up meetings

- Pitch Nazr on calls and in person, and handle questions with confidence

- Put together proposals and quotes with the founders

- Follow up until there's a clear yes or no

- Keep our partnerships pipeline updated and share a simple weekly report

- Support partner events, workshops and activations

**WHO YOU ARE**

- 1.5 to 3 years in business development, B2B sales or partnerships

- Excellent spoken and written English; you can hold a room or a call

- Quick on your feet when a conversation goes off-script

- Comfortable with cold outreach and not put off by a "no"

- Organised with follow-ups and pipelines

- Coachable: you take feedback well and act on it fast

- You care about women's safety and want to build something meaningful

**NICE TO HAVE**

- Experience selling to HR teams, colleges, or hospitality and events

- Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo or a CRM

- Hindi or Marathi

**WHAT YOU GET**

- Learn partnerships and sales directly from the founders

- Real ownership from day one

- Competitive pay, with a probation period followed by performance-based growth

- Incentives on partnerships you bring in

- Room to grow your role and pay as Nazr grows

**HOW WE HIRE**

1. Apply here on LinkedIn and answer a few quick screening questions.
2. Shortlisted candidates receive a short skills form (about 7 minutes).
3. Selected candidates complete a take-home assignment (2–3 hours).
4. Final round: A conversation with the founders.

We read every application.

description:
**Company:**
Boston Institute of Analytics (BIA)

**Location**

: Bangalore, Mahatma Gandhi Road

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
1-3 Years

**About Boston Institute of Analytics**

The Boston Institute of Analytics is one of the top-ranked international education and training institutes, headquartered in Boston, USA, with 107 campuses across 7+ countries, including the United States, United Kingdom, South Africa, and India. BIA delivers industry-leading programs across new-age technical and non-technical disciplines, helping students and professionals build future-ready careers in the world's most in-demand fields. Our programs emphasize practical learning, career-focused training, and global certification pathways, enabling learners to develop the skills required to succeed in competitive global industries.

**About the Role**

This is a
**B2C inside sales role within the EdTech industry**
, focused on converting qualified student and professional enquiries into enrollments. You will speak with prospective learners, understand their career goals, recommend relevant programs, handle objections, follow up consistently, and guide candidates through the complete admission journey. The ideal candidate is a confident communicator who enjoys sales, understands the importance of follow-ups, and is motivated by achieving and exceeding monthly targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Lead Conversion & Inside Sales**

· Handle qualified leads generated through digital marketing and other acquisition channels.

· Connect with prospective students and working professionals through calls, WhatsApp, email, and virtual meetings.

· Understand the candidate's education, experience, career goals, and learning requirements.

· Recommend relevant courses and programs based on the candidate's profile.

· Conduct effective sales pitches and product presentations.

· Convert qualified leads into paid enrollments.

· Consistently achieve monthly and quarterly admission targets.

**Student Counselling**

· Explain course curriculum, program structure, duration, certifications, fees, schedules, and career support.

· Help prospects understand the relevance and career value of different programs.

· Address questions and concerns related to courses, eligibility, fees, and admissions.

· Identify the candidate's needs and position the right program accordingly.

· Build trust and establish strong relationships throughout the decision-making process.

**Follow-ups & Objection Handling**

· Maintain regular and structured follow-ups with prospective students.

· Handle common sales objections related to pricing, course selection, competition, timing, and decision-making.

· Use effective persuasion and negotiation techniques to move prospects through the admissions funnel.

· Create urgency and drive timely enrollment decisions without compromising the student experience.

**CRM & Pipeline Management**

· Maintain accurate lead and prospect information in the CRM.

· Update lead stages, follow-up activities, conversations, and admission status.

· Manage the sales pipeline and prioritize high-intent prospects.

· Ensure no qualified lead is missed due to delayed or inconsistent follow-up.

· Track individual performance against daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.

**Admissions & Onboarding**

· Guide students through documentation, payment, and enrollment procedures.

· Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth admission and onboarding.

· Maintain a positive candidate experience from the first interaction through enrollment.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

· Strong
**B2C sales and conversion skills**
.

· Excellent verbal and written communication.

· Strong counselling, persuasion, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities.

· Highly confident and comfortable speaking with students and working professionals.

· Strong follow-up discipline and pipeline management skills.

· Target-driven and motivated by incentives and performance.

· Ability to understand customer needs and recommend the right solution.

· Comfortable working in a high-volume lead environment.

· Basic understanding of CRM systems and sales reporting.

· Strong ownership of individual sales targets and conversion numbers.

**Preferred Experience**

Candidates with
**1-3 years of experience**
in any of the following areas are preferred:

· EdTech Sales

· Inside Sales

· Education Sales

· Admissions Counselling

· Academic Counselling

· Career Counselling

· B2C Sales

· Student Recruitment

· Course Sales

· Training & Certification Sales

· Education/Training Consulting

**Educational Qualification**

· Bachelor's degree in any discipline.

· MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing, Business Management, or a related field is an added advantage but not mandatory.

**What We Offer**

· Fixed Salary + Attractive Performance Incentives

· Qualified Inbound Leads

· No Field Sales

· Structured Sales & Product Training

· Opportunity to work in the fast-growing EdTech industry

· Exposure to high-demand technology and professional education programs

· Performance-based career growth

· Supportive and energetic work environment

· Opportunity to build a long-term career in EdTech sales

**Why Join BIA?**

· Sell career-oriented programs across high-demand technology and professional domains.

· Work with a growing international education and training organization.

· Get access to qualified leads generated through marketing campaigns.

· Learn from experienced sales leaders and education professionals.

· Build expertise in consultative selling and career counselling.

· Fast career progression based on performance.

· Work in a dynamic, target-driven environment in Mumbai.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Boston Institute of Analytics is committed to fair and inclusive hiring practices. All qualified candidates will be considered based on their skills, experience, communication abilities, and suitability for the role.
