description:
**Company Description**
Full Basket Property Services Pvt Ltd is a rapidly growing company in the online real estate space, focused on becoming a one-stop solution for all types of real estate needs. The company aims to simplify property search, transactions, and related services for customers through technology-driven platforms and professional advisory support. As an expanding organization, it offers opportunities to work in a dynamic environment with exposure to diverse residential and commercial property segments. Team members contribute to building strong customer relationships and enhancing the overall property-buying experience. The company values proactive, service-oriented professionals who are interested in long-term growth within the real estate industry.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Property Advisor role based in Bengaluru. The Property Advisor will guide clients through the property selection and decision-making process, including understanding their requirements, budget, and preferred locations. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting property visits, presenting suitable real estate options, explaining project details and pricing, and supporting clients with documentation and basic financial considerations related to property transactions. The role involves maintaining regular communication with prospective and existing clients, addressing inquiries, and providing high-quality customer service to build trust and close deals. The Property Advisor will also coordinate with internal teams and property developers, update listings and market information, and work towards achieving sales and service targets.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills and the ability to build rapport with diverse clients.
* Candidates should possess Property Management and Investments knowledge relevant to residential and commercial real estate.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills for handling inquiries, resolving concerns, and ensuring a positive client experience.
* Candidates should possess basic Finance understanding, including budgets, payment plans, and loan-related concepts.
* Candidates should ideally have prior experience in real estate advisory, sales, or related customer-facing roles.
* Candidates should be comfortable working on-site in Bengaluru, conducting property visits, and meeting clients in person.
* Candidates should demonstrate proficiency in MS Office and digital tools used for listings, lead management, and reporting.
* Candidates should preferably have a bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, real estate, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

**About The Role**
Hospital discharge is one of the highest-intent moments in caregiving. The family is anxious, the patient is going home in 48 hours, and they need help they didn’t think they’d need. The hospitals that hand a family our flyer at discharge change the trajectory of those next four weeks. The Hospital Partnerships Manager builds these relationships, one hospital at a time. You’ll work with discharge case managers, geriatric clinics, orthopedic departments, oncology floors, and post-cardiac units. The goal is for EzyHelpers to be the named home-care service in their discharge pathway. It’s BD work, but for a service families actually want.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
Your day-to-day responsibilities
  
  

* Build relationships with 15–20 Bangalore hospitals across 18 months.
* Identify the right contacts — case managers, ward heads, geriatricians, surgeons.
* Present EzyHelpers credibly: process, training, pricing, escalation, outcomes.
* Negotiate discharge pathway integration, flyer placement, ward-level briefings.
* Coordinate with Care Managers to ensure smooth hospital-to-home handover.
* Maintain a CRM of every hospital contact, conversation, and follow-up.
* Run quarterly review meetings with our top 5 hospital partners.
* Field hospital escalations — if anything goes wrong in a partnered discharge, you own it.
* Identify cross-referral opportunities (geriatricians, physiotherapists, etc.).
* Represent EzyHelpers at hospital medical conferences and clinician meet-ups.
* Bring market intelligence back — what are other agencies offering hospitals.
* Hit a referral-volume target (currently 40 hospital-referred placements / month).

What we're looking for
  
  
**Skills And Experience Required**

* Bachelor’s degree, MBA preferred.
* 3+ years healthcare business development, account management, or hospital sales.
* Existing relationships in Bangalore healthcare are a strong plus.
* Polished spoken English; comfort with clinical conversation.
* Strong written proposals and CRM discipline.
* Two-wheeler or willingness to travel intra-city daily.
* Calm, low-pressure sales style — we don’t push, we earn.

Nice to have
  
  
Bonus points if you have these
  
  

* Pharma or medical-device sales background.
* Hospital insurance / TPA partnership experience.
* Existing relationships at Manipal, Apollo, Sakra, Fortis, or Narayana.
* Comfort with quarterly business reviews and clinical metric reporting.

Shift
  
  

* Daytime — 9 AM to 7 PM, 5–6 days/week.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* ₹60,000–₹1,20,000 / month base + uncapped commission.
* Commission ₹2,000–5,000 per hospital-referred placement.
* Travel + parking allowance.
* Smartphone + data plan.
* Stock options after 1 year.
* Group medical insurance (family floater).
* Annual leave (24 days).
* Festival + annual performance bonus.

Career path
  
  

* Year 1–2
* Hospital Partnerships Manager — win the first 15 hospital partnerships.
* Year 2–3
* Head of Partnerships — build a team, expand to clinics and physiotherapy networks.
* Year 3+
* Commercial Director — own all revenue channels.

title: Sales Manager-Notebooks Stationery @ Bangalore/Chennai
description:
**Job Description**
:

**Sales Manager-Stationery Note books Industry**

**Territory:**
Tamil Nadu & Karnataka

HQ: Chennai/Bangalore/Coimbatore

**Industry:**
Notebooks / Stationery / Paper Products

CTC: Upto 24 LPA

**Department:**
Sales & Business Development

**Reporting To:**
General Manager / Director

**Job Purpose**

To independently establish, develop, and grow the company's notebook brand across Tamil Nadu and Karnataka by building a strong distributor, dealer, wholesale, and retail network.

The candidate will initially be responsible for personally driving business development, market visits, distributor appointments, order generation, collections, and market expansion.

As the business grows, the candidate will be responsible for building and managing a dedicated sales team across both states.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Independent Business Development**

* Independently develop the notebook business across Tamil Nadu and Karnataka.
* Identify potential markets, distributors, wholesalers, dealers, and retailers.
* Personally visit markets and generate new business.
* Appoint distributors and develop a strong distribution network.
* Generate primary and secondary sales.
* Establish the brand in new territories and create market demand.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.

**2. Distributor & Channel Development**

* Identify, negotiate, and appoint suitable distributors and stockists.
* Develop relationships with stationery wholesalers, retailers, and educational suppliers.
* Ensure regular orders and product movement through the distribution channel.
* Monitor distributor performance, stock availability, and payments.
* Expand retail reach and product availability across assigned territories.

**3. Market Expansion & Brand Building**

* Develop new markets and identify untapped business opportunities.
* Promote the notebook brand among stationery dealers and educational institutions.
* Implement dealer schemes, trade promotions, and merchandising activities.
* Study competitor brands, pricing, product range, and market trends.
* Develop business opportunities during peak school reopening seasons.

**4. Complete Sales Operations**

* Prepare territory-wise sales plans and business development strategies.
* Manage order booking, sales forecasting, and distributor coordination.
* Monitor collections and ensure timely payment realization.
* Submit regular market visit reports and sales performance updates.
* Take ownership of the overall business performance in both states.

**5. Team Building & Leadership Future Phase**

* Initially handle the territory independently and establish a sustainable business base.
* Recommend manpower requirements based on market expansion.
* Recruit and develop sales executives and territory sales representatives as the business grows.
* Build a structured sales team covering important markets across both states.
* Train, guide, and monitor the team to achieve business targets.
* Eventually take complete responsibility for the regional sales organization.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 510 years of experience in sales and business development.
* Experience in notebooks, stationery, paper products, or related industries preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Tamil Nadu and Karnataka markets.
* Proven experience in distributor appointment and channel development.
* Ability to independently develop a market from scratch.
* Must be comfortable with extensive fieldwork and travelling.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and business development skills.
* Self-driven, result-oriented, and capable of working independently.

**Performance Measurement (KPIs)**

* New distributor and dealer appointments.
* Monthly primary and secondary sales achievement.
* Market coverage and retail penetration.
* New market development.
* Collection efficiency.
* Distributor productivity and repeat orders.
* Growth in brand presence and market share.
* Successful recruitment and development of the sales team in the future.

title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative - US
description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.Life as a Sprinter -Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.The mission -Sprinto is building the next phase of its outbound sales engine and this isn't a traditional SDR role.You'll own a Target Account List of US-based mid-market and enterprise companies and run the full outbound motion to get the right GRC buyers in front of our Account Executives. Your mission is simple: map the accounts, find the right people, start meaningful conversations, and consistently create pipeline that turns into revenue.You'll partner closely with an Account Executive carrying a $400K–$600K quota, working on enterprise deals averaging $30K–$60K ACV. You won't just hand over leads—you'll stay close to the deals you create, gaining first-handff exposure to how complex enterprise sales are won.If you're looking for a role that teaches you how to think like an enterprise seller and not just book meetings, this is where that journey begins.Where you'll leave your mark?Master enterprise account strategy - Before the first cold call, you'll map buying committees, understand stakeholder priorities, and identify the right path into every account. You'll develop the strategic account-planning skills that form the foundation of every great enterprise sellerBuild pipeline that fuels revenue - Your outbound motion—calls, emails, LinkedIn, webinars, and creative outreach—will generate qualified conversations that move deals forward. You'll be measured on business impact, not just activity, and learn what it takes to consistently create revenue opportunitiesOwn a pipeline from day one - You'll create and manage a disciplined outbound motion across a 30–60 day sales cycle, building the resilience, consistency, and commercial judgment needed to succeed in enterprise salesBuild AI-powered outbound systems - We expect you to experiment with AI, automation, and smarter ways of working. The workflows, playbooks, and systems you build won't just make you more effective—they'll become part of how Sprinto scales outbound, and a portfolio of work you'll carry throughout your careerLearn one seat away from closing - By partnering closely with experienced AEs, you'll see how enterprise deals are navigated from first conversation to signed customer. For people who aspire to become Account Executives, this role is designed as a launchpad—not a stopThe kind of builder we're looking for -You've spent the last 1–3 years sharpening your outbound craft and are now looking for a role that teaches you how enterprise sales is really wonThe phone is your first instinct, not your last resort. You enjoy real conversations and know that trust is built one call at a timeYou research before you reach out. Understanding the business, the buyer, and the context matters more to you than simply increasing activityYou've already experimented with AI, automation, prospecting tools, or outbound workflows because you're always looking for smarter ways to work—not just harder onesYou're naturally curious in conversations. You ask thoughtful questions, listen carefully, and enjoy uncovering what really matters to buyersYou bring consistency to your work. Whether it's prospecting, follow-ups, or pipeline hygiene, you know great outbound is built through discipline, not bursts of effortYou're excited by enterprise sales and understand that earning the attention of senior buyers takes patience, preparation, and persistence—not just great messagingYou enjoy working closely with Account Executives and want to understand what happens after the meeting is booked because your ambition is bigger than simply generating pipelineIf you're looking for a role where success is measured by the number of emails you send, this probably isn't it. But if you want to build the skills, judgment, and commercial instincts that turn great SDRs into exceptional enterprise sellers, we'd love to meet you.How we care for our Sprinters?Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beachCo-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowanceWe care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skillsWe count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need toYour Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salaryWorkspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for youInclusion & Diversity -At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. title: IT INFRASTRUCTURE & FULL STACK ENGINEER
description:
**IT INFRASTRUCTURE & FULL STACK ENGINEER-Job description**

 

**Role Summary**

 

The IT Infrastructure & Full Stack Engineer will manage and secure the organisation's IT infrastructure, including servers, storage, networking and cloud. The role will also design, develop and maintain healthcare web applications using Core Java, React.js and MySQL. The role uses AI-based coding tools and automation to improve efficiency, and keeps clinical and business systems running reliably while protecting patient data.
 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

1. **Server & Infrastructure Management:**
   Install, configure and monitor Windows/Linux servers, Active Directory and file servers; ensure system uptime and performance.
2. **Networking:**
   Manage LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, firewalls, switches, VLANs and VPN; resolve connectivity issues.
3. **Storage & Backup:**
   Administer NAS/SAN and RAID; implement and test backup and disaster-recovery plans as per RPO/RTO.
4. **Cloud & Identity:**
   Manage Microsoft 365, Azure/AWS and Entra ID, including user access, SSO and MFA.
6. **Full Stack Development:**
   Build responsive front-end screens using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React.js, and develop back-end logic and REST APIs using Core Java.
7. **Database Management:**
   Design MySQL databases, write optimised SQL queries and maintain data integrity.
8. **Healthcare Applications:**
   Develop, support and integrate modules such as appointment booking, patient registration, billing, HIS and ERP; coordinate with vendors when required.
9. **AI & Automation:**
   Use AI-assisted coding tools (ChatGPT, Copilot) and Python/PowerShell scripts to automate IT tasks, monitoring and reporting.
10. **Cyber Security:**
    Implement endpoint protection, patch management, access controls and secure coding practices; protect patient data confidentiality.
11. **Support & Documentation:**
    Provide technical support to clinical and non-clinical staff; maintain IT asset records, SOPs, network diagrams and technical documentation.

**Required Skills**

 

* **Infrastructure:**
  Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, GPO, DNS, DHCP, virtualisation (VMware/Hyper-V)
* **Networking:**
  TCP/IP, OSI model, VLAN, routing, firewall, VPN
* **Storage & Cloud:**
  NAS, SAN, RAID, backup tools, Microsoft 365, Azure/AWS, Entra ID
* **Programming & Frameworks:**
  Core Java, SQL (Spring Boot is an added advantage)
* **Web Technologies:**
  HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, REST APIs
* **Databases:**
  MySQL
* **AI & Automation:**
  Python, PowerShell, AI-assisted coding tools, basic understanding of LLMs
* **Tools & IDEs:**
  VS Code, Eclipse, Git
* **Security:**
  MFA, endpoint security, patch management, secure coding, incident response

**Qualifications**

 

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT or Electronics; or BCA/MCA/B.Sc. (IT/Computer Science)
* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in IT infrastructure along with Java/React application development
* Certifications preferred: CCNA, Microsoft Azure (AZ-900/AZ-104), AWS, Java or Full Stack certification
* Experience in a healthcare or hospital IT environment is an added advantage

**Key Competencies**

 

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Ability to handle critical issues calmly and prioritise patient-facing systems
* Team collaboration and clear communication with management, staff and vendors
* Adaptability, ownership and willingness to learn new technologies
* Availability for emergency support when required

title: Lead Full Stack Engineer - Assistant Vice President
description:
Role purpose
  
  
This is a
**hands-on role**
for an engineer who leads by building. You'll lead engineering on a multi-year programme to modernize and migrate a large portfolio of middle-office applications to AWS. You'll write production code across primarily front end
**(ReactJS front ends, TypeScript, NodeJS, npm/pnpm etc., DevOps pipelines)**
. You'll also set up and run the UI team's AI-augmented delivery model, using AI agents and assistants to speed up discovery, code conversion, testing and deployment while meeting the control standards a global custodian needs.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
**Hands-on UI engineering**

* Build ReactJS front ends that replace legacy desktop and GWT/PowerBuilder UIs, including state management, component libraries, SSO/MFA integration and accessibility.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Harness or similar), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), secrets management (Vault/CyberArk) and observability.
* Write reference implementations, templates and starter projects that the rest of the team and AI agents follow.
* Do daily code reviews and pair with engineers, and debug production-grade issues yourself.

**Engineering leadership**

* Lead the modernization engineering team and set standards for architecture, code quality, testing and release.
* Own technical delivery plans, estimates and release quality, working with Architecture, Platform, Data, QE and the existing application support teams.
* Lead engineering for cutover, parallel runs and handover to run teams.

**AI-augmented delivery**

* Use AI tools hands-on every day (for example GitHub Copilot, Devin, Blitzy and agent frameworks), and lead from your own experience of what works.
* Build agent workflows, prompt libraries and codebase knowledge context (knowledge graphs, MCP connections to Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow and SharePoint).
* Apply AI to reverse-engineering legacy code, generating specs, converting code and generating tests.
* Track AI productivity and quality (throughput, defect rates, rework, cost per migrated application) and report outcomes to leadership.

**Risk, controls and governance**

* Put human review checkpoints, audit trails and secure-coding gates on all AI-generated code, in line with State Street technology risk, information security and model governance policies.
* Make sure business logic extracted by AI is checked by subject-matter experts and confirmed through reconciliation before go-live.

**People and capability**

* Hire, coach and grow a permanent full-stack engineering team, and build AI fluency across the team.
* Manage vendor and temporary capacity and make sure knowledge transfers to permanent staff.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* 12+ years in software engineering, still actively coding, with 5+ years leading engineering teams on modernization or cloud migration programmes.
* ReactJS: strong in modern React (hooks, TypeScript, Redux or similar), component design, testing (Jest/React Testing Library) and building data-heavy enterprise UIs.
* DevOps: practical experience with CI/CD (Harness, Jenkins or GitHub Actions), Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes/ECS/EKS, Git workflows, automated testing and quality gates.
* AWS: compute, networking, IAM and managed services, and how to design for HA/DR.
* AI: proven hands-on use of AI coding assistants and agents in delivery, with measurable results.
* Comfort reading and reverse-engineering legacy code
* Experience delivering in a regulated financial services environment.

**Preferred**

* Knowledge of investment servicing or middle-office areas: trade capture, confirmation, settlement, collateral, reconciliation, investment accounting.
* Experience building MCP servers, knowledge graphs or retrieval-augmented context for engineering agents.
* AWS Professional-level or equivalent certification.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. description:
**Job Description – Full Stack Developer**

**Experience:**
4–6 years

**Type:**
Full-time

**Location:**
Bengaluru, with frequent GCC travel

**About ALP**

Angel Lane Partners (ALP) is a computational finance, data engineering and AI/ML firm with offices in Dubai, London, Bengaluru and Riyadh. We work with banks, financial institutions and government entities across the GCC.

**Role Overview**

You will build the web applications in the analytics and calculation platforms ALP delivers to financial-services clients. You will work end to end, from Python APIs and relational data models to React front ends where users enter data, run calculations, manage approvals and review results. You will work with data engineers, quant developers and analysts, and deliver production software for regulated clients.

**Travel**

The role is based in Bengaluru, with frequent travel to client sites in the GCC, sometimes for several weeks at a time. A valid passport is required.

**Key Responsibilities**

•  Build end-to-end features using Python (Flask or FastAPI), relational databases and React.

•  Design versioned REST APIs with request/response models, validation, error handling, pagination and OpenAPI documentation.

• Build front-end workflows: multi-period data-entry grids, multi-tab forms, editable tables with computed columns, client-side validation and results dashboards.

• Build reusable React components and handle state management, API integration, caching, loading states and error handling.

• Develop server-side workflows for maker-checker approvals, versioned parameters and reference data, configuration management and audit logging.

• Integrate with calculation engines, data pipelines and external systems through defined API and data contracts.

•  Implement authentication (SSO, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, LDAP) and role-based access with row-level data scoping by user, region, customer or business unit.

•  Generate and process Excel and CSV files (openpyxl, pandas) for imports, validation templates, reports and exports.

•  Design and maintain database schemas, migrations, indexes and constraints; implement background and long-running tasks (Celery, RQ or equivalent).

•  Write unit, integration, API and end-to-end tests; improve front-end rendering, API response times and query performance.

•  Implement logging, monitoring, error tracking and health checks; support deployments, CI/CD, environment configuration and production troubleshooting on AWS and on client infrastructure.

•  Take part in architecture and code reviews, release planning and documentation.

**Required Skills**

•  4–6 years building production full-stack web applications.

•  Python with Flask, FastAPI or Django; REST/HTTP/JSON, authentication, authorisation and API versioning.

•   React with TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML and CSS; hooks and reusable components.

•   At least one state-management approach (Redux, Zustand, Context or React Query) and one build tool (Vite, Webpack or Next.js).

•   A data-grid library such as AG Grid or TanStack Table.

•   SQL and relational modelling; hands-on PostgreSQL or Microsoft SQL Server, including migrations, indexing, query optimisation, transactions and concurrency.

•   Form-heavy, workflow-driven or calculation-intensive applications with server- and client-side validation.

•   Automated testing: pytest, Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright or Cypress.

•   Git (branching, pull requests, code reviews) and CI/CD with environment-based configuration.

•   Hands-on AWS experience deploying and running applications, such as EC2, ECS, RDS or S3.

•   Secure coding: OWASP risks, input sanitisation and secrets management.

**Preferred Skills**

•   Banking or financial-services applications (pricing, risk, regulatory reporting, reconciliation) where accuracy and reproducibility are critical.

•   Maker-checker workflows, approval hierarchies, audit trails and effective-dated configuration.

•   Enterprise identity providers, JWT, row-level security and business-unit data segregation.

•    Redis, caching and message queues for asynchronous or scheduled jobs.

•    Template-driven Excel and report generation.

•    Docker; hosting on Linux or Windows Server behind Apache or Nginx.

•    Databricks or Azure.

•    Certifications in BI, ML, cloud or infrastructure.

•    Observability tools such as Sentry, Prometheus, Grafana or OpenTelemetry.

•    Material UI or a similar component library.

**Qualifications**

•   Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT or a related field.

•   At least one full-stack application taken from design through to production deployment; regulated or data-sensitive environments preferred.

•   Able to work directly with product owners, analysts, data engineers, quant developers and client IT teams.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Vice President
description:
Role purpose
  
  
This is a
**hands-on senior engineering role who sets an example for rest of the team**
. You'll lead engineering on a multi-year programme to modernize and migrate a large portfolio of middle-office applications to AWS. You'll write production code across the
**full stack (ReactJS front ends, Java back ends, DevOps pipelines)**
. You'll also set up and run the programme's AI-augmented delivery model, using AI agents and assistants to speed up discovery, code conversion, testing and deployment while meeting the control standards a global custodian needs.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
**Hands-on full-stack engineering**

* Design and write production code for cloud-native services and user interfaces, especially for the most complex or highest-risk components.
* Build ReactJS front ends that replace legacy desktop and GWT/PowerBuilder UIs, including state management, component libraries, SSO/MFA integration and accessibility.
* Build Java/Spring Boot microservices and APIs (REST and Kafka/MQ event-driven), with Oracle persistence on ECS/EKS.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Harness or similar), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), secrets management (Vault/CyberArk) and observability.
* Write reference implementations, templates and starter projects that the rest of the team and AI agents follow.
* Do daily code reviews and pair with engineers, and debug production-grade issues yourself.

**Engineering leadership**

* Lead the modernization engineering team and set standards for architecture, code quality, testing and release.
* Own technical delivery plans, estimates and release quality, working with Architecture, Platform, Data, QE and the existing application support teams.
* Lead engineering for cutover, parallel runs and handover to run teams.

**AI-augmented delivery**

* Use AI tools hands-on every day (for example GitHub Copilot, Devin, Blitzy and agent frameworks), and lead from your own experience of what works.
* Build agent workflows, prompt libraries and codebase knowledge context (knowledge graphs, vector databases, MCP integrations).
* Apply AI to reverse-engineering legacy code, generating specs, converting code and generating tests.
* Track AI productivity and quality (throughput, defect rates, rework, cost per migrated application) and report outcomes to leadership.

**Risk, controls and governance**

* Put human review checkpoints, audit trails and secure-coding gates on all AI-generated code, in line with State Street technology risk, information security and model governance policies.
* Make sure business logic extracted by AI is checked by subject-matter experts and confirmed through reconciliation before go-live.

**People and capability**

* Hire, coach and grow a permanent full-stack engineering team, and build AI fluency across the team.
* Manage vendor and temporary capacity and make sure knowledge transfers to permanent staff.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* 16+ years in software engineering, still actively coding, with 5+ years leading engineering teams on modernization or cloud migration programmers.
* Java: expert in Java 17+, Spring Boot, JPA, REST API design, Kafka/IBM MQ messaging and performance tuning.
* ReactJS: strong in modern React (hooks, TypeScript, Redux or similar), component design, testing (Jest/React Testing Library) and building data-heavy enterprise UIs.
* DevOps: practical experience with CI/CD (Harness, Jenkins or GitHub Actions), Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes/ECS/EKS, Git workflows, automated testing and quality gates.
* AWS: compute, networking, IAM and managed services, and how to design for HA/DR.
* Databases: strong SQL; experience with Oracle and with migrating from Sybase or SQL Server.
* AI: proven hands-on use of AI coding assistants and agents in delivery, with measurable results.
* Comfort reading and reverse-engineering legacy code (COBOL, C/C++, PowerBuilder).
* Experience delivering in a regulated financial services environment.

**Preferred**

* Knowledge of investment servicing or middle-office areas: trade capture, confirmation, settlement, collateral, reconciliation, investment accounting.
* Experience building MCP servers, knowledge graphs or retrieval-augmented context for engineering agents.
* AWS Professional-level or equivalent certification.

Success measures (first 12–18 months)
  
  

* Personally delivered production code and reference implementations across the front end, back end and pipelines.
* An AI-augmented delivery model running across the programme, with productivity gains measured against a baseline.
* Modernization releases delivered to plan, with no material production incidents at cutover.
* A permanent full-stack team in place, able to run and evolve the new platform.
* No audit or control findings related to how AI is used in delivery.

Leadership attributes
  
  
You make decisions and are comfortable with ambiguity. You're equally credible writing code, reviewing a pull request or presenting to senior stakeholders. You set the technical bar by example.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. The ideal candidate should be comfortable interacting with pet parents, coordinating patient movement, maintaining records, handling billing transactions and supporting medicine stock management.

**What You'll Do**

· Welcome walk-in pet parents and provide professional assistance throughout their visit.

· Handle cash, card, UPI and other approved payment modes accurately.

· Issue invoices and maintain required billing records.

· Coordinate with the relevant team for stock replenishment and maintain accurate medicine-related records.

· Ensure billing and stock records are updated accurately and on time.

· **6 months – 2 years of experience** in front office, hospital reception, billing, pharmacy/medical store, customer service or a similar role.

· Good numerical accuracy, attention to detail and record-keeping skills.

· Ability to handle cash, digital payments and confidential patient information responsibly.

· Ability to maintain accurate registers, estimates, bills and stock records.

· Strong coordination and follow-up skills.

· Willingness to work in a **veterinary hospital environment and around pets and pet parents**.

· Ability to work flexibly across Reception and Billing based on hospital requirements.

**You Might Be a Great Fit If You Are**

· **Energetic, friendly and approachable**, with a natural ability to make clients feel comfortable.

· Organized and attentive to details, especially when handling records, billing and stock.

· Calm and professional while dealing with clients and busy hospital situations.

· Responsible and trustworthy when handling money, medicines and patient records.

· A proactive team player who can coordinate effectively with doctors and hospital teams.

· Willing to learn veterinary hospital processes and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

**Why Join SKS?**

Work in a growing veterinary healthcare organization and gain hands-on experience across **hospital reception, patient coordination, billing, boarding operations and medicine stock management**, while working closely with doctors and the wider hospital team.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on automation, platform stability, reliability, and efficiency.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

* Proven experience managing OpenShift cluster installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management.
* Strong experience with Kubernetes administration and container orchestration technologies.
* Advanced Linux administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning expertise.
* Experience managing Docker-based containerized environments.

title: Head BD & Distribution Alternates AIF - South
description:
**Head of Fundraising & Investor Relations, South – Chennai**

Vantrock Investment Managers LLP

**Vantrock is a multi-product real assets platform. Not a warehousing fund.**
Logistics and industrial is the first strategy. Office, plotted sales, land, pre-leased and yielding assets, private credit, data centres and senior living follow behind it. This seat builds the distribution network for all of it in Chennai, Coimbatore, Kochi and the Tamil Nadu and Kerala markets.

**THE SEAT**

**Employer:**
Vantrock Investment Managers LLP, the investment manager within Vantrock Ventures

**Reports to:**
Chief Business Officer, Fundraising and Investor Relations. Until that seat is filled, directly to the Founder & CEO, who will build the franchise with the zonal team hands-on

**Direct reports:**
None at launch. A senior single-contributor seat with a very large number attached

**Location:**
Chennai, in office, with twelve to fifteen travel days a month across Chennai, Coimbatore, Kochi and the wider Tamil Nadu and Kerala markets

**Experience:**
10 to 16 years

Team structure, reporting lines, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the current plan and may change. Compensation is confirmed in the offer.

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

Vantrock is an operator-led real assets platform, and it is multi-product by design. Real assets only. Warehousing and industrial parks are
**the first strategy, not the platform**
, across the full chain: first mile, last mile, city-centre, dark-store and self-storage formats, and logistics-anchored mixed-use with distribution below and office above.

Behind that first strategy sits the rest of the platform, launched in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back-office space, where our expertise transfers directly; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living. Each is a strategy in its own right, with its own pipeline and its own distributor relationships behind it.
**A candidate who reads this as a warehousing platform has read the first line and stopped.**

Three parts, kept separate. The founder's balance sheet takes the first risk: land is acquired, de-risked and approved on his capital before any investor commits. Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited develops and operates; Vantrock Investment Managers LLP underwrites every asset independently and answers to an independent Investment Committee. Assets enter at cost, with no founder premium. The platform earns only after its investors have.

Founded by
**Anshul Singhal, Founder & CEO**
. Three institutional platforms built from zero, and the fourth now on his own capital. Across that career: India's largest industrial real estate exit, Rs 5,250 Cr to Blackstone; a fund platform taken from zero to about USD 1.4 billion in peak AUM in six years, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, Rs 2,775 Cr from roughly 1,000 investors through the channel, on India's first domestic warehousing AIF; 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor; 2,000+ acres acquired, all litigation-free; 200+ buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.

**Warehousing is where the founder is best known. It is not where this platform stops.**
That record is the anchor that opens the door in the channel. The mandate you would be selling is considerably wider than it.

We hire number twos who want to become number one.

**THE PRODUCT SET YOU WOULD BE SELLING**

This is the part most candidates get wrong. You would not be carrying one product into the channel. You would be building a channel that carries a succession of products across real assets. The proposed set, built out in sequence as each is delivered and as approvals are obtained:

– Industrial parks, logistics and warehousing

– Office: suburban campuses, GCC and back-office space, starter and strata office

– Plotted and industrial plot sales

– Pre-leased and yielding assets

– A land strategy

– Private credit

– Data centres and senior living

– In time, listed or pooled vehicle formats including InvIT and REIT structures

**Multiple product lines, one channel.**
That is why this is a franchise-building job rather than a product-selling job. An RM you certify on the first strategy sells the second, third and fourth without being recruited again.

The intended route is a seeded AIF alongside deal-by-deal co-investment through CIV, co-investment PMS and other structures, subject to approvals. Seeded is the point: the operator puts assets in place before a fund launches, so much of the pipeline is de-risked on day one and no blind pool is raised. Two sales in one: a fund commitment into a visible pipeline, and larger co-investment tickets into named assets.

**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**

**Own the zone.**
Build the distribution and IFA network across Chennai, Coimbatore, Kochi and the wider Tamil Nadu and Kerala markets. Activate the RMs and advisers inside it, and convert that network into committed capital for the first strategy and into a channel that is ready when the office, plotted, land, credit and yielding strategies arrive behind it.

**Not a cold start.**
The platform brings an existing investor base, anchor commitments in place, and a founder known in the channel from two prior funds. The channel will take the meeting. What does not yet exist is the franchise: the empanelments, the certified RMs, the joint calls. There is no team to delegate that to in Year 1. Seniority here means credibility and judgment, not a desk.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

– The network. National distributors' regional offices, regional distributors, IFAs and MFDs, DSAs, RIAs, multi-family offices and wealth-platform desks. Target 5 to 7 firms empanelled and live.

– The full empanelment cycle, locally. First meeting to product committee to go-live, for both the fund and the co-investment routes. Empanel the platform, not a single product, so the next strategy does not start the cycle again.

– Activation. Branch meetings, huddles and desk conversations until 35 to 50 RMs and IFAs have each placed at least one ticket.

– Conversion. Joint client meetings as the core of the job. The pipeline from interest through contribution agreement to funds received.

– The map, in the CRM, weekly. Investor relations in the zone after the close, with Fund Operations. The face of Vantrock in Chennai and Kerala.

**THIS IS A FRONT-FACING SEAT**

You do not sell to the distributors and stop. You sell with them. Accompany partners and their RMs to their clients and pitch yourself. Tell the story so an RM can repeat it under pressure. Host investor evenings, partner meets and site visits, speak where the channel meets the asset class, and be a named voice of the platform on LinkedIn.

**Approved material only. Nothing bespoke, nothing verbal-only, no return promises, ever.**

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Essential**

– 10 to 16 years in financial services, at least five in B2B or B2B2C distribution of PMS, AIF or mutual-fund products from the manufacturer's side, an AMC, alternatives manager or fund house. You have carried a distribution number and been paid against it.

– Verifiable relationships with distributor product heads, national and regional distributors and the top IFA and MFD firms in Tamil Nadu and Kerala. You can name them, and they will take your call.

– You have launched a product into the channel from scratch at least once, not only carried an established brand.

– Third-party capital raised through the channel, stated as capital drawn, not assets influenced.

– Graduate. MBA, PGDM, CA or CFA or equivalent. NISM as applicable.

– Appetite for the road. Twelve to fifteen travel days a month is the job, not an exception to it.

**Advantageous**

– A real assets fund background. Not mandatory: a strong alternatives channel salesperson from equity, credit or PMS is often the superior hire, because channel sales is harder to teach than an asset class.

– Experience carrying more than one product line into the same channel. This platform will ask you to do it repeatedly.

– An AMC alternates or PMS desk. Co-investment tickets sold alongside a fund. Standing in the Chennai and Kerala markets, which are conservative, referral-driven and reward patience over pressure.

**COMPENSATION AND WEALTH CREATION**

Benchmarked against the upper quartile, then deliberately weighted from take-home to wealth creation. Four parts, offered as a mix: fixed; a fundraising incentive on the capital you personally bring in, with a team component on the platform's total raise; a share in the platform's additional returns on strategies you help close; and ESOPs. Numbers in the first conversation.

**Prepared for recruitment only. Not an offer of, or invitation to invest in, any fund, scheme, security or interest, and not marketing of any investment product. The product lines, structures and routes described are proposed and indicative, subject to change and to all necessary SEBI and other regulatory approvals. The track record above relates to the founder's prior roles at other organisations, is not the track record of Vantrock, and is not indicative of future results. No return is stated or implied, and none may be quoted in connection with this search.**

title: Civil Design and Site Engineer – Sports Infrastructure
description:
**Company Description**

Fitoverse is a sports infrastructure company founded by engineers, architects, and athletes who share a passion for elevating sports facilities for all levels of players. In just two years, the team has designed and built more than 40 sports courts across Tamil Nadu and Karnataka, focusing on safety, performance, and durability. Fitoverse delivers end-to-end solutions for a wide range of facilities, including courts, turfs, tracks, play areas, and multi-sport arenas for schools, communities, and sports organizations. With certifications from international sports bodies and a commitment to sustainability, innovation, and quality, the company creates world-class environments where athletes can train, compete, and grow. Fitoverse is driven by the belief that every aspiring player deserves access to professional-grade infrastructure from day one.

**About the role**

Fitoverse Pvt. Ltd. is hiring a Civil Design and Site Engineer with 3+ years of experience to be the first technical person a client meets. You visit the site, understand what the client wants and can afford, and turn that into a facility design and proposal that wins the project. Once sold, you hand a clean drawing-and-BOQ package to the execution team.

**Roles and responsibilities**

1) Initial site visit – Measure the plot, record levels, soil, drainage, access, power and water; photograph and document everything needed to design without a second visit.

2 )Client requirement capture – Understand which sports, how many courts, indoor or outdoor, usage (school, college, club, apartment, commercial venue), budget and timeline.

3) Design options – Prepare court and turf layouts to sport-body standards (FIFA, BWF, FIH, ITF, BCCI); typically 2–3 options at different budgets so the client can choose.

4) Drawings – AutoCAD layouts, sections, sub-base build-ups, drainage, fencing and lighting positions for turf (cricket, football), acrylic (basketball, pickleball, tennis) and PVC (badminton) facilities.

5) 3D visuals – SketchUp / Lumion renders for proposals so the client sees the facility before paying for it.

6) BOQ and costing – Material take-offs, quantities and cost estimates the sales team quotes from; keep estimates within agreed tolerance of actual build cost.

7 )Proposal and presentation – Write the technical part of the proposal, present it to the client, and revise until approved.

8 )Handover to execution – Pass final drawings, BOQ and site notes to the site team; stay available for clarifications during the build.

9 )Design library – Maintain standard details, templates and approved materials, and feed them into Fitoverse's in-house design tool. 10 Vendor and product awareness – Keep up with turf, acrylic, PVC and lighting products and specs so designs use the right material for the budget.

**Requirements Education and experience**

• B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering or B.Arch

• 3+ years in design or drafting for civil, landscape or outdoor works, including site surveys

• Has taken at least a few projects from site measurement to final drawing and estimate Technical skills

• Strong AutoCAD (2D plans, sections, details) • Working SketchUp for 3D layouts

• Can prepare quantity take-offs and cost estimates from a drawing

• Reads levels, understands sub-base, drainage and slopes

• MS Excel for BOQs and costing Client and work skills

• Comfortable meeting clients, asking the right questions and presenting a design

**Good to have**

• Experience with sports turf, acrylic or synthetic flooring, or landscape and outdoor sports works • Lumion or Enscape for photo-real renders

• Revit or Civil 3D

• Languages known: Tamil and English

• Interest in sports; a playing background helps when talking to clients

title: Subject Matter Expert – Taxation (GST + TDS)
description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.
  
  
To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a
**Subject Matter Expert – Taxation**
located in
**Chennai location.**
The Subject Matter Expert – Taxation will initiate and execute end-to-end GST and TDS activities, covering statutory compliance, transaction-level validations, reconciliations, tax computations, payments, return filings, audit support and technical analysis. The role requires strong hands-on experience in handling complex and high-volume transactions, with the ability to independently identify tax issues, drive resolution and ensure accurate, timely and audit-ready compliance.
  
  
Reports to the
**Manager**
, and the role involves,
  
  
**What a typical day looks like:**
**GST:**

* Initiate and execute end-to-end GST compliance across assigned GST registrations, from transaction-level data extraction and validation through tax computation, payment and statutory return filing.
* Extract and validate sales registers, purchase registers and GST GL data from ERP and identify transaction-level exceptions prior to return preparation.
* Prepare and file GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, including validation of taxable turnover, output tax liability, ITC, RCM, amendments and debit/credit notes.
* Perform invoice-level GSTR-2B vs. Purchase/ITC register reconciliation, identify missing/unmatched invoices, tax/value differences and initiate corrective actions.
* Review ITC eligibility at transaction level, including blocked/ineligible credits, reversals, re-availment and other applicable ITC adjustments.
* Identify transactions liable under Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM), validate applicable tax treatment, compute liability and ensure appropriate payment and ITC recognition.
* Perform GSTR-1 vs. Books, GSTR-3B vs. Books and GST GL vs. statutory return reconciliations and initiate timely closure of reconciling items.
* Validate HSN/SAC classification, GST rates, Place of Supply, GSTIN, tax codes and other GST master data impacting tax determination.
* Review transaction-level compliance relating to e-invoicing and e-way bills, including cancellations, amendments, exceptions and data mismatches.
* Validate GST treatment of exports, imports, SEZ/zero-rated supplies, intercompany/related-party transactions, stock transfers, debit notes and credit notes.
* Track vendor-related ITC mismatches/non-reflection in GSTR-2B and coordinate with AP, Procurement and relevant stakeholders for resolution.
* Prepare annual GST reconciliations and GSTR-9 /9C requirements, including reconciliation of turnover, tax liability and ITC with financial books.
* Initiate preparation of invoice-level data, reconciliations, ledgers and supporting documentation for GST audits, assessments, notices and departmental proceedings.
* Analyze complex transactional scenarios, identify GST exposure, compliance gaps and potential tax leakage, and initiate corrective actions.
* Monitor regulatory changes and initiate necessary process, system, master-data and control changes to ensure continued compliance.

**TDS:**

* Initiate and execute end-to-end TDS compliance, covering transaction review, tax deduction, payment, quarterly return preparation and statutory filing.
* Determine appropriate TDS sections, rates, thresholds and applicability for domestic transactions, including complex or non-routine payments.
* Perform Books vs. TDS returns vs. tax payment/challan reconciliations and initiate resolution of short deduction, non-deduction and other exceptions.
* Prepare/review quarterly TDS returns, correction returns and TDS certificates and ensure closure of PAN and other compliance exceptions.
* Review overseas payments/remittances for withholding tax implications under the Income-tax Act and applicable DTAA provisions, including relevant supporting documentation.
* Initiate responses and corrective actions for TDS notices, defaults and statutory queries, and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for closure.

**Audit, Controls & Process Improvement:**

* Initiate and provide tax reconciliations, schedules and supporting documentation for Statutory Audit, Tax Audit, Cost Audit and Internal Audit.
* Proactively coordinate with Finance, AP, Procurement, Treasury, Logistics, IT and business teams for timely collection of data and resolution of tax exceptions.
* Maintain compliance calendars, trackers, SOPs, reconciliations and audit-ready documentation with appropriate supporting evidence.
* Identify tax risks, compliance gaps and potential tax leakage and initiate corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive automation, digitalization, data analytics and exception-based compliance monitoring across GST and TDS activities.

**The experience we’re looking to add to our team:**

* B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter / CMA Inter or equivalent qualification with relevant taxation experience; professional qualification would be an advantage.
* 5–8 years of hands-on taxation experience, predominantly in GST with working expertise in TDS.
* Strong hands-on experience in handling complex, high-volume and transaction-intensive GST/TDS environments is essential.
* Experience in handling multiple GST registrations, large transaction datasets, complex reconciliations, audits, assessments and departmental proceedings is preferred.
* Candidates with prior taxation experience in the manufacturing sector will be strongly preferred, considering the complexity of supply-chain transactions, movement of goods, ITC, e-way bills, imports/exports and other manufacturing-related tax requirements.
* Experience in a large corporate, multinational or multi-location environment would be an added advantage.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel and ERP system; exposure to tax automation and analytical tools is desirable
* Day shift (8am – 5pm)

* Develop and deliver next-generation technologies for brine management and ZLD solutions.
* Study reaction kinetics and equilibria of inorganic species in treatment processes.
* Develop new coagulant or adsorbent formulations for industrial wastewater.

* Collaborate with process engineers to translate findings into scalable designs.
* Publish technical papers and participate in patent generation.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: Approximately 10 years with strong exposure to water/wastewater chemistry.

* Publications: Minimum 5 papers in reputed chemistry or environmental journals; patents preferred.

Water Technology Centre, Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu

title: Research Engineer (Process)
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled Process & Chemical Engineer to lead the development, assessment, and scale-up of advanced treatment solutions for complex water, wastewater, and industrial effluents. The role combines deep chemical engineering fundamentals with strong process engineering capabilities to design, validate, and deploy innovative treatment solutions across physico-chemical, biological, thermal, membrane, and electrochemical domains.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for conducting detailed treatability studies, developing integrated flowsheets, and implementing pilot- and field-scale systems for diverse industrial sectors including petrochemicals, refineries, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and heavy manufacturing. The role requires a strong grasp of contaminant behaviour, reaction engineering, separation processes, and system optimization. The candidate will work across laboratory testing, simulation, bench-scale experimentation, and on-site troubleshooting to deliver high-value treatment strategies. Close collaboration with chemical, biological, thermal, desalination, and digital teams is essential to ensure end-to-end technology development and deployment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end treatability studies covering characterization, experimental design, optimization, and performance validation of water, wastewater, and industrial effluents.
* Develop integrated flow sheets using physico-chemical, chemical, biological, electro-chemical, membrane, and thermal processes based on effluent characteristics.
* Conduct lab-scale and pilot-scale experiments, analyze results, and refine process conditions for scale-up.
* Simulate and model processes using tools such as ASPEN Plus, HYSYS, GPS-X, or equivalent to support design and optimization.
* Work closely with technologists, mechanical engineers, and field teams to translate laboratory findings into deployable pilot systems and field-scale implementations.
* Evaluate external technologies (both mature and early-stage innovations) and assess their applicability, differentiation, and integration potential.
* Support ZLD, high-TDS effluent treatment, and industrial sludge management programs, including development of novel chemical/physical treatment strategies.
* Generate mass balance, energy balance, and kinetic models to inform design and scale-up decisions.
* Assist in techno-economic analyses, benchmarking, cost estimation, and feasibility assessments for treatment technologies.
* Prepare detailed engineering documents, SOPs, experimental logs, and technical reports for internal and external stakeholders.
* Collaborate with digital teams to incorporate data analytics, process monitoring, and modelling improvements.
* Contribute to publications, patents, and standardization initiatives emerging from successful R&D programs.
* Provide field troubleshooting support for treatment failures, optimization needs, or performance deviations at customer plants.

**Qualifications**

* Education: PhD or M.Tech in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Biotechnology, Industrial Chemistry, or related disciplines.
* Experience: ~10 years total, with a minimum of 5 years in water, wastewater, or industrial effluent treatment.
* Strong knowledge of reaction engineering, separation processes, mass transfer, and water chemistry.
* Experience with lab-scale experimentation, pilot testing, and field implementation.
* Familiarity with process simulation tools (ASPEN, HYSYS, GPS-X, BioWin, or equivalent).
* Publications: Minimum 3–5 publications in peer-reviewed journals; patents or book chapters preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to work with cross-functional R&D teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Location**
Water Technology Centre, Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu

title: Senior Data Scientist (AI & NLP)
description:
**About Amplify Health**

**Who We Are**

Amplify Health is Asia’s leading health technology and analytics organisation, providing our customers with integrated solutions to make healthcare more accessible, affordable and effective across the region.

We offer a unique B2B business model and integrated stack of SaaS-based products, PaaS-based HealthTech launchpad and DaaS-based on-demand data offerings to deliver impact to our customers across the healthcare value-chain.

Our joint-venture partners, AIA and Discovery, have provided us with the foundations and a platform that truly differentiates us from our competitors and allows us to build and deploy products at a scale and quality that few can match.

We aim to be the trusted custodian of Asia's largest repository of health data, unifying financial, clinical, operational and behavioural data to empower our customers with insights that highlight opportunities to deliver better value and care outcomes.

**Our Vision and Ambition**

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.

**The Position**

**Summary**

We are hiring a Senior/ Lead Data Scientist to serve as a recognised organisational expert in Generative AI, Agentic AI, NLP and healthcare AI systems. This role shapes the Data & AI technical strategy and architecture, leads complex and high-impact AI initiatives, and establishes reusable, responsible AI capabilities across products, markets and business functions.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional depth in NLP, LLMs, RAG and agentic systems with broad architectural, data, analytics, product and healthcare domain judgement. The candidate defines how reliable AI systems should be designed, evaluated, governed and scaled, while developing the technical community through mentorship, standards and thought leadership.

Responsibilities

**AI Strategy and Architecture**

* Translate ambiguous business and healthcare problems into structured AI solutions with clear measurement frameworks, success metrics and delivery pathways.
* Define the enterprise technical strategy, reference architectures and capability roadmap for NLP, Generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, multimodal AI and agentic systems.
* Act as the senior technical authority for high-risk and high-impact AI systems; make architecture trade-offs across model selection, prompting, fine-tuning, retrieval, tool use, memory, orchestration, latency, cost, security and maintainability.
* Lead technical due diligence for foundation models, embedding models, vector stores, orchestration frameworks and vendors, including build-versus-buy and model-risk decisions.

**Production AI System Design**

* Lead the design of production-grade AI systems where LLMs, RAG, NLP and agents are core runtime components of the delivered solution, not merely development aids.
* Define patterns for agent planning, tool use, permissions, state and memory, observability, fallback mechanisms, human-in-the-loop controls and safe failure handling.
* Shape reusable AI platforms, knowledge services, evaluation harnesses, guardrails and LLMOps capabilities in partnership with engineering, technology, cybersecurity, risk and product leaders.
* Clearly distinguish development-process automation from runtime AI-system behaviour: govern coding and analysis assistants as productivity tools while separately engineering and validating RAG, LLM and agentic components that operate within delivered AI systems.

**Evaluation, Governance and Responsible AI**

* Establish rigorous evaluation frameworks covering task quality, groundedness, retrieval performance, hallucination risk, safety, robustness, bias, privacy, latency, cost and human oversight.
* Define governance standards for AI system design, validation, monitoring, model risk, human accountability, auditability and responsible AI practices.
* Ensure AI systems are designed with appropriate controls for healthcare privacy, security, compliance, explainability, fairness and operational safety.

**AI-Assisted Development and Productivity**

* Champion the responsible adoption of modern AI-powered development tools, such as coding assistants, analytical copilots and platform-native AI assistants, to streamline model development, automate repetitive tasks, accelerate analytical insights and improve engineering productivity.
* Define approved usage patterns, quality controls, adoption metrics and value measures for AI-assisted development and process automation.
* Ensure productivity tools are adopted responsibly without compromising security, intellectual property, scientific quality or decision accountability.

**Stakeholder Influence and Capability Building**

* Influence executive strategy, investment and risk decisions by communicating evidence, uncertainty, trade-offs, expected impact and operational implications.
* Build organisational capability through mentorship, standards, training, communities of practice and external thought leadership.
* Develop senior technical talent and raise the overall quality of AI system design, scientific reasoning and production delivery across the function.

**Candidate Profile**

**Required Qualifications**

* 8–10+ years of experience developing and implementing end-to-end solutions using machine learning and AI technologies.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in NLP, deep learning and transformer-based models.
* 3+ years of practical experience building end-to-end Generative AI solutions, including LLM workflows, fine-tuning, evaluation and RAG-based systems.
* 4+ years of experience leading, mentoring or managing high-performing data science teams is highly desirable.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, PySpark, PyTorch, LangGraph, Databricks, MLflow, Azure AI services and LLM APIs is mandatory.
* Proven experience building, deploying and monitoring production-grade ML or AI systems at scale.
* Experience with LangChain and LangGraph for developing agentic AI and RAG-based applications.
* Strong understanding of GenAI observability, model tracing and LLM evaluation frameworks, including the ability to assess model quality, detect hallucinations, monitor performance and optimise production-grade AI systems through robust evaluation and monitoring practices.
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices, including assessment and monitoring of fairness, bias, explainability, safety, privacy and compliance metrics for production AI and GenAI solutions.
* Experience defining AI governance frameworks and measurable adoption practices for AI-assisted development tools and process automation.
* Demonstrated expertise and business acumen, with the ability to convert complex business problems into practical AI solutions that deliver measurable impact.
* Ability to influence executives and cross-functional leaders, and to develop senior technical talent.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working in a matrix organisation.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, demanding environment while managing stakeholder expectations, priorities and timelines.
* Strong awareness of emerging technology trends in AI, Generative AI and Agentic AI, and the ability to assess what they mean for health tech products from both opportunity and risk perspectives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or an equivalent technical field, with specialisation or experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science or related disciplines.
* Experience in the healthcare domain is highly desirable, especially in areas such as clinical AI, payer/provider analytics, population health, claims, care management, medical operations or health data platforms.
* Experience working with healthcare data standards, privacy requirements, regulated environments or responsible AI considerations in healthcare.
* Hands-on experience with Azure, Databricks or equivalent cloud and data platforms.
* Strong knowledge of MLOps, CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, model governance and scalable deployment patterns.
* Demonstrated expertise in optimising AI systems for accuracy, performance, latency, reliability, cost and maintainability.
* Exposure to multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, medical text analytics or clinical decision support use cases is a plus.

**What Good Looks Like**

* Is recognised as the organisation’s technical authority for complex AI, NLP and agentic-system decisions.
* Shapes enterprise AI strategy while remaining credible in hands-on architecture and technical review.
* Delivers AI systems that are measurable, grounded, safe, secure, scalable and economically sustainable.
* Creates reusable platforms and standards that multiply impact across teams, products and markets.
* Builds a strong technical community and credible external reputation in healthcare AI.

title: Senior Analyst (Data Strategy & Acquisition)
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Senior Analyst (Data Strategy & Acquisition)**
**Roche India - Roche Services and Solutions**
**Hyderabad / Chennai**
At Roche, you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted, and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop, and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
**The Position**
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
**That’s What Makes Us Roche.**
As a
**Senior Data Strategy & Acquisition Analyst**
within GATE, you will be a recognized subject-matter expert on the U.S. healthcare data landscape. You will go beyond responding to requests — you will proactively scout, evaluate, and unlock new data assets that expand what Roche's U.S. commercial organization can see and act on. You will operate as a genuine thought partner to U.S. brand, market access, forecasting, field operations, and advanced analytics teams across multiple therapeutic areas, shaping decisions on multi-million-dollar data investments.
  
  
**The Opportunity**

* Multi-Facet Data Asset Portfolio: Own the evaluation, acquisition, and lifecycle management of a broad and diverse portfolio of U.S. healthcare data assets — claims, EHR/EMR and clinical real-world data, specialty pharmacy and hub data, lab and biomarker/genomic testing data, payer and formulary intelligence, sales and distribution, provider reference and affiliation data, patient-level longitudinal data, and competitive/market intelligence
* Proactive Data Scouting & Market Sensing: Continuously track the evolving U.S. data vendor and RWD market — new entrants, emerging and innovative asset types, consolidation, and pricing/licensing trends. Bring forward unsolicited recommendations on datasets Roche should consider and on new use cases that existing assets could unlock
* Therapeutic Area Partnership: Partner with stakeholders across Oncology, Ophthalmology, Cardiovascular-Renal-Metabolic (CVRM), Neurology, Immunology and Rare Disease, translating each TA's distinct commercial questions into fit-for-purpose data requirements — recognizing that a retina franchise, a solid-tumor biomarker-driven brand, and a cardiometabolic primary-care brand each demand fundamentally different data strategies
* Vendor Evaluation & Head-to-Head Benchmarking: Evaluate new and incumbent vendors (eg:-IQVIA, Komodo Health, Clarivate/DRG, MMIT, Optum, Truveta, Flatiron, Verana ), on methodology, capture and coverage, patient/provider linkage, recency and lag, known biases, limitations, and fit-for-purpose. Design and run structured bake-offs and overlap analyses rather than relying on vendor claims
* External Partnerships: Act as the primary technical counterpart to external data vendors — interrogating source methodologies, resolving data quality queries, influencing roadmap and enhancement requests, and supporting renewal and expansion discussions with an evidence-backed point of view
* Data Profiling & Risk Assessment: Perform hands-on profiling, cross-source comparison, and validation. Quantify gaps, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive pushback to ensure alignment with business objectives and realistic expectations of what the data can and cannot support

**Who You Are**
**Education:**
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Bioinformatics, Public Health, Healthcare, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  
  
**Experience:**
5–8+ years of relevant experience in pharma/biotech commercial analytics, healthcare data strategy, life sciences consulting, or a healthcare data vendor. Prior experience in a Data acquisition, Data strategy, Data governance, or RWD-evaluation function is strongly preferred.
  
  
**Multi-Facet Data Asset Exposure (core requirement):**
You have worked hands-on across several of the following and can speak credibly to the strengths, biases, and limitations of each:
  
  

* Claims: open vs. closed, medical vs. pharmacy, submits vs. remits, switch/clearinghouse vs. payer-sourced (IQVIA LAAD/Dx/PharMetrics, Komodo, Clarivate), patient-lives coverage, payer mix, rejection/denial and reversal analytics
* EHR/EMR and clinical RWD: structured vs. unstructured content, clinical depth (stage, biomarkers, labs, performance status, laterality), health-system coverage bias, ambulatory vs. inpatient capture, and the NPI/provider-identifier limitations of EHR sources
* Data Linkage: tokenization and patient-level linkage across claims, EHR, lab, and specialty pharmacy assets (e.g., Datavant), and the practical pitfalls of doing so
* Specialty pharmacy, hub, and distribution data; buy-and-bill dynamics
* Lab, diagnostic, and biomarker/genomic testing data
* Payer, formulary, and market access intelligence (MMIT, DRG Fingertip, Policy Reporter), including coverage policy, utilization management, and GTN-relevant inputs
* Provider reference and affiliation data (NPI/DEA, IQVIA OneKey, IDN/GPO and health-system hierarchies), and how it powers HCP/account targeting
* Competitive and market intelligence (Evaluate, Citeline, Spherix Global Insights, Dedham Group)
* Emerging/innovative assets: ambient and digital health data, registries, SDOH, imaging, patient-reported and adherence data

**Therapeutic Area Exposure:**
Demonstrated exposure to either of
**Oncology**
(solid tumor and/or heme; biomarker testing, staging, lines of therapy, pathways),
**Ophthalmology**
(Imaging and registry data such as IRIS/Verana), or
**CVRM**
(cardiovascular, metabolic and obesity, lab-value-driven segmentation such as HbA1c/LDL/eGFR, high-volume PCP targeting). Rare disease, neurology, or immunology exposure is a strong plus.
  
  
**Analytical & Strategic Thinking:**
Strong analytical reasoning and structured problem-solving with meticulous attention to detail. You engage stakeholders consultatively, ask the sharp clarifying question before proposing a solution, and synthesize complexity into clear recommendations and "so what?" insights
  
  
**Technical Skills**
: Proficient in SQL or similar technology for independent extraction, profiling, and validation on large patient-level datasets. Comfortable in creating a visualizations in any industry wide known platforms.
  
  
Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
