title: SAP SD
description:
**Job Summary**
GeoSpatial Analyst MAP with extensive expertise in SAP SD Testing and SAP SD will analyze complex geographic and sales distribution data to enhance supply chain performance in a hybrid work model. The role focuses on optimizing routes territories and order fulfillment processes collaborating across business and technology teams to drive efficient consumer goods distribution and support strategic decision making.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Analyze spatial data from enterprise systems to derive actionable insights that optimize sales distribution patterns and supply chain flows across diverse geographic regions ensuring efficient product availability for customers and stakeholders.
* Design and maintain geospatial models that integrate SAP SD transactional data with location intelligence to improve order routing delivery planning and regional demand forecasting for business units.
* Collaborate with SAP SD testers and business analysts to validate end to end data flows between geospatial solutions and SAP SD modules ensuring accuracy of pricing delivery and customer master information across markets.
* Develop and refine reusable test scenarios and data sets for SAP SD Testing that incorporate geospatial attributes enabling robust validation of territory assignments shipping conditions and logistic routes.
* Evaluate complex supply chain processes for consumer goods using map based analytics identifying bottlenecks in transportation warehousing and last mile delivery and recommending data driven improvements.
* Create detailed dashboards and map visualizations that present key performance indicators related to order fulfillment regional sales performance and supply chain disruptions in formats that are easy for business teams to interpret.
* Coordinate with demand planning distribution and customer service teams to ensure geospatial analysis aligns with real world constraints such as service level expectations inventory positioning and carrier capacities.
* Document geospatial analysis methods data transformations and SAP SD Testing approaches in clear technical narratives that support audit readiness knowledge transfer and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Assess the impact of new business rules and configuration changes in SAP SD on geospatial models recommending updates to algorithms and data structures that preserve consistency and reliability of insights.
* Automate data extraction and quality checks for geospatial and SAP SD data sources using approved tools reducing manual effort and increasing timeliness of reporting for supply chain and commercial stakeholders.
* Support continuous enhancement of hybrid work practices by enabling secure remote access to geospatial tools maintaining performance standards for map rendering and ensuring responsive collaboration with onsite teams.
* Participate in cross functional workshops to translate strategic supply chain goals into geospatial use cases prioritizing initiatives that improve sustainability reduce waste and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Provide thought guidance on emerging trends in geoanalytics and digital supply chain proposing practical pilots that use existing SAP SD and mapping capabilities to create measurable business impact.

**Qualifications**

* Bring strong experience in SAP SD Testing with deep understanding of order to cash pricing delivery processing and data integrity concepts applied to complex enterprise landscapes.
* Demonstrate advanced practical knowledge of SAP SD configuration and processes including customer master data material listings shipping conditions and billing flows relevant to geospatial analysis.
* Apply proven expertise in supply chain management to interpret logistics networks service levels and inventory strategies translating them into meaningful geospatial models and metrics.
* Offer solid exposure to consumer goods supply chains including channel structures promotion driven demand variation and distribution patterns that influence geospatial optimization opportunities.
* Utilize strong skills in geospatial data analysis and mapping tools to manage large spatial data sets perform proximity and route analyses and present insights in clear visual narratives.
* Employ disciplined testing and documentation practices including test case design defect tracking and root cause analysis ensuring that geospatial and SAP SD solutions meet quality expectations.
* Communicate effectively with technical and business partners synthesizing complex spatial and SAP SD information into transparent explanations that support informed decision making.

**Certifications Required**
SAP SD certification plus any recognized geospatial or GIS analytics certification such as ESRI or equivalent.

**Company Description:**

Motivus Consulting is a business and people transformation company that helps organisations improve business performance, leadership effectiveness, sales productivity, customer experience, and employee performance through consulting, coaching, training, and mentoring.

We work with businesses to address performance challenges, strengthen teams, develop leaders, improve sales effectiveness, and enable sustainable business growth.

We are looking for a high-energy, self-driven sales professional who can open doors, build relationships with decision-makers, and generate qualified business opportunities for our services.

**Key Responsibilities**

·        
**A. Proactive Prospecting and Lead Generation**

o  Identify and research prospective companies, SMEs, growing businesses, and corporate organisations that could benefit from our services.

o  Identify relevant decision-makers, including business owners, founders, CEOs, CHROs, HR Heads, L&D Heads, Sales Heads, and other functional leaders.

o  Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, business directories, company websites, networking platforms, referrals, and other relevant sources.

o  Conduct outbound calls, personalised emails, LinkedIn outreach, WhatsApp business communication where appropriate, and other prospecting activities.

o  Develop creative approaches to reach decision-makers who are difficult to contact through conventional channels.

·        
**B. Physical Field Sales and Corporate Visits**

o  Visit prospective companies, business parks, commercial establishments, and corporate offices to initiate conversations and generate business opportunities.

o  Approach receptionists, front-office personnel, administrative teams, and other gatekeepers professionally to seek access to the relevant decision-maker.

o  Find legitimate and creative ways to secure introductions and appointments while respecting company security procedures and visitor policies.

o  Conduct in-person prospecting and follow up with prospects after visits.

o  Be comfortable working outside the office and independently planning field visits.

·        
**C. Appointment Setting and Opportunity Development**

o  Convert prospecting efforts into qualified appointments with relevant decision-makers.

o  Explain Motivus Consulting's services clearly and communicate the business problems we help solve.

o  Understand the prospect's business context, challenges, priorities, and potential requirements.

o  Qualify opportunities based on need, relevance, decision-making access, timing, and potential commercial value.

o  Schedule meetings for the founder or designated consultant to conduct deeper discovery, present solutions, and discuss proposals.

o  Maintain follow-up discipline to move prospects from initial contact to meetings and subsequent sales stages.

·        
**D. Creative Sales and Market Development**

o  Experiment with different prospecting techniques, opening lines, outreach messages, introductions, and appointment-setting strategies.

o  Research prospective clients and identify relevant business triggers, such as expansion, new leadership, hiring, sales growth initiatives, or organisational changes.

o  Suggest new ways to access target companies, develop referral channels, and generate leads.

o  Learn from unsuccessful approaches, adapt quickly, and share insights that improve the overall sales process.

o  Take initiative rather than relying exclusively on scripts or instructions.

·        
**E. Digital Prospecting and Social Media**

o  Use LinkedIn and other relevant social media platforms to identify prospects, research organisations, and initiate professional conversations.

o  Support the development and distribution of relevant business content, insights, and service-related communication.

o  Build professional connections and engage with potential clients online.

o  Basic video editing, short-form video preparation, or repurposing content for social media will be an added advantage.

·        
**F. CRM and Sales Pipeline Management**

Job Description – Senior Presales Manager
  
  
Job Title
  
  
Senior Presales Manager / Lead Presales Consultant
  
  
Department

Reporting To
  
  
Head of Presales / Sales Director / Business Unit Head
  
  
Location

**Experience Required**
10–12 years of relevant experience in IT services, technology consulting, solution development, or presales.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Senior Presales Manager will lead the development of customer-centric, technically sound, and commercially competitive solutions for strategic opportunities within the IT services business.
  
  
The role requires strong experience in understanding complex customer requirements, designing end-to-end solutions, leading proposal and bid activities, developing commercial models, and presenting value propositions to senior customer stakeholders.
  
  
The successful candidate will work closely with sales leaders, solution architects, delivery teams, technology partners, finance, legal, commercial, and executive management teams to improve deal quality, win probability, and business growth.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Opportunity Qualification and Presales Strategy
* Partner with sales teams to qualify opportunities based on customer needs, strategic fit, competitive positioning, delivery capability, and commercial viability.
* Lead presales planning for strategic and complex opportunities.
* Define the overall solution strategy, win themes, value proposition, and competitive differentiators.
* Identify customer business challenges, technology priorities, decision criteria, and key stakeholders.
* Recommend bid or no-bid decisions based on opportunity assessment, risk, investment, and expected business value.
* Develop account-specific and industry-specific presales strategies.
* Customer Requirement Analysis
* Lead discovery sessions, workshops, and stakeholder discussions to understand customer business and technical requirements.
* Analyse Requests for Proposal, Requests for Information, Requests for Quotation, and other procurement documents.
* Translate customer requirements into clear functional, technical, operational, and commercial solution components.
* Identify gaps, assumptions, dependencies, risks, constraints, and clarification requirements.
* Ensure that proposed solutions address the customer’s current challenges and long-term business objectives.
* Solution Development and Architecture
* Lead the design of end-to-end IT services solutions in collaboration with solution architects and delivery teams.
* Develop solutions covering areas such as application development, cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data and analytics, enterprise applications, managed services, automation, and digital transformation.
* Define the solution scope, architecture, operating model, implementation approach, delivery methodology, governance structure, and service management framework.
* Ensure alignment between customer requirements, proposed technologies, delivery capabilities, service levels, and commercial commitments.
* Review and validate solution designs, effort estimates, staffing models, transition plans, and implementation schedules.
* Promote the use of reusable solution components, accelerators, frameworks, and industry best practices.
* Proposal and Bid Management
* Lead the preparation and submission of high-quality technical and commercial proposals.
* Manage cross-functional bid teams involving sales, technology, delivery, finance, legal, procurement, HR, and partner organisations.
* Define proposal structure, response strategy, responsibilities, review cycles, and submission timelines.
* Develop executive summaries, solution narratives, transformation roadmaps, case studies, and differentiators.
* Ensure that all proposal responses are accurate, compliant, consistent, and aligned with customer expectations.
* Conduct solution reviews, proposal reviews, risk reviews, and executive approval sessions.
* Support contract negotiations and clarification discussions until deal closure.
* Commercial Solutioning
* Work with finance and commercial teams to develop competitive and sustainable pricing models.
* Review effort estimates, resource plans, delivery locations, subcontractor costs, technology costs, and risk provisions.
* Support the development of fixed-price, time-and-material, managed services, outcome-based, and consumption-based commercial models.
* Evaluate deal profitability, gross margin, cash flow, investment requirements, and commercial risks.
* Recommend pricing strategies and optimisation opportunities without compromising delivery quality.
* Ensure alignment between solution commitments, pricing assumptions, service levels, and contractual obligations.
* Customer Engagement and Presentations
* Act as a trusted advisor to customer stakeholders throughout the sales cycle.
* Lead customer presentations, solution workshops, technical discussions, and executive briefings.
* Present complex technical solutions in clear business language.
* Articulate the business value, expected outcomes, return on investment, and transformation benefits of the proposed solution.
* Lead or coordinate demonstrations, prototypes, proofs of concept, and solution validation sessions.
* Address customer questions, objections, risks, and concerns with confidence and credibility.
* Build relationships with business leaders, CIOs, CTOs, procurement teams, and technology decision-makers.
* Industry and Technology Leadership
* Maintain a strong understanding of industry trends, emerging technologies, customer priorities, and competitive offerings.
* Provide inputs for service portfolio development, solution innovation, and go-to-market strategies.
* Develop industry-specific and technology-specific solutions, propositions, and sales materials.
* Collaborate with technology partners, cloud providers, software vendors, and alliance organisations.
* Represent the company at customer events, industry forums, webinars, and internal knowledge sessions.
* Support the creation of thought leadership content, case studies, white papers, and solution briefs.
* Sales and Business Development Support
* Support account planning, pipeline development, and opportunity creation.
* Participate in strategic account reviews and business planning sessions.
* Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing customer accounts.
* Support the development of new service offerings and market-entry strategies.
* Provide presales inputs for sales forecasts, revenue planning, and business reviews.
* Track presales performance, opportunity status, proposal progress, and win-loss trends.
* Leadership and Team Development
* Lead, mentor, and guide presales consultants, solution specialists, and bid team members.
* Allocate responsibilities and ensure effective collaboration across distributed teams.
* Review the quality of proposals, presentations, solution documents, and commercial inputs.
* Build presales capabilities through coaching, training, knowledge-sharing, and structured feedback.
* Establish and improve presales processes, templates, governance, and quality standards.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and customer-focused team culture.
* Risk and Governance
* Identify technical, operational, commercial, contractual, and delivery risks during the sales cycle.
* Develop appropriate risk mitigation plans and ensure that risks are clearly documented.
* Ensure that proposed solutions comply with company policies, security standards, regulatory requirements, and contractual guidelines.
* Conduct structured handover sessions from sales and presales teams to delivery teams.
* Ensure that customer commitments, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, and contractual obligations are clearly communicated.
* Support post-deal reviews and capture lessons learned for continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Master’s degree in Business Administration, Technology Management, or a related field is preferred.
* 10–12 years of experience in IT services, technology consulting, solution architecture, presales, bid management, or related roles.
* At least 4–5 years of experience leading complex presales engagements or large strategic bids.
* Proven experience in developing end-to-end IT services solutions for enterprise customers.
* Strong understanding of sales cycles, proposal management, commercial modelling, and contract negotiations.

title: CGT Lead
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Various outside weather conditions
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Drive the growth of Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Cell & Gene Therapy (CGT) business by enabling and leading integrated workflow selling across businesses.
  
  
The role will identify strategic CGT opportunities, understand customers’ scientific, process-development and manufacturing workflows, and bring together capabilities from across Thermo Fisher Scientific to create differentiated, end-to-end solutions.
  
  
A critical aspect of this role is the ability to
**influence without direct authority**
. The incumbent will work across multiple businesses, commercial teams, product specialists, application scientists, marketing, service and other functions to create alignment around customer opportunities and mobilize the right capabilities to win.
  
  
The role will act as a
**CGT workflow orchestrator**
, moving customer engagement beyond individual products toward integrated solutions spanning research, process development, clinical translation and commercial manufacturing.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**CGT Workflow Selling & Business Growth**

* Develop and execute the commercial strategy for growing Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Cell & Gene Therapy business across assigned markets and strategic customers.
* Identify and develop high-value opportunities where multiple Thermo Fisher businesses can participate in the customer workflow.
* Build a strong pipeline of integrated CGT workflow opportunities rather than relying primarily on individual product opportunities.
* Understand customer programs from early research and process development through clinical translation, scale-up and commercial manufacturing to identify opportunities across the workflow.
* Connect relevant capabilities across cell biology, cell culture, cell processing, gene editing, viral vector and plasmid workflows, bioprocessing, analytical technologies, instruments, consumables, reagents and services.
* Translate customer scientific and manufacturing challenges into integrated Thermo Fisher value propositions.
* Drive penetration and share of wallet within strategic CGT customers through broader workflow adoption.
* Maintain strong commercial discipline around pipeline development, opportunity progression, forecasting and execution.

**One Thermo Fisher – Cross-Business Leadership**

* Serve as the commercial integrator for CGT opportunities across Thermo Fisher Scientific businesses.
* Bring together Business Units, commercial teams, Technical Sales Specialists, Application Scientists, Product Management, Marketing, Service and other relevant stakeholders around priority CGT opportunities.
* Establish a clear opportunity strategy and define how different businesses can collectively address the customer’s workflow.
* Create alignment across businesses on customer priorities, value propositions, engagement strategy and execution.
* Ensure individual product discussions are connected wherever appropriate into a broader CGT workflow and customer strategy.
* Identify gaps or overlaps between businesses and facilitate decisions that enable a coordinated One Thermo Fisher approach.
* Act as the internal voice of the CGT customer, ensuring customer workflow requirements and emerging needs are understood across relevant businesses.

**Influence Without Authority**
Success in this role will depend heavily on the ability to
**lead through influence rather than organizational authority**
.
  
  
The incumbent will:
  
  

* Build credibility and trusted relationships with commercial and business leaders across Thermo Fisher Scientific.
* Influence Business Units and sales teams to collaborate on opportunities that span organizational boundaries.
* Create alignment among stakeholders who may have different priorities, objectives and reporting structures.
* Mobilize resources across businesses without necessarily having direct control over those resources.
* Establish shared objectives and mutual accountability around strategic CGT opportunities.
* Navigate a complex matrix organization and resolve competing priorities through collaboration, data, customer insight and business rationale.
* Build internal advocacy for CGT opportunities and secure commitment from relevant stakeholders.
* Facilitate decisions and maintain momentum across complex opportunities involving multiple internal and customer stakeholders.
* Demonstrate strong executive presence, stakeholder management, negotiation and influencing skills.

**Strategic Customer Leadership**

* Develop strong relationships with biotechnology, biopharmaceutical, CDMO, academic, translational research and other organizations participating in the Cell & Gene Therapy ecosystem.
* Engage senior scientists, R&D leaders, process-development teams, manufacturing leaders, procurement teams and business executives.
* Develop a deep understanding of customers’ therapeutic pipelines, technology platforms, manufacturing strategies, capacity expansion plans and long-term priorities.
* Build multi-year strategic account and workflow plans for priority CGT customers.
* Identify opportunities for broader strategic partnerships extending beyond individual product transactions.
* Lead complex, high-value opportunities involving multiple Thermo Fisher businesses and multiple customer stakeholders.
* Conduct strategic business reviews and workflow discussions with key customers.

**Scientific & Workflow Leadership**

* Develop strong understanding of evolving Cell & Gene Therapy technologies, modalities, manufacturing platforms and customer workflow challenges.
* Maintain working knowledge across cell therapy, gene therapy, gene editing, viral vectors, plasmids, regenerative medicine and other relevant advanced-therapy areas.
* Engage customers in scientifically credible, workflow-oriented discussions.
* Enable commercial teams to move from product selling to consultative, workflow-based and outcome-oriented selling.
* Translate scientific and technology developments into actionable commercial opportunities.
* Partner with Business Units, application teams, R&D and Product Management to communicate unmet customer needs and emerging workflow requirements.
* Support scientific forums, workshops, seminars, roundtables and customer innovation discussions that strengthen Thermo Fisher Scientific’s position within the CGT ecosystem.

**Commercial Enablement & Opportunity Leadership**

* Work alongside divisional and regional commercial teams to identify, qualify and progress strategic CGT opportunities.
* Coach and enable sales teams on CGT workflows, customer discovery, consultative selling and cross-business opportunity development.
* Support teams in mapping customer workflows, stakeholders, decision-making processes and competitive positions.
* Develop compelling integrated value propositions for complex customer opportunities.
* Facilitate opportunity strategy sessions involving relevant businesses and specialists.
* Establish mechanisms to track major cross-business CGT opportunities and ensure clear actions, ownership and follow-through.
* Review pipeline quality, customer engagement and competitive activity and drive corrective actions where required.

**Market Development & Strategic Insights**

* Continuously assess the CGT market, including scientific developments, therapeutic pipelines, manufacturing investments, technology shifts, funding trends and evolving customer needs.
* Identify emerging workflow opportunities and areas where Thermo Fisher Scientific can create differentiated value through its combined portfolio.
* Translate market and customer intelligence into recommendations for commercial strategy, portfolio development, marketing and customer engagement.
* Provide structured feedback to business and regional leadership regarding customer requirements, competitive threats and emerging opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for strategic collaborations and ecosystem partnerships where appropriate.

**Education & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Engineering, Pharmacy, Cell Biology, Immunology or a related scientific discipline.
* Advanced scientific qualification such as a PhD is advantageous.
* MBA or equivalent business/commercial qualification is desirable but not mandatory.

**Experience**

* Typically 15+ years of progressive experience in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biopharma, Cell & Gene Therapy, Bioprocessing or related industries.
* Strong understanding of the Cell & Gene Therapy ecosystem and associated research, process-development, manufacturing and analytical workflows.
* Significant experience in commercial leadership, business development, strategic account management, technical sales or market development.
* Demonstrated experience selling or developing complex workflow solutions involving multiple technologies, product categories or business units.
* Proven experience managing complex, high-value, multi-stakeholder commercial opportunities.
* Demonstrated ability to engage senior scientific, technical, manufacturing, commercial, procurement and executive stakeholders.
* Experience operating successfully within a complex matrix organization where outcomes depend on influence rather than direct authority.
* Proven record of building alignment and driving execution across multiple businesses and functions.

**Key Competencies**
**Influence Without Authority**
Exceptional ability to create alignment, gain commitment and drive execution across teams and businesses that do not directly report to the role.
  
  
**Workflow & Solution Selling**
Ability to understand complex customer workflows and connect multiple Thermo Fisher capabilities into differentiated customer solutions.
  
  
**CGT Scientific & Commercial Acumen**
Strong understanding of Cell & Gene Therapy technologies, customer workflows, business drivers and market dynamics.
  
  
**Cross-Business Collaboration**
Ability to operate effectively across organizational boundaries and create a One Thermo Fisher approach to strategic opportunities.
  
  
**Strategic Customer Leadership**
Ability to understand customer strategy beyond individual product requirements and build long-term, multi-level relationships.
  
  
**Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management**
Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and influencing capabilities with both internal and external senior stakeholders.
  
  
**Commercial Execution**
Strong opportunity management, account planning, forecasting, prioritization and execution discipline.
  
  
**Learning Agility**
Ability to rapidly understand emerging CGT technologies and translate scientific developments into commercial opportunities.
  
  
**Key Measures of Success**
Success in this role will be measured through:
  
  

* Sustainable growth of the Cell & Gene Therapy business.
* Growth and quality of the cross-business CGT workflow opportunity pipeline.
* Revenue generated through integrated / multi-business CGT opportunities.
* Increased penetration and share of wallet within strategic CGT customers.
* Number and quality of customers adopting broader Thermo Fisher workflow solutions.
* Effectiveness of cross-business collaboration and One Thermo Fisher execution.
* Ability to mobilize internal stakeholders and resources through influence without direct authority.
* Development of strategic customer relationships and executive-level engagement.
* Forecast accuracy and disciplined progression of strategic opportunities.
* Ability to translate emerging CGT customer needs and market trends into actionable growth opportunities.

The Opportunity
  
  
Royal York Property Management is hiring a Portfolio Manager to manage a portfolio of existing clients, properties, and active service files.
  
  
You will keep clients informed, monitor rent and account activity, coordinate property services, resolve problems, renew agreements, and protect client relationships.
  
  
This role requires strong service ownership and sales ability. You must be comfortable handling objections, explaining value, discussing pricing, preventing cancellations, and identifying opportunities to expand client relationships.

* Provide proactive updates about completed work, outstanding issues, and next steps.

* Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate corrections with the accounting team.

**What You’ll Need**

* Experience managing multiple clients, accounts, properties, claims, cases, or active files simultaneously.
* Experience with client retention, renewals, objection handling, negotiation, account growth, or consultative sales.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
**About Ark Abroad**

Ark Abroad helps international students and skilled migrants in Australia move from survival jobs into corporate roles, through positioning, outreach, interview prep, and accountability.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on Performance Marketing Specialist who can generate qualified leads every day at a low and steadily falling CPL. You will own paid acquisition across Meta, Google, and LinkedIn, set up and maintain clean conversion tracking, and optimise campaigns for lead quality as well as lead volume.

**Experience:**
3 to 4 years

**Work Mode:**
Remote

**Key Responsibilities**

• Plan, launch, and scale lead generation campaigns on Meta Ads, Google Ads (Search, PMax, YouTube), and LinkedIn Ads

• Deliver a consistent daily flow of qualified leads within target CPL

• Set up and manage Meta Conversions API (CAPI), Google Enhanced Conversions, and the LinkedIn Insight Tag and Conversions API

• Build and maintain tracking in Google Tag Manager and GA4, including events, UTMs, and lead form tracking

• Send CRM lead quality data back to ad platforms through offline conversions so campaigns optimise for qualified leads, not just form fills

• Run structured A/B tests on audiences, creatives, ad copy, and landing pages

• Manage Google Ads optimisation: keyword research, match types, negative keywords, bid strategies, Quality Score, and search term analysis

• Build audiences: lookalikes, retargeting, custom intent, and LinkedIn job title and industry targeting

• Work with the content and design team on ad creatives and landing page improvements

• Track and report daily, weekly, and monthly on CPL, cost per qualified lead, lead-to-call conversion, and ROAS

• Manage budgets and pacing across platforms

**Must-Have Skills**

• 3 to 4 years of hands-on experience running lead generation campaigns on Meta, Google, and LinkedIn Ads

• Proven track record of reducing CPL and improving lead quality (be ready to share numbers)

• Practical experience setting up Meta CAPI and Google Enhanced Conversions

• Strong working knowledge of Google Tag Manager and GA4

• Experience with offline conversion imports from a CRM

• Strong analytical skills, comfortable with spreadsheets and dashboards (Looker Studio or similar)

• Experience independently managing monthly ad budgets across multiple platforms

**Good to Have**

• Experience targeting audiences in Australia or other international markets

• Experience in education, study abroad, immigration, career coaching, or other high-ticket service lead generation

• Server-side tagging experience (GTM server container, Stape, or similar)

• Familiarity with CRMs such as HubSpot, Zoho, or LeadSquared

• Basic landing page building skills (Webflow, WordPress, Unbounce, or similar)

• Use of AI tools for creative testing, copy, and reporting automation

**What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)**

• Full tracking audit completed, with CAPI and Enhanced Conversions live and verified

• CRM lead stages connected back to ad platforms

• Measurable drop in CPL and cost per qualified lead against current baseline

• Weekly reporting dashboard in place

**Probation and Performance Review**

• The first 3 months are a probation period with a performance review at the end

• We are looking for someone who can deliver results from the first few weeks, not after a long ramp-up

• Performance will be measured on daily qualified lead volume, CPL, cost per qualified lead, and tracking setup quality

• Confirmation depends on meeting the agreed targets during this period

**What We Offer**

• Competitive salary

• Paid leaves

• Ownership of the full paid acquisition function

• Direct impact on company growth

**How to Apply**

Apply with your resume along with one or two campaign case studies showing spend, CPL before and after, and what you changed. Applications without measurable results will not be shortlisted.

title: CGT Lead
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Various outside weather conditions
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Drive the growth of Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Cell & Gene Therapy (CGT) business by enabling and leading integrated workflow selling across businesses.
  
  
The role will identify strategic CGT opportunities, understand customers’ scientific, process-development and manufacturing workflows, and bring together capabilities from across Thermo Fisher Scientific to create differentiated, end-to-end solutions.
  
  
A critical aspect of this role is the ability to
**influence without direct authority**
. The incumbent will work across multiple businesses, commercial teams, product specialists, application scientists, marketing, service and other functions to create alignment around customer opportunities and mobilize the right capabilities to win.
  
  
The role will act as a
**CGT workflow orchestrator**
, moving customer engagement beyond individual products toward integrated solutions spanning research, process development, clinical translation and commercial manufacturing.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**CGT Workflow Selling & Business Growth**

* Develop and execute the commercial strategy for growing Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Cell & Gene Therapy business across assigned markets and strategic customers.
* Identify and develop high-value opportunities where multiple Thermo Fisher businesses can participate in the customer workflow.
* Build a strong pipeline of integrated CGT workflow opportunities rather than relying primarily on individual product opportunities.
* Understand customer programs from early research and process development through clinical translation, scale-up and commercial manufacturing to identify opportunities across the workflow.
* Connect relevant capabilities across cell biology, cell culture, cell processing, gene editing, viral vector and plasmid workflows, bioprocessing, analytical technologies, instruments, consumables, reagents and services.
* Translate customer scientific and manufacturing challenges into integrated Thermo Fisher value propositions.
* Drive penetration and share of wallet within strategic CGT customers through broader workflow adoption.
* Maintain strong commercial discipline around pipeline development, opportunity progression, forecasting and execution.

**One Thermo Fisher – Cross-Business Leadership**

* Serve as the commercial integrator for CGT opportunities across Thermo Fisher Scientific businesses.
* Bring together Business Units, commercial teams, Technical Sales Specialists, Application Scientists, Product Management, Marketing, Service and other relevant stakeholders around priority CGT opportunities.
* Establish a clear opportunity strategy and define how different businesses can collectively address the customer’s workflow.
* Create alignment across businesses on customer priorities, value propositions, engagement strategy and execution.
* Ensure individual product discussions are connected wherever appropriate into a broader CGT workflow and customer strategy.
* Identify gaps or overlaps between businesses and facilitate decisions that enable a coordinated One Thermo Fisher approach.
* Act as the internal voice of the CGT customer, ensuring customer workflow requirements and emerging needs are understood across relevant businesses.

**Influence Without Authority**
Success in this role will depend heavily on the ability to
**lead through influence rather than organizational authority**
.
  
  
The incumbent will:
  
  

* Build credibility and trusted relationships with commercial and business leaders across Thermo Fisher Scientific.
* Influence Business Units and sales teams to collaborate on opportunities that span organizational boundaries.
* Create alignment among stakeholders who may have different priorities, objectives and reporting structures.
* Mobilize resources across businesses without necessarily having direct control over those resources.
* Establish shared objectives and mutual accountability around strategic CGT opportunities.
* Navigate a complex matrix organization and resolve competing priorities through collaboration, data, customer insight and business rationale.
* Build internal advocacy for CGT opportunities and secure commitment from relevant stakeholders.
* Facilitate decisions and maintain momentum across complex opportunities involving multiple internal and customer stakeholders.
* Demonstrate strong executive presence, stakeholder management, negotiation and influencing skills.

**Strategic Customer Leadership**

* Develop strong relationships with biotechnology, biopharmaceutical, CDMO, academic, translational research and other organizations participating in the Cell & Gene Therapy ecosystem.
* Engage senior scientists, R&D leaders, process-development teams, manufacturing leaders, procurement teams and business executives.
* Develop a deep understanding of customers’ therapeutic pipelines, technology platforms, manufacturing strategies, capacity expansion plans and long-term priorities.
* Build multi-year strategic account and workflow plans for priority CGT customers.
* Identify opportunities for broader strategic partnerships extending beyond individual product transactions.
* Lead complex, high-value opportunities involving multiple Thermo Fisher businesses and multiple customer stakeholders.
* Conduct strategic business reviews and workflow discussions with key customers.

**Scientific & Workflow Leadership**

* Develop strong understanding of evolving Cell & Gene Therapy technologies, modalities, manufacturing platforms and customer workflow challenges.
* Maintain working knowledge across cell therapy, gene therapy, gene editing, viral vectors, plasmids, regenerative medicine and other relevant advanced-therapy areas.
* Engage customers in scientifically credible, workflow-oriented discussions.
* Enable commercial teams to move from product selling to consultative, workflow-based and outcome-oriented selling.
* Translate scientific and technology developments into actionable commercial opportunities.
* Partner with Business Units, application teams, R&D and Product Management to communicate unmet customer needs and emerging workflow requirements.
* Support scientific forums, workshops, seminars, roundtables and customer innovation discussions that strengthen Thermo Fisher Scientific’s position within the CGT ecosystem.

**Commercial Enablement & Opportunity Leadership**

* Work alongside divisional and regional commercial teams to identify, qualify and progress strategic CGT opportunities.
* Coach and enable sales teams on CGT workflows, customer discovery, consultative selling and cross-business opportunity development.
* Support teams in mapping customer workflows, stakeholders, decision-making processes and competitive positions.
* Develop compelling integrated value propositions for complex customer opportunities.
* Facilitate opportunity strategy sessions involving relevant businesses and specialists.
* Establish mechanisms to track major cross-business CGT opportunities and ensure clear actions, ownership and follow-through.
* Review pipeline quality, customer engagement and competitive activity and drive corrective actions where required.

**Market Development & Strategic Insights**

* Continuously assess the CGT market, including scientific developments, therapeutic pipelines, manufacturing investments, technology shifts, funding trends and evolving customer needs.
* Identify emerging workflow opportunities and areas where Thermo Fisher Scientific can create differentiated value through its combined portfolio.
* Translate market and customer intelligence into recommendations for commercial strategy, portfolio development, marketing and customer engagement.
* Provide structured feedback to business and regional leadership regarding customer requirements, competitive threats and emerging opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for strategic collaborations and ecosystem partnerships where appropriate.

**Education & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Engineering, Pharmacy, Cell Biology, Immunology or a related scientific discipline.
* Advanced scientific qualification such as a PhD is advantageous.
* MBA or equivalent business/commercial qualification is desirable but not mandatory.

**Experience**

* Typically 15+ years of progressive experience in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biopharma, Cell & Gene Therapy, Bioprocessing or related industries.

* Significant experience in commercial leadership, business development, strategic account management, technical sales or market development.
* Demonstrated experience selling or developing complex workflow solutions involving multiple technologies, product categories or business units.
* Proven experience managing complex, high-value, multi-stakeholder commercial opportunities.
* Demonstrated ability to engage senior scientific, technical, manufacturing, commercial, procurement and executive stakeholders.
* Experience operating successfully within a complex matrix organization where outcomes depend on influence rather than direct authority.
* Proven record of building alignment and driving execution across multiple businesses and functions.

**Key Competencies**
**Influence Without Authority**
Exceptional ability to create alignment, gain commitment and drive execution across teams and businesses that do not directly report to the role.
  
  
**Workflow & Solution Selling**
Ability to understand complex customer workflows and connect multiple Thermo Fisher capabilities into differentiated customer solutions.
  
  
**CGT Scientific & Commercial Acumen**
Strong understanding of Cell & Gene Therapy technologies, customer workflows, business drivers and market dynamics.

Ability to operate effectively across organizational boundaries and create a One Thermo Fisher approach to strategic opportunities.

Strong opportunity management, account planning, forecasting, prioritization and execution discipline.

Ability to rapidly understand emerging CGT technologies and translate scientific developments into commercial opportunities.

Success in this role will be measured through:

* Growth and quality of the cross-business CGT workflow opportunity pipeline.
* Revenue generated through integrated / multi-business CGT opportunities.
* Increased penetration and share of wallet within strategic CGT customers.

The Assistant Manager, Record to Report (RTR) for Controllership will support end-to-end RTR accounting and controllership activities for assigned Warner Bros. Discovery entities and business areas. This role will be based in Hyderabad and will report directly to the Manager RTR. The role is responsible for accurate and timely month-end, quarter-end and annual close activities, journal entries, account reconciliations, variance analysis, financial reporting support, SOX documentation, audit support, and compliance with US GAAP and company accounting policies.

The role will support transition, stabilization and scaling of RTR activities into the Hyderabad Accounting COE, while contributing to process standardization, simplification, automation and continuous improvement.

The role requires a strong controllership mindset, sound technical accounting knowledge, analytical capability and ownership. The Assistant Manager is expected to independently execute assigned activities, perform detailed analysis and quality checks on assigned work, identify and resolve issues, support process knowledge sharing, and escalate material accounting, reporting or control matters to the Manager RTR in a timely manner.

Your normal hours of work are 3:00 p.m. IST to 11:00 p.m. IST, Monday to Friday. However, due to business needs, you may be required to work outside these hours and on holidays for the proper performance of your role, subject to applicable laws and company policy.

**Your Role Accountabilities…**

**Controllership, Close and Reporting**

· Support and coordinate RTR accounting and controllership activities for the assigned scope, ensuring completeness, accuracy and timely delivery.

· Prepare and post month-end journal entries including accruals, prepaids, amortizations, reclasses and other standard or ad-hoc entries.

· Prepare balance sheet account reconciliations, investigate reconciling items and aging, and drive timely resolution of open items.

· Perform monthly and quarterly balance sheet and income statement variance analysis and provide clear explanations to controllership stakeholders.

· Support intercompany reconciliations, investigate out-of-balance items and coordinate timely resolution with WBD counterparts.

· Ensure all assigned close activities are completed in accordance with the close calendar, accounting policies and reporting requirements.

· Assess accounting implications of routine transactions, apply sound judgment within established policies, and escalate complex matters to the Manager RTR.

· Prepare and support financial reporting schedules, management reporting requirements and other close deliverables as assigned.

**Governance, Controls and Audit Readiness**

· Ensure accounting and reconciliation supporting documentation meets SOX standards and internal control requirements.

· Execute assigned key controls, retain appropriate evidence and promptly escalate control exceptions or financial reporting risks.

· Support internal and external audits, statutory requirements, walkthroughs, testing and information requests, and help drive timely closure of open items.

**Transition and Operating Model Buildout**

· Support transition, knowledge transfer, stabilization and documentation of RTR activities moving into the Hyderabad Accounting COE.

· Help establish and maintain process documentation, SOPs, ownership matrices, close checklists, KPIs and escalation protocols.

· Participate in training, shadowing, reverse-shadowing, testing and readiness activities to support successful transitions and business continuity.

**Transformation, Process Excellence and Systems**

· Identify and implement opportunities for process standardization, simplification, automation and continuous improvement across RTR activities.

· Support SAP/ERP changes, BlackLine improvements, integrations, reorganizations, UAT and other finance transformation initiatives.

· Use advanced Excel, Power BI and other available tools to improve analysis, controls, reporting quality and team productivity.

**Team Collaboration, Knowledge Sharing and Support**

· Provide process guidance, knowledge sharing and training support to team members and new joiners without direct people-management responsibility.

· Support the Manager RTR in close coordination, issue tracking, backup coverage, prioritization and timely escalation of delivery risks.

· Maintain up-to-date process knowledge and contribute to a collaborative, accountable and quality-focused team culture.

· Perform other duties, special projects and ad-hoc activities requested by the Manager RTR or relevant stakeholders.

**Qualifications & Experience…**

**Required**

· MBA, B.Com, CA Inter, CMA Inter, M.Com or equivalent relevant finance/accounting qualification required; CA, CPA or CMA qualification is an advantage.

· 8-10 years of progressive accounting experience, preferably in a US GAAP environment.

· Strong experience in RTR, month-end close, journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, variance analysis, financial reporting support, audit support and internal controls.

· Minimum 2-3 years of experience in SAP FI/CO; exposure to SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA and BlackLine is preferred.

· Experience working in transitions, transformation, process stabilization or migration activities.

· Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced functions; working knowledge of Power BI is preferred.

· Experience working in a multinational or multicultural matrix organization.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving and issue-resolution skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines.

· Very good written and verbal communication, interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills.

· High attention to detail, ownership mindset and commitment to quality, compliance and timely delivery.

· Able to work effectively across various time zones.

**Desired**

· Big 4 public accounting background and/or prior exposure to a captive Finance Shared Service Centre / Global Capability Center.

· Experience in media, entertainment, production, distribution or related industries.

· Experience with finance transformation, automation, process standardization or system implementation initiatives.

· Self-driven attitude with willingness to learn, grow and take on additional responsibilities.

· Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and changing environment.

**Other Requirements**

· Required to be in the Hyderabad office three days a week (specific days to be determined upon hire).

**About Skydance**

Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

**Some Important Details**

We embrace the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit. In line with the laws of the country or region in which the role is based, this includes consideration without regard to race, color, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship status, religion or belief, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, physical or mental disability, genetic information, military or protected veteran status, union status or any other category protected by applicable law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

**About Carrier**
Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced FEA & Electronics Cooling Simulation Engineer responsible for performing advanced structural, dynamic, explicit, and thermal simulations to support product design, optimization, validation, and troubleshooting.
  
  
The candidate should have strong fundamentals in finite element analysis and hands-on experience with linear and nonlinear structural analysis, vibration and dynamic analysis, drop/impact simulations, and electronics cooling/thermal analysis. The role will work closely with Design, Product, Testing, Manufacturing, and Systems Engineering teams to ensure designs meet structural, durability, thermal, and performance requirements.
  
  
**Job Responsibility**
Structural FEA
  
  

* Perform linear static analysis to evaluate stress, strain, deformation, stiffness, and load paths.
* Conduct nonlinear analysis, including: Material nonlinearity/plasticity Geometric nonlinearity/large deformation Contact and friction Bolt/fastener and joint behavior
* Evaluate sheet-metal, cast, welded, bolted, and structural assemblies.
* Perform design iterations and recommend structural improvements based on simulation results.
* Support design optimization, weight reduction, material changes, and cost-reduction/VAVE projects.

**Dynamic & Vibration Analysis**
**Perform Structural Dynamic Analyses Including**

* Modal analysis
* Natural frequency and mode-shape evaluation
* Harmonic response analysis
* Random vibration/PSD analysis
* Shock/transient response analysis
* Frequency-response assessments
* Evaluate resonance risks and recommend design modifications.
* Support simulation-to-test correlation using vibration and modal test results.

**Explicit, Drop & Impact Analysis**

* Perform explicit nonlinear simulations for highly transient events.
* Develop simulation methodologies for: Drop tests Impact events Shock loading Component-to-component impact Large deformation Severe contact conditions
* Evaluate plastic deformation, acceleration, stress/strain, energy balance, contact forces, and structural integrity during impact events.
* Correlate simulation results with physical drop/impact testing where data is available.

**Electronics Cooling & Thermal Analysis**

* Perform electronics cooling and thermal simulations for electronic components, enclosures, and systems.
* Evaluate: Component/junction temperatures PCB thermal performance Heat sinks Fans and forced convection Natural convection Conduction paths Airflow distribution Pressure drop Hot spots and thermal bottlenecks
* Assess thermal-management concepts and recommend improvements to cooling architecture.
* Map thermal or pressure loads from CFD analysis into structural FEA models where required.
* Perform thermal-structural analysis to evaluate deformation and stresses generated by temperature distributions.

**Pre/Post-Processing & Modeling**

* Develop high-quality finite element models using 1D, 2D/shell, and 3D/solid elements as appropriate.
* Define realistic boundary conditions, contacts, joints, connectors, fasteners, materials, and loading conditions.
* Perform mesh-quality and mesh-convergence assessments.
* Perform CFD-to-FEA load transfer, such as: Pressure mapping Temperature mapping Spatially varying load mapping
* Review model assumptions and ensure that simulation methodologies appropriately represent actual product behavior.

**Engineering Analysis & Validation**

* Interpret analysis results and translate them into actionable design recommendations, rather than simply reporting stresses or temperatures.
* Identify potential structural and thermal weaknesses early in the product-development cycle.
* Define analysis assumptions, acceptance criteria, margins, and limitations.
* Support design reviews, DFMEA, validation planning, and root-cause investigations.
* Develop engineering reports and presentations clearly documenting: Objective Methodology Assumptions Boundary conditions Results Conclusions Recommendations
* Collaborate with test engineers to improve CAE-to-test correlation and update simulation methodologies based on test results.

**Preferred CAE Tools**

* Hands-on experience with several of the following is preferred:
* ANSYS Mechanical
* ANSYS LS-DYNA / LS-DYNA
* ANSYS Fluent / Icepak
* Altair HyperMesh
* Altair HyperView
* OptiStruct / Radioss
* SpaceClaim or equivalent CAD-preparation tools
* Experience working with CAD platforms such as Creo, NX, or SolidWorks would be beneficial.

**Requirements**

* Strong fundamentals in: Solid mechanics Strength of materials Finite element methods Structural dynamics Heat transfer Contact mechanics Material plasticity
* Understanding of metallic and polymer material behavior.
* Good understanding of static versus dynamic loading and implicit versus explicit solution methodologies.
* Ability to assess FEA model quality and recognize unrealistic boundary conditions, contacts, mesh behavior, or solver results.
* Ability to troubleshoot convergence problems in nonlinear simulations.
* Knowledge of fatigue and durability assessment is desirable.
* Experience with scripting/automation using Python, APDL, TCL, or similar tools is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Applied Mechanics, or a related engineering discipline.
* Relevant hands-on experience in structural/thermal CAE and product-development environments.
* Experience supporting simulation-driven design decisions and physical validation is highly desirable.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
* Sound engineering judgment
* Ability to independently develop appropriate FEA methodologies
* Ability to distinguish modeling issues from actual design problems
* Strong communication and technical presentation skills
* Effective collaboration with Design, Testing, Systems, Manufacturing, and Product Engineering teams
* Ability to manage multiple simulation activities and priorities

title: Senior Cloud Operations Engineer, Staff
description:
**We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
**You Are**
You have spent years keeping Linux infrastructure running under real pressure, the kind where a compute farm going down at 2 a.m. means a tape-out slips and someone loses sleep. You know the difference between a system that looks healthy in a dashboard and one that actually stays up when 10,000 simulation jobs hit it at once. You have debugged enough weird failures to know that the answer is rarely in the first log you check, and you are comfortable digging until you find it.
  
  
Working across cloud and on-prem does not rattle you. You have built things in Azure or AWS using Terraform and Ansible, not because it was trendy but because manual provisioning does not scale. You script in Bash and Python not to show off but to stop doing the same thing twice. When a designer in Singapore cannot access a license server, you do not guess, you pull tcpdump, check journalctl, trace the route, and fix it.
  
  
You care about uptime because you know the teams depending on your infrastructure are racing deadlines that matter. At Synopsys, you will support compute environments that power chip design work across the company, and what you keep running directly affects whether engineers can do their jobs.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
Administer and maintain CentOS/ALMA Linux systems across Azure, AWS, and GCP cloud environments that support large-scale EDA compute farms and design workflows
  
  
Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure at scale using Terraform and Ansible, handling compute, storage, and networking for simulation, synthesis, and verification workloads
  
  
Monitor system health, capacity, and performance using Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic Search, or Splunk, catching issues before they affect design teams
  
  
Troubleshoot complex system, network, and application-level problems using tcpdump, netstat, journalctl, and other diagnostic tools to minimize downtime during critical tape-out windows
  
  
Manage license servers (FlexLM/FlexNet) and batch scheduling systems like LSF, SGE, Slurm, or Altair PBS that queue simulation and regression jobs
  
  
Coordinate tool version upgrades, freeware installs, and compatibility validation with CAD and EDA application support teams
  
  
Participate in rotational shift work (monthly rotation) and on-call weekend coverage, providing front-line support to internal design and verification teams
  
  
**The Impact You Will Have**
Keep compute infrastructure running so IC design, verification, and physical design teams can meet tape-out deadlines without infrastructure delays
  
  
Reduce incident response time and system downtime through proactive monitoring, automation, and structured root-cause analysis
  
  
Scale cloud infrastructure efficiently using Infrastructure as Code, enabling faster provisioning and more reliable deployments across global teams
  
  
Improve system reliability and performance tuning so simulation and synthesis jobs run faster and more predictably
  
  
Build runbooks and documentation that help junior admins resolve issues independently and reduce repeat escalations
  
  
Strengthen cross-team collaboration by translating complex infrastructure problems into clear updates for CAD, DevOps, security, and design engineering teams
  
  
Support the adoption of AI-powered tools and workflows by maintaining the underlying compute and cloud infrastructure they depend on
  
  
**What You'll Need**
5+ years of hands-on Linux systems administration experience, ideally supporting compute-intensive or EDA environments
  
  
Strong proficiency with CentOS, ALMA, or similar Linux distributions in production cloud environments
  
  
Hands-on experience with Azure (preferred), and working knowledge of AWS or GCP
  
  
Proven experience using Terraform and Ansible to deploy and manage large-scale compute and storage infrastructure
  
  
Strong scripting skills in Bash and Python for automation, troubleshooting, and workflow optimization
  
  
Experience managing batch scheduling systems such as LSF, SGE/Univa Grid Engine, Slurm, or Altair PBS
  
  
Familiarity with license management tools like FlexLM or FlexNet, and monitoring/logging platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic Search, or Splunk is a plus
  
  
**Who You Are**
You can troubleshoot a network connectivity issue using tcpdump, netstat, traceroute, and dig without needing a runbook in front of you
  
  
You write scripts to automate repeated tasks because doing the same manual work twice feels like a waste of time
  
  
You treat internal design teams like customers, their productivity depends on your systems staying up, and you take that seriously
  
  
You can translate a complex infrastructure failure into a two-sentence update for a VP without losing the technical nuance that matters
  
  
You stay calm during on-call incidents and work methodically through root-cause analysis instead of guessing and hoping
  
  
You are comfortable coordinating across network, security, CAD, and DevOps teams to get a problem solved, even when it crosses multiple domains
  
  
**The Team You'll Be Part Of**
You will be part of a dynamic and collaborative Cloud Operations team that keeps our cloud environment running smoothly, securely, and reliably. Operating 24×5, we play a critical role in ensuring service availability, proactively monitoring infrastructure, and responding swiftly to incidents. We believe in teamwork, ownership, continuous learning, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Every team member contributes to operational excellence by embracing automation, driving improvements, and sharing knowledge. Together, we don’t just keep the cloud running—we continuously evolve, innovate, and deliver reliable services that make a real difference to the business.
  
  
**Rewards And Benefits**
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Front End Developer - Manager
description:
Role purpose
  
  
You'll build the user interfaces for a multi-year programme modernizing a large portfolio of middle-office applications and moving them to AWS. This is a
**hands-on senior development role**
. You'll build data-heavy, real-time ReactJS/TypeScript applications that replace legacy desktop and web UIs. You'll own front-end integration with back-end services over
**REST APIs, WebSockets and Server-Sent Events (SSE)**
. You'll also set front-end standards and tooling for the team, and use AI coding tools as part of your everyday work.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
**Front-end development**

* Design and build complex ReactJS/TypeScript applications for trade processing, reconciliation, settlement and operations monitoring users.
* Build high-performance, data-heavy UIs: large grids (e.g. AG Grid), virtualised lists, filtering, dashboards and live status views.
* Design reusable component libraries, state management (e.g. Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query) and accessible, consistent UI patterns.
* Write clean, modern JavaScript (ES6+) and strongly typed TypeScript, and keep API contracts type-safe.
* You will have decent experience of understanding and changing Java backend code

**Real-time and API integration**

* Integrate with server-side services over REST APIs, including authentication, pagination, caching, retries and error handling.
* Build robust WebSocket clients (native WebSocket, STOMP or Socket.IO) for two-way, low-latency updates. Handle reconnects, heartbeats, back-pressure, message ordering and subscription management.
* Implement SSE streams for one-way server push (e.g. job status, cycle progress, alerts), including reconnection and event replay.
* Choose the right pattern (REST, WebSocket or SSE) for each use case, working with back-end engineers on message design and contracts.
* Make real-time screens perform well under heavy update volumes: batched rendering, memoisation and throttling.

**Build tooling and quality**

* Set up and maintain front-end builds with npm/pnpm and Vite, including workspaces/monorepos, dependency management, environment configuration and bundle optimisation.
* Work with DevOps on CI/CD pipelines (Harness/GitHub Actions) for front-end build, test and deployment.
* Write unit, component and end-to-end tests (Vitest/Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress), and use mock servers for REST, WebSocket and SSE testing.
* Handle front-end security: SSO/MFA integration, token handling, XSS/CSRF protection and dependency vulnerability scanning.

**AI-assisted development**

* Use GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and/or Devin to speed up component building, refactoring, test generation and legacy UI analysis.
* Review all AI-generated code for correctness, accessibility, performance and security before merging.

**Leadership**

* Set front-end standards, review code and mentor other developers.
* Work with business analysts and users to turn legacy screens and workflows into modern, usable interfaces.
* Support releases, cutovers and early-life support.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* 8+ years in software development, with 5+ years building production ReactJS applications.
* ReactJS: expert in hooks, context, component design, performance tuning and state management.
* TypeScript/JavaScript: strong in TypeScript (generics, typing API contracts) and modern JavaScript, including async patterns.
* Build tooling: practical experience with npm, pnpm and Vite (including migrating from Webpack or similar).
* WebSockets: strong experience building and supporting production WebSocket integrations, including reconnection and state recovery.
* SSE: practical experience using Server-Sent Events/EventSource for streaming updates.
* REST APIs: strong experience consuming and designing contracts with server-side services (OpenAPI/Swagger).
* Decent Java knowledge
* Testing: Jest/Vitest, React Testing Library and an end-to-end framework.
* Git, CI/CD and agile delivery.
* Regular use of AI coding assistants in professional delivery.

**Preferred**

* Working knowledge of Java/Spring Boot back ends (e.g. Spring WebSocket/STOMP, SSE endpoints), to work well with back-end teams.
* Experience with Kafka-backed real-time UIs or streaming gateways.
* Experience replacing legacy UIs (GWT, PowerBuilder, desktop/Citrix applications).
* Experience in financial services, ideally trading, settlement or operations monitoring.
* Familiarity with AWS front-end hosting (S3/CloudFront, API Gateway WebSockets).

Success measures (first 12 months)
  
  

* Delivered production front ends for modernized applications, on schedule.
* Real-time features are stable under production load, with reliable reconnection and no data loss for users.
* Shared component library and front-end standards adopted across the team.
* Faster, smaller builds and good test coverage, measured against a baseline.
* Measurable productivity gains from AI tools, with no drop in quality.

As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. title: Deputy Director – S4 Data Conversion
description:
**Overview**
This role supports the implementation and deployment of Master Data Conversions for the PepsiCo Global S4 migration project (PGT). Objectives of the role is to ensure that data conversions to SAP works seamlessly , efficiently and quality data is migrated to PGT environment. In addition this person will coach and provide direction to the Data conversion team members. This role will adopt and adhere to "Selective Data transition" Methodology principles for the PepsiCo Global Template deployment projects across the globe and will ensure all the learnings are seamlessly and timely implemented to drive the optimization and productivity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business and functional teams to define data migration scope, strategy and planning.
* Lead data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) activities across legacy and SAP systems.
* Leverage tools such as SAP Data Services (BODS), SAP Migration Cockpit, LSMW, or SNP Transformation Cockpit to design and execute migration workflows.
* Map legacy data to SAP target structures, ensuring alignment with business rules and SAP best practices.
* Create and manage data load templates, mapping documents, validation rules, and reconciliation reports.
* Conduct data profiling and cleansing in collaboration with data owners and business SMEs.
* Coordinate mock loads, dry runs, and cutover activities including data load verification and sign-offs.
* Work closely with SAP functional consultants to understand module-specific data nuances.
* Document technical specifications, configuration, and process flows related to data migration.
* Track daily progress of the build and cutover activities

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field.
* 10+ years of experience in SAP data migration projects with greenfield/ blue field implementation projects.
* Strong understanding of SAP data structures, table relationships, and integration points.
* Hands-on experience in SAP migration tools: SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit, BODS, LSMW, or SNP tools(good to have).
* Good exposure to functional processes and master/transactional data elements across modules.
* Working knowledge of SQL, Excel, and data transformation logic.
* S/4HANA data migration implementation experience is a must.
* Ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders and vendor partners effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization
* Ability to work flexible hours based on varying business requirements
* Ability to solve complex issues within the project work group
* Ability to quickly adapt to changes in timelines, plans and navigate ambiguous situations.

title: Data Architect
description:
Job Summary\*\*
  
  
Cyient, is seeking a skilled and experienced Data Architect to design, implement, and manage robust and scalable data solutions. This role will be pivotal in shaping our data strategy and ensuring the integrity, security, and accessibility of our data assets.
  
  
Responsibilities\*\*
  
  
\* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise data architecture, including data models, data flows, and data governance frameworks.
  
\* Collaborate with business stakeholders and IT teams to understand data requirements and translate them into effective architectural solutions.
  
\* Evaluate and recommend appropriate data technologies, platforms, and tools (e.g., relational databases, NoSQL databases, data lakes, data warehouses, cloud data services).
  
\* Develop and enforce data standards, best practices, and security policies to ensure data quality and compliance.
  
\* Oversee the integration of various data sources, both internal and external, to create a unified view of organizational data.
  
\* Lead data migration and transformation initiatives, ensuring data accuracy and minimal disruption.
  
\* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to data engineers, developers, and other team members.
  
\* Stay abreast of emerging data architecture trends, technologies, and methodologies.
  
\* Document data architecture designs, processes, and data dictionaries.
  
  
Qualifications\*\*
  
  
\* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  
\* 10+ years of experience in data architecture, data modeling, database design, and data warehousing.
  
\* Proven expertise in designing and implementing scalable and high-performance data solutions.
  
\* Strong proficiency in various database technologies (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL).
  
\* Experience with cloud data platforms and associated services.
  
\* Solid understanding of data governance, data security, and data privacy principles (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

\* Drive modernization and migration from legacy platforms to Microsoft Fabric

\* Design Fabric Lakehouse architecture with medallion layers (Bronze/Silver/Gold).

\* Perform data modeling, schema design, and table optimization (partitioning, indexing, Delta optimization)

\* Drive AI/GenAI use cases, data agents, and predictive analytics
  
\* Experience with ETL/ELT tools and processes (e.g., SSIS, Talend, Informatica, Data Factory).
  
\* Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  
\* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  
\* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
