title: Regulatory AI & Automation Specialist
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
Role: Regulatory AI & Automation Specialist
  
  
Location: Hyderabad
  
  
Job Type: Full Time
  
  
Years of Experience: 4–6 years
  
  
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
Mission
  
  
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing an OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.
  
  
The PD Regulatory Innovation and Sustainment Chapter is accountable for creating and maintaining a framework for building, maturing, and sustaining PDR business capabilities. This includes fostering innovation, ensuring operational readiness, and implementing continuous improvement across our regulatory processes, systems, and tools. Chapter members lead by designing and deploying innovative, compliant solutions that optimize regulatory workflows while maintaining the highest standards of integrity and data quality. We operate with enterprise thinking in a highly transformative regulated environment—assessing end-to-end processes, anticipating regulatory landscape changes, and unlocking company-wide benefits through strategic partnerships across PD, affiliates, Pharma, and the Roche group. Success in this chapter requires strategic thinking, systems thinking, data and content management expertise, an enterprise mindset, and the ability to drive continuous improvement and change leadership in a matrix environment.
  
  
Your Opportunity
  
  
As a Regulatory AI & Automation Specialist within PD Regulatory Innovation and Sustainment Chapter at RSS Hyderabad, you will drive the hands-on digital execution of regulatory operations. In this role, you will design, build, and deploy AI-driven tools, document intelligence engines, and automated workflows that accelerate regulatory document processing, submission dossier management, and compliance tracking across global health authorities
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Collaborate with regulatory stakeholders to evaluate incoming AI/automation requests, assess technical feasibility, and help prioritize high-value use cases for regulatory document workflows
* Build and deploy scalable AI, machine learning, and automation solutions—integrating RPA, Low-Code/No-Code platforms, Python, NLP, and cloud-native services like AWS—specifically tailored to optimize global regulatory workflows and document management.
* Perform operational process mining and opportunity mapping by partnering directly with SMEs from PDR Innovation & Sustainment chapter and global regulatory SMEs to identify high-impact AI and automation opportunities
* Support IT team by providing business directions for ongoing technical & preventive maintenance, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting for all deployed automation scripts, machine learning models, and AI assets operating in production
* Maintain comprehensive technical artifacts (including solution architecture, source code repositories, and testing frameworks) and conduct hands-on internal training to empower business teams and drive adoption across global regulatory functions
* Drive cross-functional Agile and DevOps execution in a matrixed environment, collaborating with PDR Innovation & Sustainment chapter leads, regulatory teams, IT, and RSS peers through sprint planning, rapid PoC prototyping, iterative testing, and continuous feedback loops.
* Monitor operational performance metrics and deliver clear project updates, technical insights, and continuous improvement recommendations to functional leadership and regulatory stakeholders
* Partner with global regulatory teams to showcase the practical applications of AI, NLP, and automation, translating technical features into clear business benefits like compliance risk reduction, improved document processing throughput, and operational efficiency

Who You Are
  
  
You are a hands-on technical builder with 4–6 years of experience in software engineering, data analytics, or AI/automation development and exposure of working in pharmaceutical R&D regulatory affairs or clinical development departments. You possess strong analytical problem-solving skills and thrive in an agile setting where you take ownership of technical execution, turning complex operational processes into automated, production-ready AI tools.
  
  
Qualifications & Technical Skillset:
  
  

* Education & Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, with 4–6 years of hands-on experience building and deploying software, automation, or AI/ML solutions
* Education & Experience: Direct experience in pharmaceutical R&D regulatory affairs or clinical development.
* Advanced GenAI: Experience exposure to prompt evaluation frameworks, or multi-agent orchestration
* Core Programming & Data Engineering: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL for data extraction, manipulation, pipeline creation, and writing modular, production-ready code
* Document AI & Text Processing: Practical experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP), Optical Character Recognition (OCR like Tesseract, AWS Textract, or Azure AI Document Intelligence), and unstructured document parsing (PDFs, XML, JSON, Word)
* AI & LLM Integration: Hands-on experience developing application logic around modern LLM frameworks (e.g., Lang Chain, Llama Index, OpenAI/AWS Bedrock APIs) and building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for document querying
* Software Engineering & APIs: Solid experience with REST APIs, Git version control, unit testing, and basic CI/CD practices
* Workflow & Process Automation: Experience automating workflows using Python orchestration, low-code automation tools (e.g., Power Automate, UiPath), or enterprise schedulers
* Exposure to Deployment & Cloud: Basic exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and containerization (Docker) for deploying scripts and API services

Strong to have:
  
  

* Prompt Architecture & Validation: Ability to design complex, multi-step prompts; validate outputs against business logic; and refine solutions iteratively
* Regulatory Domain Knowledge: Foundational knowledge of ICH guidelines FDA/EMA submission processes, regulatory document formats (eCTD, GxP guidelines, CT documentation), emerging AI/ML regulatory guidance

Note: This job description is intended as a general guideline for the responsibilities and qualifications required for this position. It is not an exhaustive list, and responsibilities may evolve and change based on business needs.
  
  
Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: Senior Analyst (Data Strategy & Acquisition)
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Senior Analyst (Data Strategy & Acquisition)**
**Roche India - Roche Services and Solutions**
**Hyderabad / Chennai**
At Roche, you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted, and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop, and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
**The Position**
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
**That’s What Makes Us Roche.**
As a
**Senior Data Strategy & Acquisition Analyst**
within GATE, you will be a recognized subject-matter expert on the U.S. healthcare data landscape. You will go beyond responding to requests — you will proactively scout, evaluate, and unlock new data assets that expand what Roche's U.S. commercial organization can see and act on. You will operate as a genuine thought partner to U.S. brand, market access, forecasting, field operations, and advanced analytics teams across multiple therapeutic areas, shaping decisions on multi-million-dollar data investments.
  
  
**The Opportunity**

* Multi-Facet Data Asset Portfolio: Own the evaluation, acquisition, and lifecycle management of a broad and diverse portfolio of U.S. healthcare data assets — claims, EHR/EMR and clinical real-world data, specialty pharmacy and hub data, lab and biomarker/genomic testing data, payer and formulary intelligence, sales and distribution, provider reference and affiliation data, patient-level longitudinal data, and competitive/market intelligence
* Proactive Data Scouting & Market Sensing: Continuously track the evolving U.S. data vendor and RWD market — new entrants, emerging and innovative asset types, consolidation, and pricing/licensing trends. Bring forward unsolicited recommendations on datasets Roche should consider and on new use cases that existing assets could unlock
* Therapeutic Area Partnership: Partner with stakeholders across Oncology, Ophthalmology, Cardiovascular-Renal-Metabolic (CVRM), Neurology, Immunology and Rare Disease, translating each TA's distinct commercial questions into fit-for-purpose data requirements — recognizing that a retina franchise, a solid-tumor biomarker-driven brand, and a cardiometabolic primary-care brand each demand fundamentally different data strategies
* Vendor Evaluation & Head-to-Head Benchmarking: Evaluate new and incumbent vendors (eg:-IQVIA, Komodo Health, Clarivate/DRG, MMIT, Optum, Truveta, Flatiron, Verana ), on methodology, capture and coverage, patient/provider linkage, recency and lag, known biases, limitations, and fit-for-purpose. Design and run structured bake-offs and overlap analyses rather than relying on vendor claims
* External Partnerships: Act as the primary technical counterpart to external data vendors — interrogating source methodologies, resolving data quality queries, influencing roadmap and enhancement requests, and supporting renewal and expansion discussions with an evidence-backed point of view
* Data Profiling & Risk Assessment: Perform hands-on profiling, cross-source comparison, and validation. Quantify gaps, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive pushback to ensure alignment with business objectives and realistic expectations of what the data can and cannot support

**Who You Are**
**Education:**
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Bioinformatics, Public Health, Healthcare, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  
  
**Experience:**
5–8+ years of relevant experience in pharma/biotech commercial analytics, healthcare data strategy, life sciences consulting, or a healthcare data vendor. Prior experience in a Data acquisition, Data strategy, Data governance, or RWD-evaluation function is strongly preferred.
  
  
**Multi-Facet Data Asset Exposure (core requirement):**
You have worked hands-on across several of the following and can speak credibly to the strengths, biases, and limitations of each:
  
  

* Claims: open vs. closed, medical vs. pharmacy, submits vs. remits, switch/clearinghouse vs. payer-sourced (IQVIA LAAD/Dx/PharMetrics, Komodo, Clarivate), patient-lives coverage, payer mix, rejection/denial and reversal analytics
* EHR/EMR and clinical RWD: structured vs. unstructured content, clinical depth (stage, biomarkers, labs, performance status, laterality), health-system coverage bias, ambulatory vs. inpatient capture, and the NPI/provider-identifier limitations of EHR sources
* Data Linkage: tokenization and patient-level linkage across claims, EHR, lab, and specialty pharmacy assets (e.g., Datavant), and the practical pitfalls of doing so
* Specialty pharmacy, hub, and distribution data; buy-and-bill dynamics
* Lab, diagnostic, and biomarker/genomic testing data
* Payer, formulary, and market access intelligence (MMIT, DRG Fingertip, Policy Reporter), including coverage policy, utilization management, and GTN-relevant inputs
* Provider reference and affiliation data (NPI/DEA, IQVIA OneKey, IDN/GPO and health-system hierarchies), and how it powers HCP/account targeting
* Competitive and market intelligence (Evaluate, Citeline, Spherix Global Insights, Dedham Group)
* Emerging/innovative assets: ambient and digital health data, registries, SDOH, imaging, patient-reported and adherence data

**Therapeutic Area Exposure:**
Demonstrated exposure to either of
**Oncology**
(solid tumor and/or heme; biomarker testing, staging, lines of therapy, pathways),
**Ophthalmology**
(Imaging and registry data such as IRIS/Verana), or
**CVRM**
(cardiovascular, metabolic and obesity, lab-value-driven segmentation such as HbA1c/LDL/eGFR, high-volume PCP targeting). Rare disease, neurology, or immunology exposure is a strong plus.
  
  
**Analytical & Strategic Thinking:**
Strong analytical reasoning and structured problem-solving with meticulous attention to detail. You engage stakeholders consultatively, ask the sharp clarifying question before proposing a solution, and synthesize complexity into clear recommendations and "so what?" insights
  
  
**Technical Skills**
: Proficient in SQL or similar technology for independent extraction, profiling, and validation on large patient-level datasets. Comfortable in creating a visualizations in any industry wide known platforms.
  
  
Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

**Job Description:**
**What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe**
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. As a
**Senior Salesforce Developer**
with C3 India, you will play a key role for both our project teams and Engineering team. You will be involved with integrations and in all cases where custom development is needed. Senior Developers are responsible for production deployment planning and production deployment. They must exemplify a strong understanding of the architecture and capabilities of the Salesforce platform, while possessing the ability to recognize and scope solutions to turn business solutions into technical designs.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Attend internal and external kickoff meetings & client cadence calls, as necessary

* Develop and mentor new and junior Dev team members and play a key role in the Developer interviewing & onboarding process, as needed
* Assist in managing our Salesforce Business Unit Framework, including using, adding documentation & new features
* Assist in building and managing App Exchange products

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum 6 Years of experience is required

* Must be familiar with both the declarative and programmatic capabilities of Salesforce.com, experienced with Apex, Visualforce, Aura Components, Lightning Web Components, and the Salesforce API suite

* Ability to work autonomously, and maintain a very high quality of work while adhering to the company's best practices for working with data

title: Senior System Software Engineer - GPU
description:
NVIDIA is seeking an outstanding Senior System Software Engineer to join our Display Driver team. You will develop production-quality system software for next-generation NVIDIA GPU and Tegra platforms, working across operating systems such as Linux and Android.
  
  
The role combines broad kernel-mode driver development with opportunities to work on display security technologies, including High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection (HDCP). You will collaborate with hardware, firmware, security, and system software teams to deliver reliable and secure display solutions.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain GPU/display kernel-mode drivers and embedded firmware.
* Develop system software across Linux, Android or similar operating system.
* Implement and maintain HDCP and related display-content-protection functionality.
* Debug interactions across software, firmware, hardware, and external display devices.
* Develop multithreaded, performance-sensitive software in C.
* Participate in design, code, and security reviews.
* Build automated tests and diagnostic tools to improve reliability and interoperability.
* Collaborate with teams across NVIDIA and external partners throughout the product lifecycle.

**What We Need To See**

* BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience developing system software, embedded software, firmware, or kernel-mode drivers.
* Strong C programming and debugging skills.
* Solid understanding of operating-system fundamentals, computer architecture, memory management, synchronization, and concurrency.
* Experience developing low-level software on Linux, Android, or a similar operating system.
* Familiarity with secure protocols, cryptographic concepts, authentication, key management, or content-protection technologies.
* Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Ways to stand out from the crowd**

* Experience implementing or debugging HDCP 1.x/2.x authentication and content-protection flows.
* Knowledge of HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C DisplayPort Alt Mode, DDC/I²C, or DisplayPort AUX protocols.
* Experience with Linux DRM/KMS or graphics/display kernel drivers.
* Familiarity with trusted execution environments, secure firmware, hardware security modules, or secure key provisioning.
* Experience in debugging display interoperability, or content-protection certification issues.

title: Lead Developer Advocate
description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
Trailblazer Relations APAC is a team of creative, highly technical advocates, community builders, and program leaders. We inspire, enable, engage, and support the ever-growing Trailblazer community across Asia Pacific. We help Trailblazers succeed on the Salesforce Platform and use cutting-edge technologies like AIforce, Agentforce and Data Cloud.
  
  
Our work goes well beyond developer advocacy. We grow and support Trailblazer Community Groups, MVPs, and Group Leaders. We run community events and executive engagements. We also partner with customers, partners, and local ecosystems across the region. For developers, we write blog posts, produce video content, host workshops, and engage in person and virtually at Salesforce and third-party events.
  
  
We work closely with Trailblazer Community, Architect Evangelists, marketing, product management, engineering, and product marketing. We are the "voice of the Trailblazer" in APAC, bringing regional perspectives into the company to shape the Salesforce experience, especially around AI and data.
  
  
You're a seasoned technologist who thinks in systems. You know which tool and which feature fits the problem. That means choosing between probabilistic AI and deterministic code, and between visual builders and building from scratch. You're equally comfortable with front-end and back-end languages and APIs, and you're eager to explore new paradigms in AI-driven development.
  
  
You're curious about the full Salesforce portfolio, including platforms like MuleSoft and Heroku, and you enjoy connecting them to solve real problems. You show the "art of the possible" with prototypes that span multiple products.
  
  
You can shift between audiences, from students and new developers in emerging markets to senior architects and CTOs in mature ones. You're a lighthouse in the community, comfortable on camera and on stage in front of audiences of hundreds or thousands. You're ready to travel across APAC to meet them.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Design technical content, reference apps, and demos that span AIforce, Agentforce, Data Cloud, and the wider Salesforce platform built for reuse across events and year-long regional programs.
* Collaborate with Architect Evangelists to incorporate architect content into the programs, campaigns and hands-on activities in the region.
* Contextualize global advocacy campaigns for APAC. For example, adapt one global message into narratives that work for a student-heavy market like India and an enterprise-heavy one like ANZ.
* Own the technical workstreams for flagship events such as World Tours, TDX, and Dreamforce. Design high-scale engagement models for 1000+ audiences, using gamification and interactive coding.
* Own content strategy and assets for programs such as Journey to Salesforce (J2S)
* Delegate component building while personally owning final testing and quality assurance.
* Identify gaps between product, market, and developer needs. Take real-world friction back to product and engineering as the "voice of the Trailblazer."
* Represent the team in strategic discussions, so Trailblazer and developer needs are prioritized in marketing motions.
* Coach non-technical team members, community leaders, and external presenters to deliver technical content at scale.
* Work with Community Group Leaders and MVPs to help them grow and succeed.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 8+ years of experience implementing on the Salesforce Platform, with architect-level design skills.
* Recognized cross-product expertise, with a proven ability to build prototypes that connect multiple Salesforce products. Certifications or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Proven expertise in web applications, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Apex, and APIs, plus hands-on curiosity about AIforce, Agentforce and Data Cloud.
* Excellent presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills, and experience making complex concepts accessible.
* An understanding of how quickly the ways people consume content and share experiences are shifting.
* A strategic mind and strong problem-solving and analytical skills. You work well solo and as a collaborative team player.
* Ability to travel up to 30%.

**Even Better If...**

* Proven ability to influence without authority across regional stakeholders.
* Experience coaching and mentoring others, and a track record of raising the bar on code and content quality.

title: Full Stack Developer - Manager
description:
Role purpose
  
  
You'll build cloud-native services and user interfaces for a multi-year programme modernizing a large portfolio of middle-office applications and moving them to AWS. This is a
**hands-on development role**
with a strong back-end focus. You'll design and build Java microservices and APIs on AWS, and also contribute to ReactJS/TypeScript front ends. You'll use
**AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Devin**
every day to deliver faster, while staying fully accountable for the quality and security of the code.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
**Back-end Development (primary)**

* Design and build Java/Spring Boot microservices and REST APIs for trade processing, accounting, reconciliation and settlement functions.
* Build event-driven integrations with Kafka and IBM MQ, including message design, error handling, retries and idempotency.
* Write efficient data access against Oracle (JPA/Hibernate and SQL), working with database engineers on schema design and performance.
* Rebuild legacy business logic as clean, testable services, working with business analysts and subject-matter experts to confirm behaviour.
* Write unit, integration and contract tests, and help with performance and resilience testing.

**AWS**

* Build and deploy services on AWS: ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, SQS/SNS, RDS, CloudWatch and IAM.
* Design services for scalability, high availability and security, following AWS Well-Architected principles.
* Work with DevOps on Terraform, Docker and CI/CD pipelines (Harness/GitHub Actions) so your services deploy automatically.

**Front-end development (secondary)**

* Build and maintain ReactJS/TypeScript screens and components for data-heavy enterprise applications that replace legacy desktop UIs.
* Connect front ends to back-end APIs, handling authentication (SSO/MFA), state management and error handling.
* Write maintainable JavaScript/TypeScript and component tests (Jest/React Testing Library).

**AI-assisted development**

* Use GitHub Copilot for inline code completion, chat-based refactoring, test generation and pull-request summaries.
* Use Claude Code for agentic, multi-file work in the terminal: understanding unfamiliar codebases, refactoring across modules, generating tests and fixing failing builds.
* Work with Devin (or similar autonomous agents) on well-defined tasks: write clear task specs, review its pull requests and correct its output.
* Use AI to analyse legacy code (Java EE, Sybase SQL, PowerBuilder, COBOL) and draft specs for subject-matter experts to confirm.
* Write good prompts and context files (e.g. README files, coding standards, agent instruction files) so AI tools produce code that follows team standards.
* Review all AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance and licence compliance before merging. You stay accountable for every line.
* Share effective prompts, patterns and lessons learned with the team.

**Ways of working**

* Take part in code reviews, design discussions and agile ceremonies.
* Support production releases, cutovers and early-life support, and fix issues quickly.
* Follow State Street secure coding, information security, data classification and approved-AI-tool policies.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* 6+ years in software development, mostly on the back end.
* Java: strong in Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Data/JPA, REST API design and multithreading.
* Messaging: practical experience with Kafka and/or IBM MQ.
* AWS: good hands-on knowledge of core services (ECS/EKS or Lambda, S3, SQS/SNS, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch).
* Databases: strong SQL; experience with Oracle or another enterprise relational database.
* ReactJS/TypeScript/JavaScript: good working knowledge of React hooks, component design, TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
* AI tools: proven, regular use of at least one of GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or Devin in professional delivery, including the ability to judge when AI output is wrong.
* Engineering practices: Git, CI/CD, Docker, automated testing (JUnit, Mockito) and clean code principles.
* Experience working in agile delivery teams.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with all three of GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Devin, and a view on which tool suits which task.
* Experience with MCP servers or giving AI agents context from Jira, Confluence or code repositories.
* Experience in financial services, ideally investment servicing or middle-office areas (trade lifecycle, settlement, collateral, reconciliation or accounting).
* Experience modernizing legacy applications (e.g. Java EE/EJB on Payara or WebSphere, Sybase).
* Experience with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code.
* AWS Developer Associate or Solutions Architect certification.

Success measures (first 12 months)
  
  

* Delivered production-ready services and front-end features for modernized applications, on schedule.
* Services meet agreed standards for test coverage, performance, security and observability.
* Measurable productivity gains from AI tools (e.g. cycle time, test coverage), with no rise in defects or rework.
* Contributed reusable prompts, agent instructions or patterns that the wider team uses.
* Became a trusted contributor in design and code reviews across the team.

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. * An AI-augmented delivery model running across the programme, with productivity gains measured against a baseline.

* Design and write production code for cloud-native services and user interfaces, especially for the most complex or highest-risk components.
* Build ReactJS front ends that replace legacy desktop and GWT/PowerBuilder UIs, including state management, component libraries, SSO/MFA integration and accessibility.
* Build Java/Spring Boot microservices and APIs (REST and Kafka/MQ event-driven), with Oracle persistence on ECS/EKS.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Harness or similar), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), secrets management (Vault/CyberArk) and observability.
* Write reference implementations, templates and starter projects that the rest of the team and AI agents follow.
* Do daily code reviews and pair with engineers, and debug production-grade issues yourself.

**Engineering leadership**

* Lead the modernization engineering team and set standards for architecture, code quality, testing and release.
* Own technical delivery plans, estimates and release quality, working with Architecture, Platform, Data, QE and the existing application support teams.
* Lead engineering for cutover, parallel runs and handover to run teams.

**AI-augmented delivery**

* Use AI tools hands-on every day (for example GitHub Copilot, Devin, Blitzy and agent frameworks), and lead from your own experience of what works.
* Build agent workflows, prompt libraries and codebase knowledge context (knowledge graphs, vector databases, MCP integrations).
* Apply AI to reverse-engineering legacy code, generating specs, converting code and generating tests.
* Track AI productivity and quality (throughput, defect rates, rework, cost per migrated application) and report outcomes to leadership.

**Risk, controls and governance**

* Put human review checkpoints, audit trails and secure-coding gates on all AI-generated code, in line with State Street technology risk, information security and model governance policies.
* Make sure business logic extracted by AI is checked by subject-matter experts and confirmed through reconciliation before go-live.

**People and capability**

* Hire, coach and grow a permanent full-stack engineering team, and build AI fluency across the team.
* Manage vendor and temporary capacity and make sure knowledge transfers to permanent staff.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* 16+ years in software engineering, still actively coding, with 5+ years leading engineering teams on modernization or cloud migration programmers.
* Java: expert in Java 17+, Spring Boot, JPA, REST API design, Kafka/IBM MQ messaging and performance tuning.
* ReactJS: strong in modern React (hooks, TypeScript, Redux or similar), component design, testing (Jest/React Testing Library) and building data-heavy enterprise UIs.
* DevOps: practical experience with CI/CD (Harness, Jenkins or GitHub Actions), Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes/ECS/EKS, Git workflows, automated testing and quality gates.
* AWS: compute, networking, IAM and managed services, and how to design for HA/DR.
* Databases: strong SQL; experience with Oracle and with migrating from Sybase or SQL Server.
* AI: proven hands-on use of AI coding assistants and agents in delivery, with measurable results.
* Comfort reading and reverse-engineering legacy code (COBOL, C/C++, PowerBuilder).
* Experience delivering in a regulated financial services environment.

**Preferred**

* Knowledge of investment servicing or middle-office areas: trade capture, confirmation, settlement, collateral, reconciliation, investment accounting.
* Experience building MCP servers, knowledge graphs or retrieval-augmented context for engineering agents.
* AWS Professional-level or equivalent certification.

Success measures (first 12–18 months)
  
  

* Personally delivered production code and reference implementations across the front end, back end and pipelines.
* An AI-augmented delivery model running across the programme, with productivity gains measured against a baseline.
* Modernization releases delivered to plan, with no material production incidents at cutover.
* A permanent full-stack team in place, able to run and evolve the new platform.
* No audit or control findings related to how AI is used in delivery.

Leadership attributes
  
  
You make decisions and are comfortable with ambiguity. You're equally credible writing code, reviewing a pull request or presenting to senior stakeholders. You set the technical bar by example.
  
  
**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

**Responsibilities**

* Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Oracle applications

* Overall experience of 8–12 years, with strong hands-on and leadership experience in Oracle Unity Customer Data Platform (CDP) implementations.
* Experience leading at least 2–3 end-to-end Oracle Unity/CDP implementations.
* Good working experience with Oracle Eloqua Marketing Automation, particularly integrations between Unity, Eloqua, CRM, and other enterprise applications.

* Own technical design decisions and ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, integration, data governance, and performance standards.

* Identify technical risks, dependencies, data-quality issues, integration challenges, and performance bottlenecks and drive them to resolution.

* Design the overall Oracle Unity data architecture, including source systems, ingestion strategy, data models, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, and downstream integrations.

* Design and develop Customer 360 dashboards using rules, sub-rules, data source views, calculated attributes, and custom widgets.
* Develop dashboards for customer engagement, segmentation, campaign performance, customer behavior, and other business KPIs.
* Design and manage integrations between Oracle Unity and enterprise applications such as Oracle Sales, Salesforce, Oracle Service, Oracle Loyalty, Oracle Eloqua, Oracle Infinity, Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, Analytics platforms, and third-party systems.
* Strong understanding of Oracle Unity REST APIs, batch integrations, outbound activation mechanisms, webhooks, and integration patterns.
* Define and manage Access Control, users, roles, permissions, and security governance within Oracle Unity.
* Establish data-governance standards covering data ingestion, customer identity, data quality, data privacy, retention, consent, security, and downstream data activation.

* Perform root-cause analysis and drive resolution of data-processing, integration, identity-resolution, API, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Review platform usage and recommend performance, scalability, and operational improvements.
* Define customer-data activation patterns to support Customer 360, personalization, lead generation, cross-sell, up-sell, churn management, customer engagement, and next-best-action use cases.

**Oracle Eloqua Exposure**

* Good understanding of Oracle Eloqua architecture, campaign management, contacts, custom objects, segments, forms, landing pages, and lead-nurturing programs.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with Oracle Eloqua for customer segmentation, campaign activation, audience synchronization, and marketing personalization.
* Understand the data flow between Unity, Eloqua, CRM/Salesforce/Oracle Sales, and other downstream marketing systems.
* Support marketing teams in using Unity customer attributes, Intelligent Attributes, and segments within Eloqua campaigns.

* Support troubleshooting of data synchronization, campaign activation, contact-management, and integration issues between Unity and Eloqua.

**Integration And Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Oracle Unity REST APIs and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with:
* Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM
* Salesforce
* Oracle Service
* Oracle Loyalty
* Oracle Eloqua
* Oracle Infinity
* Data Warehouses
* Enterprise Data Lakes
* Analytics platforms
* External marketing and customer-engagement platforms
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, middleware, batch interfaces, scheduled integrations, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Good understanding of SQL/query concepts, data modelling, data transformation, and data-quality principles.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex integration, data-processing, API, identity-resolution, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Understanding of customer-data activation from Oracle Unity into Eloqua and other marketing channels.

**Leadership And Management Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage a team of Oracle Unity developers, consultants, administrators, and data specialists.
* Estimate effort, prepare delivery plans, allocate resources, and monitor project execution.
* Mentor team members and develop Oracle Unity technical capabilities through knowledge-sharing, technical sessions, and hands-on guidance.
* Review deliverables and ensure adherence to technical, documentation, security, integration, and architecture standards.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate project status, risks, dependencies, issues, and key technical decisions.
* Facilitate design workshops and technical discussions with business, enterprise architecture, security, integration, data, analytics, and infrastructure teams.
* Collaborate with marketing and Eloqua teams to define customer activation and campaign integration strategies.
* Support project planning, solution estimation, proposals, technical presentations, demos, and pre-sales activities when required.
* Identify opportunities to create reusable solutions, accelerators, frameworks, automation, and implementation best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement across Oracle Unity implementation, support, data governance, and operational processes.

title: Lead Full Stack Engineer - Assistant Vice President
description:
Role purpose
  
  
This is a
**hands-on role**
for an engineer who leads by building. You'll lead engineering on a multi-year programme to modernize and migrate a large portfolio of middle-office applications to AWS. You'll write production code across primarily front end
**(ReactJS front ends, TypeScript, NodeJS, npm/pnpm etc., DevOps pipelines)**
. You'll also set up and run the UI team's AI-augmented delivery model, using AI agents and assistants to speed up discovery, code conversion, testing and deployment while meeting the control standards a global custodian needs.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
**Hands-on UI engineering**

* Build ReactJS front ends that replace legacy desktop and GWT/PowerBuilder UIs, including state management, component libraries, SSO/MFA integration and accessibility.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Harness or similar), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), secrets management (Vault/CyberArk) and observability.
* Write reference implementations, templates and starter projects that the rest of the team and AI agents follow.
* Do daily code reviews and pair with engineers, and debug production-grade issues yourself.

**Engineering leadership**

* Lead the modernization engineering team and set standards for architecture, code quality, testing and release.
* Own technical delivery plans, estimates and release quality, working with Architecture, Platform, Data, QE and the existing application support teams.
* Lead engineering for cutover, parallel runs and handover to run teams.

**AI-augmented delivery**

* Use AI tools hands-on every day (for example GitHub Copilot, Devin, Blitzy and agent frameworks), and lead from your own experience of what works.
* Build agent workflows, prompt libraries and codebase knowledge context (knowledge graphs, MCP connections to Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow and SharePoint).
* Apply AI to reverse-engineering legacy code, generating specs, converting code and generating tests.
* Track AI productivity and quality (throughput, defect rates, rework, cost per migrated application) and report outcomes to leadership.

**Risk, controls and governance**

* Put human review checkpoints, audit trails and secure-coding gates on all AI-generated code, in line with State Street technology risk, information security and model governance policies.
* Make sure business logic extracted by AI is checked by subject-matter experts and confirmed through reconciliation before go-live.

**People and capability**

* Hire, coach and grow a permanent full-stack engineering team, and build AI fluency across the team.
* Manage vendor and temporary capacity and make sure knowledge transfers to permanent staff.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* 12+ years in software engineering, still actively coding, with 5+ years leading engineering teams on modernization or cloud migration programmes.
* ReactJS: strong in modern React (hooks, TypeScript, Redux or similar), component design, testing (Jest/React Testing Library) and building data-heavy enterprise UIs.
* DevOps: practical experience with CI/CD (Harness, Jenkins or GitHub Actions), Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes/ECS/EKS, Git workflows, automated testing and quality gates.
* AWS: compute, networking, IAM and managed services, and how to design for HA/DR.
* AI: proven hands-on use of AI coding assistants and agents in delivery, with measurable results.
* Comfort reading and reverse-engineering legacy code
* Experience delivering in a regulated financial services environment.

**Preferred**

* Knowledge of investment servicing or middle-office areas: trade capture, confirmation, settlement, collateral, reconciliation, investment accounting.
* Experience building MCP servers, knowledge graphs or retrieval-augmented context for engineering agents.
* AWS Professional-level or equivalent certification.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

title: Intake Clinical Counsellor
description:
**Purpose Of The Job**
To provide high-quality professional counselling, "in-the-moment" support, and intake services.
  
  
Serves as the central point for clinical triage and scheduling for Lyra service users.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
Helpline & Crisis Management
  
  
Serve as the primary first point of contact for employees and their dependents accessing the Lyra helpline via telephone, live chat, or email.
  
  
Provide immediate "in-the-moment" clinical support to callers in distress, utilizing psychological first aid and stabilization techniques.
  
  
Conduct comprehensive clinical risk assessments for every contact to identify potential self-harm, ideation, or risk to others, adhering strictly to Lyra’s risk protocols.
  
  
Manage emergency interventions and coordinate with local emergency services or internal senior clinical leads when high-risk situations are identified.
  
  

* Clinical Intake & Triage

Conduct detailed clinical intake interviews to assess the user’s presenting concerns, history, and level of psychological distress.
  
  
Evaluate the appropriateness of short-term counseling versus higher-acuity care pathways based on the clinical assessment.
  
  
Utilize internal decision-making frameworks to assign clients to the most suitable professional within the in-house team or partner network, matching based on specialty and language preference.
  
  
Accurately evaluate clinical needs to evaluate whether care should be provided within a structured, short-term framework.
  
  

* Delivery of Clinical Sessions

Provide high-quality, professional counseling and psychotherapy sessions to clients within a structured, short-term framework.
  
  
Utilize evidence-based interventions (such as CBT or solution-focused therapy) to address client queries and specific mental health concerns.
  
  
Ensure all clinical sessions are workplace-focused when appropriate, helping the service user improve their level of functioning and productivity.
  
  
Maintain accurate, contemporaneous clinical notes for every session, meeting the legal and professional standards of the Indian healthcare landscape.
  
  
Monitor client progress through regular outcome measurement and adjust treatment plans or escalate to the Senior CCM for complex review as necessary.
  
  

* Advanced Scheduling & Appointment Coordination

Systematically manage the daily clinical roster, ensuring optimal coverage across all shifts to meet real-time helpline demand.
  
  
Coordinate and maintain the master calendar for all in-house counseling and coaching appointments, minimizing gaps and preventing double bookings.
  
  
Act as the primary coordinator for booking, rescheduling, and managing cancellations, ensuring both service users and clinicians are updated in real-time.
  
  
Monitor clinician availability and specialized skill sets to ensure clients are scheduled with the most appropriate professional.
  
  

* Precision Data Capture & Database Stewardship

Accurately capture and input all vital clinical information—including demographics, presenting concerns, and risk status—into the database at the point of entry.
  
  
Ensure all data points required for case management (such as CORE-10 scores, session counts, and work impact metrics) are logged with high precision.
  
  
Maintain database integrity by ensuring all case statuses and appointment outcomes are updated immediately following service delivery.
  
  
Handle all sensitive clinical data with the highest level of confidentiality, adhering to global data protection standards and local regulations.
  
  

* Operational Liaison & Cross-Functional Coordination

Serve as the central point of contact to coordinate daily activities between clinical and operations teams to facilitate a seamless user experience.
  
  
Manage the transition of cases between teams, ensuring all clinical and operational context is successfully communicated to the receiving professional.
  
  
Act as a liaison to resolve logistical or operational bottlenecks between departments to ensure administrative hurdles do not impact care.
  
  
Regularly communicate operational updates and capacity shifts to leadership to ensure the strategic vision is executed daily.
  
  

* Miscellaneous & Continuous Improvement

Upholding Lyra Values: Act as a brand ambassador by consistently demonstrating Lyra’s core values of clinical excellence, innovation, and empathy.
  
  
Task Ownership: Ensure all allotted clinical and administrative tasks are performed with high precision and within agreed-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  
  
Process Optimization: Proactively identify gaps in current workflows and take the initiative to propose solutions that enhance operational efficiency.
  
  
Workshops & Content: Participate in opportunities to deliver onsite or online workshops and contribute to the development of clinical content and training manuals.
  
  
Event Participation: Represent Lyra Health at professional events and webinars to promote the transformative care model and clinical research.
  
  
**Requirements And Qualifications**

* Qualification -

Masters in Clinical or Counseling Psychology.
  
  
RCI registration is desirable
  
  
0-4 years of experience (Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply).
  
  
Must be bilingual in Hindi and English.
  
  

* Experience:

0-4 years of progressive working experience in a clinical setting, with significant exposure to complex case management.
  
  
Strong preference for candidates with a background and extensive working experience in the Employee Assistance Program (EAP) or workplace mental health field, particularly with complex return-to-work or work-impact cases.
  
  
Experience working internationally and navigating diverse healthcare systems and cultural nuances is highly preferred.
  
  
Proficiency in Google Suite and CRM systems is preferred.
  
  
**Working Hours And Flexibility**
Working Hours: 42.5 hours per week.
  
  
Schedule: 5 or 6 days a week; various shifts applicable to ensure helpline coverage.
  
  
Hybrid Work: Hybrid working can be considered as per the need of the job.
  
  
**About You**
Clinical Acumen: Advanced ability to identify and assess high-level clinical risk during "in-the-moment" helpline contacts.
  
  
Problem Solver: Capable of navigating intricate triage challenges and client queries independently.
  
  
Autonomous & Accountable: Able to work shifts independently while ensuring sound clinical decisions and appropriate escalation.
  
  
Detail-Oriented: Meticulous accuracy in data capture and maintaining contemporaneous clinical notes.
  
  
Communicator: Ability to articulate complex clinical concepts clearly to distressed callers professionally.
  
  
Proactive & Adaptive: Adaptable to a fast-paced helpline environment with a focus on refining intake workflows.
  
  
Organized: Ability to manage a high volume of intake contacts and maintain a complex roster effectively.
  
  
Collaborative: Collaborates with senior clinical leads to manage emergency interventions and referral handovers.

title: Sourcing TL
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Sourcing Team Lead | Residential Real Estate

Department: Sales

Reports To: AVP / VP / Sales Head

1. Role Overview

The Sourcing Team Lead will drive the overall sourcing vertical, focusing on expanding Channel Partner (CP) engagement, increasing CP productivity, and generating quality customer walk-ins and bookings at the project site. The role requires a hands-on, market-oriented professional with substantial real estate sourcing experience, strong relationships across the CP ecosystem, and the ability to deliver results through structured planning, consistent market engagement, and performance-driven team management. The individual will ensure the team works towards clear targets, reactivates dormant and underperforming CPs, and consistently improves walk-in and booking conversions.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities

A. Channel Partner Network Development & Activation

● Expand and strengthen the existing Channel Partner network to increase sourcing potential.

● Drive regular CP meetings, market visits, and engagement activities.

● Increase the number of active CPs contributing to customer walk-ins and bookings.

● Identify, activate, and nurture dormant and underperforming CPs through structured engagement plans.

● Improve CP participation in project activities, site visits, presentations, and sales initiatives.

● Build strong relationships with key CPs to generate consistent business.

B. Walk-in & Booking Generation

● Own the sourcing vertical’s walk-in and booking targets.

● Increase the number of CPs actively generating site walk-ins and contributing to bookings.

● Identify high-potential CPs and develop focused plans to improve their business contribution.

● Monitor the sourcing funnel from CP engagement and customer enquiries through site walk-ins and bookings.

● Analyse conversion ratios and address gaps to improve sales productivity.

● Ensure CP engagement translates into measurable business outcomes.

C. Team Leadership & Performance Management

● Lead, guide, and motivate Sourcing Managers and their teams to achieve individual and collective targets.

● Set clear performance expectations, deliverables, and accountability for every team member.

● Review managers’ market engagement, CP activation, walk-ins, bookings, and target achievement.

● Identify weak or underperforming managers and provide direct guidance, field support, and structured improvement plans.

● Accompany team members on market visits and CP meetings where required to improve productivity and closures.

● Build a performance-driven culture focused on ownership, initiative, and consistent target achievement.

D. Review Mechanism & Business Planning

● Establish a structured daily, weekly, and monthly review mechanism for the sourcing vertical.

● Track CP meetings and market visits; new, active, and productive CPs; walk-in-active and booking-active CPs; customer walk-ins; booking conversions; and manager-wise/team-wise target achievement.

● Review performance against targets, identify gaps, and implement corrective measures.

● Develop monthly action plans for CP activation, engagement activities, walk-in generation, and booking growth.

● Maintain accurate reporting, follow-ups, and accountability across the sourcing team.

E. Market Intelligence & Business Development

● Maintain a strong on-ground understanding of the local real estate market and CP ecosystem.

● Identify new business opportunities, emerging micro-markets, and potential CP networks.

● Track competitor offerings, pricing, incentives, and CP engagement strategies.

● Use market insights to recommend initiatives that strengthen project positioning and sourcing performance.

● Proactively identify opportunities to increase CP participation and improve market reach.

F. Target Achievement & Business Ownership

● Translate overall business targets into clear team-wise, manager-wise, and CP-wise action plans.

● Drive structured, consistent, and measurable efforts rather than relying on ad hoc activities.

● Ensure timely execution of planned CP meetings, activation initiatives, and business development activities.

● Continuously evaluate team productivity and CP contribution to maximise business output.

● Work closely with the AVP / VP / Sales Head to align sourcing strategies with overall project sales objectives.

3. Candidate Profile & Experience

● Substantial experience in real estate sales and channel partner sourcing, preferably in residential real estate.

● Strong understanding of the local property market and established relationships within the CP ecosystem.

● Proven ability to lead sourcing teams and drive business through channel partners.

● Demonstrated experience in achieving walk-in and booking targets.

● Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.

● Ability to analyse performance metrics, identify productivity gaps, and implement corrective actions.

● A hands-on professional who actively participates in market visits, CP meetings, and business closures.

● Strong planning, execution, review, and team development capabilities.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

● Active Channel Partners: Growth in the number of CPs actively contributing to the project.

● Walk-in-Active CPs: Increase in CPs consistently generating customer walk-ins.

● Booking-Active CPs: Increase in CPs contributing to actual bookings.

● Walk-in Generation: Achievement of monthly customer walk-in targets.

● Booking Achievement: Achievement of monthly booking targets from the sourcing channel.

● CP Engagement: Frequency and quality of market visits, meetings, and activation activities.

● Team Productivity: Improvement in individual manager performance and overall team output.

● Dormant CP Reactivation: Successful reactivation of inactive and underperforming CPs.

● Conversion Efficiency: Improvement in walk-in-to-booking conversion ratios.

● Review & Execution Discipline: Consistency in reviews, action-plan implementation, and target tracking.

5. Key Success Expectations

The ideal candidate is a target-oriented, market-driven, and hands-on leader who can build a productive CP ecosystem, strengthen team performance, and consistently generate business. The individual must go beyond team supervision and take direct ownership of market engagement, CP activation, walk-in generation, and booking closures. Success will be measured by the ability to convert structured efforts into tangible business results and deliver consistent, sustainable growth.

Interested candidates can share resume at hr@transindiagroup.com

title: Chief Business Officer- Alternates AIF
description:
**Chief Business Officer — Fundraising & Investor Relations**

Vantrock Investment Managers LLP · Mumbai

**Vantrock is a multi-product real assets platform. Not a warehousing fund.**
Logistics and industrial is the first strategy. Office, plotted sales, land, pre-leased and yielding assets, private credit, data centres and senior living follow behind it. This seat builds the national distribution business that carries all of it: the strategy, the channel, four zonal heads and the number.

**THE SEAT**

Employer: Vantrock Investment Managers LLP, the investment manager within Vantrock Ventures

Reports to: Founder & CEO

Direct reports: Zonal Heads for North, South, East and West, and the team beneath them

Location: Mumbai, with national travel. A road job at every level, including this one

Experience: 15+ years

Team structure, reporting lines, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the current plan and may change as the platform builds out. Compensation is confirmed in the offer.

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

Vantrock is an operator-led real assets platform, multi-product by design. Real assets only. Warehousing and industrial parks are the first strategy, not the platform, across the full chain: first mile, last mile, city-centre, dark-store and self-storage, and logistics-anchored mixed-use.

Behind it sits the rest of the platform, launched in sequence as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back-office space, where our expertise transfers directly; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living. Each is a strategy in its own right, with its own pipeline and distributor relationships. A candidate who reads this as a warehousing platform has read the first line and stopped.

Three parts, kept separate. The founder's balance sheet takes the first risk: land is acquired, de-risked and approved on his capital before any investor commits. Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited is the development manager and operator. Vantrock Investment Managers LLP is the investment manager, underwriting every asset independently and answering to an independent Investment Committee.

Alignment is structural. Assets enter at cost, with no founder premium. The development team takes no fee and no profit on development management. The platform earns only after its investors have.

Founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder & CEO. Three institutional platforms built from zero, and the fourth now on his own capital. Across that career: India's largest industrial real estate exit, Rs 5,250 Cr to Blackstone; a fund platform taken from zero to about USD 1.4 billion in peak AUM in six years, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, Rs 2,775 Cr from roughly 1,000 investors through the channel, on India's first domestic warehousing AIF; 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor; 2,000+ acres acquired, all litigation-free; 200+ buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.

**THE PRODUCT SET YOU WOULD BE BUILDING A CHANNEL FOR**

**Not a channel for one fund, but the distribution business for a succession of products across real assets. The proposed set, built out in sequence as each is delivered and as approvals are obtained:**

**– Industrial parks, logistics and warehousing**

**– Office: suburban campuses, GCC and back-office space, starter and strata office**

**– Plotted and industrial plot sales**

**– Pre-leased and yielding assets**

**– A land strategy**

**– Private credit**

**– Data centres and senior living**

**– In time, listed or pooled vehicle formats including InvIT and REIT structures**

**Multiple product lines, one channel.**
That is why this is a business-building job rather than a fundraising job. An empanelment won once should carry every strategy behind it. A network built around a single product is rebuilt every launch, and that is how platforms lose years.

The intended route is a seeded AIF alongside deal-by-deal co-investment through CIV, co-investment PMS and other structures, subject to approvals. Seeded is the point: the operator puts assets in place before a fund launches, so much of the pipeline is de-risked on day one and no blind pool is raised. Two sales in one: a fund commitment into a visible pipeline, and larger co-investment tickets into named assets.

**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**

Own the mandate end to end — the strategy, the channel architecture, the team, the investor franchise and the number. The single point of accountability for whether the first strategy closes on size and on time, and whether the ones behind it find a channel waiting.

A builder's seat, and not a cold start. The platform brings an existing investor base, anchor commitments in place, and a founder known in the channel from two prior funds. The channel will take the meeting. What does not yet exist is the franchise: the empanelments, the certified RMs, the four zonal networks. If you have only ever run an established distribution machine, this is not your seat.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

– The national channel strategy across national and regional distributors, IFAs and MFDs, DSAs, RIAs, family offices and wealth platforms, split by channel, zone and quarter.

– The national empanelments, opened and closed personally. Empanel the platform, not a single product, so the next strategy does not restart the cycle. Every communication and figure approved before it leaves the building.

– The second tier, built early. Regional wealth firms, multi-family offices and large IFAs convert faster and often carry a first raise while the large platforms sit in committee.

– The commercial construct, with the CIO: ticket, class structure, hurdle, distribution economics, co-investment routes. If a term will not sell in the channel, say so before the product committee does.

– The team. Four zonal heads for North, South, East and West, and the organisation beneath them, with targets, cadence and attribution rules set before anyone joins. Stay in the field yourself.

– The investor narrative — why Vantrock, why real assets, why an operator-manager, why now — with anchor and family-office conversations led personally.

– Investor relations after the close: reporting quality, capital-account transparency, the investor day, and the conversation when something goes wrong.

**THIS IS A FRONT-FACING SEAT**

You are the platform's voice in the channel. Accompany distributors and their RMs to their clients and pitch the fund yourself, co-selling beside the partner. Tell the story so an RM can repeat it under pressure. Host investor evenings, partner meets and site visits, speak where the channel meets the asset class, and be a named voice of the platform on LinkedIn.

Approved material only. Nothing bespoke, nothing verbal-only, no return promises, ever.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

Essential

– 15+ years in financial services, at least eight leading alternatives, PMS or fund distribution on the manufacturer's side — an AMC, alternatives manager or fund house. B2B throughout, never to your own clients.

– Third-party capital raised through the channel across at least two launches, named by product and vintage, and stated as capital drawn rather than assets influenced.

– A national empanelment record: products taken through the committees of multiple national distributors or large wealth platforms, and you can name who signed off.

– Led a distributed team of four or more senior people who each carried a number, across more than one zone.

– Product-head-level relationships at the national distributors and at least three top-ten wealth platforms.

– You have built a channel, not only run one. At least one product taken into the market from scratch, without inherited empanelments.

Advantageous

– A real assets fund background. Not mandatory: a strong alternatives distribution leader from equity, credit or PMS is often the superior hire, because channel leadership is harder to teach than an asset class.

– More than one product line carried through the same network; co-investment tickets sold alongside a fund; an AMC alternates or PMS desk; institutional and family-office coverage.

What this role is not

A B2B distribution leadership seat, not a private-wealth seat. If your career has been advising your own HNI clients, this is the wrong role. Not a single-product seat, and not one run from a desk in Mumbai.

**COMPENSATION AND WEALTH CREATION**

Benchmarked against the upper quartile, then deliberately weighted from take-home to wealth creation. Four parts, offered as a mix: fixed; a fundraising incentive on the capital you personally bring in, with a team component on the platform's total raise; a share in the platform's additional returns on strategies you help close; and ESOPs. Numbers in the first conversation.

**Legal Disclaimer**

**Prepared for recruitment only. Not an offer of, or invitation to invest in, any fund, scheme, security or interest, and not marketing of any investment product. The product lines, structures and routes described are proposed and indicative, subject to change and to all necessary SEBI and other regulatory approvals. The track record above relates to the founder's prior roles at other organisations, is not the track record of Vantrock, and is not indicative of future results. No return is stated or implied, and none may be quoted in connection with this search.**

title: PPC Executive Amazon Ads and Flipkart Ads
description:
**About DigiBegin Consulting**

DigiBegin Consulting (DBC) is an Amazon-focused growth agency based in Thane, Mumbai, and an Amazon Ads Verified Partner.

We work with 20+ brands across India, US and UK. Our promise to clients is to scale their Amazon business without destroying their profits. We don’t run ads to inflate revenue. We scale selectively, only where the data shows a clear advantage.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an Amazon Ads PPC Executive to run daily Amazon Ads execution across 4–6 client accounts. Your job is to make sure every rupee of spend is tied to profitable sales and organic rank.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Campaign build and structure**

* Build Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns from approved keyword and ASIN research.
* Separate auto, broad, phrase, exact and product-targeting campaigns so every search term can be traced and controlled.
* Set up brand-defence, competitor-conquest and category campaigns.
* Maintain naming conventions, portfolios and budget caps as per the ads SOP.

**Daily and weekly optimisation**

* Check budget pacing, spend spikes and zero-sale spend every day.
* Adjust bids at keyword and placement level 2–3 times a week to hit target ACoS.
* Each week, cut back loss-making targets and move budget to proven converters.
* Log every change in the account change-log with the reason.

**Search term mining and keyword management**

* Mine search term reports weekly, moving converting terms into exact or phrase campaigns and negating irrelevant or non-converting ones.
* Compare keyword-level CVR against category CVR to find keywords where the brand can win.
* Find converting ASINs and build product-targeting campaigns against them.
* Maintain each client’s master keyword sheet, with keywords tagged by type.

**Organic rank support**

* Track organic and sponsored rank on priority keywords using Helium 10 and Brand Analytics.
* Run focused ranking pushes on selected generic keywords.
* Flag listing issues that hurt conversion, such as price, reviews, images, Buy Box or delivery promise.

**Excel, MIS reporting and coordination**

* Own the MIS for every assigned account, pulling Amazon Ads, Business Report and Helium 10 data into Excel / Google Sheets trackers.
* Maintain daily and weekly MIS sheets covering spend, sales, ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CVR, CPC and organic rank, at account, SKU and campaign level.
* Keep data clean and reconciled, with zero errors in client-facing numbers.
* Prepare monthly performance decks: what changed, why, and next month’s plan.
* Flag stock runway below 20 days before scaling any SKU.
* Join client calls when required and speak to your accounts’ numbers.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Up to 1 year of hands-on Amazon Ads experience (Seller Central or Vendor Central), through a job, internship or your own or family brand.
* Working experience of Helium 10 (Cerebro, Magnet, Keyword Tracker). This is mandatory.
* Clear grasp of ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CVR, CTR and CPC, and how they move together.
* Knowledge of match types, negative targeting, placement modifiers and bidding strategies.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets and MIS reporting skills: pivots, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS and conditional formatting.
* Comfortable using Amazon bulk sheets.
* Clear written English for reports and client updates.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Brand Analytics and Search Query Performance data.
* Exposure to US, UK or UAE marketplaces.
* Flipkart Ads experience.
* Amazon Ads certifications.

**This Role Is Not for You If**

* You judge success by spend or revenue alone, without looking at profit.
* You prefer to run auto campaigns and let Amazon optimise.
* You find a weekly change-log and a fixed review rhythm restrictive.
* If you are not comfortable at looking multiple number led dashboards

**Job Details**

* Location: Thane / Mumbai, hybrid (once a week in office)
* Experience: 0–1 year
* Employment: Full-time, 6-day week (Saturday 10 am to 2 pm)

**How to Apply**

* **Apply through LinkedIn, or email your CV to**
  hr@digibeginconsulting.com with the subject line “Application – Amazon Ads PPC Executive”.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer {Mumbai}
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 80% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 80% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!
  
  
*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*
