title: IT Operations Lead  - Hands on Technical Role (70% IC / 30% Team Management)
description:
**ABOUT US**

BDx Data Centers is an AI-ready digital infrastructure platform operating across Asia-Pacific, with data centers in Singapore, Indonesia, Hong Kong, and Taiwan, and new markets in development. We deliver the powered, cooled, and connected capacity customers need to scale AI, cloud, hyperscale, and enterprise workloads across the region.

Our platform brings together secured power access, high-density design, advanced cooling capabilities, interconnection, and local market execution to accelerate delivery from grid connection to live workload. With 1.2GVA+ of secured grid capacity and a platform spanning campuses, hyperscale facilities, colocation, and edge infrastructure, BDx is built to support the next generation of digital growth.

Backed by I Squared Capital, BDx is transformed for AI and proven at speed.

For more information, visit www.bdxworld.com

**Role Summary**

The Senior IT Operations Lead will provide technical leadership and operational ownership of the organization's internal IT infrastructure and OT technology environment supporting Data Center operations. This is a senior hands-on individual contributor role within a captive Data Center organization, responsible for the reliability, security, availability, governance, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of the organization's own technology environment.

**Please Note: This is 70% hands on technical (Individual Contributor ) and 30% team management role. Candidates with stroing hands on IT Infrastructure and Data Center Operations experience are encouraged to apply. Candidates with predominatly managerial experince need not apply.**

**Duties & Responsibilities**

**1. IT Infrastructure Operations & Reliability**

• Provide technical and operational leadership for the organization's enterprise IT infrastructure supporting corporate and Data Center operations.

• Ensure the availability, reliability, performance, and security of infrastructure operating on a 24x7x365 basis.

• Oversee networking, servers and compute, virtualization, storage, backup, firewalls, security infrastructure, wireless, telephony, collaboration systems, end-user computing, and monitoring platforms.

• Drive proactive monitoring, capacity planning, performance optimization, technology lifecycle management, and operational KPI tracking.

**2. OT Security & Data Center Technology Environment**

• Support and govern IT and OT security procedures relevant to Data Center operations.

• Work closely with Data Center Operations, Engineering, Security, Automation, and Technology teams to ensure appropriate protection and segregation of IT and OT environments.

• Develop and maintain procedures for secure access, privileged access, remote connectivity, patching, vulnerability management, and system hardening.

• Support security assessments, audits, vulnerability remediation, risk mitigation, incident response, and root cause analysis involving IT and OT-related systems.

**3. IT Service Management & Operational Governance**

• Lead and continuously improve Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Configuration, and Asset Management processes.

• Analyse recurring incidents and operational trends and implement preventive and corrective actions.

• Drive service reviews, KPI reporting, risk tracking, root cause analysis, and continual service improvement.

**4. Infrastructure Architecture & Technology Lifecycle**

• Participate in infrastructure reviews and assess the impact of new systems, technology changes, and infrastructure enhancements.

• Provide recommendations for scalability, resilience, security, operational supportability, and risk mitigation.

• Support infrastructure modernization including cloud, hybrid infrastructure, software-defined networking, automation, and Infrastructure-as-a-Service models.

**5. SDLC, Change & Release Governance**

• Demonstrate strong awareness of SDLC and its impact on infrastructure and production environments.

• Work with application, automation, engineering, and technology teams to ensure infrastructure readiness for development, testing, deployment, and production releases.

• Ensure appropriate testing, documentation, rollback plans, approvals, risk assessments, and operational readiness before production implementation.

**6. Information Security, Compliance & Documentation**

• Support compliance with ISO 27001 and ISO 20000 requirements and maintain relevant operational documentation and evidence.

• Maintain infrastructure standards, procedures, architecture diagrams, Configuration Items (CIs), CMDB records, and IT asset documentation.

• Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings and compliance actions.

**7. Security, Monitoring & Critical Incident Management**

• Provide technical oversight for routers, switches, Layer 2/3 networks, firewalls, IPS/IDS, VPN, WAN, Wi-Fi, and connectivity infrastructure.

• Improve monitoring coverage, alert quality, operational visibility, and proactive issue detection.

• Lead technical investigations for major incidents, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.

**8. Vendor & Internal Stakeholder Management**

• Manage technical relationships and escalations with infrastructure, security, telecommunications, and technology vendors.

• Partner with internal Data Center Operations, Engineering, Information Security, Automation, Applications, Corporate IT, Facilities, and business stakeholders.

• Communicate technical risks, operational performance, improvement initiatives, and infrastructure status to senior stakeholders.

**9. Individual Contributor Technical Leadership**

• Act as a senior technical owner and subject matter expert, leading through technical expertise, governance, influence, and operational ownership.

• Work independently on complex technical and operational issues and mentor engineers where required.

• This is primarily a hands-on senior individual contributor role and is not intended to be a traditional service delivery, customer account management, or managed services role.

**Qualification & Experience**

15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, infrastructure operations, or IT operations leadership.

• Experience supporting business-critical, highly available, 24x7x365 infrastructure environments.

• Strong experience operating internal enterprise or captive technology environments; experience should not be limited to external customer managed services delivery.

• Strong technical experience across enterprise networking, Layer 2/3 infrastructure, routers, switches, firewalls, WAN, VPN, Wi-Fi, servers, virtualization, monitoring, infrastructure security, backup, and configuration management.

• Strong experience in Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Root Cause Analysis, KPI reporting, trend analysis, and continual service improvement.

• Practical understanding of IT and OT security principles, access management, vulnerability remediation, patching, infrastructure hardening, and operational security procedures.

• Strong awareness of SDLC, production change governance, release management, testing, risk assessment, rollback planning, and operational readiness.

• Experience with monitoring platforms such as Zabbix, Nagios, SolarWinds, Cacti, or similar tools.

• Experience conducting infrastructure architecture reviews and developing mitigation plans for technical and operational risks.

• Strong vendor management, stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving, documentation, written, and verbal communication skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

• Experience working in a Data Center operator or other mission-critical infrastructure environment.

• Exposure to OT environments supporting critical infrastructure, including Data Center automation, BMS, DCIM, SCADA, or similar operational technologies.

• Knowledge of OT/ICS security principles and industrial cybersecurity practices.

• Experience with public cloud, hybrid cloud, software-defined networking, infrastructure automation, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, or DevSecOps practices.

• Experience with Zero Trust, SIEM, SOC, EDR, vulnerability management, or security monitoring platforms.

• Experience with disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

**Preferred Certifications**

• CCNP or equivalent Cisco certification.

• CISSP, CISM, or equivalent information security certification.

• ITIL certification.

• Microsoft infrastructure, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), OT/ICS security, or Six Sigma/process improvement certifications.

**At BDx, we believe that our success lies in the hands of our talented and dedicated employees. Together, we are shaping the future of the data center industry and making a positive impact on the world.**

title: Welding Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Transformative Humane HR Services LLP is a human resources solutions provider focused on connecting skilled professionals with organizations seeking specialized expertise. The company emphasizes ethical, people-centered practices and aims to create sustainable, long-term employment relationships. By partnering with industrial and engineering clients, Transformative Humane HR Services LLP supports workforce development and operational excellence. The organization values transparency, professional growth, and inclusive hiring practices that welcome diverse talent.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Welding Engineer role based in Padgha near Bhiwandi . The Welding Engineer will design and optimize welding processes, including laser and arc welding, to meet project specifications and production targets. Daily responsibilities include preparing welding procedures, selecting appropriate materials and techniques, supervising welding operations, and ensuring compliance with safety and quality standards. The role involves conducting welding inspections, analyzing defects, recommending corrective actions, and collaborating with production, quality, and maintenance teams to improve weld integrity and efficiency. The Welding Engineer will also maintain documentation, support continuous improvement initiatives, and contribute to training and guidance for welding personnel.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong expertise in welding processes, including Laser Welding and Arc Welding, with practical experience in industrial or manufacturing environments.
* Knowledge of Welding Inspection and Quality Control techniques to evaluate welds, identify defects, and ensure adherence to standards and specifications.
* Understanding of Metallurgy, including material properties, heat treatment effects, and weldability of metals and alloys.
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Welding Technology, or a related field.
* Familiarity with relevant welding codes and standards (such as ASME, AWS, or ISO) and basic knowledge of non-destructive testing methods.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings and welding symbols, with strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Effective communication and teamwork skills, with a focus on safety, continuous improvement, and on-site collaboration.
* Professional certifications in welding engineering or inspection (e.g., CSWIP, AWS CWI) are an advantage.

title: Vice President, Facilities Management
description:
**About This Role**
Reporting to the India Head of Enterprise Services, the Mumbai Site Lead owns the strategy, performance, and continuous improvement of the workplace experience across the location. The role translates enterprise, regional, and local priorities into high-value outcomes for employees and business stakeholders while maintaining clear accountability for service delivery, people, budget, vendors, risk, projects, and sustainability. The Site Lead also anticipates emerging needs, builds evidence-based business cases, and influences decisions that strengthen operational resilience and workplace effectiveness.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Workplace Strategy and Experience: Set and execute the Mumbai workplace strategy, aligning business requirements with global, regional, and local standards to deliver a safe, inclusive, efficient, and differentiated employee experience.
* Enterprise Partnership and Influence: Partner with business leaders and functional teams to prioritize needs, resolve issues at the right level, and influence timely decisions in a complex matrix organization.
* Team Leadership and Capability: Build and lead an inclusive, high-performing One BlackRock team comprising employees and outsourced partners, with clear goals, strong succession, disciplined performance management, and continuous capability development.
* Financial, Risk, and Compliance Ownership: Own annual planning, budget performance, forecasting, controls, and mitigation of operational, financial, regulatory, health and safety, business continuity, security, and reputational risks.
* Vendor and Commercial Performance: Govern strategic supplier relationships, contracts, scopes of work, service levels, key performance indicators, and business reviews to deliver quality, value, innovation, and timely remediation.
* Projects and Change Delivery: Sponsor and oversee local projects with the India Hub Lead and regional and global functions, ensuring robust governance, stakeholder readiness, delivery to scope, schedule, budget, and intended benefits.
* Sustainability and Continuous Improvement: Reduce the site’s environmental impact, advance enterprise sustainability commitments, and use data, feedback, and external insight to identify scalable improvements and build compelling business cases.

**Success Measures**

* Service delivery consistently meets or exceeds agreed SLAs, KPIs, employee experience targets, and stakeholder expectations.
* Operating and project expenditure is delivered within approved plans, supported by accurate forecasts, transparent trade-offs, and demonstrated value.
* Material risks, audit findings, incidents, and vendor underperformance are identified early, escalated appropriately, and remediated within agreed timelines.
* Projects achieve agreed scope, schedule, budget, adoption, and benefits, while sustainability initiatives show measurable improvement against site targets.

**Core Capabilities**

* Strategic and commercial leadership, including strong financial acumen and sound judgment across competing priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead diverse teams, influence senior stakeholders, and deliver outcomes through a matrix organization.
* Strong command of workplace operations, supplier governance, projects, leases, travel, health and safety, business continuity, and corporate security.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English, supported by high emotional intelligence, organization, and disciplined execution.
* Proficiency with integrated workplace management systems, data analysis, and financial modelling tools to support evidence-based decisions.

**Experience And Qualification**

* Minimum 10 -18 years of relevant industry experience, including at least two years with independent accountability for a complex site or comparable operation.
* Proven experience in client service, budget ownership, supplier management, risk and compliance, and cross-functional project delivery.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience required; facilities management, hospitality, real estate, or business education preferred.
* Facilities Management Professional certification, or an equivalent recognized credential, preferred.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

**About Us**
WHY LINEDATA ?
  
  
Join us in shaping the fintech of tomorrow.
  
  
With more than 1,350 colleagues across 20 locations worldwide, you'll help build cutting-edge platforms and tailored services that power the daily operations of 700 leading financial institutions. As a global, multicultural company with over 45 nationalities represented and just as many languages spoken, we thrive on diverse perspectives and collaboration. Together, we tackle future-focused topics like Al and the digitalization of finance, delivering smart solutions for our customers.
  
  
Whether you're just beginning your career or are an experienced professional, Linedata offers exposure to large-scale client projects, internal mobility and opportunities to develop your skills alongside leading experts.
  
  
**The Role**
You will join a team that directly caters to the front offices of global asset managers. As a Senior Associate in Linedataʼs Research team, you will work closely with Portfolio Managers and Senior Research Professionals. You will be responsible for providing fundamental research support to buy-side clients. The role spans across various aspects of investment research – initiating/maintaining analysis on the coverage universe, understanding macroeconomic and sectoral trends, tracking corporate events, reviewing the work of co-members, training and mentoring junior analysts, etc. You are also expected to proactively engage with different stakeholders to ensure informed and timely investment decision making by clients. You are required to take complete ownership of the deliverables and demonstrate utmost integrity and commitment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide investment research support to global asset managers investing in credit instruments
* Validate system-generated financial statements and models by testing data extraction accuracy, and ensuring outputs align with reporting and covenant requirements
* Carry out detailed capital structure and covenant analysis
* Review a wide range of financial documents, including but not limited to quarterly/annual reports, lender presentations, compliance certificates, agreements, prospectus, and ad-hoc disclosures to verify data integrity, and refine extraction rules
* Prepare earnings summaries, credit outlook, and writeups on investment pros and cons for companies under coverage
* Prioritize and execute multiple assignments with tight deadlines
* Ensure adherence to high quality standards and industry best practices

**Skills Required**

* Sound experience in credit research (2-5 years)
* Exposure to US/European capital markets
* Deep understanding of capital/corporate structure and various debt documents
* Experience in writing reports
* Strong excel modelling and analytical skills with attention to detail
* Ability to independently execute assignments under tight deadlines
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Team player with professional demeanour Advantageous Skills
* Knowledge of third-party databases such as Bloomberg, CapIQ, Thomson Reuters, etc.

**Academic Requirements**

* MBA or equivalent qualification in finance from a reputed institution / CFA

title: Senior Specialist, Endpoint Management Application Packaging
description:
SitusAMC is where the best and most passionate people come to transform our client’s businesses and their own careers. Whether you’re a real estate veteran, a passionate technologist, or looking to get your start, join us as we work together to realize opportunities for everyone, we proudly serve.
  
  
At SitusAMC, we are looking to match your unique experience with one of our amazing careers, so that we can help you realize your potential and career growth within the Real Estate Industry. If you are someone who can be yourself, advocate for others, stay nimble, dream big, own every outcome, and think global but act local – come join our team!
  
  
**Essential Job Functions**

* Lead the end-to-end application packaging lifecycle from requirements gathering through deployment, maintenance, and retirement.
* Create, customize, and maintain application packages using MSI, EXE, MSIX, PSAppDeployToolkit (PSADT), and other enterprise packaging tools.
* Package, test, and deploy software applications in modern endpoint management environments.
* Perform application compatibility testing across supported Windows operating systems, including Windows 10 and Windows 11.
* Develop and maintain packaging standards, technical documentation, and deployment procedures.
* Review vendor installation packages and recommend optimal deployment strategies.
* Conduct application assessments and validation testing for operating system upgrades and feature updates.
* Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot PowerShell scripts to automate application installation, configuration, remediation, and removal processes.
* Utilize PSAppDeployToolkit (PSADT) to create standardized deployment packages and improve the end-user installation experience.
* Develop custom detection, remediation, installation, and uninstallation scripts to support enterprise application deployments.
* Automate software lifecycle management activities and improve operational efficiency through scripting.
* Troubleshoot script execution failures and optimize deployment performance.
* Deploy and manage Win32 applications through Microsoft Intune.
* Design and implement application assignment strategies, deployment rings, dependencies, supersedence relationships, and targeting methodologies.
* Create and maintain detection rules, requirement rules, proactive remediations, and deployment policies.
* Troubleshoot Intune application deployment failures, policy conflicts, detection issues, and client-side problems.
* Analyze Intune logs, Endpoint Analytics, and Windows diagnostic data to identify and resolve deployment issues.
* Support Microsoft Autopilot, Microsoft Entra ID, and modern endpoint management initiatives.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting support for Windows 10 and Windows 11 endpoints.
* Investigate application installation issues, operating system behavior, registry settings, services, user profiles, and device configuration problems.
* Utilize Event Viewer, logging tools, PowerShell diagnostics, and endpoint management tools to perform root cause analysis.
* Support Windows feature updates, cumulative updates, and application validation activities.
* Maintain and implement endpoint configuration and security settings in accordance with company standards.
* Collaborate with Endpoint Management, Infrastructure, Information Security, and Service Desk teams to ensure compliance with organizational standards.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring software deployment and application-related incidents.
* Work directly with software vendors and internal technical teams to resolve complex issues.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures.
* Participate in Change Management, Incident Management, and Problem Management processes.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior team members on application packaging standards, deployment methodologies, and scripting best practices.
* Provide technical expertise in the analysis and resolution of complex production issues while ensuring service levels and system availability objectives are met.
* Participate in on-call support and escalation activities as required.
* Maintain familiarity with Microsoft security baselines, audit requirements, and endpoint security controls.
* Develop and maintain documentation required to support internal and external audit activities.
* Monitor vendor portals, technical advisories, and release communications for software updates, patches, vulnerabilities, and lifecycle announcements.
* Partner with Information Security teams to ensure packaged applications comply with organizational security standards and regulatory requirements.
* Other activities as may be assigned by your manager

**Qualifications/ Requirements**

* Associate’s degree in related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Experienced support staff with 5+ years of relevant experience.
* 5+ years of experience in Enterprise Application Packaging and Deployment.
* Strong hands-on experience with:



* Microsoft Intune
* PowerShell Scripting
* PSAppDeployToolkit (PSADT)
* MSI, EXE, and MSIX Packaging
* Win32 Application Deployment
* Application Detection and Remediation Methods
* Advanced knowledge of Windows 10 and Windows 11 administration.
* Experience troubleshooting enterprise application deployment and endpoint management issues.
* Strong understanding of application lifecycle management and software deployment best practices.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with Microsoft Endpoint Manager / Intune.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Windows Autopilot.
* Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* Experience with Windows Autopatch.
* Familiarity with Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and Windows 365 Cloud PC environments.
* Experience with software asset management, inventory management, and license compliance.
* Knowledge of endpoint security controls, application control technologies, and endpoint hardening practices.
* Experience supporting enterprise environments with 1,000+ endpoints.
* Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to research and resolve a wide variety of endpoint and application-related technical issues.
* Ability to learn new technologies quickly and adapt to changing business requirements.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Exceptional customer service and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.
* Flexibility to work outside normal business hours, including evenings, weekends, and occasional overtime, as business needs require.
* Demonstrated reliability, professionalism, strong attendance, and a collaborative team-oriented mindset.

**Note: This job description is not intended to be all inclusive or exclusive. At any time, employees may perform other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the organization and participate in additional trainings. title: Digital Campaign Management – Senior Associate/Team Lead - Mumbai - GO/JC/4496/2026
description:
**Job Title:**
Digital Campaign Management – Senior Associate/Team Lead
  
  
**Job Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**Work Model:**
Work from Office
  
  
**Candidate Industry**
: (BPO / KPO / GBS / GCC / GSS / Captive Shared Services)

: Anywhere in India
  
  
**Education and Certification**
**Qualification:**
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Digital Media, Communications, Business, or a related field
**.**
**Detailed Job Description**
Total work experience of 2 to 8 Years. Minimum 2+ years of relevant experience in Digital Ad Campaign r with strong hands-on expertise in geofencing, location-based advertising, and programmatic campaign execution.
  
  
Hands-on experience setting up and managing geofencing, location-based targeting, mobile advertising, retargeting, and programmatic campaigns.
  
  
Hands-on experience with DSPs and geofencing platforms such as Simpli.fi, GroundTruth, StackAdapt, Basis, The Trade Desk, DV360, or similar platforms.
  
  
Strong understanding of programmatic advertising, mobile display, video, CTV/OTT, audience targeting, retargeting, attribution, and conversion tracking.
  
  
Proficiency in Excel and reporting dashboards, with the ability to analyze campaign data and derive actionable insights.
  
  
Familiarity with analytics and measurement tools such as Google Analytics, campaign dashboards, ad servers, pixel tracking, and third-party attribution platforms.
  
  
**Role Key Responsibilities**
Campaign Strategy, Setup and Execution:
  
  
**Geofencing Campaign Setup**

* Create and manage geofencing campaigns using polygon, radius, address-based, and location-specific targeting methods.
* Build targeting strategies for competitor location targeting, event-based targeting, store-visit campaigns, and hyperlocal audience reach.
* Configure audience segments, location rules, frequency caps, budgets, pacing, and campaign parameters within DSP platforms.

**Campaign Trafficking And QA**

* Traffic digital creatives across display, mobile, video, native, and CTV/OTT channels, ensuring correct specifications, tags, landing pages, and tracking are implemented.
* Perform quality checks on campaign setup, geo boundaries, audience rules, conversion pixels, click trackers, and third-party tags before launch.

**Quality Assurance**

* Monitor live campaigns to ensure impressions, clicks, conversions, footfall attribution, and delivery volumes are tracking as expected.
* Identify and resolve campaign delivery issues related to under-pacing, over-pacing, geo leakage, low CTR, tag errors, creative rejection, or attribution gaps.

- Continuously optimize campaigns based on KPIs such as impressions, CTR, CPM, CPC, CPA, conversions, footfall, store visits, and ROAS.
- Recommend changes to bids, budgets, geographies, audience segments, creatives, frequency caps, and inventory sources to improve campaign performance.
- Audience and Location Strategy:

* Develop audience strategies using location history, demographic overlays, behavioral segments, CRM audiences, retargeting pools, and lookalike audiences.
* Support campaign planning for local businesses, retail, automotive, healthcare, real estate, events, and other location-sensitive advertisers.
* Compliance and Data Privacy:

+ Ensure campaigns follow applicable data privacy, consent, location-data usage, platform, and brand-safety guidelines.
+ Maintain awareness of evolving digital advertising policies, privacy regulations, and industry best practices related to location-based marketing.

**Reporting And Insights**

* Prepare campaign performance reports covering delivery, engagement, conversion, attribution, footfall, pacing, and optimization actions.
* Analyze performance trends and provide actionable recommendations to improve campaign ROI and future targeting strategies.
* Communicate insights clearly to internal stakeholders, account teams, sales teams, and clients.

**Key Skills:**
Digital advertising, campaign management, programmatic media buying, performance marketing.

title: Content Strategist Intern
description:
**About Shahi Serve**
Shahi Serve is an Indian heritage food brand, bringing the heritage of Indian food and royal Indian cuisine into an accessible ready-to-eat format, with no preservatives. We're India's first gourmet non-veg ready-to-eat brand. We started with Awadhi cuisine, and more ranges are on the way. We want an intern who'll help India stop scrolling for it, and stay on if they do.
  
  
**The internship**
Three months inside our Meta ads engine. You'll design, shoot and cut real ads that go live with real budgets from week one. No coffee runs, no dummy briefs.
  
  
**What you'll do**
• Execute 2+ new ad concepts every week, from idea to live ad, across statics, carousels and Reels
  
• Design performance creatives in our identity: loud, legible, on-brand
  
• Cut Reels and UGC-style edits: the hook in two seconds, captions, pace
  
• Shoot basic product content on a phone: the sear, the steam, the pour, the plate
  
• Learn to read Meta Ads Manager (hook rate, CTR, CPA) and see what works, and why
  
• Keep a swipe file: mine the Ad Library, comments and customer calls for new angles
  
  
**You'll fit if**
• You're a final-year student or a recent grad. Design, film, mass media or none at all: your portfolio decides.
  
• You can design in Canva or Figma, and edit in CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar
  
• You make things for fun: a meme page, a food account, college fest posters. Show us.
  
• You think in hooks, and write sharp lines in English and Hinglish
  
• You learn fast, take feedback without flinching, and ship anyway
  
  
**Hit the ground running**
• Week 1: Understand all of our recipes, study our live ads, and get your first 2 concepts executed and live
  
• Month 1: 3+ concepts executed every week, and your first Reel shot and cut by you
  
• Month 3: PPO review. Your live ads and their numbers make the case.
  
  
**What you get**
• A pre-placement offer: hit the bar and you join full-time as our Creative Strategist, with no second interview round
  
• A portfolio of live ads with real results, not mock briefs
  
• Mentorship from the founders, with weekly feedback and no layers
  
• An internship certificate and a letter of recommendation
  
• A taste of every R&D batch, straight from Chef Yusuf's kitchen
  
  
**How to apply**
Apply here on Linkedin or mail your resume and portfolio (college or personal work counts) to raghav@shahiserve.com
  
Subject line: Creative Strategist Intern — [Your name]
  
Add one ad idea for our Chicken Shami Kebab. A line or a rough sketch is enough. If you're shortlisted, a short task follows.
  
  
**Skills**
: Performance Creative · Meta Ads · Graphic Design · Video Editing · Reels · UGC · Canva · Figma · CapCut · Premiere Pro · Copywriting · Content Creation

title: Creative Copywriter
description:
**About The Company**
Global University Systems (GUS) is one of the world’s most dynamic, inclusive, and diverse education organisations. GUS is an international network of higher education institutions, brought together by a shared passion for accessible and industry-relevant qualifications. We deliver a wide variety of programmes, including bachelor’s degree programmes, master’s degree programmes, professional training, English Language training, and corporate & executive education. When someone chooses to study at one of our institutions, whether on campus in Europe, North America, Asia or even in their own home, they are joining a network of over 100,000 students worldwide. When you decide to work with GUS, you will be joining an industry leading, global organisation that has a reach in over 150 different countries.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Are you a gifted wordsmith with a knack for transforming ideas into compelling stories that engage audiences and drive action? As a Creative Copywriter at GUS, you will leverage innovative writing techniques and digital tools to captivate our prospective students and meet our organizational goals. We're looking for creative individuals with a passion for excellence and a drive for results.
  
  
As a Creative Copywriter, you will contribute to GUS' worldwide content initiatives, harnessing the power of technology and digital platforms to create unique and engaging campaigns that resonate with our brand's ethos. Your work will span across various channels, including organic and paid social media, PPC, SEO and local marketing efforts, harmonizing these elements to build a best-in-class content portfolio.
  
  
To excel in this role, you should be an exceptional communicator with a proven ability to conceptualize and implement creative ideas. You should know when to apply technology to accelerate the writing process and when human creativity is essential to the process.
  
  
To be an ideal candidate, you will have had extensive experience producing powerful written content for multinational companies. You should be a natural team player who wants to contribute to a creative environment where everyone can produce their best work.
  
  
If you're a passionate communicator who is excited by the prospect of shaping the future narratives of our brands and making an impact on a global scale, we invite you to apply for this exhilarating opportunity.
  
  
**Key Activities And Responsibilities**
As a Creative Copywriter at GUS, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Developing compelling and creative copy for various organic and paid mediums, including social media, PPC, SEO, print and digital campaigns, and email journeys, while ensuring consistency in tone, style, and voice across all platforms and institutions.
* Utilizing technology and AI tools to enhance the copywriting process, while understanding when a human touch is necessary for the crafting of content.
* Working in alignment with the overall company's goals and marketing strategies, ensuring that your written content supports these objectives and helps to deliver the desired message to the targeted audience.
* Staying up to date on the latest trends in content and copywriting, implementing best practices in daily tasks and continuously seeking innovative ways to improve the quality and impact of written content.
* Working in coordination with the marketing teams to maintain a content calendar that aligns with the company's broader marketing and business goals.
* Ensuring all content and communication efforts take diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) into consideration.
* Contributing to content audits on a regular basis to assess the effectiveness of our copywriting efforts, providing useful recommendations for improvements based on key metrics and analysis.
* Assisting in managing relationships with GUS’ internal brand partners, ensuring clear, persuasive and effective copy is provided for all collaborative efforts.
* Maintaining a high level of quality control to ensure all produced copy aligns with brand guidelines and is free of errors.

**Essential**
**Qualifications and Education**

* Undergraduate level or equivalent work experience

**Desirable**

* Digital marketing qualification
* Writing qualification

**Experience**

* Significant (5+ years) experience in creative copywriting for multiple channels, including social media, PPC, SEO, content marketing and PR.
* Demonstrated experience (2+ years) in a team-oriented environment, with the ability to collaborate and contribute to team projects.
* Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to understand audience sentiment, analyse content performance and optimize copy based on performance data.
* An understanding of, and demonstrated interest in, emerging technologies that may impact copywriting including generative AI, automation tools, and data analytics.
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, while ensuring timely execution.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to effectively present ideas to internal stakeholders and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Proven experience working collaboratively with an international team.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think strategically and creatively to continually improve the company's content and copywriting strategy.
* Expertise in Microsoft Office, particularly Word and PowerPoint.
* Fluency in English with excellent writing and editing skills, with a strong grasp of grammar and style.
* Knowledge of AP Style or other major style guides is a plus.
* A portfolio of work that demonstrates your writing abilities and creative skills.
* A demonstrated passion for the educational space
* Experience with content-related tools and services including SEO tools (such as SEMRush, Ahrefs), social media management tools (such as Buffer, Hootsuite) and content management systems (such as WordPress).
* Experience in digital marketing including SEO, social media advertising and content marketing.

The post holder may be asked to undertake different or additional duties in line with business requirements at the request of their line manager. There is an expectation that all employees will maintain the values of the Group and will comply with the code of conduct as well as equality and diversity, health and safety and safeguarding policies.
  
  
**Other Information**
Please note this position is only available on our Consultancy agreement.
  
  
We acknowledge receipt of your resume for a position at Global University Systems and sincerely appreciate your interest in our company.
  
  
We will screen all applicant CVs and select the candidates whose qualifications and experience meet our requirements. Please note due to the high volume of applications we will only contact you if you are selected to continue for the next stage of the recruitment process. We wish you every success.
  
  
GUS is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, or religion or belief.

title: E-Commerce & Shopify Specialist
description:
**About Us**

Pivot Apparel Group is a multi-brand apparel company with offices in the US, India, and China. Our brands include Velvet by Graham & Spencer, a contemporary women’s brand based in Los Angeles, and Emily Daniels and Club 76, both direct-to-consumer brands.

**The Role**

We’re looking for an E-Commerce & Shopify Executive in our India office to help run our brand websites day to day. You’ll manage product uploads, site updates, imagery, and SEO across Velvet (US and EU), Emily Daniels, and Club 76, and you’ll help set up new brand sites as we grow. For Velvet, the focus is product and Shopify management. For our other brands, you’ll also work with our e-commerce and marketing teams on stock and inventory.

This is a hands-on role for someone early in their e-commerce career who wants to grow quickly across multiple brands. You’ll work closely with teams in India and the US.

**What You’ll Do**

*Product Uploads & Management*

* Upload new products to all brand sites, including titles, descriptions, images, sizes, colors, pricing, and tags.
* Use bulk upload tools (CSV or similar) to launch large drops accurately and on time.
* Keep existing listings current: update pricing, swap imagery, retire old products, and fix errors.
* Organize collections, filters, and navigation so customers can easily find products.
* Check every product before it goes live for correct images, copy, sizing, and variants.

*Website Updates*

* Update homepage banners, landing pages, collection pages, and other site content for launches, campaigns, and seasonal changes.
* Resize, crop, and optimize images to each site’s specs so pages load quickly and look consistent.
* Work with the creative and copy teams to get new imagery and copy live on schedule.
* Test pages on desktop and mobile after changes, and report and fix broken links, layout issues, or errors.

*Velvet: US and EU Sites*

* Manage both the US and EU Velvet Shopify stores.
* Keep product, imagery, and site content consistent between the two sites.
* Handle EU-specific details such as currency, pricing, sizing information, and market settings.

*SEO*

* Write and maintain SEO titles, meta descriptions, image alt text, and clean URLs for products, collections, and pages.
* Set up redirects when products or pages are removed.
* Track basic search performance (Google Search Console) and suggest improvements.

*Stock & Inventory (Emily Daniels, Club 76, and other Pivot brands)*

* Coordinate with the e-commerce and marketing teams on stock levels, restocks, and new arrivals.
* Keep online inventory accurate and in sync with available stock.
* Flag low-stock, sold-out, and slow-moving items to the team.

*New Websites*

* Help set up new brand Shopify stores, including theme setup, product loading, pages, and settings.
* Use the processes we’ve built on our existing sites to launch new ones quickly.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 1–3 years of hands-on Shopify experience, ideally with a fashion or apparel brand.
* Comfortable in Shopify admin: products, collections, themes, navigation, and apps.
* Experience with bulk product uploads (CSV, Matrixify, or similar).
* Basic knowledge of e-commerce SEO.
* Very detail-oriented with product data and imagery.
* Organized enough to manage several sites and deadlines at once.
* Clear written English, and comfortable working with US-based teams across time zones, including some overlap with US hours.

**Nice to Have**

* Basic image editing in Photoshop, Canva, or similar.
* Some familiarity with HTML/CSS or Shopify Liquid.
* Experience with Google Analytics or Search Console.
* Experience managing more than one Shopify store, or an international (EU) store.
* Comfortable using AI tools to speed up product copy, image work, or bulk tasks.

title: Senior PR & Brand Manager
description:
Senior PR & Brand Relations Manager

About Clotite

Clotite Private Limited is the backend team behind multiple D2C brands. We work across marketing, branding, technology and operations, helping build and scale brands across fashion, lifestyle and consumer categories.

We are building a team that doesn't just manage brands; we want to make them culturally relevant, visible and talked about.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior PR & Brand Relations Manager who can essentially function as an in-house PR agency for our portfolio of brands.

Your job is:

Get our brands into the right rooms, onto the right people, and into the right conversations.

From getting a fashion brand worn by a celebrity, to securing an editorial feature, arranging an influencer placement, negotiating a shoot, planning a launch event or creating an entire PR strategy, you should know how to make it happen.

What You'll Own

Media & Editorial PR

•⁠ ⁠Build relationships with journalists, editors, publications and digital media.

•⁠ ⁠Secure features, interviews, product mentions, editorials and press coverage.

•⁠ ⁠Handle press releases, media kits, story pitches and brand announcements.

•⁠ ⁠Build PR calendars and strategies around launches, collections, campaigns and cultural moments.

Celebrity & Stylist Relations

•⁠ ⁠Build and maintain relationships with celebrity stylists, managers, publicists and talent agencies.

•⁠ ⁠Secure celebrity dressing, product placements, appearances, shoots and gifting opportunities.

•⁠ ⁠Coordinate samples, fittings, dispatches, returns and placement logistics.

Influencers & Creators

•⁠ ⁠Identify the right creators for each brand.

•⁠ ⁠Manage influencer seeding, gifting, barter and paid collaborations.

•⁠ ⁠Negotiate commercials and deliverables.

•⁠ ⁠Build long-term relationships rather than treating every collaboration as a one-off transaction.

Events, Launches & Experiences

•⁠ ⁠Plan PR around product launches, store openings, previews, pop-ups, fashion events and brand activations.

•⁠ ⁠Curate media, celebrity and influencer guest lists.

•⁠ ⁠Identify sponsorships, partnerships and opportunities where our brands should be present.

Collaborations & Opportunities

•⁠ ⁠Build relationships with other brands, designers, photographers, stylists, production houses, agencies and industry professionals.

•⁠ ⁠Find interesting brand collaborations, cultural partnerships and cross-promotional opportunities.

•⁠ ⁠Source and negotiate photographers, models, stylists, locations, production teams and other requirements for PR-led shoots and campaigns.

Reputation & Brand Visibility

•⁠ ⁠Understand how each brand should be perceived publicly.

•⁠ ⁠Build founder and brand profiles where relevant.

•⁠ ⁠Monitor conversations and coverage around our brands.

•⁠ ⁠Help manage sensitive communication or reputation issues when required.

What We're Looking For

Ideally, you have 3–5+ years of experience in PR, preferably within fashion, luxury, lifestyle, beauty, entertainment or consumer brands.

More importantly, we want someone who already understands the ecosystem.

You should have strong working relationships, or know how to quickly build them, with:

Journalists. Editors. Stylists. Influencers. Talent managers. Celebrity teams. Publications. Event organisers. Production houses. Photographers. Agencies.

You should be someone who can pick up the phone, make things happen, negotiate intelligently and find opportunities that aren't sitting in someone's inbox waiting to be discovered.

Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills are essential.

The Exciting Part

You won't be handling PR for one brand.

You'll work across a growing portfolio of D2C brands, giving you the opportunity to build completely different PR strategies across fashion, lifestyle and consumer categories.

We are looking for someone who enjoys connections, culture, fashion, media and people, and wants the freedom to build an entire PR ecosystem from the inside.

If your instinct when you see a brand is immediately, “I know exactly who should be talking about this,” we should probably meet.

title: YouTube Lead (AI Search)
description:
Pepper helps brands win organic search, AI search, and every organic channel that drives growth. YouTube is one of the most powerful and underused: it's the world's second-largest search engine, its videos compound for years, and it increasingly feeds both Google and AI-driven discovery.

We're looking for a
**YouTube Lead**
to own this channel for our customers — turning video into a durable engine for visibility, trust, and demand.

If you understand how YouTube actually grows channels and want to do it for ambitious brands, this one's for you.

About the role

As YouTube Lead, you'll own YouTube strategy and execution across a set of customer accounts, working inside our Organic Growth pods. You'll shape what each brand publishes, how it's packaged, and how the channel grows over time. You'll have playbooks, AI workflows, and a strong team behind you.

What you'll do

* Own each customer's YouTube strategy: positioning, content pillars, formats, and cadence
* Turn topics into video concepts that earn both search and suggested-feed discovery
* Drive strong packaging — titles, thumbnails, hooks, and retention — because that's what decides whether a video wins
* Build briefs and direction the production team and creators can execute on
* Grow channels deliberately: search-led evergreen video plus content built to be recommended
* Repurpose video into clips and other formats so each piece works harder across channels
* Track performance (impressions, CTR, retention, watch time, subscribers) and report it clearly

Go deep on how YouTube actually grows

This is the heart of the role:

* Understand the two engines of YouTube discovery — search and suggested — and how to win each
* Know what drives the algorithm: click-through rate, retention, and satisfaction, and how to design for them
* Build evergreen, search-led video that compounds, alongside content engineered to be recommended
* Understand how YouTube feeds Google results and AI-driven discovery, and use that to extend reach
* Have a real point of view on packaging and storytelling, not just keywords

What you'll bring

* Hands-on YouTube experience — you've grown a channel or run YouTube content and understand why videos win or stall
* A confident grasp of YouTube SEO, packaging, and retention
* An understanding of how YouTube connects to broader search and AI discovery
* Strong creative judgment plus comfort with data
* An ownership mindset and comfort working across a few accounts
* Comfort using AI tools to work faster — we'll help you level up

Nice to have

* A track record of growing a YouTube channel (your own or a brand's)
* Experience with scripting, editing direction, or video production workflows
* A background in organic growth, content, or video marketing

Why you'll love it here

* You'll own a channel with massive, compounding upside for our customers
* Real support: onboarding, playbooks, AI workflows, and a strong pod around you
* A focused book of accounts so you can go deep, not spread thin
* Room to grow as we scale the team

description:
**Lead – Digital Growth Marketing (SEM / Performance)**
*Pepper Content · Full-time · Mumbai (US Hours)*

**About the Role**

We're hiring a Lead – Digital Growth Marketing to
**own SEM and performance marketing**
for our US business — Pepper's largest and fastest-growing market. You'll run a multi-million-dollar paid budget across Google, Bing, Meta, LinkedIn, and YouTube, and you'll be measured on one number:
**qualified pipeline at efficient CAC**
.

This is a hands-on, P&L-style role. You'll set the channel mix, build the bidding and creative strategy, run the experimentation engine, and deploy AI-led automation to extract every dollar of efficiency. SEO and GEO sit under your remit as compounding levers that lower your blended CAC — but the core job is paid: own the auction, own the funnel, own the number.

This role is for someone who has run 7-figure paid budgets, can audit a Google Ads account in 30 minutes, and gets restless when CPLs creep up by 5%.

**Location & Hours**

Base location: Mumbai (in-office).

Working hours:
**5:00 PM – 2:30 AM IST**
, aligned to US business hours, Monday–Friday.

This role partners daily with US stakeholders and the US growth/marketing team. The shift is non-negotiable — please apply only if you're committed to the US schedule.

**What You'll Own**

*SEM & Paid Search (Primary)*

Own Google Ads and Bing end-to-end — campaign architecture, keyword strategy, match-type discipline, bidding (manual + Smart Bidding), Quality Score, ad copy, sitelinks, audience layering, and negative keyword hygiene.

Drive
**CPL and CAC efficiency**
quarter-over-quarter through structured experimentation: bid strategy tests, ad copy iteration, landing page A/B tests, audience exclusions, and dayparting.

Build
**AI-driven SEM workflows**
— search intent classification, automated negative keyword harvesting, bid optimization, ad copy generation, and anomaly detection — using tools like SEMrush, Gumloop, n8n, Optmyzr, or custom GPT-based pipelines. Replace hours of manual work with automation.

Own SEM landing page strategy in partnership with Web Engineering and Content. Ship dedicated, conversion-optimized LPs (not generic homepage drops) for every major campaign cluster.

Run rigorous SEM forecasting and budget allocation: weekly pacing, channel-level ROAS, marginal CAC analysis, and incremental budget cases for leadership.

*Paid Social & Performance Channels*

Own Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, and emerging paid channels for US demand gen. Drive MQLs, demos, and pipeline at target CPA.

Build full-funnel paid social: prospecting, retargeting, lookalikes, abandoned-funnel sequences, and creative-led campaigns (e.g., Meta DM campaigns with incentives, LinkedIn Document Ads, YouTube demand gen).

Own creative strategy with the brand/design team — brief, test, iterate. You don't just run media; you drive what gets made.

Build paid attribution and incrementality testing — geo holdouts, conversion lift studies, MMM inputs — to know what's actually working vs. what looks good in last-click.

description:

VIL is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversifying its workforce.
  
  
**Role**
**Category Lead – Financial services and payments**
**Job Level / Designation**
General Manager / Band M3
  
  
**Function / Department**
Digital – Partnerships & Growth
  
  
**Location**
Corporate Office, Mumbai
  
  
**Context for the new role**
Vi Finance is a strategic growth agenda to bring relevant financial propositions for Vi’s captive customer base. The business will operate through a partnership-led model, bringing credible banks, NBFCs and fintechs onto the Vi platform across lending, cards, deposits and payments. Personal Loans will be the anchor portfolio within the broader Vi Finance proposition.
  
  
The immediate priority is to establish a high-quality, compliant multi-lender Personal Loan proposition: identify and onboard credible lending partners, define the right operating and commercial model, build seamless customer journeys, launch the go-to-market, and scale disbursals profitably. The role therefore requires a techno-commercial leader who can combine lender partnerships, product and platform execution, funnel analytics, regulatory governance and P&L ownership.
  
  
**Proposal**
We propose to appoint a Category Lead – Vi Finance to build and scale the Financial Services & Payments business, with Personal Loans as the primary growth portfolio.
  
  
The incumbent will first create a credible lender network and take partners from evaluation to launch readiness across commercials, contracting, API integration, information security, compliance and operating SLAs. Thereafter, the individual will define and execute the GTM, optimise the end-to-end funnel, expand distribution across Vi channels, build new platform capabilities, and scale disbursals and revenue while maintaining portfolio quality and sustainable unit economics.
  
  
The role will continuously benchmark Vi Finance against best-in-class lending and fintech platforms, translate market insights into a prioritised capability roadmap, and deliver customer adoption, conversion, disbursals, incremental revenue, partner productivity and customer experience in line with the annual operating plan.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
**Build and scale Vi Finance as a trusted, partnership-led financial-services platform, with primary ownership of Personal Loans. Create a differentiated multi-lender proposition, deliver a seamless customer experience, and drive profitable growth in adoption, disbursals and revenue.**
**Key Result Areas / Accountabilities**
**Product and Growth**

* Own the end-to-end vision, business plan and roadmap for Vi Finance, with Personal Loans as the principal focus alongside Credit Cards, Fixed Deposits, Payments and adjacent propositions.
* Build a scalable multi-lender Personal Loan platform by defining lender-selection criteria and onboarding credible banks and NBFCs and work across commercials, legal agreements, APIs, Design team, information security, compliance, etc. to define SLAs and create launch readiness.
* Design and execute the GTM across Vi digital assets, partner with CVM, retail & mass retail distribution and appoint channel partner; establish the proposition, segmentation, communication, offer architecture and acquisition playbook.
* Own the complete lending funnel from eligibility and pre-qualified leads through application, approval and disbursal; use funnel, cohort and lender-level analytics to improve conversion, approval rates and lead quality.
* Manage lender mix, commercials, CAC, unit economics and portfolio P&L to balance customer scale, partner productivity, portfolio health and profitability.
* Benchmark leading fintech and lending platforms, identify customer-experience and technology gaps, and prioritize capabilities such as multi-lender routing, straight-through processing, decisioning, experimentation, reporting and partner governance.
* Lead zero-to-one launches and subsequent scale-up of adjacent financial-services and payment categories in line with the portfolio strategy.

**New Partnerships & Business Development**
Develop and manage a high-quality ecosystem of banks, NBFCs, fintechs and payment partners. Create a structured partner-evaluation framework covering customer fit, scale, approval and fulfilment capability, economics, technology readiness, data security and regulatory compliance. Negotiate commercials and contracts, establish partner governance and performance scorecards, resolve integration and operating dependencies, give visibility to leadership team, keep evolving the finance business roadmap and maintain a pipeline of prospective partners to strengthen proposition breadth and resilience.
  
  
**Other Tasks**

* Translate the business blueprint into prioritized customer journeys, platform requirements and a sequenced delivery roadmap.
* Lead cross-functional execution with Product, Technology, Analytics, CVM, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, InfoSec, Finance, Customer Service and Retail teams.
* Create points of ingress across Vi App, web, CVM, prepaid and postpaid journeys, generate top of the funnel from the retail touchpoints and partner ecosystems.
* Plan and run performance campaigns, experiments and tailored offers to drive qualified traffic, application starts, approvals and disbursals.
* Establish daily and monthly MIS covering funnel conversion, lender performance, customer cohorts, CAC, revenue, unit economics, SLA adherence and customer experience.
* Institute compliance-by-design and operating governance in line with applicable RBI digital-lending requirements, data-privacy standards and Vi policies.
* Review performance, identify bottlenecks and lead course corrections with partners and internal teams to deliver the annual operating plan.
* Provide leadership with market intelligence, competitor benchmarks, forward-looking risks and recommendations for the next phase of growth.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Personal Loans: active lender count, lead volumes, application-to-disbursal conversion, approval rate, monthly disbursals and revenue.
* Economics: CAC, revenue per disbursal, contribution margin, partner payouts and portfolio P&L.
* Execution: time to onboard and launch partners, API and journey delivery milestones, SLA adherence and funnel improvements.
* Customer: adoption, repeat engagement, journey completion, complaint rate and NPS.
* Broader portfolio: customers, transactions, GMV and revenue across Cards, Deposits and Payments.

**Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience**
Demonstrated experience in digital lending, preferably building or scaling a multi-lender LSP or marketplace model. Strong lender-partnership and business-development capability across banks and NBFCs, including commercial negotiation, contracting, API integrations, InfoSec, compliance and operating governance. Deep understanding of Personal Loan funnels, credit journeys, customer segmentation, cohort analytics, CAC/LTV, unit economics and P&L. Working knowledge of RBI Digital Lending Guidelines, data privacy and partner-risk management. Proven ability to lead zero-to-one launches, scale GTM across large consumer ecosystems, benchmark best-in-class practices and influence senior stakeholders while leading large cross-functional teams.
  
  
Preferred profile: 7–12 years across fintech, banks, NBFCs or large digital ecosystems, with meaningful ownership of Personal Loans, lender partnerships, digital product or platform delivery, analytics-led growth and business planning.
  
  
**Must Have Technical / Professional Qualifications**
MBA preferred
  
  
**Years Of Experience**
07-12 years
  
  
**Industries to look from**
Financial services, Fintech, NBFC & Banks
  
  
**Ideal Organizations to look from**
Paytm, PhonePe, Gpay, TataNeu, Airtel Finance etc.
  
  
**Team Size**
Individual contributor
  
  
**Business Size**
INR 100 Cr+ revenue
  
  
**Vodafone Idea Limited**
(formerly Idea Cellular Limited)
