title: Entrepreneur in Residence
description:
Pepper (
https://www.pepper.inc/
) is an AI-native marketing services company redefining how enterprise brands scale organic growth through a unified blend of strategy, creative talent, technology, and automation. We are building an AI-powered marketing services engine that seamlessly combines top global creative talent with proprietary workflows and automation to deliver measurable, scalable outcomes for modern CMOs.

Our platform and services bring together content, data, talent, and AI to help brands plan, create, manage, distribute, and measure high-impact marketing programs and all on one intelligent system designed for enterprise growth and efficiency.

**Role Overview**

We're hiring an Entrepreneur in Residence (EIR) into the Founder's Office at Pepper

.

This is not a strategy seat. It's an operating seat.

We're looking for someone who has already carried the weight of a business. A founder who built and ran something, or an operator who has owned Ops, Strategy, or Customer Success end-to-end and been accountable for the number at the bottom. You'll work alongside the Founder/CEO and the central Centre of Excellence (COE) team, and you'll be handed the problems that matter most and are least defined: a business line that needs to be rebuilt, a function that needs an owner, a market that needs to be cracked, a manual process that needs to become an AI-first one.

You won't be given a playbook. You'll be expected to write one, run it, prove it works, and then hand it to someone else so you can go take the next thing.

Base location: Mumbai (in-office)

Shift: 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM IST

**What You'll Own**

* Take a business problem from zero to working. You'll be handed ambiguous, high-stakes mandates, a new revenue line, a broken unit economic, an underperforming segment, a market entry and own them outright. Diagnosis, plan, build, launch, iterate, results.
* **Run functions that don't have an owner yet.**
  Where something is founder-led, ad-hoc, or held together by heroics, you step in as interim owner: build the team, the process, and the metrics, stabilise it, then hand it over.
* **Rebuild how work gets done with AI.**
  Identify the highest-leverage workflows across Ops, CS, Delivery and GTM, and rebuild them AI-first. Partner with product and engineering to ship, then hold yourself to measurable impact on cost, speed, margin, and quality.
* **Own customer outcomes where it counts.**
  Get into live accounts — especially US enterprise — understand why customers stay or churn, fix retention and expansion mechanics at the root, and turn what you learn into product and process.
* **Build the operating layer.**
  Definitions, dashboards, reviews, and cadences that make performance legible. If the Founder can't see what's working within 24 hours of asking, that's your problem to fix.
* **Be a genuine second pair of hands for the Founder.**
  Diligence, fundraising material, pricing experiments, partnership evaluation, board prep, escalations — whatever the quarter demands.
* **Build the bench.**
  Hire, coach, and hand off. Success in this role is measured partly by how many things you've made someone else's job.

**What We're Looking For**

* **6–10 years of experience, with at least one of the following as your core story:**
* **You founded and ran a company.**
  You raised or bootstrapped, hired, sold, shipped, and made payroll. Whether it exited, scaled, or shut down matters less than what you carried and what you learned.
* **You've owned Ops, Strategy, or Customer Success at a high-growth company.**
  A real function with a team, a budget, and a number you were held to. Not a supporting role in one
* Full-stack operating range. You can build the model, write the deck, sit in the QBR, debug the process, and get on the phone with an unhappy customer all in the same day. No task is beneath you and no problem is above you.
* Comfort with ambiguity that would paralyse most people. You're handed a sentence, not a brief. You come back with a plan.
* Commercial instinct. You think in margin, CAC, retention, and payback and not just activity and output.
* A real point of view on AI. You use LLMs, agents, and automation platforms daily, and you have an argument about how they change the shape of a services and marketplace business. Bonus if you've actually deployed AI into production workflows and can talk about what broke.
* Bias for shipping. A working v1 beats a perfect plan. You'd rather be corrected by the market than by a meeting.
* Sharp, structured communication. You can write a one-pager the board reads without questions, and a brief a frontline team can execute without a follow-up call.
* High ownership, low ego. You chase the hundredth detail without losing the plot, and you don't need credit to do the work.
* Prior exposure to US customers or teams is a strong plus.

title: Senior PR & Brand Manager
description:
Senior PR & Brand Relations Manager

About Clotite

Clotite Private Limited is the backend team behind multiple D2C brands. We work across marketing, branding, technology and operations, helping build and scale brands across fashion, lifestyle and consumer categories.

We are building a team that doesn't just manage brands; we want to make them culturally relevant, visible and talked about.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior PR & Brand Relations Manager who can essentially function as an in-house PR agency for our portfolio of brands.

Your job is:

Get our brands into the right rooms, onto the right people, and into the right conversations.

From getting a fashion brand worn by a celebrity, to securing an editorial feature, arranging an influencer placement, negotiating a shoot, planning a launch event or creating an entire PR strategy, you should know how to make it happen.

What You'll Own

Media & Editorial PR

•⁠ ⁠Build relationships with journalists, editors, publications and digital media.

•⁠ ⁠Secure features, interviews, product mentions, editorials and press coverage.

•⁠ ⁠Handle press releases, media kits, story pitches and brand announcements.

•⁠ ⁠Build PR calendars and strategies around launches, collections, campaigns and cultural moments.

Celebrity & Stylist Relations

•⁠ ⁠Build and maintain relationships with celebrity stylists, managers, publicists and talent agencies.

•⁠ ⁠Secure celebrity dressing, product placements, appearances, shoots and gifting opportunities.

•⁠ ⁠Coordinate samples, fittings, dispatches, returns and placement logistics.

Influencers & Creators

•⁠ ⁠Identify the right creators for each brand.

•⁠ ⁠Manage influencer seeding, gifting, barter and paid collaborations.

•⁠ ⁠Negotiate commercials and deliverables.

•⁠ ⁠Build long-term relationships rather than treating every collaboration as a one-off transaction.

Events, Launches & Experiences

•⁠ ⁠Plan PR around product launches, store openings, previews, pop-ups, fashion events and brand activations.

•⁠ ⁠Curate media, celebrity and influencer guest lists.

•⁠ ⁠Identify sponsorships, partnerships and opportunities where our brands should be present.

Collaborations & Opportunities

•⁠ ⁠Build relationships with other brands, designers, photographers, stylists, production houses, agencies and industry professionals.

•⁠ ⁠Find interesting brand collaborations, cultural partnerships and cross-promotional opportunities.

•⁠ ⁠Source and negotiate photographers, models, stylists, locations, production teams and other requirements for PR-led shoots and campaigns.

Reputation & Brand Visibility

•⁠ ⁠Understand how each brand should be perceived publicly.

•⁠ ⁠Build founder and brand profiles where relevant.

•⁠ ⁠Monitor conversations and coverage around our brands.

•⁠ ⁠Help manage sensitive communication or reputation issues when required.

What We're Looking For

Ideally, you have 3–5+ years of experience in PR, preferably within fashion, luxury, lifestyle, beauty, entertainment or consumer brands.

More importantly, we want someone who already understands the ecosystem.

You should have strong working relationships, or know how to quickly build them, with:

Journalists. Editors. Stylists. Influencers. Talent managers. Celebrity teams. Publications. Event organisers. Production houses. Photographers. Agencies.

You should be someone who can pick up the phone, make things happen, negotiate intelligently and find opportunities that aren't sitting in someone's inbox waiting to be discovered.

Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills are essential.

The Exciting Part

You won't be handling PR for one brand.

You'll work across a growing portfolio of D2C brands, giving you the opportunity to build completely different PR strategies across fashion, lifestyle and consumer categories.

We are looking for someone who enjoys connections, culture, fashion, media and people, and wants the freedom to build an entire PR ecosystem from the inside.

If your instinct when you see a brand is immediately, “I know exactly who should be talking about this,” we should probably meet.

title: SEO Project Manager (India)
description:
**SEO Account Manager / Project Manager — India Market**
*Pepper Content · Mumbai (On-site) · India Business Hours*

**Location / Time Zone:**
Mumbai · India Standard Time
**Experience:**
5–9 years
**Reports To:**
Head of Customer Success / Revenue Operations Lead

**About Pepper**

Pepper is building a new category of content and SEO growth platform — where strategy, content, technology, automation, and AI come together to drive measurable business outcomes for our customers.

Over the last five years, Pepper has built a network of 150,000+ content creators, a customer base of 2,500+ global brands, and a SaaS-enabled platform powering content creation, workflow orchestration, and distribution at scale. We're now building an Agentic AI SEO Platform — and we need someone to make sure our customers actually win from it.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an
**SEO Account Manager**
to own the customer relationship, account health, and revenue retention for Pepper's India customer portfolio.

**Important — this is NOT an SEO execution role.**

You will not be running keyword research, fixing crawl errors, or pulling Ahrefs reports. We have a Growth Lead and an SEO execution team for that. Your job is the
**business of the account**
: the client conversation, the QBR, the renewal, the upsell, the cross-sell, the escalation, the retention.

You are the single owner of whether the customer is happy, growing, and renewing. You quarterback the engagement — pulling in the SEO Lead, Content Lead, and Growth Lead at the right moments — and you own the commercial outcome end-to-end.

This is a
**customer success + project management + account growth**
role for someone who

knows SEO well enough to be credible with senior client stakeholders, but whose superpower is relationships, ownership, and revenue.

**What You'll Own**

*1. Client Relationship & Trust*

Be the primary day-to-day contact for a portfolio of India customers — typically 8–15 accounts depending on ARR.

Build deep, trusted relationships with marketing, growth, and content leadership at the client side (CMOs, Heads of Growth, Heads of Content).

Run weekly/bi-weekly client calls, monthly business reviews (MBRs), and quarterly business reviews (QBRs). Set the agenda, drive the narrative, own the follow-through.

Be the steady, clear voice in the room when things get difficult. Escalations come to you first.

*2. Revenue: Retention, Upsell, Cross-Sell*

You will be measured on
**GRR, NRR, and account expansion**
— not on traffic or rankings.

Own the renewal cycle for every account in your book — proactively, not reactively. No surprise churn.

Identify and close
**upsell**
(more SEO scope, more content, more services) and
**cross-sell**
(additional Pepper products and platform modules) opportunities. Build the business case, run the conversation, partner with Sales/Solutions where needed.

Maintain a forward-looking pipeline of expansion opportunities for your portfolio. Forecast accurately.

*3. Project Management & Delivery Orchestration*

Own the engagement plan for every account — scope, milestones, deliverables, timelines, and dependencies.

Quarterback internal delivery: pull in the right people at the right moments — Growth Lead, SEO Lead, Content Lead, Product, AI/Automation team — and unblock them.

Run tight cadences: weekly internal pod stand-ups, clear status updates to the client, on-time delivery of every commitment.

Ensure every commitment made on a client call is tracked, owned, and closed.

*4. Strategic Partner to the Customer*

Be SEO-fluent enough that clients trust you in a strategy conversation: know the lever, the trade-off, the realistic timeline. You're not the executor — but you're not a coordinator either.

Translate client business goals (pipeline, revenue, brand) into clear SEO and content priorities for the internal team.

Bring proactive recommendations to clients — not just status updates. Spot patterns across their account, benchmark against the portfolio, and push them toward bigger outcomes.

*5. Account Health & CS Rigour*

Own the health score for every account: usage, engagement, sentiment, business outcomes, executive alignment.

Build and maintain account plans, success plans, and stakeholder maps for every customer.

Flag at-risk accounts early. Run save plays. Close the loop with leadership weekly.

Drive
**CSAT, NPS, and reference-ability**
across your book.

**What We're Looking For**

*Must-Haves*

5–9 years of customer-facing experience in
**B2B SaaS/Agency account management, customer success, or strategic project management**
— ideally at a content, marketing, or martech company.

Demonstrated track record of
**owning a book of business**
, hitting GRR/NRR targets, and closing upsell/cross-sell.

Strong working knowledge of SEO and content marketing — enough to lead a client conversation, push back on weak strategy, and translate business goals into SEO priorities. You don't need to be an SEO IC, but you need to be SEO-fluent.

Excellent project management chops — you run tight engagements, hit deadlines, and surface delivery risks early.

Outstanding written and verbal communication. You can write a crisp QBR deck, send a delicate escalation email, and run a tense renewal conversation with equal clarity.

High ownership, high EQ, high follow-through. Customers feel confident with you on the account.

*What Will Set You Apart*

Experience managing enterprise accounts with multiple stakeholders.

Background that includes time spent in SEO, content, or growth (even if you've moved into AM/CS since).

Experience working with AI/automation-led delivery models — comfortable when the "team" includes agents, not just humans.

Strong commercial instincts — you can spot a expansion the executor would miss.

**Who This Role Is NOT For**

Someone who wants to do hands-on SEO execution. (We have a Growth Lead and an SEO team for that.)

Someone who sees account management as just status updates and meeting notes. This role owns commercial outcomes.

Someone uncomfortable with revenue accountability — GRR/NRR are your scoreboard.

Someone who needs a manager closely directing the day-to-day. This is an ownership role.

**Benefits at Pepper**

Paid menstrual leave · Comprehensive medical insurance · COVID-19 coverage

**To Apply**

Skip the generic cover letter. Tell us:

1. One account you personally retained and grew — what was the ARR before, what was it after, and what did you do?
2. One time a major escalation landed on your desk — how did you handle it, and what was the outcome?
3. Why account management as a craft? What do you love about it that someone outside the role wouldn't understand?

.

with deep experience in building and scaling enterprise banking platforms. The role requires a solid engineering foundation, strong understanding of
**microservices architecture, API design and cloud-native technologies**
, and the ability to make critical architectural and technology decisions.

**personally grown through engineering and product development**

  .

  .

  and deployment practices.

  across the engineering stack.

* Identify opportunities to incorporate
  **AI/ML and GenAI capabilities**
  into product and engineering workflows.

  .

  .

  .
* Demonstrated experience leading senior engineering teams and making enterprise-level

  .

  **cloud-native, API-led architectures**
  .
* Understanding of Trade Finance ecosystems, integrations and banking platforms.
* Awareness of
  **AI/ML and GenAI use cases**
  and their application to banking products and engineering productivity.

title: Senior Manager - BFSI (Lending & speciality finance)
description:
**About us:**
1Lattice™ is a 360-degree business decision support partner with a tech-enabled services stack of data, people network, and custom research. Powered by advanced tech tools and unique data-gathering approaches, 1Lattice is an integrated product suite to make decisions smartly, right from Inputs to Validation to Execution to Measurement. 1Lattice works with clients and partners globally, helping clients solving a wide variety of organizational and business challenges through actionable research-led insights.
  
  
Location: Mumbai
  
  
About the role:
  
  
As an Senior Manager (SM), you will have four key responsibilities: (1) Driving account growth and supporting business development activities, (2) Client management, (3) Ensuring project delivery, and (4) Team management.
  
  
The foremost responsibility of this role is to drive account growth, client retention, and project profitability. You will be expected to seamlessly own and nurture existing client accounts for repeat and continued business, identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing accounts, and ensure sustained client engagement. In addition, you will support the Director in business development activities, including proposal development, solutioning, and other pre-sales initiatives. Apart from ensuring account continuity and growth, you will also be responsible for the profitability of your projects by effectively managing direct and indirect costs. You will further contribute towards the development and enhancement of product offerings and capabilities within 1Lattice.
  
  
This role will be expected to develop close connections and relationships with senior level executives across the BFSI (Lending & Specialty Finance) space. This will require building and developing a wide network in the industry and leading interactions with them, playing a significant role in influencing their thinking, identifying potential project leads / opportunities / proposals and driving them to closure. This will also involve ensuring high quality project delivery through your teams to ensure high client satisfaction and repeat business.
  
  
This position will lead and drive delivery teams of 10+ members in the BFSI (Lending & Specialty Finance) department for 1Lattice, including senior members who will be responsible for project delivery, and mid-junior levels for execution. This will involve supervising and guiding the research process and generating insights that help clients make critical business decisions across key sub-verticals within BFSI - Lending & Specialty Finance.
  
  
You will also play a very important leadership role internally - to grow and engage your team and align them to the 1Lattcie culture. As such, your team's success will also enhance your own personal results. You will support and promote the 1Lattice culture by motivating your team members, train them and help them develop their skills, showcase their talents, make them feel part of the 1Lattice family, and overall helping them grow professionally. As such, you will be responsible for both their growth as well as overall happiness.
  
  
Roles and responsibilities:
  
  

* Ensuring sustained growth and profitability of existing accounts through effective account farming, client retention, and identification of expansion opportunities within key accounts.
* Driving business continuity with existing clients, ensuring repeat business and long-term engagement from key accounts.
* Supporting the Director in business development activities, including proposal development, solutioning, client discussions, and other pre-sales initiatives.
* Driving sectoral marketing, industry visibility, representing the 1Lattice brand, and supporting lead generation and conversion initiatives.
* End-to-end ownership of project scoping and delivery by leading high-impact teams and ensuring overall client satisfaction and engagement.
* Driving thought leadership in projects and coming up with compelling approaches, frameworks, and solutions to client problems.
* Managing team growth and satisfaction - be responsible for their success as well as build a strong team culture.
* Play an active role in recruitment and build project delivery teams in your vertical.

Competencies and skills:
  
  

* Deep understanding of the BFSI domain, including lending & specialty finance-linked segments.
* Proven experience in business research / consulting / data services, with a minimum of 8+ years of experience leading and managing teams in the BFSI, Lending, or Specialty Finance industry.
* Strong and credible industry relationships with the ability to manage senior stakeholder conversations, drive account growth within existing clients, understand client needs, and develop trusted relationships.
* Ability to create impactful proposals for specific projects with a tailored approach and support business development initiatives for maximum conversions.
* Demonstrated ability to execute and project manage large-scale projects from beginning to completion, with a strong orientation to planning work, defining scope and approach for assignments, and driving work through teams with high efficiency.
* Strong team management skills: building a strong team culture, driving high impact and efficiency, and ensuring team growth and happiness.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, deriving insights from data and conversations.
* Excellent communication skills, both written (slide / text output) and verbal (client presentations).

title: Credit Policy Analyst
description:
We are seeking a Credit Policy Analyst to join our team in the Mumbai Region, Maharashtra. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in developing and implementing credit policies that align with the company's strategic objectives. description:
**Role:**
Senior Sales Manager

**Location:**
Mumbai (field + office)

**Experience:**
5+ years in B2B sales

**Reports to:**
CMO

**Role description:**

This is a pure, quota-carrying sales role for someone who loves winning new customers. You will be the company's dedicated sales hire, owning the full cycle from prospecting to signing contract for SMEs and start-ups.

You will not inherit a team or a playbook. You will build the pipeline, close the first wave of logos, and help shape how the company sells as we grow. The growth potential is as much as you can chase your dream!

**What you will do:**

1. **Hunt new logos.**
   Build and work a target list of SME’s and start-ups in Manufacturing, Services and Retail your own network.
2. **Own the full sales cycle.**
   Run discovery with promoters, CEOs, CFOs and finance heads; deliver demos; build the business case; handle objections; negotiate and close.
3. **Hit your number.**
   Own and deliver an annual new-business target.
4. **Keep the pipeline honest.**
   Maintain every lead, opportunity and forecast in HubSpot CRM and share a weekly pipeline review with the Leadership.
5. **Work with marketing.**
   Follow up fast on inbound leads and feedback what prospects say so we can sharpen messaging, content and pricing.
6. **Shape the playbook.**
   Document what works (ICP, pitch, objection handling, pricing approach) so the next sales hires ramp faster and of course you will lead it!

**What you must bring:**

This role is open only to candidates with a hands-on, quota-carrying sales background. Applications from pre-sales, marketing, customer success or account-management-only profiles will not be considered.

* **7+ years in B2B sales**
  , with at least 4-5 years selling software, SaaS or tech services to SMEs or mid-market companies. Selling software’s like SAP / Oracle will be a big plus.
* **A closing track record:**
  you have personally negotiated and closed deals and can share your quota and attainment for the last 2–3 years.
* **Self-sourced pipeline:**
  a meaningful share of your closed deals came from your own prospecting and not inbound leads.
* **Comfort with business owners and finance leaders:**
  you can hold a conversation about cost, cashflow, margins and reporting with a promoter or CFO.
* You sell outcomes and not features.
* **Hunter mindset:**
  high activity, resilience with rejection and urgency in follow-up.
* **CRM discipline:**
  experience keeping a clean pipeline and forecast in a CRM such as HubSpot, Salesforce or Zoho.
* **Strong communication**
  in English and Hindi; Marathi is a plus.
* Comfort splitting time between client meetings across Mumbai and the office.

**Good to have:**

* Experience selling ERP, finance software (SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, MS Business central etc).
* An existing network among SME promoters, CFOs, CA firms or industry associations in Manufacturing, Services or Retail.
* Experience as an early sales hire at a start-up or opening a new region or vertical.
* Any Degree does not matter, what matter is your sales record!

**This role is not for you if:**

* You have mainly set meetings or generated leads, and others closed the deals.
* You prefer managing a team over selling yourself.

title: Area Contract Logistics Business Development Manager
description:
**It's more than a job**
As part of the Contract Logistics team at Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in designing, managing, and optimizing solutions that keep goods moving efficiently. Whether you’re leading a team, engineering processes, or driving projects, your work ensures that our customers’ products are stored, handled, and delivered with precision. From everyday essentials to seasonal items, what we do in Contract Logistics impacts businesses and communities around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, your contribution goes far beyond the warehouse—it helps shape the flow of global trade.
  
  
‎
  
  
You will be part of our Contract Logistics team, adding your leadership expertise + skills to the delivery of Business Growth.
  
  
**How you create impact**
Your primary objective will be to develop existing or new Contract Logistics business by coordinating all business development actions + triggering opportunities for larger accounts at a country or cluster level. You will do this by working with a variety of internal + external stakeholders, ensuring compliance with our current commercial policy while focusing on the following key objectives;
  
  

* To develop + manage a sizeable pipeline of opportunities, actively driving each opportunity through the entire Customer Engagement CycleTo lead commercial negotiations + create high quality business proposals.
* To actively develop + maintain customer contacts along with a network of prospects
* To actively network + link with other colleagues (Subject matter experts, Vertical Specialists, Account Managers) at every level of the organisation, from global to regional to country
* To highlight achievements in the business development space using a variety of dynamic tools
* To capture + manage business + market intelligence, ensuring the communication of same to key stakeholders
* To drive + roll-out yearly business development plans

**What we would like you to bring**

* Minimum 8–10 years of experience in Contract Logistics or 3PL business development, preferably in a country or cluster-level role.
* Preferred candidate who have strong knowledge in the West India.
* Proven track record of winning new business and developing key accounts.
* Deep understanding of warehouse and distribution operations, including solution design and cost modeling.
* Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

**What's in it for you**
At Kuehne+Nagel, you’ll be part of a global logistics leader that believes in creating real impact on business, on customers, and on careers. Here’s what you can look forward to:
  
  

* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100+ countries.
* People-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care.
* Learning & Development: Grow with us personally and professionally through world-class training and career pathways.
* Innovation & Sustainability: Be part of a future-focused company driving real change in logistics and the planet.
* Rewards & Recognition: Get rewarded for your passion, performance, and potential.
* Stability with Agility: Enjoy the best of both worlds a trusted global brand with a startup spirit.

**Who we are**
Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
  
  
As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst, Revenue Operations (India Remote) - Hours 1-9pm IST
description:
**Company Description**
  
When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
  
  
Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
  
  
Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
  
  
  
**Job Description**
  
Turnitin's Revenue Operations team is modernizing its analytics foundation — moving to governed dbt models on Redshift and building a trusted, consolidated view of the business for Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Finance.
  
  
You own the models, pipelines, and tests that everything downstream depends on. You're not a ticket-taker: we expect you to understand why a metric matters before you model it, and to say so when the requirement as stated will produce a number that's technically correct and practically wrong.
  
  
This is an early-stage function, so you'll have unusual influence over how it's built.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**

* Lead the migration of legacy Alteryx workflows into documented, tested dbt models on Redshift.
* Design models with deliberate grain and clear lineage, building toward a certified set of marts that reporting reads from.
* Own orchestration, monitoring, and alerting in Dagster (or Airflow), and the ingestion layer feeding it.
* Keep Redshift fast and cost-effective.
* Trace issues to the right root cause — reporting, data model, or upstream business process — and route each to the right fix.
* Build the data foundations behind RevOps initiatives such as account-based marketing, customer health scoring, and predictive work like churn and lead scoring.
* Use AI and LLM tooling thoughtfully in the engineering workflow, and help the team form a view on where it belongs.

  
  
**Qualifications**
  
**What We're Looking For**

* A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, leads with questions, and doesn't wait to be assigned work.
* A translator who can explain a data problem to a Sales Director in terms of their quota, and a quota problem to an engineer in terms of a data model.
* A systems thinker who looks upstream and downstream before proposing a fix.
* Someone constructively skeptical who reconciles the numbers before shipping them.
* Impact-focused — you deliver the "so what?", not just the data.
* An owner who takes pride in the cleanliness of their code and their documentation.

**Essential**

* 6 - 8+ years in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or Business Intelligence with substantial hands-on modeling responsibility.
* Proven experience building and maintaining production-grade dbt projects, including testing and documentation.
* Hands-on production experience with Dagster or Airflow.
* Advanced SQL and real experience with Amazon Redshift (or Snowflake / BigQuery), including performance tuning.
* Git-based workflow, code review, and CI as a normal part of how you work.
* Strong working knowledge of the Salesforce data model.
* Python for data work and automation.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Alteryx, particularly in a migration context.
* Experience with Airbyte, Dagster & DBT or comparable ELT tooling.
* Salesforce-specific data modeling experience.
* Exposure to predictive modeling or machine learning workflows.
* Experience with large customer engagement datasets (1M+ rows).
* Ability to build and maintain Tableau dashboards, even if it isn't your primary craft.

  
  
**Additional Information**
  
**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
  
  
Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
  
  
In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.
  
  
**Our Mission**
is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
  
  
  
  
**Our Values**
underpin everything we do.
  

* **Customer Centric:**
  Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:**
  We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:**
  Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action & Ownership:**
  We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:**
  We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:**
  We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

**Global Benefits**

* Remote First Culture
* Health Care Coverage\*
* Education Reimbursement\*
* Competitive Paid Time Off
* Self-Care Days
* National Holidays\*
* 2 Founder Days + Juneteenth Observed
* Paid Volunteer Time\*
* Charitable contribution match\*
* Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement/\*
* Access to Modern Health (mental health platform)
* Parental Leave\*
* Retirement Plan with match/contribution\*

\* varies by country
  
  
**Seeing Beyond the Job Ad**
  
At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad.  We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

description:
**BMI is currently seeking an Associate Director or Director, Risk Advisory – Credit Risk Modelling, based out of our Mumbai office.**
BMI's systematic, independent and data-driven market insights, analysis and forecasts enable customers to recognize and assess risks and opportunities across markets and industries. For almost 40 years, we have provided impartial views to support our customers’ strategic plans and investment decisions.
  
  
At BMI, we’re proud of the work we do to help our clients manage risks and opportunities in global markets, which began in 1984 and continues to this day. By stepping into a role here, you will help shape the strategic decisions of the world’s leading organizations. As a member of our team, your role will go beyond conventional boundaries. You will collaborate with industry experts, thought leaders, and visionary executives, collectively working towards shaping the future of businesses that span a multitude of sectors. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, and we continuously strive to offer our colleagues a great place to work, with opportunities to learn, innovate, develop their careers, and serve the community.
  
  
Want to learn more about a career at BMI? Visit: https://careers.fitch.group/content/BMI/
  
  
**About The Team**
BMI's Risk Advisory team provides specialist advisory services across credit risk modelling, model validation, IFRS 9 implementation, portfolio analytics and regulatory risk management. Working closely with financial institutions and corporate clients, the team combines deep technical expertise with practical industry experience to design and deliver data-driven risk solutions that support effective decision-making, governance and regulatory compliance.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**
**Credit Risk Model Development & Delivery**

* Develop and review credit risk models using Excel-based rating agency frameworks, Python and statistical techniques including logistic regression, decision trees and ensemble methods.
* Build and enhance IFRS 9 expected credit loss models, including PD, LGD, EAD and CCF components across both simplified and general approaches.
* Develop roll-rate-based PD models using customer-level receivables data, portfolio-level data and ageing cohort analysis.
* Apply advanced methodologies including TTC-to-PiT conversion, Vasicek modelling, survival PDs and term PD structures.
* Partner with senior subject matter experts to scope engagements, define analytical frameworks and deliver robust, client-ready solutions.

**Model Validation, Governance & Quality Assurance**

* Conduct credit risk model validations aligned with OCC 2011-12 guidance and Basel requirements, assessing discriminatory power, calibration, model stability and population stability.
* Perform parameter-level validation including WoE, IV analysis, backtesting and out-of-time performance testing.
* Evaluate statistical, scorecard and hybrid risk models to ensure analytical integrity and regulatory compliance.
* Produce clear, defensible and auditable validation reports, technical documentation and client deliverables.
* Drive continuous improvement through evaluation of new methodologies, technologies and emerging modelling practices.

**Client & Commercial Partnership**

* Serve as a subject matter expert in client discussions, supporting solution design, proposal development and project delivery.
* Translate client requirements into practical modelling approaches and commercially relevant analytical outputs.
* Present modelling methodologies, validation findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to expand client engagements through value-added risk advisory solutions.

**Technical Leadership & Capability Building**

* Support the development of the wider Advisory team's credit risk modelling and validation capability through mentoring, coaching and knowledge sharing.
* Create reusable modelling templates, validation frameworks and best-practice guidance to improve consistency and efficiency.
* Help colleagues develop expertise in statistical modelling, IFRS 9/ECL methodologies, model validation standards and emerging AI-related risk concepts.

**You May Be a Good Fit If**

* Significant hands-on experience in credit risk model development, model validation, IFRS 9/ECL modelling, credit analytics or related risk advisory functions.
* Strong proficiency in Excel and Python for statistical analysis, model development and validation.
* Deep understanding of credit risk methodologies, scorecard development, rating frameworks, model lifecycle management and regulatory model governance.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex analytical projects and client engagements.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.

**What Would Make You Stand Out**

* Experience in stress testing, reverse stress testing and scenario-based portfolio analytics.
* Experience developing or validating Early Warning Systems (EWS) and related monitoring frameworks.
* Exposure to AI, machine learning or deep learning model validation in credit risk applications.
* Experience supporting business development activities, proposals and client solution design.

**Why Choose Fitch**

* Hybrid Work Environment: 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location
* A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
* Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
* Promoting Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
* Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
* Inclusive Work Environment : A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
* Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day—supporting smarter decision-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.
  
  
Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.

Establish standards, policies, ownership models, and governance processes to improve consistency and quality across SAP and non-SAP systems.
* Lead functional master data governance: Partner with business process owners and data owners to define business rules, data definitions, approval workflows, stewardship responsibilities, and exception management processes. Facilitate governance forums and drive alignment across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, Commercial, Quality, and Regulatory teams.
* Define, design, and deliver MDM technical solutions: Lead design and implementation of MDM platforms and capabilities either Syniti, SAP MDG, or home grown application for MDG , SAP S/4HANA master data setup, data quality rules, workflow automation, validation controls, integration patterns, and data lifecycle management.
* Support SAP S/4HANA transformation and data migration: Own master data readiness for SAP deployment including profiling, cleansing, harmonization, mapping, migration rules, mock conversion support, data validation, cutover readiness, and post-go live stabilization. Ensure future-state master data design aligns with SAP business processes and enterprise architecture.
* Manage data quality, controls, and compliance: Define data quality scorecards, cleansing rules, duplicate prevention controls, mandatory field standards, audit trails, and governance metrics. Ensure master data processes support regulatory requirements, process controls, system validation, and audit readiness in a medical device environment.
* Provide technical and functional guidance: Guide SAP functional teams, data migration teams, integration teams, analytics teams, and business data stewards on master data standards, data models, dependencies, interfaces, and quality controls. Ensure common design principles are applied and duplication of effort is avoided.
* Drive integration and enterprise data alignment: Ensure master data is consistently integrated across SAP, legacy ERP applications, PLM, LIMS, CRM, planning systems, reporting platforms, and other relevant applications. Work with architecture and integration teams to establish scalable patterns for data synchronization and governance.
* Monitor MDM program progress and operational performance: Lead execution of MDM workstreams, track risks and issues, manage partner deliverables, monitor data readiness, and ensure high-quality delivery across projects and operations. Establish regular reporting for leadership on data quality, remediation progress, and governance adoption.
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders: Act as liaison between business teams, IT SAP COE, IT Business Partners , implementation partners, data stewards, and senior leaders. Translate technical data topics into business impact and ensure clear decision-making on data ownership, standards, and remediation priorities.
* Continuous monitoring and improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify data processes, automate controls, improve stewardship productivity, reduce data defects, and enhance reporting confidence. Stay current with emerging MDM technologies, SAP MDG capabilities, Syniti functionality, AI-enabled data quality, and industry best practices.
* Team building and mentorship: Build and mentor a high-performing MDM team including data stewards, analysts, functional SMEs, and technical specialists. Provide coaching, standards, and repeatable methods to strengthen the enterprise data management capability.

**Minimum Requirements**
Education & Certification
  
  

* B Tech, Master’s Degree, MBA, or equivalent in Information Technology, Data Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Finance, or related field.
* Advanced degree preferred.
* Certification in SAP, SAP MDG, Syniti, Data Governance, or equivalent preferred.

**Experience**
Must have 12–15+ years of overall experience in Data Management, ERP, SAP, Data Governance, Data Quality, or Enterprise Applications.
  
  
Minimum of 7+ years of experience leading enterprise Master Data Management programs in the capacity of MDM Lead, Data Governance
  
  
Lead, SAP Data Lead, MDM Architect, or equivalent role.
  
  
**Key Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA master data design and dependencies across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, Sales, Quality, and Planning processes.
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA implementation or major ERP transformation programs; at least 2–3 implementation / rollout / data migration cycles preferred.
* Hands-on knowledge of master data domains including Business Partner, Customer, Vendor/Supplier, Material/Product, Finance master data, BOM, Routing, Work Centers, Plants, Storage Locations, Profit Centers, Cost Centers, GL Accounts, and related organizational structures.
* Experience with MDM / Data Governance platforms such as Syniti, SAP MDG, Informatica MDM, or any home grown application.
* Strong understanding of data governance operating models, data ownership, data stewardship, workflow approvals, data quality rules, metadata, and data lifecycle management.
* Experience in data profiling, cleansing, harmonization, enrichment, duplication management, migration mapping, validation, reconciliation, and cutover data readiness.
* Ability to define master data standards, naming conventions, mandatory fields, validation rules, governance controls, and exception management processes.
* Knowledge of integration between SAP and non-SAP systems such as PLM, LIMS, CRM, planning systems, warehouse systems, analytics platforms, and legacy ERP applications.
* Experience working with SAP functional modules such as FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, QM, PM, EWM/WM, IBP, and integration touchpoints.
* Strong understanding of regulated industry expectations, including process controls, audit readiness, system validation, and data integrity requirements.
* Experience in Medical Device, Pharmaceutical, Life Sciences, or other regulated global manufacturing industry strongly preferred.
* Experience in fast-paced global multinational matrix organization.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage, influence, and align business stakeholders, SAP teams, data stewards, project teams, and implementation partners.
* Strong team player who collaborates well across business and IT to solve complex master data issues and actively incorporates input from various sources.
* Should have managed data governance forums, regulatory/audit discussions, partner teams, and senior stakeholder escalations.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Enterprise data strategy and governance leadership.
* Technical MDM architecture and platform delivery.
* Functional understanding of end-to-end SAP business processes.
* Data quality management, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
* Executive communication, stakeholder management, and change leadership.
* Ability to lead both strategic design and hands-on execution.

Location
  
  

* Location is Remote in India.
* 30–40% Travel within India / Global as needed.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer
description:
Senior UX/UI Designer

About Design @ IDFC First Bank

IDFC First Bank is a new-age, Digital-first bank, aggressively working towards transforming

the way Indians bank. We want to build a world-class bank in India that’s built on ethics,

powered by technology and works towards social good. We understand that building value

for our customers over Digital needs a deep understanding of their behaviors and a hunger

for continuously improving their user experience. This makes good Design paramount in

driving our vision. When you join IDFC First, you can be sure that your work will impact

millions of humans in the way they save, grow and move their money...and that you will have

the power to change it for the better. Come, let’s set new boundaries in modern banking,

together.

Job title: Senior UX/UI Designer • 7-10 years’ experience

Place of work: BKC Mumbai

Business unit: Digital Banking

What and whom we’re looking for:

Most products do not delight us because we consider them ‘done’ once they become easy to

use (convenient). The best products push through and bring meaning and delight.

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, detail-oriented senior website/product

design specialist who can push the quality of our digital products beyond ‘convenience’ and

make them award-worthy. They are masters of craft and collaboration. They carry strong

product and design mindsets that help them create impactful products while collaborating

and helping the team learn and grow into ace designers.

IDFC First Bank is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on

the basis of caste, race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital or disability status.

IDFC First Bank is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on

the basis of caste, race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital or disability status.

What will you be responsible for:

• Product Vision: Shape and drive the overall website/product design vision for your

product category, ensuring alignment with business goals and user needs.

• Design Leadership: Provide design leadership and mentorship to the product design

team, fostering a collaborative and innovative design culture.

• End-to-End Design: Lead end-to-end design processes, from ideation and concept

development to detailed interaction and visual design, ensuring a seamless and

delightful user experience.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams,

including product managers, engineers, and stakeholders, to bring design concepts to

life and ensure successful product launches.

• User Research and Testing: Conduct user research, usability testing, and gather

feedback to iterate and refine designs, ensuring a user-centric approach throughout

the product development lifecycle.

• Design Systems: Contribute to the development and maintenance of design systems,

ensuring consistency and scalability across products and features.

• Stay Current: Keep abreast of industry trends, design best practices, and emerging

technologies to continuously improve and innovate our product design processes.

Therefore, you should have:

• Experience: 7-10 years of proven experience as a senior UX/UI designer with a strong

portfolio showcasing a variety of design projects and successful product launches

depicting growth in the business and improvement in its UX.

• Design Expertise: Proficiency in product metrics, user-centered design principles

(especially for native and web apps), information architecture, interaction design, and

pixel-perfect UI design.

• Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire a design team, fostering a

collaborative and inclusive environment. Have the EQ to handle conflicts.

• Problem Solving: Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate complex

ideas into intuitive and effective design solutions. Ability to hustle and get fast

outcomes while navigating ambiguity.

• Technical Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Figma and a fair understanding of frontend

development technologies.

• Communication Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate

design decisions and rationale to cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

• User Advocacy: A passion for user advocacy and a deep understanding of user

research methodologies.

• Portfolio: An online portfolio that documents your best work and thinking process (a

PDF would do too). If not, you might be asked to take a design assignment.

IDFC First Bank is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on

the basis of caste, race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital or disability status.

We’d love if you:

• Have won awards in design or have a high follower-count on your Behance, Dribbble

or professional Instagram account.

• Take interest in areas adjacent to Design: emerging tech, innovation and patenting,

culture, psychology, etc.

• Enjoy teaching, mentoring, reading, researching, writing articles, evangelizing design,

and working with the broader community of Design.

• Believe Design is more than just work, but a way of life. You love to doodle, sketch,

illustrate, arrange, showcase, and have a keen eye for aesthetics.

Best of luck!

title: Sr. Plant 3D Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
IDAC India Pvt Ltd is a leading simulation and structural analysis consultancy that supports engineering firms worldwide in solving complex design, performance, and reliability challenges. The company specializes in Finite Element Analysis (FEA), Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), structural design and code compliance, and building offshore and global capability centers. Having delivered over 500 projects across 11 countries, IDAC serves diverse industries such as oil and gas, marine, infrastructure, process, energy, HVAC, automotive, and defense. Engineers at IDAC are mentored by seasoned domain experts, ensuring high standards of technical excellence, simulation insight, and delivery integrity. The organization offers opportunities to work on global engineering projects and contribute to scalable, cost-effective simulation solutions.
  
**Role Description**
The Sr. Plant 3D Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in the Pune Division. This role involves developing, updating, and managing detailed 3D plant models, including equipment layouts, piping, structural elements, and instrumentation. The Sr. Plant 3D Engineer will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to review design inputs, ensure compliance with project specifications and applicable codes, and prepare accurate drawings and documentation. Day-to-day responsibilities include coordinating with plant operations and maintenance teams, resolving design and layout issues, supporting troubleshooting activities, and optimizing plant configurations for safety, reliability, and performance. The person in this role will also participate in design reviews, support construction and commissioning teams with as-built updates, and contribute to continuous improvement of plant engineering standards and workflows.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in Plant Engineering and Plant Operations, with the ability to interpret and develop detailed 3D plant layouts and piping arrangements.
* Experience with Plant Maintenance and Troubleshooting, supporting operational teams in resolving design-related issues and improving equipment reliability.
* Knowledge of Power Generation systems, including major equipment, auxiliaries, and related processes, to ensure robust and efficient plant designs.
* Proficiency in 3D CAD/Plant design software (such as AutoCAD Plant 3D or equivalent) and familiarity with relevant industry codes and standards.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mechanical, Chemical, or related Engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Experience in industries such as energy, oil and gas, process, or infrastructure is an advantage, along with exposure to simulation or structural analysis environments.

title: Senior Test & Evaluation Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Develop and execute comprehensive test plans in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external customers
* Define and assess with product engineering details of required prototype
* Evaluate and propose most suitable prototype manufacturing process
* Design, develop, operate & maintain complex test equipment and automated data acquisition systems, using programming applications such as LabVIEW, FlexLogger, DIAdem, and DeltaV.
* Build and integrate custom test systems using National Instruments (NI) hardware and electromechanical components
* Analyze experimental results and prepare clear, data-driven engineering reports including conclusions and recommendations
* Create, document, and implement engineering best practices
* Interpret industry standards that pertain to HPBV testing and coordinate testing associated with certification.
* Provide technical input and direction to the design and evaluation of new product concepts, including conceptualization, design review, and testing of complex products.
* Lead future development of lab space specific to Isolation Valve testing.
* Drive efficiency, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives within the laboratory
* Mentor and support other engineers while promoting best practices and continuous learning
* Work effectively in a global and local team with the ability to work independently in local test facility to drive projects forward.
* Leverage expertise in valve test methods and lead continuous improvement and implementation of test technologies across the global labs
* Perform additional duties or special projects as assigned by the Engineering Manager

**Who You Are:**
You take on new opportunities and challenging assignments with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm. You apply knowledge of business and engineering drivers to advance work and achieve meaningful results. You build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives while fostering an inclusive and respectful environment. You consistently deliver on commitments by holding yourself accountable for quality, safety, and performance outcomes.
  
  
**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Proven competency and experience with data acquisition systems and instrumentation of mechanical systems
* Strong analytical, problem solving, critical thinking and decision-making skills
* Demonstrated commitment to safety and risk management in planning process
* Ability to apply fundamental knowledge of mathematics and physical sciences to real-world applications supporting the development of products, test equipment, test procedures, and measurement techniques.
* Background in machine design, material selection and manufacturing methods
* Working experience in CAD software, such as Inventor, AutoCAD, Solidwork.
* Experience with pressure retaining materials, material coatings, and wear mechanisms
* Background in machine design, material selection and manufacturing methods
* Hands on experience with design/certification standards like EN 12516, ASME standards, API 609, AWWA, ISO15848, API 607, TSx, SIL etc.
* New product designs, development, hands on experience with design verification tools such as 6σ, GD&T, DFMEA, QFD, DFM/A and engineering calculations
* Strong communication skills
* Must be well organized, detail oriented and capable of handling multiple tasks simultaneously
* Willingness to work outside traditional work hours to interact with supporting locations globally

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**
**Minimum Educational Requirements:**

* Advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering discipline
* English fluent – verbal and writing, any additional language is a plus

**Minimum Work Experience Required:**

* Min. of 8 years related experience with min. of 5 years in the area of industrial valves
* Experience in matrix organization with skip level reporting
* Experience working with remote/global teams

**Our Culture & Commitment to You:**
At Emerson, we believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and stronger business outcomes. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every individual feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute.
  
  
We invest in professional growth, encourage continuous learning, and provide opportunities to work on meaningful engineering challenges that impact global industries. Our collaborative culture promotes knowledge sharing, innovation, accountability, and a commitment to safety and operational excellence.
  
  
By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to work with talented professionals across the world, contribute to cutting-edge product development, and help shape the future of valve testing and evaluation technologies.

title: Principal Insights Engineer
description:
**Role Summary**
The Principal Insights Engineer is the senior technical individual contributor responsible for turning analytical technology into scalable, reliable, and usable products for business stakeholders.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of BI and Data Science with a flavor of Data Engineering; This role focuses on technology innovation, operationalizing forecasting, building internal applications for insight delivery.
  
  
This individual is expected to deliver value by building solutions, interfaces, and pipelines that bring analytical logic to life and allow business users to make better decisions at scale.
  
  
Their focus on the technology space allows them to drive innovation so that project leads, BI Developers, and other technical practitioners can use new tools and technologies to better deliver value to the business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Innovation**

* Grow our ability to deploy ML Models and use the outputs in Business Intelligence tools.
* Apply new tools or new features to existing business cases to determine the usability

**Insight Product Engineering**

* Convert data science models into production-ready forecasting systems that are versioned, monitored, documented, and reliable.
* Promote product-level data quality with technical controls such as data quality checks, and automated monitoring to ensure forecasting runs as expected.
* Prototype new ways of consuming insights that go beyond dashboards.
* Build and enhance custom data applications (e.g., Streamlit apps or embedded analytics experiences) that make advanced analytics easy for business partners to use.
* Develop scalable approaches for integrating forecasts and advanced analytics into business workflows.

**Reliability, Observability & Maintainability**

* Improve reliability of new analytical solutions by developing monitoring and alerting tools ensure insight products operate consistently.
* Build tests and right-sized automation to reduce breakage and manual effort.
* Produce clear documentation for pipelines, interfaces, and forecasting workflows.

**Collaboration & Technical Integration**

* Work closely with BI Lab leadership on prioritization and business alignment.
* Partner with data scientists on inputs/outputs, feature sets, and model expectations.
* Collaborate with IT and Data Teams to follow guidance on pipelines, compute, and tooling as well as to support scaled development.
* Ask detailed questions directly to clarify requirements when needed.

**Hands-On Technical Execution**

* Operate as an 50% builder / 50% guide.
* Deliver usable solutions quickly, with the understanding that internal IT partners can provide architectural refinement over time.
* Create initial patterns for forecasting, insight delivery, and lightweight applications that can scale as demand grows.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8-10 years of experience in BI tooling and experience with Machine Learning Models or similar roles with strong experience in data/analytics.
* Demonstrated experience building and deploying production-grade analytical tools. Including Experience operationalizing machine learning or forecasting models.
* Strong Python and SQL skills and ability to work with complex data structures.
* Experience implementing data quality checks, monitoring, alerting, or other observability practices.
* Ability to build internal-facing tools or applications using low code/no code apps
* Strong communication skills; able to ask clarifying questions and work independently with minimal specification.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with feature engineering pipelines.
* Exposure to CI/CD concepts for data or application deployment.
* Experience building internal tools or user interfaces for consuming analytics.
* Prior work in a global or cross-functional technical environment

* Experience with field troubleshooting and customer interaction is a strong advantage.

**Required Skills:**

* Familiarity with marking software, galvo tuning, and embedded control systems.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Knowledge of PCB design, solid works.

title: Sr Associate Support Engineer (AI/ML & Platform Operations)
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
At Workday, we bring technical rigor, customer empathy, and a spirit of fun to enterprise software. Our support team underpins operational excellence across Workday's digital experience, AI/ML platform, and Agent Factory initiative. Workday’s Agent Factory is our internal engine that builds, trains, and deploys autonomous AI agents to execute complex HR and Finance workflows, including expense processing, hiring, and workforce scheduling. We partner with core engineering to eliminate bottlenecks, maintain high platform availability, and ensure system reliability for our global customer base.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a customer-focused Support Engineer to drive incident resolution, root-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimisation across Workday’s enterprise platform and autonomous AI agent workflows. In this high-visibility role, you will analyze system metrics, debug cloud-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, and manage critical customer escalations within strict SLAs. You will also partner directly with engineering and data science teams through feature iteration and optimisation. A key part of this role involves hands-on AI evaluation: analysing LLM outputs, reviewing conversation logs, and digging into system traces to spot failure modes and translate those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Enterprise SaaS & Functional Domain Expertise: Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise applications to validate AI responses and assist in troubleshooting functional processing errors.
* Hands-On AI Evaluation: Review LLM outputs, conversation logs, and execution traces to identify edge cases, hallucinations, and routine failure modes. Perform structured data labeling and report findings to senior engineering staff.
* Technical Troubleshooting & RCA: Assist in root-cause analysis for software defects and pipeline execution failures using monitoring tools like Kibana and Grafana, following established diagnostic runbooks.
* Cloud & LLM Diagnostics: Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.
* Incident & Queue Management: Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on-call rotations.
* Customer Communication: Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high-stakes escalations.
* Database & Code Diagnostics: Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
* Documentation & Team Collaboration: Maintain detailed investigation logs in Jira, ServiceNow, or Salesforce, help maintain team runbooks, and flag recurring issue trends to senior engineers and product teams.

**About You**
**Basic Qualifications (Required)**
Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.
  
  
Technical & Diagnostic Skills:
  
  

* Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
* Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command-line tools.

Cloud & Monitoring Systems:
  
  

* Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.

AI & LLM Exposure:
  
  

* Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.

Triage & Operations:
  
  

* Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.

Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).
* Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
* History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer-facing teams.
* Strong active problem-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi-tiered enterprise systems.

Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  
  
Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.
