**About SwitchON Foundation & Greenovation Accelerator**

SwitchON Foundation (est. 2008) is a mission-driven organization working to strengthen
**sustainable agriculture, rural livelihoods, and climate resilience**
. We partner with Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs), climate startups, investors, and institutions to build scalable solutions that create both economic and social impact.

The
**Greenovation Accelerator**
is our flagship platform for climate-focused startups, SMEs, FPOs, and FPCs working across agriculture, circularity, clean energy, resilience, and other areas of climate action. Through challenge programs, bootcamps, capacity building, mentorship, market linkages, and connections to capital, Greenovation helps promising organizations strengthen their business foundations and progress toward investment readiness and scale.

**Position Overview**

The
**Greenovation Accelerator Co-Lead**
will lead the end-to-end operational execution, capacity building, and ecosystem coordination for SwitchON’s flagship accelerator programs. Based in Kolkata or Bangalore (Hybrid), this role requires strong program management, field execution, deal flow sourcing, and startup engagement capabilities.

You will work directly with early-stage climate startups, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), NGO partners, mentors, and internal teams to deliver high-impact bootcamps and foster founder communities. This role is highly execution-oriented and suited for an experienced professional who thrives in fast-moving, entrepreneurial, and impact-driven environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program Execution & Operations:**

* Lead end-to-end operational execution and coordination of accelerator cohorts, challenges, webinars, and ecosystem engagements.
* Develop detailed implementation plans, operational workflows, timelines, and coordination systems for virtual and in-person programs.
* Plan, manage, and execute intensive 3-to-5-day bootcamps, immersive workshops, and pitch days across regional hubs.
* Track milestones, deliverables, participant attendance, and post-program growth trajectories.

**Startup, FPO & Ecosystem Deal Flow:**

* Drive multi-channel deal flow sourcing to identify high-quality climate tech startups, agri-tech innovators, and FPOs.
* Build long-term relationships with founders, eco-champions, FPOs, and grassroots innovators.
* Conduct regular startup check-ins, field visits, and on-ground ecosystem interactions.
* Handle application screening, due diligence support, eligibility evaluations, and panel logistics.

**Capacity Building & Founder Mentorship:**

* Design and deliver capacity-building workshops, bootcamps, and structured learning journeys tailored to startup and FPO needs.
* Identify capability gaps across cohorts and onboard relevant mentors, trainers, industry experts, and speakers.

**Investment & Startup Readiness Support:**

* Connect high-potential startups and FPOs directly with investment teams for catalytic grant and equity funding opportunities.
* Assist founders with startup readiness assessments, data room preparation, and pitch deck refinement.
* Support due diligence processes and investor review sessions.

**Community & Stakeholder Coordination:**

* Build and nurture a vibrant community network among cohort founders, alumni, mentors, and ecosystem enablers.
* Maintain program dashboards, trackers, and documentation to prepare clear progress updates for leadership and partners.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  6+ years of hands-on experience managing startup accelerator programs, incubators, or venture-building initiatives.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Agriculture, Sustainability, Environmental Studies, or related fields (Master’s degree like MBA, MS, or MPP strongly preferred).
* **Track Record:**
  Proven ability in executing multi-day bootcamps, cohort capacity building, and deal flow sourcing across urban tech and rural/FPO ventures.
* **Operational Drive:**
  Skilled in managing multiple workflows, timelines, and stakeholders simultaneously with high discipline.
* **Field Readiness:**
  Comfortable with periodic field travel, site visits, and direct engagement with startup founders and rural collectives.
* **Language Proficiency:**
  Excellent written and verbal English communication; fluency in Hindi or regional languages preferred.

**Compensation & Perks**

* **Annual CTC:**
  ₹10.0 – ₹12.0 LPA per annum
* **Travel & Logistics:**
  All official travel, accommodation, and event logistics covered as per organizational policy.

* Pegging Mechanics: Strong knowledge of dynamic vs. fixed pegging setups and execution.
* Heuristics Execution: Demonstrated expertise in running product, process, and service heuristics.

title: Head BD & Distribution Alternates AIF - East
description:
**Head of Fundraising & Investor Relations, East – Kolkata**

Vantrock Investment Managers LLP

**Vantrock is a multi-product real assets platform. Not a warehousing fund.**
Logistics and industrial is the first strategy. Office, plotted sales, land, pre-leased and yielding assets, private credit, data centres and senior living follow behind it. This seat builds the distribution network for all of it in Kolkata and the East.

**THE SEAT**

**Employer:**
Vantrock Investment Managers LLP, the investment manager within Vantrock Ventures

**Reports to:**
Chief Business Officer, Fundraising and Investor Relations. Until that seat is filled, directly to the Founder & CEO, who will build the franchise with the zonal team hands-on

**Direct reports:**
None at launch. A senior single-contributor seat with a very large number attached

**Location:**
Kolkata, in office, with twelve to fifteen travel days a month across Kolkata, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Patna, Ranchi and Raipur

**Experience:**
10 to 16 years

Team structure, reporting lines, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the current plan and may change. Compensation is confirmed in the offer.

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

Vantrock is an operator-led real assets platform, and it is multi-product by design. Real assets only. Warehousing and industrial parks are
**the first strategy, not the platform**
, across the full chain: first mile, last mile, city-centre, dark-store and self-storage formats, and logistics-anchored mixed-use with distribution below and office above.

Behind that first strategy sits the rest of the platform, launched in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back-office space, where our expertise transfers directly; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living. Each is a strategy in its own right, with its own pipeline and its own distributor relationships behind it.
**A candidate who reads this as a warehousing platform has read the first line and stopped.**

Three parts, kept separate. The founder's balance sheet takes the first risk: land is acquired, de-risked and approved on his capital before any investor commits. Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited develops and operates; Vantrock Investment Managers LLP underwrites every asset independently and answers to an independent Investment Committee. Assets enter at cost, with no founder premium. The platform earns only after its investors have.

Founded by
**Anshul Singhal, Founder & CEO**
. Three institutional platforms built from zero, and the fourth now on his own capital. Across that career: India's largest industrial real estate exit, Rs 5,250 Cr to Blackstone; a fund platform taken from zero to about USD 1.4 billion in peak AUM in six years, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, Rs 2,775 Cr from roughly 1,000 investors through the channel, on India's first domestic warehousing AIF; 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor; 2,000+ acres acquired, all litigation-free; 200+ buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.

**Warehousing is where the founder is best known. It is not where this platform stops.**
That record is the anchor that opens the door in the channel. The mandate you would be selling is considerably wider than it.

We hire number twos who want to become number one.

**THE PRODUCT SET YOU WOULD BE SELLING**

This is the part most candidates get wrong. You would not be carrying one product into the channel. You would be building a channel that carries a succession of products across real assets. The proposed set, built out in sequence as each is delivered and as approvals are obtained:

– Industrial parks, logistics and warehousing

– Office: suburban campuses, GCC and back-office space, starter and strata office

– Plotted and industrial plot sales

– Pre-leased and yielding assets

– A land strategy

– Private credit

– Data centres and senior living

– In time, listed or pooled vehicle formats including InvIT and REIT structures

**Multiple product lines, one channel.**
That is why this is a franchise-building job rather than a product-selling job. An RM you certify on the first strategy sells the second, third and fourth without being recruited again.

The intended route is a seeded AIF alongside deal-by-deal co-investment through CIV, co-investment PMS and other structures, subject to approvals. Seeded is the point: the operator puts assets in place before a fund launches, so much of the pipeline is de-risked on day one and no blind pool is raised. Two sales in one: a fund commitment into a visible pipeline, and larger co-investment tickets into named assets.

**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**

**Own the zone.**
Build the distribution and IFA network across East and North-East India: Kolkata, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Patna, Ranchi and Raipur. Activate the RMs and advisers inside it, and convert that network into committed capital for the first strategy and into a channel that is ready when the office, plotted, land, credit and yielding strategies arrive behind it.

**Not a cold start.**
The platform brings an existing investor base, anchor commitments in place, and a founder known in the channel from two prior funds. The channel will take the meeting. What does not yet exist is the franchise: the empanelments, the certified RMs, the joint calls. There is no team to delegate that to in Year 1. Seniority here means credibility and judgment, not a desk.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

– The network. National distributors' regional offices, regional distributors, IFAs and MFDs, DSAs, RIAs, multi-family offices and wealth-platform desks. Target 5 to 7 firms empanelled and live.

– The full empanelment cycle, locally. First meeting to product committee to go-live, for both the fund and the co-investment routes. Empanel the platform, not a single product, so the next strategy does not start the cycle again.

– Activation. Branch meetings, huddles and desk conversations until 35 to 50 RMs and IFAs have each placed at least one ticket.

– Conversion. Joint client meetings as the core of the job. The pipeline from interest through contribution agreement to funds received.

– The map, in the CRM, weekly. Investor relations in the zone after the close, with Fund Operations. The face of Vantrock in the East.

**THIS IS A FRONT-FACING SEAT**

You do not sell to the distributors and stop. You sell with them. Accompany partners and their RMs to their clients and pitch yourself. Tell the story so an RM can repeat it under pressure. Host investor evenings, partner meets and site visits, speak where the channel meets the asset class, and be a named voice of the platform on LinkedIn.

**Approved material only. Nothing bespoke, nothing verbal-only, no return promises, ever.**

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Essential**

– 10 to 16 years in financial services, at least five in B2B or B2B2C distribution of PMS, AIF or mutual-fund products from the manufacturer's side, an AMC, alternatives manager or fund house. You have carried a distribution number and been paid against it.

– Verifiable relationships with distributor product heads, national and regional distributors and the top IFA and MFD firms in East and North-East India. You can name them, and they will take your call.

– You have launched a product into the channel from scratch at least once, not only carried an established brand.

– Third-party capital raised through the channel, stated as capital drawn, not assets influenced.

– Graduate. MBA, PGDM, CA or CFA or equivalent. NISM as applicable.

– Appetite for the road. Twelve to fifteen travel days a month is the job, not an exception to it.

**Advantageous**

– A real assets fund background. Not mandatory: a strong alternatives channel salesperson from equity, credit or PMS is often the superior hire, because channel sales is harder to teach than an asset class.

– Experience carrying more than one product line into the same channel. This platform will ask you to do it repeatedly.

– An AMC alternates or PMS desk. Co-investment tickets sold alongside a fund. Standing in the Marwari, Bengali and North-East business communities, where alternatives penetration is low relative to wealth and a well-run fund house faces less competition.

**COMPENSATION AND WEALTH CREATION**

Benchmarked against the upper quartile, then deliberately weighted from take-home to wealth creation. Four parts, offered as a mix: fixed; a fundraising incentive on the capital you personally bring in, with a team component on the platform's total raise; a share in the platform's additional returns on strategies you help close; and ESOPs. Numbers in the first conversation.

**Prepared for recruitment only. Not an offer of, or invitation to invest in, any fund, scheme, security or interest, and not marketing of any investment product. The product lines, structures and routes described are proposed and indicative, subject to change and to all necessary SEBI and other regulatory approvals. The track record above relates to the founder's prior roles at other organisations, is not the track record of Vantrock, and is not indicative of future results. No return is stated or implied, and none may be quoted in connection with this search.**

Approve and West follows.

title: Manager - Testing (Oil Type Transformer)
description:
**Company Description**
Megatherm Induction Ltd. began operations in 1989, building on Electro Thermal Processing expertise and industry experience dating back to 1970. Over the years, the company has grown into a diversified group serving a broad range of domestic and international clients. Megatherm is recognized as a preferred partner for high-quality solutions in induction and related technologies. With more than 3,000 installations across 51 countries, the organization offers a global work environment and exposure to advanced industrial applications. Team members benefit from working in a company focused on technology, reliability, and long-term customer relationships.
  
**Role Description**
The Manager – Testing (Oil Type Transformer) is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Kolkata Area. This role oversees and manages the complete testing lifecycle for oil type transformers, including planning, supervising, and executing routine and type tests as per relevant standards. The manager is responsible for developing and implementing test strategies, reviewing and approving test cases, and ensuring accurate documentation of test results. Daily activities include coordinating with production, design, and quality teams, troubleshooting test failures, ensuring adherence to safety and compliance requirements, and preparing test reports for internal stakeholders and customers. The role also involves mentoring testing team members, optimizing testing processes, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product reliability and performance.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Testing and Test Execution for oil type transformers, including familiarity with standard electrical tests and measurement techniques.
* Candidates should possess skills in Test Management and Test Strategy to plan, organize, and optimize testing activities across multiple projects.
* Candidates should possess skills in creating, reviewing, and maintaining Test Cases aligned with technical specifications and industry standards.
* Relevant qualifications such as a degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, with experience in transformer testing or power equipment testing.
* Knowledge of applicable electrical and safety standards (e.g., IEC, IS), and experience with test instruments, data logging, and test report preparation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and capability to lead and guide a testing team in a manufacturing environment.
* Effective communication and coordination skills to work with cross-functional teams and interact with customers or inspectors as needed.
* Experience in industrial or heavy engineering settings, particularly in transformer manufacturing or power systems, is highly beneficial.

title: Customer Support Manager (Food Tech Background Only)
description:
**Experience:**
6–8+ Years

About Gintaa

At
**Gintaa**
, we’re redefining how Indians order food. With our focus on affordability, exclusive restaurant partnerships, and hyperlocal logistics, we aim to scale across India’s Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities. We’re backed by a mission-driven team and expanding rapidly – now’s the time to join the core tech leadership and build something impactful from the ground up.

Role Overview

The Customer Support Manager will be responsible for the
**end-to-end management of customer support operations**
, including team performance, escalations, SLA adherence, quality, reporting, restaurant menu management, process improvement, and cross-functional coordination.

The role will also be responsible for ensuring that restaurant menus displayed on the Gintaa app are
**accurate, updated, complete, and aligned with information provided by restaurant partners**
, helping ensure a smooth ordering experience for customers.

Key ResponsibilitiesCustomer Support Operations

* Own and manage day-to-day customer support operations across calls, chat, email, and other support channels.
* Ensure customer queries, complaints, refunds, order-related issues, and escalations are resolved within defined SLAs.

* Ensure adequate manpower planning, shift management, workload allocation, and support coverage.

Restaurant Menu Management

* Own and oversee the
  **restaurant menu management process within the Gintaa app**
  .

* Monitor menu update volumes, accuracy, pending requests, and turnaround times.
* Work with Product and Technology teams to identify opportunities to make menu creation and management more efficient and scalable.

Team Leadership & Performance Management

* Lead, mentor, and develop the customer support team to consistently deliver high-quality customer experiences.
* Define and monitor individual and team KPIs, productivity, quality, and SLA performance.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and feedback discussions.
* Identify training requirements across customer support and restaurant menu management processes.
* Build a culture of accountability, customer obsession, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Escalation & Complaint Management

* Own critical and high-priority customer escalations and ensure timely closure.
* Establish and manage an effective escalation matrix across functions.
* Conduct root-cause analysis of recurring complaints and identify systemic issues impacting customers.
* Coordinate with relevant internal stakeholders for resolution of complex cases.
* Reduce repeat complaints through corrective and preventive actions.

Customer Experience & Process Improvement

* Identify customer journey gaps and recommend solutions to improve the overall experience.
* Analyse Voice of Customer (VoC), CSAT, complaint trends, menu-related issues, and support interactions to generate actionable insights.
* Drive initiatives to reduce customer effort, repeat contacts, escalations, and resolution time.
* Identify opportunities for process automation, self-service, FAQs, chatbots, and knowledge management.
* Develop and continuously improve SOPs, workflows, response templates, menu management processes, escalation processes, and support policies.

Cross-functional & Restaurant Partner Coordination

* Work closely with
  **Restaurant Operations, Product, Technology, Finance, Marketing, and other relevant teams**
  to resolve customer and restaurant-related issues.
* Coordinate with restaurant partners regarding menu corrections, pricing updates, availability, and other operational requirements.
* Represent customer and restaurant support requirements in internal discussions.
* Highlight recurring product, menu, payment, order, or operational issues to relevant stakeholders.
* Partner with Product and Technology teams to improve customer-facing, restaurant-facing, and support workflows.

Reporting & Governance

* Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly customer support and menu management dashboards/MIS.
* Monitor operational and customer experience metrics.
* Conduct regular reviews of support performance, menu accuracy, escalations, complaint categories, and root causes.
* Present key customer insights, operational challenges, and improvement initiatives to management.
* Ensure adherence to internal processes, customer service standards, and defined SLAs.

Key Performance Indicators

The role will be measured against metrics including:

* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
* SLA adherence
* First Response Time (FRT)
* Average Resolution Time (ART)
* First Contact Resolution (FCR)
* Ticket backlog and ageing
* Escalation and repeat contact rates
* Quality scores
* Team productivity
* Complaint reduction
* **Menu accuracy**
* **Menu update turnaround time**
* **Pending menu update requests**
* **Menu-related complaint/error rate**
* **Restaurant partner issue-resolution turnaround time**
* **Overall operational efficiency**

Skills & Competencies

* Strong leadership and people-management capabilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer and restaurant partner orientation.
* Ability to handle complex and sensitive escalations.
* Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis capabilities.
* Understanding of customer support operations, SLAs, quality, and workforce management.
* Ability to manage high-volume operational activities requiring accuracy and attention to detail.
* Data-driven approach with strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
* Strong stakeholder and restaurant partner management skills.
* Hands-on experience with CRM/ticketing platforms and customer support tools.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets.

Candidate Profile

* **6–8+ years of experience**
  in Customer Support, Customer Experience, Customer Service Operations, Restaurant Operations, or related functions.
* At least 4
  **–6+ years of experience managing or supervising a customer support/operations team**
  .
* Proven experience managing customer escalations, SLAs, support quality, and team performance.
* Experience in
  **food delivery, food-tech, e-commerce, quick commerce, marketplace, consumer internet, or technology-driven businesses**
  is strongly preferred.
* Prior exposure to
  **restaurant menu/catalogue management, restaurant operations, merchant support, or catalogue operations**
  will be a strong advantage.
* Experience coordinating directly with restaurant/merchant partners and cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrated experience in process improvement and customer experience initiatives.
* Graduate in any discipline; postgraduate qualification will be an advantage.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for an operations-focused customer support leader who combines
**customer empathy, people leadership, attention to detail, and strong execution**
.

The successful candidate should be comfortable taking end-to-end ownership across
**customer support, restaurant menu management, escalations, team performance, SLAs, restaurant coordination, and process improvement**
.

The individual will play an important role in ensuring that customers receive reliable support while restaurant information and menus on the Gintaa app remain accurate and up to date, contributing to a seamless ordering experience.

title: Data Quality Engineer (Data QE)
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced
**Data Quality Engineer (Data QE)**
to ensure the quality, accuracy, reliability, and integrity of data across enterprise data platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in
**Data Warehousing, Medallion Architecture, ETL/ELT testing, Data Governance, Data Quality frameworks, Data Lineage, and test automation**

**CDP, GA4, BigQuery, and Azure Blob Storage**
into
**Snowflake**

**Power BI**
.

* Proven experience performing Source-to-Target validation from CDP, GA4, BigQuery, Blob Storage, PostgreSQL, and MSSQL into Snowflake.

* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT data processing, data transformations, and data lineage.
* Experience working with Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Data Dictionary, and Data Catalog solutions.
* Experience with Data Quality tools such as Soda or equivalent.
* Experience designing, executing, and automating test cases for large-scale data platforms using SQL, Python, and PySpark.
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Validation & Testing**

* Perform end-to-end data validation across the data lifecycle, including ingestion, transformation, storage, and reporting.
* Validate data movement from source systems including:

+ Customer Data Platforms (CDP)
+ Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
+ Google BigQuery
+ Azure Blob Storage
+ PostgreSQL
+ MSSQL
+ Snowflake

* Perform comprehensive Source-to-Target (S2T) data validation between source systems and Snowflake.
* Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, uniqueness, and timeliness across datasets.
* Execute data reconciliation and data profiling activities.
* Conduct source-to-target validation across databases, data lakes, and data warehouses.
* Validate schema changes, constraints, indexes, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and views.

**Medallion Architecture Validation**

* Validate data across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers within the Medallion Architecture.
* Verify data transformations, cleansing, aggregations, and business rules between layers.
* Ensure data quality controls are enforced throughout the Medallion framework.

**ETL/ELT Testing**

* Test and validate ETL/ELT pipelines and data transformations.
* Validate business mappings, transformation logic, and data lineage.
* Verify incremental and full-load processes.
* Perform regression, integration, functional, and end-to-end testing of data pipelines.
* Identify and troubleshoot data discrepancies across source and target systems.

**Snowflake Data Validation**

* Validate data ingestion, transformations, and storage within Snowflake.
* Perform large-scale data validation using SQL and automation scripts.
* Validate Snowflake views, tables, materialized views, stored procedures, and data sharing mechanisms.

**Power BI Testing**

* Validate datasets, data models, measures, KPIs, and dashboards.
* Ensure Power BI reports accurately reflect Snowflake data.
* Verify report-level calculations, filters, row-level security, and business metrics.
* Perform end-to-end testing from source systems through Snowflake into Power BI.

**Data Governance & Data Management**

* Validate implementation of Data Governance policies and standards.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise data quality and governance requirements.
* Validate and maintain:

+ Data Lineage
+ Data Dictionary
+ Metadata Management
+ Business Glossary
+ Data Catalogs

* Collaborate with Data Governance and Business teams to improve data quality processes.

**Data Quality Frameworks**

* Implement and execute data quality checks and monitoring solutions.
* Define and monitor Data Quality KPIs and metrics.
* Develop and automate validation rules for:

+ Completeness
+ Accuracy
+ Consistency
+ Uniqueness
+ Validity
+ Timeliness

* Support root cause analysis and remediation of data quality issues.

**Test Automation**

* Develop automated data validation frameworks and reusable test suites.
* Automate source-to-target reconciliation and regression testing.
* Integrate automated data quality tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Build automated validation using SQL, Python, PySpark, and Data Quality tools.

**Required Technical Skills**
**Databases & Data Warehousing**

* PostgreSQL
* Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL)
* Snowflake
* BigQuery
* Data Warehouse Testing
* Data Modeling Concepts
* Star Schema & Snowflake Schema
* Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
* Fact & Dimension Validation
* CDC Validation
* Data Migration Testing

**SQL Expertise**

* Advanced SQL Query Writing
* Complex Joins
* Window Functions
* Aggregations
* Query Optimization
* Data Reconciliation Queries
* Data Profiling and Data Analysis

**Modern Data Platform Validation**

* Medallion Architecture Validation (Bronze, Silver, Gold)
* Source-to-Target Testing
* ETL/ELT Testing
* Data Lake & Data Warehouse Validation
* Power BI Report & Dashboard Validation

title: ASSET AND CONFIGURATION COORDINATOR L3
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

The Configuration co-ordinator is focused on managing and maintaining the Configuration Management System and the Configuration Management Database (CMDB).
  
The Configuration Management co-ordinator watches over the integrity of the CMDB and associated libraries.  As an assistant to the Configuration Management Process Manager they report directly to him.

͏

**Do**
The roles and responsibilities defined below indicate the co-ordinator as well as the configuration managers roles, rolled into one.
  
    The Configuration Manager is responsible for maintaining information about Configuration Items required in delivering IT services. 
  
    Maintains a logical model, containing the components of the IT infrastructure (CIs) and their associations. 
  
    Ensuring that all CI s are accurately registered
  
    Interfacing with other support organizations to ensure the effective use of the CMDB and Configuration Management System
  
    Maintaining and recommending improvements to facilitate effective use and integrity of the CMDB
  
    Creating reports and analyses the CMDB when requested by the Configuration Manager
  
    Ensuring that CI Owners maintain adequate Configuration Management process disciplines and systems for the CIs they own
  
    Ensuring that authorized procedures and work practices are followed
  
    Own the SACM process end to end
  
    Make sure all changes to the CIs and the CMS are controlled, audited and reported
  
    Make sure the CMS is up-to-date 
  
    Define the naming conventions for the CIs
  
    Own the CMS
  
    All updates to the CMS go through the Configuration Manager
  
    Take control of both the software and hardware CIs
  
    Control of all assets and liaison with the procurement team is one of the key responsibilities
  
    Define the asset disposal policy along with the customer
  
    Work closely with the change and release team to make sure the CMS is up-to-date
  
    Conduct scheduled and also ad hoc audits of the CIs
  
    Define an audit policy and audit process covering local as well as remote CIs
  
    Handle discrepancies resulting out of the audits
  
    Maintain libraries or other storage areas to hold CIs
  
    Safeguard the integrity of the logic of the CMDB and associated libraries

͏

    Configuration Librarian in particular will be responsible for the following activities

* Supervise and control receipt, identification, storage and withdrawal of all supported CIs
* Supervise the functional design and support of the CMDB and associated libraries
* Assist in the identification of products and CIs
* Maintain and provide information on the status of CIs
* Number, record, store and distribute Configuration Management issues
* Record the receipt of authorized new or revised configurations and archive superseded configurations to the appropriate library
* Hold master copies of documents, software, etc.
* Notify holders of any changes to their products or CIs
* Assist in conducting audits

͏

**KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES**
    Good analytic and decision-making skills. 
  
    Good communication skills. 
  
    Good presentation skills. 
  
    Must have conflict resolution abilities.
  
    Technical background with demonstrated skills in at least one or multiple IT technologies / disciplines
  
    IT hardware and Software setup, management and troubleshooting capabilities
  
    Configuration Management experience on document control, source code management, and Defect Management tools
  
    Should be able to create a CMDB repository
  
    Should have understanding of the software development  lifecycle
  
    Experience of working in a multi-site environment
  
    Extensive experience with SCM tools and with build automation software

͏

Mandatory Skills: ITIL - IT Hardware Asset Management
  
.

Experience: 3-5 Years
  
.

title: Channel Sales Manager – Pan India
description:
**Channel Sales Manager – Pan India**

Company: Secure Innovative Solutions LLP

Department: Sales & Marketing

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Pan India Travel)

Position: Channel Sales Manager – Pan India

Reporting To: VP – Sales & Marketing / Director

Experience: 7–12 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

**1. About Secure Innovative Solutions LLP**

Secure Innovative Solutions LLP is an Indian manufacturer and solution provider specialising in advanced physical security, entrance control and High-Security Vehicle Mitigation (HVM) solutions.

**Our product portfolio includes:**

* Automatic and manual boom barriers.
* Hydraulic and automatic bollards.
* Crash-rated road blockers and vehicle barriers.
* Tyre killers and wedge barriers.
* Crash-rated sliding and swing gates.
* Turnstiles and pedestrian entrance-control systems.
* Mantrap doors and security portals.
* Perimeter fencing and access-control solutions.

We serve critical infrastructure, data centres, government establishments, defence, airports, industrial facilities and commercial infrastructure projects.

**2. Job Purpose**

We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Channel Sales Manager to establish, develop and manage a strong Pan-India channel partner network.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying and appointing authorised dealers, distributors, system integrators, security consultants and regional business associates to generate new business opportunities and increase the company’s market penetration across India.

The primary objective is to build a scalable channel-driven sales network that generates sustainable revenue and reduces dependency on direct sales.

**3. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**A. Channel Partner Development**

* Identify and appoint dealers, distributors and channel partners across all major Indian regions.
* Develop regional channel networks covering North, South, East and West India.
* Identify established ELV contractors, system integrators, security solution providers and infrastructure vendors.
* Build relationships with security consultants, architects, MEP consultants and project contractors.
* Develop a structured channel partner appointment and onboarding process.
* Ensure adequate geographical coverage and product representation.

**B. Channel Sales & Business Development**

* Achieve assigned channel sales targets and revenue objectives.
* Generate business opportunities through channel partners.
* Drive sales of the complete Secure product portfolio.
* Develop new business opportunities in data centres, airports, defence, government, industrial and commercial sectors.
* Support partners in identifying and converting large projects.
* Coordinate with the direct sales team to avoid channel conflicts.

**C. Channel Partner Management**

* Conduct regular meetings, business reviews and performance assessments.
* Develop annual business plans with key channel partners.
* Ensure partners maintain adequate product knowledge and market engagement.
* Organise product training, technical presentations and demonstrations.
* Monitor partner sales pipelines, enquiries, quotations and order conversion.
* Develop long-term relationships with high-performing channel partners.

**D. Marketing & Brand Promotion**

* Promote Secure Innovative Solutions LLP as a trusted Indian manufacturer of physical security and HVM solutions.
* Conduct regional dealer meets, seminars and product awareness programmes.
* Participate in exhibitions, industry events and security conferences.
* Ensure channel partners actively use company-approved marketing and promotional material.
* Develop regional market intelligence and competitor analysis.

**E. Coordination & Internal Management**

* Coordinate with internal sales, engineering, estimation, production and project departments.
* Support partners in technical discussions and commercial negotiations.
* Ensure timely submission of quotations and technical documentation.
* Track enquiries, orders, collections and customer feedback.
* Provide regular MIS and sales performance reports to management.

**4. Desired Candidate Profile**

* Graduate in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing or a related discipline.
* 7–12 years of experience in channel sales, dealer development or distribution management.
* Experience in physical security, ELV, access control, automation, building materials, industrial products or infrastructure equipment.
* Proven experience in appointing and managing distributors or dealers.
* Strong understanding of the Indian security and infrastructure market.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India.
* Ability to independently develop new territories and business networks.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The candidate will be evaluated on the following parameters:

1. Number of qualified channel partners appointed.
2. Number of active and revenue-generating channel partners.
3. Region-wise channel sales revenue.
4. New customer and project enquiries generated.
5. Order conversion ratio through channel partners.
6. Channel partner productivity and repeat business.
7. Achievement of monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
8. Outstanding payment and collection performance.
9. Market coverage and brand penetration.

**6. First-Year Performance Expectations**

* Establish a strong channel network across major Indian markets.
* Appoint 20–30 qualified channel partners in priority territories.
* Activate at least 12–15 productive channel partners.
* Develop regional business plans with key partners.
* Generate a sustainable channel-based sales pipeline.
* Achieve the annual channel revenue target assigned by management.

**7. Desired Competencies**

* Strategic thinking and territory development.
* Strong dealer and distributor relationship management.
* Business development and sales closure.
* Commercial negotiation and pricing management.
* Market mapping and competitor intelligence.
* Independent working and team coordination.
* Target-oriented and result-driven approach.

**8. Compensation & Benefits**

* Attractive fixed salary based on experience and industry background.
* Performance-linked sales incentives.
* Travel and business development expenses as per company policy.
* Opportunity to grow with an expanding Indian manufacturer with national and international business operations.

**9. Career Opportunity**

This is an important leadership position within the Sales & Marketing Department. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to build and lead Secure’s nationwide channel ecosystem and contribute directly to the company’s growth strategy.

* Interested candidates can share their updated CV with details of their current CTC, expected CTC, notice period and channel sales achievements.

title: Front End Developer - Manager
description:
Role purpose
  
  
You'll build the user interfaces for a multi-year programme modernizing a large portfolio of middle-office applications and moving them to AWS. This is a
**hands-on senior development role**
. You'll build data-heavy, real-time ReactJS/TypeScript applications that replace legacy desktop and web UIs. You'll own front-end integration with back-end services over
**REST APIs, WebSockets and Server-Sent Events (SSE)**
. You'll also set front-end standards and tooling for the team, and use AI coding tools as part of your everyday work.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
**Front-end development**

* Design and build complex ReactJS/TypeScript applications for trade processing, reconciliation, settlement and operations monitoring users.
* Build high-performance, data-heavy UIs: large grids (e.g. AG Grid), virtualised lists, filtering, dashboards and live status views.
* Design reusable component libraries, state management (e.g. Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query) and accessible, consistent UI patterns.
* Write clean, modern JavaScript (ES6+) and strongly typed TypeScript, and keep API contracts type-safe.
* You will have decent experience of understanding and changing Java backend code

**Real-time and API integration**

* Integrate with server-side services over REST APIs, including authentication, pagination, caching, retries and error handling.
* Build robust WebSocket clients (native WebSocket, STOMP or Socket.IO) for two-way, low-latency updates. Handle reconnects, heartbeats, back-pressure, message ordering and subscription management.
* Implement SSE streams for one-way server push (e.g. job status, cycle progress, alerts), including reconnection and event replay.
* Choose the right pattern (REST, WebSocket or SSE) for each use case, working with back-end engineers on message design and contracts.
* Make real-time screens perform well under heavy update volumes: batched rendering, memoisation and throttling.

**Build tooling and quality**

* Set up and maintain front-end builds with npm/pnpm and Vite, including workspaces/monorepos, dependency management, environment configuration and bundle optimisation.
* Work with DevOps on CI/CD pipelines (Harness/GitHub Actions) for front-end build, test and deployment.
* Write unit, component and end-to-end tests (Vitest/Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress), and use mock servers for REST, WebSocket and SSE testing.
* Handle front-end security: SSO/MFA integration, token handling, XSS/CSRF protection and dependency vulnerability scanning.

**AI-assisted development**

* Use GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and/or Devin to speed up component building, refactoring, test generation and legacy UI analysis.
* Review all AI-generated code for correctness, accessibility, performance and security before merging.

**Leadership**

* Set front-end standards, review code and mentor other developers.
* Work with business analysts and users to turn legacy screens and workflows into modern, usable interfaces.
* Support releases, cutovers and early-life support.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* 8+ years in software development, with 5+ years building production ReactJS applications.
* ReactJS: expert in hooks, context, component design, performance tuning and state management.
* TypeScript/JavaScript: strong in TypeScript (generics, typing API contracts) and modern JavaScript, including async patterns.
* Build tooling: practical experience with npm, pnpm and Vite (including migrating from Webpack or similar).
* WebSockets: strong experience building and supporting production WebSocket integrations, including reconnection and state recovery.
* SSE: practical experience using Server-Sent Events/EventSource for streaming updates.
* REST APIs: strong experience consuming and designing contracts with server-side services (OpenAPI/Swagger).
* Decent Java knowledge
* Testing: Jest/Vitest, React Testing Library and an end-to-end framework.
* Git, CI/CD and agile delivery.
* Regular use of AI coding assistants in professional delivery.

**Preferred**

* Working knowledge of Java/Spring Boot back ends (e.g. Spring WebSocket/STOMP, SSE endpoints), to work well with back-end teams.
* Experience with Kafka-backed real-time UIs or streaming gateways.
* Experience replacing legacy UIs (GWT, PowerBuilder, desktop/Citrix applications).
* Experience in financial services, ideally trading, settlement or operations monitoring.
* Familiarity with AWS front-end hosting (S3/CloudFront, API Gateway WebSockets).

Success measures (first 12 months)
  
  

* Delivered production front ends for modernized applications, on schedule.
* Real-time features are stable under production load, with reliable reconnection and no data loss for users.
* Shared component library and front-end standards adopted across the team.
* Faster, smaller builds and good test coverage, measured against a baseline.
* Measurable productivity gains from AI tools, with no drop in quality.

title: QA Automation - Manager
description:
Role purpose
  
  
You'll design, build and maintain automated end-to-end tests for a multi-year programme modernizing a large portfolio of middle-office applications and moving them to AWS. This is a
**hands-on engineering role**
: most of your time is spent writing test code with modern automation frameworks and running it in CI/CD pipelines. You'll help prove that modernized and migrated applications behave the same as, or better than, the legacy systems they replace. You'll use AI coding tools to speed up writing and maintaining tests.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
**End-to-end UI test automation**

* Design and build a scalable UI automation framework using Playwright, Cypress, Selenium WebDriver or WebdriverIO, with the Page Object Model or Screenplay pattern, fixtures and reusable helpers.
* Write automated end-to-end tests for ReactJS applications that cover critical user journeys in trade processing, reconciliation, settlement and operations.
* Test real-time features delivered over WebSockets and Server-Sent Events, such as live updates, reconnection and message ordering.
* Make tests reliable and fast: stable locators, smart waits, parallel execution (e.g. Selenium Grid or cloud grids like BrowserStack/Sauce Labs) and fixing flaky tests.
* Cover cross-browser, accessibility (axe-core) and visual regression testing (Applitools, Percy or Playwright snapshots) where it adds value.

**Behaviour-driven and component testing**

* Write BDD scenarios with Cucumber (Java or JS) or SpecFlow-style tools, so business analysts and subject-matter experts can read and confirm test coverage.
* Support component-level testing with React Testing Library, Vitest/Jest or Cypress Component Testing, working with developers.

**API, contract and integration testing**

* Automate REST API tests using REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman or Playwright API testing.
* Write consumer-driven contract tests with Pact, and validate against OpenAPI specifications.
* Test event-driven integrations (Kafka/MQ) by publishing test messages and checking downstream results, using tools such as Testcontainers.
* Use mock servers and service virtualisation (WireMock, MockServer) to test components independently.

**Migration and data validation**

* Build automated comparison tests that check outputs from legacy and modernized systems match during parallel runs (reports, files, database results).
* Validate batch and end-of-day processing results, and support reconciliation with data engineers.
* Manage test data, including masking and creating realistic financial test data sets.

**Performance testing**

* Build and run load and performance tests with k6, JMeter or Gatling to confirm modernized services meet or beat current response times and batch windows.

**CI/CD and reporting**

* Run test suites in Harness, GitHub Actions or Jenkins pipelines as quality gates on every build and deployment.
* Run tests in containers and on cloud test infrastructure for speed and scale.
* Publish clear test reports, traces and dashboards (Allure, ExtentReports or framework-native reports) for engineers and release managers.

**AI-assisted testing**

* Use GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and/or Devin to generate test cases, page objects and test data, and to analyse failures.
* Use AI to draft test scenarios from requirements and from legacy application behaviour, then review them with business analysts.
* Review all AI-generated tests carefully for real coverage and meaningful checks, not just passing tests.

**Collaboration**

* Work with developers, business analysts and subject-matter experts to agree acceptance criteria and test coverage.
* Take part in code reviews and promote testable design and shift-left practices.
* Support cutover rehearsals, release testing and early-life support.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* 5+ years in test automation or software engineering in test.
* UI automation: strong hands-on experience with at least one of Playwright, Cypress, Selenium WebDriver or WebdriverIO, and working knowledge of at least one other.
* Programming: strong coding skills in TypeScript/JavaScript and/or Java; tests are treated as production code.
* API testing: experience automating REST API tests with REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman or similar.
* BDD: experience writing and maintaining Cucumber (or similar) scenarios.
* Web testing: solid understanding of modern ReactJS applications, the DOM, browser dev tools and network inspection.
* CI/CD: running automated tests in pipelines (Harness, GitHub Actions or Jenkins).
* SQL: ability to write queries to set up and check test data.
* Git, Docker and agile delivery.
* Regular use of AI coding assistants in professional work.

**Preferred**

* Experience with several UI frameworks and migrating test suites between them (e.g. Selenium to Playwright).
* Contract testing with Pact and service virtualisation with WireMock.
* Performance testing with k6, JMeter or Gatling.
* Experience testing WebSocket, SSE, Kafka/MQ or batch processing.
* Testing migration or modernization programmes, including parallel runs and data reconciliation.

title: Systems Test Engineer
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn , X , Instagram , and YouTube .
  
  
The Hivemind Solutions Test Department is seeking a Senior Test Engineer (Software & Simulation Focus) to join our Bangalore-based team. Since Shield AI's mission is to protect service members and civilians, The Hivemind Solutions Test Department makes this a reality by validating the reliability, safety, and performance of our world-class autonomy software.
  
  
You’ll lead simulation-driven testing, automation, and software quality efforts for Hivemind, building and executing test frameworks that ensure our autonomy software performs reliably across simulated and real-world mission environments.
  
  
Shield AI is growing quickly, and we're looking for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, embraces learning, and brings a high-ownership, mission-driven mindset. This is a chance to have a real impact—advancing autonomy that protects lives—while working with a collaborative, high-performing team.
  
  
**What you'll do:**

* Develop automated regression, integration, and system-level tests to ensure Hivemind software quality and stability across releases.
* Identify, reproduce, and diagnose software issues—collaborating closely with development teams to drive fixes and improvements.
* Create and execute test plans and documentation for autonomy software in simulated environments, ensuring mission and safety requirements are met.
* Design, implement, and maintain simulation-based test frameworks to validate Hivemind autonomy behavior and performance.
* Build tools and utilities in Python to automate testing, data processing, and analysis workflows.
* Develop test harnesses and data validation tools for Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) / Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) / Vehicle-in-the-Loop (VIL) and simulation environments.
* Contribute to the definition of testing methodologies, metrics, and performance benchmarks for autonomy software validation.
* Support the scaling and reliability of simulation infrastructure used for large-scale software validation.
* Maintain detailed and accurate test documentation, ensuring traceability and knowledge sharing across teams.
* Work with developers to integrate test coverage directly into the development pipeline (CI/CD).

* Typically requires a minimum of 3-5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 2-4 years and a Master’s degree; or 2 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience.

* Experience in robotics, small UAS, or related hands-on engineering projects.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
* Passionate about intelligent aircraft systems.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional software. hardware and mechanical engineering teams.

description:
**Description**
We are seeking a talented QA Engineer to own the quality of new Alexa devices. In this role, you will collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to own the end-to-end product quality of new Alexa devices, from product inception until it reaches the customer's hands. You will design and build AI-based automation tools and frameworks to support new device feature and non-functional testing.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Own end-to-end release quality for assigned new and experimental Alexa devices, from branch cut through WOTA release.
  
  
Drive daily BAT execution and weekly regression cycles; analyze results and ensure timely failure resolution.
  
  
Triage bugs by severity, track fix versions, and coordinate with development teams to prevent release blockers.
  
  
Monitor crash rates and adoption metrics during OTA ramps; escalate anomalies to stakeholders.
  
  
Coordinate release sign-off activities, including wiki creation, component POC follow-ups, and GM readiness validation.
  
  
Execute weekly beta publishes and validate customer-reported bugs for assigned devices.
  
  
Collaborate with feature teams, TPMs, and cross-location PQA teams to drive seamless release execution.
  
  
Design and maintain AI-based automation tools and frameworks to improve test coverage and execution efficiency.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are a high-performing team of engineers — including SDEs, SDETs, and QAEs — who build and maintain automation frameworks, AI-based testing tools, and lab infrastructure serving the Alexa Product QA needs.
  
  
As Alexa's device portfolio expands with new and experimental form factors in 2027, we are extending our charter into Product Quality Assurance (PQA) ownership — taking end-to-end accountability for release quality from branch cut through customer delivery. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a team that is scaling its impact, operating across time zones to provide round-the-clock quality coverage, and shaping how Alexa's next-generation devices reach customers.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
* Experience in automation testing
* Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
* Experience coordinating between technical teams, peers and business stakeholders
* Experience working with device technologies under development, familiarity with flashing firmware, basic device debugging and familiarity with reading/pulling device logs, or experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working closely with development and business teams to communicate problem impacts and to understand business requirements
* Experience in leading/coordinating work for other test teams

title: Full Stack Developer - Manager
description:
**Role purpose**
----------------

You'll build cloud-native services and user interfaces for a multi-year programme modernizing a large portfolio of middle-office applications and moving them to AWS. This is a **hands-on development role** with a strong back-end focus. You'll design and build Java microservices and APIs on AWS, and also contribute to ReactJS/TypeScript front ends. You'll use **AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Devin** every day to deliver faster, while staying fully accountable for the quality and security of the code.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Back-end development (primary)**

* Design and build **Java/Spring Boot** microservices and REST APIs for trade processing, accounting, reconciliation and settlement functions.
* Build event-driven integrations with **Kafka and IBM MQ** , including message design, error handling, retries and idempotency.
* Write efficient data access against **Oracle** (JPA/Hibernate and SQL), working with database engineers on schema design and performance.
* Rebuild legacy business logic as clean, testable services, working with business analysts and subject-matter experts to confirm behaviour.
* Write unit, integration and contract tests, and help with performance and resilience testing.

**AWS**

* Build and deploy services on **AWS** : ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, SQS/SNS, RDS, CloudWatch and IAM.
* Design services for scalability, high availability and security, following AWS Well-Architected principles.
* Work with DevOps on Terraform, Docker and CI/CD pipelines (Harness/GitHub Actions) so your services deploy automatically.

**Front-end development (secondary)**

* Build and maintain **ReactJS/TypeScript** screens and components for data-heavy enterprise applications that replace legacy desktop UIs.
* Connect front ends to back-end APIs, handling authentication (SSO/MFA), state management and error handling.
* Write maintainable **JavaScript/TypeScript** and component tests (Jest/React Testing Library).

**AI-assisted development**

* Use **GitHub Copilot** for inline code completion, chat-based refactoring, test generation and pull-request summaries.
* Use **Claude Code** for agentic, multi-file work in the terminal: understanding unfamiliar codebases, refactoring across modules, generating tests and fixing failing builds.
* Work with **Devin** (or similar autonomous agents) on well-defined tasks: write clear task specs, review its pull requests and correct its output.
* Use AI to analyse legacy code (Java EE, Sybase SQL, PowerBuilder, COBOL) and draft specs for subject-matter experts to confirm.
* Write good prompts and context files (e.g. README files, coding standards, agent instruction files) so AI tools produce code that follows team standards.
* Review all AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance and licence compliance before merging. You stay accountable for every line.
* Share effective prompts, patterns and lessons learned with the team.

**Ways of working**

* Take part in code reviews, design discussions and agile ceremonies.
* Support production releases, cutovers and early-life support, and fix issues quickly.
* Follow State Street secure coding, information security, data classification and approved-AI-tool policies.

**Required experience and skills**
----------------------------------

* 6+ years in software development, mostly on the back end.
* **Java:** strong in Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Data/JPA, REST API design and multithreading.
* **Messaging:** practical experience with Kafka and/or IBM MQ.
* **AWS:** good hands-on knowledge of core services (ECS/EKS or Lambda, S3, SQS/SNS, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch).
* **Databases:** strong SQL; experience with Oracle or another enterprise relational database.
* **ReactJS/TypeScript/JavaScript:** good working knowledge of React hooks, component design, TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
* **AI tools:** proven, regular use of at least one of GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or Devin in professional delivery, including the ability to judge when AI output is wrong.
* **Engineering practices:** Git, CI/CD, Docker, automated testing (JUnit, Mockito) and clean code principles.
* Experience working in agile delivery teams.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Hands-on experience with **all three** of GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Devin, and a view on which tool suits which task.
* Experience with MCP servers or giving AI agents context from Jira, Confluence or code repositories.
* Experience in financial services, ideally investment servicing or middle-office areas (trade lifecycle, settlement, collateral, reconciliation or accounting).
* Experience modernizing legacy applications (e.g. Java EE/EJB on Payara or WebSphere, Sybase).
* Experience with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code.
* AWS Developer Associate or Solutions Architect certification.

**Success measures (first 12 months)**
--------------------------------------

* Delivered production-ready services and front-end features for modernized applications, on schedule.
* Services meet agreed standards for test coverage, performance, security and observability.
* Measurable productivity gains from AI tools (e.g. cycle time, test coverage), with no rise in defects or rework.
* Contributed reusable prompts, agent instructions or patterns that the wider team uses.
* Became a trusted contributor in design and code reviews across the team.

description:

----------------

This is a **hands-on senior engineering role who sets an example for rest of the team** . You'll lead engineering on a multi-year programme to modernize and migrate a large portfolio of middle-office applications to AWS. You'll write production code across the **full stack (ReactJS front ends, Java back ends, DevOps pipelines)** . * Design and write production code for cloud-native services and user interfaces, especially for the most complex or highest-risk components.

* Build and maintain **CI/CD pipelines** (Harness or similar), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), secrets management (Vault/CyberArk) and observability.
* Write reference implementations, templates and starter projects that the rest of the team and AI agents follow.

* Apply AI to reverse-engineering legacy code, generating specs, converting code and generating tests.

* **DevOps:** practical experience with CI/CD (Harness, Jenkins or GitHub Actions), Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes/ECS/EKS, Git workflows, automated testing and quality gates.
* **AWS:** compute, networking, IAM and managed services, and how to design for HA/DR.
* **Databases:** strong SQL; experience with Oracle and with migrating from Sybase or SQL Server.
* **AI:** proven hands-on use of AI coding assistants and agents in delivery, with measurable results.
* Comfort reading and reverse-engineering legacy code (COBOL, C/C++, PowerBuilder).
* Experience delivering in a regulated financial services environment.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Knowledge of investment servicing or middle-office areas: trade capture, confirmation, settlement, collateral, reconciliation, investment accounting.
* Experience building MCP servers, knowledge graphs or retrieval-augmented context for engineering agents.
* AWS Professional-level or equivalent certification.

**Success measures (first 12–18 months)**
-----------------------------------------

* Personally delivered production code and reference implementations across the front end, back end and pipelines.
* An AI-augmented delivery model running across the programme, with productivity gains measured against a baseline.
* Modernization releases delivered to plan, with no material production incidents at cutover.
* A permanent full-stack team in place, able to run and evolve the new platform.

title: Front End Developer - Manager
description:

----------------

You'll build the user interfaces for a multi-year programme modernizing a large portfolio of middle-office applications and moving them to AWS. This is a **hands-on senior development role** . **Key responsibilities**

**Front-end development**

* **WebSockets:** strong experience building and supporting production WebSocket integrations, including reconnection and state recovery.
* **SSE:** practical experience using Server-Sent Events/EventSource for streaming updates.
* **REST APIs:** strong experience consuming and designing contracts with server-side services (OpenAPI/Swagger).
* Decent Java knowledge
* **Testing:** Jest/Vitest, React Testing Library and an end-to-end framework.
* Git, CI/CD and agile delivery.
* Regular use of AI coding assistants in professional delivery.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Working knowledge of Java/Spring Boot back ends (e.g. Spring WebSocket/STOMP, SSE endpoints), to work well with back-end teams.
* Experience with Kafka-backed real-time UIs or streaming gateways.
* Experience replacing legacy UIs (GWT, PowerBuilder, desktop/Citrix applications).
* Experience in financial services, ideally trading, settlement or operations monitoring.
* Familiarity with AWS front-end hosting (S3/CloudFront, API Gateway WebSockets).

**Success measures (first 12 months)**
--------------------------------------

* Delivered production front ends for modernized applications, on schedule.
* Real-time features are stable under production load, with reliable reconnection and no data loss for users.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer {Chennai}
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 80% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 80% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

title: Forward Deployed Engineer {Mumbai}
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 80% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 80% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!
  
  
*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*

description:

**FinTech’s Finest 50**
by Welcome to the Jungle
