title: Game Developer
description:
Job Description: Senior Game Developer / Lead Game Engineer

**Experience:** 5–8+ Years  
**Department:** Game Development / Technology & Engineering  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Industry:** Gaming, Interactive Entertainment, Mobile Gaming, PC & Console Gaming  
**Work Mode:** On-site / Hybrid  
**Seniority:** Senior / Technical Lead

1. About the Role

We are looking for an exceptional, highly skilled Senior Game Developer / Lead Game Engineer with 5+ years of professional experience in designing, developing, engineering, and delivering high-quality interactive gaming experiences.

The ideal candidate must possess strong expertise in modern game engines, gameplay programming, 2D/3D game development, graphics programming, multiplayer systems, physics simulations, artificial intelligence, and game optimization.

The candidate will be responsible for the complete game development lifecycle, from concept development and technical architecture to gameplay engineering, prototyping, production, testing, deployment, and post-launch optimization.

We are looking for a technically strong and creatively driven developer who can build immersive, visually impressive, scalable, high-performance games for mobile, PC, console, and web platforms.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Game Development & Engineering

* Design, develop, and implement high-quality 2D and 3D games.
* Build engaging gameplay mechanics, game systems, environments, and interactive experiences.
* Develop core game architecture, frameworks, reusable components, and gameplay systems.
* Implement character controllers, movement systems, combat mechanics, animations, and interactions.
* Develop game logic, AI systems, physics simulations, and environmental interactions.
* Build prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and production-ready game features.
* Optimize gameplay systems for performance, scalability, and stability.
* Translate game design documents into functional gameplay experiences.
* Ensure clean, maintainable, modular, and reusable code.

B. Game Engines & Development Frameworks

* Strong professional experience with Unreal Engine 5.x and/or Unity 6.x.
* Work with Unreal Engine Blueprints, C++, Unity C#, and engine-specific scripting systems.
* Develop custom gameplay systems and engine extensions.
* Work with rendering pipelines, shaders, materials, lighting, and visual effects.
* Implement animation systems, skeletal meshes, character rigs, and state machines.
* Integrate third-party SDKs, plugins, and development frameworks.
* Evaluate emerging game engine technologies and development tools.
* Familiarity with Godot and other emerging game development frameworks is an advantage.

C. 3D Game Development & Graphics Programming

* Develop immersive 3D environments, characters, objects, and interactive worlds.
* Work with 3D models, meshes, textures, materials, and lighting systems.
* Implement real-time rendering, shadows, reflections, and visual effects.
* Work with PBR materials, physically based rendering, and advanced shaders.
* Optimize draw calls, polygon counts, memory consumption, and GPU performance.
* Implement LOD systems, occlusion culling, and asset streaming.
* Work with advanced rendering technologies such as Lumen, Nanite, and modern rendering pipelines where appropriate.
* Ensure consistent visual quality across different hardware configurations.

D. 2D Game Development

* Develop 2D casual, arcade, puzzle, strategy, simulation, and action games.
* Implement sprite animations, tilemaps, collision systems, and physics.
* Develop UI interactions, transitions, scoring systems, and game progression.
* Optimize 2D rendering and gameplay performance.
* Create reusable frameworks for rapid game development.

E. Multiplayer & Online Game Development

* Design and implement real-time multiplayer gaming systems.
* Develop client-server architecture and network communication.
* Implement matchmaking, player sessions, lobbies, and multiplayer synchronization.
* Work with authoritative servers, replication, prediction, and lag compensation.
* Develop cross-platform multiplayer and cross-play functionality.
* Implement leaderboards, ranking systems, tournaments, and competitive gameplay.
* Integrate online services, player authentication, and cloud-based game data.
* Optimize network performance, latency, and server reliability.
* Implement anti-cheat systems and multiplayer security measures.

F. Game AI & Intelligent Systems

* Implement intelligent NPCs and enemy behavior.
* Develop pathfinding, navigation meshes, behavior trees, and decision-making systems.
* Work with machine learning and AI-assisted game development tools.
* Implement procedural content generation and dynamic game environments.
* Develop adaptive difficulty and intelligent gameplay mechanics.
* Explore AI-driven NPC interactions, dialogue systems, and dynamic storytelling.
* Integrate generative AI tools into appropriate development workflows while maintaining quality and performance.

G. Game Physics & Animation

* Implement realistic physics simulations and collision detection.
* Work with rigid bodies, soft bodies, ragdoll systems, and physics constraints.
* Develop character animation systems and animation blending.
* Implement inverse kinematics (IK), motion matching, and procedural animation where applicable.
* Integrate motion capture and animation assets.
* Optimize animation performance across target devices.

H. Mobile, PC & Cross-Platform Development

* Develop and optimize games for Android and iOS.
* Build games for Windows, macOS, and supported console platforms.
* Implement cross-platform game architecture and input systems.
* Optimize CPU, GPU, RAM, battery consumption, and loading times.
* Handle different screen resolutions, aspect ratios, and device configurations.
* Implement platform-specific SDKs, integrations, and services.
* Manage game builds, packaging, deployment, and release processes.
* Ensure compatibility across different operating systems and hardware generations.

I. Game Backend & Cloud Integration

* Integrate game backend services and REST APIs.
* Develop player authentication, profiles, inventory, and progression systems.
* Implement cloud saves, player statistics, and leaderboard services.
* Work with databases, caching, and real-time data synchronization.
* Integrate multiplayer backend services and dedicated game servers.
* Implement analytics, telemetry, and player behavior tracking.
* Ensure secure communication between game clients and backend services.

J. Game Monetization & Live Operations

* Implement in-app purchases and virtual currency systems.
* Integrate rewarded advertisements, interstitial ads, and other monetization formats.
* Develop battle passes, achievements, missions, rewards, and progression systems.
* Implement daily challenges, seasonal events, and limited-time content.
* Develop live operations (LiveOps) features and content update systems.
* Integrate analytics and monetization SDKs.
* Optimize player retention, engagement, and lifetime value.
* Support A/B testing and data-driven gameplay improvements.

K. Game Testing, Debugging & Optimization

* Conduct gameplay testing, debugging, profiling, and performance analysis.
* Identify and resolve crashes, memory leaks, rendering issues, and gameplay defects.
* Perform CPU, GPU, network, and memory profiling.
* Optimize frame rates, loading times, and rendering performance.
* Collaborate with QA teams on functional, compatibility, regression, and performance testing.
* Ensure stable builds and production-ready releases.
* Monitor post-launch bugs and implement timely fixes.

L. Collaboration & Technical Leadership

* Collaborate with game designers, 3D artists, animators, UI/UX designers, sound designers, QA engineers, and backend developers.
* Translate creative requirements into technical implementation plans.
* Review code and maintain engineering standards.
* Mentor junior developers and support technical problem-solving.
* Estimate development effort and identify technical dependencies.
* Maintain technical documentation and development workflows.
* Participate in technical architecture discussions and development planning.

3. Required Technical Skills & Technologies

**Game Engines**

* Unreal Engine 5.x (C++ and Blueprints).
* Unity 6.x (C#).
* Godot Engine.
* Experience selecting engines based on project requirements.

**Programming Languages**

* C++.
* C#.
* Python.
* JavaScript / TypeScript.
* GLSL / HLSL shader programming.

**3D & Graphics Technologies**

* Blender.
* Autodesk Maya.
* Substance 3D Painter.
* Photoshop.
* PBR workflows.
* Shader development.
* Real-time rendering and lighting.
* Niagara and VFX Graph.

**Multiplayer & Networking**

* Photon.
* Unity Netcode.
* Mirror Networking.
* Unreal Engine replication.
* WebSockets.
* Dedicated game servers.
* Client-server architecture.
* Real-time synchronization.

**Backend & Cloud**

* AWS.
* Microsoft Azure.
* Google Cloud Platform.
* PlayFab.
* Firebase.
* REST APIs.
* SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals.

**Development & Collaboration Tools**

* Git.
* GitHub.
* GitLab.
* Perforce Helix Core.
* Jira.
* Confluence.
* Visual Studio.
* Rider.
* Unreal Insights.
* Unity Profiler.

4. Advanced & Emerging Game Development Technologies

Candidates with experience in the following areas will receive preference:

* AI-assisted game development and coding workflows.
* Generative AI integration for game content and development pipelines.
* Procedural generation of environments, levels, and assets.
* Intelligent NPCs and AI-driven character interactions.
* Advanced real-time rendering and graphics optimization.
* Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR).
* Extended Reality (XR).
* Cloud gaming and distributed game infrastructure.
* Cross-platform multiplayer and shared gaming ecosystems.
* Motion matching and procedural animation.
* Real-time physics and destruction systems.
* Automated gameplay testing and AI-assisted QA.
* Advanced game analytics and player behavior intelligence.

5. Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 5+ years of professional experience in game development.
* Proven experience delivering commercial or production-ready games.
* Strong proficiency in at least one major game engine: Unreal Engine or Unity.
* Strong programming skills in C++ or C#.
* Experience developing 2D and/or 3D games.
* Understanding of game architecture, algorithms, data structures, and design patterns.
* Experience with performance optimization and debugging.
* Knowledge of multiplayer systems, APIs, and backend integration.
* Experience working with cross-functional game production teams.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and creative thinking abilities.
* Ability to independently own game development modules from concept to deployment.

6. Preferred Certifications & Professional Credentials

* Unreal Engine professional training or certifications.
* Unity Certified Professional.
* Unity Certified Programmer.
* Relevant C++ programming certifications.
* AWS Certified Developer or relevant cloud certifications.
* Professional game development courses or recognized industry credentials.

Certifications are preferred but demonstrated production experience and a strong portfolio are more important.

7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Development Delivery:** Successful completion of assigned game development milestones.
* **Code Quality:** Maintainable, optimized, and reusable code.
* **Performance Optimization:** Stable FPS, reduced loading times, and efficient memory utilization.
* **Bug Resolution:** Reduction in critical defects and recurring gameplay issues.
* **Gameplay Quality:** Smooth, responsive, and engaging gameplay experiences.
* **Multiplayer Stability:** Reliable synchronization, low latency, and server stability.
* **Cross-Platform Compatibility:** Consistent gameplay and performance across supported platforms.
* **Release Management:** Successful builds, testing, and production deployments.
* **Development Efficiency:** Effective use of engineering resources and development tools.
* **Player Experience:** Improved retention, engagement, and gameplay satisfaction.
* **Technical Innovation:** Adoption of relevant emerging technologies and improved development workflows.
* **Post-Launch Support:** Timely updates, performance improvements, and issue resolution.

8. Leadership & Professional Competencies

* Strong technical ownership and accountability.
* Excellent problem-solving and debugging capabilities.
* Creative thinking and game design understanding.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Strong communication and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to work under tight production deadlines.
* Passion for gaming, interactive entertainment, and emerging technologies.
* Ability to mentor developers and contribute to engineering excellence.
* Strong focus on product quality, performance, and innovation.

9. What We Expect

We are looking for a highly capable game development professional who can go beyond basic gameplay programming and contribute to building technically advanced, commercially viable, and engaging gaming products.

The ideal candidate should understand the complete game production ecosystem, including game architecture, programming, graphics, multiplayer networking, AI, physics, optimization, backend integration, monetization, and deployment.

The candidate must be capable of transforming creative concepts into production-ready gaming experiences while maintaining high engineering standards, performance, scalability, and player satisfaction.

**Our expectation is to hire a world-class game engineering professional who can build, optimize, and deliver next-generation gaming experiences across mobile, PC, console, and emerging interactive platforms.**

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹90,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* Project management: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

We're looking for a Software Development Engineer II who wants to own high-scale, low-latency systems that directly move the speed and reliability customers see at checkout. You'll design and build services that compute and optimize the fastest reliable delivery promise for every order.
  
  

* Build customer-facing systems at massive scale and single-digit-millisecond latency
* Own features end-to-end, from design through production and operations
* Directly impact conversion, delivery speed, and customer trust across 10+ marketplaces

* Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency, highly available services that power SSD delivery promises.

title: Engineering Manager, AI Builder Experience
description:
AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI — and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience org at MongoDB, we’re forming a brand new engineering team to make that happen, and we're looking for the founding Engineering Manager to hire the team, set the technical direction, and ship integrations into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech.
  
  
In this role, you'll be close enough to the code to jump into exploratory work yourself while also building the team, process, and operational rigor to keep a growing integration portfolio healthy long-term. The new team will work mostly in Python and TypeScript while collaborating closely with client library teams and other engineering groups across MongoDB that deliver the underlying driver, platform, and product capabilities needed to support these integrations well.
  
  
You’ll collaborate closely and move quickly with product, partners, field teams, the developer community, and open source project maintainers to ship where demand is real, deepen investment where adoption proves out, and evolve the portfolio over time as it becomes a critical part of MongoDB’s future in AI.
  
  
MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our values every day. We value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Position expectations
  
  

* Work closely with recruiting to hire a team of Python and TypeScript engineers who will build and own MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like Langchain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra
* Execute effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities may shift week to week based on framework changes, customer demand, partner needs, and strategic opportunity. Deliver quickly while keeping a high standard of technical quality
* Flag issues, concerns, and resource needs early, working with management to triage, staff, borrow expertise, and cross-functionally hand off completed projects as needed
* Work closely with product managers, program managers, sales, GTM, and peer engineering teams to define, prioritize, and deliver capabilities that improve the builder experience and strengthen MongoDB’s position in the AI framework ecosystem; help decide where to invest effort and where to pull back
* Manage dependencies on drivers, platform capabilities, and other MongoDB product surfaces required to deliver excellent framework integrations
* Collaborate with external teams who own open source projects MongoDB integrates with, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy to work effectively through external maintainer review cycles to land high-quality upstream contributions
* Jump in to do initial, exploratory work. Guide key decisions, unblock the team, and contribute when needed as projects grow
* Own the monitoring, operations, maintenance, and ongoing quality of a broad, evolving integration portfolio; develop testing strategy, release readiness, and operational follow-through after launch
* Help the team build and maintain sustainable engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, version compatibility awareness, and strong integration health over time
* Develop a team that stays current with the Python, TypeScript, and broader AI builder ecosystems, including important frameworks, community discussions, and emerging patterns; maintain awareness of trends and discourse in contemporary AI
* Bring a research and discovery mindset to the role, using customer, community, partner, and field signals to help guide roadmap and investment decisions; identify emerging opportunities in the ecosystem and help decide where early investment could create strategic advantage

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience building developer platforms, libraries, or other high-scale technical systems, with strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript and an ability to lead teams working across both the Python and TypeScript ecosystems. Experience working with programming language polyglot teams is a plus
* 3+ years of experience managing a team of software engineers and providing technical leadership for complex projects or products
* Experience with query optimization (especially MongoDB) and AI coding tools; distributed systems experience would be an asset
* Demonstrated success hiring, mentoring, and growing high-performing engineering teams, including experience supporting career development, feedback, and performance management
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving technical landscape with frequent context switching, incomplete information, and competing opportunities, while maintaining sound prioritization and strong judgment
* Strong technical depth in developer-facing software, with the judgment to make and guide architectural trade-offs
* Experience leading the launch of new features or systems and operating them successfully in production after release
* Excellent written and verbal technical communication, with a strong instinct to collaborate across engineering, product, and other stakeholder groups
* A track record of escalating issues early and fostering a team culture that values intellectual honesty and collaboration
* Comfort operating in ambiguous, evolving spaces and helping teams make progress when customer behavior, technical requirements, or ecosystem priorities are still taking shape
* Strong and demonstrated interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape, ideally with familiarity across frameworks, retrieval patterns, agent workflows, embedding, vector search, or adjacent areas; experience in this area would be an asset
* Experience working with open source software, external ecosystems, or integrations with third-party frameworks and communities, especially in the Python ecosystem; familiarity with open source contribution models, external maintainers, and engineering work that spans company-owned and upstream repositories would be a plus

Success measures
  
  

* In the first month, you will understand the team’s scope, the high-level architecture of the platform and integrations, the current portfolio of work, and the key technical and organizational dependencies around the role. You will start building relationships with cross-functional partners, especially recruiting, and develop a hiring plan
* In three months, in collaboration with our recruiting team, you will have a healthy candidate pipeline and the first members of your new team onboarding. You’ll have a hand-off plan with the teams currently owning AI Framework Integrations
* In six months, you will have staffed the core of your team, demonstrated effective partnership with recruiting, taken responsibility for major initiatives in the upcoming quarter, and improved the team’s ability to execute through technical and organizational ambiguity
* In twelve months, you’ll be having active growth conversations with your team members about performance and longer-term career development. You’ll have led the development and operation of multiple meaningful features or integrations and helped shape the forward-looking technical and execution strategy for this area

title: Process Excellence Senior Specialist
description:
**Join Us!**
At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
  
  
As a Process Excellence Senior Specialist within the Innovation & Transformation Office (ITO), you will serve as a Strategic Innovation Partner—moving beyond traditional Process Excellence methodologies to rethink, reinvent, and redesign service models at scale.
  
  
In this role, you are the architect of your vertical’s improvement agenda. You will bridge the gap between global strategic goals and ground-level execution by blending the analytical discipline of Lean Six Sigma with the cutting-edge potential of AI-driven insights to unlock untapped value and develop a lasting competitive advantage for GOC. Partnering closely with key stakeholders, you will lead high-impact charters focused on optimization, productivity, customer experience elevation and business impact , ultimately turning operational challenges into a lasting competitive advantage
  
  
****Position Responsibilities****

* Strategic Transformation: Serve as a Transformation Lead for your aligned workflow, to design and deliver a long-term "future-state" or “NorthStar” operating model. You will drive systemic change through three pillars: Operational Agility, Digital Transformation, and Industry Excellence.
* Service Excellence & User Experience: Spearhead the customer experience agenda by developing best-in-class service models. You will identify key leverage points in the user journey to elevate customer satisfaction and ensure global consistency in service delivery.
* Data-Driven Analysis: You will use quantitative data mining and Lean Six Sigma methodologies to re-baseline metrics, reduce process variation, and ensure alignment with global business impact goals and Identifying / implementing data modeling to shift from reactive to proactive operations.
* Resilience & Risk Mitigation: Proactively detect and eliminate systemic process and technical vulnerabilities. You will design resilience frameworks that safeguard operations while maintaining the agility to pivot during organizational shifts.
* Market & Industry Benchmarking: Redefine internal workflows to meet or exceed industry standards. You will perform external research and benchmarking to align product synergy with global best practices, ensuring GOC remains at the forefront of operational excellence.
* Scalable AI & Automation Integration: Identify and design requirements for AI-driven solutions or automation opportunities to optimize high-impact workflows. You will focus on achieving large-scale efficiency
* Rapid Prototyping & MVP Development: Shift from a "documentation-first" to a "prototype-first" mindset. You will build functional Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) and proof-of-concepts using generative AI, no-code tools to accelerate solution delivery.
* Stakeholder & Global Orchestration: Partner with cross-functional teams (Operations, Technology, Quality, Stakeholders , and Account Management) to lead the transformation agenda. You will support global projects, and enable the sharing of best practices across regions.
* Executive Storytelling & Influence: Uplevel the narration of complex operational issues for senior leadership. You will create "impact stories" that clearly link opportunities to strategic business value to gain stakeholder buy-in.
* Capability Building: Provide mentorship/training on Lean principles and modern innovation methodologies to elevate the overall capability of the operations and site-level teams.

**Qualifications**
****Minimum Qualifications****

* Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience: 8+ years of experience in Service Sector operations, with a verified track record in Strategic Transformation, Digital Transformation or Process Excellence.
* Process Mastery/Lean Six Sigma Certification: Lean Six Sigma Certification (Green Belt) with a proven ability to integrate traditional LSS discipline with modern, AI-first operating models.
* Tech-Forward Innovation & Digital Fluency: Knowledge of the existing and emerging technology landscape (e.g., RPA, Low-code/No-code platforms, Automation tools) combined with a Proficiency in Prompting and using GenAI for daily workflow analysis.
* Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated experience building high-trust relationships and influencing senior stakeholders to prioritize and execute complex, global projects.
* Change Champions: Proven ability to Identify / Lead end-to-end innovation —from initial strategy to operational implementation—during high-stakes organizational shifts for large-scale, global project(s) that deliver measurable ROI.
* Analytical Rigor: Ability to translate complex datasets into prescriptive business recommendations and high-level 'impact stories' for executive decision-making.

**Preferred Qualifications**
****Preferred Qualifications****

* AI & Digital Fluency: Demonstrated experience building Prototypes , functional MVPs or automating end-to-end workflows using no-code/AI tools.
* Strategic Value Engineering: Deep domain knowledge with the ability to identify “Industry Benchmarking” & "Value Engineering" opportunities that drive exponential business impact
* Ambiguity Management: Exceptional ability to navigate highly ambiguous environments and manage complexity while maintaining a focus on large-scale transformative opportunities.
* Certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (CLSSBB) preferred.

**Benefits**

* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

description:

NetReveal Technical Lead

Design an efficient approach for loading data at scale and reduce the existing method from 20 to 30 days to 5 or 10 days.
  
  
Define the strategy for customer profile creation, rebuild and reprofiling.
  
  
Ensure sufficient transaction history is available to support scenario look-back periods.
  
  
Evaluate alternative approaches to historical transaction and sequential batch processing.
  
  
Lead the technical implementation of customer segmentation requirements.

Provide technical direction to NetReveal developers.
  
  
Review technical designs, code, configuration and deployment artefacts.
  
  
Work with the Test Lead to define technically representative test scenarios.
  
  
Agree data controls and certification approach.
  
  
Produce technical documentation and evidence for design, risk and governance approval.
  
  
Support cutover planning, implementation, reconciliation and post-migration assurance.
  
  
**Essential Experience**
Extensive hands-on experience implementing or enhancing SymphonyAI NetReveal version 8 or later (version 9 preferred).
  
  
Strong experience with the Transaction Monitoring SMBD engine using Spark; experience limited to the classic NetReveal TM engine will not be sufficient.
  
  
Strong understanding of NetReveal data structures, profiling, segmentation, scenarios and batch processing.
  
  
Experience with customer profile generation, large-scale reprofiling and migration using the TM SMBD Spark engine.
  
  
Experience loading significant volumes of historical transaction data into NetReveal.
  
  
Experience using and analysing Parquet files generated by the TM SMBD Spark engine for profile validation and migration activities.
  
  
Strong understanding of AML Transaction Monitoring concepts.
  
  
Experience with scenario look-back periods, behavioural monitoring and customer segmentation.
  
  
Strong SQL and data analysis capability.
  
  
Experience diagnosing performance issues and optimising batch processing.
  
  
Experience working within a highly governed banking environment.
  
  
Ability to lead technical delivery while remaining sufficiently hands-on.

title: Project Leader-  People & ORG (Data Statistician)
description:
**ABOUT US:**

Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services. 

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:**
 

This role is based out of the People & ORG CoE which sits in the broader Data & Tech cluster at the BCN. People & ORG CoE works on building and deploying analytical solutions pertaining to Operating Model and Organization Practice. The team primarily helps Bain case teams, across geographies and industries, solve critical client issues by applying battle-proven diagnostics/ solutions that can identify client pain points related to org, culture, and talent. The team also plays a significant role in creating, testing, and contributing to the proprietary products and Bain IP within the Org domain. This role will focus on development, maintenance and evolution of the state-of-the art org tool and data assets.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* Clean, harmonize and prepare large past client datasets (multi-wave, multi-region, industry, size bands) for analysis
* Conduct extensive analysis independently from large datasets using statistical techniques such as regression, tree-based models, partial-dependence etc. and present findings to senior stakeholders with proper facts and figures
* Work cross-functionally with Practice stakeholders, BCN teams, other survey/ data experts to ensure data & model integrity, and to understand business/client context
* Build reports, presentations, dashboards for internal stakeholders and external marketing/editorial use: summarizing insights, visualizing trends, producing clear narratives.
* Become an expert and own, maintain and help evolve advanced AI based tools by testing and verifying results confidence as well as help develop new tools, in individual capacity
* Design and execute statistical tests to validate synthetic-data generators and non-survey predictive models (distributional tests, reliability/validity tests, correlation structure checks, hold-out testing)
* Be responsible for end-to-end handling of any new tool testing process, i.e., determining statistical testing methods, troubleshooting low scores, presenting findings, leading brainstorming discussions, etc.
* Help with case delivery related to those tools and generate meaningful insights for Bain clients
* Work under the guidance of a Team Manager / Sr. Team Manager, playing a key role in driving the team’s innovation, especially on data statistics topics
* Lead internal team calls and effectively communicate data, knowledge, insights and actionable next steps on tool development, relaying implications to own internal team where necessary
* Keep abreast of statistical and methodological advances relevant to surveys, diagnostic tools, synthetic-data methods, relevant software/tools, and advanced data analytics techniques

  

**ABOUT YOU:**

* Candidate should be a Economics/ Statistics/ Mathematics Graduate/ Post-graduate from top-tier college with strong academic background
* Must have 5 years of professional experience focused on statistics/data analytics (ideally within consulting, market research, organizational diagnostics or data science)
* Strong foundation in statistical theory and methods (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression, mixed-models, reliability/validity, sampling)
* Hands-on experience with statistical software (e.g., Python (pandas/ statsmodels /scikit-learn) , or similar) and data-manipulation tools
* Experience with synthetic-data generation using AI and/or model validation frameworks (predictive, reliability, fairness)
* Good to have - experience working with survey data (Likert-scales, national/international datasets, multi-wave) and performing benchmark/norming analyses
* Good to have - Experience building or validating predictive/statistical models (preferably including synthetic data generation or simulation work) is a strong plus
* Ability to manage multiple work-streams, meet deadlines, and maintain high quality and accuracy in deliverables
* Good business acumen and ability to work collaboratively in a consulting-style environment
* Must be able to generate and screen realistic answers based on sound reality checks and recommend actionable solutions
* Must be willing to own and maintain high visibility and high impact product
* Excellent oral and written communication skills including the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical senior stakeholders

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK:**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

KKR’s Technology team is responsible for building and supporting the firm’s technological foundation including a globally distributed infrastructure, information security, and application and data platforms. The team drives a culture of technology excellence across the firm through efficient workflow automation, democratization of data through modern data and collaboration platforms, and more recently through research and development of Generative AI based tools and services.
  
  
Technology is regarded as a key business enabler at KKR and is an important accelerator to drive towards global scale creation and business process transformation. A dedicated Program Management function along with the Product Managers drive execution discipline across multiple technology teams with a goal to consistently deliver excellence serving our business needs. The Technology team consists of highly technical and business centric technologists with the ability to form strong partnerships across all of our businesses.
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a Senior FAST Engineer to lead the configuration, integration, and optimization of our FAST platform. This is a senior technical role for someone who can operate independently, set standards for configuration quality, mentor junior configuration analysts, and own the technical health of the FAST ecosystem end-to-end. The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on FAST configuration expertise with strong integration and solution-design skills, and can translate complex business requirements into scalable, maintainable configurations.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
FAST Configuration & Administration
  
  

* Requirements Leadership: Partner with business stakeholders to gather, challenge, document, and implement complex configuration requirements; translate ambiguous business needs into technical solutions

* Task Management: Architect, configure, and route tasks and workflows to support business processes
* User Access Administration: Own user permissions, roles, and access controls in accordance with security and compliance policies
* Accounting Configuration: Configure and maintain accounting-related processes, with attention to reconciliation and downstream financial reporting
* Data Reporting & Extracts: Build and optimize SQL-based reports and extracts to support business intelligence and operational needs
* eDelivery Workflows: Design and configure electronic delivery workflows to streamline document distribution

**Integration & Solution Design**

* Integration Management: Design, build, and manage integrations within the FAST ecosystem — including APIs, web services, batch/file interfaces, and data exchange with upstream/downstream systems (policy admin, GL, payments, third-party vendors)

* Environment & Release Management: Support configuration migration, versioning, and promotion across environments (dev → test → prod), following deployment best practices

**Technical Leadership**

* Mentorship: Guide and review the work of junior FAST configuration analysts; establish and enforce configuration standards and best practices
* Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis: Diagnose complex production issues spanning configuration, integrations, and data
* Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and design artifacts

**Qualifications**
**Experience**

* 3–5 years of hands-on FAST configuration experience across the modules above
* Demonstrated experience managing integrations within the FAST ecosystem (APIs, web services, batch interfaces, data exchange with external systems)
* Track record of independently delivering configuration work in a production environment

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of software development principles and deployment/release best practices
* Advanced SQL for querying, reporting, and extract generation (performance tuning a plus)
* Proficiency with XSLT scripting and data transformation
* Experience with configuration management, environment promotion, and system administration
* Familiarity with workflow automation and business process optimization

**Professional Attributes**

* Intuitive Problem Solver — anticipates issues and proactively identifies solutions
* Inquisitive Mindset — asks clarifying questions to ensure accurate requirement implementation
* Detail-Oriented — rigorous about configuration quality and testing
* Self-Motivated — works independently with minimal supervision
* Collaborative Leader — mentors others and communicates clearly with technical and business audiences

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of insurance/annuity industry processes and terminology
* Experience integrating FAST with policy administration, general ledger, or payment systems
* Background in business process improvement or operational efficiency projects
* Exposure to Agile/Scrum delivery and CI/CD practices

title: Forward Deployed Engineer {Mumbai}
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 80% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 80% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

**Our Product & Engineering Team:**

We're a growth-stage fintech with teams in London, Nottingham, Atlanta, Stockholm, Munich and Mumbai, and we’re building a global Product, Data & Engineering team that thrives on autonomy, ownership, and is focused on impact! Our teams solve real-world problems for small businesses, shaping products that unlock opportunity at scale.
  
  
Engineering is going through an AI-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. It's changing what a small team can do! We empower our teams to make decisions, move fast, and take full responsibility for the solutions they deliver. You’ll join a team where curiosity is encouraged and collaboration across Product, Data, Delivery and Engineering is the norm.
  
  
Our Salesforce Team:
  
  
You’ll join the Salesforce engineering team within Liberis’ wider Technology function. The team owns and evolves the Salesforce platform that underpins how Liberis acquires, onboards, and supports merchants and partners across 15 markets. They also work closely with other engineering development teams, product teams, and business functions such as commercial and operations to turn business needs into reliable, well-built Salesforce solutions.
  
  
The role:
  
  
As a Senior Salesforce Developer, you’ll take ownership of complex Salesforce solutions from discovery through to production. You’ll work across both code and configuration, making informed technical decisions around architecture, automation, integrations, security, and maintainability.
  
  
You’ll be trusted to take ambiguous or complex requirements, work with stakeholders to understand the underlying problem, and shape a solution that is scalable and aligned with the wider Salesforce platform.
  
  
You’ll remain hands-on with Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations, and declarative tooling, while also acting as a technical point of reference for other members of the team. You’ll review code and designs, support colleagues through challenging technical problems, and help improve the engineering practices that underpin how Salesforce changes are developed and released.
  
  
Success in the role means consistently delivering high-quality solutions with a high degree of autonomy, making sound technical decisions, and having a positive impact on both the platform and the engineers around you.
  
  
What you’ll get to do:
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, and declarative tools such as Flow, validation rules, and Salesforce configuration.
* Own complex features and technical changes end to end, from understanding the business problem and shaping the technical approach through to testing, release, and production support.
* Make and contribute to technical design decisions across areas such as object modelling, automation, security and sharing, integrations, and platform architecture.
* Build and support integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, and other appropriate integration patterns.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs early, and communicate them clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Write high-quality, maintainable code and automated tests, and provide thoughtful code reviews that improve both the solution and the capability of the wider team.

title: Design Technologist, eShop
description:
**Description**
Help shape the future of AI-powered creative production at Amazon. As a GenAI Design Technologist, you will pioneer the intersection of Generative AI and creative production - shipping tools and workflows that transform how product images and videos are created at scale.
  
  
We are operationalizing Generative AI for visual content creation. This team partners with world-class artists and scientists to push what's possible with image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal AI systems. You will work at the rare intersection where creative craft meets technical depth.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Develop, optimize, and scale Generative AI workflows and pipelines for production-grade visual content
* Act as the bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering - translating artistic intent into scalable technical solutions
* Build automation that removes bottlenecks and enables content creators to focus on what they do best
* Evaluate emerging foundational models and translate the latest research breakthroughs into production-ready capabilities
* Partner with engineers and scientists on prompt engineering frameworks and centralized GenAI tooling

This role is ideal for someone who's equal parts technologist and creative problem solver - someone who can evaluate output quality with a trained eye while optimizing the pipeline that produces it. You will ship work that directly impacts the shopping experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Develop, test, and optimize Generative AI workflows and pipelines for visual content production using inference platforms and services
* Act as a bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering - translating production needs into technical requirements and delivering working solutions
* Build and maintain automation scripts and tools that resolve workflow bottlenecks, improve content quality, and increase creator productivity
* Evaluate AI-generated output for visual quality, brand consistency, and production readiness - applying both technical metrics and creative judgment
* Support the fine-tuning, testing, and evaluation of foundational models and LLMs for image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal content creation
* Design and implement prompt engineering frameworks that enable consistent, high-quality results at scale across content types
* Collaborate with engineers and scientists to contribute to a centralized suite of GenAI tools used across visual content workflows
* Research and prototype emerging Generative AI capabilities - assessing production viability and recommending adoption paths to creative leadership
* Develop batch processing solutions and content pipelines that enable teams to generate, review, and publish AI-created assets efficiently
* Document workflows, best practices, and technical specifications to enable partner teams to adopt generative workflows independently
* Participate in cross-functional reviews to align AI tooling development with evolving creative standards and business requirements

A day in the life
  
  
In this role, you will move between creative and technical work. You might review AI-generated image outputs -tuning prompts and parameters to improve quality and consistency. Then shift to prototyping a workflow with a creative lead and ML engineer, translating a creative brief into a scalable technical solution. You could also be evaluating a new foundational model for production readiness or helping a partner team adopt your automation pipeline. Throughout it all, you will collaborate closely with creative directors, applied scientists, and content producers - solving the gap between what AI can technically generate and what meets the visual quality bar at scale.

* Experience with UI design for complex workflows and for end users
* Experience building scripts, tooling, and automation for large-scale computing environments
* Experience with prompt engineering techniques for content generation

title: Applied AI Architect, Meta Enterprise Platform (India)
description:
As an Applied AI Architect for the Meta Enterprise Platform, you are the strategic technical advisor who helps enterprise customers understand the full potential of our Enterprise AI products (such as Model API) and design the right architectures to unlock that value. You combine deep knowledge of Generative AI with enterprise architecture expertise and effective communication skills to guide customers from initial discovery through successful deployment, ongoing adoption and expansion.This role combines pre-sales technical leadership with post-sales customer adoption and expansion. You will design scalable architectures, develop evaluation frameworks, create reference implementations, and serve as the technical authority that gives customers and internal stakeholders the confidence to purchase. You are the architect of the blueprint - ensuring the right technical foundation is in place before and during implementation. You will not just design architectures; you will help to deploy end-to-end AI solutions that drive actual AI usage such as API consumption and business ROI. You will own the customer's technical success from the initial scoping phase through to live production deployment, post-sales adoption and growth.  
  
  

### **Applied AI Architect, Meta Enterprise Platform (India) Responsibilities:**

* \*\*Technical Discovery & Solution Design\*\* - Partner with sales to deeply understand customer requirements, business context, and existing technology stacks. Translate these into clear, technically feasible AI solution architectures and integration plans
* \*\*Technical Account Ownership\*\* - Establish technical account plans covering current use cases, adoption milestones and agreed measures of value. Review API usage, technical account health and blockers. Qualify additional use cases and help build the technical case for expansion. Coordinate specialist input where needed and follow through on agreed actions
* \*\*AI Architecture Advisory\*\* - Serve as the primary technical advisor throughout the customer's AI / API adoption journey. Guide architecture decisions around LLM selection, RAG patterns, prompt engineering strategies, agentic workflow and tool use, data pipelines, and enterprise integration points
* \*\*Evaluation & Proof of Value\*\* - Design and guide customer evaluation frameworks (evals) to measure AI performance for specific use cases. Create compelling demos, reference architectures, and lightweight POCs that demonstrate practical value and feasibility. Agree acceptance criteria for quality, latency, cost and reliability, linking evaluation results to customer business goals and a decision on production deployment
* \*\*Enterprise Trust & Governance\*\* - Address enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements (SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR). Navigate complex sales lifecycles involving IT, Legal, Security, and executive stakeholders to build technical confidence
* \*\*Cross-Functional Collaboration\*\* - Act as the bridge between customers and internal Product, Engineering, and PMM teams. Gather technical feedback, identify common integration patterns, surface product gaps, and contribute field insights that shape the product roadmap and GTM strategy
* \*\*Thought Leadership & Enablement\*\* - Create technical content including architecture guides, best-practice documentation, and industry-specific solution briefs. Enable the broader sales and partner ecosystem with technical training and reusable assets
* \*\*Hands-on Solutions\*\* - Act as the primary technical owner for strategic accounts. Assist in the design, prototyping, and deployment planning for customer full-stack applications, RAG pipelines, and custom integrations using our AI APIs. Contribute reference implementations and technical reviews
* \*\*Rapid Prototyping\*\* - Translate customer business problems into concrete technical plans. Rapidly develop and iterate on functional proofs-of-concept (POCs) to demonstrate immediate value
* \*\*Production Implementation\*\* - Guide customers through the "Integration Wall." Navigate enterprise security, legacy databases, and complex infrastructures
* \*\*Technical Advisory\*\* - Serve as the subject matter expert on Generative AI architecture, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI security/guardrails for C-level executives and lead developers
* \*\*Travel\*\* - Flexibility to travel up to 30% of the time

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience engaging enterprise customers through the sales lifecycle, purchasing and deployment decisions, involving multiple stakeholders across IT, Security, Legal, and executive leadership
* Comfortable with Python and able to build lightweight demos, scripts, and reference implementations (not expected to write production-grade application code)
* Familiarity with the Generative AI ecosystem: APIs, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, vector databases, and evaluation frameworks. Ability to use LLM APIs to build and evaluate lightweight demos, prototypes and reference implementations
* Ability to design use-case-specific evaluation tests and assess quality, latency, cost and reliability against agreed customer requirements and business goals
* Experience planning and managing customer technical engagements, resolving blockers and coordinating customer and internal teams through evaluation, integration and adoption. A high degree of ownership, and the ability to thrive in highly ambiguous, fast-paced environments
* Experience communicating and translating complex AI/ML concepts for C-suite executives, IT leaders, engineering teams and non-technical business leaders while simultaneously working with customer engineering teams

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience with AI safety, responsible AI practices, and implementing guardrails for LLM applications in regulated industries
* Experience creating and delivering technical enablement programs for sales teams, partners, or customer communities
* Familiarity with enterprise security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, HIPAA) in the context of AI deployments
* Experience architecting AI/ML solutions at scale in enterprise environments, including model deployment, monitoring, and governance. Experience helping customers move from evaluation to live applications with measurable business value
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience with AI observability, evaluation frameworks (evals) assessing quality, latency, cost and reliability, and implementing enterprise-grade security guardrails for AI applications
* Hands-on experience building applications using AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) and familiarity with the Generative AI ecosystem (Vector Databases, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, tool use and frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

We are looking for a proactive professional with strong analytical and problem-solving skills who can work closely with developers and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, high-quality software applications.

Strong experience in manual testing and software quality assurance. Hands-on experience with automation testing tools and frameworks. Exposure to AI-assisted testing tools and AI-powered QA workflows. Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills. Experience in API testing, defect tracking, and regression testing. Opportunity to work on modern applications and improve QA processes using automation and AI.

title: Design Technologist, eShop
description:
**Description**
Help shape the future of AI-powered creative production at Amazon. As a GenAI Design Technologist, you will pioneer the intersection of Generative AI and creative production - shipping tools and workflows that transform how product images and videos are created at scale.
  
  
We are operationalizing Generative AI for visual content creation. This team partners with world-class artists and scientists to push what's possible with image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal AI systems. You will work at the rare intersection where creative craft meets technical depth.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Develop, optimize, and scale Generative AI workflows and pipelines for production-grade visual content
* Act as the bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering - translating artistic intent into scalable technical solutions
* Build automation that removes bottlenecks and enables content creators to focus on what they do best
* Evaluate emerging foundational models and translate the latest research breakthroughs into production-ready capabilities
* Partner with engineers and scientists on prompt engineering frameworks and centralized GenAI tooling

This role is ideal for someone who's equal parts technologist and creative problem solver - someone who can evaluate output quality with a trained eye while optimizing the pipeline that produces it. You will ship work that directly impacts the shopping experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Develop, test, and optimize Generative AI workflows and pipelines for visual content production using inference platforms and services
* Act as a bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering - translating production needs into technical requirements and delivering working solutions
* Build and maintain automation scripts and tools that resolve workflow bottlenecks, improve content quality, and increase creator productivity
* Evaluate AI-generated output for visual quality, brand consistency, and production readiness - applying both technical metrics and creative judgment
* Support the fine-tuning, testing, and evaluation of foundational models and LLMs for image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal content creation
* Design and implement prompt engineering frameworks that enable consistent, high-quality results at scale across content types
* Collaborate with engineers and scientists to contribute to a centralized suite of GenAI tools used across visual content workflows
* Research and prototype emerging Generative AI capabilities - assessing production viability and recommending adoption paths to creative leadership
* Develop batch processing solutions and content pipelines that enable teams to generate, review, and publish AI-created assets efficiently
* Document workflows, best practices, and technical specifications to enable partner teams to adopt generative workflows independently
* Participate in cross-functional reviews to align AI tooling development with evolving creative standards and business requirements

A day in the life
  
  
In this role, you will move between creative and technical work. You might review AI-generated image outputs -tuning prompts and parameters to improve quality and consistency. Then shift to prototyping a workflow with a creative lead and ML engineer, translating a creative brief into a scalable technical solution. You could also be evaluating a new foundational model for production readiness or helping a partner team adopt your automation pipeline. Throughout it all, you will collaborate closely with creative directors, applied scientists, and content producers - solving the gap between what AI can technically generate and what meets the visual quality bar at scale.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our team builds how hundreds of millions of customers see products - through photography, video, CGI, and increasingly through Generative AI. We are a global network of creatives, technologists, and scientists unified by one mission: make every product look its best, at extraordinary scale. Our culture values builders who are curious, collaborative, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. We ship fast, learn from what breaks, and believe the best creative work happens when art and technology push each other forward.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science or equivalent
* 3+ years of experience in front-end technology, engineering, or UX prototyping
* Coding samples in front-end programming languages
* Available online portfolio demonstrating relevant work
* Experience with web, mobile web, or mobile app front-end development
* Experience with UI design for complex workflows and for end users
* Experience building scripts, tooling, and automation for large-scale computing environments
* Experience with prompt engineering techniques for content generation

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of technologies such as JavaScript/Node.js, HTML/CSS, Responsive/Adaptive Design
* Knowledge of Python, JavaScript, and source control (Git)
* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead, or leading an engineering team
* Knowledge of video production, live streaming technologies, studio workflows, edit and post-production techniques, production calendars and staffing

title: Principal Software Architect
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a technically strong software engineering leader to own software quality, architecture and integrated delivery across our India software organisation. Our robots depend on multiple software disciplines working together reliably. You will help shape technology strategy and organisational direction, and translate that into sound architectural decisions, strong engineering practices and dependable execution. This is a hands-on leadership role combining technical depth, people management and accountability for outcomes.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka,
**Reports to:**
Chief Technology Officer
  
  

* Experience: 10+ years

**About Us**
We are building robots to maintain, organise and reset common public and commercial spaces — offices, campuses, venues and other high-traffic facilities. We are building a hybrid end-to-end architecture where classical and modern methods work together for maximum reliability and robustness, with R&D in Bengaluru and Wellington, New Zealand.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Technology direction and architecture:**
help shape technology strategy and drive architecture decisions across robot software, cloud services, data processing and model training infrastructure. Own system-level requirements — latency, compute and memory budgets, end-to-end reliability. Establish clear interfaces and component ownership, and resolve technical trade-offs across the stack.
  
  
**Software quality, security and engineering practices:**
set and embed standards for code quality, testing, documentation, observability and secure development. Own the software security review and audit process across robot and cloud systems, working with specialists where needed. Build quality into everyday development through effective reviews, automated validation and measurable acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Integrated software delivery:**
own delivery across teams, turning product priorities into realistic plans with clear commitments, dependencies and milestones. Resolve execution bottlenecks and hold teams accountable for working software and demonstrated robot behaviour.
  
  
**Integration, resilience and release readiness:**
own integration and release readiness across robot software, cloud services, and data and training pipelines, including Kubernetes. Define and validate behaviour during connectivity loss, service degradation and component failures, including safe fallback, recovery and rollback. Establish reproducible builds and simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, on-robot and cloud testing.
  
  
**Hands-on technical leadership:**
stay close to implementation through critical design and code work, complex debugging and direct involvement in the most consequential technical problems.
  
  
**People and team development:**
lead and develop engineers and technical leads; build capability through hiring, coaching, clear performance expectations and stronger technical ownership.
  
  
**Cross-team alignment:**
bring teams together around shared technical decisions and delivery outcomes, including teams outside your reporting line.
  
  
**Experience**

* At least 10 years in robotics or AI, including technical leadership roles
* Strong understanding of autonomy systems such as VLA/VLM models, SLAM, planning, perception and ML-based decision-making
* Python, C++, ROS, and ML stacks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
* Experience with robotics, embedded systems, autonomous systems or comparable products where software interacts with physical hardware
* Practical experience improving automated testing, continuous integration, release processes and production reliability
* Evidence of delivering programmes spanning multiple teams, including teams outside your reporting line
* Experience architecting and operating cloud platforms, containerised workloads, and large-scale data processing or model training pipelines

**What Success Looks Like**

* Teams deliver predictably against a shared plan, with clear ownership and fewer late integration surprises
* Architecture supports product goals and makes the software easier to extend, test and maintain
* Releases produce measurable improvements in robot behaviour and reliability
* Recurring failures, escaped defects and avoidable engineering rework decrease
* Engineers and technical leads grow in capability, ownership and execution independence

Skills:- Robotics, Software architecture, Autonomy systems, ROS, C++, Python, Kubernetes, Cloud platforms, CI/CD, Software security, Engineering leadership and Hardware-in-the-loop testing

title: Senior Staff Solution Architect – Revenue Recognition (Oracle Fusion))
description:
**Job Description Summary**
This role is part of the IT Finance Systems team and provides senior solution leadership for Revenue Recognition as GE HealthCare migrates from Oracle E-Business Suite R12 to Oracle Fusion Cloud. We are looking for a revenue accounting practitioner who has delivered multiple ERP implementations across industries and can bring leading practices that go beyond any single platform. The role shapes global solution decisions and guides controlled, scalable revenue recognition capabilities across revenue management, accounting, integrations, and reporting.
  
  
**Job Description**
**In this role, you will**

* Act as the design authority for revenue recognition: define target-state business processes and the solution architecture across contract and performance obligation management, revenue accounting, adjustments, reconciliation, close, and reporting.
* Advise Finance, Controllership, Commercial, Tax, and business leaders on leading practices in revenue accounting, drawing on experience from other industries and challenging current ways of working where a process should change rather than be configured around.
* Lead revenue recognition design for contract and transaction scenarios, including performance obligations, allocation, satisfaction events, contract modifications, variable consideration, billing-versus-revenue differences, and period-end accounting, in line with approved accounting policies under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.
* Define and govern the use and integration of Revenue Management, Subledger Accounting, General Ledger, and upstream order, billing, and commercial systems that feed revenue contracts, evaluating options and documenting trade-offs, controls, and accounting impact.
* Provide hands-on application leadership for configuration, setup validation, and prototyping, and assess downstream business, accounting, control, security, reporting, and integration impacts.
* Lead workshops, fit-gap analysis, solution confirmation, and design reviews, and manage decisions, risks, and dependencies.
* Oversee and produce high-quality functional specifications, process flows, user stories, accounting examples, mappings, test scenarios, and acceptance criteria for RICE components; guide technical teams on source-to-target mappings, event and accounting logic, interface controls, error handling, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Define test strategy and lead CRP, SIT, UAT, regression, conversion, cutover, and validation of revenue contracts, revenue schedules, accounting entries, balances, and reports.
* Lead R12-to-Fusion migration and reconciliation of revenue contract, performance obligation, deferred or unearned revenue, and related accounting data.
* Drive training, deployment readiness, and hypercare, and own the solution beyond go-live, including controls, operational documentation, impact assessment of Oracle quarterly releases, enhancements, and continuous improvement.
* Mentor product team members, manage cross-workstream risks and dependencies, and communicate recommendations to senior stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, IT, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in revenue accounting or finance systems, including ERP implementations.
* Deep expertise in revenue accounting and recognition that does not depend on any one system: the ASC 606 / IFRS 15 framework, contract and performance obligation analysis, allocation, deferred and unearned revenue, contract modifications, and the relationship between contracts, billing, and GL accounting.
* Led or held a principal design role in at least three end-to-end ERP implementations across at least two different industries, covering revenue recognition.
* Proven ability to advise business stakeholders on alternative process models and leading practices, and to translate approved accounting policies into system requirements.
* Working expertise in Oracle Fusion Revenue Management, Subledger Accounting, and integration with Order Management, Receivables (as the billing source), GL, and upstream systems (or Oracle E-Business Suite R12 equivalents), sufficient to validate configuration and explain accounting, control, reporting, and integration impacts.
