title: Principal Pre-Silicon Firmware Lead
description:
**Description**
**Invent the future with us.**
Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.
  
  
As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.
  
  
Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a
**Principal Pre-Silicon Firmware Lead**
to architect and implement low-level software for our next-generation microcontrollers/ SoCs. You will bridge the gap between hardware architecture and final software delivery. You will own the pre-silicon development lifecycle—including driver development for CAN/CAN-FD/CAN XL stacks —using high-performance enterprise emulation environments and ensures hardware-software co-design that satisfies strict ISO 26262 safety and high-quality engineering frameworks up to ASIL-D.
  
  
**What You’ll Achieve**
**Technical Leadership & Hardware Co-Design**

* Drive firmware architecture and technical roadmaps for in-house microcontroller/ SOCs.
* Align development milestones with SoC architecture, RTL design, verification, and post-silicon validation teams.
* Provide technical mentorship and enforce rigorous coding standards (MISRA C/C++).
* Author comprehensive design specifications, firmware architecture documentation, and test strategies.

**Pre-Silicon Validation & Emulation**

* Develop early boot code, low-level drivers, and runtime firmware targeting pre-silicon environments.
* Lead virtual bring-up and hardware-software co-verification using both enterprise emulation platforms like Cadence Palladium/ Synopsys ZeBu.
* Optimize firmware execution speed
* Debug complex, deep-silicon anomalies using JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analysers, and internal emulator trace features.

**Communication Drivers & Protocols**

* Design, implement, and optimize highly robust peripheral drivers for CAN, CAN-FD, and CAN XL.
* Develop and maintain critical application layer protocols, featuring standard diagnostics (ISO 14229), network management, and heavy-duty diagnostic framing fault handling.
* Design, implement and Integrate communication driver stacks into industry standard layers (e.g., AUTOSAR MCAL interfaces).
* Deep knowledge of priority-based identifier arbitration, bit-stuffing mechanisms, and cyclical redundancy check (CRC) validation

**Safety & Quality Compliance**

* Enforce absolute compliance with ISO 26262 safety requirements.
* Participate in safety analyses (FMEA, root cause analysis) to ensure driver-level fault-handling routines are deterministic.

**About You**

* Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master’s degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware development, specifically within the embedded semiconductor or safety-critical industry
* 3+ years acting as a Technical Lead or Principal Engineer guiding architectural decisions and mentoring engineering teams.
* Expert proficiency in Embedded C with strict adherence to MISRA guidelines.
* Deep knowledge of embedded MCU/SoC architectures, including ARM Cortex-M/R or multi-core safety architectures.
* Direct hands-on experience with hardware emulation platforms, specifically Cadence Palladium and/or Synopsys ZeBu systems
* Authoritative understanding of industrial fieldbus architectures (ISO 11898 standard family), physical/data link layers, priority-based identifier arbitration, bit-stuffing mechanisms, and diagnostic implementations
* Proficient with professional embedded pipelines, including ARM compiler toolchains, JTAG debuggers (e.g., Lauterbach), and emulation control scripts
* Experience with ISO 26262 functional safety requirements up to ASIL-D
* Understanding of HSM/SHE concepts and secure boot requirements
* Experience building automated testing setups using Python and continuous integration tools (e.g., Jenkins)

**What We’ll Offer**
At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.
  
  
**Benefits Highlights Include**

* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.
  
  
Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

**Company:** Wildhub Designs Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Title:** Pre-DCR Draftsman / Building Plan Approval Draftsman  
**Location:** Bangalore, Karnataka  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years (Preferred)

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Pre-DCR Draftsman** with knowledge of building plan approval drawings, AutoCAD, Pre-DCR software, and local building regulations. The candidate will be responsible for preparing accurate architectural drawings for submission to BBMP/GBA and other relevant planning authorities.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare building plan approval drawings using AutoCAD and Pre-DCR software.
* Create Pre-DCR drawings with proper layers, polylines, and required drawing standards.
* Prepare floor plans, elevations, sections, site plans, and area statements.
* Ensure drawings comply with applicable building bye-laws, zoning regulations, setbacks, FAR/FSI, and parking requirements.
* Prepare drawings for residential, commercial, and mixed-use building approvals.
* Identify and rectify Pre-DCR drawing errors and scrutiny objections.
* Revise drawings according to authority requirements and client feedback.
* Coordinate with architects, engineers, and liaison officers for building plan approvals.
* Assist with online building plan submission, document preparation, and query compliance.
* Maintain proper records of approval drawings and revisions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Diploma in Civil Engineering / Architecture / Draftsmanship or relevant qualification.
* Proficiency in **AutoCAD and Pre-DCR software**.
* Knowledge of BBMP/GBA building plan approval procedures.
* Understanding of Karnataka building bye-laws and applicable planning regulations.
* Experience preparing sanction drawings and approval documentation.
* Ability to independently prepare error-free Pre-DCR drawings.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

Preferred Candidate

* Minimum 1 year of experience in Pre-DCR drafting and building plan approvals.
* Previous experience working with architects, planning consultants, or liaisoning firms.
* Familiarity with online building plan approval portals.
* Ability to handle multiple projects and meet submission deadlines.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹120,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule

title: Tech Lead - Hyderabad - WFO
description:
**Job Description –Tech Lead**

**Location:** Gachibowli, Hyderabad  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office (WFO)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 7+ Years

**Job Overview**

We are looking for an experienced **Tech Lead** with strong expertise in Java backend development, solution architecture, database technologies, and modern AI/ML and Agentic AI solutions.

The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in designing scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise applications, leading technical teams, and delivering end-to-end solutions from architecture and development through production deployment and support.

Candidates must have hands-on development experience and should have successfully deployed at least one project into a production environment, including experience handling production support and resolving critical technical issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Architecture & Solution Design**

* Design and develop scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise application architectures.
* Define technical architecture, application design patterns, coding standards, and development best practices.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate technologies, frameworks, and architectural approaches.
* Design microservices-based and distributed application architectures.

**2. Java Backend Development**

* Strong hands-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, and RESTful API development.
* Develop robust, reusable, maintainable, and high-performance backend services.
* Implement microservices, API integrations, and enterprise application components.
* Ensure code quality, security, scalability, and maintainability.

**3. Database Technologies – RDBMS & NoSQL**

* Strong experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Redis, or similar technologies.
* Design database schemas, optimize SQL queries, and improve database performance.
* Implement efficient data models, indexing, and transaction management strategies.

**4. AI/ML & Agentic AI Solutions**

* Design and integrate AI/ML-powered capabilities into enterprise applications.
* Hands-on exposure to Agentic AI solutions, AI agents, and LLM-based application development.
* Experience with LLM integration, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and AI orchestration frameworks.
* Understand how to integrate AI services with Java-based backend applications.
* Experience with Python backend development is an added advantage.

**5. Technical Leadership**

* Lead technical design discussions and drive architecture and implementation decisions.
* Own technical delivery, code quality, and engineering standards.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and implementation challenges.
* Collaborate with product owners, architects, DevOps, QA, and business stakeholders.

**6. CI/CD & DevOps Integration**

* Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and implementation.
* Working knowledge of tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment.
* Understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is preferred.

**7. Hands-on Development**

* Actively participate in coding, code reviews, debugging, and technical problem-solving.
* Develop prototypes and proof of concepts for complex technical requirements.
* Guide the team in implementing scalable and maintainable solutions.
* Balance technical leadership responsibilities with hands-on development.

**8. Team Leadership & Mentorship**

* Mentor and guide developers and technical team members.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to coding and architectural standards.
* Support team members in resolving complex technical challenges.
* Promote engineering best practices and continuous improvement.

**9. VAPT & Security Defect Closure**

* Work closely with security and testing teams to address VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing) findings.
* Analyze and resolve application security vulnerabilities.
* Drive timely closure of security defects and ensure compliance with security standards.
* Implement secure coding practices and application security best practices.

**10. Performance Optimization & Production Support**

* Identify and resolve application performance bottlenecks.
* Optimize backend services, database queries, APIs, and resource utilization.
* Handle production incidents, root cause analysis (RCA), and critical defect resolution.
* Ensure application stability, availability, scalability, and reliability.
* Participate in production releases, monitoring, and post-deployment support.

**Mandatory Skills & Experience**

* 7+ years of overall experience in software development and backend engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience in Java and Spring Boot.
* Experience in solution architecture and backend application design.
* Strong knowledge of RDBMS and NoSQL databases.
* Experience with microservices and REST API development.
* Exposure to AI/ML, LLM integration, or Agentic AI solutions.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Proven technical leadership and team mentoring experience.
* Hands-on experience in production support and troubleshooting.
* Must have successfully delivered and deployed at least one end-to-end project into a live production environment.
* Experience in VAPT findings analysis and security defect closure.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Python backend development (FastAPI, Flask, or Django).
* Agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar.
* RAG architecture, vector databases, and LLM integrations.
* Cloud-native application development (AWS/Azure/GCP).
* Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation.
* Observability, application monitoring, and distributed tracing.

**Candidate Expectations**

We are looking for someone who is:

* A strong hands-on Java backend engineer with architectural capabilities.
* Experienced in taking projects from design and development to production deployment.
* Comfortable handling production support and critical technical issues.
* Capable of leading a technical team while remaining actively involved in development.
* Familiar with emerging AI/ML and Agentic AI technologies.
* Focused on delivering secure, scalable, reliable, and high-quality solutions.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer {Mumbai}
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 80% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 80% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

**Our Product & Engineering Team:**
Liberis is building the embedded finance platform that lets partners around the world offer innovative funding products to their small business customers. We're a growth-stage fintech with teams in London, Nottingham, Atlanta, Stockholm, Munich and Mumbai, and we’re building a global Product, Data & Engineering team that thrives on autonomy, ownership, and is focused on impact! Our teams solve real-world problems for small businesses, shaping products that unlock opportunity at scale.
  
  
Engineering is going through an AI-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. It's changing what a small team can do! We empower our teams to make decisions, move fast, and take full responsibility for the solutions they deliver. You’ll join a team where curiosity is encouraged and collaboration across Product, Data, Delivery and Engineering is the norm.
  
  
Our Salesforce Team:
  
  
You’ll join the Salesforce engineering team within Liberis’ wider Technology function. The team owns and evolves the Salesforce platform that underpins how Liberis acquires, onboards, and supports merchants and partners across 15 markets. They also work closely with other engineering development teams, product teams, and business functions such as commercial and operations to turn business needs into reliable, well-built Salesforce solutions.
  
  
The role:
  
  
As a Senior Salesforce Developer, you’ll take ownership of complex Salesforce solutions from discovery through to production. You’ll work across both code and configuration, making informed technical decisions around architecture, automation, integrations, security, and maintainability.
  
  
You’ll be trusted to take ambiguous or complex requirements, work with stakeholders to understand the underlying problem, and shape a solution that is scalable and aligned with the wider Salesforce platform.
  
  
You’ll remain hands-on with Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations, and declarative tooling, while also acting as a technical point of reference for other members of the team. You’ll review code and designs, support colleagues through challenging technical problems, and help improve the engineering practices that underpin how Salesforce changes are developed and released.
  
  
Success in the role means consistently delivering high-quality solutions with a high degree of autonomy, making sound technical decisions, and having a positive impact on both the platform and the engineers around you.
  
  
What you’ll get to do:
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, and declarative tools such as Flow, validation rules, and Salesforce configuration.
* Own complex features and technical changes end to end, from understanding the business problem and shaping the technical approach through to testing, release, and production support.
* Make and contribute to technical design decisions across areas such as object modelling, automation, security and sharing, integrations, and platform architecture.
* Build and support integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, and other appropriate integration patterns.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs early, and communicate them clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Write high-quality, maintainable code and automated tests, and provide thoughtful code reviews that improve both the solution and the capability of the wider team.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues, investigate root causes, and help improve platform resilience and observability.
* Work closely with Product, Commercial, Operations, and other engineering teams to challenge requirements where appropriate and ensure solutions address the underlying business need.
* Contribute to the evolution of engineering practices across the team, including Git-based development, CI/CD, Salesforce DX, testing, release management, and documentation.
* Support and mentor other developers and admins, sharing knowledge and helping raise technical standards across the team.
* Proactively identify opportunities to simplify existing solutions, reduce technical debt, improve platform performance, and make Salesforce easier to maintain and evolve.
* Contribute to technical documentation and architectural decision-making so that knowledge is shared effectively across the team.

What we think you’ll need:
  
  

* Proven success in a hands-on Salesforce development role, with experience delivering and owning complex Salesforce solutions.
* Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, and SOQL/SOSL.
* Strong Salesforce configuration skills, including Flow, object modelling, validation rules, security, and sharing.
* Experience making or contributing meaningfully to technical design and architecture decisions, rather than only implementing predefined solutions.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, or similar integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of automated testing, code quality, and code review practices.
* Experience working with Git-based version control and modern Salesforce development and deployment practices.
* Ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical or production issues.
* Strong communication skills, with experience working directly with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand problems, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
* A collaborative approach and experience supporting, mentoring, or providing technical guidance to other developers.
* Good judgement around when to use code versus declarative Salesforce functionality, with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and platform health.

**Next steps**
If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
Even if you don’t meet every requirement, don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Chess (Internal Recruiter) on chess.crossley@liberis.com
  
  
Career development is really important to us here at Liberis, with progression opportunities for both individual contributors and people managers. You can have a look through our Engineering Career Framework via this link
  
  
**Our hybrid approach**
Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better, and build a great Liberis culture. Our hybrid working policy requires team members to be in the office at least 3 days a week. At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer {Mumbai}
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 80% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 80% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

The Senior IT Operations Lead will provide technical leadership and operational ownership of the organization's internal IT infrastructure and OT technology environment supporting Data Center operations. This is a senior hands-on individual contributor role within a captive Data Center organization, responsible for the reliability, security, availability, governance, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of the organization's own technology environment.

**Please Note: This is 70% hands on technical (Individual Contributor ) and 30% team management role. Candidates with stroing hands on IT Infrastructure and Data Center Operations experience are encouraged to apply. Candidates with predominatly managerial experince need not apply.**

**Duties & Responsibilities**

**1. IT Infrastructure Operations & Reliability**

• Provide technical and operational leadership for the organization's enterprise IT infrastructure supporting corporate and Data Center operations.

• Ensure the availability, reliability, performance, and security of infrastructure operating on a 24x7x365 basis.

• Oversee networking, servers and compute, virtualization, storage, backup, firewalls, security infrastructure, wireless, telephony, collaboration systems, end-user computing, and monitoring platforms.

• Drive proactive monitoring, capacity planning, performance optimization, technology lifecycle management, and operational KPI tracking.

**2. OT Security & Data Center Technology Environment**

• Support and govern IT and OT security procedures relevant to Data Center operations.

• Work closely with Data Center Operations, Engineering, Security, Automation, and Technology teams to ensure appropriate protection and segregation of IT and OT environments.

• Develop and maintain procedures for secure access, privileged access, remote connectivity, patching, vulnerability management, and system hardening.

• Support security assessments, audits, vulnerability remediation, risk mitigation, incident response, and root cause analysis involving IT and OT-related systems.

**3. IT Service Management & Operational Governance**

• Lead and continuously improve Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Configuration, and Asset Management processes.

• Analyse recurring incidents and operational trends and implement preventive and corrective actions.

• Drive service reviews, KPI reporting, risk tracking, root cause analysis, and continual service improvement.

**4. Infrastructure Architecture & Technology Lifecycle**

• Participate in infrastructure reviews and assess the impact of new systems, technology changes, and infrastructure enhancements.

• Provide recommendations for scalability, resilience, security, operational supportability, and risk mitigation.

• Support infrastructure modernization including cloud, hybrid infrastructure, software-defined networking, automation, and Infrastructure-as-a-Service models.

**5. SDLC, Change & Release Governance**

• Demonstrate strong awareness of SDLC and its impact on infrastructure and production environments.

• Work with application, automation, engineering, and technology teams to ensure infrastructure readiness for development, testing, deployment, and production releases.

• Ensure appropriate testing, documentation, rollback plans, approvals, risk assessments, and operational readiness before production implementation.

**6. Information Security, Compliance & Documentation**

• Support compliance with ISO 27001 and ISO 20000 requirements and maintain relevant operational documentation and evidence.

• Maintain infrastructure standards, procedures, architecture diagrams, Configuration Items (CIs), CMDB records, and IT asset documentation.

• Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings and compliance actions.

**7. Security, Monitoring & Critical Incident Management**

• Provide technical oversight for routers, switches, Layer 2/3 networks, firewalls, IPS/IDS, VPN, WAN, Wi-Fi, and connectivity infrastructure.

• Improve monitoring coverage, alert quality, operational visibility, and proactive issue detection.

• Lead technical investigations for major incidents, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.

**8. Vendor & Internal Stakeholder Management**

• Manage technical relationships and escalations with infrastructure, security, telecommunications, and technology vendors.

• Partner with internal Data Center Operations, Engineering, Information Security, Automation, Applications, Corporate IT, Facilities, and business stakeholders.

• Communicate technical risks, operational performance, improvement initiatives, and infrastructure status to senior stakeholders.

**9. Individual Contributor Technical Leadership**

• Act as a senior technical owner and subject matter expert, leading through technical expertise, governance, influence, and operational ownership.

• Work independently on complex technical and operational issues and mentor engineers where required.

• This is primarily a hands-on senior individual contributor role and is not intended to be a traditional service delivery, customer account management, or managed services role.

**Qualification & Experience**

15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, infrastructure operations, or IT operations leadership.

• Experience supporting business-critical, highly available, 24x7x365 infrastructure environments.

• Strong experience operating internal enterprise or captive technology environments; experience should not be limited to external customer managed services delivery.

• Strong technical experience across enterprise networking, Layer 2/3 infrastructure, routers, switches, firewalls, WAN, VPN, Wi-Fi, servers, virtualization, monitoring, infrastructure security, backup, and configuration management.

• Strong experience in Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Root Cause Analysis, KPI reporting, trend analysis, and continual service improvement.

• Practical understanding of IT and OT security principles, access management, vulnerability remediation, patching, infrastructure hardening, and operational security procedures.

• Strong awareness of SDLC, production change governance, release management, testing, risk assessment, rollback planning, and operational readiness.

• Experience with monitoring platforms such as Zabbix, Nagios, SolarWinds, Cacti, or similar tools.

• Experience conducting infrastructure architecture reviews and developing mitigation plans for technical and operational risks.

• Strong vendor management, stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving, documentation, written, and verbal communication skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

• Experience working in a Data Center operator or other mission-critical infrastructure environment.

• Exposure to OT environments supporting critical infrastructure, including Data Center automation, BMS, DCIM, SCADA, or similar operational technologies.

• Knowledge of OT/ICS security principles and industrial cybersecurity practices.

• Experience with public cloud, hybrid cloud, software-defined networking, infrastructure automation, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, or DevSecOps practices.

• Experience with Zero Trust, SIEM, SOC, EDR, vulnerability management, or security monitoring platforms.

• Experience with disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

**Preferred Certifications**

• CCNP or equivalent Cisco certification.

• CISSP, CISM, or equivalent information security certification.

• ITIL certification.

• Microsoft infrastructure, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), OT/ICS security, or Six Sigma/process improvement certifications.

**At BDx, we believe that our success lies in the hands of our talented and dedicated employees. Together, we are shaping the future of the data center industry and making a positive impact on the world.**

title: Principal Pre-Silicon Firmware Lead
description:
**Description**
**Invent the future with us.**
Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.
  
  
As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.
  
  
Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a
**Principal Pre-Silicon Firmware Lead**
to architect and implement low-level software for our next-generation microcontrollers/ SoCs. You will bridge the gap between hardware architecture and final software delivery. You will own the pre-silicon development lifecycle—including driver development for CAN/CAN-FD/CAN XL stacks —using high-performance enterprise emulation environments and ensures hardware-software co-design that satisfies strict ISO 26262 safety and high-quality engineering frameworks up to ASIL-D.
  
  
**What You’ll Achieve**
**Technical Leadership & Hardware Co-Design**

* Drive firmware architecture and technical roadmaps for in-house microcontroller/ SOCs.
* Align development milestones with SoC architecture, RTL design, verification, and post-silicon validation teams.
* Provide technical mentorship and enforce rigorous coding standards (MISRA C/C++).
* Author comprehensive design specifications, firmware architecture documentation, and test strategies.

**Pre-Silicon Validation & Emulation**

* Develop early boot code, low-level drivers, and runtime firmware targeting pre-silicon environments.
* Lead virtual bring-up and hardware-software co-verification using both enterprise emulation platforms like Cadence Palladium/ Synopsys ZeBu.
* Optimize firmware execution speed
* Debug complex, deep-silicon anomalies using JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analysers, and internal emulator trace features.

**Communication Drivers & Protocols**

* Design, implement, and optimize highly robust peripheral drivers for CAN, CAN-FD, and CAN XL.
* Develop and maintain critical application layer protocols, featuring standard diagnostics (ISO 14229), network management, and heavy-duty diagnostic framing fault handling.
* Design, implement and Integrate communication driver stacks into industry standard layers (e.g., AUTOSAR MCAL interfaces).
* Deep knowledge of priority-based identifier arbitration, bit-stuffing mechanisms, and cyclical redundancy check (CRC) validation

**Safety & Quality Compliance**

* Enforce absolute compliance with ISO 26262 safety requirements.
* Participate in safety analyses (FMEA, root cause analysis) to ensure driver-level fault-handling routines are deterministic.

**About You**

* Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master’s degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware development, specifically within the embedded semiconductor or safety-critical industry
* 3+ years acting as a Technical Lead or Principal Engineer guiding architectural decisions and mentoring engineering teams.
* Expert proficiency in Embedded C with strict adherence to MISRA guidelines.
* Deep knowledge of embedded MCU/SoC architectures, including ARM Cortex-M/R or multi-core safety architectures.
* Direct hands-on experience with hardware emulation platforms, specifically Cadence Palladium and/or Synopsys ZeBu systems
* Authoritative understanding of industrial fieldbus architectures (ISO 11898 standard family), physical/data link layers, priority-based identifier arbitration, bit-stuffing mechanisms, and diagnostic implementations
* Proficient with professional embedded pipelines, including ARM compiler toolchains, JTAG debuggers (e.g., Lauterbach), and emulation control scripts
* Experience with ISO 26262 functional safety requirements up to ASIL-D
* Understanding of HSM/SHE concepts and secure boot requirements
* Experience building automated testing setups using Python and continuous integration tools (e.g., Jenkins)

**What We’ll Offer**
At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.
  
  
**Benefits Highlights Include**

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) - Senior, Tax Technology Services**
Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service offerings have obtained support services through the USI Tax teams. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
Deloitte Tax is leading its clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace, offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and technical tax resources to comply with reporting requirements, uncover insights and deploy smarter approaches for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for an innovative Technical SAP ABAP on HANA, CDS, OData, RAP Plus Gen AI develop and implement systems architecture that meet business needs, along with ensuring that our clients’ can keep pace with the changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
Design, build, and support performance SAP S/4HANA extensions and services using ABAP on HANA, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), Core Data Services (CDS), and OData to enable modern Fiori/UI and integration scenarios.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best SAP Tax design for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group. You will also need to continually assess the SAP product suite and development roadmap to integrate any updated specifications and requirements into SAP system architecture.
  
  
You will also need to integrate with the wider client project team (whether that is delivered by Deloitte Consulting or another Systems Integration partner). This will involve an understanding of how the tax design interacts with other process flows and also the inter-personal skills to build the required relationships.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities -**

* Develop and enhance ABAP solutions on SAP S/4HANA using clean, modular, and testable patterns.
* Build Gen AI applications and AI Agents.
* Code Python is a plus.
* Ability to navigate fragmented landscapes through API-calls and MCP- servers is key.
* Build end-to-end RAP artifacts (behavior definitions/implementations, validations, determinations, actions, draft handling, locking, authorization concepts).
* Create and optimize CDS views (interface/consumption views, associations, annotations) with strong focus on pushdown and performance.
* Design, expose, and support OData services (preferably OData V4 via RAP; maintain OData V4 where required).
* Implement Fiori-enablement via CDS annotations and support UI integration with SAP Fiori elements (as applicable).
* Integrate with SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP-recommended patterns (e.g., APIs, events, messaging where applicable).
* Apply performance tuning (SQL optimization, buffering strategy, ST05/SAT/SQLM analysis, CDS performance best practices).
* Follow SAP extensibility guidelines (in-app/extensibility, key-user vs developer extensibility, released APIs, clean-core approach where applicable).
* Produce technical designs, code documentation, unit tests, and participate in code reviews.
* Support testing cycles, defect triage, hyper care, and production support with strong root-cause analysis

**Qualification And Experience Required -**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).
* 4+ years of Experience in SAP or SAP4HANA.
* Hands-on experience in building Gen AI applications, AI Agents.
* SAP Business AI certification is a plus.
* SAP certifications (ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, BTP) are a plus.
* Strong hands-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA / ABAP on HANA environments.
* Proven delivery experience with:
* RAP (managed/unmanaged as needed, behavior implementation, draft, authorization)
* CDS (views, annotations, associations, table functions if needed)
* OData service exposure and troubleshooting (RAP/OData V4 strongly preferred)
* Strong understanding of HANA-optimized development: SQL/CDS pushdown, avoiding SELECT-in-loops, efficient joins, pagination, etc.
* Familiarity with modern ABAP practices (e.g., ABAP OO, clean code, exception handling, unit testing mindset).
* Experience working in Agile delivery (user stories, estimation, sprint ceremonies).

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* SAP BTP exposure (e.g., Integration Suite, API Management, Event Mesh, ABAP environment/Steampunk—if relevant).
* BTP, Joule and SAP business AI certification.
* Proven knowledge of Tax touchpoints within SAP.

description:

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We are the trusted delivery partner for Salesforce Professional Services that ensures end to end multi-cloud delivery capabilities across all Salesforce technologies and scales with agility for successful customer outcomes! We at GDC strive to foster growth & innovation and enable for Salesforce Professional Services with focus on performance, productivity & impact.

Salesforce is currently seeking a Director, Technical Consulting (in the Architects’ Practice) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. description:
Tower is home to some of the world’s best systematic trading and engineering talent. We empower portfolio managers to build their teams and strategies independently while providing the economies of scale that come from a large, global organization.

Our ongoing investment in top engineering talent and technology ensures our platform remains unmatched in terms of functionality, scalability and performance.

At Tower, employees will find a stimulating, results-oriented environment where highly intelligent and motivated colleagues inspire each other to reach their greatest potential.

title: Insurance Client Systems - Fast Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
  
  
**Team Overview**
KKR’s Technology team is responsible for building and supporting the firm’s technological foundation including a globally distributed infrastructure, information security, and application and data platforms. The team drives a culture of technology excellence across the firm through efficient workflow automation, democratization of data through modern data and collaboration platforms, and more recently through research and development of Generative AI based tools and services.
  
  
Technology is regarded as a key business enabler at KKR and is an important accelerator to drive towards global scale creation and business process transformation. A dedicated Program Management function along with the Product Managers drive execution discipline across multiple technology teams with a goal to consistently deliver excellence serving our business needs. The Technology team consists of highly technical and business centric technologists with the ability to form strong partnerships across all of our businesses.
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a Senior FAST Engineer to lead the configuration, integration, and optimization of our FAST platform. This is a senior technical role for someone who can operate independently, set standards for configuration quality, mentor junior configuration analysts, and own the technical health of the FAST ecosystem end-to-end. The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on FAST configuration expertise with strong integration and solution-design skills, and can translate complex business requirements into scalable, maintainable configurations.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
FAST Configuration & Administration
  
  

* Requirements Leadership: Partner with business stakeholders to gather, challenge, document, and implement complex configuration requirements; translate ambiguous business needs into technical solutions
* Document Indexing: Design and maintain document indexing structures for efficient data retrieval and organization at scale
* Task Management: Architect, configure, and route tasks and workflows to support business processes
* User Access Administration: Own user permissions, roles, and access controls in accordance with security and compliance policies
* Accounting Configuration: Configure and maintain accounting-related processes, with attention to reconciliation and downstream financial reporting
* Data Reporting & Extracts: Build and optimize SQL-based reports and extracts to support business intelligence and operational needs
* eDelivery Workflows: Design and configure electronic delivery workflows to streamline document distribution
* Business Rules & Automation: Use data aggregations, decision tables, and XSLT scripts to configure business rules and drive operational efficiency

**Integration & Solution Design**

* Integration Management: Design, build, and manage integrations within the FAST ecosystem — including APIs, web services, batch/file interfaces, and data exchange with upstream/downstream systems (policy admin, GL, payments, third-party vendors)
* Solution Architecture: Contribute to technical design decisions, integration patterns, and configuration standards across the platform
* Environment & Release Management: Support configuration migration, versioning, and promotion across environments (dev → test → prod), following deployment best practices

**Technical Leadership**

* Mentorship: Guide and review the work of junior FAST configuration analysts; establish and enforce configuration standards and best practices
* Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis: Diagnose complex production issues spanning configuration, integrations, and data
* Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and design artifacts

**Qualifications**
**Experience**

* 3–5 years of hands-on FAST configuration experience across the modules above
* Demonstrated experience managing integrations within the FAST ecosystem (APIs, web services, batch interfaces, data exchange with external systems)
* Track record of independently delivering configuration work in a production environment

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of software development principles and deployment/release best practices
* Advanced SQL for querying, reporting, and extract generation (performance tuning a plus)
* Proficiency with XSLT scripting and data transformation
* Experience with configuration management, environment promotion, and system administration
* Familiarity with workflow automation and business process optimization

**Professional Attributes**

* Intuitive Problem Solver — anticipates issues and proactively identifies solutions
* Inquisitive Mindset — asks clarifying questions to ensure accurate requirement implementation
* Detail-Oriented — rigorous about configuration quality and testing
* Self-Motivated — works independently with minimal supervision
* Collaborative Leader — mentors others and communicates clearly with technical and business audiences

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of insurance/annuity industry processes and terminology
* Experience integrating FAST with policy administration, general ledger, or payment systems
* Background in business process improvement or operational efficiency projects
* Exposure to Agile/Scrum delivery and CI/CD practices

title: Engineering Manager, AI Builder Experience
description:
AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI — and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience org at MongoDB, we’re forming a brand new engineering team to make that happen, and we're looking for the founding Engineering Manager to hire the team, set the technical direction, and ship integrations into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech.
  
  
In this role, you'll be close enough to the code to jump into exploratory work yourself while also building the team, process, and operational rigor to keep a growing integration portfolio healthy long-term. The new team will work mostly in Python and TypeScript while collaborating closely with client library teams and other engineering groups across MongoDB that deliver the underlying driver, platform, and product capabilities needed to support these integrations well.
  
  
You’ll collaborate closely and move quickly with product, partners, field teams, the developer community, and open source project maintainers to ship where demand is real, deepen investment where adoption proves out, and evolve the portfolio over time as it becomes a critical part of MongoDB’s future in AI.
  
  
MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our values every day. We value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Position expectations
  
  

* Work closely with recruiting to hire a team of Python and TypeScript engineers who will build and own MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like Langchain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra
* Execute effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities may shift week to week based on framework changes, customer demand, partner needs, and strategic opportunity. Deliver quickly while keeping a high standard of technical quality
* Flag issues, concerns, and resource needs early, working with management to triage, staff, borrow expertise, and cross-functionally hand off completed projects as needed
* Work closely with product managers, program managers, sales, GTM, and peer engineering teams to define, prioritize, and deliver capabilities that improve the builder experience and strengthen MongoDB’s position in the AI framework ecosystem; help decide where to invest effort and where to pull back
* Manage dependencies on drivers, platform capabilities, and other MongoDB product surfaces required to deliver excellent framework integrations
* Collaborate with external teams who own open source projects MongoDB integrates with, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy to work effectively through external maintainer review cycles to land high-quality upstream contributions
* Jump in to do initial, exploratory work. Guide key decisions, unblock the team, and contribute when needed as projects grow
* Own the monitoring, operations, maintenance, and ongoing quality of a broad, evolving integration portfolio; develop testing strategy, release readiness, and operational follow-through after launch
* Help the team build and maintain sustainable engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, version compatibility awareness, and strong integration health over time
* Develop a team that stays current with the Python, TypeScript, and broader AI builder ecosystems, including important frameworks, community discussions, and emerging patterns; maintain awareness of trends and discourse in contemporary AI
* Bring a research and discovery mindset to the role, using customer, community, partner, and field signals to help guide roadmap and investment decisions; identify emerging opportunities in the ecosystem and help decide where early investment could create strategic advantage

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience building developer platforms, libraries, or other high-scale technical systems, with strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript and an ability to lead teams working across both the Python and TypeScript ecosystems. Experience working with programming language polyglot teams is a plus
* 3+ years of experience managing a team of software engineers and providing technical leadership for complex projects or products
* Experience with query optimization (especially MongoDB) and AI coding tools; distributed systems experience would be an asset
* Demonstrated success hiring, mentoring, and growing high-performing engineering teams, including experience supporting career development, feedback, and performance management
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving technical landscape with frequent context switching, incomplete information, and competing opportunities, while maintaining sound prioritization and strong judgment
* Strong technical depth in developer-facing software, with the judgment to make and guide architectural trade-offs
* Experience leading the launch of new features or systems and operating them successfully in production after release
* Excellent written and verbal technical communication, with a strong instinct to collaborate across engineering, product, and other stakeholder groups
* A track record of escalating issues early and fostering a team culture that values intellectual honesty and collaboration
* Comfort operating in ambiguous, evolving spaces and helping teams make progress when customer behavior, technical requirements, or ecosystem priorities are still taking shape
* Strong and demonstrated interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape, ideally with familiarity across frameworks, retrieval patterns, agent workflows, embedding, vector search, or adjacent areas; experience in this area would be an asset
* Experience working with open source software, external ecosystems, or integrations with third-party frameworks and communities, especially in the Python ecosystem; familiarity with open source contribution models, external maintainers, and engineering work that spans company-owned and upstream repositories would be a plus

Success measures
  
  

* In the first month, you will understand the team’s scope, the high-level architecture of the platform and integrations, the current portfolio of work, and the key technical and organizational dependencies around the role. You will start building relationships with cross-functional partners, especially recruiting, and develop a hiring plan
* In three months, in collaboration with our recruiting team, you will have a healthy candidate pipeline and the first members of your new team onboarding. You’ll have a hand-off plan with the teams currently owning AI Framework Integrations
* In six months, you will have staffed the core of your team, demonstrated effective partnership with recruiting, taken responsibility for major initiatives in the upcoming quarter, and improved the team’s ability to execute through technical and organizational ambiguity
* In twelve months, you’ll be having active growth conversations with your team members about performance and longer-term career development. You’ll have led the development and operation of multiple meaningful features or integrations and helped shape the forward-looking technical and execution strategy for this area

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

title: Design Technologist, eShop
description:
**Description**
Help shape the future of AI-powered creative production at Amazon. As a GenAI Design Technologist, you will pioneer the intersection of Generative AI and creative production - shipping tools and workflows that transform how product images and videos are created at scale.
  
  
We are operationalizing Generative AI for visual content creation. This team partners with world-class artists and scientists to push what's possible with image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal AI systems. You will work at the rare intersection where creative craft meets technical depth.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Develop, optimize, and scale Generative AI workflows and pipelines for production-grade visual content
* Act as the bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering - translating artistic intent into scalable technical solutions
* Build automation that removes bottlenecks and enables content creators to focus on what they do best
* Evaluate emerging foundational models and translate the latest research breakthroughs into production-ready capabilities
* Partner with engineers and scientists on prompt engineering frameworks and centralized GenAI tooling

This role is ideal for someone who's equal parts technologist and creative problem solver - someone who can evaluate output quality with a trained eye while optimizing the pipeline that produces it. You will ship work that directly impacts the shopping experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Develop, test, and optimize Generative AI workflows and pipelines for visual content production using inference platforms and services
* Act as a bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering - translating production needs into technical requirements and delivering working solutions
* Build and maintain automation scripts and tools that resolve workflow bottlenecks, improve content quality, and increase creator productivity
* Evaluate AI-generated output for visual quality, brand consistency, and production readiness - applying both technical metrics and creative judgment
* Support the fine-tuning, testing, and evaluation of foundational models and LLMs for image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal content creation
* Design and implement prompt engineering frameworks that enable consistent, high-quality results at scale across content types
* Collaborate with engineers and scientists to contribute to a centralized suite of GenAI tools used across visual content workflows
* Research and prototype emerging Generative AI capabilities - assessing production viability and recommending adoption paths to creative leadership
* Develop batch processing solutions and content pipelines that enable teams to generate, review, and publish AI-created assets efficiently
* Document workflows, best practices, and technical specifications to enable partner teams to adopt generative workflows independently
* Participate in cross-functional reviews to align AI tooling development with evolving creative standards and business requirements

A day in the life
  
  
In this role, you will move between creative and technical work. You might review AI-generated image outputs -tuning prompts and parameters to improve quality and consistency. Then shift to prototyping a workflow with a creative lead and ML engineer, translating a creative brief into a scalable technical solution. You could also be evaluating a new foundational model for production readiness or helping a partner team adopt your automation pipeline. Throughout it all, you will collaborate closely with creative directors, applied scientists, and content producers - solving the gap between what AI can technically generate and what meets the visual quality bar at scale.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our team builds how hundreds of millions of customers see products - through photography, video, CGI, and increasingly through Generative AI. We are a global network of creatives, technologists, and scientists unified by one mission: make every product look its best, at extraordinary scale. Our culture values builders who are curious, collaborative, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. We ship fast, learn from what breaks, and believe the best creative work happens when art and technology push each other forward.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science or equivalent
* 3+ years of experience in front-end technology, engineering, or UX prototyping
* Coding samples in front-end programming languages
* Available online portfolio demonstrating relevant work
* Experience with web, mobile web, or mobile app front-end development
* Experience with UI design for complex workflows and for end users
* Experience building scripts, tooling, and automation for large-scale computing environments
* Experience with prompt engineering techniques for content generation

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of technologies such as JavaScript/Node.js, HTML/CSS, Responsive/Adaptive Design
* Knowledge of Python, JavaScript, and source control (Git)
* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead, or leading an engineering team
* Knowledge of video production, live streaming technologies, studio workflows, edit and post-production techniques, production calendars and staffing

description:

You have:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, with 7+ years of experience in architecting software, IT, or telecom solutions.

* Extensive experience in telecommunications (4G/5GSA) with a deep understanding of Mobile Core network elements and technologies, their evolution, and the latest industry trends.
* Understanding of the interfaces and interactions between Mobile Core solution elements including 3rd parties.
* Experience in CSD/Signaling domain: SCP, SEPP, BSF, SLF, DRA, DEA, DFW, SLF and IWF.
* Competences on TCP/IP & main Protocols: Diameter (Gx-Rx-Sy)/ HTTP2/ SIP / Sigtran / SOAP-XML / SNMP.
* Competences in Java/J2EE, Linux, DBMS, web technologies, cloud/virtualization, Kubernetes, containers, SDN, and data analytics.
* Experience of Unix/Linux OS’s & Databases (Aerospike/MariaDB/Oracle/SQL)

**Job Summary**
As a Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer, you will design, develop, operate, and debug software and services that power OCI’s bare metal and GPU infrastructure. title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Now Assist-HRSD
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Now Assist & HRSD)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The role of Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of ServiceNow solutions focusing on HR Service Delivery as well as Now Assist capabilities (including AI agents, agentic workflows and now assist skills). In addition, this role would lead implementations to make ServiceNow as an orchestrator to call multiple AI agents within and outside of ServiceNow using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent-to-Agent protocol (A2A) to allow ServiceNow agents to invoke external data sets and APIs.
  
  
The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Implementation expertise of Now Assist capabilities (out of box and custom skills), agentic workflow and AI agents
* Experience in configuring out of box agentic workflows and implementing custom AI agents
* Understanding of A2A and MCP protocols
* Deep functional knowledge of LLMs, agentic patterns and API integration paths (REST)
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of HRSD and ITSM applications.
