title: DevOps Engineer - Manager
description:
**Role purpose**
----------------

You'll build and run the CI/CD pipelines which build state of the art application platforms and deploy AWS infrastructure for a multi-year programme moving a large portfolio of middle-office applications to AWS. This is a **hands-on engineering role** : most of your day is spent writing pipeline code, Terraform and scripts, and fixing builds and deployments. You'll work closely with full-stack application teams (ReactJS and Java), database engineers and SRE.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Build tooling**

* Set up and maintain front-end builds with **npm and pnpm** , vite, babel etc including workspaces/monorepos, dependency caching, lockfile management and private registries.
* Set up and maintain Java builds with **Maven and Gradle** , including multi-module projects, dependency management and build performance.
* Publish and version artifacts through Artifactory (or similar), and keep builds reproducible.

**CI/CD pipelines**

* Design and build pipelines in **Harness and GitHub Actions** for build, test, security scanning and deployment across all environments.
* Create reusable pipeline templates so application teams can onboard quickly and consistently.
* Add quality and security gates: unit tests, code coverage, SAST/SCA scanning, container image scanning and approval steps.
* Support blue/green and canary deployments, automated rollback and release tracking that meets State Street change management requirements.

**Infrastructure as code and AWS**

* Write and maintain **Terraform** modules for AWS: VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS/EKS, ALB, S3, RDS and related services.
* Manage Terraform state, module versioning and policy checks; detect and fix configuration drift.
* Build and run container platforms (Docker, ECS/EKS) for application workloads.
* Integrate secrets management (HashiCorp Vault/CyberArk) into pipelines and runtime environments.

**Linux**

* Build, harden and automate **Linux** servers and container images for applications moving off Solaris and Windows.
* Write Shell and Python scripts for automation, troubleshooting and operational tasks.
* Support migration of batch jobs and file transfers to the target platform (e.g. AutoSys, MFX/SFTP).

**Reliability and collaboration**

* Work with SRE to add logging, metrics and alerting (e.g. Dynatrace, Splunk) to pipelines and environments.
* Troubleshoot build, deployment and environment issues for application teams.
* Document runbooks and standards, and use AI assistants (e.g. GitHub Copilot) to speed up pipeline, Terraform and script development, with review.

**Required experience and skills**
----------------------------------

* 5+ years in DevOps, build or platform engineering roles.
* **Front-end builds:** practical experience with npm and pnpm for React/TypeScript projects.
* **Java builds:** strong experience with Maven and Gradle.
* **Terraform:** writing production modules and managing state for AWS.
* **AWS:** hands-on experience with core compute, networking, IAM, containers and managed services.
* **CI/CD:** building pipelines in Harness and/or GitHub Actions; Jenkins experience is a plus.
* **Linux:** strong administration, hardening and scripting (Bash, Python).
* Docker and Kubernetes/ECS/EKS.
* Git, branching strategies and pull-request workflows.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience in a regulated financial services environment.
* Experience with secrets management (Vault, CyberArk) and security scanning tools (e.g. SonarQube, Black Duck, Checkmarx).
* Experience with database change pipelines (Liquibase/Flyway).
* AWS certification (DevOps Engineer or SysOps Administrator) and/or HashiCorp Terraform certification.

**Success measures (first 12 months)**
--------------------------------------

* Reusable pipeline templates adopted by all modernization and migration teams.
* All target environments provisioned through Terraform, with no manual infrastructure changes.
* Faster, more reliable builds and deployments, measured against a baseline.
* No audit findings related to pipeline controls or secrets handling.

title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
**Role Summary:**
As an Application Security Engineer at JioStar, you will play a critical role in securing our applications, products, and user data across a large-scale, cloud-native streaming ecosystem. You will work closely with engineering, product, and security teams to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle, identify and remediate vulnerabilities, and drive secure-by-design practices across web, mobile, and backend applications.
  
  
This role requires strong expertise in application security, secure coding practices, security testing, and threat modeling, along with the ability to collaborate with engineering teams to build secure and resilient products at scale.
  
  
**About Us:**
Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Drive application security across the software development lifecycle, from design and development to deployment and production
* Conduct security assessments and identify vulnerabilities across web, mobile, APIs, backend services, and other application components
* Perform and support application security testing, including SAST, DAST, SCA, API security testing, and penetration testing
* Conduct threat modeling and security reviews for new features, products, and architectural changes, and provide actionable remediation recommendations
* Partner with engineering and product teams to identify security risks and implement secure-by-design and secure-by-default practices
* Review application architecture, design, and code to identify security weaknesses and recommend appropriate security controls
* Help define and maintain secure coding standards, application security guidelines, and security best practices across engineering teams
* Work with development teams to triage, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities based on severity, business impact, and exploitability
* Integrate security tools and automated security checks into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous security testing and shift-left security practices
* Develop automation and tooling using Python, Shell, or similar languages to improve application security processes and scale security assessments
* Assess third-party libraries, dependencies, APIs, and open-source components for security risks and vulnerabilities
* Support security incident investigations by analysing application logs, attack patterns, vulnerabilities, and potential areas of compromise
* Collaborate with engineering teams to address security risks related to authentication, authorization, session management, encryption, data protection, and API security
* Contribute to security reviews for web and mobile applications, including identifying common vulnerabilities such as OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security risks
* Help prepare security documentation, risk assessments, remediation reports, and evidence required for audits and compliance activities
* Stay updated on emerging application security threats, attack techniques, vulnerabilities, and industry best practices, and translate them into actionable security improvements

**Skills and attributes for success:**

* Hands-on experience in Application Security, Product Security, or Software Security Engineering
* Strong understanding of web, mobile, API, and backend application security
* Good understanding of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, secure coding practices, and common application vulnerabilities
* Experience with application security testing tools and methodologies, including SAST, DAST, SCA, API security testing, and penetration testing
* Experience with threat modeling, security architecture reviews, and secure SDLC practices
* Familiarity with common authentication and authorization mechanisms, encryption, API security, and data protection principles
* Experience integrating security tools and controls into CI/CD and DevSecOps workflows
* Strong scripting/programming skills in Python, Shell, Java, JavaScript, or similar languages
* Experience with vulnerability management, security risk assessment, and remediation tracking
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills
* Ability to work closely with engineering and product teams and influence secure development practices across the organization

**Preferred Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related technical field; a Master’s degree is a plus
* 3–6 years of experience in Application Security, Product Security, Security Engineering, or a related field
* Experience securing consumer-facing web, mobile, API, or large-scale digital products is preferred
* Experience working with fast-paced product engineering teams or media/OTT platforms is an added advantage
* Relevant security certifications such as OSCP, CEH, CSSLP, or equivalent are a plus

title: IT Operations Lead  - Hands on Technical Role (70% IC / 30% Team Management)
description:
**ABOUT US**

BDx Data Centers is an AI-ready digital infrastructure platform operating across Asia-Pacific, with data centers in Singapore, Indonesia, Hong Kong, and Taiwan, and new markets in development. We deliver the powered, cooled, and connected capacity customers need to scale AI, cloud, hyperscale, and enterprise workloads across the region.

Our platform brings together secured power access, high-density design, advanced cooling capabilities, interconnection, and local market execution to accelerate delivery from grid connection to live workload. With 1.2GVA+ of secured grid capacity and a platform spanning campuses, hyperscale facilities, colocation, and edge infrastructure, BDx is built to support the next generation of digital growth.

Backed by I Squared Capital, BDx is transformed for AI and proven at speed.

For more information, visit www.bdxworld.com

**Role Summary**

The Senior IT Operations Lead will provide technical leadership and operational ownership of the organization's internal IT infrastructure and OT technology environment supporting Data Center operations. This is a senior hands-on individual contributor role within a captive Data Center organization, responsible for the reliability, security, availability, governance, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of the organization's own technology environment.

**Please Note: This is 70% hands on technical (Individual Contributor ) and 30% team management role. Candidates with stroing hands on IT Infrastructure and Data Center Operations experience are encouraged to apply. Candidates with predominatly managerial experince need not apply.**

**Duties & Responsibilities**

**1. IT Infrastructure Operations & Reliability**

• Provide technical and operational leadership for the organization's enterprise IT infrastructure supporting corporate and Data Center operations.

• Ensure the availability, reliability, performance, and security of infrastructure operating on a 24x7x365 basis.

• Oversee networking, servers and compute, virtualization, storage, backup, firewalls, security infrastructure, wireless, telephony, collaboration systems, end-user computing, and monitoring platforms.

• Drive proactive monitoring, capacity planning, performance optimization, technology lifecycle management, and operational KPI tracking.

**2. OT Security & Data Center Technology Environment**

• Support and govern IT and OT security procedures relevant to Data Center operations.

• Work closely with Data Center Operations, Engineering, Security, Automation, and Technology teams to ensure appropriate protection and segregation of IT and OT environments.

• Develop and maintain procedures for secure access, privileged access, remote connectivity, patching, vulnerability management, and system hardening.

• Support security assessments, audits, vulnerability remediation, risk mitigation, incident response, and root cause analysis involving IT and OT-related systems.

**3. IT Service Management & Operational Governance**

• Lead and continuously improve Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Configuration, and Asset Management processes.

• Analyse recurring incidents and operational trends and implement preventive and corrective actions.

• Drive service reviews, KPI reporting, risk tracking, root cause analysis, and continual service improvement.

**4. Infrastructure Architecture & Technology Lifecycle**

• Participate in infrastructure reviews and assess the impact of new systems, technology changes, and infrastructure enhancements.

• Provide recommendations for scalability, resilience, security, operational supportability, and risk mitigation.

• Support infrastructure modernization including cloud, hybrid infrastructure, software-defined networking, automation, and Infrastructure-as-a-Service models.

**5. SDLC, Change & Release Governance**

• Demonstrate strong awareness of SDLC and its impact on infrastructure and production environments.

• Work with application, automation, engineering, and technology teams to ensure infrastructure readiness for development, testing, deployment, and production releases.

• Ensure appropriate testing, documentation, rollback plans, approvals, risk assessments, and operational readiness before production implementation.

**6. Information Security, Compliance & Documentation**

• Support compliance with ISO 27001 and ISO 20000 requirements and maintain relevant operational documentation and evidence.

• Maintain infrastructure standards, procedures, architecture diagrams, Configuration Items (CIs), CMDB records, and IT asset documentation.

• Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings and compliance actions.

**7. Security, Monitoring & Critical Incident Management**

• Provide technical oversight for routers, switches, Layer 2/3 networks, firewalls, IPS/IDS, VPN, WAN, Wi-Fi, and connectivity infrastructure.

• Improve monitoring coverage, alert quality, operational visibility, and proactive issue detection.

• Lead technical investigations for major incidents, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.

**8. Vendor & Internal Stakeholder Management**

• Manage technical relationships and escalations with infrastructure, security, telecommunications, and technology vendors.

• Partner with internal Data Center Operations, Engineering, Information Security, Automation, Applications, Corporate IT, Facilities, and business stakeholders.

• Communicate technical risks, operational performance, improvement initiatives, and infrastructure status to senior stakeholders.

**9. Individual Contributor Technical Leadership**

• Act as a senior technical owner and subject matter expert, leading through technical expertise, governance, influence, and operational ownership.

• Work independently on complex technical and operational issues and mentor engineers where required.

• This is primarily a hands-on senior individual contributor role and is not intended to be a traditional service delivery, customer account management, or managed services role.

**Qualification & Experience**

15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, infrastructure operations, or IT operations leadership.

• Experience supporting business-critical, highly available, 24x7x365 infrastructure environments.

• Strong experience operating internal enterprise or captive technology environments; experience should not be limited to external customer managed services delivery.

• Strong technical experience across enterprise networking, Layer 2/3 infrastructure, routers, switches, firewalls, WAN, VPN, Wi-Fi, servers, virtualization, monitoring, infrastructure security, backup, and configuration management.

• Strong experience in Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Root Cause Analysis, KPI reporting, trend analysis, and continual service improvement.

• Practical understanding of IT and OT security principles, access management, vulnerability remediation, patching, infrastructure hardening, and operational security procedures.

• Strong awareness of SDLC, production change governance, release management, testing, risk assessment, rollback planning, and operational readiness.

• Experience with monitoring platforms such as Zabbix, Nagios, SolarWinds, Cacti, or similar tools.

• Experience conducting infrastructure architecture reviews and developing mitigation plans for technical and operational risks.

• Strong vendor management, stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving, documentation, written, and verbal communication skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

• Experience working in a Data Center operator or other mission-critical infrastructure environment.

• Exposure to OT environments supporting critical infrastructure, including Data Center automation, BMS, DCIM, SCADA, or similar operational technologies.

• Knowledge of OT/ICS security principles and industrial cybersecurity practices.

• Experience with public cloud, hybrid cloud, software-defined networking, infrastructure automation, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, or DevSecOps practices.

• Experience with Zero Trust, SIEM, SOC, EDR, vulnerability management, or security monitoring platforms.

• Experience with disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

**Preferred Certifications**

• CCNP or equivalent Cisco certification.

• CISSP, CISM, or equivalent information security certification.

• ITIL certification.

• Microsoft infrastructure, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), OT/ICS security, or Six Sigma/process improvement certifications.

**At BDx, we believe that our success lies in the hands of our talented and dedicated employees. Together, we are shaping the future of the data center industry and making a positive impact on the world.**

title: Automation Tech Lead - Power platforms
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. **The Role**

**Your Role:**

  

As a Automation Tech Lead - Power platforms, you will provide technical leadership for the design, development, integration, deployment, and operational support of enterprise automation solutions. You will leverage Microsoft Power Platform, UiPath, Azure, and related technologies to deliver scalable, secure, and supportable automation solutions while leading engineering teams, driving operational excellence, and ensuring continuous platform improvement.

* Lead automation operations, service transition, monitoring, maintenance, upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives across production environments.

* Define and enforce standards for development, architecture, security, documentation, exception handling, logging, quality assurance, and production readiness.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex incidents, integration failures, runtime issues, performance bottlenecks, and environment-related challenges.
Collaborate with business, product, platform, and engineering teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and compliant automation solutions while managing stakeholder expectations.  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* 7-15 years of experience, including significant hands-on experience in automation engineering, technology development, and enterprise automation operations.

Strong technical leadership, stakeholder management, Agile delivery, communication, analytical, problem-solving, and team mentoring capabilities.  

  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

* Strong knowledge of ITSM processes and tools such as Jira Service Management, Jira, SharePoint, Wrike, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience designing scalable automation frameworks, reusable components, DevOps practices, and governance models.
* Microsoft certifications including PL-400 (Power Platform Developer Associate), PL-500 (Power Automate RPA Developer Associate), PL-900, AZ-900, or equivalent certifications.
Professional certifications in Agile Service Management, GitHub Copilot, or automation technologies such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism are preferred.

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

We’re here to champion your journey. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: QA Automation - Manager
description:
**Role purpose**
----------------

You'll design, build and maintain automated end-to-end tests for a multi-year programme modernizing a large portfolio of middle-office applications and moving them to AWS. This is a **hands-on engineering role** : most of your time is spent writing test code with modern automation frameworks and running it in CI/CD pipelines. You'll help prove that modernized and migrated applications behave the same as, or better than, the legacy systems they replace. You'll use AI coding tools to speed up writing and maintaining tests.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**End-to-end UI test automation**

* Design and build a scalable UI automation framework using **Playwright, Cypress, Selenium WebDriver or WebdriverIO** , with the Page Object Model or Screenplay pattern, fixtures and reusable helpers.
* Write automated end-to-end tests for ReactJS applications that cover critical user journeys in trade processing, reconciliation, settlement and operations.
* Test real-time features delivered over **WebSockets and Server-Sent Events** , such as live updates, reconnection and message ordering.
* Make tests reliable and fast: stable locators, smart waits, parallel execution (e.g. Selenium Grid or cloud grids like BrowserStack/Sauce Labs) and fixing flaky tests.
* Cover cross-browser, accessibility (axe-core) and visual regression testing (Applitools, Percy or Playwright snapshots) where it adds value.

**Behaviour-driven and component testing**

* Write BDD scenarios with **Cucumber (Java or JS) or SpecFlow-style tools** , so business analysts and subject-matter experts can read and confirm test coverage.
* Support component-level testing with **React Testing Library, Vitest/Jest or Cypress Component Testing** , working with developers.

**API, contract and integration testing**

* Automate **REST API** tests using **REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman or Playwright API testing** .
* Write consumer-driven contract tests with **Pact** , and validate against OpenAPI specifications.
* Test event-driven integrations (Kafka/MQ) by publishing test messages and checking downstream results, using tools such as Testcontainers.
* Use mock servers and service virtualisation ( **WireMock, MockServer** ) to test components independently.

**Migration and data validation**

* Build automated comparison tests that check outputs from legacy and modernized systems match during parallel runs (reports, files, database results).
* Validate batch and end-of-day processing results, and support reconciliation with data engineers.
* Manage test data, including masking and creating realistic financial test data sets.

**Performance testing**

* Build and run load and performance tests with **k6, JMeter or Gatling** to confirm modernized services meet or beat current response times and batch windows.

**CI/CD and reporting**

* Run test suites in **Harness, GitHub Actions or Jenkins** pipelines as quality gates on every build and deployment.
* Run tests in containers and on cloud test infrastructure for speed and scale.
* Publish clear test reports, traces and dashboards ( **Allure, ExtentReports or framework-native reports** ) for engineers and release managers.

**AI-assisted testing**

* Use **GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and/or Devin** to generate test cases, page objects and test data, and to analyse failures.
* Use AI to draft test scenarios from requirements and from legacy application behaviour, then review them with business analysts.
* Review all AI-generated tests carefully for real coverage and meaningful checks, not just passing tests.

**Collaboration**

* Work with developers, business analysts and subject-matter experts to agree acceptance criteria and test coverage.
* Take part in code reviews and promote testable design and shift-left practices.
* Support cutover rehearsals, release testing and early-life support.

**Required experience and skills**
----------------------------------

* 5+ years in test automation or software engineering in test.
* **UI automation:** strong hands-on experience with **at least one** of Playwright, Cypress, Selenium WebDriver or WebdriverIO, and working knowledge of at least one other.
* **Programming:** strong coding skills in **TypeScript/JavaScript and/or Java** ; tests are treated as production code.
* **API testing:** experience automating REST API tests with REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman or similar.
* **BDD:** experience writing and maintaining Cucumber (or similar) scenarios.
* **Web testing:** solid understanding of modern ReactJS applications, the DOM, browser dev tools and network inspection.
* **CI/CD:** running automated tests in pipelines (Harness, GitHub Actions or Jenkins).
* **SQL:** ability to write queries to set up and check test data.
* Git, Docker and agile delivery.
* Regular use of AI coding assistants in professional work.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with several UI frameworks and migrating test suites between them (e.g. Selenium to Playwright).
* Contract testing with Pact and service virtualisation with WireMock.
* Performance testing with k6, JMeter or Gatling.
* Experience testing WebSocket, SSE, Kafka/MQ or batch processing.
* Testing migration or modernization programmes, including parallel runs and data reconciliation.
* Experience in financial services, ideally trading, settlement, collateral or accounting.
* ISTQB Advanced Test Automation Engineer or equivalent certification.

**Success measures (first 12 months)**
--------------------------------------

* A standard automation framework and patterns adopted across all modernization teams, with critical user journeys automated.
* UI, API and contract test suites running as quality gates in CI/CD for every application in scope.
* Low flaky-test rate and fast feedback times, measured against an agreed target.
* Automated parallel-run comparisons supporting cutover sign-off.
* Fewer defects escaping to UAT and production, compared with a baseline.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

  
  

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. title: Project Manager
description:
Job Description: Senior IT Project Manager – Technology & Software Development

**Experience:** 5–8+ Years  
**Department:** Technology / Product & Engineering  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Industry:** IT Services, Software Development, SaaS, AI/ML & Digital Technology  
**Work Mode:** On-site / Hybrid  
**Seniority:** Senior-Level Management

1. About the Role

We are looking for an exceptional, results-driven Senior IT Project Manager with 5+ years of experience in managing complex technology projects, leading cross-functional engineering teams, and delivering high-quality software products and enterprise technology solutions.

The ideal candidate must possess a strong combination of technical expertise, strategic thinking, project governance, stakeholder management, resource planning, and execution excellence.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete project lifecycle, from project initiation and requirement gathering to strategic planning, development, testing, deployment, and post-launch optimization.

This position requires an experienced technology leader capable of managing multiple large-scale digital products simultaneously, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, maintaining delivery excellence, and aligning technology execution with business objectives.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Strategic Project Leadership

* Own end-to-end delivery of multiple IT, software development, SaaS, and technology projects.
* Define project objectives, scope, deliverables, milestones, timelines, and success criteria.
* Develop strategic project roadmaps aligned with organizational goals.
* Drive project execution while ensuring quality, efficiency, and timely delivery.
* Manage project dependencies, priorities, resource allocation, and competing business requirements.
* Establish project governance frameworks, delivery standards, and operational processes.
* Ensure accountability and ownership across all project teams.

B. Software Development & Technical Project Management

* Manage the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Coordinate with frontend, backend, Android, iOS, DevOps, QA, UI/UX, and product engineering teams.
* Oversee web applications, mobile applications, APIs, microservices, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise software development.
* Work closely with engineering leaders to understand technical architecture, integrations, and development dependencies.
* Ensure adherence to coding standards, development processes, security requirements, and deployment practices.
* Monitor development progress and proactively resolve technical and operational blockers.
* Ensure seamless integration between frontend, backend, mobile applications, databases, and third-party services.

C. Agile & Scrum Management

* Implement and manage Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid project management methodologies.
* Lead sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and backlog refinement.
* Define sprint goals, track velocity, monitor deliverables, and manage sprint commitments.
* Ensure effective collaboration between product owners, developers, QA engineers, and stakeholders.
* Manage product backlogs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release planning.
* Continuously improve development workflows and team productivity.

D. Team Leadership & Resource Management

* Lead and manage cross-functional teams of developers, designers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, and business analysts.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and performance expectations.
* Allocate resources based on project priorities and delivery requirements.
* Identify skill gaps, resource constraints, and operational challenges.
* Monitor individual and team performance.
* Mentor team members and build a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
* Ensure effective collaboration across distributed and multidisciplinary teams.

E. Project Planning, Budgeting & Financial Control

* Prepare comprehensive project plans, resource plans, and delivery schedules.
* Develop and manage project budgets, cost estimates, and resource utilization.
* Monitor project expenditure against approved budgets.
* Identify cost optimization opportunities without compromising quality.
* Track project profitability, operational efficiency, and delivery performance.
* Prepare resource allocation and capacity planning reports.

F. Stakeholder & Client Management

* Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.
* Communicate project progress, risks, dependencies, and delivery expectations.
* Conduct executive reviews, client meetings, and project governance discussions.
* Manage expectations, escalations, scope changes, and critical decisions.
* Translate complex technical information into clear business communication.
* Coordinate with senior management, product leadership, engineering heads, and business teams.

G. Quality Assurance & Delivery Excellence

* Collaborate with QA teams to establish comprehensive testing strategies.
* Oversee functional, integration, regression, performance, security, compatibility, and UAT testing.
* Ensure critical bugs and release-blocking issues are resolved before production deployment.
* Establish quality gates and release acceptance criteria.
* Monitor defect trends, testing coverage, and resolution cycles.
* Drive continuous improvement in product quality, stability, and customer experience.

H. Risk Management & Problem Resolution

* Identify, assess, prioritize, and mitigate project risks.
* Maintain risk registers, issue logs, and mitigation plans.
* Proactively resolve delivery bottlenecks and cross-team dependencies.
* Lead root cause analysis for major project delays and production issues.
* Establish contingency plans for critical milestones and releases.
* Escalate critical risks and provide actionable recommendations to management.

I. Reporting, Documentation & Governance

* Prepare executive-level project reports, dashboards, and delivery scorecards.
* Maintain project documentation, BRDs, PRDs, SRS, technical specifications, and meeting minutes.
* Track KPIs, milestones, sprint performance, budget utilization, and delivery health.
* Ensure transparent reporting and timely escalation of critical issues.
* Establish standardized project management processes across teams.
* Present weekly, monthly, and quarterly project performance reports to senior management.

3. Company Product Portfolio & Project Ownership

The candidate will be responsible for managing and overseeing the complete development lifecycle, operational delivery, enhancements, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the company's five technology platforms.

1. WN Social – Social Networking Platform

* Manage the overall product development and delivery roadmap.
* Oversee social networking functionalities, user profiles, news feeds, posts, stories, reels, and video sharing.
* Manage social engagement features, likes, comments, shares, reposts, followers, and communities.
* Oversee messaging, notifications, content discovery, search, Explore, Trending, and hashtag functionalities.
* Coordinate creator tools, professional accounts, analytics, and monetization features.
* Manage admin dashboards, content moderation, reporting, and platform security.
* Drive web and Android application development, performance optimization, and scalability.

2. Werfie – Digital Social & Content Platform

* Manage the overall product roadmap and development lifecycle.
* Oversee social networking, multimedia uploads, content sharing, and engagement functionalities.
* Coordinate user profiles, feeds, notifications, discovery, and interaction modules.
* Manage web and Android application development.
* Drive feature enhancements, bug resolution, performance optimization, and product stability.
* Coordinate backend integrations, administration, and platform management.

3. Seezitt – Social & Digital Platform

* Manage complete product development and feature delivery.
* Oversee core platform functionality, content creation, publishing, and engagement.
* Coordinate social interaction, communication, and user experience modules.
* Manage search, discovery, and platform enhancements.
* Oversee web and Android application development.
* Coordinate backend services, APIs, database integrations, and quality assurance.
* Drive application performance, reliability, and continuous product improvements.

4. Omre – Digital & Social Technology Platform

* Manage the complete Android application development and product lifecycle.
* Coordinate core product modules, feature development, integrations, and user workflows.
* Oversee AI-enabled capabilities and intelligent product functionalities, where applicable.
* Manage backend services, admin panel functionalities, and operational workflows.
* Drive application performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Coordinate QA, regression testing, release management, and deployment.
* Ensure continuous feature enhancements and product optimization.

5. Vidmero – Video & Digital Content Platform

* Manage the complete product development and delivery roadmap.
* Oversee video content creation, uploading, publishing, and multimedia management.
* Coordinate video streaming, processing, encoding, and playback functionalities.
* Manage content discovery, user engagement, and platform workflows.
* Coordinate backend infrastructure, APIs, and third-party integrations.
* Drive application performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Ensure quality assurance, release management, and continuous improvements.

4. Cross-Platform Technology & Delivery Management

* Take complete ownership of project planning and delivery across all five platforms.
* Manage multiple product roadmaps, releases, development cycles, and technical dependencies simultaneously.
* Coordinate web, Android, iOS (where applicable), backend, API, database, cloud infrastructure, and administrative systems.
* Ensure consistent development standards and quality benchmarks across all products.
* Track feature completion, unresolved bugs, technical debt, and development progress.
* Establish structured QA, testing, bug tracking, retesting, and release approval processes.
* Coordinate with Product Managers, Business Heads, Marketing Teams, and senior management.
* Ensure product performance, scalability, security, reliability, and user experience.
* Monitor production issues, application stability, and post-release performance.
* Prepare consolidated weekly and monthly project reports covering all five products.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and engineering efficiency.

5. Required Technical Knowledge & Skills

The candidate must have a strong understanding of the following technology domains:

**Software Engineering**

* Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Frontend and backend development concepts.
* Web application and mobile application architectures.
* REST APIs, GraphQL, microservices, and third-party integrations.
* Database architecture, SQL, and NoSQL technologies.
* System architecture, integrations, and application security.

**Cloud & DevOps**

* AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Docker, Kubernetes, and containerization.
* CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
* GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and version control.
* Infrastructure monitoring, application performance, and cloud scalability.

**Quality Assurance**

* Manual and automated testing methodologies.
* Functional, regression, integration, and performance testing.
* API testing and security testing fundamentals.
* Bug tracking, defect management, and release validation.
* UAT coordination and quality control.

**Project & Product Management**

* Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and Waterfall methodologies.
* Product roadmaps, sprint planning, and backlog management.
* Requirement gathering, BRD, PRD, and technical documentation.
* Project budgeting, resource planning, and delivery governance.
* Stakeholder communication and executive reporting.

6. Project Management Tools & Platforms

* Jira and Confluence.
* Azure DevOps.
* Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, and Trello.
* Microsoft Project and Microsoft Planner.
* Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Google Workspace.
* Power BI, Tableau, and Advanced Excel.
* GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket.

7. Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5+ years of proven experience in IT project management or software project delivery.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple technology projects simultaneously.
* Proven track record of delivering complex software projects within agreed timelines and budgets.
* Experience managing cross-functional engineering and technology teams.
* Strong understanding of Agile project management and software development processes.
* Experience in web applications, mobile applications, SaaS platforms, or digital products.
* Strong technical understanding of software architecture, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps.
* Excellent stakeholder management, leadership, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.

8. Preferred Certifications

* PMP – Project Management Professional.
* PMI-ACP – Agile Certified Practitioner.
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM).
* Professional Scrum Master (PSM).
* PRINCE2 Practitioner.
* SAFe Agilist.
* ITIL 4 Foundation.

9. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated against measurable business and delivery outcomes:

* **On-Time Delivery:** Percentage of projects delivered within committed timelines.
* **Budget Adherence:** Ability to execute projects within approved budgets.
* **Project Success Rate:** Achievement of agreed project objectives and deliverables.
* **Sprint Predictability:** Accuracy of sprint planning and commitment completion.
* **Team Productivity:** Effective utilization of engineering and operational resources.
* **Quality Metrics:** Reduction in critical bugs, production defects, and rework.
* **Stakeholder Satisfaction:** Internal and external stakeholder satisfaction.
* **Risk Management:** Early identification and resolution of project risks.
* **Resource Optimization:** Effective allocation and utilization of team resources.
* **Product Delivery:** Successful development and release of planned product features across all five platforms.
* **Production Stability:** Reduction in application downtime, recurring issues, and production incidents.
* **Process Improvement:** Continuous improvement in delivery efficiency and operational performance.

10. Leadership Competencies

* Strategic thinking and business-oriented decision-making.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to lead large, distributed, and cross-functional teams.
* High-level problem-solving and conflict-resolution capabilities.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and changing priorities.
* Strong execution discipline and attention to detail.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.
* Ability to balance business priorities with technical requirements.
* Strong decision-making and execution capabilities.

11. What We Expect

We are looking for a technology leader who does more than track project timelines, assign tasks, or conduct meetings.

The ideal candidate must take complete ownership of project outcomes, understand engineering challenges, align technology execution with business strategy, and consistently deliver measurable results.

The candidate must be capable of managing multiple complex digital products simultaneously, leading multidisciplinary teams, driving product innovation, maintaining engineering standards, and ensuring world-class software delivery.

**The successful candidate will be someone who can lead people, manage technology, control budgets, drive execution, oversee multiple products, and deliver scalable, secure, reliable, and high-performance technology solutions.**

**Our expectation is complete project ownership, operational excellence, engineering coordination, and measurable business results across WN Social, Werfie, Seezitt, Omre, and Vidmero.**

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹90,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* Project management: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

description:
**Job Title:**
AI Data Analyst Intern
  
  
**Location:**
Pune (on-site)
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
12:00 PM – 8:30 PM IST
  
  
**Duration:**
6 months
  
  
**About Amber**
Amber is a long-term accommodation booking platform for students (think booking.com for student housing). We help 80M+ students globally find and book full-time accommodation near their universities, without the hassle of negotiations, non-standardized paperwork, or broken payment processes.
  
  
We are the largest and fastest-growing student housing platform globally, with 1M+ units across 6 countries and 100+ cities, backed by $21M in institutional funding led by Gaja Capital.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As an AI Data Analyst Intern, you’ll work on real analytical projects for our business, operations, and product teams, using AI tools as a core part of how you work. We want someone who uses AI to move faster and still checks every number before it reaches a stakeholder.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own project-specific analyses for business, operations, or product teams.
* Write, debug, and optimize SQL queries, using AI assistants to speed up the work and validating every result yourself.
* Build and maintain dashboards in Tableau / Power BI to track key metrics and trends.
* Use AI chatbots (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) and AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) to explore data, automate repetitive reporting, and prototype small tools.
* Find patterns, gaps, and opportunities in the data, and turn them into clear recommendations.
* Present insights to stakeholders in a clear, structured way.
* Document prompts, workflows, and automations so the team can reuse them.

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions).
* Working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets (pivots, lookups) and Tableau and/or Power BI.
* Regular, hands-on use of AI chatbots for real work, not just casual use.
* Basic experience with at least one AI coding tool or agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, or similar).
* Have built something of your own using AI: an app, a script, a dashboard, an automation, or an analysis. Shipped, rough, or half-broken all count. We want to see that you built it.
* Habit of checking AI output against the source data.
* Able to work independently on defined projects and meet timelines.

**Nice to Have**

* Python (pandas) for analysis.
* Familiarity with APIs, MCP, or connecting AI tools to data sources.
* Experience with Metabase, GA4, or product analytics tools.

Send your resume along with:
  
  

* A link to something you built with AI (GitHub repo, live demo, Loom walkthrough, or Notion write-up).
* 3–5 lines covering what it does, which AI tools you used, and one thing the AI got wrong that you had to fix.

*Applications without a project link will not be considered.*
**Why Join Amber?**

* Work on real business problems at a global, high-growth startup.
* Live projects, not mock assignments.
* AI-first workflows: you’ll use and help shape how our analytics team works with AI.
* Learn hands-on from experienced analysts and business leaders.
* Fast-paced, collaborative, learning-focused culture.

description:
**Role Summary**
The Principal Insights Engineer is the senior technical individual contributor responsible for turning analytical technology into scalable, reliable, and usable products for business stakeholders.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of BI and Data Science with a flavor of Data Engineering; This role focuses on technology innovation, operationalizing forecasting, building internal applications for insight delivery.
  
  
This individual is expected to deliver value by building solutions, interfaces, and pipelines that bring analytical logic to life and allow business users to make better decisions at scale.
  
  
Their focus on the technology space allows them to drive innovation so that project leads, BI Developers, and other technical practitioners can use new tools and technologies to better deliver value to the business.

**Technical Innovation**

* Grow our ability to deploy ML Models and use the outputs in Business Intelligence tools.
* Apply new tools or new features to existing business cases to determine the usability

**Insight Product Engineering**

* Convert data science models into production-ready forecasting systems that are versioned, monitored, documented, and reliable.
* Promote product-level data quality with technical controls such as data quality checks, and automated monitoring to ensure forecasting runs as expected.
* Prototype new ways of consuming insights that go beyond dashboards.
* Build and enhance custom data applications (e.g., Streamlit apps or embedded analytics experiences) that make advanced analytics easy for business partners to use.
* Develop scalable approaches for integrating forecasts and advanced analytics into business workflows.

**Reliability, Observability & Maintainability**

* Improve reliability of new analytical solutions by developing monitoring and alerting tools ensure insight products operate consistently.
* Build tests and right-sized automation to reduce breakage and manual effort.

* Work closely with BI Lab leadership on prioritization and business alignment.
* Partner with data scientists on inputs/outputs, feature sets, and model expectations.
* Collaborate with IT and Data Teams to follow guidance on pipelines, compute, and tooling as well as to support scaled development.
* Ask detailed questions directly to clarify requirements when needed.

**Hands-On Technical Execution**

* Operate as an 50% builder / 50% guide.
* Deliver usable solutions quickly, with the understanding that internal IT partners can provide architectural refinement over time.
* Create initial patterns for forecasting, insight delivery, and lightweight applications that can scale as demand grows.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8-10 years of experience in BI tooling and experience with Machine Learning Models or similar roles with strong experience in data/analytics.
* Demonstrated experience building and deploying production-grade analytical tools. Including Experience operationalizing machine learning or forecasting models.
* Strong Python and SQL skills and ability to work with complex data structures.
* Experience implementing data quality checks, monitoring, alerting, or other observability practices.
* Ability to build internal-facing tools or applications using low code/no code apps
* Strong communication skills; able to ask clarifying questions and work independently with minimal specification.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with feature engineering pipelines.
* Exposure to CI/CD concepts for data or application deployment.
* Experience building internal tools or user interfaces for consuming analytics.
* Prior work in a global or cross-functional technical environment

title: Supply Chain Coordinator - Level II - SHOP
description:
**Job Summary**
Under general supervision, uses statistical analysis, collaborative cross-functional intelligence, and validated planning parameter settings to disaggregate the demand plan and determine the optimal inventory levels. Aligns the supply plan with the demand plan and drives stability in the supply chain.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE)
  
  
Reports any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard.
  
  
Complies with HSE standards, policies, procedures & regulations.
  
  
Engages in HSE training.
  
  
Quality
  
  
Follows applicable standard work, process documentation, and quality procedures.
  
  
Performs quality checks on system planning parameters (min/max inventory level, re-order point, upper/lower tracking signals, segments, etc.) taking action to support Plan for Every Part (PFEP).
  
  
Delivery
  
  
Performs supply and demand analysis, highlighting areas of concern for the next 12 months.
  
  
Assists others in gathering and compiling information through primary and secondary research.
  
  
Runs planning parameter setting changes in the simulation environment to analyze the impact to KPIs, and provides executive and detailed report of results.
  
  
Monitors signals indicating abnormal demand and/or stock levels feeding the supply schedule.
  
  
Makes adjustments to the planning parameter settings if approved.
  
  
Enters approved forecast adjustments at the detail level to align with the aggregate demand plan.
  
  
Takes ownership and accountability for the disaggregate demand plan, supply plan, and inventory plan that supports end Customer needs.
  
  
Demonstrates the target level of proficiency in core competencies.
  
  
Remains flexible and performs other miscellaneous duties, as required, to meet business goals.
  
  
Teamwork
  
  
Communicates effectively within the assigned team and with all support teams.
  
  
Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements and career goals.
  
  
Participates in improvement (quality, safety, process, material flow, etc.) projects.
  
  
**Competencies**
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  
  
Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
  
  
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  
  
Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
  
  
Materials Planning System Utilization - Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day-to-day operations.
  
  
Plan for Every Part (PFEP) - Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.
  
  
Inventory Management and Optimization - Uses analytics and algorithms to determine the optimal level of inventory investment across the end-to-end supply chain within specific constraints (warehouse space, customer delivery, etc.); provides guidance and expertise on planning parameter refinement; develops inventory strategies to support Cummins' strategy and not just a business unit strategy.
  
  
Materials KPI Management - Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end-customer impact; strategically balances trade-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.
  
  
Network Master Supply Planning - Uses statistical analysis and collaborates with other disciplines to provide a long term view of customers demand, and ensures the supply plan is aligned with the demand plan; balances supply and demand in a manner that achieves the financial and service objectives, while stabilizing the supply chain and optimizing the supply chain tensions.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
  
  
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
**Experience**
Requires some work experience and intermediate level knowledge obtained through training or on-the-job experience.
  
  

* This position will be handling the supplier schedules for Suppliers in F&A - MM Cluster having commodity of TBH, S&F, Valves and some part of E&E etc.
* Ensuring on time material availability to meet KEP production requirements.
* Collaborate with Supply Continuity, Purchasing, SQE, Plant Quality teams to resolve supply related issues
* Provide feedback to planning team on material availability to plan the production.
* Do analysis for E&O, OTD miss parts, Respond to Er's & SRC's as per requirement.
* Co-ordinate with Logistics & Warehouse teams for vehicle placements and unloading.
* Close co-ordination with the cross-functional teams.

description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
Addepar has just launched an Alternatives Product offering that gives Addepar clients the option to have their Private Funds data extracted, processed, validated, and ingested directly from Private Fund documents for a more automated end-to-end solution for handling Alternatives on the platform. This white-glove solution combines proprietary machine learning technology that automatically extracts data from Private Funds documents and human-in-loop review to validate any documents that fail to pass confidence and data quality checks.
  
  
As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the Alternatives Data Ops team is responsible for the human-in-loop review of Private Funds documents, ensuring clients' Alternatives data is processed, validated, and available in Addepar in a timely manner. This role will include managing a team and reviewing Private Fund statements, modifying data that has been incorrectly extracted by our machine learning models, and reprocessing the data within SLAs. The Alternatives Data Ops team plays a critical role in the success of Addepar's Alternatives offering and requires daily communications with the Alternatives Product Team, Machine Learning Operations, clients, data providers (GPs and Fund Admins), and additional personnel across the organization.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and manage a team of Analysts & Senior Analysts ensuring effective work allocation, timely delivery.
* Act as a Subject matter expert & support the team on complex document processing
* Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex Private Fund statement processing exceptions
* Perform quality reviews and assist the team in modifying incorrectly extracted data
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Act as a primary escalation point for operational and data quality issues.
* Partner with our Machine Learning Operations team to identify and relabel documents for model retraining
* Engage clients, GPs, or Fund Admins on statement data related inquiries
* Support the Maintenance Alternatives Data Operations workflow procedures and play-books.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, and standardization.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to implement new processes and tooling features that improve Alternatives Data processing UX and increase operational workflow efficiency.

**Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw-down) Funds reporting statements and data
* Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R&D
* Highly self-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team-player mentality
* Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
* Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. At Workday, we bring technical rigor, customer empathy, and a spirit of fun to enterprise software. Our support team underpins operational excellence across Workday's digital experience, AI/ML platform, and Agent Factory initiative. Workday’s Agent Factory is our internal engine that builds, trains, and deploys autonomous AI agents to execute complex HR and Finance workflows, including expense processing, hiring, and workforce scheduling. We partner with core engineering to eliminate bottlenecks, maintain high platform availability, and ensure system reliability for our global customer base.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a customer-focused Support Engineer to drive incident resolution, root-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimisation across Workday’s enterprise platform and autonomous AI agent workflows. In this high-visibility role, you will analyze system metrics, debug cloud-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, and manage critical customer escalations within strict SLAs. You will also partner directly with engineering and data science teams through feature iteration and optimisation. A key part of this role involves hands-on AI evaluation: analysing LLM outputs, reviewing conversation logs, and digging into system traces to spot failure modes and translate those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Enterprise SaaS & Functional Domain Expertise: Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise applications to validate AI responses and assist in troubleshooting functional processing errors.
* Hands-On AI Evaluation: Review LLM outputs, conversation logs, and execution traces to identify edge cases, hallucinations, and routine failure modes. Perform structured data labeling and report findings to senior engineering staff.
* Technical Troubleshooting & RCA: Assist in root-cause analysis for software defects and pipeline execution failures using monitoring tools like Kibana and Grafana, following established diagnostic runbooks.
* Cloud & LLM Diagnostics: Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.
* Incident & Queue Management: Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on-call rotations.
* Customer Communication: Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high-stakes escalations.
* Database & Code Diagnostics: Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
* Documentation & Team Collaboration: Maintain detailed investigation logs in Jira, ServiceNow, or Salesforce, help maintain team runbooks, and flag recurring issue trends to senior engineers and product teams.

**About You**
**Basic Qualifications (Required)**
Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.
  
  
Technical & Diagnostic Skills:
  
  

* Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
* Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command-line tools.

Cloud & Monitoring Systems:
  
  

* Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.

AI & LLM Exposure:
  
  

* Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.

Triage & Operations:
  
  

* Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.

Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).
* Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
* History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer-facing teams.
* Strong active problem-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi-tiered enterprise systems.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services. 

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:**
 

This role is based out of the People & ORG CoE which sits in the broader Data & Tech cluster at the BCN. People & ORG CoE works on building and deploying analytical solutions pertaining to Operating Model and Organization Practice. The team primarily helps Bain case teams, across geographies and industries, solve critical client issues by applying battle-proven diagnostics/ solutions that can identify client pain points related to org, culture, and talent. The team also plays a significant role in creating, testing, and contributing to the proprietary products and Bain IP within the Org domain. This role will focus on development, maintenance and evolution of the state-of-the art org tool and data assets.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* Clean, harmonize and prepare large past client datasets (multi-wave, multi-region, industry, size bands) for analysis
* Conduct extensive analysis independently from large datasets using statistical techniques such as regression, tree-based models, partial-dependence etc. and present findings to senior stakeholders with proper facts and figures
* Work cross-functionally with Practice stakeholders, BCN teams, other survey/ data experts to ensure data & model integrity, and to understand business/client context
* Build reports, presentations, dashboards for internal stakeholders and external marketing/editorial use: summarizing insights, visualizing trends, producing clear narratives.
* Become an expert and own, maintain and help evolve advanced AI based tools by testing and verifying results confidence as well as help develop new tools, in individual capacity
* Design and execute statistical tests to validate synthetic-data generators and non-survey predictive models (distributional tests, reliability/validity tests, correlation structure checks, hold-out testing)
* Be responsible for end-to-end handling of any new tool testing process, i.e., determining statistical testing methods, troubleshooting low scores, presenting findings, leading brainstorming discussions, etc.
* Help with case delivery related to those tools and generate meaningful insights for Bain clients
* Work under the guidance of a Team Manager / Sr. Team Manager, playing a key role in driving the team’s innovation, especially on data statistics topics
* Lead internal team calls and effectively communicate data, knowledge, insights and actionable next steps on tool development, relaying implications to own internal team where necessary
* Keep abreast of statistical and methodological advances relevant to surveys, diagnostic tools, synthetic-data methods, relevant software/tools, and advanced data analytics techniques

  

**ABOUT YOU:**

* Candidate should be a Economics/ Statistics/ Mathematics Graduate/ Post-graduate from top-tier college with strong academic background
* Must have 5 years of professional experience focused on statistics/data analytics (ideally within consulting, market research, organizational diagnostics or data science)
* Strong foundation in statistical theory and methods (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression, mixed-models, reliability/validity, sampling)
* Hands-on experience with statistical software (e.g., Python (pandas/ statsmodels /scikit-learn) , or similar) and data-manipulation tools
* Experience with synthetic-data generation using AI and/or model validation frameworks (predictive, reliability, fairness)
* Good to have - experience working with survey data (Likert-scales, national/international datasets, multi-wave) and performing benchmark/norming analyses
* Good to have - Experience building or validating predictive/statistical models (preferably including synthetic data generation or simulation work) is a strong plus
* Ability to manage multiple work-streams, meet deadlines, and maintain high quality and accuracy in deliverables
* Good business acumen and ability to work collaboratively in a consulting-style environment

  **GDPR and education-sector data regulations**

Leadership & Collaboration

  **data architects, engineers, BI developers, and analysts**

  **Data, Analytics, or Business Intelligence**

  **AI/ML use cases**

Desirable Experience

* Excellent communicator able to translate data into business and academic value
* Passion for improving education through data and technology
* Highly collaborative and outcome-focused
* Commitment to innovation, quality, and continuous improvement
