title: Applied AI Architect, Meta Enterprise Platform (India)
description:
As an Applied AI Architect for the Meta Enterprise Platform, you are the strategic technical advisor who helps enterprise customers understand the full potential of our Enterprise AI products (such as Model API) and design the right architectures to unlock that value. You combine deep knowledge of Generative AI with enterprise architecture expertise and effective communication skills to guide customers from initial discovery through successful deployment, ongoing adoption and expansion.This role combines pre-sales technical leadership with post-sales customer adoption and expansion. You will design scalable architectures, develop evaluation frameworks, create reference implementations, and serve as the technical authority that gives customers and internal stakeholders the confidence to purchase. You are the architect of the blueprint - ensuring the right technical foundation is in place before and during implementation. You will not just design architectures; you will help to deploy end-to-end AI solutions that drive actual AI usage such as API consumption and business ROI. You will own the customer's technical success from the initial scoping phase through to live production deployment, post-sales adoption and growth.  
  
  

### **Applied AI Architect, Meta Enterprise Platform (India) Responsibilities:**

* \*\*Technical Discovery & Solution Design\*\* - Partner with sales to deeply understand customer requirements, business context, and existing technology stacks. Translate these into clear, technically feasible AI solution architectures and integration plans
* \*\*Technical Account Ownership\*\* - Establish technical account plans covering current use cases, adoption milestones and agreed measures of value. Review API usage, technical account health and blockers. Qualify additional use cases and help build the technical case for expansion. Coordinate specialist input where needed and follow through on agreed actions
* \*\*AI Architecture Advisory\*\* - Serve as the primary technical advisor throughout the customer's AI / API adoption journey. Guide architecture decisions around LLM selection, RAG patterns, prompt engineering strategies, agentic workflow and tool use, data pipelines, and enterprise integration points
* \*\*Evaluation & Proof of Value\*\* - Design and guide customer evaluation frameworks (evals) to measure AI performance for specific use cases. Create compelling demos, reference architectures, and lightweight POCs that demonstrate practical value and feasibility. Agree acceptance criteria for quality, latency, cost and reliability, linking evaluation results to customer business goals and a decision on production deployment
* \*\*Enterprise Trust & Governance\*\* - Address enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements (SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR). Navigate complex sales lifecycles involving IT, Legal, Security, and executive stakeholders to build technical confidence
* \*\*Cross-Functional Collaboration\*\* - Act as the bridge between customers and internal Product, Engineering, and PMM teams. Gather technical feedback, identify common integration patterns, surface product gaps, and contribute field insights that shape the product roadmap and GTM strategy
* \*\*Thought Leadership & Enablement\*\* - Create technical content including architecture guides, best-practice documentation, and industry-specific solution briefs. Enable the broader sales and partner ecosystem with technical training and reusable assets
* \*\*Hands-on Solutions\*\* - Act as the primary technical owner for strategic accounts. Assist in the design, prototyping, and deployment planning for customer full-stack applications, RAG pipelines, and custom integrations using our AI APIs. Contribute reference implementations and technical reviews
* \*\*Rapid Prototyping\*\* - Translate customer business problems into concrete technical plans. Rapidly develop and iterate on functional proofs-of-concept (POCs) to demonstrate immediate value
* \*\*Production Implementation\*\* - Guide customers through the "Integration Wall." Navigate enterprise security, legacy databases, and complex infrastructures
* \*\*Technical Advisory\*\* - Serve as the subject matter expert on Generative AI architecture, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI security/guardrails for C-level executives and lead developers
* \*\*Travel\*\* - Flexibility to travel up to 30% of the time

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience engaging enterprise customers through the sales lifecycle, purchasing and deployment decisions, involving multiple stakeholders across IT, Security, Legal, and executive leadership
* Comfortable with Python and able to build lightweight demos, scripts, and reference implementations (not expected to write production-grade application code)
* Familiarity with the Generative AI ecosystem: APIs, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, vector databases, and evaluation frameworks. Ability to use LLM APIs to build and evaluate lightweight demos, prototypes and reference implementations
* Ability to design use-case-specific evaluation tests and assess quality, latency, cost and reliability against agreed customer requirements and business goals
* Experience planning and managing customer technical engagements, resolving blockers and coordinating customer and internal teams through evaluation, integration and adoption. A high degree of ownership, and the ability to thrive in highly ambiguous, fast-paced environments
* Experience communicating and translating complex AI/ML concepts for C-suite executives, IT leaders, engineering teams and non-technical business leaders while simultaneously working with customer engineering teams

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience with AI safety, responsible AI practices, and implementing guardrails for LLM applications in regulated industries
* Experience creating and delivering technical enablement programs for sales teams, partners, or customer communities
* Familiarity with enterprise security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, HIPAA) in the context of AI deployments
* Experience architecting AI/ML solutions at scale in enterprise environments, including model deployment, monitoring, and governance. Experience helping customers move from evaluation to live applications with measurable business value
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience with AI observability, evaluation frameworks (evals) assessing quality, latency, cost and reliability, and implementing enterprise-grade security guardrails for AI applications
* Hands-on experience building applications using AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) and familiarity with the Generative AI ecosystem (Vector Databases, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, tool use and frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas – Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role the Manager, Field Effectiveness plays a critical hands-on role in supporting the effectiveness of the sales force through high-quality data analysis, reporting, and operational execution. This role sits at the intersection of data analytics, commercial operations, and field strategy, with a focus on enabling actionable insights and operational excellence.
  
  
This position reports to the Sr Manager, Field Effectiveness and will be responsible for the following
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Incentive Plan Design and Modeling**

* Design, develop, and implement field incentive compensation (IC) plans that align with brand strategies and sales goals.
* Build financial models to simulate plan performance under various scenarios using real and projected data.
* Conduct historical analysis and “what-if” simulations to evaluate plan effectiveness, fairness, and alignment.
* Prepare IC plan documents, FAQs, and communication decks to support field understanding and adoption.

**Contest Design**

* Create and manage short-term incentive contests (SPIFs) and tactical bonus programs to support product launches or boost performance.
* Analyze data to define contest eligibility, metrics, goals, and payout curves.
* Develop rules documents and communication materials for field engagement.
* Track contest performance and manage end-to-end execution from concept through payout.

**Health Check Analytics and Plan Monitoring**

* Develop and run regular health checks to monitor plan effectiveness, payout distribution, and motivational integrity.
* Identify anomalies, outliers, or gaming behaviors and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide monthly/quarterly dashboards and insights to Sales Leadership on IC plan performance.
* Monitor alignment between incentive outcomes and commercial KPIs such as sales performance and call activity.

**Data Management and Processing**

* Extract, transform, and validate large datasets (e.g., sales, territory alignments, performance metrics).
* Perform data quality checks to ensure accuracy and completeness.

**Compliance, Governance, and Documentation**

* Maintain documentation of IC plan rules, calculations, exceptions, and approvals for audit readiness.
* Track IC plan change requests and rationale over time.

**What We Expect Of You**
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Incentive Compensation professional we seek has these qualifications.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Master / bachelor's degree & 6 to 9 years of experience in Incentive Compensation Design.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant Bio/Pharmaceutical industry and/or consulting experience.
* Execution-Focused Delivery: Own and execute day-to-day analytics tasks, reporting development, and field data operations with speed, accuracy, and minimal oversight.
* Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret large, complex datasets. Demonstrated ability to translate business rules into data logic and calculations. Proven track record of identifying errors, troubleshooting data, and resolving issues efficiently.
* Attention to Detail and Accountability: High degree of accuracy and attention to detail, especially in preparing payment files and reports. Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Proven ability to maintain confidentiality and ensure data integrity.

title: Sr. Specialist, AI Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Senior/Principal AI Engineer, you will drive the end-to-end development of GenAI applications, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, and LLM-based workflows, while ensuring high standards of performance, scalability, and responsible AI practices. You will provide technical leadership, mentor teams, and translate complex AI capabilities into impactful business solutions.
  
  
**What Will You Do In This Role**

* Design and implement Agentic AI systems leveraging frameworks such as LangChain, Google ADK, Strands, and Semantic Kernel, enabling multi-step reasoning and task orchestration.
* Develop and operationalize multi-agent systems, incorporating patterns such as planning, tool usage, memory, and iterative reasoning.
* Apply advanced prompt engineering techniques (ReAct, few-shot learning, chain-of-thought, prompt chaining) to improve accuracy, determinism, and robustness of LLM systems.
* Establish AgentOps practices, including observability, tracing, logging, and performance monitoring for production-grade AI systems.
* Build multimodal AI solutions, integrating text with images or structured data to support complex enterprise use cases.
* Apply harness engineering practices to systematically design, test, and evaluate AI/agent workflows across different scenarios.
* Develop reusable agent tooling and integrations, enabling interaction with enterprise services, tools, and workflows, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication patterns.
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable GenAI-driven solutions.
* Leverage modern AI developer tooling such as Claude CLI, GitHub Copilot, Vertex AI, and Codex to accelerate development workflows.
* Support deployment and operationalization of AI solutions using cloud platforms such as AWS and GCP.

**What Should You Have**

* Masters in a relevant quantitative, applied field (Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering)
* Minimum of 5 years of work experience in the end-to-end lifecycle of ML model development and deployment into production within a cloud infrastructure (Databricks is highly preferred).

**Primary Skills (must-have)**

* Deep expertise in RAG architectures, including embedding generation, retrieval optimization, grounding, and context management.
* Proficiency in prompt engineering techniques (ReAct, chain-of-thought, few-shot learning, prompt chaining, instruction refinement).
* Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications and agent-based systems in production environments.
* Experience implementing AgentOps practices, including observability, tracing, logging, and performance evaluation of AI systems.
* Strong Python programming skills with experience in tooling, function-calling, and agent-driven integrations.
* Experience designing context engineering strategies, including chunking, context optimization, and prompt-context alignment.
* Familiarity with harness engineering approaches for systematic testing, validation, and benchmarking of AI systems.
* Understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) interaction patterns.
* Experience building ML/AI pipelines, including automation, orchestration, and CI/CD integration.
* Solid expertise in NLP and text processing, including tokenization, embeddings, and preprocessing pipelines.
* Understanding of transformer architectures and modern LLM ecosystems.
* Understanding of basic machine learning, including supervised/unsupervised learning concepts and model evaluation techniques.

**Secondary Skills (nice To Have)**

* Experience with advanced agentic patterns, such as planner-executor, reflection, and memory-augmented agents.
* Exposure to multimodal AI systems involving text, vision, or structured data fusion.
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation techniques, including synthetic test generation and prompt regression testing.
* Experience with advanced chunking strategies and context window optimization.
* Exposure to LLMOps/MLOps practices for deployment, monitoring, and scaling AI systems.

**Who We Are**
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
**What We Look For**
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

Animal Vaccination, Biopharmaceutical Industry, Collaborative Development, Databricks Platform, Data Engineering, Design Applications, Digital Transformation, Disease Prevention, Econometrics, Information Security, Machine Learning (ML), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Performance Monitoring, Prompt Engineering, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), System Designs, System Integration, Technical Leadership, Testing, Unsupervised Learning

**Roche India - Roche Services and Solutions**
**Hyderabad / Chennai**
At Roche, you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted, and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop, and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
**The Position**
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
**That’s What Makes Us Roche.**
As a
**Senior Data Strategy & Acquisition Analyst**
within GATE, you will be a recognized subject-matter expert on the U.S. healthcare data landscape. You will go beyond responding to requests — you will proactively scout, evaluate, and unlock new data assets that expand what Roche's U.S. commercial organization can see and act on. You will operate as a genuine thought partner to U.S. brand, market access, forecasting, field operations, and advanced analytics teams across multiple therapeutic areas, shaping decisions on multi-million-dollar data investments.
  
  
**The Opportunity**

* Multi-Facet Data Asset Portfolio: Own the evaluation, acquisition, and lifecycle management of a broad and diverse portfolio of U.S. healthcare data assets — claims, EHR/EMR and clinical real-world data, specialty pharmacy and hub data, lab and biomarker/genomic testing data, payer and formulary intelligence, sales and distribution, provider reference and affiliation data, patient-level longitudinal data, and competitive/market intelligence
* Proactive Data Scouting & Market Sensing: Continuously track the evolving U.S. data vendor and RWD market — new entrants, emerging and innovative asset types, consolidation, and pricing/licensing trends. Bring forward unsolicited recommendations on datasets Roche should consider and on new use cases that existing assets could unlock
* Therapeutic Area Partnership: Partner with stakeholders across Oncology, Ophthalmology, Cardiovascular-Renal-Metabolic (CVRM), Neurology, Immunology and Rare Disease, translating each TA's distinct commercial questions into fit-for-purpose data requirements — recognizing that a retina franchise, a solid-tumor biomarker-driven brand, and a cardiometabolic primary-care brand each demand fundamentally different data strategies
* Vendor Evaluation & Head-to-Head Benchmarking: Evaluate new and incumbent vendors (eg:-IQVIA, Komodo Health, Clarivate/DRG, MMIT, Optum, Truveta, Flatiron, Verana ), on methodology, capture and coverage, patient/provider linkage, recency and lag, known biases, limitations, and fit-for-purpose. Design and run structured bake-offs and overlap analyses rather than relying on vendor claims
* External Partnerships: Act as the primary technical counterpart to external data vendors — interrogating source methodologies, resolving data quality queries, influencing roadmap and enhancement requests, and supporting renewal and expansion discussions with an evidence-backed point of view
* Data Profiling & Risk Assessment: Perform hands-on profiling, cross-source comparison, and validation. Quantify gaps, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive pushback to ensure alignment with business objectives and realistic expectations of what the data can and cannot support

**Who You Are**
**Education:**
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Bioinformatics, Public Health, Healthcare, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  
  
**Experience:**
5–8+ years of relevant experience in pharma/biotech commercial analytics, healthcare data strategy, life sciences consulting, or a healthcare data vendor. Prior experience in a Data acquisition, Data strategy, Data governance, or RWD-evaluation function is strongly preferred.
  
  
**Multi-Facet Data Asset Exposure (core requirement):**
You have worked hands-on across several of the following and can speak credibly to the strengths, biases, and limitations of each:
  
  

* Claims: open vs. closed, medical vs. pharmacy, submits vs. remits, switch/clearinghouse vs. payer-sourced (IQVIA LAAD/Dx/PharMetrics, Komodo, Clarivate), patient-lives coverage, payer mix, rejection/denial and reversal analytics
* EHR/EMR and clinical RWD: structured vs. unstructured content, clinical depth (stage, biomarkers, labs, performance status, laterality), health-system coverage bias, ambulatory vs. inpatient capture, and the NPI/provider-identifier limitations of EHR sources
* Data Linkage: tokenization and patient-level linkage across claims, EHR, lab, and specialty pharmacy assets (e.g., Datavant), and the practical pitfalls of doing so
* Specialty pharmacy, hub, and distribution data; buy-and-bill dynamics
* Lab, diagnostic, and biomarker/genomic testing data
* Payer, formulary, and market access intelligence (MMIT, DRG Fingertip, Policy Reporter), including coverage policy, utilization management, and GTN-relevant inputs
* Provider reference and affiliation data (NPI/DEA, IQVIA OneKey, IDN/GPO and health-system hierarchies), and how it powers HCP/account targeting
* Competitive and market intelligence (Evaluate, Citeline, Spherix Global Insights, Dedham Group)
* Emerging/innovative assets: ambient and digital health data, registries, SDOH, imaging, patient-reported and adherence data

**Therapeutic Area Exposure:**
Demonstrated exposure to either of
**Oncology**
(solid tumor and/or heme; biomarker testing, staging, lines of therapy, pathways),
**Ophthalmology**
(Imaging and registry data such as IRIS/Verana), or
**CVRM**
(cardiovascular, metabolic and obesity, lab-value-driven segmentation such as HbA1c/LDL/eGFR, high-volume PCP targeting). Rare disease, neurology, or immunology exposure is a strong plus.
  
  
**Analytical & Strategic Thinking:**
Strong analytical reasoning and structured problem-solving with meticulous attention to detail. You engage stakeholders consultatively, ask the sharp clarifying question before proposing a solution, and synthesize complexity into clear recommendations and "so what?" insights
  
  
**Technical Skills**
: Proficient in SQL or similar technology for independent extraction, profiling, and validation on large patient-level datasets. Comfortable in creating a visualizations in any industry wide known platforms.
  
  
Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing an OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.
  
  
The PD Regulatory Innovation and Sustainment Chapter is accountable for creating and maintaining a framework for building, maturing, and sustaining PDR business capabilities. This includes fostering innovation, ensuring operational readiness, and implementing continuous improvement across our regulatory processes, systems, and tools. Chapter members lead by designing and deploying innovative, compliant solutions that optimize regulatory workflows while maintaining the highest standards of integrity and data quality. We operate with enterprise thinking in a highly transformative regulated environment—assessing end-to-end processes, anticipating regulatory landscape changes, and unlocking company-wide benefits through strategic partnerships across PD, affiliates, Pharma, and the Roche group. Success in this chapter requires strategic thinking, systems thinking, data and content management expertise, an enterprise mindset, and the ability to drive continuous improvement and change leadership in a matrix environment.
  
  
Your Opportunity
  
  
As a Regulatory AI & Automation Specialist within PD Regulatory Innovation and Sustainment Chapter at RSS Hyderabad, you will drive the hands-on digital execution of regulatory operations. In this role, you will design, build, and deploy AI-driven tools, document intelligence engines, and automated workflows that accelerate regulatory document processing, submission dossier management, and compliance tracking across global health authorities
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Collaborate with regulatory stakeholders to evaluate incoming AI/automation requests, assess technical feasibility, and help prioritize high-value use cases for regulatory document workflows
* Build and deploy scalable AI, machine learning, and automation solutions—integrating RPA, Low-Code/No-Code platforms, Python, NLP, and cloud-native services like AWS—specifically tailored to optimize global regulatory workflows and document management.
* Perform operational process mining and opportunity mapping by partnering directly with SMEs from PDR Innovation & Sustainment chapter and global regulatory SMEs to identify high-impact AI and automation opportunities
* Support IT team by providing business directions for ongoing technical & preventive maintenance, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting for all deployed automation scripts, machine learning models, and AI assets operating in production
* Maintain comprehensive technical artifacts (including solution architecture, source code repositories, and testing frameworks) and conduct hands-on internal training to empower business teams and drive adoption across global regulatory functions
* Drive cross-functional Agile and DevOps execution in a matrixed environment, collaborating with PDR Innovation & Sustainment chapter leads, regulatory teams, IT, and RSS peers through sprint planning, rapid PoC prototyping, iterative testing, and continuous feedback loops.
* Monitor operational performance metrics and deliver clear project updates, technical insights, and continuous improvement recommendations to functional leadership and regulatory stakeholders
* Partner with global regulatory teams to showcase the practical applications of AI, NLP, and automation, translating technical features into clear business benefits like compliance risk reduction, improved document processing throughput, and operational efficiency

Who You Are
  
  
You are a hands-on technical builder with 4–6 years of experience in software engineering, data analytics, or AI/automation development and exposure of working in pharmaceutical R&D regulatory affairs or clinical development departments. You possess strong analytical problem-solving skills and thrive in an agile setting where you take ownership of technical execution, turning complex operational processes into automated, production-ready AI tools.
  
  
Qualifications & Technical Skillset:
  
  

* Education & Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, with 4–6 years of hands-on experience building and deploying software, automation, or AI/ML solutions
* Education & Experience: Direct experience in pharmaceutical R&D regulatory affairs or clinical development.
* Advanced GenAI: Experience exposure to prompt evaluation frameworks, or multi-agent orchestration
* Core Programming & Data Engineering: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL for data extraction, manipulation, pipeline creation, and writing modular, production-ready code
* Document AI & Text Processing: Practical experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP), Optical Character Recognition (OCR like Tesseract, AWS Textract, or Azure AI Document Intelligence), and unstructured document parsing (PDFs, XML, JSON, Word)
* AI & LLM Integration: Hands-on experience developing application logic around modern LLM frameworks (e.g., Lang Chain, Llama Index, OpenAI/AWS Bedrock APIs) and building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for document querying
* Software Engineering & APIs: Solid experience with REST APIs, Git version control, unit testing, and basic CI/CD practices
* Workflow & Process Automation: Experience automating workflows using Python orchestration, low-code automation tools (e.g., Power Automate, UiPath), or enterprise schedulers
* Exposure to Deployment & Cloud: Basic exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and containerization (Docker) for deploying scripts and API services

Strong to have:
  
  

* Prompt Architecture & Validation: Ability to design complex, multi-step prompts; validate outputs against business logic; and refine solutions iteratively

title: Business Intelligence Analyst, Revenue Operations (India Remote) - Hours 1-9pm IST
description:
**Company Description**
  
When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
  
  
Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
  
  
Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
  
  
  
**Job Description**
  
Turnitin's Revenue Operations team is modernizing its analytics foundation — moving to governed dbt models on Redshift and building a trusted, consolidated view of the business for Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Finance.
  
  
You own the models, pipelines, and tests that everything downstream depends on. You're not a ticket-taker: we expect you to understand why a metric matters before you model it, and to say so when the requirement as stated will produce a number that's technically correct and practically wrong.
  
  
This is an early-stage function, so you'll have unusual influence over how it's built.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**

* Lead the migration of legacy Alteryx workflows into documented, tested dbt models on Redshift.
* Design models with deliberate grain and clear lineage, building toward a certified set of marts that reporting reads from.
* Own orchestration, monitoring, and alerting in Dagster (or Airflow), and the ingestion layer feeding it.
* Keep Redshift fast and cost-effective.
* Trace issues to the right root cause — reporting, data model, or upstream business process — and route each to the right fix.
* Build the data foundations behind RevOps initiatives such as account-based marketing, customer health scoring, and predictive work like churn and lead scoring.
* Use AI and LLM tooling thoughtfully in the engineering workflow, and help the team form a view on where it belongs.

  
  
**Qualifications**
  
**What We're Looking For**

* A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, leads with questions, and doesn't wait to be assigned work.
* A translator who can explain a data problem to a Sales Director in terms of their quota, and a quota problem to an engineer in terms of a data model.
* A systems thinker who looks upstream and downstream before proposing a fix.
* Someone constructively skeptical who reconciles the numbers before shipping them.
* Impact-focused — you deliver the "so what?", not just the data.
* An owner who takes pride in the cleanliness of their code and their documentation.

**Essential**

* 6 - 8+ years in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or Business Intelligence with substantial hands-on modeling responsibility.
* Proven experience building and maintaining production-grade dbt projects, including testing and documentation.
* Hands-on production experience with Dagster or Airflow.
* Advanced SQL and real experience with Amazon Redshift (or Snowflake / BigQuery), including performance tuning.
* Git-based workflow, code review, and CI as a normal part of how you work.
* Strong working knowledge of the Salesforce data model.
* Python for data work and automation.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Alteryx, particularly in a migration context.
* Experience with Airbyte, Dagster & DBT or comparable ELT tooling.
* Salesforce-specific data modeling experience.
* Exposure to predictive modeling or machine learning workflows.
* Experience with large customer engagement datasets (1M+ rows).
* Ability to build and maintain Tableau dashboards, even if it isn't your primary craft.

  
  
**Additional Information**
  
**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
  
  
Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
  
  
In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.
  
  
**Our Mission**
is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
  
  
  
  
**Our Values**
underpin everything we do.
  

* **Customer Centric:**
  Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:**
  We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:**
  Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action & Ownership:**
  We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:**
  We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:**
  We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

**Global Benefits**

At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad.  We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

title: Forward Deployed Engineer {Mumbai}
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 80% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 80% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

title: Energy manager / auditor
description:
**Company Description**
AAR Consulting & Services Pvt. Ltd. (AARCS), a sister company of Shetty Infraservices Pvt. Ltd., is a Mumbai-based engineering consultancy focused on safety, reliability, and efficiency in building and industrial operations. The company specializes in energy audits, electrical safety audits, fire and life safety audits, and power quality studies for commercial buildings, manufacturing units, industrial plants, warehouses, hospitals, hotels, and offices. AARCS supports facility heads, plant managers, EHS leaders, and owners in reducing energy costs, preventing electrical and fire incidents, and preparing for regulatory inspections through standards-aligned audits and practical recommendations. Its multidisciplinary team assesses electrical systems, HVAC and chillers, fire protection, power quality, and indoor conditions to identify risks and efficiency gaps while promoting a strong safety culture and sustainable operations. Clients benefit from a blend of technical, operational, and business expertise combined with sector-specific regulatory and risk management skills.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Energy Manager / Auditor role based in Thane. The Energy Manager / Auditor will conduct detailed energy audits and assessments of electrical systems, HVAC equipment, and other utilities to identify efficiency improvements and cost-saving opportunities. Responsibilities include collecting and analyzing energy consumption data, evaluating equipment performance, preparing audit reports, and recommending practical, standards-compliant solutions for energy optimization. The role involves coordinating with facility and plant teams, supporting implementation of energy-saving measures, and monitoring results to verify performance. The Energy Manager / Auditor will also assist in related safety and power quality assessments, contribute to project planning, and ensure alignment with relevant codes, regulations, and client requirements.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret energy data, diagnose performance issues, and develop data-driven recommendations.
* Candidates should possess skills in Energy Management and Energy efficiency, including knowledge of utility systems, HVAC, electrical loads, and conservation measures.
* Candidates should possess Project Management skills to plan audits, coordinate stakeholders, manage timelines, and track implementation of recommendations.
* Candidates should possess Procurement-related skills to support sourcing of energy-efficient equipment, evaluate vendor proposals, and optimize lifecycle costs.
* Relevant qualifications such as a degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Energy Engineering (or equivalent technical discipline) are preferred.
* Knowledge of national and international energy, electrical safety, and fire safety standards, along with familiarity with industrial and commercial building systems, is beneficial.
* Strong communication and report-writing skills, ability to work on-site with cross-functional teams, and readiness to travel to client locations as needed are important.
* Professional certifications in energy auditing or energy management (e.g., CEA, CEM, or equivalent) will be an added advantage.

title: Associate - Treasury Liquidity Controllers
description:
**Job Description**
You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving solutions in Treasury. You have found the right team.
  
  
As a Liquidity Associate in our Finance team, you will spend each day defining, refining and delivering set goals for our firm. You will be instrumental in managing the liquidity, balance sheet, and capital positions of our Investment Banking businesses. In this role, you will engage with a variety of stakeholders, including senior leadership and global teams, to develop and implement strategies that enhance our risk management capabilities. This position offers a dynamic and fast-paced environment, ideal for individuals with a keen interest in capital markets and economics.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Produce comprehensive liquidity risk reports on a daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis, including JPM Internal Stress and 6G/LCR reports, focusing on identifying key drivers of period-over-period movements and providing insightful variance commentary.
* Develop and deliver detailed liquidity metrics packages for CIB senior management and key stakeholders, ensuring all reports are accurate and timely.
* Leverage understanding of financial products such as deposits, commitments, derivatives, and secured funding, along with regulatory guidelines like Basel III and LCR/NSFR, to assess their potential impact on our Line of Business.
* Coordinate with global teams to create specific sub-Line of Business commentary and analysis, ensuring reporting results are comprehensive and aligned with business objectives.
* Collaborate with FALMA, CTMO, and other stakeholders to ensure the timely and accurate production of regulatory reporting, maintaining a high standard of data integrity.
* Engage with senior CIB Treasury and business leadership, Controllers, Global Treasury, and Liquidity Risk Oversight to gather, understand, and analyze information related to balance sheet and liquidity implications.
* Contribute to ongoing process improvements, optimization, and rationalization efforts related to balance sheet and liquidity management, driving efficiency and effectiveness in operations.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Bachelor's Degree in Finance or a related field, with a minimum of 4 years of experience in finance, emphasizing analytical work.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to think creatively and solve complex problems. You should be comfortable managing large datasets and extracting meaningful insights.
* A solid understanding of finance and financial markets, including On and Off balance sheet products, particularly those related to market business such as prime brokerage and secured funding.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present information in a clear, concise, and effective manner.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to execute responsibilities independently, take ownership of tasks, and work under pressure to prioritize and complete multiple tasks.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Access.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Familiarity with liquidity risk regulations and their implications for financial products.
* Experience with automation tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, or Python, which can enhance data analysis and reporting capabilities.
* A proactive approach to staying informed about regulatory developments related to liquidity impacting CIB Treasury.
* Engage with senior CIB Treasury and business leadership, Controllers, Global Treasury, and Liquidity Risk Oversight to gather, understand, and analyze information related to balance sheet and liquidity implications.
* Contribute to ongoing process improvements, optimization, and rationalization efforts related to balance sheet and liquidity management, driving efficiency and effectiveness in operations.

Morgan and Chase brands. * Perform gap analysis and benchmarking against regulatory guidelines and best practices.

title: Associate Director or Director, Risk Advisory Head of Modelling, Mumbai
description:
**BMI is currently seeking an Associate Director or Director, Risk Advisory – Credit Risk Modelling, based out of our Mumbai office.**
BMI's systematic, independent and data-driven market insights, analysis and forecasts enable customers to recognize and assess risks and opportunities across markets and industries. For almost 40 years, we have provided impartial views to support our customers’ strategic plans and investment decisions.
  
  
At BMI, we’re proud of the work we do to help our clients manage risks and opportunities in global markets, which began in 1984 and continues to this day. By stepping into a role here, you will help shape the strategic decisions of the world’s leading organizations. As a member of our team, your role will go beyond conventional boundaries. You will collaborate with industry experts, thought leaders, and visionary executives, collectively working towards shaping the future of businesses that span a multitude of sectors. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, and we continuously strive to offer our colleagues a great place to work, with opportunities to learn, innovate, develop their careers, and serve the community.
  
  
Want to learn more about a career at BMI? Visit: https://careers.fitch.group/content/BMI/
  
  
**About The Team**
BMI's Risk Advisory team provides specialist advisory services across credit risk modelling, model validation, IFRS 9 implementation, portfolio analytics and regulatory risk management. Working closely with financial institutions and corporate clients, the team combines deep technical expertise with practical industry experience to design and deliver data-driven risk solutions that support effective decision-making, governance and regulatory compliance.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**
**Credit Risk Model Development & Delivery**

* Develop and review credit risk models using Excel-based rating agency frameworks, Python and statistical techniques including logistic regression, decision trees and ensemble methods.
* Build and enhance IFRS 9 expected credit loss models, including PD, LGD, EAD and CCF components across both simplified and general approaches.
* Develop roll-rate-based PD models using customer-level receivables data, portfolio-level data and ageing cohort analysis.
* Apply advanced methodologies including TTC-to-PiT conversion, Vasicek modelling, survival PDs and term PD structures.
* Partner with senior subject matter experts to scope engagements, define analytical frameworks and deliver robust, client-ready solutions.

**Model Validation, Governance & Quality Assurance**

* Conduct credit risk model validations aligned with OCC 2011-12 guidance and Basel requirements, assessing discriminatory power, calibration, model stability and population stability.
* Perform parameter-level validation including WoE, IV analysis, backtesting and out-of-time performance testing.
* Evaluate statistical, scorecard and hybrid risk models to ensure analytical integrity and regulatory compliance.
* Produce clear, defensible and auditable validation reports, technical documentation and client deliverables.
* Drive continuous improvement through evaluation of new methodologies, technologies and emerging modelling practices.

**Client & Commercial Partnership**

* Serve as a subject matter expert in client discussions, supporting solution design, proposal development and project delivery.
* Translate client requirements into practical modelling approaches and commercially relevant analytical outputs.
* Present modelling methodologies, validation findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to expand client engagements through value-added risk advisory solutions.

**Technical Leadership & Capability Building**

* Support the development of the wider Advisory team's credit risk modelling and validation capability through mentoring, coaching and knowledge sharing.
* Create reusable modelling templates, validation frameworks and best-practice guidance to improve consistency and efficiency.
* Help colleagues develop expertise in statistical modelling, IFRS 9/ECL methodologies, model validation standards and emerging AI-related risk concepts.

**You May Be a Good Fit If**

* Significant hands-on experience in credit risk model development, model validation, IFRS 9/ECL modelling, credit analytics or related risk advisory functions.
* Strong proficiency in Excel and Python for statistical analysis, model development and validation.
* Deep understanding of credit risk methodologies, scorecard development, rating frameworks, model lifecycle management and regulatory model governance.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex analytical projects and client engagements.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.

**What Would Make You Stand Out**

* Experience in stress testing, reverse stress testing and scenario-based portfolio analytics.
* Experience developing or validating Early Warning Systems (EWS) and related monitoring frameworks.
* Exposure to AI, machine learning or deep learning model validation in credit risk applications.
* Experience supporting business development activities, proposals and client solution design.

**Why Choose Fitch**

* Hybrid Work Environment: 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location
* A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
* Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
* Promoting Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
* Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
* Inclusive Work Environment : A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
* Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day—supporting smarter decision-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.
  
  
Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.
  
  
Fitch is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluatequalified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

title: PPC Executive Amazon Ads and Flipkart Ads
description:
**About DigiBegin Consulting**

DigiBegin Consulting (DBC) is an Amazon-focused growth agency based in Thane, Mumbai, and an Amazon Ads Verified Partner.

We work with 20+ brands across India, US and UK. Our promise to clients is to scale their Amazon business without destroying their profits. We don’t run ads to inflate revenue. We scale selectively, only where the data shows a clear advantage.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an Amazon Ads PPC Executive to run daily Amazon Ads execution across 4–6 client accounts. Your job is to make sure every rupee of spend is tied to profitable sales and organic rank.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Campaign build and structure**

* Build Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns from approved keyword and ASIN research.
* Separate auto, broad, phrase, exact and product-targeting campaigns so every search term can be traced and controlled.
* Set up brand-defence, competitor-conquest and category campaigns.
* Maintain naming conventions, portfolios and budget caps as per the ads SOP.

**Daily and weekly optimisation**

* Check budget pacing, spend spikes and zero-sale spend every day.
* Adjust bids at keyword and placement level 2–3 times a week to hit target ACoS.
* Each week, cut back loss-making targets and move budget to proven converters.
* Log every change in the account change-log with the reason.

**Search term mining and keyword management**

* Mine search term reports weekly, moving converting terms into exact or phrase campaigns and negating irrelevant or non-converting ones.
* Compare keyword-level CVR against category CVR to find keywords where the brand can win.
* Find converting ASINs and build product-targeting campaigns against them.
* Maintain each client’s master keyword sheet, with keywords tagged by type.

**Organic rank support**

* Track organic and sponsored rank on priority keywords using Helium 10 and Brand Analytics.
* Run focused ranking pushes on selected generic keywords.
* Flag listing issues that hurt conversion, such as price, reviews, images, Buy Box or delivery promise.

**Excel, MIS reporting and coordination**

* Own the MIS for every assigned account, pulling Amazon Ads, Business Report and Helium 10 data into Excel / Google Sheets trackers.
* Maintain daily and weekly MIS sheets covering spend, sales, ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CVR, CPC and organic rank, at account, SKU and campaign level.
* Keep data clean and reconciled, with zero errors in client-facing numbers.
* Prepare monthly performance decks: what changed, why, and next month’s plan.
* Flag stock runway below 20 days before scaling any SKU.
* Join client calls when required and speak to your accounts’ numbers.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Up to 1 year of hands-on Amazon Ads experience (Seller Central or Vendor Central), through a job, internship or your own or family brand.
* Working experience of Helium 10 (Cerebro, Magnet, Keyword Tracker). This is mandatory.
* Clear grasp of ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CVR, CTR and CPC, and how they move together.
* Knowledge of match types, negative targeting, placement modifiers and bidding strategies.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets and MIS reporting skills: pivots, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS and conditional formatting.
* Comfortable using Amazon bulk sheets.
* Clear written English for reports and client updates.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Brand Analytics and Search Query Performance data.
* Exposure to US, UK or UAE marketplaces.
* Flipkart Ads experience.
* Amazon Ads certifications.

**This Role Is Not for You If**

* You judge success by spend or revenue alone, without looking at profit.
* You prefer to run auto campaigns and let Amazon optimise.
* You find a weekly change-log and a fixed review rhythm restrictive.
* If you are not comfortable at looking multiple number led dashboards

**Job Details**

* Location: Thane / Mumbai, hybrid (once a week in office)
* Experience: 0–1 year
* Employment: Full-time, 6-day week (Saturday 10 am to 2 pm)

**How to Apply**

* **Apply through LinkedIn, or email your CV to**
  hr@digibeginconsulting.com with the subject line “Application – Amazon Ads PPC Executive”.

description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. * Collaborate with developers, business analysts, data analysts, data engineers and stakeholders to clarify requirements, troubleshoot issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive resolution.

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computers and related fields.

* Strong understanding of the software development life cycle and multiple software engineering and testing methodologies.
* Proficiency in SQL, database testing, business intelligence testing, and data validation.
* Experience creating test cases and testing documentation from requirements or specifications, including for projects with limited development documentation.
* Familiarity with issue-tracking tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Well-developed communication and interpersonal skills, attention to detail, self-motivation, and the ability to work accurately in a fast-paced, changing environment.
* Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with peers and stakeholders, with a continuous-improvement mindset and technical agility.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced capability in agile testing, test management, and database testing, including SQL.
* Working knowledge of extract-transform-load processes, test design techniques, and test planning.
* Foundational knowledge of application programming interfaces, artificial intelligence and machine learning, dbt, and Monte Carlo.
* ISTQB certification.
* Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and related services such as BigQuery or Cloud Functions.
* Knowledge of big data concepts, data warehouse structures, extract-transform-load processes, and data architecture principles.
* Basic knowledge of Python programing.
* Exposure to usage of GenAI tools in testing.
* Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines and DevOps methodologies.
* Demonstrated alignment with General Mills values: do the right thing, play to win, grow and inspire, win as a team, and act boldly and move quickly.

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

****Preferred Qualifications****

title: Principal Security Engineer, Cloud Security
description:
Overview:

**Working at Atlassian**

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, as part of being a distributed-first company.

**About Team**

The Product Security team at Atlassian is committed to ensuring the delivery of secure products. These teams are geographically distributed, with a presence in the USA, Australia, and India. Each team is structured uniformly to provide comprehensive product security services tailored to their respective time zones. These services include security consulting, risk identification, and mitigation consulting for all products within their purview.

Recognising the critical importance of product security as a customer necessity and a competitive edge, our team holds a pivotal position within the organisation. With Atlassian's strong engineering focus and emphasis on autonomous teams, maturing the security of this complex environment stands as our core duty. Our tasks encompass identifying potential security threats in our products, devising suitable mitigation strategies, and evaluating their effectiveness on a large scale. It is imperative to execute these responsibilities in a scalable manner, allowing us to adapt to the evolving landscape shaped by changes in our business, global dynamics, adversarial strategies, customer requirements, technological advancements, and other factors.

**Overview**  
As a **Principal Security Engineer, Cloud Security** at Atlassian, you will be the technical architect and engineer driving the architecture and technical vision across our cloud platforms, infrastructure, and software supply chain. You will partner closely with engineering leadership, platform teams, and principal architects to define secure-by-default standards, architect scalable guardrails, and lead cross - organisational initiatives that protect Atlassian’s cloud environments at global scale.

In this role, you will operate at the intersection of deep technical leadership and strategic influence - diving hands-on into complex architectural designs, critical codebases, and high-severity escalations, while steering long-term security roadmaps and mentoring senior engineers across the organization. You will systematically identify systemic risks, design resilient mitigations, and ensure our cloud platforms deliver world-class security, reliability, and trust for over 300,000+ customers.

Responsibilities:

As a **Principal Product Security Engineer, Cloud Security**, you will be the technical architect and engineer driving the architecture and and strategic SME driving cloud security architecture, automation, and secure-by-default platforms across Atlassian's global footprint. You will define the technical vision, establish architectural standards, and lead cross-organizational initiatives that equip engineering teams with state-of-the-art tools, patterns, and guardrails to build secure products by default. Partnering closely with security leadership, principal architects, and platform engineering teams, you will champion strategic programs that uplift and scale our security posture across multi-cloud environments. Some of your key responsibilities will include:

* **Strategic Architecture & Secure Design:** Define and steer the overarching security architecture for multi-cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), setting company-wide secure-by-default standards, architectural patterns, and guardrails for cloud-native services and core platforms.
* **Complex Threat Modeling & High-Impact Assessments:** Drive advanced threat modeling and deep-dive security assessments across critical, complex systems, distributed microservices, and high-assurance environments (such as Isolated, Private, and Regulated/FedRAMP offerings).
* **Platform Automation & Guardrails at Scale:** Architect, champion, and scale automated security controls, detection capabilities, and self-healing guardrails embedded directly into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (IaC), systematically eliminating classes of vulnerabilities.
* **Continuous Posture Optimization & CSPM Strategy:** Set the technical direction for Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and posture analytics, driving continuous compliance, maturing security baselines, and providing leadership visibility into systemic risk.
* **Operational & Architectural Excellence:** Establish company-wide reusable security frameworks, engineering guidelines, and operational standards that improve resilience, reliability, and security performance across Atlassian products.
* **Technical Leadership & Mentorship:** Serve as a technical sponsor and mentor for security and software engineers across the organization, fostering an inclusive culture of engineering excellence, security advocacy, and cross-team capability uplift.
* **Critical Incident Advisory & Architectural Remediation:** Act as the principal cloud security authority during high-severity security incidents, partnering with Incident Response to conduct root-cause investigations, formulate long-term architectural mitigations, and prevent recurrence.
* **Executive & Stakeholder Influence:** Translate complex cloud security risks and technical roadmaps into strategic priorities for executive and non-technical stakeholders, driving consensus and cross-functional alignment on mission-critical security initiatives.

### **On Your First Day, We'll Expect You To Have**

* 10+ years of experience in security engineering with deep specialization in cloud security, secure architecture, and platform security at enterprise or hyper-growth SaaS scale.
* Proven track record as a technical authority or principal engineer driving large-scale security architectures, risk mitigations, and threat modeling initiatives across complex SaaS and cloud-native systems.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in multi-cloud security (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure) and container orchestration ecosystems (Docker, Kubernetes, service mesh).
* Extensive experience designing, securing, and conducting comprehensive architectural reviews for highly regulated, high-assurance cloud environments (such as Isolated, Private, Government, and FedRAMP offerings).
* Demonstrated experience guiding broad architectural transformations, including overseeing security strategy for monolith-to-microservices migrations.
* Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language (such as Python, Go, Java, or JavaScript) and proven experience authoring scalable security automation, tooling, and infrastructure as code (IaC).
* Deep experience embedding automated security controls, policy-as-code, and compliance gates into modern CI/CD pipelines.
* Exceptional technical communication and executive influence, with a demonstrated ability to align diverse engineering teams, architects, and senior leadership around strategic security goals.
* Proven track record of mentoring and coaching senior engineers and cultivating an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture.

Compensation:

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Deep architectural mastery of cloud security, zero trust architecture, tenant data isolation, cryptographic systems/encryption, and multi-tenant SaaS environments at enterprise scale.
* Proven track record designing and driving infrastructure as code (IaC) governance, centralised secrets management, and embedding automated security guardrails across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Deep understanding of cloud detection engineering, distributed telemetry/logging, IAM graph analysis, least-privilege policy automation, and enterprise alert optimisation.
* Demonstrated ability to champion developer velocity and engineering experience (DevEx) while establishing robust, non-negotiable security guardrails.
* Exceptional communication, technical leadership, and stakeholder influence across both executive leadership and engineering teams.

**It's great, but not required if you have:**

* Extensive experience architecting and building scalable internal software platforms or developer tooling that automate security and compliance workflows.
* Discovered and disclosed notable CVEs, or active maintainership/contributions to open-source security tooling and frameworks.
* Delivered presentations at recognized industry security conferences (e.g., Black Hat, DEF CON) or published security research.
* Deep hands-on experience securing modern serverless architectures, service meshes, and large-scale container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes).
* Experience architecting security controls for highly regulated cloud environments (such as FedRAMP, Isolated, or Sovereign Cloud offerings).

**You’ll Thrive Here If You**

* Take ownership of outcomes and drive projects to completion.
* Are proactive in identifying and mitigating security risks.
* Enjoy collaborating across teams and mentoring others.
* Communicate clearly and adapt your message to your audience.
* Are passionate about scaling security through automation and best practices.

description:
