* Workplace Strategy and Experience: Set and execute the Mumbai workplace strategy, aligning business requirements with global, regional, and local standards to deliver a safe, inclusive, efficient, and differentiated employee experience.
* Enterprise Partnership and Influence: Partner with business leaders and functional teams to prioritize needs, resolve issues at the right level, and influence timely decisions in a complex matrix organization.
* Team Leadership and Capability: Build and lead an inclusive, high-performing One BlackRock team comprising employees and outsourced partners, with clear goals, strong succession, disciplined performance management, and continuous capability development.
* Financial, Risk, and Compliance Ownership: Own annual planning, budget performance, forecasting, controls, and mitigation of operational, financial, regulatory, health and safety, business continuity, security, and reputational risks.
* Vendor and Commercial Performance: Govern strategic supplier relationships, contracts, scopes of work, service levels, key performance indicators, and business reviews to deliver quality, value, innovation, and timely remediation.
* Projects and Change Delivery: Sponsor and oversee local projects with the India Hub Lead and regional and global functions, ensuring robust governance, stakeholder readiness, delivery to scope, schedule, budget, and intended benefits.
* Sustainability and Continuous Improvement: Reduce the site’s environmental impact, advance enterprise sustainability commitments, and use data, feedback, and external insight to identify scalable improvements and build compelling business cases.

**Success Measures**

* Service delivery consistently meets or exceeds agreed SLAs, KPIs, employee experience targets, and stakeholder expectations.
* Operating and project expenditure is delivered within approved plans, supported by accurate forecasts, transparent trade-offs, and demonstrated value.
* Material risks, audit findings, incidents, and vendor underperformance are identified early, escalated appropriately, and remediated within agreed timelines.
* Projects achieve agreed scope, schedule, budget, adoption, and benefits, while sustainability initiatives show measurable improvement against site targets.

**Core Capabilities**

* Strategic and commercial leadership, including strong financial acumen and sound judgment across competing priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead diverse teams, influence senior stakeholders, and deliver outcomes through a matrix organization.
* Strong command of workplace operations, supplier governance, projects, leases, travel, health and safety, business continuity, and corporate security.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English, supported by high emotional intelligence, organization, and disciplined execution.
* Proficiency with integrated workplace management systems, data analysis, and financial modelling tools to support evidence-based decisions.

**Experience And Qualification**

* Minimum 10 -18 years of relevant industry experience, including at least two years with independent accountability for a complex site or comparable operation.
* Proven experience in client service, budget ownership, supplier management, risk and compliance, and cross-functional project delivery.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience required; facilities management, hospitality, real estate, or business education preferred.
* Facilities Management Professional certification, or an equivalent recognized credential, preferred.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Chief Operating Officer (Infrastructure/Real Estate)
description:
**Job Description: Chief Operating Officer (COO)**

**Location:**
Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Reporting to:**
Managing Director / Board of Directors

**About the Organisation**

A real estate and infrastructure development company based in Navi Mumbai, affiliated with the Reputed National and globally recognised University. The organisation focuses on infrastructure and real estate projects that support and complement the Group’s educational, healthcare, sports, and institutional presence in the region. Work primarily involves development and operational support related to the Group’s existing and upcoming facilities and land parcels in Navi Mumbai and the wider Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

**Role Overview**

The Chief Operating Officer will be responsible for the overall day-to-day operations of the company. The role involves translating strategic vision into executable plans, ensuring timely and cost-effective delivery of real estate and infrastructure projects, building robust operational systems, and driving organisational growth.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Operational Leadership & Project Delivery**

* Oversee end-to-end operations of all real estate and infrastructure projects — from planning, land/development stage, construction, quality control, to handover.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to required quality, safety, and compliance standards.
* Establish project governance, milestones, KPIs, dashboards, and regular review mechanisms.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously and resolve operational bottlenecks promptly.

**2. Process Excellence & Systems**

* Design, implement, and continuously improve operational processes, SOPs, and systems across functions (projects, procurement, contracts, quality, safety, etc.).
* Drive institutionalisation of best practices in project management, cost control, risk management, and digital tools (if applicable).
* Ensure strong internal controls, documentation, and audit readiness.

**3. Financial & Cost Management**

* Work closely with Finance on budgeting, cost monitoring, cash-flow management, and profitability of projects.
* Monitor project costs vs. budgets, identify variances early, and implement corrective actions.
* Support commercial decisions related to contracts, vendors, and resource allocation.

**4. Stakeholder & Statutory Management**

* Liaise with government authorities, local bodies (CIDCO, MIDC, municipal corporations, etc.), consultants, contractors, architects, and other external stakeholders.
* Ensure timely statutory approvals, RERA compliance (where applicable), environmental clearances, and other regulatory requirements.
* Represent the company in key external forums as required.

**5. Team Leadership & Organisational Development**

* Build, lead, and mentor high-performing cross-functional teams (projects, procurement, quality, administration, etc.).
* Foster a culture of accountability, safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Identify talent needs, support recruitment of key positions, and drive performance management.

**6. Strategic Support**

* Partner with the MD/Board in translating business strategy into operational plans.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, technology adoption, and operational scalability.
* Support new project evaluation, feasibility assessments, and expansion initiatives in the Navi Mumbai / MMR region.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

**Experience**

* 15+ years of progressive experience in real estate development, infrastructure, EPC, or construction, with at least 5–8 years in a senior leadership role (COO, Business Head – Operations, VP/Head of Projects, or equivalent).
* Proven track record of successfully delivering multiple real estate or infrastructure projects, preferably in the Mumbai / Navi Mumbai / MMR region.
* Strong exposure to project execution, land/development processes, statutory liaisoning, cost control, and contractor/vendor management.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or related technical field (preferred).
* MBA / Post-graduate degree in Management, Operations, or related discipline (preferred).
* Professional certifications (PMP, etc.) will be an advantage.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong leadership and people-management skills.
* Excellent project management, planning, and execution capabilities.
* Commercial and financial acumen with focus on cost and profitability.
* Deep understanding of real estate regulations, RERA, approvals processes, and local authority systems in Maharashtra.
* Strong stakeholder management and negotiation skills.
* Results-oriented, hands-on, and capable of working in a growing organisation environment.
* High integrity and alignment with organisational values.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Prior experience in developer-side real estate operations (preferred over pure EPC).
* Familiarity with Navi Mumbai / MMR market dynamics and infrastructure ecosystem.
* **Experience working in family-promoted or group company environments.**

title: Data Analytics Intern
description:
Programme Overview

The Data Analytics Internship is designed to develop candidates' practical skills in data extraction, data manipulation, business intelligence, statistical analysis, and data visualization. Interns work with business and operational datasets to identify trends, monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), generate meaningful insights, and support organizational decision-making. The programme emphasizes SQL querying, spreadsheet analysis, interactive dashboard development, and automated reporting using industry-standard analytics tools.

Key Responsibilities

* Extract, clean, transform, and aggregate multi-source structured datasets using SQL queries and Excel.
* Perform exploratory and descriptive data analysis to identify business trends, performance patterns, and anomalies.
* Analyze operational and business datasets to identify key performance indicators (KPIs) and performance gaps.
* Build interactive business intelligence dashboards and operational reports using Power BI and Tableau.
* Develop charts, graphs, and visual reports to communicate analytical findings effectively.
* Perform comparative, trend, and performance analysis to support business decision-making.
* Automate recurring reports and improve data reporting workflows.
* Write efficient database queries and retrieve information from relational databases.
* Prepare analytical summaries and present data-driven recommendations to project managers and business stakeholders.
* Maintain data accuracy, consistency, and quality throughout the reporting and analysis process.

Technical Tools & Technologies

* Microsoft Excel (Advanced)
* SQL (PostgreSQL, BigQuery)
* Power BI
* Tableau
* Python (Pandas, NumPy)
* Google Sheets
* Data Visualization
* Git and GitHub

Learning Outcomes

* Master data extraction, cleaning, transformation, and manipulation techniques.
* Develop strong SQL querying skills for working with relational databases.
* Gain practical experience in business intelligence and interactive dashboard development.
* Learn to create professional reports and visualizations using Power BI and Tableau.
* Understand KPI monitoring, business performance analysis, and trend identification.
* Improve statistical interpretation and analytical problem-solving skills.
* Develop the ability to convert raw business data into actionable insights.
* Gain practical experience in communicating analytical findings to business stakeholders.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

Senior Manager Business Planning
description:
The role will have end-to-end responsibility for footwear business planning, production planning, commercial governance, factory capacity planning, vendor management, merchandising coordination, tooling planning, and delivery performance across the India business.

The footwear business is increasingly dependent on an optimal combination of imports and local manufacturing to meet changing business, compliance, quality, cost, and availability requirements. In this environment, the role will be responsible for developing a clear understanding of current and future production capacity, identifying potential supply constraints, and proactively aligning production plans with business requirements.

The position will work closely with Category, Merchandising, Planning, Sourcing, Finance, Supply Chain, Quality, Product Development, Operations, and manufacturing partners to ensure that the business has the right product, at the right cost, in the right quantity and at the right time.

The ideal candidate should bring strong footwear industry experience, commercial acumen, analytical capability and a strong understanding of production planning, factory operations, vendor management, and business planning.

**Designation:**
Senior Manager

**Department:**
Category – Footwear

**Function:**
Business Planning & Commercials

**Reports To:**
Director – Category (Footwear)

**Experience:**
12+ Years

**Qualification:**
FDDI / NIFT preferred; Post-Graduation in Footwear, Business Planning, Supply Chain, Production Planning, Merchandising or a related discipline preferred

**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Planning & Commercial Governance
* Drive the overall business planning for the Footwear Category across India, ensuring alignment with business strategy, channel requirements, and financial objectives.
* Develop and maintain the annual, seasonal, and monthly footwear business plans in alignment with category and channel requirements.
* Understand the business dynamics and commercial requirements across Retail, MBO, Distribution, E-commerce, and other relevant channels.
* Translate sales plans and business requirements into actionable buying, production, and supply plans.
* Drive OTB planning and governance, ensuring that all buying decisions are aligned with approved budgets, business plans, and commercial objectives.
* Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained before commitments or buys are placed.
* Define and govern the Annual Footwear Buy Plan, including import and local production requirements.
* Monitor business performance against planned buys, sales, inventory, margin, and cost objectives.
* Partner with Finance and Category teams to ensure alignment between business plans and financial targets.
* Identify commercial risks and opportunities and provide timely recommendations to the leadership team.
* Margin, COGS & Commercial Management
* Drive governance of agreed Gross Margin (GM%) deliverables for the Footwear business.
* Plan and monitor COGS as a percentage of MRP for each season and across relevant product/channel segments.
* Analyze cost structures and identify opportunities for improving product economics and overall business profitability.
* Work closely with sourcing, merchandising, and manufacturing teams to identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality, product standards or delivery timelines.
* Monitor cost movements arising from local manufacturing, imports, production efficiencies, tooling, and other commercial factors.
* Evaluate the financial impact of production and supply decisions and provide recommendations to the Category leadership.
* Track commercial deviations against approved plans and ensure timely corrective action.
* Support scenario planning for changes in demand, production capacity, cost, lead times, and business requirements.
* Production Planning & Factory Capacity Management
* Own the production planning framework for locally manufactured footwear.
* Develop a clear view of current and future factory capacity, production output, and available manufacturing capability.
* Align factory capacity with seasonal business requirements, sales orders, and agreed production plans.
* Monitor factory production output against the agreed plan and proactively identify capacity constraints.
* Work closely with factories to optimize production schedules based on business priorities.
* Manage production planning challenges arising from changing demand, quality requirements, compliance requirements, raw material availability, and factory constraints.
* Develop alternate production scenarios where planned output is at risk.
* Ensure production plans are realistic, achievable, and aligned with required delivery dates.
* Establish regular production planning reviews with manufacturing partners.
* Drive weekly and monthly production planning and dispatch reviews.
* Factory & Vendor Performance Management
* Establish and maintain vendor/factory performance scorecards covering key operational and commercial parameters.
* Track and improve key KPIs including:
* OTIF – On-Time In-Full delivery
* On-time production completion
* Dispatch adherence
* Production output
* Capacity utilization
* Quality performance
* Production lead time
* Plan adherence
* Commercial compliance
* Identify underperforming factories/vendors and develop corrective action plans.
* Work with vendors to resolve production and delivery challenges and escalate critical issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Conduct regular factory reviews to evaluate production performance, capacity, constraints, and upcoming requirements.
* Undertake visits to production facilities as required to review production planning, manufacturing progress, and dispatch readiness.
* Ensure factories have clear visibility of business requirements and agreed production priorities.
* Drive accountability among vendors for committed timelines and deliverables.
* Merchandising & Product Planning Coordination
* Partner closely with the Footwear Merchandising and Category teams to translate assortment and sales requirements into actionable production and buying plans.
* Ensure production planning is aligned with seasonal assortment requirements and approved sales orders.
* Monitor product-level requirements and identify potential supply gaps.
* Coordinate with merchandising teams on product availability, production status, and delivery timelines.
* Ensure that changes in product requirements, quantities or timelines are communicated to factories in a timely manner.
* Support business decisions related to local production versus imports based on capacity, cost, lead time, quality, and business requirements.
* Provide commercial and operational inputs into seasonal planning and range-building discussions.
* Tooling Planning & Management
* Own the planning and governance of footwear tooling requirements in alignment with sales orders and production plans.
* Ensure tooling requirements are identified and communicated sufficiently in advance to avoid production delays.
* Track tooling development and readiness against agreed production timelines.
* Coordinate with relevant product development, merchandising, sourcing, and factory teams to ensure tooling availability.
* Identify tooling-related risks and escalate potential impact on production or delivery timelines.
* Establish visibility of tooling requirements across seasons and future production plans.
* Imports & Local Manufacturing Planning
* Develop an optimal planning approach for the import and locally manufactured footwear portfolio.
* Evaluate business requirements and recommend the appropriate sourcing/manufacturing mix.
* Consider factors such as:
* Factory capacity
* Production lead time
* Product availability
* COGS
* Quality requirements
* Compliance requirements
* Tooling requirements
* Demand and sales plans
* Delivery commitments
* Proactively identify situations where local production capacity may not be sufficient and recommend alternate supply solutions.
* Support the Category leadership team with data-driven recommendations on production versus import decisions.
* Business Analytics, Reporting & MIS
* Develop and maintain robust business planning and production tracking tools to provide timely visibility to the Category and leadership teams.
* Prepare detailed and actionable analytics covering:
* Business plan vs. actual
* Buy plan vs. actual
* OTB utilization
* Production plan vs. actual
* Factory capacity
* Production output
* OTIF performance
* Dispatch status
* COGS and margin
* Vendor performance
* Tooling readiness
* Supply risks
* Ensure all reports are supported by accurate, timely and reliable data.
* Provide clear insights, risks, and recommended actions, rather than only reporting historical performance.
* Establish weekly and monthly reporting mechanisms for leadership review.
* Develop dashboards that provide forward-looking visibility on production and supply risks.
* Highlight deviations early and ensure ownership and closure of action points.
* Process, SOP & Governance
* Develop and strengthen SOPs, processes and governance mechanisms for business planning, production planning, factory reporting and vendor management.
* Standardize planning and reporting practices across factories and business stakeholders.
* Ensure factories follow agreed reporting formats, timelines, and planning processes.
* Establish clear escalation mechanisms for production, capacity, quality, and delivery risks.
* Drive process discipline and ensure adherence to agreed procedures.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and increased planning efficiency.
* Align factory processes with relevant global requirements, processes, and best practices.
* Facilitate effective communication between India factories and the global team.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration

**Work Closely With Internal And External Stakeholders Including**

* Category – Footwear
* Merchandising
* Planning
* Sourcing
* Supply Chain
* Finance
* Quality
* Product Development
* Retail
* E-commerce
* Distribution
* Operations
* Global/Regional Teams
* Local Manufacturing Partners
* Vendors and Factories

Ensure that all stakeholders have timely visibility of business plans, production requirements, risks, changes, and delivery commitments.

* Team Leadership & Capability Building
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 4 direct reports.
* Establish clear goals, responsibilities, and performance expectations for the team.
* Build strong analytical, planning, and commercial capabilities within the team.
* Encourage ownership, accountability, and proactive problem-solving.
* Review team performance through structured business reviews and KPI tracking.
* Develop succession capability and ensure adequate functional coverage.
* Create a culture of urgency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Key Performance Indicators**

The role will be measured against a combination of business, commercial, operational, and planning KPIs, including:

**Business & Commercial**

* Annual/seasonal business plan adherence
* OTB utilization and governance
* GM% achievement
* COGS% to MRP
* Buy plan adherence
* Commercial savings/optimization initiatives

**Production & Supply**

* Production plan adherence
* Factory capacity utilization
* On-time production completion
* OTIF performance
* On-time dispatch percentage
* Production lead-time adherence
* Reduction in production-related business risks

**Vendor Management**

* Vendor/factory scorecard performance
* Improvement in underperforming vendor performance
* Timely closure of corrective action plans

**Planning & Governance**

* Accuracy and timeliness of business/production plans
* Timely identification of capacity constraints
* Tooling readiness against production requirements
* Compliance with planning SOPs
* Accuracy and timeliness of management reporting

**Candidate Profile**

**Educational Qualification**

* Graduate/post-graduate qualification from FDDI, NIFT or another reputed institution preferred.
* Candidates with a strong Footwear Production Planning / Manufacturing / Supply Chain / Merchandising / Business Planning background may also be considered.
* Post-Graduation in Business Management, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related discipline would be an advantage.

**Experience**

* 12+ years of relevant experience, preferably within the footwear industry.
* Strong experience in business planning, production planning, footwear manufacturing, and/or commercial planning.
* Experience working with footwear factories, vendors, and manufacturing partners.
* Strong understanding of footwear production processes, capacity planning, and delivery management.
* Experience managing multiple stakeholders and leading a team is essential.
* Exposure to both local manufacturing and import planning would be highly desirable.

**Functional Competencies**

**The Candidate Should Demonstrate Strong Capability In**

* Footwear Business Planning
* Production Planning
* Factory Capacity Planning
* Commercial Planning
* OTB Planning & Governance
* COGS & Margin Management
* Vendor Management
* Factory Performance Management
* Merchandising Coordination
* Tooling Planning
* Supply Planning
* Business Analytics
* MIS & Dashboard Development
* Cost Optimization
* Process & SOP Development
* Risk Identification & Mitigation
* Cross-functional Stakeholder Management

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Dynamic and versatile with the ability to operate in a fast-paced business environment.
* Strong analytical and planning orientation.
* High level of commercial acumen and business understanding.
* Strong decision-making and problem-solving ability.
* Highly detail-oriented with strong process discipline.
* Strong sense of urgency and ownership.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Team player with the ability to work effectively across functions and cultures.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage stretched timelines when business requirements demand.
* Strong execution focuses with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, including data analysis, reporting and business planning.
* Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint for management presentations.
* Working knowledge of MS Word.
* Experience with ERP/Planning/Business Intelligence systems would be an advantage.
* Ability to build and maintain analytical dashboards and production/business tracking tools.

**Key Role Expectations**

**The Successful Candidate Will Be Expected To**

**Own the Footwear business planning agenda**
and ensure alignment between business requirements and supply capability. Maintain strong forward visibility of
**production output, factory capacity, and delivery commitments**
. Ensure the right balance between
**imports and local manufacturing**
. Protect and improve
**commercial outcomes through OTB, COGS and GM governance**
. Ensure factories and vendors deliver against agreed plans and timelines. Identify production, capacity, tooling, and delivery risks
**before they impact the business**
. Provide leadership with accurate, timely and actionable business intelligence. Establish robust planning processes, SOPs, and governance mechanisms. Build a high-performing and commercially oriented planning team. Act as a key link between
**Category, Merchandising, Factories, Vendors, Finance, Supply Chain and Global Stakeholders**
.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate will be a
**footwear industry professional with strong business planning and commercial expertise**
, who can operate across both strategic planning and day-to-day execution. The person should be equally comfortable analyzing business numbers, reviewing factory capacity, challenging production plans, managing vendors, driving cross-functional alignment and presenting clear recommendations to senior leadership.

The role requires an individual who can
**anticipate business requirements, translate them into executable production and commercial plans, identify risks early and drive stakeholders towards timely closure**
, while maintaining strong process discipline and commercial accountability.

The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services. 

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:**
 

This role is based out of the People & ORG CoE which sits in the broader Data & Tech cluster at the BCN. People & ORG CoE works on building and deploying analytical solutions pertaining to Operating Model and Organization Practice. The team primarily helps Bain case teams, across geographies and industries, solve critical client issues by applying battle-proven diagnostics/ solutions that can identify client pain points related to org, culture, and talent. The team also plays a significant role in creating, testing, and contributing to the proprietary products and Bain IP within the Org domain. This role will focus on development, maintenance and evolution of the state-of-the art org tool and data assets.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* Clean, harmonize and prepare large past client datasets (multi-wave, multi-region, industry, size bands) for analysis

**ABOUT YOU:**

* Good business acumen and ability to work collaboratively in a consulting-style environment
* Must be able to generate and screen realistic answers based on sound reality checks and recommend actionable solutions
* Must be willing to own and maintain high visibility and high impact product
* Excellent oral and written communication skills including the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical senior stakeholders

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK:**

Demonstrated experience working with compensation data, salary benchmarking, or market-pricing analysis. Strong Microsoft Excel capability, including:Pivot TablesXLOOKUP and INDEX-MATCHAdvanced formulasData validation and reconciliationLarge dataset manipulationPower QueryReporting and dashboard developmentStrong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify data anomalies and investigate root causes. Ability to interpret data and develop meaningful conclusions rather than simply producing reports. High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work with broad direction. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Experience working across countries, regions, or business units. Preferred QualificationsExperience within Technology, IT Services, Consulting, or Professional Services. Experience with compensation survey platforms such as Mercer, Aon Radford, WTW, Comptryx, Remchannel, or equivalent providers. Experience with Power BI or comparable data-visualization tools. title: Grants Payments Data Analyst
description:
Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At **Worldwide Clinical Trials** , we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.

  

With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.

  

**Make an Impact as a Grants Payments Data Analyst at Worldwide**
-----------------------------------------------------------------

  

As a Grants Payments Data Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how clinical site payments are forecasted and reported. Your work will help bring together critical financial and operational data, supporting accurate forecasting and informed decision-making across clinical studies.

In this role, you'll take ownership of forecasting models used outside of Medidata Payments, driving ongoing enhancements and ensuring alignment with broader payment forecasting processes. You’ll collaborate with teams across Revenue Recognition, Clinical Payments, Investigator Grants Payments, Project Analysis, and Clinical Operations to develop efficient, audit-ready forecasting solutions.

Your expertise will help deliver accurate client-facing financial forecasts, support compliance with financial reporting requirements, and contribute to the successful management and reconciliation of clinical site payments throughout the study lifecycle.

  

**Where You'll Work**
---------------------

  

This is a REMOTE role open to candidates based in India. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.

Travel for this role is remote-based and may be required only as specified by business needs.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve forecasting models used outside of Medidata Payments.
* Partner with Central Planning and Clinical Operations teams to gather and analyze site and patient enrollment actuals and forecasts.
* Integrate forecasting outputs with Medidata Payments forecasts to support end-to-end clinical site payment planning.
* Collaborate with Revenue Recognition teams to ensure forecasting processes meet financial audit and compliance requirements.
* Create client-ready forecasting reports and deliverables in accordance with sponsor contractual requirements.
* Analyze forecast performance, budget utilization, and plan-versus-actual results to identify trends and risks.
* Communicate over- and under-forecast variances to Project Analysts and Global Project Leads, enabling timely corrective action.
* Support study closeout activities through final payment reconciliations and preparation of client-ready financial reports.
Contribute to process development and continuous improvement initiatives related to clinical site payment forecasting and reporting.  

  

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

  

* Bachelor's degree and 2–5 years of finance experience.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex financial and operational data.
* Experience working with Excel, databases, and accounting systems.
* Understanding of accounting principles and revenue recognition standards.
* Knowledge of clinical site payment processes and forecasting methodologies.
* Ability to influence, collaborate, and challenge stakeholders constructively across cross-functional teams.
* Experience supporting audit requirements, financial reporting, and compliance-related activities.
Proficiency in English.  

  

**Discover the Difference**

  

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do. Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit **http://www.worldwide.com/careers** **,** or connect with us on **LinkedIn** .

description:
**Role Objective**

The key objective of this position is to ensure timely availability of raw materials and packing materials to support uninterrupted production operations. The role is responsible for executing Material Requirement Planning (MRP) runs, generating purchase requisitions, coordinating with procurement teams for purchase order creation, and ensuring timely delivery of materials as per production schedules.

The position plays a critical role in aligning material availability with production plans, monitoring inventory levels, and coordinating with cross-functional teams to avoid production delays due to material shortages.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* Professional certifications such as Certified in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM) or equivalent will be considered an advantage.
* 8–10 years of experience in material planning, supply planning, or inventory management within a manufacturing environment.
* Strong hands-on experience in executing MRP runs and material planning processes.
* Experience in raising Purchase Requisitions (PR), coordinating for Purchase Orders (PO), and vendor delivery follow-ups.
* Hands-on experience with SAP (MRP / MM modules) and strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel.
* Solid understanding of inventory management, material planning, and supply chain processes.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Execute MRP runs in SAP to identify material requirements based on production plans and demand forecasts.

* Create and release Purchase Requisitions (PR) in SAP based on MRP results and production requirements.
* Coordinate with the procurement team to ensure timely conversion of PR to Purchase Orders (PO).
* Follow up with procurement and vendors to ensure on-time delivery of raw materials and packing materials.
* Ensure material availability in line with the production plan to prevent production interruptions.
* Monitor inventory levels, safety stock, and consumption trends to maintain optimal stock levels.
* Coordinate with Production Planning, Stores, Quality, and Procurement teams to ensure smooth material flow.
* Track incoming materials and proactively escalate potential delivery delays or shortages.
* Maintain accurate planning parameters and master data in SAP for material planning activities.
* Support cross-functional teams in material code creation, BOM updates, and planning master data updates where required.
* Prepare and maintain MIS reports related to material planning, shortages, and inventory status.
* Ensure proper documentation and adherence to planning processes and internal quality systems.

**Functional Skills Required**

* Material Requirement Planning (MRP)
* Inventory Planning & Control
* SAP MM / MRP Modules
* Purchase Requisition Management
* Vendor Follow-up & Material Coordination
* Data Analysis and MIS Reporting
* Understanding of manufacturing supply chain workflows
* Cross-functional coordination with production and procurement teams

**Behavioral Skills Required**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Excellent organizational and planning skills
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to multitask and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Attention to detail and accuracy in planning and reporting
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills
* Proactive decision-making and issue resolution capability

**Team Size**

* Reports to: Assistant General Manager – Supply Planning
* Team Structure: Individual contributor role with cross-functional collaboration responsibilities.

**About Bayfield Food Ingredients**
Bayfield Food Ingredients is a dynamic and innovative company specializing in the development and manufacturing of high-quality flavors and seasonings for the food industry. (www.bayfield.in)
  
  
We are passionate about creating exceptional taste experiences that delight consumers and help our clients succeed. With a focus on culinary expertise and cutting-edge technology, we strive to provide customized solutions that meet the unique needs of each customer. At Bayfield, we are committed to quality, creativity, and collaboration, fostering a stimulating work environment where employees are empowered to contribute and grow.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Sensory Science Specialist will play a crucial role in developing and implementing sensory evaluation strategies for our diverse range of flavors and seasonings. This role requires a strong understanding of sensory science principles, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work collaboratively within a cross-functional team. The ideal candidate will be passionate about food and possess a keen sense of taste and smell.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Method Development: Develop and optimize sensory methodologies for evaluating various flavor and seasoning profiles, including descriptive analysis, discrimination testing, and consumer preference studies.

* Collaboration: Work closely with product development, marketing, and quality assurance teams to provide sensory guidance and support product innovation and improvement efforts.
* Literature Review: Stay abreast of current trends and advancements in sensory science and related fields.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate records of sensory evaluations, panel performance, and research findings.

* Education: M.Sc. Chemical Science, Food Science, or a related field.
* Experience: [2 to 5 years in sensory evaluation or similar, preferably in the food industry.

* Strong understanding of sensory science principles and methodologies.
* Experience in panel management and training.
* Proficiency in statistical analysis of sensory data.
* Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Familiarity with sensory software and data analysis tools.
* Passion for food and flavor.

As per industry standards

Java

title: Product Architect
description:
**We are hiring Principal Data Architect / Product Architect for a global software company based out of chennai. - 15 + years preferred ground from Microsoft, Amazon , Google , or similar enterprise technology/product organizations**

**Domain:**
Enterprise AI | Generative AI | Data Platforms | Cloud SaaS | Product Architecture

**The Role**

We are seeking an accomplished
**Principal Data Architect / Product Architect**
with 15+ years of experience to lead the architecture and technical evolution of next-generation enterprise AI platform.

This role will be responsible for designing scalable, secure, cloud-native AI products and enterprise data architectures, translating complex business requirements into reusable technology platforms that deliver measurable business value.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in modern data architectures, cloud technologies, AI/ML, Generative AI, and enterprise SaaS product development, preferably gained through experience with
**Microsoft, Amazon, Google, or comparable global technology companies.**

The architect will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, and business leadership to define architectural strategy, establish technology standards, and ensure successful platform development and enterprise adoption.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise Data & Product Architecture**

* Define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for enterprise AI platform.
* Design highly scalable, resilient, secure, and modular cloud-native product architectures.
* Establish enterprise data architecture frameworks supporting structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.
* Architect modern data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, data warehouses, and real-time data processing.
* Build reusable platform components, APIs, microservices, integration frameworks, and enterprise data services.
* Ensure architectural alignment between product capabilities, enterprise customer requirements, and long-term technology strategy.

**2. AI/ML & Generative AI Architecture**

* Architect enterprise-grade AI/ML and Generative AI solutions, including LLM-based applications and intelligent AI agents.
* Design Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, vector database integrations, embedding pipelines, and semantic search capabilities.
* Establish AI agent orchestration patterns, model evaluation frameworks, and integration with enterprise workflows.
* Develop solutions to address hallucination reduction, contextual retrieval accuracy, model reliability, and response quality.
* Define scalable MLOps and LLMOps frameworks covering model deployment, monitoring, versioning, governance, and optimization.
* Evaluate foundation models, AI frameworks, and emerging technologies for enterprise product integration.

**3. Cloud & Platform Engineering**

* Lead cloud-native architecture leveraging
  **Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).**
* Design distributed systems, containerized applications, microservices, event-driven architectures, and API-led integrations.
* Establish architectural standards for scalability, performance, availability, security, and cost optimization.
* Guide engineering teams on Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and DevSecOps practices.
* Design secure integration patterns for enterprise applications, data platforms, and third-party services.

**4. Product Architecture & Technology Strategy**

* Partner with Product Management to convert product vision and roadmaps into executable technical architectures.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, technology investments, platform capabilities, and architectural trade-offs.
* Establish reusable product frameworks and domain-specific accelerators to accelerate product development.
* Drive architectural consistency across multiple products, engineering teams, and customer implementations.
* Ensure the platform supports multi-tenancy, extensibility, interoperability, and enterprise-grade security.
* Contribute to technical feasibility assessments, proof-of-concepts, architecture reviews, and product innovation.

**5. Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

* Serve as the principal technical authority for enterprise AI and data platform architecture.
* Collaborate with senior engineering leaders, data scientists, product managers, and enterprise customers.
* Mentor solution architects, data architects, and senior engineers.
* Lead architecture design reviews, technical decision-making, and technology governance.
* Engage with enterprise customers to understand integration requirements, architectural challenges, and deployment considerations.
* Influence technology direction through architectural recommendations and hands-on technical leadership.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

**Overall Experience**

* Minimum 15+ years in software engineering, enterprise architecture, data architecture, or product/platform engineering.
* Significant experience in senior architecture roles involving enterprise-scale products or platforms.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering complex B2B SaaS, AI/ML, or data-driven enterprise platforms.

**Data Architecture & Engineering**

* Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, distributed processing, and data governance.
* Experience with technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent data platforms.
* Expertise in modern data lakehouse architectures and enterprise data integration patterns.

**AI/ML & GenAI**

* Strong understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, RAG, vector databases, and agentic AI architectures.
* Working knowledge of AI orchestration frameworks and model evaluation methods.
* Experience architecting scalable AI-powered applications or products.

**Cloud & Engineering**

* Deep architectural expertise in at least one major hyperscaler: Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Strong knowledge of microservices, REST APIs, distributed systems, Kubernetes, and cloud-native architectures.
* Understanding of enterprise security, identity management, encryption, compliance, and platform observability.

**Product Architecture**

* Experience building reusable, configurable, and scalable enterprise software products rather than exclusively project-specific solutions.
* Ability to translate product requirements into architecture blueprints and technical roadmaps.
* Experience making architectural decisions that balance business value, technical feasibility, security, performance, and cost.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Prior experience working with Microsoft, Amazon or Google is strongly preferred.**
* Experience building commercial AI, SaaS, cloud, or enterprise data products at scale.
* Previous involvement in platform architecture, architecture leadership, or Principal/Distinguished Engineer-level responsibilities.
* Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or similar enterprise AI services.
* Exposure to enterprise GenAI governance, responsible AI, and data privacy frameworks.
* Strong experience collaborating with global engineering and product teams.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

An experienced
**Principal Architect, Enterprise Data Architect, AI Platform Architect, or Product Architect**
who has spent 15+ years designing enterprise technologies and has demonstrated the ability to build scalable cloud and AI-enabled products.

title: Senior Cloud Operations Engineer, Staff
description:
**We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
**You Are**
You have spent years keeping Linux infrastructure running under real pressure, the kind where a compute farm going down at 2 a.m. means a tape-out slips and someone loses sleep. You know the difference between a system that looks healthy in a dashboard and one that actually stays up when 10,000 simulation jobs hit it at once. You have debugged enough weird failures to know that the answer is rarely in the first log you check, and you are comfortable digging until you find it.
  
  
Working across cloud and on-prem does not rattle you. You have built things in Azure or AWS using Terraform and Ansible, not because it was trendy but because manual provisioning does not scale. You script in Bash and Python not to show off but to stop doing the same thing twice. When a designer in Singapore cannot access a license server, you do not guess, you pull tcpdump, check journalctl, trace the route, and fix it.
  
  
You care about uptime because you know the teams depending on your infrastructure are racing deadlines that matter. At Synopsys, you will support compute environments that power chip design work across the company, and what you keep running directly affects whether engineers can do their jobs.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
Administer and maintain CentOS/ALMA Linux systems across Azure, AWS, and GCP cloud environments that support large-scale EDA compute farms and design workflows
  
  
Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure at scale using Terraform and Ansible, handling compute, storage, and networking for simulation, synthesis, and verification workloads
  
  
Monitor system health, capacity, and performance using Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic Search, or Splunk, catching issues before they affect design teams
  
  
Troubleshoot complex system, network, and application-level problems using tcpdump, netstat, journalctl, and other diagnostic tools to minimize downtime during critical tape-out windows
  
  
Manage license servers (FlexLM/FlexNet) and batch scheduling systems like LSF, SGE, Slurm, or Altair PBS that queue simulation and regression jobs
  
  
Coordinate tool version upgrades, freeware installs, and compatibility validation with CAD and EDA application support teams
  
  
Participate in rotational shift work (monthly rotation) and on-call weekend coverage, providing front-line support to internal design and verification teams
  
  
**The Impact You Will Have**
Keep compute infrastructure running so IC design, verification, and physical design teams can meet tape-out deadlines without infrastructure delays
  
  
Reduce incident response time and system downtime through proactive monitoring, automation, and structured root-cause analysis
  
  
Scale cloud infrastructure efficiently using Infrastructure as Code, enabling faster provisioning and more reliable deployments across global teams
  
  
Improve system reliability and performance tuning so simulation and synthesis jobs run faster and more predictably
  
  
Build runbooks and documentation that help junior admins resolve issues independently and reduce repeat escalations
  
  
Strengthen cross-team collaboration by translating complex infrastructure problems into clear updates for CAD, DevOps, security, and design engineering teams
  
  
Support the adoption of AI-powered tools and workflows by maintaining the underlying compute and cloud infrastructure they depend on
  
  
**What You'll Need**
5+ years of hands-on Linux systems administration experience, ideally supporting compute-intensive or EDA environments
  
  
Strong proficiency with CentOS, ALMA, or similar Linux distributions in production cloud environments
  
  
Hands-on experience with Azure (preferred), and working knowledge of AWS or GCP
  
  
Proven experience using Terraform and Ansible to deploy and manage large-scale compute and storage infrastructure
  
  
Strong scripting skills in Bash and Python for automation, troubleshooting, and workflow optimization
  
  
Experience managing batch scheduling systems such as LSF, SGE/Univa Grid Engine, Slurm, or Altair PBS
  
  
Familiarity with license management tools like FlexLM or FlexNet, and monitoring/logging platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic Search, or Splunk is a plus
  
  
**Who You Are**
You can troubleshoot a network connectivity issue using tcpdump, netstat, traceroute, and dig without needing a runbook in front of you
  
  
You write scripts to automate repeated tasks because doing the same manual work twice feels like a waste of time
  
  
You treat internal design teams like customers, their productivity depends on your systems staying up, and you take that seriously
  
  
You can translate a complex infrastructure failure into a two-sentence update for a VP without losing the technical nuance that matters
  
  
You stay calm during on-call incidents and work methodically through root-cause analysis instead of guessing and hoping
  
  
You are comfortable coordinating across network, security, CAD, and DevOps teams to get a problem solved, even when it crosses multiple domains
  
  
**The Team You'll Be Part Of**
You will be part of a dynamic and collaborative Cloud Operations team that keeps our cloud environment running smoothly, securely, and reliably. Operating 24×5, we play a critical role in ensuring service availability, proactively monitoring infrastructure, and responding swiftly to incidents. We believe in teamwork, ownership, continuous learning, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Every team member contributes to operational excellence by embracing automation, driving improvements, and sharing knowledge. Together, we don’t just keep the cloud running—we continuously evolve, innovate, and deliver reliable services that make a real difference to the business.
  
  
**Rewards And Benefits**
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

**Performance & Reliability Optimization**

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with engineering, data science, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and business teams to operationalize AI initiatives and ensure comprehensive observability coverage.

**Budget & Vendor Management**

* Manage departmental budgets and vendor relationships to deliver cost-effective, scalable solutions.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, IT, or a related field.
* 15+ years of progressive technology experience, including 5–7 years in enterprise operations, ARE/SRE and AI operations.
* Deep understanding of the lifecycle, including development, deployment, observability, and retraining.
* Proven experience with enterprise observability across hybrid environments.
* Expertise in AIOps principles and implementation.

* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, containerization, and microservices.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Open Telemetry, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana - PLGJ stack

MCP, REST APIs

Jira

title: Software Development Engineer II, International Emerging Stores Sub-same Day
description:
**Description**
Do you want to shape how fast Amazon can deliver to hundreds of millions of customers? The Sub-Same-Day (SSD) team builds the technology behind Amazon's fastest delivery promises across India and Emerging Marketplaces — getting orders to customers in hours, not days.
  
  
We're looking for a Software Development Engineer II who wants to own high-scale, low-latency systems that directly move the speed and reliability customers see at checkout. You'll design and build services that compute and optimize the fastest reliable delivery promise for every order.
  
  

* Build customer-facing systems at massive scale and single-digit-millisecond latency
* Own features end-to-end, from design through production and operations
* Directly impact conversion, delivery speed, and customer trust across 10+ marketplaces

Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency, highly available services that power SSD delivery promises.
* Own features end-to-end — requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations.
* Lead design discussions and independently drive alignment with partner teams (Promise, transportation, search etc. ).
* Uphold operational excellence: monitoring, alarming, on-call, and driving down defects and tickets.
* Dive deep on edge cases, testing, and safe production rollouts (canary deployments, metrics, dashboards).
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks; communicate progress, blockers, and tradeoffs clearly.
* Mentor SDE-1s and junior engineers — review code and designs, unblock them, and raise the technical bar.
* Contribute to the team's technical roadmap and continuous improvement of our systems.

A day in the life
  
  
You'll partner with product managers, applied scientists, and engineering teams across Promise, ATROPS, transportation, and DEX to ship features that make delivery faster and more reliable. A typical day includes a team standup, design and code reviews, hands-on development, and digging into production metrics. You'll take part in operational excellence and on-call to keep our services healthy. Beyond delivery, we invest in learning and fun — quarterly hackathons and fortnightly GenAI brown-bag sessions where the team explores new technology together.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Sub-Same-Day (SSD) team owns the technology behind Amazon's fastest delivery experiences across India and Emerging Marketplaces (AU, BR, MX, AE, SA, SG, EG, TR, ZA). Our mission is to give every customer the fastest reliable promise we can keep — and to extend same-day and sub-same-day speed to new marketplaces and customers. We're a high-ownership, customer-obsessed team that values deep technical work, operational excellence, and continuous learning. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Engineering Manager, AI Builder Experience
description:
AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI — and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience org at MongoDB, we’re forming a brand new engineering team to make that happen, and we're looking for the founding Engineering Manager to hire the team, set the technical direction, and ship integrations into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech.
  
  
In this role, you'll be close enough to the code to jump into exploratory work yourself while also building the team, process, and operational rigor to keep a growing integration portfolio healthy long-term. The new team will work mostly in Python and TypeScript while collaborating closely with client library teams and other engineering groups across MongoDB that deliver the underlying driver, platform, and product capabilities needed to support these integrations well.
  
  
You’ll collaborate closely and move quickly with product, partners, field teams, the developer community, and open source project maintainers to ship where demand is real, deepen investment where adoption proves out, and evolve the portfolio over time as it becomes a critical part of MongoDB’s future in AI.
  
  
MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our values every day. We value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Position expectations
  
  

* Work closely with recruiting to hire a team of Python and TypeScript engineers who will build and own MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like Langchain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra
* Execute effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities may shift week to week based on framework changes, customer demand, partner needs, and strategic opportunity. Deliver quickly while keeping a high standard of technical quality
* Flag issues, concerns, and resource needs early, working with management to triage, staff, borrow expertise, and cross-functionally hand off completed projects as needed
* Work closely with product managers, program managers, sales, GTM, and peer engineering teams to define, prioritize, and deliver capabilities that improve the builder experience and strengthen MongoDB’s position in the AI framework ecosystem; help decide where to invest effort and where to pull back
* Manage dependencies on drivers, platform capabilities, and other MongoDB product surfaces required to deliver excellent framework integrations
* Collaborate with external teams who own open source projects MongoDB integrates with, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy to work effectively through external maintainer review cycles to land high-quality upstream contributions
* Jump in to do initial, exploratory work. Guide key decisions, unblock the team, and contribute when needed as projects grow
* Own the monitoring, operations, maintenance, and ongoing quality of a broad, evolving integration portfolio; develop testing strategy, release readiness, and operational follow-through after launch
* Help the team build and maintain sustainable engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, version compatibility awareness, and strong integration health over time
* Develop a team that stays current with the Python, TypeScript, and broader AI builder ecosystems, including important frameworks, community discussions, and emerging patterns; maintain awareness of trends and discourse in contemporary AI
* Bring a research and discovery mindset to the role, using customer, community, partner, and field signals to help guide roadmap and investment decisions; identify emerging opportunities in the ecosystem and help decide where early investment could create strategic advantage

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience building developer platforms, libraries, or other high-scale technical systems, with strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript and an ability to lead teams working across both the Python and TypeScript ecosystems. Experience working with programming language polyglot teams is a plus
* 3+ years of experience managing a team of software engineers and providing technical leadership for complex projects or products
* Experience with query optimization (especially MongoDB) and AI coding tools; distributed systems experience would be an asset
* Demonstrated success hiring, mentoring, and growing high-performing engineering teams, including experience supporting career development, feedback, and performance management
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving technical landscape with frequent context switching, incomplete information, and competing opportunities, while maintaining sound prioritization and strong judgment
* Strong technical depth in developer-facing software, with the judgment to make and guide architectural trade-offs
* Experience leading the launch of new features or systems and operating them successfully in production after release
* Excellent written and verbal technical communication, with a strong instinct to collaborate across engineering, product, and other stakeholder groups
* A track record of escalating issues early and fostering a team culture that values intellectual honesty and collaboration
* Comfort operating in ambiguous, evolving spaces and helping teams make progress when customer behavior, technical requirements, or ecosystem priorities are still taking shape
* Strong and demonstrated interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape, ideally with familiarity across frameworks, retrieval patterns, agent workflows, embedding, vector search, or adjacent areas; experience in this area would be an asset
* Experience working with open source software, external ecosystems, or integrations with third-party frameworks and communities, especially in the Python ecosystem; familiarity with open source contribution models, external maintainers, and engineering work that spans company-owned and upstream repositories would be a plus

Success measures
  
  

* In the first month, you will understand the team’s scope, the high-level architecture of the platform and integrations, the current portfolio of work, and the key technical and organizational dependencies around the role. You will start building relationships with cross-functional partners, especially recruiting, and develop a hiring plan
* In three months, in collaboration with our recruiting team, you will have a healthy candidate pipeline and the first members of your new team onboarding. You’ll have a hand-off plan with the teams currently owning AI Framework Integrations
* In six months, you will have staffed the core of your team, demonstrated effective partnership with recruiting, taken responsibility for major initiatives in the upcoming quarter, and improved the team’s ability to execute through technical and organizational ambiguity
* In twelve months, you’ll be having active growth conversations with your team members about performance and longer-term career development. You’ll have led the development and operation of multiple meaningful features or integrations and helped shape the forward-looking technical and execution strategy for this area

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.
