title: Manager | Fusion Technical | Ahmedabad | Oracle
description:
**Job Title:**

Oracle Fusion Technical Manager

**Experience:** 9–12 years

**Job Description**

We are looking for an Oracle Fusion Technical Manager with extensive experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud technical architecture, integration delivery, reporting solutions, and technical team leadership. The candidate will be responsible for managing technical delivery across OIC, BI Publisher, OTBI, APIs, and related integration technologies, ensuring solution quality, performance, security, operational stability, and successful implementation outcomes.

The role requires a combination of technical expertise, solution architecture, delivery management, stakeholder engagement, team development, and production support governance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership and Architecture**

* Lead technical architecture, solution design, and delivery for Oracle Fusion Cloud integrations, reporting, data migration, and technical enhancements.
* Define integration architecture and standards using OIC, REST/SOAP APIs, Oracle adapters, and other enterprise integration technologies.
* Review technical requirements and recommend scalable, secure, maintainable, and cost-effective solutions.
* Establish development standards, reusable frameworks, naming conventions, logging, error handling, security, and monitoring practices.
* Oversee technical solutions spanning Oracle Fusion Cloud, Oracle EBS, databases, and third-party applications.
* Provide technical direction for BI Publisher, OTBI, SQL/PLSQL, FBDI, BICC, and ESS-based solutions.
* Evaluate new Oracle Fusion capabilities, quarterly updates, integration changes, and opportunities for modernization and automation.

**Delivery and Project Management**

* Manage end-to-end technical delivery across implementation, enhancement, migration, and application support engagements.
* Prepare estimates, resource plans, delivery schedules, milestones, dependencies, and risk mitigation plans.
* Monitor delivery against scope, timelines, quality expectations, SLAs, and agreed project commitments.
* Coordinate with functional leads, architects, business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, security teams, and external vendors.
* Manage technical dependencies, escalations, release planning, environment readiness, and production cutover activities.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, testing evidence, approvals, and deployment controls are maintained.
* Drive root-cause analysis, problem management, technical debt reduction, and continuous service improvement.

**Team and Stakeholder Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop technical consultants and senior consultants across OIC, reporting, APIs, and database technologies.
* Review resource requirements, allocation, skills development, utilization, and delivery capacity.
* Conduct technical interviews, evaluate candidate capabilities, and support recruitment and onboarding.
* Establish knowledge-sharing practices, technical training plans, and certification roadmaps.
* Communicate project status, risks, issues, and delivery progress to client stakeholders and senior management.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, resolve escalations, and ensure timely decisions on technical dependencies.
* Contribute to solution proposals, effort estimation, presales discussions, and account growth opportunities.

**Production Support and Governance**

* Oversee production integration monitoring, incident management, problem management, and service-level compliance.
* Establish operational dashboards, alerting mechanisms, support procedures, and escalation paths.
* Ensure production releases follow appropriate change management, security, testing, and approval processes.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description**
**I&O Platform Infrastructure Hyperconverged Infrastructure (HCI) Engineer**
**Supervising Associate | Enterprise Technology**
**The opportunity**
In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a proven Hyperconverged Infrastructure (HCI) Engineer to support and evolve EY's HCI platforms globally. The role will provide engineering, operational support, automation and lifecycle management for Microsoft Azure Stack HCI environments and associated technologies. The successful candidate will work with cutting-edge infrastructure technologies with a specific focus on virtualization, clustering, storage, security, resiliency and automation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
The I&O Platform Infrastructure Hyperconverged Infrastructure Specialist provides technical support and engineering of complex nature for the firm's Azure Stack HCI platforms and associated infrastructure services. This professional applies knowledge of Windows Server, Failover Clustering, Storage Spaces Direct (S2D), Azure Stack HCI, networking and virtualization technologies to support enterprise-scale workloads.
  
  
The role requires in-depth knowledge of the firm's infrastructure to implement platform enhancements, lifecycle management activities, patching programs, security initiatives and operational improvements. The engineer will assist in maintaining highly available HCI environments across global data center locations while ensuring compliance, resiliency and operational excellence.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Large-scale Windows Server Systems Administration experience.
* Strong experience administering Microsoft Azure Stack HCI platforms.
* Deep knowledge of Windows Failover Clustering technologies.
* Strong Storage Spaces Direct (S2D) design, administration and troubleshooting experience (exclusionary).
* Experience maintaining mission-critical production systems running in a data center environment (exclusionary).
* Experience supporting hyperconverged infrastructure environments.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization technologies.
* Experience performing lifecycle management, upgrades and patching of HCI clusters.
* Experience with Cluster Aware Updating (CAU).
* Good networking knowledge including:

+ VLANs
+ NIC Teaming
+ Switch Embedded Teaming (SET)
+ RDMA
+ SMB Direct
+ Data Center Bridging

* Experience with PowerShell automation and scripting.
* Ability to create technical documentation and operational procedures.
* Knowledge of Azure hybrid management capabilities.
* Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
* Ability to work effectively with clients, management and global engineering teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have experience with**

* Microsoft Azure Stack HCI administration and support — 5–7 years.
* Microsoft Windows Server 2019/2022/2025 administration — 5–7 years.
* Windows Failover Clustering administration and troubleshooting — 5–7 years.
* Storage Spaces Direct (S2D) design, support and operational management — 5–7 years.
* Hyper-V virtualization administration — 5–7 years.
* Cluster deployment, expansion and lifecycle management — 5–7 years.
* Cluster Aware Updating (CAU) implementation and administration.
* Host Guardian Service (HGS) administration.
* Shielded Virtual Machine deployment and management.
* Secured-Core Server technologies.
* PowerShell scripting and automation — 5–7 years.
* Firmware, driver and hardware lifecycle management.
* Server patching and maintenance management.
* Networking for HCI environments including:

+ RDMA
+ SMB Direct
+ QoS
+ SET
+ VLANs
+ Data Center Bridging

* Troubleshooting cluster performance, storage latency and resiliency issues.
* Storage enclosure and disk management.
* Azure Arc and Azure hybrid services integration.
* Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity planning for HCI platforms.
* Security hardening and vulnerability remediation of Windows Server platforms.
* VMware to Azure Stack HCI migration projects (preferred).

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Stack HCI certification (desired).
* Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (desired).
* Microsoft Azure Administrator certification (desired).
* Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect certification (better to have).
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator certification (better to have).
* Experience working with Dell AX nodes, Lenovo ThinkAgile, HPE or similar HCI platforms.
* Experience with Azure Local and future Azure Stack HCI roadmap technologies.

**What We Look For**
An experienced and talented infrastructure engineer to help build, maintain and modernize EY's Hyperconverged Infrastructure platforms. We are looking for an individual with strong Microsoft infrastructure expertise, a passion for automation and security, and the ability to support highly available enterprise platforms while driving continuous operational improvement.
  
  
**What We Offer**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited is a publicly listed health insurance provider committed to giving every individual in India the confidence to access quality healthcare. * Proactive, result-oriented mindset with the ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment in Mumbai.

title: Technical Lead
description:
Job Description: Team Lead – Software Development

Position Overview-

Experience- 8+ years

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on
**Team Lead – Software Development**
to lead a software development team responsible for designing, developing, and delivering high-quality enterprise applications.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in
**Java or .NET development**
, a solid understanding of the
**Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**
, and proven experience in
**Agile software development, team management, application architecture, and delivery of complex projects**
.

This role is intended for a technical leader who has experience
**building applications and projects from the ground up (greenfield development)**
, rather than primarily working on customization, maintenance, or enhancement activities. The candidate should be capable of translating business requirements into technical solutions, contributing to architecture and design decisions, creating architectural diagrams, and guiding the team through the complete development lifecycle.

The successful candidate will combine
**technical leadership, hands-on development expertise, architecture/design skills, project ownership, and people management**
.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Leadership

* Lead a team of software developers and provide technical direction, mentoring, and guidance.
* Own the technical delivery of projects from requirements analysis through design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Participate actively in technical discussions, design reviews, code reviews, and solution planning.
* Establish and enforce coding standards, development best practices, design principles, and quality standards.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues and provide appropriate solutions.
* Guide developers in selecting appropriate technologies, frameworks, tools, and development approaches.
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for the development team and key stakeholders.
* Promote best practices around maintainability, scalability, security, performance, and reliability.

2. Greenfield / Application Development

* Demonstrated experience in
  **developing applications and projects from scratch**
  , including taking ownership of a new application from concept and requirements through production deployment.
* Design and develop scalable, maintainable, and secure enterprise applications.
* Participate in requirements analysis and convert business requirements into technical specifications and implementation plans.
* Define application structure, modules, components, interfaces, data flows, and integration points.
* Develop proof-of-concepts and technical prototypes where required.
* Establish development standards and technical foundations for new applications.
* Ensure applications are designed for scalability, performance, maintainability, and future extensibility.
* Lead the team in implementing complete end-to-end application solutions rather than limiting the role to customization or minor enhancements.

3. Software Architecture & Design

* Participate in and contribute to
  **solution architecture and application architecture**
  .
* Design technical solutions for complex business and technical requirements.
* Create and maintain architectural and technical design documentation.
* Develop and review architectural diagrams, including:
* High-Level Architecture (HLA)
* Low-Level Design (LLD)
* Application/component diagrams
* System context diagrams
* Sequence diagrams
* Data-flow diagrams
* Integration diagrams
* Deployment diagrams
* Evaluate architectural options and recommend appropriate solutions based on scalability, performance, security, maintainability, and cost.
* Define application components, interfaces, APIs, services, integrations, and technology dependencies.
* Work closely with architects, product owners, business stakeholders, DevOps, QA, and infrastructure teams.
* Identify technical risks and define mitigation strategies.
* Ensure architectural decisions are aligned with enterprise standards and business objectives.

4. Java / .NET Development

The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in
**either Java or .NET**
, with a willingness and ability to work with modern enterprise development practices.

Java

Experience may include:

* Core Java
* Spring / Spring Boot
* REST APIs and web services
* Microservices
* JPA / Hibernate
* SQL and relational databases
* Messaging/integration technologies
* Enterprise application development
* Unit and integration testing

**OR**

.NET

Experience may include:

* C#
* .NET / .NET Core / modern .NET
* ASP.NET / ASP.NET Core
* Web APIs
* Entity Framework
* REST APIs and web services
* Microservices
* SQL and relational databases
* Enterprise application development
* Unit and integration testing

The candidate should be comfortable understanding existing systems as well as
**designing and building new applications from the ground up**
.

5. SDLC & Engineering Practices

* Strong understanding and practical experience across the complete
  **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**
  .
* Participate in requirements gathering, estimation, technical design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Define development tasks, technical milestones, dependencies, and delivery plans.
* Ensure development activities follow established SDLC processes and organizational standards.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to coding and design standards.
* Promote automated testing, continuous integration, and continuous delivery practices.
* Identify opportunities to improve development processes, engineering practices, and delivery efficiency.
* Ensure appropriate technical documentation is maintained throughout the project lifecycle.

6. Agile Development

* Work effectively within
  **Agile/Scrum**
  development environments.
* Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Business Analysts, QA, and other stakeholders.
* Break complex requirements into manageable technical tasks and user stories.
* Provide technical estimates and contribute to sprint planning and release planning.
* Identify and manage technical dependencies and risks.
* Ensure the team maintains a sustainable pace while meeting quality and delivery expectations.
* Promote continuous improvement and Agile engineering practices.

7. Team Management & People Leadership

* Lead, mentor, coach, and develop a team of software engineers.
* Allocate work based on team members' skills, experience, and project priorities.
* Monitor individual and team performance and provide constructive feedback.
* Conduct regular technical mentoring and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Identify skill gaps and support team members in developing their technical capabilities.
* Encourage collaboration, ownership, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Support recruitment and technical evaluation of software developers when required.
* Build a high-performing engineering culture focused on quality and delivery.
* Resolve technical and interpersonal issues within the team effectively.
* Serve as a bridge between developers, management, architects, business teams, and other stakeholders.

8. Complex Project Delivery

* Lead development teams working on
  **complex, enterprise-scale, or technically challenging projects**
  .
* Break large and complex problems into manageable technical components.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and delivery challenges.
* Drive solutions for performance, scalability, integration, security, and reliability issues.
* Manage multiple technical priorities while maintaining delivery commitments.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve project dependencies.
* Ensure successful delivery of projects within agreed scope, quality, timelines, and technical standards.
* Take ownership of technical issues through to resolution.

9. Stakeholder Management

* Work closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, Project Managers, Solution Architects, Enterprise Architects, QA, DevOps, infrastructure, and support teams.
* Understand business objectives and translate them into practical technical solutions.
* Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Provide regular updates on technical progress, risks, dependencies, and issues.
* Participate in solution discussions, requirement clarification, technical workshops, and project planning.
* Manage expectations and communicate technical constraints and trade-offs clearly.

10. Quality, Security & Performance

* Ensure software is developed according to established quality standards.
* Promote clean code, SOLID principles, design patterns, reusable components, and maintainable architecture.
* Ensure appropriate unit, integration, system, and regression testing practices.
* Identify and address application performance issues.
* Consider security requirements throughout application design and development.
* Support secure coding practices and vulnerability remediation.
* Ensure applications are scalable and resilient for expected business volumes.
* Conduct technical and design reviews to identify potential quality and architectural issues early.

**Job Overview**
Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5Gs potential into world-changing technologies and products. We are looking for a passionate and skilled software professionals to provide software engineering solutions for development projects in the Security systems team. In this position, you will work with a team of multi-disciplined professionals to develop and optimize systems, tools and methods for QTI security solutions. The position will require you to work on security software development that needs close interactions with internal teams and potentially with external customers as well.
  
  
You will be contributing on various Security related technologies across Mobile platform Security, Cryptography, Trusted Execution environments, Access control mechanisms, vulneraility detection etc. You will work across multiple processors, Embedded software platforms, and operating systems. Your work will contribute towards making mobile platforms safe and secure to use and thus creating a positive impact on end user of the handset.

* Responsible for leading team in timely, high-quality execution on larger, less-defined, moderately complex tasks.

title: Principal Service Engineer
description:
# Job Description – ServiceNow Architect / Senior Developer
  
  
## IRM / BCM / SecOps
  
  

* Experience:\*\* 10–16 Years
* Location:\*\* Hyderabad
* Employment Type:\*\* Full-Time

## Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced \*\*ServiceNow Architect / Senior Developer\*\* with strong expertise in \*\*Integrated Risk Management (IRM), Business Continuity Management (BCM), and Security Operations (SecOps)\*\* to lead the architecture, design, development, and implementation of enterprise-grade ServiceNow solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on platform expertise, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to translate governance, resilience, risk, and cyber-security requirements into scalable ServiceNow workflows, integrations, and user experiences.
  
  
# Key Responsibilities
  
  
## ServiceNow Architecture & Solution Design
  
  

* Lead end-to-end architecture, solution design, and technical delivery for ServiceNow implementations across IRM, BCM, and SecOps.
* Define scalable, secure, and maintainable platform architecture, development standards, governance controls, and integration patterns.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, cyber-security teams, risk/compliance teams, and enterprise architects to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Provide technical leadership for enterprise ServiceNow implementations and enhancements.
* Ensure adherence to ServiceNow best practices, platform governance, performance optimization, and scalability.

## Integrated Risk Management (IRM)
  
  

* Architect and implement ServiceNow IRM / GRC solutions including:
* Risk Management
* Policy & Compliance
* Audit Management
* Regulatory Change Management
* Configure risk registers, controls, entity frameworks, indicators, issue management, and remediation workflows.
* Automate governance, risk, and compliance processes for improved audit readiness and enterprise visibility.
* Support integration of IRM processes with CMDB, business applications, and operational data.

## Business Continuity Management (BCM)
  
  

* Design and implement BCM capabilities including:
* Business Impact Analysis (BIA)
* Continuity Planning
* Recovery Management
* Crisis Response Workflows
* Configure continuity plans, process dependencies, recovery objectives, and resilience workflows.
* Support continuity testing, simulation exercises, and recovery readiness initiatives.
* Enable operational resilience through integrated ServiceNow workflows and automation.

## Security Operations (SecOps)
  
  

* Lead implementations across ServiceNow SecOps modules including:
* Security Incident Response (SIR)
* Vulnerability Response
* Threat Intelligence integrations
* Design workflows for incident triage, threat prioritization, vulnerability remediation, and coordinated response.
* Integrate ServiceNow with security tools such as SIEM, vulnerability scanners, EDR, and threat intelligence platforms.
* Enable visibility into security posture, risk exposure, and operational KPIs through dashboards and reporting.

## Development & Integrations
  
  

* Develop and customize ServiceNow applications using:
* JavaScript
* Glide API
* Script Includes
* Business Rules
* Client Scripts
* Flow Designer
* IntegrationHub
* Build and maintain REST/SOAP integrations with enterprise applications and security platforms.
* Design reusable workflows, automation components, and scalable integrations.
* Support platform upgrades, release activities, and performance improvements.

## Leadership & Governance
  
  

* Mentor developers and administrators across implementation and support activities.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical assessments.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise standards and ServiceNow development best practices.
* Collaborate with QA, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams during deployments and production releases.

# Required Skills & Experience
  
  

* 10–16 years of overall IT experience with strong ServiceNow implementation and architecture expertise.
* Proven hands-on experience in:
* IRM / GRC
* BCM
* SecOps
* Strong knowledge of:
* JavaScript
* Glide API
* Flow Designer
* ServiceNow scripting
* REST/SOAP integrations
* Experience implementing:
* Security Incident Response
* Vulnerability Response
* Risk & Compliance workflows
* Business Continuity processes
* Good understanding of:
* CMDB
* Enterprise integrations
* Security operations
* Governance and compliance frameworks
* Strong leadership, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

# Preferred Skills
  
  

* Experience integrating ServiceNow with:
* SIEM tools
* Vulnerability scanners
* Cloud security platforms
* Identity and access management solutions
* Exposure to Operational Resilience frameworks.
* Experience working in enterprise-scale digital transformation programs.
* Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and ITIL practices.

# Preferred Certifications
  
  

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
* Certified Application Developer (CAD)
* CIS – Risk & Compliance (CIS-RC)
* Additional ServiceNow implementation or architect certifications preferred

title: Junior Mobile Performance Tester
description:
**Job Description**
**Junior Native Mobile Performance Testing Engineer**
**Primary Technologies:**
Apache JMeter | BlazeMeter | BrowserStack
  
  
**Experience Required:**
2–4 Years
  
  
**Primary Specialization:**
Native Android and iOS Application Performance Testing
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a motivated, hands-on
**Junior Native Mobile Performance Testing Engineer**
with experience in Apache JMeter, BlazeMeter, and BrowserStack to support performance testing of enterprise-native Android and iOS applications.
  
  
**This position focuses specifically on native mobile applications installed and executed on Android and iOS devices—not mobile websites, mobile browsers, or responsive web applications.**
The ideal candidate will have practical experience developing and executing performance test scripts, working with REST APIs, supporting cloud-based load tests, and automating native mobile application scenarios on real devices.
  
  
The engineer will work alongside senior performance engineers, mobile developers, and infrastructure teams to execute performance tests, collect and analyze results, identify performance issues, and contribute to improving native mobile application responsiveness, stability, and scalability.
  
  
This is a
**hands-on technical position**
requiring foundational performance testing knowledge, strong scripting and troubleshooting capabilities, and a willingness to develop advanced mobile performance engineering skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Native Android and iOS Application Performance Testing**

* Assist in developing and executing performance tests for native Android and iOS applications.
* Perform performance validation of installed native mobile applications using Android APK and iOS IPA packages.
* Execute test scenarios covering application launch, screen navigation, user interactions, and critical business transactions.
* Measure and document application response times, transaction completion times, and overall responsiveness.
* Support testing across different Android and iOS devices, operating system versions, and network conditions.
* Collect application logs, execution results, and available device performance metrics.
* Assist in identifying performance issues related to mobile applications, network connectivity, APIs, and backend services.
* Execute test scenarios and analyze results under normal and elevated backend load conditions.

**JMeter and BlazeMeter Performance Testing**

* Develop, maintain, and execute JMeter scripts for REST API and HTTP(S) performance testing.
* Implement basic to intermediate parameterization, correlation, assertions, JSON extraction, and test-data management.
* Configure and execute load tests using BlazeMeter under guidance from senior engineers.
* Support load, stress, spike, and endurance testing activities.
* Execute predefined workload models involving concurrent users, transaction pacing, and ramp-up/ramp-down configurations.
* Monitor and analyze response times, throughput, transactions per second, error rates, and response-time percentiles.
* Troubleshoot script execution errors, authentication failures, and test-data issues.
* Maintain reusable performance testing scripts and documentation.

**BrowserStack Native Mobile Application Testing**

* Execute native Android and iOS application tests using BrowserStack real-device infrastructure.
* Develop, maintain, and execute mobile automation scripts using Appium or equivalent automation frameworks.
* Automate native application interactions, including login, screen navigation, user actions, and business workflows.
* Configure and execute test scenarios across different physical Android and iOS devices.
* Support parallel execution of BrowserStack native application automation and JMeter/BlazeMeter backend load tests.
* Capture native application execution timings, logs, and available device diagnostics.
* Assist senior engineers in correlating real-device application responsiveness with backend API performance.

**Important:**
Candidates must have experience with or demonstrate practical knowledge of native mobile application testing. Experience limited to testing websites through mobile browsers is not sufficient.
  
  
**Performance Monitoring, Analysis, and Reporting**

* Monitor application and infrastructure performance using tools such as Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, Splunk, or comparable platforms.
* Collect and analyze performance test execution results, logs, and monitoring data.
* Identify performance trends, elevated response times, transaction failures, and resource utilization issues.
* Assist senior engineers with performance bottleneck investigation and root cause analysis.
* Document performance defects with supporting evidence and reproducible test conditions.
* Prepare test execution summaries, performance metrics, charts, and status reports.
* Work with development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to validate fixes and execute performance regression tests.
* Participate in Agile sprint activities and support in-sprint performance testing.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Apache JMeter: Hands-on experience creating and executing HTTP(S)/REST API performance test scripts.
* BlazeMeter: Working knowledge of cloud-based load execution, performance test configuration, monitoring, and reporting.
* BrowserStack: Practical experience with or strong working knowledge of native Android/iOS application testing on real devices.
* Mobile Automation: Working experience with Appium or a similar mobile application automation framework.
* Native Mobile Applications: Understanding of installed Android APK and iOS IPA applications, application navigation, API communication, and mobile application behavior.
* API Testing: Experience with REST APIs, HTTP methods, request/response validation, JSON, and authentication.
* Scripting: Knowledge of Java, JavaScript, Python, or another relevant scripting language.
* Performance Metrics: Understanding response time, throughput, concurrency, transaction rates, error rates, and resource utilization.
* Monitoring: Basic experience with an APM or observability solution.
* Defect Management: Experience documenting, tracking, and retesting performance issues.

**Required Experience And Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of experience in software performance testing, QA automation, or a related engineering role, with practical exposure to performance testing.
* Hands-on experience developing and executing JMeter performance scripts.
* Working knowledge or project experience with BlazeMeter.
* Exposure to BrowserStack real-device testing of native Android or iOS applications.
* Experience developing or executing Appium-based native mobile automation scripts.
* Basic understanding of native mobile application architecture and backend API interactions.
* Familiarity with performance test execution, metric collection, result analysis, and reporting.
* Experience working in Agile software development environments.
* Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently on assigned testing activities while collaborating with senior engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience testing both native Android and iOS applications.
* Experience executing mobile automation in parallel with backend load tests.
* Familiarity with Android Studio Profiler, Apple Instruments, or other native mobile diagnostic utilities.
* Knowledge of mobile application CPU, memory, startup-time, rendering, and battery performance metrics.
* Experience with mobile network conditions such as Wi-Fi, 4G, and 5G.
* Familiarity with AWS or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or other CI/CD tools.
* Experience with application monitoring platforms such as Dynatrace or Datadog.
* Knowledge of Android App Bundles (AAB) and mobile application distribution.
* Traditional web application performance testing.
* Exposure to Tricentis NeoLoad or other commercial performance testing tools.

**Web performance testing is a secondary, nice-to-have skill and does not replace native mobile application testing experience.**
**Expected Outcomes**
**The Successful Candidate Will Be Expected To**

* Develop and maintain reliable JMeter performance test scripts.
* Successfully execute BlazeMeter load tests and document the results.
* Execute automated native Android/iOS application scenarios on BrowserStack.
* Support concurrent backend load testing and real-device mobile performance validation.
* Collect relevant performance metrics, logs, and application diagnostics.
* Identify and document performance issues for investigation by senior engineers and development teams.
* Produce accurate test execution reports and performance summaries.
* Contribute to reusable performance testing assets and continuous testing improvements.
* Demonstrate increasing independence in native mobile performance testing activities.

**Technical Screening Questions**

* Native Mobile Application Testing

What is the difference between testing a native Android/iOS application and testing a website in a mobile browser? Describe your experience testing installed APK or IPA applications.
  
  

* JMeter Performance Scripting

Explain how you would create a JMeter script to test a REST API used by a native mobile application. How would you handle authentication, parameterization, and dynamic response values?
  
  

* BlazeMeter Test Execution

Describe your experience executing performance tests using BlazeMeter. How do you configure a test, monitor its execution, and interpret response times, throughput, and error rates?
  
  

* BrowserStack and Appium

How would you use BrowserStack and Appium to execute a native Android or iOS application test? What types of application interactions and execution metrics would you capture?
  
  

* Performance Testing and Analysis

If a native mobile application becomes slow while a JMeter load test is running against its backend APIs, what information would you collect to help determine the cause of the performance degradation?
  
  
**Senior vs. Junior — Responsibility comparison**
This matrix can help recruiters distinguish between the two positions.
  
  
**Competency**
**Junior Engineer (2–4 years)**
**Senior Engineer (5–10 years)**
JMeter
  
  
Develop and maintain scripts
  
  
Architect complex scripts and frameworks
  
  
BlazeMeter
  
  
Configure and execute tests
  
  
Design distributed workload strategies
  
  
BrowserStack
  
  
Execute and maintain native app tests
  
  
Architect real-device testing solutions
  
  
Appium
  
  
Develop and execute automation
  
  
Design and troubleshoot automation frameworks
  
  
Workload modeling
  
  
Execute predefined models
  
  
Design production-representative workloads
  
  
Mobile diagnostics
  
  
Collect and interpret metrics
  
  
Perform advanced diagnostics and profiling
  
  
APM
  
  
Monitor and identify anomalies
  
  
Perform root cause analysis
  
  
Test strategy
  
  
Follow established strategies
  
  
Define strategy and acceptance criteria
  
  
Reporting
  
  
Prepare execution summaries
  
  
Deliver detailed recommendations
  
  
Leadership
  
  
Collaborate and learn
  
  
Mentor engineers and lead implementation
  
  
**Recommended screening priorities — Junior role**
Recommendation: For this junior position, emphasize demonstrated JMeter scripting capability and actual native mobile application testing experience. Candidates should have practical exposure to BlazeMeter, BrowserStack, and Appium, but they should not be expected to independently architect an enterprise performance framework.
  
  
The key hiring distinction is that the Senior Engineer designs and leads the native mobile performance testing solution, while the Junior Engineer develops scripts, executes tests, analyzes initial results, and maintains automation within that solution.

* Exhibit initiative and participate in corporate social and team events.

* 4 to 8 years of demonstrated experience with Risk Management across the Third-Party engagement lifecycle (pre-contracting, contracting, and post contracting) and an understanding of the associated organizational infrastructure (e.g., relevant internal controls, business processes, governance structures).
* Strong understanding of the TPRM framework, Risk Management, Information Security practices.

* Good knowledge of privacy regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, etc.
* Good knowledge of regulations such as FISMA, HIPAA, Reg SCI, MAS, etc.
* Good knowledge of TCP/IP, concepts of OSI layer and protocols, networking and security concepts, Physical & Environmental Security, Asset Security and Identity & Access Management.
* Good knowledge of OS (Windows / Linux) security, Database security, IT infrastructure (switches, routers, firewalls, IDS, IPS, etc.), Security architecture design, and review.
* Good familiarity with OWASP, and Secure SDLC standards/frameworks, anti-virus solutions (e.g., Symantec, McAfee, etc.).
* Good experience in LAN/WAN architectures and reviews.
* Good knowledge of incident management, disaster recovery, and business continuity management, cryptography.
* Good to have prior Big-4 experience.
* Good to have certifications - CISSP, CISA, CISM, CTPRP, CIPP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project Management skills.
* Exposure to tools like ProcessUnity, ServiceNow, Archer.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with enthusiasm to develop new skills and knowledge and experience to succeed and inquisitiveness to learn new things in this fast-moving environment.
* Actively tracks and communicates engagement performance and planning to EY engagement management, ensuring project milestones remain on track and are completed timely.
* Actively mentors and trains team members on Third-Party Risk Management processes, governance, and frameworks.
* Works cross-functionally with team members to support and drive a collaborative team environment.
* Creates and design effective presentations as a means for communicating project and deliverable progress to clients.
* Performs sophisticated data analyses to understand client s business and identify risk
* Executes advanced services and supervise staff in delivering essential services.
* Understands client s business environment and basic risk management approaches
* Actively participates in decision making with engagement management and seek to understand the broader impact of current decisions.
* Actively contributes to improving operational efficiency on projects & internal initiatives.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from the startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is on education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your progress with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Vulnerability Management Professional
description:
**About Marvell**
Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.
  
  
At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.
  
  
**Your Team, Your Impact**
At Marvell, we are looking for a Vulnerability Management Professional who will be instrumental in protecting the company’s digital assets. The individual shall come with proven strong technical competence and leadership capability to contribute towards the success of the enterprise-wide vulnerability management program. A Vulnerability Management Professional will be responsible for identification, assessment, prioritization, and drive mitigation of security weaknesses across an organization’s IT infrastructure, including cloud and on-premises systems. Key responsibilities include running vulnerability scans (e.g., Qualys, Tenable), analyzing risks, collaborating with IT teams to remediate threats, and automating security workflows
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* Scanning & Detection: Conduct regular, scheduled, and on-demand vulnerability scans of servers, networks, applications, and cloud environments.
* Manage the regular scanning of Marvell’s infrastructure and applications to detect vulnerabilities.
* Tool Management: Configure, maintain, and tune security tools (e.g., Qualys, Rapid7, Defender VM).
* Analysis & Risk Assessment: Analyze scan results to distinguish actual threats from false positives and prioritize vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, and business impact.
* Perform vulnerability risk profiling and prioritization of vulnerabilities.
* Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing to identify weaknesses and potential threats to Marvell's systems and networks.
* Remediation Coordination: Work closely with system owners, IT teams, and engineers to ensure timely patching, configuration changes, or mitigation of vulnerabilities.
* Automation & Improvement: Implement automation for security workflows, data aggregation, and scanning to increase efficiency.
* Threat Intelligence: Research emerging threats and vulnerabilities to proactively update security controls.
* Stay up-to-date on emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and industry best practices to continuously improve Marvell's security posture.
* Metrics & Reporting: Prepare detailed reports on vulnerability trends, remediation metrics, and compliance status for management and compliance teams.
* Leverage technology stack to report and manage the requirements of various metrics requested by different stakeholders.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
* 6+ years of experience in vulnerability management.
* In-depth knowledge of common security vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and mitigation techniques.
* Experience with vulnerability scanning tools such as Qualys, Nessus, or similar.
* Strong understanding of network protocols, operating systems, and software development processes.
* Industry certifications such as OSCP, CISSP, GIAC GWAPT, are highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen attention to detail.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.
  
  
**Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements**
With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.
  
  
**Interview Integrity**
To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.
  
  
These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.
  
  
**This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.**

title: Staff Systems Administrator (5996)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn , X , Instagram , and YouTube .
  
  
Shield AI is seeking a highly autonomous Staff Systems Administrator to serve as the accountable technical owner for enterprise IT infrastructure and end-user computing within a dedicated, security-sensitive entity environment. This senior individual contributor will design, implement, operate, secure, and continuously improve on-premises systems, cloud platforms, identity services, networks, and endpoints while preserving required legal, operational, information-security, and access boundaries.
  
  
The role combines deep infrastructure ownership with hands-on service delivery. The successful candidate will translate security and compliance requirements into durable technical controls, maintain audit-ready evidence, drive equipment and endpoint hardening, and deliver resilient support to engineering and business teams with minimal oversight.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**
Infrastructure Ownership (On-Prem & Cloud)
  
  

* Own and operate on-premises and cloud infrastructure, including physical and virtual servers, storage, backup platforms, identity services, core network services, and enterprise applications.
* Administer Azure and/or AWS environments with responsibility for availability, capacity, performance, monitoring, secure configuration, backup, and disaster-recovery readiness.
* Define technical roadmaps, identify operational risks, and independently drive modernization, standardization, scalability, and resilience improvements.
* Maintain accurate architecture diagrams, inventories, operating procedures, recovery documentation, configuration records, and service ownership information.
* Plan and execute infrastructure changes using disciplined change, testing, rollback, and post-implementation review practices.

Firewalled Entity and Segmented-Environment Support
  
  

* Operate technology services for a dedicated legal or operating entity with explicit separation of systems, identities, data, administration, suppliers, and access from other corporate environments where required.
* Implement and maintain approved trust boundaries, network segmentation, firewall policies, secure remote access, administrative tiers, and controlled cross-entity connectivity.
* Ensure data, devices, accounts, cloud resources, and third-party access remain within authorized entity, contractual, regulatory, and data-residency boundaries.
* Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and corporate IT teams to translate entity-specific obligations into practical controls, operating procedures, and evidence.
* Document and periodically validate boundary controls, data flows, privileged access paths, exceptions, and intercompany dependencies; escalate gaps and drive remediation to closure.
* Support local business continuity and operational autonomy while aligning with approved global architecture, security standards, and governance.

Security, Compliance, and Systems
  
  

* Establish, implement, and maintain secure configuration baselines for Windows, macOS, Linux, servers, network devices, cloud services, and endpoint-management platforms using recognized frameworks and vendor guidance.
* Own patching and vulnerability-remediation workflows, including asset coverage, risk-based prioritization, remediation timelines, exception documentation, validation, and status reporting.
* Administer and validate endpoint protections such as full-disk encryption, EDR/XDR, host firewall, secure boot, application controls, device compliance, removable-media controls, and least-privilege configurations.
* Harden identity and administrative access through role-based access control, multifactor authentication, privileged-access separation, conditional access, service-account governance, and periodic access reviews.
* Maintain logging, alerting, time synchronization, configuration monitoring, backup protection, and security telemetry needed for detection, investigation, and auditability.
* Collect and maintain audit-ready evidence; support internal and external audits, control assessments, security reviews, customer requirements, and remediation plans.
* Participate in incident response, containment, recovery, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions for infrastructure and endpoint security events.
* Manage technical risks and policy exceptions transparently, including compensating controls, accountable owners, expiration dates, and closure plans.

Identity, Endpoint, and Service Delivery
  
  

* Manage Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints through Intune, Jamf, or equivalent tooling, ensuring secure provisioning, configuration compliance, software deployment, inventory accuracy, and timely retirement.
* Administer Active Directory and Entra ID or equivalent identity platforms, including user and group lifecycle, authentication, authorization, federation, and policy enforcement.
* Lead onboarding and offboarding activities, including device provisioning, access configuration, license assignment, asset recovery, and compliance validation.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and escalation support for employees, engineering systems, lab environments, collaboration services, and secure connectivity.
* Own IT asset lifecycle, software licensing, vendor coordination, procurement support, warranty management, and secure equipment disposal.
* Use scripting and automation to improve consistency, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and provide meaningful operational and compliance reporting.
* Contribute reusable infrastructure patterns, standards, and documentation that can scale across comparable international entity environments.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering, enterprise IT operations, or a closely related discipline.
* Demonstrated success independently owning production IT infrastructure and end-user environments in a complex, regulated, segmented, or security-sensitive organization.
* Strong hands-on expertise with Windows, macOS, and Linux; server administration and virtualization; Azure and/or AWS; and Active Directory and Entra ID or equivalent identity platforms.
* Practical experience implementing system and endpoint hardening, configuration baselines, patch management, vulnerability remediation, encryption, endpoint detection and response, and least-privilege controls.
* Experience supporting security or compliance programs and producing evidence for audits, assessments, or customer and regulatory requirements.
* Strong networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, VPNs, network segmentation, firewall policy, and secure remote access.
* Experience with endpoint management platforms such as Intune, Jamf, or equivalent, including compliance policy and device lifecycle management.
* Experience implementing and testing monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and business-continuity capabilities.
* Excellent documentation, prioritization, risk communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to drive outcomes under limited supervision.
* Ability to support time-sensitive operational needs and participate in planned after-hours maintenance or incident response when required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting a firewalled, ring-fenced, subsidiary, joint-venture, sovereign, or otherwise separately governed entity environment.
* Experience supporting engineering, R&D, aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or other mission-critical technical teams.
* Working knowledge of recognized security and compliance frameworks such as CIS Controls and Benchmarks, NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials, or equivalent local and contractual standards.
* Experience with security tooling such as SIEM, vulnerability-management platforms, privileged-access management, data-loss prevention, certificate management, or network-access control.
* Experience supporting isolated, air-gapped, export-controlled, or data-residency-restricted systems.
* Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python, APIs, infrastructure as code, or configuration-management tooling.
* Familiarity with GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD environments, and secure engineering workflows.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, AWS, VMware, Cisco, CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CISM, GIAC, ITIL, or equivalent.

description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens™ Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced Senior Privileged Access Management (PAM) Engineer to design, implement, and support enterprise-grade privileged access management solutions that secure administrative accounts and enforce robust access controls. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in protecting privileged credentials, reducing insider threats, ensuring regulatory compliance, and strengthening the organization's overall security posture. You will collaborate with infrastructure, security, IAM, and application teams to deliver secure privileged access across on-premises and cloud environments.

  

* **Role: Senior PAM Engineer**
* **Location: Bengaluru**
* **Experience: 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Design, deploy, configure, and support enterprise PAM solutions across the organization.
* Implement PAM platform components, connectors, integrations, and security policies.
* Onboard privileged, shared, service, application, and administrative accounts into the PAM platform.
* Configure password vaulting, password rotation, credential checkout, and automated account management processes.
* Implement privileged session management, session recording, monitoring, and audit controls.
* Establish least-privilege access models and secure privilege elevation workflows.
* Integrate PAM solutions with Active Directory, cloud platforms, operating systems, databases, network devices, and enterprise applications.
* Investigate and resolve PAM platform issues, access-related incidents, and onboarding challenges.
* Automate repetitive PAM administration, account onboarding, and operational activities using scripting and automation tools.
* Partner with Cyber Security, IAM, Infrastructure, and Compliance teams to strengthen privileged access controls.
* Support internal and external audits by providing evidence, reports, and technical documentation.
* Develop operational runbooks, architecture documents, and standard operating procedures for PAM environments.
* Monitor platform health, capacity, and performance while recommending continuous improvements.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8-12 years of experience in Privileged Access Management, Identity & Access Management, or Cybersecurity Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with enterprise PAM platforms such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea (Thycotic), One Identity Safeguard, or similar solutions.
* Deep understanding of privileged account lifecycle management, credential security, and access governance principles.
* Experience implementing password vaulting, session monitoring, privileged session recording, and just-in-time access controls.
* Strong knowledge of Active Directory, LDAP, Windows Server, Linux/Unix environments, databases, and cloud platforms.
* Experience integrating PAM solutions with enterprise applications, infrastructure systems, and security tools.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and compliance standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls, SOX, PCI-DSS, and GDPR.
* Experience automating onboarding, provisioning, and administration activities using PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, or similar technologies.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills related to privileged access and authentication issues.
* Understanding of Zero Trust Security principles and privileged access risk management.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional security, infrastructure, and application teams.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and documentation skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Relevant certifications such as CyberArk Defender/Guardian, BeyondTrust Certification, CISSP, CISM, Security+, or Microsoft Security certifications are highly desirable.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

**You Are**
You have spent years keeping Linux infrastructure running under real pressure, the kind where a compute farm going down at 2 a.m. means a tape-out slips and someone loses sleep. You know the difference between a system that looks healthy in a dashboard and one that actually stays up when 10,000 simulation jobs hit it at once. You have debugged enough weird failures to know that the answer is rarely in the first log you check, and you are comfortable digging until you find it.
  
  
Working across cloud and on-prem does not rattle you. You have built things in Azure or AWS using Terraform and Ansible, not because it was trendy but because manual provisioning does not scale. You script in Bash and Python not to show off but to stop doing the same thing twice. When a designer in Singapore cannot access a license server, you do not guess, you pull tcpdump, check journalctl, trace the route, and fix it.
  
  
You care about uptime because you know the teams depending on your infrastructure are racing deadlines that matter. At Synopsys, you will support compute environments that power chip design work across the company, and what you keep running directly affects whether engineers can do their jobs.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
Administer and maintain CentOS/ALMA Linux systems across Azure, AWS, and GCP cloud environments that support large-scale EDA compute farms and design workflows
  
  
Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure at scale using Terraform and Ansible, handling compute, storage, and networking for simulation, synthesis, and verification workloads
  
  
Monitor system health, capacity, and performance using Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic Search, or Splunk, catching issues before they affect design teams
  
  
Troubleshoot complex system, network, and application-level problems using tcpdump, netstat, journalctl, and other diagnostic tools to minimize downtime during critical tape-out windows
  
  
Manage license servers (FlexLM/FlexNet) and batch scheduling systems like LSF, SGE, Slurm, or Altair PBS that queue simulation and regression jobs
  
  
Coordinate tool version upgrades, freeware installs, and compatibility validation with CAD and EDA application support teams
  
  
Participate in rotational shift work (monthly rotation) and on-call weekend coverage, providing front-line support to internal design and verification teams
  
  
**The Impact You Will Have**
Keep compute infrastructure running so IC design, verification, and physical design teams can meet tape-out deadlines without infrastructure delays
  
  
Reduce incident response time and system downtime through proactive monitoring, automation, and structured root-cause analysis
  
  
Scale cloud infrastructure efficiently using Infrastructure as Code, enabling faster provisioning and more reliable deployments across global teams
  
  
Improve system reliability and performance tuning so simulation and synthesis jobs run faster and more predictably
  
  
Build runbooks and documentation that help junior admins resolve issues independently and reduce repeat escalations
  
  
Strengthen cross-team collaboration by translating complex infrastructure problems into clear updates for CAD, DevOps, security, and design engineering teams
  
  
Support the adoption of AI-powered tools and workflows by maintaining the underlying compute and cloud infrastructure they depend on
  
  
**What You'll Need**
5+ years of hands-on Linux systems administration experience, ideally supporting compute-intensive or EDA environments
  
  
Strong proficiency with CentOS, ALMA, or similar Linux distributions in production cloud environments
  
  
Hands-on experience with Azure (preferred), and working knowledge of AWS or GCP
  
  
Proven experience using Terraform and Ansible to deploy and manage large-scale compute and storage infrastructure
  
  
Strong scripting skills in Bash and Python for automation, troubleshooting, and workflow optimization
  
  
Experience managing batch scheduling systems such as LSF, SGE/Univa Grid Engine, Slurm, or Altair PBS
  
  
Familiarity with license management tools like FlexLM or FlexNet, and monitoring/logging platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic Search, or Splunk is a plus
  
  
**Who You Are**
You can troubleshoot a network connectivity issue using tcpdump, netstat, traceroute, and dig without needing a runbook in front of you
  
  
You write scripts to automate repeated tasks because doing the same manual work twice feels like a waste of time
  
  
You treat internal design teams like customers, their productivity depends on your systems staying up, and you take that seriously
  
  
You can translate a complex infrastructure failure into a two-sentence update for a VP without losing the technical nuance that matters
  
  
You stay calm during on-call incidents and work methodically through root-cause analysis instead of guessing and hoping
  
  
You are comfortable coordinating across network, security, CAD, and DevOps teams to get a problem solved, even when it crosses multiple domains
  
  
**The Team You'll Be Part Of**
You will be part of a dynamic and collaborative Cloud Operations team that keeps our cloud environment running smoothly, securely, and reliably. Operating 24×5, we play a critical role in ensuring service availability, proactively monitoring infrastructure, and responding swiftly to incidents. We believe in teamwork, ownership, continuous learning, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Every team member contributes to operational excellence by embracing automation, driving improvements, and sharing knowledge. Together, we don’t just keep the cloud running—we continuously evolve, innovate, and deliver reliable services that make a real difference to the business.
  
  
**Rewards And Benefits**
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: QA Automation - Manager
description:
Role purpose
  
  
You'll design, build and maintain automated end-to-end tests for a multi-year programme modernizing a large portfolio of middle-office applications and moving them to AWS. This is a
**hands-on engineering role**
: most of your time is spent writing test code with modern automation frameworks and running it in CI/CD pipelines. You'll help prove that modernized and migrated applications behave the same as, or better than, the legacy systems they replace. You'll use AI coding tools to speed up writing and maintaining tests.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
**End-to-end UI test automation**

* Design and build a scalable UI automation framework using Playwright, Cypress, Selenium WebDriver or WebdriverIO, with the Page Object Model or Screenplay pattern, fixtures and reusable helpers.
* Write automated end-to-end tests for ReactJS applications that cover critical user journeys in trade processing, reconciliation, settlement and operations.
* Test real-time features delivered over WebSockets and Server-Sent Events, such as live updates, reconnection and message ordering.
* Make tests reliable and fast: stable locators, smart waits, parallel execution (e.g. Selenium Grid or cloud grids like BrowserStack/Sauce Labs) and fixing flaky tests.
* Cover cross-browser, accessibility (axe-core) and visual regression testing (Applitools, Percy or Playwright snapshots) where it adds value.

**Behaviour-driven and component testing**

* Write BDD scenarios with Cucumber (Java or JS) or SpecFlow-style tools, so business analysts and subject-matter experts can read and confirm test coverage.
* Support component-level testing with React Testing Library, Vitest/Jest or Cypress Component Testing, working with developers.

**API, contract and integration testing**

* Automate REST API tests using REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman or Playwright API testing.
* Write consumer-driven contract tests with Pact, and validate against OpenAPI specifications.
* Test event-driven integrations (Kafka/MQ) by publishing test messages and checking downstream results, using tools such as Testcontainers.
* Use mock servers and service virtualisation (WireMock, MockServer) to test components independently.

**Migration and data validation**

* Build automated comparison tests that check outputs from legacy and modernized systems match during parallel runs (reports, files, database results).
* Validate batch and end-of-day processing results, and support reconciliation with data engineers.
* Manage test data, including masking and creating realistic financial test data sets.

**Performance testing**

* Build and run load and performance tests with k6, JMeter or Gatling to confirm modernized services meet or beat current response times and batch windows.

**CI/CD and reporting**

* Run test suites in Harness, GitHub Actions or Jenkins pipelines as quality gates on every build and deployment.
* Run tests in containers and on cloud test infrastructure for speed and scale.
* Publish clear test reports, traces and dashboards (Allure, ExtentReports or framework-native reports) for engineers and release managers.

**AI-assisted testing**

* Use GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and/or Devin to generate test cases, page objects and test data, and to analyse failures.
* Use AI to draft test scenarios from requirements and from legacy application behaviour, then review them with business analysts.
* Review all AI-generated tests carefully for real coverage and meaningful checks, not just passing tests.

**Collaboration**

* Work with developers, business analysts and subject-matter experts to agree acceptance criteria and test coverage.
* Take part in code reviews and promote testable design and shift-left practices.
* Support cutover rehearsals, release testing and early-life support.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* 5+ years in test automation or software engineering in test.
* UI automation: strong hands-on experience with at least one of Playwright, Cypress, Selenium WebDriver or WebdriverIO, and working knowledge of at least one other.
* Programming: strong coding skills in TypeScript/JavaScript and/or Java; tests are treated as production code.
* API testing: experience automating REST API tests with REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman or similar.
* BDD: experience writing and maintaining Cucumber (or similar) scenarios.
* Web testing: solid understanding of modern ReactJS applications, the DOM, browser dev tools and network inspection.
* CI/CD: running automated tests in pipelines (Harness, GitHub Actions or Jenkins).
* SQL: ability to write queries to set up and check test data.
* Git, Docker and agile delivery.
* Regular use of AI coding assistants in professional work.

**Preferred**

* Experience with several UI frameworks and migrating test suites between them (e.g. Selenium to Playwright).
* Contract testing with Pact and service virtualisation with WireMock.
* Performance testing with k6, JMeter or Gatling.
* Experience testing WebSocket, SSE, Kafka/MQ or batch processing.
* Testing migration or modernization programmes, including parallel runs and data reconciliation.
* Experience in financial services, ideally trading, settlement, collateral or accounting.
* ISTQB Advanced Test Automation Engineer or equivalent certification.

Success measures (first 12 months)
  
  

* A standard automation framework and patterns adopted across all modernization teams, with critical user journeys automated.
* UI, API and contract test suites running as quality gates in CI/CD for every application in scope.
* Low flaky-test rate and fast feedback times, measured against an agreed target.
* Automated parallel-run comparisons supporting cutover sign-off.
* Fewer defects escaping to UAT and production, compared with a baseline.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most.
