title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer -Distributed System Development
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Team**
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure’s Compute Bare Metal Provisioning team builds services and tools that automate the server lifecycle, from platform creation and hardware bring-up to customer-ready instance provisioning and firmware management.
  
  
The team works across distributed systems, Linux, and hardware integration. Its services provision, configure, secure, and validate compute and GPU platforms across OCI’s fleet, interfacing with components such as BMCs, NICs, SmartNICs, ILOMs, GPUs, and custom firmware. Team members partner with Compute, Networking, Security, Data Center Engineering, and Hardware Development to launch and operate platforms reliably at scale.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer, you will design, develop, operate, and debug software and services that power OCI’s bare metal and GPU infrastructure. You’ll build scalable distributed services and tooling, work across the stack from orchestration to Linux systems, and help bring new server platforms into production with high reliability and low operational overhead.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop major software components for OCI’s compute infrastructure.
* Build and operate scalable services that automate server provisioning, configuration, security, and validation.
* Develop tooling for hardware bring-up, platform lifecycle management, and firmware orchestration.
* Troubleshoot issues across distributed services, Linux systems, and hardware integrations.
* Collaborate with partner teams to launch and maintain platforms across AMD, Intel, Arm, and NVIDIA systems.
* Improve service reliability, scalability, performance, and operational efficiency.
* Take ownership of engineering problems, identify improvements, and deliver solutions in an agile environment.

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop major software components for OCI’s compute infrastructure.
* Build and operate scalable services that automate server provisioning, configuration, security, and validation.
* Develop tooling for hardware bring-up, platform lifecycle management, and firmware orchestration.
* Troubleshoot issues across distributed services, Linux systems, and hardware integrations.
* Collaborate with partner teams to launch and maintain platforms across AMD, Intel, Arm, and NVIDIA systems.
* Improve service reliability, scalability, performance, and operational efficiency.
* Take ownership of engineering problems, identify improvements, and deliver solutions in an agile environment.

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* 3–8+ years of software development experience, including building or operating large-scale, highly available distributed systems.
* Strong coding skills in Java or C++, plus experience with Python or another scripting language.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Experience or exposure to Linux, operating systems concepts, and systems troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with TCP/IP, HTTP, and standard network architectures.
* Understanding of databases, NoSQL systems, storage, or distributed persistence.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn new technologies and collaborate across teams.
* Comfort using AI agents and prompt engineering to support software development, code analysis, and debugging.

**Good to Have**

* Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code experience.
* Experience with Docker, SQL, or Java web services.
* Systems engineering experience, including performance tuning.
* Firmware or hardware experience, especially with servers, GPUs, BMCs, NICs, SmartNICs, or ILOMs.
* Experience building multi-tenant or virtualized infrastructure.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Have I built or operated distributed services that needed to remain available and reliable at scale?
* Can I contribute hands-on code in Java or C++, and use Python or scripting to automate engineering tasks?
* Have I worked with Linux systems and debugged issues across software, operating systems, or infrastructure?
* Can I explain how networking, storage, and persistence affect the behavior of distributed services?
* Am I comfortable learning unfamiliar systems and working across software and hardware boundaries?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

title: Junior Civil 3D Modeller (Freshers)
description:
ON-SITE IN HYDERABAD ONLY. PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING.

This is a full-time, paid junior role for fresh civil engineering graduates and diploma holders, at our office in Hyderabad, India. Remote work, hybrid work, or working from any other city is not possible. If you live outside Hyderabad, apply only if you will relocate to Hyderabad before joining.

Start your career in infrastructure design on live projects for Saudi Arabia. If you have completed a Civil 3D course and want to work on real utility and infrastructure networks, this role is for you.

About Invicta-Tech

Invicta-Tech is a digital design and construction advisory firm specialising in BIM and technology-driven delivery for complex projects across KSA and the GCC. We work with contractors, consultants and asset owners to turn models, drawings and point clouds into measurable, client-ready deliverables aligned with ISO 19650, project EIRs and BEPs.

Our work spans BIM production (LOD 200-500), model coordination and clash management, BIM automation and asset handover, across infrastructure & landscape, airports, hospitality, giga projects, industrial and logistics facilities. Our delivery team is based in Hyderabad, India.

The role

You will join our infrastructure and utilities team as a junior Civil 3D modeller. You will start with supervised modelling and drawing tasks and move to independent work as you pass checkpoints, trained by our lead design engineer and BIM coordinators.

Terms of the role

Full-time, on-site, Hyderabad, India.

Paid role. The first 6 months are a training and probation period, with a review at month 3 and confirmation at month 6.

Salary is discussed after the interview and the practical test.

This is not a remote, part-time or contract role.

What you will do

Build Civil 3D models from survey data, drawings and markups: surfaces, alignments, profiles and grading, under supervision.

Model utility networks in Civil 3D: gravity pipe networks (storm water, sewer) and pressure networks (potable water, irrigation, fire water), and duct banks.

Produce plan and profile sheets, sections and schedules, with labels and annotations.

Draft and clean up 2D drawings in AutoCAD.

Check your work against the project standards before you hand it over, and flag missing or conflicting information early.

Learn how infrastructure models are coordinated with buildings, roads and other disciplines.

What we are looking for (must-have)

B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Civil Engineering. Final-year students who can join full-time on completion are welcome.

A completed Civil 3D course or training, with a project or exercises you can show.

AutoCAD basics.

Can read civil and infrastructure drawings (plans, profiles, sections).

Attention to detail and clear written English.

Able to work full-time, on-site in Hyderabad.

Willing to take a short practical Civil 3D test at our office.

Nice to have

A portfolio or sample drawings from your course or college project (a link or PDF).

Exposure to Infraworks, Navisworks or Revit.

Interest in drainage, water supply or road design.

How we hire

1. Apply here on Indeed with your CV and a portfolio or sample drawings link.

2. Short first call.

3. Short practical test at our office in Hyderabad: a timed Civil 3D task (a surface and a small pipe network from supplied data, with one plan and profile sheet).

4. Only candidates who clear the test move to a conversation with our technical team and the terms discussion.

Please do not apply if you cannot attend the test in person in Hyderabad.

Openings: 1

Location: Hyderabad, India. Full-time, on-site with the delivery team.

How to apply: Apply here on Indeed with your CV and a link to your portfolio or sample drawings.

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Can you attend a short practical Civil 3D test at our office in Hyderabad?
* Have you completed a Civil 3D course or training? Name the course and the year.
* Is your degree or diploma in Civil Engineering (completed, or in your final year)?

Work Location: In person

title: BIM Engineer - Electrical (GCC Projects)
description:
ON-SITE IN HYDERABAD ONLY. PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING.

This is a full-time role at our office in Hyderabad, India. Remote work, hybrid work, or working from any other city is not possible. If you live outside Hyderabad, apply only if you will relocate to Hyderabad before joining.

We are looking for an experienced electrical BIM engineer with at least 5 years of electrical design and modelling on GCC projects, to own the electrical side of our infrastructure and building packages for Saudi Arabia.

About Invicta-Tech

Invicta-Tech is a digital design and construction advisory firm specialising in BIM and technology-driven delivery for complex projects across KSA and the GCC. We work with contractors, consultants and asset owners to turn models, drawings and point clouds into measurable, client-ready deliverables aligned with ISO 19650, project EIRs and BEPs.

Our work spans BIM production (LOD 200-500), model coordination and clash management, BIM automation and asset handover, across infrastructure & landscape, airports, hospitality, giga projects, industrial and logistics facilities. Our delivery team is based in Hyderabad, India.

The role

You will design, model and check electrical systems for our projects in Saudi Arabia and the GCC, and be the electrical reviewer on our packages before they go to the client. You will work with our lead design engineer, BIM coordinators and modellers in Hyderabad, and take part in client and design-team calls.

What you will do

Design and model electrical systems in Revit MEP and AutoCAD: LV power distribution, lighting (including external and street lighting), small power, earthing and lightning protection, containment and cable routes.

Prepare calculations and back-up: load schedules, cable sizing, voltage drop and short-circuit checks, and lighting calculations.

Model external electrical networks with the civil team: duct banks, cable routes, feeder pillars and street lighting layouts.

Produce and check electrical drawings and schedules from the model: layouts, single-line diagrams, panel schedules and details.

Review electrical models and drawings from other engineers and modellers, and check them against the project specifications, client comments and authority requirements before submission.

Run clash detection in Navisworks and resolve electrical clashes with the other disciplines.

Respond to client and consultant comments, and track them to closure.

Guide junior electrical modellers on standards, families and drawing quality.

What we are looking for (must-have)

B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering (or Electrical and Electronics).

5+ years of electrical design and BIM work, with at least part of it on projects in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC.

Strong hands-on Revit MEP (electrical) and AutoCAD.

Working knowledge of the codes and authority requirements used on GCC projects (for example IEC/BS, NFPA where relevant, and local utility requirements).

Able to do the core calculations yourself: load, cable sizing, voltage drop.

Clear written and spoken English for client comments and calls.

Full-time, on-site in Hyderabad.

Nice to have

Street lighting and external electrical network design for masterplans or giga projects.

DIALux, ETAP, Amtech or similar calculation software.

Navisworks and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360.

Experience with Saudi utility and authority submissions.

ELV / ICT or fire alarm exposure.

How we hire

1. Apply here on Indeed with your CV and, if possible, sample drawings (no confidential information).

2. A first call with our team.

3. A technical round: a design and drawing review exercise with our technical lead.

4. A final conversation with the partners, then an offer.

Openings: 1

Location: Hyderabad, India. Full-time, on-site with the delivery team.

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Have you worked on electrical design for projects in Saudi Arabia or the GCC?

Experience:

* electrical design and Revit MEP: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

**About the Team**
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure’s Compute Bare Metal Provisioning team builds services and tools that automate the server lifecycle, from platform creation and hardware bring-up to customer-ready instance provisioning and firmware management.
  
  
The team works across distributed systems, Linux, and hardware integration. **Job Summary**

* Design and develop major software components for OCI’s compute infrastructure.
* Build and operate scalable services that automate server provisioning, configuration, security, and validation.
* Develop tooling for hardware bring-up, platform lifecycle management, and firmware orchestration.
* Troubleshoot issues across distributed services, Linux systems, and hardware integrations.
* Collaborate with partner teams to launch and maintain platforms across AMD, Intel, Arm, and NVIDIA systems.
* Improve service reliability, scalability, performance, and operational efficiency.
* Take ownership of engineering problems, identify improvements, and deliver solutions in an agile environment.

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop major software components for OCI’s compute infrastructure.

* Troubleshoot issues across distributed services, Linux systems, and hardware integrations.
* Collaborate with partner teams to launch and maintain platforms across AMD, Intel, Arm, and NVIDIA systems.
* Improve service reliability, scalability, performance, and operational efficiency.
* Take ownership of engineering problems, identify improvements, and deliver solutions in an agile environment.

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* 3–8+ years of software development experience, including building or operating large-scale, highly available distributed systems.
* Strong coding skills in Java or C++, plus experience with Python or another scripting language.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Experience or exposure to Linux, operating systems concepts, and systems troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with TCP/IP, HTTP, and standard network architectures.
* Understanding of databases, NoSQL systems, storage, or distributed persistence.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn new technologies and collaborate across teams.
* Comfort using AI agents and prompt engineering to support software development, code analysis, and debugging.

**Good to Have**

* Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code experience.

title: Quality Engineer-II, Alexa Devices - Product QA
description:
**Description**
We are seeking a talented QA Engineer to own the quality of new Alexa devices. In this role, you will collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to own the end-to-end product quality of new Alexa devices, from product inception until it reaches the customer's hands. You will design and build AI-based automation tools and frameworks to support new device feature and non-functional testing.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Own end-to-end release quality for assigned new and experimental Alexa devices, from branch cut through WOTA release.
  
  
Drive daily BAT execution and weekly regression cycles; analyze results and ensure timely failure resolution.
  
  
Triage bugs by severity, track fix versions, and coordinate with development teams to prevent release blockers.
  
  
Monitor crash rates and adoption metrics during OTA ramps; escalate anomalies to stakeholders.
  
  
Coordinate release sign-off activities, including wiki creation, component POC follow-ups, and GM readiness validation.
  
  
Execute weekly beta publishes and validate customer-reported bugs for assigned devices.
  
  
Collaborate with feature teams, TPMs, and cross-location PQA teams to drive seamless release execution.
  
  
Design and maintain AI-based automation tools and frameworks to improve test coverage and execution efficiency.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are a high-performing team of engineers — including SDEs, SDETs, and QAEs — who build and maintain automation frameworks, AI-based testing tools, and lab infrastructure serving the Alexa Product QA needs.
  
  
As Alexa's device portfolio expands with new and experimental form factors in 2027, we are extending our charter into Product Quality Assurance (PQA) ownership — taking end-to-end accountability for release quality from branch cut through customer delivery. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a team that is scaling its impact, operating across time zones to provide round-the-clock quality coverage, and shaping how Alexa's next-generation devices reach customers.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
* Experience in automation testing
* Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
* Experience coordinating between technical teams, peers and business stakeholders
* Experience working with device technologies under development, familiarity with flashing firmware, basic device debugging and familiarity with reading/pulling device logs, or experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working closely with development and business teams to communicate problem impacts and to understand business requirements
* Experience in leading/coordinating work for other test teams

title: Repair Specialist
description:

As a repair specialist, you should know how current, voltage, resistance, capacitance, inductance, and other electrical parameters function in your circuit. You need to know how to use common test equipment like Multimeter, oscilloscopes, logic analysers, power supplies, signal generators. You also need to know how to choose the right test equipment for your specific PCB testing. You should know how to use logical thinking, systematic analysis, and creative problem-solving to diagnose and resolve PCB issues.

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related engineering discipline.
* 5 plus years of experience in manufacturing engineering, repair engineering, production support, testing, or a related technical environment.
* Strong troubleshooting, failure analysis, and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret technical data and documentation.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, quality standards, test methodologies, and engineering procedures.

title: SAP SD
description:
**Job Summary**
GeoSpatial Analyst MAP with extensive expertise in SAP SD Testing and SAP SD will analyze complex geographic and sales distribution data to enhance supply chain performance in a hybrid work model. The role focuses on optimizing routes territories and order fulfillment processes collaborating across business and technology teams to drive efficient consumer goods distribution and support strategic decision making.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Analyze spatial data from enterprise systems to derive actionable insights that optimize sales distribution patterns and supply chain flows across diverse geographic regions ensuring efficient product availability for customers and stakeholders.
* Design and maintain geospatial models that integrate SAP SD transactional data with location intelligence to improve order routing delivery planning and regional demand forecasting for business units.
* Collaborate with SAP SD testers and business analysts to validate end to end data flows between geospatial solutions and SAP SD modules ensuring accuracy of pricing delivery and customer master information across markets.
* Develop and refine reusable test scenarios and data sets for SAP SD Testing that incorporate geospatial attributes enabling robust validation of territory assignments shipping conditions and logistic routes.
* Evaluate complex supply chain processes for consumer goods using map based analytics identifying bottlenecks in transportation warehousing and last mile delivery and recommending data driven improvements.
* Create detailed dashboards and map visualizations that present key performance indicators related to order fulfillment regional sales performance and supply chain disruptions in formats that are easy for business teams to interpret.
* Coordinate with demand planning distribution and customer service teams to ensure geospatial analysis aligns with real world constraints such as service level expectations inventory positioning and carrier capacities.
* Document geospatial analysis methods data transformations and SAP SD Testing approaches in clear technical narratives that support audit readiness knowledge transfer and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Assess the impact of new business rules and configuration changes in SAP SD on geospatial models recommending updates to algorithms and data structures that preserve consistency and reliability of insights.
* Automate data extraction and quality checks for geospatial and SAP SD data sources using approved tools reducing manual effort and increasing timeliness of reporting for supply chain and commercial stakeholders.
* Support continuous enhancement of hybrid work practices by enabling secure remote access to geospatial tools maintaining performance standards for map rendering and ensuring responsive collaboration with onsite teams.
* Participate in cross functional workshops to translate strategic supply chain goals into geospatial use cases prioritizing initiatives that improve sustainability reduce waste and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Provide thought guidance on emerging trends in geoanalytics and digital supply chain proposing practical pilots that use existing SAP SD and mapping capabilities to create measurable business impact.

**Qualifications**

* Bring strong experience in SAP SD Testing with deep understanding of order to cash pricing delivery processing and data integrity concepts applied to complex enterprise landscapes.
* Demonstrate advanced practical knowledge of SAP SD configuration and processes including customer master data material listings shipping conditions and billing flows relevant to geospatial analysis.
* Apply proven expertise in supply chain management to interpret logistics networks service levels and inventory strategies translating them into meaningful geospatial models and metrics.
* Offer solid exposure to consumer goods supply chains including channel structures promotion driven demand variation and distribution patterns that influence geospatial optimization opportunities.
* Utilize strong skills in geospatial data analysis and mapping tools to manage large spatial data sets perform proximity and route analyses and present insights in clear visual narratives.
* Employ disciplined testing and documentation practices including test case design defect tracking and root cause analysis ensuring that geospatial and SAP SD solutions meet quality expectations.
* Communicate effectively with technical and business partners synthesizing complex spatial and SAP SD information into transparent explanations that support informed decision making.

**Certifications Required**
SAP SD certification plus any recognized geospatial or GIS analytics certification such as ESRI or equivalent.

title: Software Development Engineer II, International Emerging Stores Sub-same Day
description:
**Description**
Do you want to shape how fast Amazon can deliver to hundreds of millions of customers? The Sub-Same-Day (SSD) team builds the technology behind Amazon's fastest delivery promises across India and Emerging Marketplaces — getting orders to customers in hours, not days.
  
  
We're looking for a Software Development Engineer II who wants to own high-scale, low-latency systems that directly move the speed and reliability customers see at checkout. You'll design and build services that compute and optimize the fastest reliable delivery promise for every order.
  
  

* Build customer-facing systems at massive scale and single-digit-millisecond latency
* Own features end-to-end, from design through production and operations
* Directly impact conversion, delivery speed, and customer trust across 10+ marketplaces

Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency, highly available services that power SSD delivery promises.
* Own features end-to-end — requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations.
* Lead design discussions and independently drive alignment with partner teams (Promise, transportation, search etc. ).
* Uphold operational excellence: monitoring, alarming, on-call, and driving down defects and tickets.
* Dive deep on edge cases, testing, and safe production rollouts (canary deployments, metrics, dashboards).
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks; communicate progress, blockers, and tradeoffs clearly.
* Mentor SDE-1s and junior engineers — review code and designs, unblock them, and raise the technical bar.
* Contribute to the team's technical roadmap and continuous improvement of our systems.

A day in the life
  
  
You'll partner with product managers, applied scientists, and engineering teams across Promise, ATROPS, transportation, and DEX to ship features that make delivery faster and more reliable. A typical day includes a team standup, design and code reviews, hands-on development, and digging into production metrics. You'll take part in operational excellence and on-call to keep our services healthy. Beyond delivery, we invest in learning and fun — quarterly hackathons and fortnightly GenAI brown-bag sessions where the team explores new technology together.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Sub-Same-Day (SSD) team owns the technology behind Amazon's fastest delivery experiences across India and Emerging Marketplaces (AU, BR, MX, AE, SA, SG, EG, TR, ZA). Our mission is to give every customer the fastest reliable promise we can keep — and to extend same-day and sub-same-day speed to new marketplaces and customers. We're a high-ownership, customer-obsessed team that values deep technical work, operational excellence, and continuous learning. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Lifeasy Interior is a manufacturer of home and office furniture, specializing in modular kitchens, modular wardrobes, TV units, and office furnishings. **FREELANCE PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT & PRODUCTION PROJECT MANAGER – INDIA**

SAKSHAM is looking for a Freelance Product Development & Production Project Manager based in Delhi, India, to support its activities with international fashion brands and Indian manufacturers.

We are looking for a hands-on, organised and technically skilled professional with solid experience in garment manufacturing, product development and quality control.

**Position details**

Location: Delhi, India, with travel across India

Availability: Approximately 2 days per week to start

Initial assignment: 3 months, with potential for further collaboration

Status: Freelance / Independent Consultant

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Product Development & Production Management**

* Coordinate product development and production with manufacturers.
* Follow up on samples, technical comments, corrections and approvals.
* Ensure brands' technical instructions are correctly communicated and implemented.
* Monitor production timelines, key milestones and deliveries.
* Identify and assess potential manufacturing partners.

**2. Technical Quality Control, Fabrics & Compliance**

* Check fabrics and trims against technical specifications and quality requirements.
* Verify fabric quality, colours, composition and relevant test reports.

* Inspect construction, stitching, finishing and workmanship.
* Check prints, embroidery and other embellishments for quality and execution.
* Identify defects, communicate corrective actions and follow up until issues are resolved.
* Follow up on required certifications, audits and compliance documentation.

* Review and evaluate supplier quotations and garment costing breakdowns.
* Assess fabric, trims, labour and manufacturing costs.
* Benchmark prices against target costs and market standards.
* Identify cost optimisation opportunities without compromising quality.
* Negotiate prices, MOQs and commercial terms with manufacturers.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers.

**The ideal profile**

* Previous experience in garment manufacturing, product development, merchandising, production management or quality control.
* Strong technical knowledge and ability to assess garment fit, construction and finishing, as well as quality of fabrics, trims, prints and embroidery.
* Knowledge of garment quality standards, testing and compliance requirements.
* Good understanding of garment costing, price evaluation and supplier negotiations.
* Excellent organisational and communication skills.
* Good command of Excel is essential.

Experience working with European fashion brands is a strong plus.

If this sounds like you, or someone in your network, please get in touch.

Send your CV and a short introduction via LinkedIn message.

Please feel free to share this opportunity with your network.

title: Senior Manager Business Planning
description:
The role will have end-to-end responsibility for footwear business planning, production planning, commercial governance, factory capacity planning, vendor management, merchandising coordination, tooling planning, and delivery performance across the India business.

The footwear business is increasingly dependent on an optimal combination of imports and local manufacturing to meet changing business, compliance, quality, cost, and availability requirements. In this environment, the role will be responsible for developing a clear understanding of current and future production capacity, identifying potential supply constraints, and proactively aligning production plans with business requirements.

The position will work closely with Category, Merchandising, Planning, Sourcing, Finance, Supply Chain, Quality, Product Development, Operations, and manufacturing partners to ensure that the business has the right product, at the right cost, in the right quantity and at the right time.

The ideal candidate should bring strong footwear industry experience, commercial acumen, analytical capability and a strong understanding of production planning, factory operations, vendor management, and business planning.

**Designation:**
Senior Manager

**Department:**
Category – Footwear

**Function:**
Business Planning & Commercials

**Reports To:**
Director – Category (Footwear)

**Experience:**
12+ Years

**Qualification:**
FDDI / NIFT preferred; Post-Graduation in Footwear, Business Planning, Supply Chain, Production Planning, Merchandising or a related discipline preferred

**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Planning & Commercial Governance
* Drive the overall business planning for the Footwear Category across India, ensuring alignment with business strategy, channel requirements, and financial objectives.
* Develop and maintain the annual, seasonal, and monthly footwear business plans in alignment with category and channel requirements.
* Understand the business dynamics and commercial requirements across Retail, MBO, Distribution, E-commerce, and other relevant channels.
* Translate sales plans and business requirements into actionable buying, production, and supply plans.
* Drive OTB planning and governance, ensuring that all buying decisions are aligned with approved budgets, business plans, and commercial objectives.
* Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained before commitments or buys are placed.
* Define and govern the Annual Footwear Buy Plan, including import and local production requirements.
* Monitor business performance against planned buys, sales, inventory, margin, and cost objectives.
* Partner with Finance and Category teams to ensure alignment between business plans and financial targets.
* Identify commercial risks and opportunities and provide timely recommendations to the leadership team.
* Margin, COGS & Commercial Management
* Drive governance of agreed Gross Margin (GM%) deliverables for the Footwear business.
* Plan and monitor COGS as a percentage of MRP for each season and across relevant product/channel segments.
* Analyze cost structures and identify opportunities for improving product economics and overall business profitability.
* Work closely with sourcing, merchandising, and manufacturing teams to identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality, product standards or delivery timelines.
* Monitor cost movements arising from local manufacturing, imports, production efficiencies, tooling, and other commercial factors.
* Evaluate the financial impact of production and supply decisions and provide recommendations to the Category leadership.
* Track commercial deviations against approved plans and ensure timely corrective action.
* Support scenario planning for changes in demand, production capacity, cost, lead times, and business requirements.
* Production Planning & Factory Capacity Management
* Own the production planning framework for locally manufactured footwear.
* Develop a clear view of current and future factory capacity, production output, and available manufacturing capability.
* Align factory capacity with seasonal business requirements, sales orders, and agreed production plans.
* Monitor factory production output against the agreed plan and proactively identify capacity constraints.
* Work closely with factories to optimize production schedules based on business priorities.
* Manage production planning challenges arising from changing demand, quality requirements, compliance requirements, raw material availability, and factory constraints.
* Develop alternate production scenarios where planned output is at risk.
* Ensure production plans are realistic, achievable, and aligned with required delivery dates.
* Establish regular production planning reviews with manufacturing partners.
* Drive weekly and monthly production planning and dispatch reviews.
* Factory & Vendor Performance Management
* Establish and maintain vendor/factory performance scorecards covering key operational and commercial parameters.
* Track and improve key KPIs including:
* OTIF – On-Time In-Full delivery
* On-time production completion
* Dispatch adherence
* Production output
* Capacity utilization
* Quality performance
* Production lead time
* Plan adherence
* Commercial compliance
* Identify underperforming factories/vendors and develop corrective action plans.
* Work with vendors to resolve production and delivery challenges and escalate critical issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Conduct regular factory reviews to evaluate production performance, capacity, constraints, and upcoming requirements.
* Undertake visits to production facilities as required to review production planning, manufacturing progress, and dispatch readiness.
* Ensure factories have clear visibility of business requirements and agreed production priorities.
* Drive accountability among vendors for committed timelines and deliverables.
* Merchandising & Product Planning Coordination
* Partner closely with the Footwear Merchandising and Category teams to translate assortment and sales requirements into actionable production and buying plans.
* Ensure production planning is aligned with seasonal assortment requirements and approved sales orders.
* Monitor product-level requirements and identify potential supply gaps.
* Coordinate with merchandising teams on product availability, production status, and delivery timelines.
* Ensure that changes in product requirements, quantities or timelines are communicated to factories in a timely manner.
* Support business decisions related to local production versus imports based on capacity, cost, lead time, quality, and business requirements.
* Provide commercial and operational inputs into seasonal planning and range-building discussions.
* Tooling Planning & Management
* Own the planning and governance of footwear tooling requirements in alignment with sales orders and production plans.
* Ensure tooling requirements are identified and communicated sufficiently in advance to avoid production delays.
* Track tooling development and readiness against agreed production timelines.
* Coordinate with relevant product development, merchandising, sourcing, and factory teams to ensure tooling availability.
* Identify tooling-related risks and escalate potential impact on production or delivery timelines.
* Establish visibility of tooling requirements across seasons and future production plans.
* Imports & Local Manufacturing Planning
* Develop an optimal planning approach for the import and locally manufactured footwear portfolio.
* Evaluate business requirements and recommend the appropriate sourcing/manufacturing mix.
* Consider factors such as:
* Factory capacity
* Production lead time
* Product availability
* COGS
* Quality requirements
* Compliance requirements
* Tooling requirements
* Demand and sales plans
* Delivery commitments
* Proactively identify situations where local production capacity may not be sufficient and recommend alternate supply solutions.
* Support the Category leadership team with data-driven recommendations on production versus import decisions.
* Business Analytics, Reporting & MIS
* Develop and maintain robust business planning and production tracking tools to provide timely visibility to the Category and leadership teams.
* Prepare detailed and actionable analytics covering:
* Business plan vs. actual
* Buy plan vs. actual
* OTB utilization
* Production plan vs. actual
* Factory capacity
* Production output
* OTIF performance
* Dispatch status
* COGS and margin
* Vendor performance
* Tooling readiness
* Supply risks
* Ensure all reports are supported by accurate, timely and reliable data.
* Provide clear insights, risks, and recommended actions, rather than only reporting historical performance.
* Establish weekly and monthly reporting mechanisms for leadership review.
* Develop dashboards that provide forward-looking visibility on production and supply risks.
* Highlight deviations early and ensure ownership and closure of action points.
* Process, SOP & Governance
* Develop and strengthen SOPs, processes and governance mechanisms for business planning, production planning, factory reporting and vendor management.
* Standardize planning and reporting practices across factories and business stakeholders.
* Ensure factories follow agreed reporting formats, timelines, and planning processes.
* Establish clear escalation mechanisms for production, capacity, quality, and delivery risks.
* Drive process discipline and ensure adherence to agreed procedures.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and increased planning efficiency.
* Align factory processes with relevant global requirements, processes, and best practices.
* Facilitate effective communication between India factories and the global team.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration

**Work Closely With Internal And External Stakeholders Including**

* Category – Footwear
* Merchandising
* Planning
* Sourcing
* Supply Chain
* Finance
* Quality
* Product Development
* Retail
* E-commerce
* Distribution
* Operations
* Global/Regional Teams
* Local Manufacturing Partners
* Vendors and Factories

Ensure that all stakeholders have timely visibility of business plans, production requirements, risks, changes, and delivery commitments.

* Team Leadership & Capability Building
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 4 direct reports.
* Establish clear goals, responsibilities, and performance expectations for the team.
* Build strong analytical, planning, and commercial capabilities within the team.
* Encourage ownership, accountability, and proactive problem-solving.
* Review team performance through structured business reviews and KPI tracking.
* Develop succession capability and ensure adequate functional coverage.
* Create a culture of urgency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Key Performance Indicators**

The role will be measured against a combination of business, commercial, operational, and planning KPIs, including:

**Business & Commercial**

* Annual/seasonal business plan adherence
* OTB utilization and governance
* GM% achievement
* COGS% to MRP
* Buy plan adherence
* Commercial savings/optimization initiatives

**Production & Supply**

* Production plan adherence
* Factory capacity utilization
* On-time production completion
* OTIF performance
* On-time dispatch percentage
* Production lead-time adherence
* Reduction in production-related business risks

**Vendor Management**

* Vendor/factory scorecard performance
* Improvement in underperforming vendor performance
* Timely closure of corrective action plans

**Planning & Governance**

* Accuracy and timeliness of business/production plans
* Timely identification of capacity constraints
* Tooling readiness against production requirements
* Compliance with planning SOPs
* Accuracy and timeliness of management reporting

**Candidate Profile**

**Educational Qualification**

* Graduate/post-graduate qualification from FDDI, NIFT or another reputed institution preferred.
* Candidates with a strong Footwear Production Planning / Manufacturing / Supply Chain / Merchandising / Business Planning background may also be considered.
* Post-Graduation in Business Management, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related discipline would be an advantage.

**Experience**

* 12+ years of relevant experience, preferably within the footwear industry.
* Strong experience in business planning, production planning, footwear manufacturing, and/or commercial planning.
* Experience working with footwear factories, vendors, and manufacturing partners.
* Strong understanding of footwear production processes, capacity planning, and delivery management.
* Experience managing multiple stakeholders and leading a team is essential.
* Exposure to both local manufacturing and import planning would be highly desirable.

**Functional Competencies**

**The Candidate Should Demonstrate Strong Capability In**

* Footwear Business Planning
* Production Planning
* Factory Capacity Planning
* Commercial Planning
* OTB Planning & Governance
* COGS & Margin Management
* Vendor Management
* Factory Performance Management
* Merchandising Coordination
* Tooling Planning
* Supply Planning
* Business Analytics
* MIS & Dashboard Development
* Cost Optimization
* Process & SOP Development
* Risk Identification & Mitigation
* Cross-functional Stakeholder Management

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Dynamic and versatile with the ability to operate in a fast-paced business environment.
* Strong analytical and planning orientation.
* High level of commercial acumen and business understanding.
* Strong decision-making and problem-solving ability.
* Highly detail-oriented with strong process discipline.
* Strong sense of urgency and ownership.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Team player with the ability to work effectively across functions and cultures.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage stretched timelines when business requirements demand.
* Strong execution focuses with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, including data analysis, reporting and business planning.
* Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint for management presentations.
* Working knowledge of MS Word.
* Experience with ERP/Planning/Business Intelligence systems would be an advantage.
* Ability to build and maintain analytical dashboards and production/business tracking tools.

**Key Role Expectations**

**The Successful Candidate Will Be Expected To**

**Own the Footwear business planning agenda**
and ensure alignment between business requirements and supply capability. Maintain strong forward visibility of
**production output, factory capacity, and delivery commitments**
. Ensure the right balance between
**imports and local manufacturing**
. Protect and improve
**commercial outcomes through OTB, COGS and GM governance**
. Ensure factories and vendors deliver against agreed plans and timelines. Identify production, capacity, tooling, and delivery risks
**before they impact the business**
. Provide leadership with accurate, timely and actionable business intelligence. Establish robust planning processes, SOPs, and governance mechanisms. Build a high-performing and commercially oriented planning team. Act as a key link between
**Category, Merchandising, Factories, Vendors, Finance, Supply Chain and Global Stakeholders**
.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate will be a
**footwear industry professional with strong business planning and commercial expertise**
, who can operate across both strategic planning and day-to-day execution. The person should be equally comfortable analyzing business numbers, reviewing factory capacity, challenging production plans, managing vendors, driving cross-functional alignment and presenting clear recommendations to senior leadership.

The role requires an individual who can
**anticipate business requirements, translate them into executable production and commercial plans, identify risks early and drive stakeholders towards timely closure**
, while maintaining strong process discipline and commercial accountability.

title: Project Leader - TMT
description:
**ABOUT US:**

Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services. 

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:**

You will be a part of Technology, Media & Telecommunications CoE (TMT CoE) in BCN’s Consulting Services and work closely with TMT experts and case teams for solving management questions for the clients and developing industry perspective and products. The CoE serves leading companies across domains such as Wireline and Wireless Telecommunication, Cable and Satellite, Media, Software, Semiconductors, Hardware, Technology, CSPs, and IT Services. The team is primarily focused on collaborating with practice/case teams on the development and deployment of industry specific analytical products to answer strategic questions of Bain’s TMT clients.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* Day to day management of 4-5 team members
  1. Lead a group of Analysts and Associates to execute projects with limited guidance from the Manager
  2. Understand client context, situation and business problem – translate that into actionable research problems
  3. Create workplan, provide guidance to junior team members, and review outputs to ensure high quality delivery to the clients
  4. Showcase proficiency in identifying and using analytical tools such as Alteryx and Tableau to improve quality and team efficiency
  5. Proactively resolve problems, remove roadblocks, escalate issues as needed
* Own and maintain client relationships
  1. Engage with stakeholders on a broad range of TMT topics, bringing personal experience and parallels from industry knowledge
  2. Manage client and team meetings and deliver clear and professional presentations to the team/team manager and Partners
  3. Understand client needs and situations and adapt to project expectations
* Exert strong positive influence over hiring, developing and retaining top talent 
  1. Coach and provide actionable feedback to the team members to ensure their professional development
  2. Deliver performance reviews, recommend ratings
  3. Participate in hiring activities to onboard top talent
  4. Acts as a role model and brand ambassador of the Bain culture

**ABOUT YOU:**

* Relevant work experience in the range of 5-8 years (for undergraduates) and 3-6 years (for post-graduates), preferably in providing internal/external strategic consulting in areas related to telecom, media and technology

description:

**About The Role**
Novus Hi-Tech Robotic Systemz Pvt. Ltd. is seeking an experienced Engineering Manager - Firmware to lead firmware development for its ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) Business Unit.
  
  
This role owns the technical direction, delivery and quality of embedded firmware across radar- and vision-based ADAS platforms, while also managing and mentoring a team of embedded/firmware engineers.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on expertise in automotive embedded systems with proven people and program leadership.
  
  
**Key Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end firmware (BSW & ASW) development for ADAS products across Qualcomm, Infineon, ST and NXP/KEA platforms, covering radar and vision-based systems.
* Own the technical architecture and design of AUTOSAR-based embedded software, including RTE, BSW module configuration and diagnostics.
* Drive functional safety compliance (ISO 26262, ASIL-D) across the firmware lifecycle, from requirements through verification and validation.
* Define and enforce automotive cybersecurity practices to ensure secure firmware and system architectures.
* Manage bootloader and device driver development, and lead low-level debugging (CAN, hardware/software integration issues) across platforms.

**People Leadership**

* Build, mentor and manage a team of firmware/embedded engineers.
* Own technical hiring, performance reviews and career development for direct reports.

**Delivery & Program Management**

* Partner with product management, hardware, systems and QA teams to translate ADAS product requirements into firmware deliverables and release plans.
* Manage project timelines, technical risk and resource planning for firmware workstreams within the ADAS Business Unit.
* Act as the primary technical escalation point for firmware issues with OEM and Tier-1 stakeholders.

**Process & Innovation**

* Establish and improve firmware development processes, coding standards and review practices across the team.
* Drive innovation and IP generation - identify and file patents in areas such as V2X, radar, suspension/steering control and in-cabin monitoring.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in automotive embedded systems, with direct exposure to ADAS, telematics or camera-based systems.
* Strong hands-on expertise in BSW & ASW development within an AUTOSAR architecture, including RTE and BSW module configuration.
* Proven experience delivering safety-critical software compliant with ISO 26262 (ASIL-D) for global OEMs or Tier-1 suppliers.
* Working knowledge of automotive cybersecurity principles and secure firmware design.
* Practical experience with bootloader development, device drivers, and CAN-based debugging and diagnostics.
* Experience developing on Qualcomm, Infineon, ST and/or NXP/KEA microcontroller/SoC platforms.
* Prior experience leading or mentoring a firmware/embedded engineering team, with the ability to balance hands-on technical contribution with people management.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to radar-based and/or vision-based ADAS systems.
* Demonstrated track record of technical innovation, ideally with patents filed in automotive/embedded domains (e.g., V2X, radar, suspension, in-cabin monitoring).
* Experience working with, or delivering solutions for, Defence/government programs.

**Education**

* Required : Bachelor's degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline.
* Preferred : Master's degree

title: Lead – Field Operations & Partnerships
description:
**About NinjaHelp**

Finding trusted help for your home (an elder-care attendant, a nanny, a cook) is still one of the most stressful, word-of-mouth, cash-only searches in urban India. Families struggle to trust who walks through their door, and workers rarely get fair, dependable work.

NinjaHelp is changing that. We’re building the technology layer for India’s household help market: verified worker profiles, smart matching, partner management and simple monthly payments. Families get trusted help in days, not weeks. Our worker app, Saathi, already supports six Indian languages. We work with a growing network of partner agencies across Delhi-NCR, with Bangalore and Mumbai next.

We’re a small team led by leaders from Paytm, MakeMyTrip, Goibibo and Flipkart, and we’re building the operations engine that makes all of this work on the ground.

**The role**

You’ll own field operations and partnerships in Delhi-NCR: the people, partners and processes that turn a family’s request into a trusted worker at their door. You’ll build the playbook here, then take it to new cities. This is a hands-on leadership role: you’ll be in the field as much as in spreadsheets.

**What you’ll do**

* **Grow and manage our partner agency network:**
  identify, pitch and onboard agencies; run document checks and compliance; drive them on service levels through our Priority Partner programme.
* **Build worker supply:**
  run onboarding drives with partners and community networks; get workers onto Saathi with complete, verified profiles.
* **Own fulfilment end to end:**
  from a family’s request to matching, trial and a successful start. Track time-to-fill, trial success and replacement rates, and fix what breaks.
* **Run the family experience on the ground:**
  home visits, escalations and replacement conversations, with a high bar for trust and safety.
* **Build and lead the field team:**
  hire, train and manage field executives; set targets, routines and reviews.
* **Shape the product:**
  work with our tech team on the operations console, partner portal and Saathi app, turning field insight into features.
* **Launch new cities:**
  document what works in Delhi-NCR and lead the playbook for our 2027 city launches.

**You’ll be a great fit if you have**

* 3–6 years in supply, partner or field operations at a marketplace or consumer platform: home services, mobility, food or quick commerce, travel supply, seller onboarding, or hyperlocal fulfilment.
* A track record of building and managing a partner or supplier network, with numbers to show it.
* Experience leading a small field team and running operations on metrics.
* Comfort on the ground: you’re as effective at an agency office in Dwarka as on a call with a family in Golf Course Road.
* Fluency in Hindi and English. Bengali, Nepali, Assamese or Odia is a strong plus.
* High ownership, integrity and calm under pressure. You’ll be dealing with people’s homes and livelihoods.

**Why join now: early equity, real ownership**

* **Early-team ESOPs.**
  You’ll be among our first team members and receive stock options from our earliest grants, at today’s valuation. Equity granted this early is where the meaningful upside sits if we execute, and you’ll be one of the people executing.
* **Build from zero to one.**
  No inherited playbook: the operating system you design becomes the template for every city we launch.
* **Direct access to leadership.**
  You’ll work closely with the founders and have a real say in how the company is built.
* **A problem that matters.**
  Every match you make means a family gets trusted help and a worker gets fair, dependable work.
* **Room to grow.**
  As we expand, this role is built to grow into heading operations across cities.

**Compensation:**
competitive fixed salary plus early-team ESOPs.

**To apply:**
apply here with your CV and a short note on the toughest partner or supply network you’ve built, and what the numbers looked like.

title: Project Leader-  People & ORG (Data Statistician)
description:
**ABOUT US:**

Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services. 

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:**
 

This role is based out of the People & ORG CoE which sits in the broader Data & Tech cluster at the BCN. People & ORG CoE works on building and deploying analytical solutions pertaining to Operating Model and Organization Practice. The team primarily helps Bain case teams, across geographies and industries, solve critical client issues by applying battle-proven diagnostics/ solutions that can identify client pain points related to org, culture, and talent. The team also plays a significant role in creating, testing, and contributing to the proprietary products and Bain IP within the Org domain. This role will focus on development, maintenance and evolution of the state-of-the art org tool and data assets.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* Clean, harmonize and prepare large past client datasets (multi-wave, multi-region, industry, size bands) for analysis
* Conduct extensive analysis independently from large datasets using statistical techniques such as regression, tree-based models, partial-dependence etc. and present findings to senior stakeholders with proper facts and figures
* Work cross-functionally with Practice stakeholders, BCN teams, other survey/ data experts to ensure data & model integrity, and to understand business/client context
* Build reports, presentations, dashboards for internal stakeholders and external marketing/editorial use: summarizing insights, visualizing trends, producing clear narratives.
* Become an expert and own, maintain and help evolve advanced AI based tools by testing and verifying results confidence as well as help develop new tools, in individual capacity
* Design and execute statistical tests to validate synthetic-data generators and non-survey predictive models (distributional tests, reliability/validity tests, correlation structure checks, hold-out testing)
* Be responsible for end-to-end handling of any new tool testing process, i.e., determining statistical testing methods, troubleshooting low scores, presenting findings, leading brainstorming discussions, etc.
* Help with case delivery related to those tools and generate meaningful insights for Bain clients
* Work under the guidance of a Team Manager / Sr. Team Manager, playing a key role in driving the team’s innovation, especially on data statistics topics
* Lead internal team calls and effectively communicate data, knowledge, insights and actionable next steps on tool development, relaying implications to own internal team where necessary
* Keep abreast of statistical and methodological advances relevant to surveys, diagnostic tools, synthetic-data methods, relevant software/tools, and advanced data analytics techniques

  

**ABOUT YOU:**

* Candidate should be a Economics/ Statistics/ Mathematics Graduate/ Post-graduate from top-tier college with strong academic background
* Must have 5 years of professional experience focused on statistics/data analytics (ideally within consulting, market research, organizational diagnostics or data science)
* Strong foundation in statistical theory and methods (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression, mixed-models, reliability/validity, sampling)
* Hands-on experience with statistical software (e.g., Python (pandas/ statsmodels /scikit-learn) , or similar) and data-manipulation tools
* Experience with synthetic-data generation using AI and/or model validation frameworks (predictive, reliability, fairness)
* Good to have - experience working with survey data (Likert-scales, national/international datasets, multi-wave) and performing benchmark/norming analyses
* Good to have - Experience building or validating predictive/statistical models (preferably including synthetic data generation or simulation work) is a strong plus
* Ability to manage multiple work-streams, meet deadlines, and maintain high quality and accuracy in deliverables
* Good business acumen and ability to work collaboratively in a consulting-style environment
* Must be able to generate and screen realistic answers based on sound reality checks and recommend actionable solutions
* Must be willing to own and maintain high visibility and high impact product
* Excellent oral and written communication skills including the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical senior stakeholders

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK:**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Now Assist-HRSD
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Now Assist & HRSD)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The role of Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of ServiceNow solutions focusing on HR Service Delivery as well as Now Assist capabilities (including AI agents, agentic workflows and now assist skills). In addition, this role would lead implementations to make ServiceNow as an orchestrator to call multiple AI agents within and outside of ServiceNow using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent-to-Agent protocol (A2A) to allow ServiceNow agents to invoke external data sets and APIs.
  
  
The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Implementation expertise of Now Assist capabilities (out of box and custom skills), agentic workflow and AI agents
* Experience in configuring out of box agentic workflows and implementing custom AI agents
* Understanding of A2A and MCP protocols
* Deep functional knowledge of LLMs, agentic patterns and API integration paths (REST)
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of HRSD and ITSM applications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
