title: Manager (IFM - Technical Services & Sustainable Operations) — Campus Development
description:
**About the IIHS Campus Development**

The IIHS campus is located on a 54-acre site at Kengeri, Bengaluru, located between a 500-acre reserve forest and a 800-year old 150-acre lake. Its digitally augmented buildings and facilities, slated to be built over multiple phases, will enable interdisciplinary teaching-learning, research and practice, and demonstrate the best examples of Indian design and crafts. The campus will provide faculty, students and researchers with the opportunity to immerse themselves in and innovate around India’s core urban challenges.

The campus features a robust integrated infrastructure and services network supported by various sensors and other IoT devices to enable cost-effective high performance and long-term sustainability. This will be enabled via an intelligent digital twin to integrate all MEP services at site and building level to help in optimised predictive operations and maintenance.

The IIHS Campus Development team focuses on design, procurement, execution, and

documentation of the development of the IIHS Kengeri Campus. Joining the Campus Development team at IIHS offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of building one of India’s most ambitious, sustainable and climate-resilient campuses. Situated in the upcoming Kengeri area of Bengaluru, it is deeply rooted in principles of net neutrality and long-term environmental stewardship targeting Factor two to four infrastructure and services.

As part of this fast-paced and dynamic team, you will gain hands-on experience and

unparalleled exposure to interdisciplinary planning, design and implementation spanning various technology domains, architecture, urban design, planning and environmental design, . The role is designed to accelerate your professional development, offering meaningful engagement with cutting-edge practices in sustainable development. We are looking for candidates passionate about building a better future and eager to shape a living, learning campus from the ground up. Join this team if you are interested in a purpose-driven career.

**Job Description**

IIHS is looking to hire an experienced Integrated Facility Management (IFM) Manager – Technical Services & Sustainable Operations to assume direct operational accountability for mission-critical MEP infrastructure and sustainable campus operations across IIHS facilities. The incumbent will manage internal technical engineering staff while providing rigorous contractual governance over external IFM service providers, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), and Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs). This role demands strict alignment with green campus benchmarking, net-zero resource targets, high-voltage asset uptime, and robust Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) regulatory compliance.

**Activities and Tasks**

Responsibilities will include, but not be limited to, the following:

* Hard services and critical infrastructure governance:
* Operations & maintenance:
  Overseeing routine and specialised O&M of high-voltage/ low-voltage (HT/LT) electrical systems, transformers, DG sets, HVAC central chillers, STP/ WTP facilities, and Fire & Life Safety (FLS) networks;
* BMS & IoT monitoring: Managing Building Management Systems (BMS) and IoT-enabled digital twin frameworks for real-time asset tracking and predictive fault detection;
* Preventive maintenance: Establishing and executing strict Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM) schedules to ensure maximum equipment lifecycle and zero unplanned downtime;
* Sustainability and resource optimization:
* Green campus initiatives: Driving initiatives targeting net-zero energy, water efficiency, carbon footprint reduction, and campus zero-waste goals;
* Resource conservation: Monitoring and optimising energy/ water baselines through intelligent sub-metering, STP recycled water utilisation, and waste segregation protocols;
* Auditing and reporting: Conducting regular energy and environmental audits, tracking performance against institutional sustainability targets;
* Internal staff leadership & vendor/ AMC governance:
* In-house crew management: Directing, scheduling, upskilling, and evaluating performance standards for in-house technicians, electricians, and shift engineers;
* Contractual SLA enforcement: Drafting technical SOWs/ RFPs, tracking performance scorecards, and enforcing strict SLAs/ KPIs for external IFM service providers and OEM AMC partners;
* Compliance & risk control: Ensuring 100% adherence to statutory EHS guidelines, Electrical Inspectorate norms, local municipal rules, and leading disaster management emergency response drills;
* Financial budgeting: Formulating and tracking OPEX/ CAPEX budgets for hard services, utility bills, spare parts inventory, and engineering repairs;
* Institutional:
* Providing support to other IIHS activities including academics, research, training, practice, operations and others;
* Participating in all activities of Institution-Building at IIHS; carrying out tasks as assigned by IIHS; and traveling on IIHS work within or outside the country as and when needed.

**Structure and Reporting**

The Manager (IFM – Hard Technical Services & Sustainable Operations) will report directly to the Head – Campus Development or to any other person designated by the
Head at IIHS. The incumbent will need to collaborate effectively with the Campus Development Team, internal engineering staff, and external IFM/ AMC vendors.

**Person Specification**

The ideal candidate should possess:

* Bachelor’s degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in Electrical or Mechanical; professional certifications such as LEED AP, IGBC AP, or Certified Energy Manager (CEM) are highly desirable;
* Minimum 9 years of hands-on experience managing hard technical services, mission-critical infrastructure, and sustainable operations within complex campus environments;
* In-depth operational knowledge of BMS/IoT integrations, predictive maintenance models, Computer-Aided Facility Management (CAFM)/CMMS software, and energy management systems;
* Proven vendor negotiation expertise, crisis management composure, strong leadership of blue-collar and engineering teams, and executive-level reporting.

This offer is on an exclusive basis, which implies that other professional assignments (whether compensated or not) that bear a potential conflict of interest with IIHS cannot be undertaken.

The search will remain open until the position is filled.

**Location**

This position is based in Kengeri, Bengaluru and may entail travel to other locations in India.

**Review and Assessment**

The role and performance of the incumbent shall be subject to normal review and assessment systems at IIHS.

**Diversity Policy**

IIHS is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions.

**Contact**

Please write to us at careers@iihs.co.in if you need any clarifications while filling the online application form.

* Role: Security Service Manager
* Location: Bengaluru
* Experience: Between 8 to 12 Years

**What You'll Do**

* Own the end-to-end delivery and performance of cybersecurity services across multiple service domains.
* Manage service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), operational metrics, risks, issues, and escalation processes.
* Act as the primary point of contact for customers, business stakeholders, and service owners regarding security service delivery.
* Coordinate activities across security operations, engineering, infrastructure, cloud, IAM, vulnerability management, and support teams.
* Lead regular service review meetings, governance forums, executive reporting sessions, and customer engagement activities.
* Drive major incident communication, business impact assessments, stakeholder updates, and post-incident reviews.

* Maintain service documentation, operational procedures, audit evidence, compliance records, and reporting frameworks.
* Monitor service quality, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and contractual commitments.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, cost reduction, and service enhancement.
* Track remediation plans, service improvement initiatives, and continuous improvement programs.
* Support audit, compliance, risk management, and governance activities aligned with organizational standards.
* Collaborate with leadership teams to develop service strategies, operational roadmaps, and resource planning initiatives.
* Mentor team members and promote service management best practices across the organization.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* 8-12 years of experience in Security Service Management, IT Service Management, Cybersecurity Operations, or Service Delivery Management.
* Strong experience managing enterprise security services in complex, large-scale environments.
* Deep understanding of ITIL service management practices including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Service Level Management, and Continual Service Improvement.
* Experience managing security domains such as SOC, IAM, Vulnerability Management, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security, Endpoint Security, or Managed Security Services.
* Proven track record of managing SLAs, KPIs, governance forums, customer escalations, and executive stakeholder communications.
* Experience leading service reviews, operational governance meetings, and performance reporting programs.
* Strong understanding of risk management, compliance requirements, audit processes, and security governance practices.
* Experience working with ticketing and service management platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Remedy, or similar tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage complex operational challenges.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Experience driving service transformation, automation, operational excellence, and customer experience improvement initiatives.
* Ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities in fast-paced enterprise environments.
* Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls, ITIL, and COBIT is desirable.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Engineering, Business Management, or a related discipline.
* Certifications such as ITIL v4 Managing Professional, ITIL Expert, CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, PMP, PRINCE2, or COBIT are highly desirable.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies

title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Now Assist-HRSD
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Now Assist & HRSD)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The role of Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of ServiceNow solutions focusing on HR Service Delivery as well as Now Assist capabilities (including AI agents, agentic workflows and now assist skills). In addition, this role would lead implementations to make ServiceNow as an orchestrator to call multiple AI agents within and outside of ServiceNow using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent-to-Agent protocol (A2A) to allow ServiceNow agents to invoke external data sets and APIs.
  
  
The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Implementation expertise of Now Assist capabilities (out of box and custom skills), agentic workflow and AI agents
* Experience in configuring out of box agentic workflows and implementing custom AI agents
* Understanding of A2A and MCP protocols
* Deep functional knowledge of LLMs, agentic patterns and API integration paths (REST)
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of HRSD and ITSM applications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

You will have established a disciplined and transparent approach to managing strategic priorities, strengthened accountability and decision-making, enhanced management and Board reporting, and demonstrated measurable improvements in organizational execution.
  
  
**What We Value**

* Strategic program leadership: Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs and translating strategic priorities into measurable outcomes.
* Analytical and commercial mindset: Ability to interpret complex information and translate data into actionable insights.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

title: Senior CQV Engineer
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area.
  
  
The role will require the leadership of an experienced, energetic, and committed Senior CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals.
  
  
The person should have experience of leading a team of CQV engineers for a project and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle from SLIA generation through to OQ completion. The lead will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations.
* To prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan.
* Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level.
* Track progress of C&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.
* Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities.
* Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards.
* Provide leadership in team meetings and facilitate problem-solving discussions to ensure project milestones are met.
* Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and external vendors to drive project success.
* Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management.
* Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule.
* Well versed with risk-based approaches to C&Q (e.g., ASTM E2500, ISPE)
* Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies.
* Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C&Q.
* Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports.
* Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems.
* Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design.
* Review vendor documents (CTOPs/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements.
* Ensures C&Q non-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner.
* Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews.
* Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site.
* Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction.
* System Startup activities

**Working Conditions**

* The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities.
* Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements.
* Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm., M. Pharm., B.Tech or BE or MSc.
* 10-15 year’s experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing.
* Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects.
* Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project.

**Technical Skills**

* Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis.
* In-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations.
* Experience with process validation and computer system validation.
* Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta-V, 800xA, etc.
* Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage.
* Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Service Parts Program Integrator
description:

The role leads cross-functional collaboration to ensure service-readiness for New Product Introductions (NPIs), to resolve technical obsolescence of service parts, to build a strategy to continue service after end of product sales and to reduce service inventory in anticipation of product End of Guaranteed Service (EOGS). title: Enterprise Solutions Manager
description:
This role combines people leadership with technical ownership. The manager will establish a reliable operating rhythm for the team, set priorities, coach and develop engineers, manage stakeholder expectations, and ensure that enterprise platforms and services are secure, well-documented, measurable, and responsive to business needs.
  
  
The manager will oversee capabilities including Atlassian products, Jira Service Management, Jira Assets, Zendesk, Glean, Power BI, Power Automate, and related enterprise integrations and data workflows.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
People leadership and team management

Portfolio, prioritization, and stakeholder management

* Establish standards for data integrity, security, accessibility, documentation, and report ownership.

Process automation and systems integration

* Identify opportunities to remove manual effort, improve control quality, reduce operational risk, and increase service responsiveness.

Asset management and service operations

* Maintain accurate inventories and ensure alignment with compliance, lifecycle-management, and operational requirements.
* Define service measures, operational reports, escalation paths, and support procedures for Enterprise Solutions services.
* Ensure incidents, problems, requests, changes, and recurring operational work are managed consistently and used to drive improvement.
* Require clear root-cause analysis and corrective actions for material service issues or missed commitments.

Documentation, training, and knowledge management
  
  

* Establish and maintain technical documentation, operating procedures, runbooks, service definitions, and ownership records.
* Ensure the team creates user-focused knowledge articles and delivers training for platform users and stakeholders.
* Build a searchable, current knowledge base that supports onboarding, self-service, continuity, and auditability.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in enterprise applications, business systems, IT operations, systems integration, business intelligence, or a related field.
* 2+ years of experience leading, managing, mentoring, or coordinating technical professionals.

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

title: Lead Business System Analyst - Atlassian Products
description:
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly collaborative and experienced Lead Business Systems Analyst to support and evolve Dolby’s Atlassian ecosystem as we transition from Data Center to Cloud. This role is responsible for partnering with business stakeholders, platform vendor, cross-functional team and engineering teams to design scalable solutions, improve process efficiency, and ensure a smooth migration experience for ~4,000 global users.
  
  
You will work across Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and related marketplace apps to enable agile delivery, knowledge management, incident/service workflows, and reporting. Experience with Atlassian Cloud features, app rationalization, and macro remediation is strongly preferred.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with global teams to gather requirements, assess current usage, and define Cloud platform needs.
* Lead discovery sessions to identify Data Center dependencies, blocked features, and app-to-app replacements.
* Support rationalization decisions around marketplace add-ons (e.g., Reporting, Table Filter, Scaffolding, Comala, ScriptRunner).
* Work closely with vendors on migration planning, macro remediation strategies, and security/compliance impact assessments.
* Lead and manage projects end-to-end, ensuring successful delivery with ownership and accountability.
* Assist in building communication and adoption plans for phased Cloud rollout.
* Design and document Jira workflows, request types, SLAs, forms, and automation rules aligned to operational needs.
* Configure Confluence spaces, templates, permission models, and lifecycle policies.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes using native Cloud automation and integrations.
* Support integration patterns between Atlassian products and platforms like Salesforce, Miro, GitLab, and Microsoft Teams.
* Author FRDs, functional specs, configuration guides, and runbooks.
* Support user acceptance testing and manage hyper-care post-migration.
* Provide recommendations on permission schemes, groups, project roles, issue security, and Confluence space governance.
* Troubleshoot platform issues and work with Atlassian Support to resolve.
* Analyze usage patterns and recommend improvements for adoption and performance.
* Provide training, office hours, and knowledge articles for end users and space/project admins.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.
* 8+ years hands-on experience with Atlassian platforms (Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence).
* Experience with marketplace apps such as:

+ ScriptRunner
+ Comala
+ Table Filter & Charts
+ Scaffolding
+ Aura

* Exposure to migration from Data Center to Cloud (assessment, planning, testing).
* Strong knowledge of Jira workflows, schemes (permissions, issue type, notification), automations, and SLAs.
* Strong functional understanding of Confluence structuring, macros, templates, and permissions.
* Experience documenting requirements, process flows, user stories, test plans, and runbooks.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills across global teams.
* Atlassian certifications ACP-620 and ACP-120.
* Understanding of ITSM frameworks.

**Preferred**

* Prior experience rationalizing or replacing legacy macros.
* Familiarity with API-based integrations (REST).
* Atlassian certifications ACP-420.
* Experience with license optimization and cost containment.

title: Founder's Office - Generalist
description:
12 of the top 15 pharma generic companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.
  
  
Pharma manufacturing is one of the last large industries still running on paper, Excel, and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant.
  
  
Leucine is the AI platform replacing all of it. Series A, backed by top-tier global investors, 60+ pharma enterprises in production, and the team that's going to define this category.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Tackle founder-level problems. Dive into ambiguous questions (e.g., "How do we cut customer onboarding time by 40%?") and deliver a data-backed solution—process, product spec, or growth playbook
* Shadow → Own. Start by shadowing founders and executives across GTM, Product, and Operations, and quickly take ownership of initiatives with significant revenue, customer, or cost impact
* Be the connective tissue. Translate hard manufacturing realities from shop-floor SMEs into crisp product requirements; then turn those into value propositions sales can run with
* Scale what works. Systematize every win—dashboards, SOPs, automations—so the next team member can sprint from day 1
* Rinse, learn, repeat. Each quarter you'll rotate (sales → CS → product → biz ops), compounding domain depth while keeping a 10,000-foot strategic view

**You Might Thrive Here If You**

* Love messy problems. You run towards the smoke, disassemble chaos into first-principles, then rebuild in clean layers of logic & data
* Play in spreadsheets & slides with equal joy. Google Sheets in the morning; crisp narrative memo by lunch; client demo at 4 PM
* Have a bias for action. You'd rather ship v0.1 today and iterate than debate v2.0 for weeks
* Communicate like an engineer and a poet. Precision when the stakes are technical; story when hearts & budgets are on the line
* Are hungry—really hungry. Titles don't impress you; impact does. You measure weeks in learnings shipped
* Bring 1-5 years of high-intensity experience. Early-stage start-up, tier-one consulting, I-banking, ops in manufacturing—anything that shows you can out-execute peers

**Requirements**
**Must-Haves**

* 1-4 years of experience in start-up, consulting, business operations, product, or manufacturing.
* Engineering background from tier 1 / tier 2 colleges
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent Excel/Google Sheets and presentation skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* High ownership, bias for action, and comfort with ambiguity.
* Ability to work cross-functionally across GTM, Product, Operations, and CS.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience working with founders/CXOs or on strategic projects.
* Background in B2B SaaS, manufacturing, pharma/lifesciences, or enterprise tech.
* Experience with SQL, dashboards, automation, or process building.

**Benefits**

* Be part of a fast-growing SaaS company transforming the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing through cutting-edge technology
* Collaborate with a passionate, high-performing team building innovative AI-powered digital solutions
* Take ownership of impactful client implementations from day one, with ample opportunities for learning, career growth, and professional development
* Enjoy a competitive compensation package designed to reward your contributions
* Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry-leading coverage for your peace of mind
* Complimentary Meals & Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
* Family-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments

title: P2P - CI & Transformation Specialist
description:
**Your Job**
As a
**P2P Continuous Improvement & Transformation Specialist**
, you will help drive excellence processes, controls governance, and technology-enabled transformation across the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) value stream. In this role, you will partner with Finance, Procurement, Internal Controls, Product, and Technology teams to identify improvement opportunities, strengthen operational performance, enhance compliance, and support the implementation of innovative digital solutions that create measurable business value.
  
  
**Our Team**
The Invoice-to-Pay (I2P) team is responsible for delivering efficient, compliant, and scalable finance operations that support Koch businesses globally. We work closely with finance leaders, shared service teams, business partners, and technology teams to continuously improve processes, strengthen controls, and leverage automation and digital solutions to improve outcomes for our customers and stakeholders.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across invoice processing, payments, supplier enablement, vendor master data, and exception management processes.
* Identify process inefficiencies, control risks, and automation opportunities through data analysis, benchmarking, and stakeholder engagement.
* Partner with Internal Finance Controls and business stakeholders to strengthen governance, support audits, and drive remediation activities.
* Collaborate with Product and Technology teams to implement workflow enhancements, automation capabilities, AI-enabled solutions, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Translate business requirements, process rules, and control frameworks into functional solution designs and technology improvements.
* Lead and support user acceptance testing (UAT), implementation readiness activities, and successful deployment of new capabilities.
* Develop and maintain governance documentation, SOPs, process maps, control frameworks, and operational standards.
* Monitor and improve key P2P performance metrics using internal targets and external benchmarks to drive measurable business outcomes.
* Support change management, adoption, training, and post-implementation stabilization activities across global teams.
* Build effective partnerships across Finance, Procurement, Treasury, Internal Controls, Business, Product, and Technology organizations to create long-term value.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Technology, or a related discipline.
* 12+ years of experience in Finance Operations, Shared Services, or Global Business Services with strong Procure-to-Pay (P2P) / Invoice-to-Pay (I2P) process experience.
* Experience supporting internal controls, audit programs, remediation activities, evidence validation, and governance requirements.
* Experience leading process improvement, operational excellence, transformation, or automation initiatives within finance operations.
* Working knowledge of SAP or other ERP systems, including workflows, reporting, and business process dependencies.
* Experience defining, monitoring, and improving operational KPIs, service metrics, and performance scorecards.
* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving capabilities.

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Master's degree in a related field or professional certifications such as CPA, CMA, Lean Six Sigma, Agile, or equivalent process improvement certifications.
* Experience with OCR technologies, intelligent automation, workflow solutions, Agentic AI, Sema4 platforms, or similar finance transformation technologies.
* Experience with UAT planning, test scenario development, defect management, deployment readiness, and post-go-live stabilization.
* Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, SQL, PQL, or similar reporting and analytics tools.
* Experience working across global teams in a matrixed business environment.
* Ability to create training materials, change management plans, and knowledge-sharing resources that support sustainable adoption of new processes and technologies.

*At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.*
**Who We Are**
At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. We create value through a growing portfolio of businesses that provide products and services people depend on every day. Guided by our Principle Based Management™ philosophy, we empower employees to challenge the status quo, develop their capabilities, and contribute in meaningful ways.
  
  
At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

title: Product Architect
description:
**We are hiring Principal Data Architect / Product Architect for a global software company based out of chennai. - 15 + years preferred ground from Microsoft, Amazon , Google , or similar enterprise technology/product organizations**

**Domain:**
Enterprise AI | Generative AI | Data Platforms | Cloud SaaS | Product Architecture

**The Role**

We are seeking an accomplished
**Principal Data Architect / Product Architect**
with 15+ years of experience to lead the architecture and technical evolution of next-generation enterprise AI platform.

This role will be responsible for designing scalable, secure, cloud-native AI products and enterprise data architectures, translating complex business requirements into reusable technology platforms that deliver measurable business value.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in modern data architectures, cloud technologies, AI/ML, Generative AI, and enterprise SaaS product development, preferably gained through experience with
**Microsoft, Amazon, Google, or comparable global technology companies.**

The architect will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, and business leadership to define architectural strategy, establish technology standards, and ensure successful platform development and enterprise adoption.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise Data & Product Architecture**

* Define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for enterprise AI platform.
* Design highly scalable, resilient, secure, and modular cloud-native product architectures.
* Establish enterprise data architecture frameworks supporting structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.
* Architect modern data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, data warehouses, and real-time data processing.
* Build reusable platform components, APIs, microservices, integration frameworks, and enterprise data services.
* Ensure architectural alignment between product capabilities, enterprise customer requirements, and long-term technology strategy.

**2. AI/ML & Generative AI Architecture**

* Architect enterprise-grade AI/ML and Generative AI solutions, including LLM-based applications and intelligent AI agents.
* Design Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, vector database integrations, embedding pipelines, and semantic search capabilities.
* Establish AI agent orchestration patterns, model evaluation frameworks, and integration with enterprise workflows.
* Develop solutions to address hallucination reduction, contextual retrieval accuracy, model reliability, and response quality.
* Define scalable MLOps and LLMOps frameworks covering model deployment, monitoring, versioning, governance, and optimization.
* Evaluate foundation models, AI frameworks, and emerging technologies for enterprise product integration.

**3. Cloud & Platform Engineering**

* Lead cloud-native architecture leveraging
  **Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).**
* Design distributed systems, containerized applications, microservices, event-driven architectures, and API-led integrations.
* Establish architectural standards for scalability, performance, availability, security, and cost optimization.
* Guide engineering teams on Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and DevSecOps practices.
* Design secure integration patterns for enterprise applications, data platforms, and third-party services.

**4. Product Architecture & Technology Strategy**

* Partner with Product Management to convert product vision and roadmaps into executable technical architectures.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, technology investments, platform capabilities, and architectural trade-offs.
* Establish reusable product frameworks and domain-specific accelerators to accelerate product development.
* Drive architectural consistency across multiple products, engineering teams, and customer implementations.
* Ensure the platform supports multi-tenancy, extensibility, interoperability, and enterprise-grade security.
* Contribute to technical feasibility assessments, proof-of-concepts, architecture reviews, and product innovation.

**5. Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

* Serve as the principal technical authority for enterprise AI and data platform architecture.
* Collaborate with senior engineering leaders, data scientists, product managers, and enterprise customers.
* Mentor solution architects, data architects, and senior engineers.
* Lead architecture design reviews, technical decision-making, and technology governance.
* Engage with enterprise customers to understand integration requirements, architectural challenges, and deployment considerations.
* Influence technology direction through architectural recommendations and hands-on technical leadership.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

**Overall Experience**

* Minimum 15+ years in software engineering, enterprise architecture, data architecture, or product/platform engineering.
* Significant experience in senior architecture roles involving enterprise-scale products or platforms.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering complex B2B SaaS, AI/ML, or data-driven enterprise platforms.

**Data Architecture & Engineering**

* Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, distributed processing, and data governance.
* Experience with technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent data platforms.
* Expertise in modern data lakehouse architectures and enterprise data integration patterns.

**AI/ML & GenAI**

* Strong understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, RAG, vector databases, and agentic AI architectures.
* Working knowledge of AI orchestration frameworks and model evaluation methods.
* Experience architecting scalable AI-powered applications or products.

**Cloud & Engineering**

* Deep architectural expertise in at least one major hyperscaler: Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Strong knowledge of microservices, REST APIs, distributed systems, Kubernetes, and cloud-native architectures.
* Understanding of enterprise security, identity management, encryption, compliance, and platform observability.

**Product Architecture**

* Experience building reusable, configurable, and scalable enterprise software products rather than exclusively project-specific solutions.
* Ability to translate product requirements into architecture blueprints and technical roadmaps.
* Experience making architectural decisions that balance business value, technical feasibility, security, performance, and cost.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Prior experience working with Microsoft, Amazon or Google is strongly preferred.**
* Experience building commercial AI, SaaS, cloud, or enterprise data products at scale.
* Previous involvement in platform architecture, architecture leadership, or Principal/Distinguished Engineer-level responsibilities.
* Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or similar enterprise AI services.
* Exposure to enterprise GenAI governance, responsible AI, and data privacy frameworks.
* Strong experience collaborating with global engineering and product teams.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

An experienced
**Principal Architect, Enterprise Data Architect, AI Platform Architect, or Product Architect**
who has spent 15+ years designing enterprise technologies and has demonstrated the ability to build scalable cloud and AI-enabled products.

title: Senior Expert, Material Science Project Leader
description:
**Summary**
As a Materials Science Project Lead, you will provide scientific and project leadership for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) crystallization and finishing process-development activities, as well as solid-form activities performed at strategic external partners in India. You will define strategies, provide technical direction, critically evaluate experimental plans and results, and ensure that externally executed work delivers scientifically sound, robust and scalable solutions for our development projects.
  
  
You will apply your subject-matter expertise to direct and scientifically oversee laboratory studies performed by strategic external partners. Your principal technical focus will be crystallization and API finishing processes, including sieving, milling and micronization, with particular emphasis on ensuring successful scale-up from laboratory to pilot-plant and manufacturing environments.
  
  
Based in India, you will be an integral member of our global Materials Science organization and collaborate closely with colleagues and subject-matter experts in India, Switzerland and China. You will combine technical depth with strong external-partner project leadership, ensuring effective scientific alignment, knowledge exchange and delivery across organizational and geographic boundaries.
  
  
As a core contributor to the External Partner and Supply Management Team, you will build effective scientific relationships with strategic external partners, maintain oversight of project execution, and connect externally performed activities with internal project strategies, stakeholders and governance forums. The role may involve travel within India to partner sites according to project needs.
  
  
**About The Role**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead Materials Science activities at strategic external partners in India, defining development strategies, experimental plans for API crystallization and finishing step processes, and solid form development.
* Provide subject-matter expertise in crystallization process optimization, robustness, scale-up and transfer, and in finishing technologies including sieving, milling and micronization.
* Scientifically oversee external laboratory work, critically reviewing protocols, data, conclusions and technical reports, and guiding troubleshooting and risk mitigation.
* Assess particle and powder properties of APIs to ensure suitability for subsequent drug product processing.
* Collaborate with global Materials Science colleagues, represent the function in project and governance forums, and ensure scientific alignment and knowledge exchange.
* Bridge between drug substance and drug product during technical development, whilst ensuring full business alignment with other line functions and project sub-teams.

**Essential Requirements**

* PhD in a relevant scientific or engineering discipline, or a relevant master's degree with minimum 5 years of industry experience. Chemical Engineer with 8-14 years of experience.
* Relevant industrial experience and strong subject-matter expertise in API crystallization and finishing process development including process optimization robustness and scale-up.
* Strong knowledge of sieving, milling or micronization and of relevant particle and powder characterization.
* Experience in planning, overseeing and directing laboratory development activities at external partners, reviewing and assessing data, and turning results into clear technical recommendations
* Ability to provide scientific direction, constructively challenge stakeholders and guide troubleshooting in complex projects.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with strong communication, influencing and cross-cultural collaboration skills.

Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

title: CG Supervisor
description:
Eyeline is a global team of risk takers, innovators and perfectionists who achieve creative visions and have fun doing it. A dynamic workforce nestled within the industry’s most intriguing cities, united by a drive to push the boundaries of storytelling. Learn more.
  
  
The CG Supervisor oversees the day-to-day operations of the show within the facility. They will be responsible for ensuring clear communication to the 3D team within the show, and that the 3D departments deliver on time. Along with the VFX Supervisor, they are responsible for artistic cohesion with the client.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Works directly with the leadership team and other VFX Supervisors to determine and advise technical solutions
* Ensures quality of work is of the highest standards
* Advises and ensures timely delivery of production department assignments and scheduling
* Collaborates with other department managers on dailies, workflow, and pipeline strategies, providing ongoing improvement to processes and methodology
* Responsible for workflow, organization, shot continuity, grain continuity, and quality control metrics
* Will be expected to spot check individual work of other artists and evaluate quality and efficiency of team’s work
* Mentors team members and conducts performance evaluations
* Assesses quality, problem solves, and escalates as needed
* Serves as a key technical expert on shows as well as facility
* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

* Minimum six (6) years of live-action visual effects experience on high profile feature films
* Demonstrates strong technical and leadership capabilities
* Experience in leading, mentoring, and training large teams
* Exceptional artistic skills and organizational skills; understands how to prioritize the necessary tasks and assignments
* Ability to communicate creative and technical thoughts and ideas clearly, verbally, and in written form
* Well rounded working knowledge of the technical and artistic aspects of live-action and visual effects, as well as a deep understanding of CG pipelines
* Experience and knowledge of all 3D areas (modeling, rigging, texturing, look development, character FX, FX, and lighting)
* Keenness to learn Flowline (our proprietary software)
* Ability to take direction positively, work well within a team, and thrive under the pressure of tight deadlines
* Bachelor`s Degree in a relevant field or equivalent
* Experience in 3ds Max

**About Us**
Eyeline is a global creative studio partnering with storytellers to turn their ambitions into stunning reality. By blending the time-honored craft of filmmaking with breakthrough technologies, we unlock bold, cinematic visions at scale. Our three pillars - VFX, Studios and Labs - form the creative spine of Eyeline, guiding how we think, work, and show up in every frame.
  
  
At Eyeline, we believe technology serves artistry and our people are the soul behind everything we do, deepening creative connection, rather than replacing it. We build worlds with exceptional craft and precision, working hand in hand with our creative partners from concept to final pixel.
  
  
Netflix Investment- Eyeline
  
  
With the support of Netflix’s investment in our pipeline, infrastructure, and workforce, we’re pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in visual effects and virtual production technology. In addition to our work with Netflix, we continue to partner with a wide range of long-standing and new clients worldwide.
  
  
Come as you are
  
  
We are looking for those seeking to take risks with us, those driven by passion for their craft. To us, these are key ingredients that we look for in our team. We are committed to ensuring fair and equal treatment of your application. When you apply for a role with us, you will receive consideration based solely on your qualifications.

title: Taleo Principal Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
Your potential has a place here with TTEC's award-winning employment experience. As a Principal Analyst working onsite in Hyderabad, India, you'll be a part of bringing humanity to business. #experienceTTEC
  
  
Our employees have spoken. Our purpose, team, and company culture are amazing and our Great Place to Work® certification in India says it all!
  
  
**Job Title**
**Principal Analyst – Taleo Application (IT Enterprise Solutions)**
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Principal Analyst to own the strategy, configuration, integration, and support of the Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition (ATS) platform. The ideal candidate will bring strong functional command of the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle, deep hands-on expertise across all Taleo modules and features, and proven experience delivering full-cycle Taleo ATS implementations. This role requires a seasoned professional who can independently manage integrations with HRMS/ERP systems, background check providers, job boards, and career sites, while serving as the primary point of contact for stakeholders and external vendors.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
***End-to-End Recruitment Process & Taleo Application Ownership***

* Own and drive functional and technical ownership of the Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition platform across all modules, including Taleo Recruiting (OTAC), Onboarding, Career Sections (internal and external), and Taleo Connect Client (TCC).
* Demonstrate strong functional knowledge of the complete recruitment lifecycle – requisition creation and approval, sourcing, candidate screening, interview scheduling, offer management, background verification, and onboarding – and translate this knowledge into effective Taleo configurations.
* Lead the design, configuration, testing, and rollout of new Taleo features, workflows, and enhancements aligned to evolving recruitment and business needs.
* Provide advanced production support and root-cause troubleshooting for issues related to requisitions, workflows, offers, career sites, and integrations.
* Manage Taleo upgrades, patches, and release cycles, ensuring minimal disruption to live recruitment operations.

***Taleo Connect Client (TCC) & Integrations***

* Serve as the hands-on subject matter expert for Taleo Connect Client (TCC), independently building, testing, scheduling, and troubleshooting inbound/outbound data integrations and exports/imports.
* Design, build, and maintain integrations between Taleo and HRMS/ERP systems, including Oracle ERP/HCM, ensuring seamless data flow for candidate, requisition, and employee records.
* Own integrations with background check providers, job boards/aggregators, and career site platforms, ensuring accurate posting, sourcing, and candidate data exchange.
* Work with XML, CSV, flat-file structures, web services, and APIs to support integration development, monitoring, and error resolution.
* Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance across all integration touchpoints in line with organizational and regulatory requirements.

***Implementation & Project Delivery***

* Independently manage and execute Taleo ATS implementations end-to-end, from requirements gathering and solution design through configuration, testing, cutover, and hypercare support.
* Prepare functional and technical specification documents, configuration workbooks, test scripts, and cutover/rollout plans.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles, coordinate defect resolution, and manage go-live readiness.
* Drive process improvement initiatives to optimize recruitment workflows, system performance, and user experience.

***Stakeholder & Vendor Management***

* Act as the primary liaison between HR, Talent Acquisition, IT, and business leadership to gather requirements and translate them into scalable Taleo solutions.
* Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across geographies, managing expectations, timelines, and priorities effectively.
* Manage relationships with Oracle Taleo support, implementation partners, background check vendors, and job board/career site providers, including contract deliverables, SLAs, and issue escalation.
* Communicate clearly and confidently with technical and non-technical audiences, through written documentation, presentations, and verbal updates to stakeholders and leadership.

***Reporting, Compliance & Mentoring***

* Develop and maintain standard and custom Taleo reports and dashboards to support recruiting metrics, compliance reporting, and executive insights.
* Ensure recruitment processes and system configurations align with applicable compliance requirements (e.g., EEOC, OFCCP, GDPR, and internal audit/SOX controls where applicable).
* Provide technical and functional guidance to junior analysts and HR systems team members, and contribute to knowledge transfer, training, and documentation.

**Required Qualifications**
***Experience***

* 8–12+ years of overall IT/HR systems experience, with a significant portion focused on Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition.
* Proven track record of having managed and executed at least one full-cycle Taleo ATS implementation, in addition to multiple enhancement and support engagements.
* Mandatory hands-on expertise with Taleo Connect Client (TCC), including building and troubleshooting integrations independently.
* Demonstrated experience integrating Taleo with HRMS/ERP platforms (e.g., Oracle ERP/HCM), background check providers, job boards, and career sites.

***Technical & Functional Skills***

* Strong functional command of the end-to-end recruitment process and how it maps to Taleo Recruiting, requisition lifecycle, candidate management, and offer processes.
* In-depth, hands-on knowledge of Taleo application features and functions across Recruiting, Onboarding, and Career Sections.
* Proficiency with XML, CSV, and data integration techniques, along with web services and APIs.
* Experience with Career Section configuration, branding, and localization.
* Strong reporting and analytics capability within the Taleo platform.

***Soft Skills***

* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate, and drive alignment across cross-functional and cross-geography teams.
* Demonstrated vendor management experience, including managing SLAs, escalations, and deliverables with external partners.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and lead initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Oracle Taleo certification(s).
* Experience with Oracle HCM Cloud or Oracle ERP integrations.
* Exposure to global recruiting processes and compliance requirements (GDPR, EEOC, OFCCP).
* Prior experience in large enterprise or global HR/IT environments.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology , Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**What You Can Expect**

* Supportive of your career and professional development
* An inclusive culture and community-minded organization where giving back is encouraged
* A global team of curious lifelong learners guided by our company values
* Ask us about our paid time off (PTO) and wellness and healthcare benefits
* And yes… a great compensation package and performance bonus opportunities, benefits you'd expect and maybe a few that would pleasantly surprise you

**About TTEC**
Our business is about making customers happy. That's all we do. Since 1982, we've helped companies build engaged, pleased, profitable customer experiences powered by our combination of humanity and technology. On behalf of many of the world's leading iconic and hypergrowth brands, we talk, message, text, and video chat with millions of customers every day. These exceptional customer experiences start with you.
  
  
TTEC is proud to be an equal opportunity employer where all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. title: Manager Shared Services
description:
Manager - Governance and Value Realization
  
  
**Who We Are**
FedEx is the largest express transportation company in the world, connecting more than 220 countries and territories. We work every moment to deliver the most important package of someone’s day. Our team of passionate people know their day-to-day work is invaluable in delivering outstanding experience to our customers. 530,000 team members strong, we are as diverse as the world we serve. We love what we do, and we do it well. Our reach is big, and so are our dreams. Join us and let's write our next chapter together.
  
  
**Job Title: Manager - Governance and Value Realization**
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a highly motivated and strategic Manager of Governance and Value Realization to lead our transformation oversight and benefits realization initiatives. This individual will be responsible for developing and implementing governance frameworks and value-tracking strategies that ensure projects deliver their intended financial and operational ROI. The Manager will play a key role in ensuring that changes to business processes, systems, and technology are strategically aligned, rigorously governed, and actively monitored for business value. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in portfolio management, financial analysis, leading high-level project assurances, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement to support overarching organizational goals.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Value Realization & Benefits Tracking: Conduct detailed business case reviews and establish baseline metrics for key changes to people, processes, and technology. Define, monitor, and measure KPI progress against defined financial and operational success metrics. Maintain a portfolio-level view of transformation initiatives to prioritize efforts, track realized value vs. expected ROI, and optimize enterprise impact.
* Project Leadership: Lead high-level cross-functional projects to manage and resolve significant business issues, balancing stakeholder requirements with strategic objectives within quality, time, and budget constraints.
* Governance & Executive Reporting: Design, develop, and manage enterprise governance structures (e.g., Steering Committees, Stage-Gate reviews). Serve in a proactive strategy and oversight role for key functional areas, providing executive management support. Support critical operating areas) by ensuring compliance, managing cross-functional risks, and implementing performance dashboards.
* Stakeholder Management: Act as the single point of contact for project governance, collaborating with stakeholders at all levels to assess strategic alignment, report on portfolio health, and enforce decision-making rights.
* Team Management: Select, train, develop, and motivate a staff of governance analysts, value realization managers, and project managers. Manage the department's operational budget and allocate oversight resources effectively.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Finance or a related discipline.
* MBA or Master's degree in Business Administration of related discipline, Leadership preferred.
* 5-10 years of professional experience in PMO/Portfolio Management, Value Realization, Corporate Governance, Management Consulting, or Finance, with an emphasis on strategic planning and data analysis.

**Certifications**

* Preferred but not required: Project Management Professional (PMP), Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP), or Value Management certifications (e.g., BRMP).

**Desired Skills & Competencies**

* Proven ability to innovate and produce high-quality results on a consistent basis.
* Significant project/process management and organizational change management experience.
* Strong understanding of business and financial planning functions.

title: Senior CQV Engineer
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area.
  
  
The role will require the leadership of an experienced, energetic, and committed Senior CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals.
  
  
The person should have experience of leading a team of CQV engineers for a project and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle from SLIA generation through to OQ completion. The lead will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations.
* To prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan.
* Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level.
* Track progress of C&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.
* Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities.
* Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards.
* Provide leadership in team meetings and facilitate problem-solving discussions to ensure project milestones are met.
* Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and external vendors to drive project success.
* Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management.
* Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule.
* Well versed with risk-based approaches to C&Q (e.g., ASTM E2500, ISPE)
* Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies.
* Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C&Q.
* Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports.
* Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems.
* Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design.
* Review vendor documents (CTOPs/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements.
* Ensures C&Q non-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner.
* Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews.
* Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site.
* Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction.
* System Startup activities

**Working Conditions**

* The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities.
* Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements.
* Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm., M. Pharm., B.Tech or BE or MSc.
* 10-15 year’s experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing.
* Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects.
* Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project.

**Technical Skills**

* Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis.
* In-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations.
* Experience with process validation and computer system validation.
* Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta-V, 800xA, etc.
* Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage.
* Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

description:

title: Founder’s Office Associate (Execution & Strategy)
description:
**About The Role**
Decisions don’t deliver themselves.
  
  
Every growing company has a gap between what leadership decides on Monday and what ships a month later. Priorities get agreed, energy peaks, and then daily fires take over. At Techdome, we’re hiring one person to own that gap.
  
  
You’ll sit beside our CEO and CTO as their execution partner. You’ll turn strategic intent into concrete plans, line up the right owners, and push every initiative to a finished result across Engineering, Marketing, Business Development, and Operations. You’ll also find places where AI and automation can make the whole company faster.
  
  
You’ll be judged on outcomes delivered, not updates sent.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Turn leadership discussions into clear plans with named owners, deadlines, and defined deliverables.
* Run cross-functional initiatives end to end, from decision to delivery, so nothing slips.
* Spot operational bottlenecks early and fix them before they slow teams down.
* Build pitch decks, proposals, and executive briefings that are ready to put in front of clients.
* Join client and business development meetings, and own every follow-up so no opportunity is lost.
* Research markets, competitors, and customers, and turn your findings into recommendations leadership can act on.
* Design and launch AI-powered or automated workflows for research, reporting, documentation, and other recurring work, and track the time saved.
* Take ownership of new strategic and cross-functional projects as priorities change.

**What Success Looks Like**
In the first 30 days, you understand how Techdome operates, have built working relationships across teams, and own your first leadership initiatives.
  
  
By 60 days, you’re running several cross-functional projects at once, producing client and leadership materials, and delivering research that influences real decisions.
  
  
By 90 days, you’re the go-to execution partner for the CEO and CTO, with at least one AI or automation improvement live and saving the team measurable time.
  
  
Overall, leadership priorities consistently get delivered, teams stay aligned, blockers clear fast, and nothing important slips through the cracks.
  
  
**What You Bring**

* 6+ months of experience in a Founder’s Office, Business Operations, Strategy, Business Development, or early-stage startup role
* A record of getting things done in unstructured environments where nobody hands you a playbook
* Strong initiative: you notice problems before anyone asks and act on them
* Comfort with ambiguity and fast-changing priorities
* Solid PowerPoint and Excel/Google Sheets skills, including models that support real decisions
* Daily, hands-on use of AI tools to work faster and better
* Good judgment with confidential information, and the ability to juggle many moving parts
* Strong written and verbal communication

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in a fast-moving startup or founder’s office
* Client-facing or business development exposure
* Working knowledge of Notion, Asana, or Trello
* Familiarity with AI, SaaS, FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, or Enterprise Technology
* Experience building automations with tools like n8n, Zapier, or Make
* An MBA is welcome, but a proven record of execution matters far more than a degree

**Why Join Techdome?**

* Proximity to decisions: work directly with the CEO and CTO and help shape key business choices.
* Unusual breadth: get hands-on with strategy, technology, AI, business development, client relationships, and operations all at once.
* Real ownership: take on a wide scope with the freedom to decide how the work gets done.
* Room to grow: build a path toward senior leadership or strategy roles as your impact grows.

description:

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. * Liaising with internal teams & management groups. Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency

Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes.
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management and reporting. Deliver quality service and ensure all customer demands are met.
* Participates in recruiting efforts and performance management of the existing team. Continually raises the bar.
* Conducts financial analysis and contributes to financial decisions. Procurement for DCEO related expenditure
* Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers.
* Responsible for asset and inventory management.
* Assist in the design and build out of new facilities & multiple projects to increase current facility efficiency. Oversee the build out of Facility-specific infrastructure in existing locations.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Mentorship and Career Growth
