title: Architect / Architectural Project Lead
description:
Architect / Architectural Project Lead

Architectural Design | Site Planning | Permits | Multidisciplinary Coordination | Construction Administration DEPARTMENT EXPERIENCE INDUSTRY / SCOPE Architecture & Development Design

Role Summary Relevant architectural design and project coordination experience; seniority to be confirmed Commercial & Mixed-Use Development / Retail Buildings Whiteland is seeking an Architect / Architectural Project Lead to develop building and site designs and coordinate architectural documentation from concept and schematic design through Plan Approval, permit submissions, working drawings, and construction-stage design support. The role integrates architectural requirements with civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, and landscape consultant information, coordinates tenant and authority-driven revisions, and maintains current drawing packages. The position focuses on architectural design, technical coordination, and architectural construction administration, working alongside the Land Development Planner responsible for land-use approvals and the Construction Project Manager responsible for site execution and delivery.

Key Responsibilities

1. Architectural Concepts & Schematic Design

• Develop architectural concepts, schematic designs, building layouts, and exterior elevations for commercial and mixed-use developments.

• Translate project objectives, contextual design influences, and owner requirements into coordinated building and site proposals.

• Revise designs when ownership, subdivision, property boundaries, or development requirements change and present options for owner review.

2. Architectural Site Plans & Master-Plan Design

• Prepare and revise architectural site plans and master plans showing buildings, property lines, easements, parking, landscaping, and pedestrian connections.

• Review building areas, potential overlaps, setbacks, lot dimensions, uses, proposed lot numbers, and parking requirements against current project information.

• Coordinate accessible and van-accessible parking, bicycle parking, gross parking areas, and related site-design information in the drawing package.

3. Plan Approval, Development & Building Permits

• Prepare architectural site plans, elevations, and supporting drawings for municipal Plan Approval and coordinate design revisions with the planners handling the application.

• Prepare separate Development Permit application drawing packages where required, coordinating architectural and landscape information with civil engineering drawings.

• Prepare or coordinate building and foundation permit packages, submit or support applications, and track circulation and outstanding requirements.

• Respond to approving-authority questions, reissue drawings addressing municipal requirements, and provide Whiteland with permit-status updates.

4. Working Drawings & Multidisciplinary Design Coordination

• Prepare and coordinate architectural working and permit drawings through 50%, 100%, owner-review, and permitsubmission stages.

• Share current CAD reference files and Xrefs, coordinate consultant deliverables, and organize design coordination meetings at key milestones.

• Coordinate civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, and landscape drawings and review information needed for consolidated project packages.

• Identify drawing conflicts and missing information, track consultant responses, and coordinate specialist scope assessments and fee inputs when required.

5. Planning, Subdivision & Survey Interfaces

• Provide planners and surveyors with current PDF and CAD architectural/site plans for subdivision, variance, and other development applications.

• Update plans to reflect proposed lot and property boundaries and coordinate the resulting implications for building placement, parking, and easements.

• Identify potential planning or variance impacts arising from architectural changes and coordinate resolution with the Land Development Planner and survey team.

6. Tenant Design, Architectural Guidelines & Landlord Work

• Coordinate tenant and major-retailer design requirements with Whiteland’s base-building and site designs.

• Review tenant elevations, exterior materials, cladding, and colours against applicable development architectural design guidelines and coordinate requested changes with tenant design teams.

• Integrate approved tenant designs into Plan Approval and Development Permit packages and provide architectural input on landlord work and base-building requirements. 7. Code, Technical Advice & Authority-Driven Revisions

• Provide architectural input on demising walls, roof insulation and alternatives, energy-code considerations, wall ratings, under-slab conditions, floor drains, and related design-development questions within the assigned professional scope.

• Coordinate architectural, civil, structural, and building-system revisions arising from municipal, utility, and other authority requirements.

• Refer discipline-specific engineering matters to the responsible consultants and incorporate their confirmed requirements into coordinated documentation.

8. Construction-Stage Architectural Administration

• Review and respond to design-related Requests for Information (RFIs), issue architectural clarifications and supplementary instructions, and coordinate required drawing revisions.

• Prepare and circulate Proposed Change Notices (PCNs), obtaining contractor pricing and any resulting schedule impact before a Change Order is issued through the designated approval process.

• Coordinate and document architectural, structural, civil, electrical, and other building-system changes arising during construction.

• Work with the Construction Project Manager and responsible consultants to clarify design intent while keeping construction execution and commercial approvals with the designated parties. 9. Drawing Control, Distribution & Stakeholder Meetings

• Maintain current architectural drawing sets, site plans, permit packages, consultant information, and issued revisions with clear issue dates and revision references.

• Distribute appropriate drawing versions to Whiteland, contractors, planners, surveyors, tenants, and other project consultants and retain issued-document records.

• Participate in architectural and design coordination meetings, document decisions and outstanding actions, and follow up with the responsible project parties. Required Qualifications

• Relevant architectural education and experience appropriate to the appointed role; professional registration and authorization requirements for the Architect title and assigned services to be confirmed for the project jurisdictions.

• Experience developing architectural concepts, site plans, building layouts, elevations, and coordinated permit and working drawings.

• Experience coordinating civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, and landscape consultants and responding to municipal drawing requirements.

• Ability to assess architectural code and technical issues within the assigned professional scope and coordinate specialist advice where required.

• Proficiency with architectural CAD/drawing tools, reference-file coordination, PDF review, and drawing version control.

• Strong design communication, documentation, multidisciplinary coordination, and deadline-management skills. Preferred Skills

• Experience with commercial retail units, mixed-use developments, major-retailer design requirements, and development architectural guidelines.

• Familiarity with Plan Approval, Development Permit, foundation permit, and building permit coordination.

• Exposure to subdivision-related design changes, accessible parking layouts, easements, and planner/surveyor interfaces.

• Experience managing RFIs, supplementary instructions, PCNs, and multidisciplinary construction-stage drawing revisions. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Timely delivery of schematic, 50%, 100%, owner-review, and permit drawing packages against agreed design milestones.

• Completeness and coordination of architectural and consultant packages, with drawing conflicts and missing requirements tracked to resolution.

• Timely responses to municipal, owner, tenant, and consultant comments and clear reporting of outstanding permit requirements.

• Consistency of architectural plans with current property boundaries, tenant requirements, approved elevations, and design guidelines.

• Timely RFI and clarification responses and complete PCN records, including pricing, schedule impacts, and required approvals.

• Accuracy and currency of issued drawing registers, revision records, and project-team distributions. Reporting Structure Reporting manager, project portfolio, professional registration requirements, and delegated design/change approval authority to be confirmed. The role works with Whiteland’s management, development, planning, leasing, and construction teams and external consultants. Land-use entitlement and public planning processes are coordinated with the Land Development Planner; contractor execution, site costs, deficiencies, and delivery schedules are coordinated with the Construction Project Manager. Professional design responsibility, signing, and certification follow the assigned scope and appropriate authorization; financial and contractual commitments remain with authorized decision-makers. Role Objective To translate Whiteland’s development objectives into coordinated architectural and site designs, complete approval and permit documentation, and clear construction-stage design information through effective consultant integration, tenant and authority coordination, disciplined change documentation, and reliable drawing control.

title: Head of Transformation, Field Operations
description:
**About The Team**
The Strategy and Transformation team for the Field Operations organization at Uber sets the vision and strategy for Field Ops, runs agent operations, undertakes our most complex and transformative projects, and drives the optimization of our global operations. We execute this future-state vision across five core pillars: Special Projects, Strategy and Programs, Business Planning and Improvement, Transformation, and Analytics. Within Transformation, we act as the catalyst for large-scale structural change, redefining our operating models, optimizing our global footprint, and fostering a high-performance culture that empowers our globally distributed workforce to thrive.
  
  
**About The Role**
As the Head of Transformation, you will lead the Transformation Office for the entire Field Ops organization. You will be the central force driving our most critical organizational shifts, taking ownership of key workstreams spanning our footprint, operating model, people, technology, and culture.
  
  
In this highly visible leadership role, you will set the overarching agenda and narrative for the transformation, ensuring alignment across the business. You will build the robust tracking and reporting infrastructure necessary to measure success and define the target culture that underpins our future state. Operating in a highly matrixed environment, you will manage complex, interdependent initiatives involving multiple internal and external stakeholders. You are a seasoned leader with exceptional executive presence, capable of influencing senior management and driving large-scale change across a highly distributed global network.
  
  
This is not a traditional PMO or program management role. We are looking for a leader who can combine strategic thinking with operational execution—someone who can define the future state, influence executive stakeholders, and personally lead complex transformation initiatives from concept through implementation.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Transformation Office Leadership: Direct the central Transformation Office, overseeing end-to-end strategy and execution for core workstreams including footprint, operating model, people, tech, and culture.
* Agenda & Narrative Setting: Define the strategic agenda and author the overarching transformation narrative, ensuring clear alignment and purpose across the organization.
* Culture Definition: Set the target culture and cultural narrative, ensuring structural changes are supported by the right behaviors and mindsets.
* Infrastructure & Tracking: Build and manage a rigorous tracking, reporting, and governance infrastructure to monitor the health and progress of all transformational initiatives.
* Stakeholder & Executive Influence: Manage complex, highly interdependent cross-functional initiatives, leveraging strong reporting and influencing abilities to align senior management and diverse stakeholders.
* Drive AI & Technology Transformation: Partner across Product, Engineering, and Operations to identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and technology to reduce manual work, improve operational efficiency, and enable scalable growth.

**Basic Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's or Postgraduate degree.
* 12+ years of professional experience, with at least 5+ years specifically dedicated to leading large-scale change and transformation programs in a large, distributed organization.
* Must Have: Prior management consulting experience combined with a background in direct operating roles.

**Preferred Experience**

* Led enterprise-wide operating model transformations within complex global organizations.
* Experience driving productivity, cost optimization, or organizational effectiveness programs.
* Built governance models for multi-workstream transformation portfolios.
* Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience partnering directly with C-level executives or executive steering committees.
* Experience leading change management and organizational capability-building initiatives.

**Ready to Ride?**
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.
  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

**Role**
**Category Lead – Financial services and payments**
**Job Level / Designation**
General Manager / Band M3
  
  
**Function / Department**
Digital – Partnerships & Growth
  
  
**Location**
Corporate Office, Mumbai
  
  
**Context for the new role**
Vi Finance is a strategic growth agenda to bring relevant financial propositions for Vi’s captive customer base. The business will operate through a partnership-led model, bringing credible banks, NBFCs and fintechs onto the Vi platform across lending, cards, deposits and payments. Personal Loans will be the anchor portfolio within the broader Vi Finance proposition.
  
  
The immediate priority is to establish a high-quality, compliant multi-lender Personal Loan proposition: identify and onboard credible lending partners, define the right operating and commercial model, build seamless customer journeys, launch the go-to-market, and scale disbursals profitably. The role therefore requires a techno-commercial leader who can combine lender partnerships, product and platform execution, funnel analytics, regulatory governance and P&L ownership.
  
  
**Proposal**
We propose to appoint a Category Lead – Vi Finance to build and scale the Financial Services & Payments business, with Personal Loans as the primary growth portfolio.
  
  
The incumbent will first create a credible lender network and take partners from evaluation to launch readiness across commercials, contracting, API integration, information security, compliance and operating SLAs. Thereafter, the individual will define and execute the GTM, optimise the end-to-end funnel, expand distribution across Vi channels, build new platform capabilities, and scale disbursals and revenue while maintaining portfolio quality and sustainable unit economics.
  
  
The role will continuously benchmark Vi Finance against best-in-class lending and fintech platforms, translate market insights into a prioritised capability roadmap, and deliver customer adoption, conversion, disbursals, incremental revenue, partner productivity and customer experience in line with the annual operating plan.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
**Build and scale Vi Finance as a trusted, partnership-led financial-services platform, with primary ownership of Personal Loans. Create a differentiated multi-lender proposition, deliver a seamless customer experience, and drive profitable growth in adoption, disbursals and revenue.**
**Key Result Areas / Accountabilities**
**Product and Growth**

* Own the end-to-end vision, business plan and roadmap for Vi Finance, with Personal Loans as the principal focus alongside Credit Cards, Fixed Deposits, Payments and adjacent propositions.
* Build a scalable multi-lender Personal Loan platform by defining lender-selection criteria and onboarding credible banks and NBFCs and work across commercials, legal agreements, APIs, Design team, information security, compliance, etc. to define SLAs and create launch readiness.
* Design and execute the GTM across Vi digital assets, partner with CVM, retail & mass retail distribution and appoint channel partner; establish the proposition, segmentation, communication, offer architecture and acquisition playbook.
* Own the complete lending funnel from eligibility and pre-qualified leads through application, approval and disbursal; use funnel, cohort and lender-level analytics to improve conversion, approval rates and lead quality.
* Manage lender mix, commercials, CAC, unit economics and portfolio P&L to balance customer scale, partner productivity, portfolio health and profitability.
* Benchmark leading fintech and lending platforms, identify customer-experience and technology gaps, and prioritize capabilities such as multi-lender routing, straight-through processing, decisioning, experimentation, reporting and partner governance.
* Lead zero-to-one launches and subsequent scale-up of adjacent financial-services and payment categories in line with the portfolio strategy.

**New Partnerships & Business Development**
Develop and manage a high-quality ecosystem of banks, NBFCs, fintechs and payment partners. Create a structured partner-evaluation framework covering customer fit, scale, approval and fulfilment capability, economics, technology readiness, data security and regulatory compliance. Negotiate commercials and contracts, establish partner governance and performance scorecards, resolve integration and operating dependencies, give visibility to leadership team, keep evolving the finance business roadmap and maintain a pipeline of prospective partners to strengthen proposition breadth and resilience.
  
  
**Other Tasks**

* Translate the business blueprint into prioritized customer journeys, platform requirements and a sequenced delivery roadmap.
* Lead cross-functional execution with Product, Technology, Analytics, CVM, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, InfoSec, Finance, Customer Service and Retail teams.
* Create points of ingress across Vi App, web, CVM, prepaid and postpaid journeys, generate top of the funnel from the retail touchpoints and partner ecosystems.
* Plan and run performance campaigns, experiments and tailored offers to drive qualified traffic, application starts, approvals and disbursals.
* Establish daily and monthly MIS covering funnel conversion, lender performance, customer cohorts, CAC, revenue, unit economics, SLA adherence and customer experience.
* Institute compliance-by-design and operating governance in line with applicable RBI digital-lending requirements, data-privacy standards and Vi policies.
* Review performance, identify bottlenecks and lead course corrections with partners and internal teams to deliver the annual operating plan.
* Provide leadership with market intelligence, competitor benchmarks, forward-looking risks and recommendations for the next phase of growth.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Personal Loans: active lender count, lead volumes, application-to-disbursal conversion, approval rate, monthly disbursals and revenue.
* Economics: CAC, revenue per disbursal, contribution margin, partner payouts and portfolio P&L.
* Execution: time to onboard and launch partners, API and journey delivery milestones, SLA adherence and funnel improvements.
* Customer: adoption, repeat engagement, journey completion, complaint rate and NPS.
* Broader portfolio: customers, transactions, GMV and revenue across Cards, Deposits and Payments.

**Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience**
Demonstrated experience in digital lending, preferably building or scaling a multi-lender LSP or marketplace model. Strong lender-partnership and business-development capability across banks and NBFCs, including commercial negotiation, contracting, API integrations, InfoSec, compliance and operating governance. Deep understanding of Personal Loan funnels, credit journeys, customer segmentation, cohort analytics, CAC/LTV, unit economics and P&L. Working knowledge of RBI Digital Lending Guidelines, data privacy and partner-risk management. Proven ability to lead zero-to-one launches, scale GTM across large consumer ecosystems, benchmark best-in-class practices and influence senior stakeholders while leading large cross-functional teams.
  
  
Preferred profile: 7–12 years across fintech, banks, NBFCs or large digital ecosystems, with meaningful ownership of Personal Loans, lender partnerships, digital product or platform delivery, analytics-led growth and business planning.
  
  
**Must Have Technical / Professional Qualifications**
MBA preferred
  
  
**Years Of Experience**
07-12 years
  
  
**Industries to look from**
Financial services, Fintech, NBFC & Banks
  
  
**Ideal Organizations to look from**
Paytm, PhonePe, Gpay, TataNeu, Airtel Finance etc.
  
  
**Team Size**
Individual contributor
  
  
**Business Size**
INR 100 Cr+ revenue
  
  
**Vodafone Idea Limited**
(formerly Idea Cellular Limited)
  
  
An Aditya Birla Group & Vodafone partnership

title: E-Commerce And Marketplace Business Manager
description:
Job Title: E-commerce & Marketplace Business Manager

Company: Really Agritech Private Limited

Location: Kolshet Road, Thane West, Maharashtra

Department: Sales / E-commerce & Marketplace Business

Reporting To: Sales Head / Directors

Experience: 3–5 years

Compensation: Competitive salary based on experience and profile relevance, plus performance-based incentives.

About Really Agritech

Really Agritech Private Limited is engaged in the import, distribution and supply of agricultural machinery and equipment across India through an extensive B2B dealer and distributor network. Our product portfolio includes brush cutters, power weeders, sprayers, chainsaws, water pumps, cultivators and various other agricultural machinery and equipment.

As part of our next phase of growth, we are expanding our presence across B2B and B2C online marketplaces, aggregators and e-commerce platforms.

Role Overview

We are looking for a commercially driven and experienced E-commerce & Marketplace Business Manager to lead and expand our marketplace business.

The candidate will be responsible for managing existing marketplace partnerships, onboarding new platforms and business partners, driving online sales, managing marketplace advertising budgets, monitoring business performance and building a team to handle day-to-day marketplace operations.

The role requires a combination of marketplace operations, business development, digital marketing, commercial understanding and team leadership.

Key Responsibilities

1. Marketplace Operations & Management

\* Manage existing B2B aggregators and marketplaces, including Toolsvilla, Agrim, Shoption, Moglix and other relevant platforms.

\* Manage B2C marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart and other suitable e-commerce platforms.

\* Oversee product listings, catalogue creation, product descriptions, images, pricing, specifications, keywords and product categorisation.

\* Ensure accurate and timely updates of product information, inventory, pricing, offers and availability across platforms.

\* Monitor orders, dispatch coordination, cancellations, returns, customer complaints, claims and marketplace service-level requirements.

\* Coordinate with internal sales, warehouse, logistics, accounts and customer service teams to ensure smooth operations.

2. Business Development & Platform Onboarding

\* Identify, evaluate and onboard new B2B aggregators, e-commerce marketplaces, online retailers and strategic channel partners.

\* Develop relationships with marketplace category managers, business development teams and key account managers.

\* Negotiate commercial terms, commissions, margins, payment cycles, promotional support and other partnership conditions within company policy.

\* Evaluate new platforms based on customer reach, sales potential, commercial viability and strategic relevance.

\* Prepare business proposals and expansion plans for management approval.

\* Develop and execute plans to grow revenue from existing and newly onboarded partners.

3. Marketplace Advertising & Performance Marketing

\* Plan, execute and optimise advertising campaigns on Amazon, Flipkart and other platforms wherever advertising facilities are available.

\* Manage sponsored listings, keyword campaigns, promotional campaigns and platform-specific advertising tools.

\* Analyse advertising performance using relevant metrics such as sales, impressions, clicks, conversion rate, advertising cost of sales (ACoS), return on ad spend (ROAS) and customer acquisition cost, where applicable.

\* Allocate and monitor advertising budgets, ensuring expenditure remains within approved limits.

\* Identify high-performing products, optimise campaigns and recommend improvements to increase profitable sales.

\* Monitor campaign outcomes and prepare regular performance reports.

4. Sales Growth & Commercial Management

\* Develop platform-wise and product-wise sales plans, revenue targets and growth strategies.

\* Monitor gross margins, marketplace commissions, logistics costs, advertising expenses, returns and other variable costs to assess profitability.

\* Analyse pricing, competitor activity, product demand and marketplace trends.

\* Identify opportunities to improve product visibility, conversion rates, average order value and repeat business.

\* Ensure marketplace pricing, discounting and promotional activities comply with company policies and approved commercial terms.

\* Track outstanding payments, settlement discrepancies, deductions, claims and reconciliation with the accounts team.

5. Inventory, Order & Supply Chain Coordination

\* Monitor stock availability and inventory accuracy across all active platforms.

\* Coordinate with warehouse and dispatch teams to maintain adequate stock and fulfil orders within committed timelines.

\* Prevent stock-outs, overselling, unnecessary inventory accumulation and avoidable cancellations.

\* Forecast product demand based on historical sales, seasonality, campaigns and planned promotions.

\* Coordinate returns, damaged goods, replacement requirements and inventory reconciliation.

6. Team Building & Leadership

\* Build, train and manage a dedicated marketplace operations team as the business expands.

\* Allocate responsibilities for catalogue management, inventory updates, order processing, advertising, reporting and partner coordination.

\* Establish clear responsibilities, operating procedures, productivity measures and performance targets.

\* Review team performance regularly and ensure timely completion of daily operational activities.

\* Develop a scalable operating structure that can support an increasing number of platforms and SKUs.

7. Reporting & Management Reviews

\* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reports covering platform-wise sales, orders, inventory, returns, advertising spend and business performance.

\* Track revenue, gross margin, contribution after variable costs, marketplace commissions and advertising ROI.

\* Maintain a pipeline of prospective platforms and report onboarding progress.

\* Highlight operational issues, commercial risks and growth opportunities to the Sales Head and Directors.

\* Recommend corrective actions and business expansion initiatives based on data and performance analysis.

Required Qualifications & Experience

\* 3–5 years of relevant experience in e-commerce marketplace management, online business operations or marketplace account management.

\* Demonstrated hands-on experience with both B2B aggregators/marketplaces and B2C e-commerce platforms.

\* Practical knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub and relevant marketplace or aggregator portals.

\* Proven experience in managing product catalogues, inventory, orders, pricing, returns and account performance.

\* Experience in planning and optimising marketplace advertising campaigns and managing budgets.

\* Ability to analyse sales, advertising performance, margins and profitability using Excel or Google Sheets.

\* Previous experience managing, supervising or building a team.

\* Experience in onboarding new marketplaces, negotiating commercial terms and developing business partnerships.

\* Strong coordination, communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills.

\* Ability to work with multiple departments and manage a large product catalogue.

Preferred Qualifications

\* Experience in agricultural machinery, industrial equipment, tools, hardware, automotive products or other technical product categories.

\* Experience managing large catalogues with multiple SKUs.

\* Understanding of marketplace settlements, commissions, returns, claims and reconciliation.

\* Familiarity with marketplace analytics, inventory management systems, ERP or order management systems.

\* Experience in scaling an online business from an initial stage to a structured, team-led operation.

Performance Expectations

The successful candidate will be expected to:

\* Grow revenue from existing marketplace partners.

\* Onboard new platforms and commercially viable business partners.

\* Improve catalogue quality, inventory accuracy and order fulfilment.

\* Generate profitable sales through effective marketplace advertising.

\* Maintain control over marketplace expenses, commissions and promotional budgets.

\* Build and manage a capable team for daily operations.

\* Establish a scalable and measurable marketplace business for Really Agritech.

Compensation & Application

Compensation: Competitive fixed salary based on experience and profile relevance, plus performance-based incentives.

Work Location: Kolshet Road, Thane West, Maharashtra.

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at:

Email: hr@reallyagritech.com

Contact: +91 89280 21959

Please mention “E-commerce & Marketplace Business Manager” in the subject line of your application.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence
description: Pepper (https://www.pepper.inc/) is an AI-native marketing services company redefining how enterprise brands scale organic growth through a unified blend of strategy, creative talent, technology, and automation. We are building an AI-powered marketing services engine that seamlessly combines top global creative talent with proprietary workflows and automation to deliver measurable, scalable outcomes for modern CMOs.Our platform and services bring together content, data, talent, and AI to help brands plan, create, manage, distribute, and measure high-impact marketing programs and all on one intelligent system designed for enterprise growth and efficiency.Role OverviewWe're hiring an Entrepreneur in Residence (EIR) into the Founder's Office at Pepper.This is not a strategy seat. It's an operating seat.We're looking for someone who has already carried the weight of a business. A founder who built and ran something, or an operator who has owned Ops, Strategy, or Customer Success end-to-end and been accountable for the number at the bottom. You'll work alongside the Founder/CEO and the central Centre of Excellence (COE) team, and you'll be handed the problems that matter most and are least defined: a business line that needs to be rebuilt, a function that needs an owner, a market that needs to be cracked, a manual process that needs to become an AI-first one.You won't be given a playbook. You'll be expected to write one, run it, prove it works, and then hand it to someone else so you can go take the next thing.Base location: Mumbai (in-office)Shift: 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM ISTWhat You'll OwnTake a business problem from zero to working. You'll be handed ambiguous, high-stakes mandates, a new revenue line, a broken unit economic, an underperforming segment, a market entry and own them outright. Diagnosis, plan, build, launch, iterate, results.Run functions that don't have an owner yet. Where something is founder-led, ad-hoc, or held together by heroics, you step in as interim owner: build the team, the process, and the metrics, stabilise it, then hand it over.Rebuild how work gets done with AI. Identify the highest-leverage workflows across Ops, CS, Delivery and GTM, and rebuild them AI-first. Partner with product and engineering to ship, then hold yourself to measurable impact on cost, speed, margin, and quality.Own customer outcomes where it counts. Get into live accounts — especially US enterprise — understand why customers stay or churn, fix retention and expansion mechanics at the root, and turn what you learn into product and process.Build the operating layer. Definitions, dashboards, reviews, and cadences that make performance legible. If the Founder can't see what's working within 24 hours of asking, that's your problem to fix.Be a genuine second pair of hands for the Founder. Diligence, fundraising material, pricing experiments, partnership evaluation, board prep, escalations — whatever the quarter demands.Build the bench. Hire, coach, and hand off. Success in this role is measured partly by how many things you've made someone else's job.What We're Looking For6–10 years of experience, with at least one of the following as your core story:You founded and ran a company. You raised or bootstrapped, hired, sold, shipped, and made payroll. Whether it exited, scaled, or shut down matters less than what you carried and what you learned.You've owned Ops, Strategy, or Customer Success at a high-growth company. A real function with a team, a budget, and a number you were held to. Not a supporting role in oneFull-stack operating range. You can build the model, write the deck, sit in the QBR, debug the process, and get on the phone with an unhappy customer all in the same day. No task is beneath you and no problem is above you.Comfort with ambiguity that would paralyse most people. You're handed a sentence, not a brief. You come back with a plan.Commercial instinct. You think in margin, CAC, retention, and payback and not just activity and output.A real point of view on AI. You use LLMs, agents, and automation platforms daily, and you have an argument about how they change the shape of a services and marketplace business. Bonus if you've actually deployed AI into production workflows and can talk about what broke.Bias for shipping. A working v1 beats a perfect plan. You'd rather be corrected by the market than by a meeting.Sharp, structured communication. You can write a one-pager the board reads without questions, and a brief a frontline team can execute without a follow-up call.High ownership, low ego. You chase the hundredth detail without losing the plot, and you don't need credit to do the work.Prior exposure to US customers or teams is a strong plus.

title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Now Assist-HRSD
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Now Assist & HRSD)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The role of Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of ServiceNow solutions focusing on HR Service Delivery as well as Now Assist capabilities (including AI agents, agentic workflows and now assist skills). In addition, this role would lead implementations to make ServiceNow as an orchestrator to call multiple AI agents within and outside of ServiceNow using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent-to-Agent protocol (A2A) to allow ServiceNow agents to invoke external data sets and APIs.
  
  
The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Implementation expertise of Now Assist capabilities (out of box and custom skills), agentic workflow and AI agents
* Experience in configuring out of box agentic workflows and implementing custom AI agents
* Understanding of A2A and MCP protocols
* Deep functional knowledge of LLMs, agentic patterns and API integration paths (REST)
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of HRSD and ITSM applications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Enterprise Solutions Manager
description:
This role combines people leadership with technical ownership. The manager will establish a reliable operating rhythm for the team, set priorities, coach and develop engineers, manage stakeholder expectations, and ensure that enterprise platforms and services are secure, well-documented, measurable, and responsive to business needs.
  
  
The manager will oversee capabilities including Atlassian products, Jira Service Management, Jira Assets, Zendesk, Glean, Power BI, Power Automate, and related enterprise integrations and data workflows.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
People leadership and team management
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop Enterprise Solutions Engineers in India and across the broader team.
* Set clear goals, ownership, service expectations, and development plans for each team member.
* Establish team standards for communication, documentation, quality, delivery, and operational follow-through.
* Run regular one-on-ones, team meetings, planning sessions, and performance reviews.
* Build accountability for commitments while creating a collaborative and supportive team environment.
* Recruit, onboard, mentor, and retain Enterprise Solutions talent.
* Coordinate knowledge transfer, coverage, succession planning, and cross-training so critical services do not depend on a single individual.

Portfolio, prioritization, and stakeholder management
  
  

* Own the Enterprise Solutions team backlog and prioritize work across operational support, projects, platform improvements, automation, reporting, and strategic initiatives.
* Translate business needs into clear requirements, delivery plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for Enterprise Solutions work and communicate status, risks, dependencies, and decisions to leadership.
* Establish and maintain an operating rhythm for intake, prioritization, delivery tracking, service reviews, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Corporate Support, Product Engineering, Data & AI, Information Security, Finance, Human Resources, and business stakeholders.
* Ensure commitments are realistic, visible, and delivered with appropriate quality and documentation.

Enterprise platform ownership
  
  

* Provide governance and technical direction for Atlassian products, Jira Service Management, Zendesk, Glean, Power BI, Power Automate, Jira Assets, and related platforms.
* Ensure platforms are configured, administered, monitored, and improved as reliable enterprise services.
* Establish platform roadmaps, lifecycle plans, access controls, configuration standards, and service documentation.
* Oversee provisioning, configuration, troubleshooting, vendor coordination, and platform changes.
* Ensure platform administration follows security, compliance, change-management, and data-protection requirements.

AI adoption and enablement
  
  

* Lead the assessment, piloting, implementation, governance, and adoption of AI tools such as Glean, Claude, Cursor, and Fellow.ai.
* Identify and document business cases for AI integration and measure adoption, productivity, quality, and business outcomes.
* Establish practical standards, workflows, training, and compliance procedures for responsible AI use.
* Coach the team to use AI-assisted development and automation tools responsibly to improve delivery speed and quality.

Enterprise data management and business intelligence
  
  

* Oversee the design, management, and optimization of Power BI dataflows, reports, dashboards, and supporting data processes.
* Ensure reporting requirements are translated into accurate, maintainable, and actionable business intelligence solutions.
* Establish standards for data integrity, security, accessibility, documentation, and report ownership.
* Coordinate the transition and modernization of reporting infrastructure, including potential migration toward Snowflake and partnership with the Data & AI team.

Process automation and systems integration
  
  

* Direct automation of business processes within Jira Service Management and other enterprise platforms.
* Oversee integrations using Power Automate, APIs, Python, and other middleware or automation technologies.
* Identify opportunities to remove manual effort, improve control quality, reduce operational risk, and increase service responsiveness.
* Ensure automation is tested, documented, monitored, supportable, and governed through appropriate change controls.

Asset management and service operations
  
  

* Oversee asset-management practices using Jira Assets, including hardware, software, application, service, and ownership records.
* Maintain accurate inventories and ensure alignment with compliance, lifecycle-management, and operational requirements.
* Define service measures, operational reports, escalation paths, and support procedures for Enterprise Solutions services.
* Ensure incidents, problems, requests, changes, and recurring operational work are managed consistently and used to drive improvement.
* Require clear root-cause analysis and corrective actions for material service issues or missed commitments.

Documentation, training, and knowledge management
  
  

* Establish and maintain technical documentation, operating procedures, runbooks, service definitions, and ownership records.
* Ensure the team creates user-focused knowledge articles and delivers training for platform users and stakeholders.
* Build a searchable, current knowledge base that supports onboarding, self-service, continuity, and auditability.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in enterprise applications, business systems, IT operations, systems integration, business intelligence, or a related field.
* 2+ years of experience leading, managing, mentoring, or coordinating technical professionals.
* Proven hands-on experience with enterprise platforms such as Atlassian products, Jira Service Management, Zendesk, Power BI, and AI tools such as Glean or Claude.
* Experience managing a team backlog, setting priorities, coordinating delivery, and communicating status to senior stakeholders.
* Competence in data modeling, ETL, reporting, and dashboard development, including Power BI and preferably Python or SQL.
* Demonstrated ability to automate and integrate systems and business processes using Power Automate, APIs, scripting, or middleware.
* Experience supporting asset-management solutions such as Jira Assets or comparable platforms.
* Strong understanding of access management, information security, data protection, change management, and operational controls.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with US-based and globally distributed teams.
* Demonstrated ability to create clear documentation, facilitate training, and establish repeatable operating practices.
* Strong judgment, problem-solving, prioritization, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Experience administering or leading an Atlassian ecosystem, including Jira, Confluence, and Jira Service Management.
* Experience with Zendesk administration, reporting, workflows, or platform transitions.
* Experience with Glean, Claude, Cursor, Fellow.ai, or comparable enterprise AI platforms.
* Experience with Power BI dataflows, Power Automate, Python, SQL, REST APIs, or similar integration technologies.
* Experience leading platform migrations, service consolidations, or enterprise operating-model improvements.
* Experience in financial technology, wealth management, or another regulated industry.
* Familiarity with vendor management, licensing, service-level reporting, and technology portfolio planning.

Success in the first 12 months
  
  

* A clear team structure, ownership model, backlog, and operating rhythm are in place.
* Each Enterprise Solutions Engineer has defined responsibilities, goals, development priorities, and backup coverage.
* Critical Atlassian, Power BI, Power Automate, Zendesk, Glean, and Jira Assets services have documented owners, procedures, and escalation paths.
* Reporting and service metrics are reliable, visible, and reviewed regularly.
* The team has reduced dependency on individual knowledge through documentation, cross-training, and repeatable processes.
* Priority automation and platform-improvement initiatives are delivered with measurable operational or business impact.
* Stakeholders experience predictable communication, clear prioritization, and improved responsiveness from Enterprise Solutions.

title: QA Lead
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
  
  
**About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)**
Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a “100,000-year data gap” - the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments - kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes - to capture the high-fidelity task data that the world’s leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more here.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Lead Workforce & Operations: Drive day-to-day workforce management for Clippers, Graders, Regraders, SMEs, and ICs across shifts/sites, optimizing staffing, capacity planning, and throughput against SLA targets.
* Implement Quality Systems & Methods: Maintain the QMS and apply structured methods (RCA, CAPA, FMEA, 8D, SPC) to address recurring defects, calibration drift, gold-sample injections, and consensus checks.
* Own SOPs & Process Standards: Build, version-control, and continuously iterate SOPs for existing and new program launches, ensuring floor adoption and structured QA onboarding/re-calibration paths.
* Bridge Cross-Functional Teams: Translate engineering data requirements into floor-executable QA criteria, report field issues back with evidence, and represent QA in program launches and crisis calls.
* Drive Data-Led Quality: Monitor and analyze key QA metrics—defect/reject rates, inter-grader agreement (kappa), gold-sample pass rates, yield, and escalation volume—to root out quality degradation with data.

What we’re looking for
  
  

* Distributed QA/QC Leadership: Proven experience managing large or dispersed grading/QA teams across multiple shifts or sites.
* Quality Methods Depth: Strong working command and practical application of RCA, CAPA, FMEA, 8D, SPC, and QMS frameworks.
* Analytical & Data-Driven Mindset: Proven track record of building and interpreting quality dashboards, interrogating metrics, and quantifying operational trade-offs.
* Stakeholder & Communication Skills: Clear, structured communication skills across all levels—upward to leadership, cross-functionally with engineering, and directly to floor teams.
* Hands-on, High Ownership: A proactive problem-solver who thrives on the floor building processes and tackling operational challenges directly, rather than just administering them.

What success looks like
  
  

* QA metrics (defect rates, inter-grader agreement/kappa, gold-sample pass rates) show clear, measurable improvement across all programs.
* Quality issues and calibration drifts are caught early, analyzed via structured methods (RCA/CAPA/8D), and systematically resolved.
* SOPs are systematically updated, version-controlled, and seamlessly adopted on the floor with full operational alignment.
* Engineering requirements are accurately translated into actionable floor criteria, enabling smooth program launches and rapid feedback loops.
* Grading and QA operations scale smoothly across teams, shifts, and locations with balanced staffing and clear role execution.

**Our Values**

* Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**
Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
  
  
Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
  
  
Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

title: Director - Business Intelligence
description:
The Data Experience (DEx) practice builds the data foundations, pipelines, and products that power Dentsu's media and marketing effectiveness work across Carat, iProspect, and Dentsu X. We are seeking a Director, Data Engineering to lead our offshore (DGS) engineering capability — owning the architecture, quality, and delivery of the data platform that everything downstream depends on.
  
  
This is a senior leadership and hands-on engineering role. You will set the standard for how DEx ingests, models, and serves media and marketing data on Databricks, and you will do it as a modern practitioner — using AI-assisted data development (Databricks Genie, Copilot, Claude Code) to move faster and raise quality. You will lead and mentor a team of DGS engineers while staying close enough to the code to set the bar yourself. This role demands deep Databricks expertise and a genuine understanding of what media data means, not just how to move it.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Core Skills & Requirements**
Databricks & Data Engineering
  
  

* Deep, hands-on Databricks expertise: Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow / Delta Live Tables, Medallion architecture, and performance tuning.
* Expert-level SQL and strong Python for data engineering; production experience building and operating pipelines at scale.
* Solid grasp of data modeling, orchestration, data quality, and governance — building for reuse and maintainability, not one-off delivery.
* Experience with the surrounding ecosystem (Azure, lightweight ETL / data-prep tooling such as Trifacta or dbt) is a strong plus.

AI-Assisted Data Development
  
  

* Hands-on experience developing data solutions with AI tooling — Databricks Genie, GitHub / Databricks Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding agents.
* Able to use AI assistants to accelerate pipeline build, transformation logic, and debugging while maintaining correctness, governance, and quality.
* A builder's mindset: comfortable pairing with AI tools as a force multiplier for the team, not a novelty.

Media & Marketing Data Fluency
  
  
*You must understand not just how to engineer the data, but what the data means.*

* Strong command of media and marketing data: what impressions, spend, clicks, and conversions represent, and how they relate.
* Understanding of how reach and frequency work — served vs. viewable impressions, de-duplicated reach, and frequency capping — and the implications for how data must be modeled.
* Familiarity with conversion tracking and attribution mechanics — pixels, tags, post-click vs. post-view, and lookback windows.
* Knowledge of how media data connects across campaigns, placements, creatives, and channels, and how spend flows through to outcomes.
* Practical experience with media taxonomies and naming conventions as the foundation of trustworthy, joinable data.

Leadership
  
  

* Proven experience leading and developing an engineering team, ideally in an offshore / DGS or global delivery model.
* Ability to set architecture and code standards, review work critically, and raise the quality bar across a team.
* Strong communication across time zones with onshore leads and stakeholders.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* Experience with streaming / near-real-time ingestion patterns.
* Familiarity with trafficking / ad ops platforms (CM360, Prisma, DV360, TTD) and how their data lands in the platform.
* Exposure to semantic / metrics layers and how engineering choices affect downstream reporting (Power BI, dbt metrics).
* Experience in an agency, ad tech, or marketing analytics environment.
* CI/CD, testing, and DataOps practices for data pipelines.

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years in data engineering, with several years in a leadership or director-level capacity.
* Demonstrated deep Databricks / Lakehouse expertise in production.
* Demonstrated domain knowledge of media and/or marketing data (hard requirement).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

DGS India - Chennai - Anna Nagar Tyche Towers
  
  
**Brand:**
Paragon
  
  
**Time Type:**
Full time
  
  
**Contract Type:**
Permanent#DGS

title: SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) - Senior, Tax Technology Services
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) - Senior, Tax Technology Services**
Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service offerings have obtained support services through the USI Tax teams. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
Deloitte Tax is leading its clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace, offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and technical tax resources to comply with reporting requirements, uncover insights and deploy smarter approaches for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for an innovative Technical SAP ABAP on HANA, CDS, OData, RAP Plus Gen AI develop and implement systems architecture that meet business needs, along with ensuring that our clients’ can keep pace with the changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
Design, build, and support performance SAP S/4HANA extensions and services using ABAP on HANA, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), Core Data Services (CDS), and OData to enable modern Fiori/UI and integration scenarios.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best SAP Tax design for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group. You will also need to continually assess the SAP product suite and development roadmap to integrate any updated specifications and requirements into SAP system architecture.
  
  
You will also need to integrate with the wider client project team (whether that is delivered by Deloitte Consulting or another Systems Integration partner). This will involve an understanding of how the tax design interacts with other process flows and also the inter-personal skills to build the required relationships.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities -**

* Develop and enhance ABAP solutions on SAP S/4HANA using clean, modular, and testable patterns.
* Build Gen AI applications and AI Agents.
* Code Python is a plus.
* Ability to navigate fragmented landscapes through API-calls and MCP- servers is key.
* Build end-to-end RAP artifacts (behavior definitions/implementations, validations, determinations, actions, draft handling, locking, authorization concepts).
* Create and optimize CDS views (interface/consumption views, associations, annotations) with strong focus on pushdown and performance.
* Design, expose, and support OData services (preferably OData V4 via RAP; maintain OData V4 where required).
* Implement Fiori-enablement via CDS annotations and support UI integration with SAP Fiori elements (as applicable).
* Integrate with SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP-recommended patterns (e.g., APIs, events, messaging where applicable).
* Apply performance tuning (SQL optimization, buffering strategy, ST05/SAT/SQLM analysis, CDS performance best practices).
* Follow SAP extensibility guidelines (in-app/extensibility, key-user vs developer extensibility, released APIs, clean-core approach where applicable).
* Produce technical designs, code documentation, unit tests, and participate in code reviews.
* Support testing cycles, defect triage, hyper care, and production support with strong root-cause analysis

**Qualification And Experience Required -**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).
* 4+ years of Experience in SAP or SAP4HANA.
* Hands-on experience in building Gen AI applications, AI Agents.
* SAP Business AI certification is a plus.
* SAP certifications (ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, BTP) are a plus.
* Strong hands-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA / ABAP on HANA environments.
* Proven delivery experience with:
* RAP (managed/unmanaged as needed, behavior implementation, draft, authorization)
* CDS (views, annotations, associations, table functions if needed)
* OData service exposure and troubleshooting (RAP/OData V4 strongly preferred)
* Strong understanding of HANA-optimized development: SQL/CDS pushdown, avoiding SELECT-in-loops, efficient joins, pagination, etc.
* Familiarity with modern ABAP practices (e.g., ABAP OO, clean code, exception handling, unit testing mindset).
* Experience working in Agile delivery (user stories, estimation, sprint ceremonies).

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* SAP BTP exposure (e.g., Integration Suite, API Management, Event Mesh, ABAP environment/Steampunk—if relevant).
* BTP, Joule and SAP business AI certification.
* Proven knowledge of Tax touchpoints within SAP.

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

title: Lead Medical Planner
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
As a Senior Medical Planner, you will play a key role in shaping healthcare environments that directly influence patient care, staff workflows, and clinical outcomes. You'll lead the planning and design of complex healthcare facilities ranging from 80,000 to more than 800,000 sq. ft., working across outpatient, acute care, post-acute, and specialty healthcare settings.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to partner with healthcare providers, architects, engineers, and multidisciplinary specialists to develop evidence-based planning solutions that improve operational performance and support exceptional patient experiences. You'll have visible impact on project outcomes while helping to guide and develop junior healthcare planners within the team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead medical planning, master facility planning, and functional space planning for healthcare projects ranging from 80,000 to 800,000+ sq. ft.
* Develop clinical planning solutions across the continuum of care, including outpatient, acute care, post-acute, and specialty healthcare services.
* Apply evidence-based design principles and healthcare planning best practices to support positive patient outcomes and efficient clinical operations.
* Collaborate with architects, engineers, and specialist consultants to integrate medical planning requirements into the overall facility design.
* Facilitate user group meetings with healthcare stakeholders to gather operational requirements and validate planning solutions.
* Develop and oversee functional programs, space matrices, and departmental planning layouts.
* Review medical planning deliverables to ensure quality, accuracy, and compliance with FGI, ADA, and applicable local building codes.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior planners, supporting team capability development.
* Utilize Revit, AutoCAD, and healthcare planning tools to develop and communicate planning and design solutions.

Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Essential Requirements**

* Demonstrated ability to lead healthcare planning and design activities for complex healthcare facility projects.
* Typically demonstrated through 10+ years of healthcare planning and design experience on complex healthcare facility projects.
* Ability to translate clinical and operational requirements into effective facility planning solutions.
* Knowledge of clinical operations, healthcare regulations, and medical equipment planning principles.
* Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and facilitation skills, including leading user group meetings and workshops.
* Ability to develop functional programs, medical planning, space planning documentation, and departmental layouts.
* Strong quality review skills with the ability to ensure planning deliverables meet regulatory and project requirements.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills when working with multidisciplinary project teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across concurrent healthcare projects.
* Collaborative leadership skills, including mentoring and supporting the development of junior team members.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Degree in Architecture, Healthcare Design, or a related discipline.
* Professional certification in healthcare planning (e.g., ACHA, EDAC).
* Experience contributing to international healthcare projects.
* Passion for improving healthcare environments and patient-centered design outcomes

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer {Chennai}
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 80% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 80% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!
  
  
*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*
