title: Project Manager
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Project Manager to manage mobile game development from planning through release. You will

coordinate development, art, design, and QA teams, maintain clear priorities, resolve blockers, and ensure builds meet

agreed timelines and quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Turn project goals into clear tasks, milestones, sprint plans, and release schedules.

- Coordinate developers, artists, designers, and QA to deliver features and fixes.

- Maintain Jira boards with accurate priorities, ownership, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.

- Run sprint planning, progress reviews, demos, and retrospectives.

- Track delivery risks, identify blockers early, and coordinate solutions.

- Manage scope changes and communicate their impact on timelines and resources.

- Coordinate build delivery, QA testing, bug prioritization, and release readiness.

- Work with technical leads to align branching, integration, and hotfix schedules.

- Share concise progress updates and decisions with management and stakeholders.

- Coordinate post-release monitoring and prioritize issues using player feedback and performance data.

- Improve team workflows to reduce delays and strengthen delivery predictability.

title: Project Coordinator – MSP Business
description:
Job Description (JD)  
Position: Project Coordinator – MSP Business

**Department:** Project Operations – MSP Business

**Designation:** Project Coordinator  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Head Office (Delhi)  
**Reporting To:** Project Manager / Operations Head

1. Job Purpose

The Project Coordinator will be responsible for managing and coordinating end-to-end project operations, from project initiation and planning to execution, monitoring, documentation, billing coordination and final closure.

The candidate will act as a coordination link between clients, internal teams, field supervisors, technicians, vendors and management to ensure timely project delivery within defined timelines and quality standards.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities

**A. Project Planning & Initiation**

* Understand project scope, client requirements, SOW, BOQ and timelines.

* Prepare project execution plans, activity schedules and deployment plans.

* Coordinate with internal teams for manpower, material and resource requirements.

* Prepare district-wise, state-wise and location-wise project allocation plans.

* Conduct project kickoff meetings and communicate responsibilities to stakeholders.

**B. Project Execution & Field Team Coordination**

* Coordinate with field teams, supervisors, technicians and vendors for daily execution.

* Ensure timely manpower deployment at assigned locations.

* Monitor daily installation, survey and other project activities.

* Track site readiness, material availability and execution status.

* Resolve field-level operational challenges in coordination with concerned teams.

* Ensure field teams follow the approved SOPs and client instructions.

**C. Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary coordination point between the client and internal operations team.

* Attend client meetings and prepare Minutes of Meeting (MOM).

* Share daily, weekly and monthly project progress reports.

* Follow up with clients for approvals, site readiness, work orders and pending information.

* Escalate critical issues and ensure timely resolution.

* Maintain professional communication and strong client relationships.

**D. Project Monitoring & MIS Reporting**

* Maintain daily project trackers and centralized MIS.

* Monitor planned versus actual project progress.

* Track completed, pending, SNR, blocked and rejected cases.

* Maintain district-wise and vendor-wise performance reports.

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly progress dashboards.

* Highlight project delays, bottlenecks and resource gaps to management.

* Ensure accurate and timely reporting from field teams.

**E. Documentation & Compliance**

* Ensure collection and verification of all project-related documents.

* Maintain installation reports, inspection reports, checklists and site photographs.

* Ensure geo-tagged photographs, GPS details and required signatures are collected.

* Maintain soft-copy and hard-copy documentation.

* Coordinate for IR forms, LOA, completion certificates and client acceptance documents.

* Ensure all documentation complies with client requirements and project SOPs.

**F. Vendor & Manpower Management**

* Coordinate with vendors and third-party agencies for project execution.

* Track vendor-wise manpower deployment and productivity.

* Monitor attendance, daily activities and field team performance.

* Coordinate for vendor payments, advances and operational expenses.

* Ensure vendors meet project timelines and quality requirements.

**G. Quality Control & Issue Resolution**

* Monitor execution quality as per approved checklists and SOPs.

* Identify installation gaps, incomplete work and client complaints.

* Coordinate for rework, corrections and pending activities.

* Conduct regular follow-ups with supervisors to ensure quality closure.

* Maintain an issue and escalation tracker.

**H. Billing & Commercial Coordination**

* Track completed work against the approved PO / WO.

* Coordinate with the accounts team for invoice preparation.

* Ensure supporting documents are available before billing.

* Track billable quantities, approved rates and completed milestones.

* Follow up for client approvals, invoice submission and pending payments.

* Maintain project-wise billing and payment status.

**I. Project Closure**

* Prepare project-wise final completion reports.

* Reconcile total allocated, completed and pending cases.

* Ensure all IRs, LOAs, checklists and supporting documents are submitted.

* Coordinate with clients for final acceptance and sign-off.

* Prepare final project MIS and hand over documentation to the concerned department.

* Ensure no pending operational or documentation activities remain at closure.

3. Daily Reporting Responsibilities

The Project Coordinator must share the following daily updates:

* Total project allocation and completion status.

* Team deployment status.

* Planned versus actual execution.

* District-wise / location-wise progress.

* Pending and SNR cases with reasons.

* Material and site readiness status.

* Client-related issues and escalations.

* Documentation and IR/LOA collection status.

* Next-day execution and deployment plan.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of project execution targets.

* Timely completion of assigned project milestones.

* Accuracy and timely submission of daily MIS.

* Effective field team and vendor coordination.

* Documentation completeness and accuracy.

* Reduction in pending and SNR cases.

* Client satisfaction and issue resolution TAT.

* Timely submission of billing documents.

* Successful project closure within defined timelines.

5. Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong project coordination and execution skills.

* Excellent communication and client-handling abilities.

* Good command of MS Excel, Google Sheets and PowerPoint.

* Experience in preparing MIS reports and project trackers.

* Knowledge of project planning and resource management.

* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

* Strong follow-up, problem-solving and escalation management.

* Ability to coordinate with field teams across multiple locations.

* Good documentation and reporting skills.

6. Educational Qualification & Experience

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA / PGDM in Operations or Project Management will be preferred.

* 2–5 years of experience in project coordination, operations or field execution.

* Experience in IT infrastructure, vendor onboarding, smart classroom installation, telecom, networking or field-service operations will be an added advantage.

7. Preferred Candidate Profile

The candidate should be proactive, responsible and capable of independently handling end-to-end project coordination. The person must have strong ownership, follow-up discipline and the ability to work with clients, field teams, vendors and internal departments.

**Important:** The candidate should not only prepare MIS reports but also take ownership of actual project execution, issue resolution, documentation and closure.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Sr Construction & Commissioning Manager HVDC
description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Senior HVDC Construction and Commissioning Manager is accountable for the strategic oversight, technical leadership, and overall management of site execution teams. This role provides technical and project leadership for the planning, coordination, construction, installation, testing, and commissioning of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) projects. The position requires periodic travel to project sites, particularly during critical construction & commissioning phases and major shutdown or outage events.
  
  
This role ensures that project execution is delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with technical specifications, quality standards, and contractual requirements.
  
  
**Job Description**
Construction Management
  
  

* Support on-site construction activities for HVDC converter stations, substations, cable systems, and associated infrastructure with primary responsibility of managing commissioning.
* Coordinate site managers, subcontractors, and suppliers to achieve commissioning milestones.
* Oversee installation of major equipment such as converters, transformers, valves, reactors, GIS/AIS equipment, cooling systems, and control/protection systems.

Technical Leadership
  
  

* Development of the work methodology and detailed day-to-day execution plan for the refurbishment of HVDC components (Valves and Control Systems) in alignment with the approved outage schedule.
* Oversee commissioning of HVDC converter systems, transformers, valves, switchgear, smoothing reactors, cooling systems, AC/DC yard equipment, and control/protection systems.
* Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for issues encountered during testing and energization.
* Ensure technical compliance with design documents, grid code requirements, contractual specifications, and industry standards.
* Support engineering teams in resolving design changes, non-conformances, and site technical queries.

Commissioning Management
  
  

* Development of pre-commissioning and commissioning documentation, checklists, and reporting formats.
* Plan and manage pre-commissioning, commissioning, energization, and performance testing activities for HVDC systems.
* Coordinate system integration and interface testing between electrical, control, protection, telecom, and SCADA systems.
* Ensure commissioning procedures, test protocols, and acceptance criteria are developed, reviewed, and approved.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of technical issues during testing and energization.
* Support handover of commissioned systems to the client and operations team.

Environment, Health, & Safety (EHS) and Quality
  
  

* Promote and enforce a strong safety culture across all site activities.
* Ensure compliance with EHS regulations, permit-to-work systems, lockout/tagout procedures, and project-specific safety requirements.
* Ensure all construction and commissioning work meets applicable quality standards, codes, and contractual obligations.

Stakeholder Coordination and Reporting
  
  

* Serve as the main point of contact for commissioning-related matters with the client, project management, OEMs, and grid operators.
* Participate in progress reviews, readiness assessments, and milestone meetings.
* Report commissioning progress, issues, risks, and recovery plans to project leadership.
* Support final acceptance testing, handover, and project closeout activities.

Documentation and Compliance
  
  

* Ensure site documentation is complete and up to date, including inspection records, test reports, punch lists, and as-built documentation.
* Verify compliance with grid codes, customer specifications, and applicable international standards.
* Support factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), and final project documentation closure.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Extensive experience in HVDC, substations, power transmission, or large utility-scale electrical infrastructure projects.
* Strong experience in both construction management and commissioning of high-voltage electrical systems.
* Proven knowledge of converter stations, protection and control systems, testing procedures, and energization processes.
* Proven ability to manage multi-disciplinary teams in a remote/distributed capacity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing large, complex EPC or turnkey HVDC projects.
* Knowledge of LCC and/or VSC HVDC technologies.
* Experience working with multinational teams, contractors, and clients across multiple geographies.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and commissioning procedures.
* Strong data analysis skills for reporting project performance, risks, and recovery plans.

Typical Experience Profile
  
  

* 15+ years of experience in power transmission, substation, or HVDC projects
* 8+ years in a site leadership, construction management, or commissioning leadership role
* Demonstrated experience with high-voltage equipment installation, testing, and energization

Working Conditions
  
  

* Office-based role with significant domestic travel requirements.
* Work may involve remote project locations, outage windows, and high-pressure commissioning periods.
* Availability for field troubleshooting and critical milestone support is necessary. Depending on project requirements, site assignments may involve extended on-site deployments for prolonged durations.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: ITIL - Operations Analysis Senior Specialist
description:
**Req ID:**
369911
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a ITIL - Operations Analysis Senior Specialist to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
Oversees, facilitates, and administers ITIL based service support and/or technical account management in the coordination of incident ownership and client account management on a 24x7 basis.
  
  
Responsibilities include the management and oversight of service delivery processes, which may include incident management, problem management, request management, change management, service level management and configuration management as well as resource coordination, client management, dispute and technical resolution management, and communications at various levels during services engagements from tactical to strategic.
  
  
In this role you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Individuals have a deep understanding of their own area.
* They have a limited understanding of related subject areas.
* They manage critical projects with general direction and may allocate some work to others

Requirements for this role include:
  
  

* Assigned to larger / more complex service delivery processes and associated projects.
* Plays key role in continuous improvement activities in support of client or internal business processes.
* Compiles, analyzes and reports statistical data and trends relating to service level compliance and operational effectiveness.
* Assists program or process development and implementation.
* Typically requires 6-8 years relevant experience.
* Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience.
* Solid understanding of ITIL processes and principals.
* Solid written and verbal skills.
* Ability to physically perform general office requirements.
* Must be able to perform essential responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodations.
* Travel including overnight domestic or international trips may be required.

**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.

title: Meme Campaign Strategist
description:
**Company Overview:**

Leap of Faith? Nah, Leap of Creativity! THE LEAPFROG NETWORK is not your average ad agency - we are the cool experts in the marketing playground. We craft campaigns stronger than your coffee and have more ideas than coffee stains on their brainstorming whiteboard. Join us for a joyride through the world of witty campaigns and quirky concepts. THE LEAPFROG NETWORK is not in the business of blending in; we are here to make your brand stand out like a unicorn.

**About the Role:**

We're on the hunt for a highly creative and strategically-minded
**Meme Campaign Strategist**
to join our dynamic team. In this crucial role, you'll be at the forefront of shaping how our client campaigns connect with their target audiences and achieve measurable results.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage meme marketing campaigns end-to-end, ensuring timely execution and completion of all assigned deliverables.
* Coordinate across multiple Instagram handles to manage and monitor ongoing campaigns.
* Develop campaign plans and timelines tailored to client goals, target audiences, and platforms.
* Align content and posting schedules based on client feedback and approvals.
* Coordinate content revisions and ensure all deliverables meet client requirements.
* Plan and oversee campaign launches and day-to-day execution.
* Track campaign progress, pending tasks, approvals, and dependencies.
* Identify and resolve execution gaps to ensure smooth campaign delivery.
* Scrape and analyse campaign performance data to prepare detailed reports at the end of each campaign.
* Maintain clear documentation of campaign timelines, deliverables, and client feedback.

**Requirements:**

* Proficiency in Google Sheets (formulas, data organization, basic analysis).
* Strong understanding of Instagram trends, content formats, and audience behavior.
* Comfortable with client communication, including taking briefs, giving updates, and handling feedback.
* Ability to multitask, stay organized, and work in a fast-paced environment.
* A proactive attitude and eagerness to learn.

title: Manager, Circ & IDS Support
description:
**Who We Are**
Insurity empowers insurance organizations to quickly capitalize on new opportunities by delivering the world’s most configurable, cloud-native, easy-to-use, and intuitively analytical insurance software. Just as importantly, we empower our people—providing the tools, support, and opportunities they need to grow and succeed.

As the largest cloud-based software provider for the Property & Casualty market, Insurity is trusted by 22 of the top 25 P&C carriers and 7 of the top 10 wholesale brokers in the MGA space. While our technology sets us apart, it’s our people who truly make the difference. At Insurity, you’ll collaborate with some of the most creative and knowledgeable minds in insurance tech—in a culture that fosters innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning. Our award-winning onboarding experience welcomes and supports you from the moment you accept our offer.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you.
**#UatInsurity**
**What’s In It For U**

* Work Where You Thrive: Find a hybrid work environment that allows you to enjoy great work life balance, stay connected and collaborative
* Generous Time Off: Our leadership believes in taking the time you need when you need it.
* Day One Health Benefits + Employer-Matched Retirement Savings: You might think these are table stakes, but we know these matter to you.
* More Than Just Core Values: Our values are fundamental in how we attract, train, and retain top talent.
* Award-Winning Onboarding Program: We set you up from the get-go to make a significant impact from Day One and follow you through your entire first year.
* Real Career Growth Opportunities: We love to promote from within with over 25% of our open roles filled through internal applicants on average.
* Mentorship Program: We support a champion culture and growth mindset by pairing you with experienced, talented leaders to help you grow personally and professionally.
* Insurity Podcasts: Explore podcasts from our Learning & Development team for deeper insight into Insurity products, company innovation, and the business as a whole.
* Continuous Learning Opportunities: Own your development with your own LinkedIn Learning and Kaplan licenses.
* Employee Referral Bonus: Once you come onboard, give Insurity the biggest compliment you can give by referring someone to work here and earn a referral bonus.

**Insurity’s Next**
**Manager**
Insurity is looking for a people focused Manager to lead a high-performing team. This role is responsible for developing team members, delivering departmental goals, supporting strong customer and stakeholder relationships, and helping the team operate effectively in a changing environment. The ideal candidate combines sound judgment, strong communication, hands-on knowledge of the function, and a genuine commitment to coaching and developing people.
  
  
**What Our Manager**
**Will Do**

* Lead, coach, and mentor a high-performing, highly engaged team of individual contributors supporting bureau content for the base system & customers
* Interview, hire, onboard, and retain exceptional talent while building a collaborative and accountable team culture.
* Provide input to departmental goals and help ensure those goals are met.
* Lead team members through Insurity’s performance management and development process.
* Communicate effectively and regularly with team members, customers, and other stakeholders.
* Manage financial responsibilities and activities for large projects
* Effectively manage release planning including capacity for resources
* Develop and maintain trusted customer relationships and effectively engage with internal and external stakeholders.
* Drive utilization across the team and communicate financial results, goal progress, and KPI's to direct reports.
* Perform hands-on individual-contributor work as needed to support the team and business objectives.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* Recommended: 5 years of experience managing people
* Recommended: Bachelor’s degree in a related field; equivalent work experience may be considered.
* Experience leading, managing, coaching, and developing a team of individual contributors
* Experience in the U.S. Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance industry, with the ability to apply that knowledge in a support and operational leadership environment.
* Ability to work U.S. Based hours (full-time ET Time Zone preferred)
* Highly proficient analytical and critical-thinking skills, written and oral English communication, time management, prioritization, and organization
* Strong ability to manage multiple priorities
* Self-starter mindset, willingness to learn, attention to detail, active listening skills, and ability to collaborate while working autonomously.
* Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information, ability to negotiate toward effective outcomes, and readiness to accept challenging assignments.
* Ability to apply hands-on experience as an individual contributor and break down complex issues into simple, clear terms.
* Willingness to complete Insurity’s Leadership Development Program and Insurity Manager Training within 12 months.
* Ability to travel approximately 10–30% as needed.

Thank you for your interest in Insurity! Please understand that due to the volume of applicants we receive, only selected candidates will be contacted.
  
  
medical insurance; dental insurance; vision insurance; 401(K) match; paid maternity leave; paid paternity leave; disability insurance

Bachelors/Masters in IT/Computer Science; Certification in Concur

6-10 years

description:

We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI-led engineering through hands-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  
  
This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting-edge AI engineering. Hands-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
  
  
Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

AI Governance & Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human-in-the-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI-enabled enterprise systems.
  
  
Job responsibilities

* Client Engagement & Strategic Architecture

– Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high-value areas for AI-led acceleration.
  
  
– Design & Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.

title: Yarn spinning technical head
company: WHITE GOLD COTTON TESTING LABORATORY LLP
description:
**Company Description**
WHITE GOLD COTTON TESTING LABORATORY LLP operates in the textile and yarn spinning sector, with a focus on quality assurance and technical excellence. The organization specializes in testing and evaluating cotton and yarn to support efficient, high-quality spinning operations. By combining technical expertise with industry best practices, the company aims to optimize production performance and product consistency. Team members collaborate closely across functions to maintain high standards, support continuous improvement, and meet customer requirements.
  
**Role Description**
The Yarn Spinning Technical Head is a full-time, on-site role based in Ahmedabad. This position is responsible for overseeing all technical aspects of yarn spinning, including process optimization, quality control, and troubleshooting issues in spinning operations. The role involves monitoring production parameters, analyzing test data from the laboratory, and implementing corrective actions to improve yarn quality and productivity. The Yarn Spinning Technical Head will guide and support technical staff, coordinate with production teams, and ensure compliance with industry standards and internal procedures. The role also includes training team members on best practices, introducing new technologies or methods as needed, and preparing technical reports and documentation for management.

* Strong analytical skills to interpret test data, diagnose process issues, and drive continuous improvement in yarn spinning operations.
* Effective communication skills for coordinating with production teams, laboratory staff, and management, and for preparing clear technical reports.
* Technical support capabilities, including hands-on experience with spinning machinery, process settings, and quality control systems.
* Team management experience, with the ability to lead, mentor, and coordinate technical and operational staff in a mill or laboratory environment.
* Training skills to design and deliver practical training sessions on spinning processes, quality standards, and safety procedures.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Textile Engineering, Textile Technology, or a related field, with substantial experience in yarn spinning.
* In-depth knowledge of cotton properties, yarn testing methods, and industry quality standards (e.g., count, strength, evenness, Uster parameters).
* Familiarity with production planning, process control tools, and basic computer skills for data analysis and reporting.
* Commitment to workplace safety, regulatory compliance, and ethical, non-discriminatory practices.

description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O&M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Wind Turbine Generator (WTG)**
**:**
Adani Wind Turbine Generators (WTG) is a leading player in the renewable energy sector, specializing in the design, manufacturing, and installation of high-performance wind turbine systems. With a commitment to sustainability, Adani WTGs deliver efficient and reliable energy solutions, contributing to clean power generation across global markets.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Lead - Electrical drives the design, integration, and validation of turbine electrical systems, ensuring high performance, reliability, and compliance with industry standards. The role focuses on SCADA integration, subsystem validation, thermal management, and power quality optimization, addressing compatibility challenges and ensuring efficient load distribution. It leads the testing and maintenance of critical components like converters, transformers, and generators to align with performance goals. The role supports field operations, conducts root cause analyses for subsystem failures, and implements corrective actions to improve reliability. Additionally, it collaborates with cross-functional teams to refine designs and ensure manufacturability, contributing to long-term operational efficiency.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Subsystem-Level Electrical Design**

* Lead the end-to-end design and optimization of turbine electrical subsystems, focusing on high-performance inverters, control circuits, and transformer interfaces for reliable grid integration.
* Optimize nacelle cabling layouts to reduce electromagnetic interference (EMI), minimize power losses, and improve thermal management in compact spaces.
* Design redundant electrical pathways to enhance fault tolerance and ensure continuous turbine operation under extreme conditions.

**Integration of Electrical and SCADA Systems**

* Coordinate the seamless integration of electrical components with SCADA platforms, ensuring real-time data capture, fault detection, and rapid response mechanisms.
* Resolve compatibility issues between SCADA software and electrical subsystems, focusing on synchronization of monitoring with turbine control logic.
* Develop protocols for optimized data flow, ensuring minimal latency and reliable system feedback loops.

**Component Validation and Testing**

* Manage comprehensive testing protocols for turbine electrical components, including insulation resistance, power converter efficiency, and transformer load handling.
* Collaborate with instrumentation teams to ensure accurate sensor placement and calibration, capturing critical performance metrics.
* Supervise fault simulation tests, such as grid fault ride-through (FRT) events, to validate subsystem behavior under adverse conditions.

**Power Conversion Optimization**

* Oversee optimization of power conversion systems by implementing harmonic distortion mitigation strategies and fine-tuning inverter control parameters.
* Analyze power quality metrics to ensure adherence to grid compliance standards, focusing on voltage stability and transient response performance.

**Failure Analysis and Corrective Actions**

* Conduct root cause failure analysis (RCFA) for electrical subsystem failures, such as converter overheating or generator insulation breakdown.
* Define and implement corrective actions, including design modifications for improved thermal management and enhanced material selection for reliability.
* Develop reliability improvement plans, integrating predictive maintenance schedules into operational workflows.

**Collaboration with Instrumentation Teams**

* Work closely with instrumentation engineers to configure and validate sensors for monitoring voltage, current, and thermal performance across components.
* Ensure SCADA-integrated data acquisition systems provide accurate and actionable insights into subsystem performance.
* Lead troubleshooting efforts for sensor-related issues, ensuring minimal disruption to turbine monitoring and control.

**Grid Interface and Compliance**

* Analyze grid connection points to validate voltage stability and ensure compliance with international standards, such as IEC 61400-21.
* Develop real-time voltage and frequency regulation algorithms to support grid stability during transient and steady-state operations.

**Thermal and Power Loss Analysis**

* Conduct detailed thermal performance studies for converters, transformers, and cabling, focusing on heat dissipation efficiency and thermal stability under varying loads.
* Analyze power loss patterns in nacelle wiring, identifying hotspots and proposing improved layouts or materials to enhance efficiency.
* Validate thermal simulations with field data to ensure subsystem performance aligns with design expectations.

**Technical Reporting and Documentation**

* Prepare detailed technical reports highlighting subsystem performance evaluations, failure analyses, and actionable recommendations for improvement.
* Document testing procedures, validation protocols, and outcomes for traceability during audits and certifications.

**Mentorship and Guidance**

* Mentor junior engineers in advanced topics, such as harmonic distortion analysis and thermal management in high-voltage systems.
* Conduct regular technical reviews of team deliverables to ensure alignment with project requirements and quality standards.
* Develop training modules focusing on the latest advancements in electrical engineering and renewable energy technologies.

**Key Stakeholders - Internal**

* Head - Engineering
* Head - Electrical Engineering
* Electrical Engineer
* OMS Engineering & Support - Electrical
* Nacelle Plant Support Engineer - Electrical
* Lead - Blade Process Engineering
* Lead - Testing & Certification
* Lead - Grid Compliance
* Lead - Performance Management
* Lead - Load Simulation
* Lead - Mechanical Drive Train
* Manufacturing Teams
* QA Teams

**Key Stakeholders - External**

* Electrical Component Suppliers
* Testing and Commissioning Agencies
* Grid Compliance Consultants
* Certification Bodies

**Qualifications**
**Educational Background:**

* BE in Electrical Engineering or related discipline.

**Work Experience**

* 8+ years in designing, testing, and optimizing electrical systems, including power converters and transformers. Experience with failure analysis, thermal management, and compliance verification is essential.

**Industry Knowledge**

* Expertise in load management, harmonics mitigation, and SCADA systems. Familiarity with IEC standards and advanced simulation tools is required.

title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Now Assist-HRSD
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Now Assist & HRSD)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The role of Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of ServiceNow solutions focusing on HR Service Delivery as well as Now Assist capabilities (including AI agents, agentic workflows and now assist skills). In addition, this role would lead implementations to make ServiceNow as an orchestrator to call multiple AI agents within and outside of ServiceNow using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent-to-Agent protocol (A2A) to allow ServiceNow agents to invoke external data sets and APIs.
  
  
The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Implementation expertise of Now Assist capabilities (out of box and custom skills), agentic workflow and AI agents
* Experience in configuring out of box agentic workflows and implementing custom AI agents
* Understanding of A2A and MCP protocols
* Deep functional knowledge of LLMs, agentic patterns and API integration paths (REST)
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of HRSD and ITSM applications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Engineering Lead - AI
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**EY Job Description**
**Job Title: Engineering Lead – AI**
**Job Rank (must note a single rank only for each job description): Associate Director**
**Function: EY Technology – Enterprise Technology**
**Scope (indicate either “global/cross-border” or “local/country”):Global**
**Sub Function: EY Technology | CBS Technology | Intelligent Automation**
**Reports to (Job Title): Service Delivery Lead: AI & Automation**
**Job Summary:**
The Engineering Lead is responsible for hands-on engineering delivery of enterprise AI/ML/GenAI and automation solutions, coding standards, design patterns, ensuring production-grade security, scalability, reliability, and supportability. It is not a solution advisory, PoC, or platform administration role. Success is measured by the quality, reliability, scalability, and operability of AI systems in production.
  
  
Operating as a player–coach, the Engineering Lead works alongside AI Engineers to design and build ML Models, LLM pipelines and agentic workflows, while also setting engineering standards, coaching teams, and ensuring delivery.
  
  
**The ideal candidate will possess:**

* Extensive, hands-on software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and operating complex systems in production environments.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-relevant outcomes.
* Ability to independently design and code across multiple technical components, while guiding and elevating the work of senior engineers.
* Deep technical expertise across the full stack, including cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, and data-intensive platforms.
* Strong command of non-functional requirements, including reliability, availability, scalability, performance, and cost optimization, and the ability to make sound technology and architecture decisions as systems evolve over time.
* Demonstrated experience delivering production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, including:
* LLM-powered applications and services
* Agentic workflows and orchestration frameworks
* Model integration, evaluation, and lifecycle management
* MLOps / LLMOps pipelines and operational practices
* Proven experience partnering with Data Science and AI Research teams to operationalize models and AI capabilities at enterprise scale.
* Ability to drive the design and delivery of AI-first architectures, including LLM-powered services, agentic workflows, orchestration layers, and human-in-the-loop systems.
* Experience building robust data and software foundations that enable advanced analytics, real-time AI inference, and intelligent decisioning at scale.

**Essential Functions of the Job:**

* Engineering Ownership & Delivery Accountability

+ Own end-to-end technical delivery of AI and GenAI solutions—from design through production and BAU support.
+ Act as the technical authority for the build team, accountable for:

- Code quality and engineering standards
- Security, privacy, and compliance
- Reliability, scalability, performance, and cost
- Operational readiness and supportability

+ Make hard engineering trade-offs balancing latency, accuracy, cost, reliability, and scale.
+ Own production systems post go-live, including incident analysis, performance tuning, and architectural evolution.

* Hands-on GenAI & AI Systems Engineering


+ Collaborate with solution architecture on design and own build production-grade GenAI systems, including:

- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
- Agentic workflows and tool-based orchestration
- Prompt pipelines, routing, and integration layers
- Human-in-the-loop and safety guardrails

+ Work shoulder-to-shoulder with AI Engineers and Data Scientists to:

- Productionize models and LLM pipelines
- Implement evaluation, monitoring, and observability
- Optimize inference cost, performance, and reliability

+ Ensure experimental AI capabilities are engineered into real systems, not isolated prototypes.

* Architecture & Engineering Standards

+ Define and enforce reference architectures and engineering standards for AI and GenAI systems.
+ Drive consistent adoption of:

- Clean and modular architecture patterns
- Reusable components and shared frameworks
- CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud-native practices

+ Partner with architecture, platform, security, and data teams while retaining final accountability for build quality.

* AI Platform Engineering & MLOps / LLMOps

+ Build and evolve AI platforms that support:

- Model lifecycle management
- LLMOps / MLOps pipelines
- Evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection
- Secure access, auditability, and governance

+ Ensure AI systems meet enterprise non-functional requirements over time, not just at launch.

* Team Leadership & Capability Building

+ Lead and grow a team of senior engineers within the AI & Automation build function.
+ Coach engineers on:

- Backend and distributed systems engineering
- GenAI application design and implementation
- Writing maintainable, testable, production-quality code

+ Set a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, rigor, and continuous improvement.
+ Support hiring and skills development aligned to future AI engineering needs.

* Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration

+ Partner closely with:

- AI/ML Engineering and Data Science teams
- Platform, security, and operations teams
- Architecture and governance forums

+ Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical designs.
+ Act as a senior technical voice in design authorities and delivery governance.

**Engineering Expectations (Non Negotiable)**

* Has built and operated complex, distributed backend systems in production.
* Comfortable debugging production incidents involving AI/LLM pipelines.
* Writes, reviews, and maintains production-quality code, not just prototypes.
* Understands failure modes of AI systems and designs for resilience.
* Takes ownership for systems after go-live, including reliability and cost optimization.

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
This role is critical to ensuring the enterprise’s AI ambition translates into
**real, reliable, and scalable systems**
—not just innovation theater. You will define how AI is built, shipped, and operated across the organization.
  
  
**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
**Core Engineering Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in Python, Java, C#, or similar backend languages.
* Proven experience building API-driven, cloud-native systems.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and reliability patterns.

**GenAI / AI Engineering (Essential)**

* Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, including:

+ RAG pipelines
+ Agentic or tool-augmented workflows
+ Prompt orchestration and integration layers

* Experience with:

+ Vector databases and embeddings
+ LLM evaluation, observability, and monitoring
+ Guardrails, safety, and cost controls

* Experience operationalizing AI models at scale in enterprise environments.

**Nice to Have (Not Core Identity)**

* Experience integrating AI services into enterprise automation platforms (e.g., Power Platform, ServiceNow).
* Familiarity with Azure AI services and data platforms.

**Detailed Responsibilities:**

* Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and ServiceNow. Create custom workflows, forms, and applications to automate business processes and enhance user experience.
* Integration Management: Integrate Microsoft and ServiceNow platforms with other enterprise applications using APIs, web services, and middleware. Ensure seamless data flow between systems and maintain data integrity across integrated applications.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing of automation solutions to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with business requirements. Implement best practices for code quality, documentation, and version control.
* Observability and Maintenance: Monitor the performance of automation solutions and troubleshoot issues as they arise. Perform regular maintenance and updates to ensure optimal functionality and security of automation applications.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for automation solutions, including design specifications, user guides, and technical manuals. Document processes, workflows, and integration points for future reference and knowledge transfer.
* User Training and Support: Provide training and support to end-users and team members on automation tools and processes.Develop training materials and conduct workshops to facilitate user adoption of automation solutions.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, project managers, and IT staff, to ensure alignment on automation initiatives. Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments to automation solutions.
* Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of automation solutions. Generate reports and dashboards to communicate the impact of automation on business processes and operational efficiency.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in automation, AI, and relevant technologies.Identify areas for continuous improvement and propose enhancements to existing automation solutions.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure that automation solutions adhere to organizational policies, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Participate in risk assessments and audits related to automation initiatives.
* Innovation and Research: Explore and evaluate new technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance automation capabilities. Conduct research on industry best practices and competitor strategies to inform decision-making and innovation.
* Change Management: Analyze the impact of automation on organizational processes and culture, making recommendations for change management strategies. Assist in developing communication plans to inform stakeholders about automation initiatives and their benefits.

**Other Requirements:**

* Familiarity with Python practices and tools.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and influence
* Strong leadership and conflict resolution capability
* Leading virtual teams

**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**

* A degree in Computer Science / Engineering or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience

**Experience:**

* 10+ years in a Global IT environment working with multiple disciplines to deliver projects in line with customer needs
* 3+ Years Global delivery or transformation preferably in large scale infrastructure programs
* 3+ Years in a global operations environment

**Certification Requirements:**

* Relevant certifications in MS Power Platform and ServiceNow RPA
* Python Certification
* Azure AI Services
* Azure Data Services

**EY | Building a better working world**

title: Sr Lead - SNOW Lead
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Northern Trust is looking for an experienced Senior Lead to join its Technology Development Centre in Pune/Bangalore, India and provide quality engineering leadership for enterprise ServiceNow applications across multiple modules and shared platform capabilities.
  
  
The role is accountable for defining and driving the overall test strategy, functional and integration test delivery, ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) adoption, regression automation, defect governance, and release-quality readiness across ServiceNow initiatives and platform releases.
  
  
The Senior Lead will partner with Product Owners, business stakeholders, platform architects, Business Analysts, Developers, Quality Engineers, Operations and vendor teams to embed quality throughout the delivery lifecycle and ensure stable, secure and audit-ready releases.
  
  
**Application Domain**

* IT Service Management (ITSM): Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Major Incident and Service Catalog
* IT Operations Management (ITOM): Discovery, Event Management, Service Mapping and Configuration Management Database (CMDB)
* Customer Service Management (CSM), HR Service Delivery (HRSD), Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) and App Engine
* Integrated Risk Management (IRM), Security Operations, IT Asset Management, Software Asset Management and other enabled modules
* Service Portal / Employee Center, mobile, reporting, Performance Analytics, integrations, access controls and shared platform services

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on testing experience across multiple ServiceNow modules and shared platform capabilities.
* Strong ServiceNow ATF knowledge, including test and suite design, reusable/custom test steps, regression execution, test data, reporting and maintenance.
* Experience validating forms, workflows, Flow Designer, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, notifications, approvals, SLAs, scheduled jobs and reports.
* Strong functional, integration, system, regression, smoke, sanity and end-to-end testing experience.
* Experience validating REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server, file-based interfaces and upstream/downstream integrations.
* Strong database and data-validation skills, including SQL, reconciliation, transformations, migration validation and data integrity.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, ServiceNow Test Management, Jira or equivalent tools.
* Understanding of CI/CD, source control, automated quality gates, platform upgrades and release management.
* Exposure to performance, reliability, security and accessibility testing is desirable.

**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Quality Engineering and Test Leadership**

* Own the quality engineering and test strategy for enterprise ServiceNow applications across modules, integrations and shared services.
* Define scope, estimates, approach, entry and exit criteria, quality gates, regression strategy and release-readiness criteria.
* Lead planning, execution, monitoring and closure across concurrent initiatives, enhancements, defects, upgrades and releases.
* Apply risk-based testing to prioritize business-critical workflows, cross-module dependencies and high-impact platform changes.
* Ensure traceability between requirements, processes, test coverage, evidence, defects and release outcomes.
* Identify environment, test-data, integration and access dependencies early and drive timely resolution.

**Cross-Module Functional Testing**

* Validate core ITSM processes and end-to-end fulfillment workflows.
* Validate ITOM, Discovery, Event Management, Service Mapping, CMDB data quality and service relationships where applicable.
* Validate CSM, HRSD, SPM, IRM, Security Operations, Asset Management and App Engine solutions based on implementation scope.
* Validate module-specific and cross-platform roles, ACLs, assignment rules, data segregation, audit history and persona-based experiences.
* Validate integrations and cross-module dependencies for complete processing and data consistency.
* Translate business and technical requirements into positive, negative, boundary, integration and regression scenarios.

**ATF and Test Automation**

* Define, establish and govern the ServiceNow ATF automation strategy and framework.
* Identify high-value regression scenarios using business criticality, execution frequency, stability and maintenance cost.
* Build and maintain scalable ATF suites across modules and shared platform services.
* Establish standards for reusability, naming, maintainability, test data, evidence, execution and reporting.
* Partner with developers and platform teams on custom ATF steps and complex automation constraints.
* Assess automation coverage after configuration changes, new modules and platform upgrades.
* Integrate automated tests into release and CI/CD processes where applicable.

**Defect, Data and Release Governance**

* Lead defect triage, severity and priority assessment, business-impact articulation and resolution tracking.
* Govern SQL and data validation for interfaces, transformations, reconciliation and migration outcomes.
* Provide clear quality status, metrics, risks, dependencies, constraints and mitigation plans.
* Drive release-readiness reviews and provide quality recommendations based on objective evidence.
* Ensure testing artifacts meet governance, security, compliance and audit needs.
* Use defect and execution trends to drive preventive actions and continuous improvement.

**Leadership and Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the functional and technical quality escalation point for ServiceNow testing.
* Coach and mentor Quality Engineers and vendor teams across functional testing and automation practices.
* Partner with Product, Platform, Business, Technology and Operations stakeholders to align priorities.
* Drive consistent standards, engineering practices, reporting and delivery discipline.
* Reduce dependency on repetitive manual testing through sustainable ATF coverage and knowledge development.

**Required Functional / Platform Knowledge**
**ServiceNow Platform**

* Strong understanding of ServiceNow tables, forms, workflows, Flow Designer, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, notifications and scheduled jobs.
* Working knowledge of users, groups, roles, ACLs, update sets, application scopes and platform upgrades.
* Understanding of Service Portal / Employee Center, dashboards, reports, Performance Analytics and mobile where applicable.
* Ability to assess shared-platform changes, cross-module dependencies and regression impact.

**ServiceNow Modules**

* Broad functional knowledge of ITSM, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalog and Major Incident Management.
* Working understanding of ITOM, Discovery, Event Management, Service Mapping and CMDB.
* Exposure to one or more additional modules such as CSM, HRSD, SPM, IRM, Security Operations, Asset Management, Software Asset Management or App Engine.
* Ability to learn and test new ServiceNow modules based on business priorities without limiting the role to one product area.

**Integration, Database and Data Validation**

* Strong understanding of relational data concepts and ServiceNow table relationships.
* Proficiency in SQL for backend and interface validation where external databases are involved.
* Experience validating APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server and file-based integrations.
* Ability to validate completeness, accuracy, integrity, reconciliation, transformations and migration outcomes.
* Understanding of CMDB data quality, identification and reconciliation concepts is desirable.

**Required Skills**

* Proven experience leading Software Quality Engineering for complex enterprise ServiceNow implementations.
* Strong hands-on ServiceNow testing and ATF experience.
* Broad ServiceNow functional and platform knowledge with ability to engage business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong integration, database and SQL testing capability.
* Excellent test strategy, planning, defect management and release-governance experience.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, facilitation and influencing skills.
* Ability to manage multiple releases, priorities, risks and dependencies concurrently.
* Strong leadership and mentoring capability across distributed internal and vendor teams.

**Personal Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 13+ years of experience in Software Quality Engineering / Testing, preferably including enterprise ServiceNow platform delivery.
* Demonstrated leadership through ownership, accountability, sound judgment and decision-making in a Lead Individual Contributor role.
* Ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, Product Owners, platform leaders and delivery teams.
* Proactive, detail-oriented and quality-driven mindset with strong execution focus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with large-scale ServiceNow implementations, transformations or platform upgrades.
* ServiceNow certifications or formal training in the platform, ATF or one or more product modules.
* Experience working in financial services, banking or another highly regulated enterprise environment.

title: Sr Lead, Software Quality Engineering (SQE/SQM)
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Senior Lead, Software Quality Engineering (SQE/SQM), leads end-to-end quality engineering for
  
  
assigned applications, platforms, programs, or business domains. The role combines hands-on technical
  
  
leadership with test strategy, delivery execution, automation, non-functional testing, environment and
  
  
test-data readiness, defect management, and quality governance.
  
  
The Senior Lead partners with Application Development, Product and Business teams, Architecture,
  
  
DevOps, Production Support, and other technology functions to embed quality throughout the software
  
  
delivery lifecycle and provide objective evidence of production readiness.
  
  
**ROLE PURPOSE**
Own quality outcomes, identify risk early, engineer effective test solutions, and enable informed release decisions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Quality Engineering and Test Leadership
  
  

* Own the test strategy and execution approach for assigned applications, platforms, or programs.
* Lead functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and release-validation activities.
* Establish risk-based coverage using architecture, business criticality, change impact, dependencies, and

control requirements.
  
  

* Drive shift-left quality by ensuring appropriate developer-level testing is completed before formal QE

execution.
  
  

* Provide clear quality input and supporting evidence for release-readiness and Go/No-Go decisions.

Automation and Engineering
  
  

* Drive maintainable automation across API, UI, integration, regression, and other appropriate testing

layers.
  
  

* Integrate automated quality checks into CI/CD pipelines and improve the speed and reliability of

feedback.
  
  

* Identify opportunities to use service virtualization, synthetic test data, engineering utilities, and

AI-assisted testing.
  
  

* Focus automation on risk reduction and business-flow protection rather than coverage percentages alone.

Non-Functional Quality
  
  

* Plan and coordinate relevant performance, capacity, resiliency, recovery, failover, compatibility, and

operational-readiness testing.
  
  

* Partner with Performance Engineering, SRE, Security, Infrastructure, Architecture, and Production Support

specialists as required.
  
  

* Ensure non-functional risks, assumptions, and acceptance criteria are visible early in the delivery

lifecycle.
  
  
Environment and Test-Data Readiness
  
  

* Confirm the availability and fitness of non-production environments, integrations, interfaces, and test

data.
  
  

* Identify environment and data constraints early, establish mitigation plans, and track them through

closure.
  
  

* Promote appropriate use of data masking, test-data management, data virtualization, and service

virtualization.
  
  
Risk and Defect Management
  
  

* Lead defect triage and ensure consistent severity, priority, ownership, aging, and resolution decisions.
* Identify testing gaps, constraints, and residual risks before deployment.
* Escalate material quality risks early and communicate business and technology impact objectively.
* Maintain traceable evidence supporting quality status and release recommendations.

Delivery and Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Coordinate QE deliverables, dependencies, milestones, and readiness across multiple teams.
* Partner with Development leads to make quality a shared engineering responsibility.
* Communicate progress, blockers, defects, risks, and readiness clearly to program and technology

leadership.
  
  

* Mentor engineers, provide technical direction, and promote consistent QE practices across the team.
* Support concurrent initiatives while maintaining governance, transparency, and delivery discipline.

**Required Experience And Capabilities**

* 13+ years' experience in software quality engineering, testing, or software engineering within complex

enterprise environments.
  
  

* Experience leading quality activities for integrated applications, platforms, or major programs.
* Strong understanding of SDLC/STLC, Agile delivery, CI/CD, DevOps, risk-based testing, and shift-left

engineering.
  
  

* Hands-on knowledge of API, UI, integration, and test-automation approaches and frameworks.
* Working knowledge of performance testing and broader non-functional quality disciplines.
* Experience with test-data management and complex non-production environment dependencies.
* Ability to interpret application architecture, interfaces, data flows, and upstream/downstream impacts.
* Strong communication, facilitation, defect-management, risk-management, and release-readiness skills.

**Working with Us**

**Job Description Summary**
As an ICAR modality Test Lead at GEHC, you will lead and execute testing activities for interventional cardiology new programs and IB lifecycle projects. GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

* Drive continuous improvement in testing methodologies, tools, and processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
* Prepare and present test status reports, defect metrics, and quality summaries to project stakeholders.
* Ensure adherence to GE Healthcare's quality management system (QMS) and relevant industry standards

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or in “STEM” Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math), A minimum of 10 years of professional experience.
* 8 years plus of relevant experience in product development and testing leadership in manual and automated testing.
* Experience using AI in day-day testing activities

* Good experience in leading product testing across the software and hardware development lifecycle. Familiarity with Windows operating systems and policies, UFT, ALM/Jama. Knowledge in behavior-driven frameworks and scripting using Python, C# is highly desirable.

* Strong understanding of medical device regulations (e.g., FDA, CE Mark) and quality system requirements (e.g., ISO 13485).
* Expertise in test methodologies, including functional, performance, reliability, and regression testing.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional team environment.

This Job Description is intended to provide a high-level guide to the role. However, it is not intended to amend or otherwise restrict/expand the duties required by each individual employee as set out in their respective employment contract and/or as otherwise agreed between an employee and their manager.

title: Enterprise Solutions Manager
description:
This role combines people leadership with technical ownership. The manager will establish a reliable operating rhythm for the team, set priorities, coach and develop engineers, manage stakeholder expectations, and ensure that enterprise platforms and services are secure, well-documented, measurable, and responsive to business needs.
  
  
The manager will oversee capabilities including Atlassian products, Jira Service Management, Jira Assets, Zendesk, Glean, Power BI, Power Automate, and related enterprise integrations and data workflows.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
People leadership and team management
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop Enterprise Solutions Engineers in India and across the broader team.
* Set clear goals, ownership, service expectations, and development plans for each team member.
* Establish team standards for communication, documentation, quality, delivery, and operational follow-through.
* Run regular one-on-ones, team meetings, planning sessions, and performance reviews.
* Build accountability for commitments while creating a collaborative and supportive team environment.
* Recruit, onboard, mentor, and retain Enterprise Solutions talent.
* Coordinate knowledge transfer, coverage, succession planning, and cross-training so critical services do not depend on a single individual.

Portfolio, prioritization, and stakeholder management
  
  

* Own the Enterprise Solutions team backlog and prioritize work across operational support, projects, platform improvements, automation, reporting, and strategic initiatives.
* Translate business needs into clear requirements, delivery plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for Enterprise Solutions work and communicate status, risks, dependencies, and decisions to leadership.
* Establish and maintain an operating rhythm for intake, prioritization, delivery tracking, service reviews, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Corporate Support, Product Engineering, Data & AI, Information Security, Finance, Human Resources, and business stakeholders.
* Ensure commitments are realistic, visible, and delivered with appropriate quality and documentation.

Enterprise platform ownership
  
  

* Provide governance and technical direction for Atlassian products, Jira Service Management, Zendesk, Glean, Power BI, Power Automate, Jira Assets, and related platforms.
* Ensure platforms are configured, administered, monitored, and improved as reliable enterprise services.
* Establish platform roadmaps, lifecycle plans, access controls, configuration standards, and service documentation.
* Oversee provisioning, configuration, troubleshooting, vendor coordination, and platform changes.
* Ensure platform administration follows security, compliance, change-management, and data-protection requirements.

AI adoption and enablement
  
  

* Lead the assessment, piloting, implementation, governance, and adoption of AI tools such as Glean, Claude, Cursor, and Fellow.ai.
* Identify and document business cases for AI integration and measure adoption, productivity, quality, and business outcomes.
* Establish practical standards, workflows, training, and compliance procedures for responsible AI use.
* Coach the team to use AI-assisted development and automation tools responsibly to improve delivery speed and quality.

Enterprise data management and business intelligence
  
  

* Oversee the design, management, and optimization of Power BI dataflows, reports, dashboards, and supporting data processes.
* Ensure reporting requirements are translated into accurate, maintainable, and actionable business intelligence solutions.
* Establish standards for data integrity, security, accessibility, documentation, and report ownership.
* Coordinate the transition and modernization of reporting infrastructure, including potential migration toward Snowflake and partnership with the Data & AI team.

Process automation and systems integration
  
  

* Direct automation of business processes within Jira Service Management and other enterprise platforms.
* Oversee integrations using Power Automate, APIs, Python, and other middleware or automation technologies.
* Identify opportunities to remove manual effort, improve control quality, reduce operational risk, and increase service responsiveness.
* Ensure automation is tested, documented, monitored, supportable, and governed through appropriate change controls.

Asset management and service operations
  
  

* Oversee asset-management practices using Jira Assets, including hardware, software, application, service, and ownership records.
* Maintain accurate inventories and ensure alignment with compliance, lifecycle-management, and operational requirements.
* Define service measures, operational reports, escalation paths, and support procedures for Enterprise Solutions services.
* Ensure incidents, problems, requests, changes, and recurring operational work are managed consistently and used to drive improvement.
