title: Technical Lead
description:
Job Description: Team Lead – Software Development

Position Overview-

Experience- 8+ years

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on
**Team Lead – Software Development**
to lead a software development team responsible for designing, developing, and delivering high-quality enterprise applications.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in
**Java or .NET development**
, a solid understanding of the
**Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**
, and proven experience in
**Agile software development, team management, application architecture, and delivery of complex projects**
.

This role is intended for a technical leader who has experience
**building applications and projects from the ground up (greenfield development)**
, rather than primarily working on customization, maintenance, or enhancement activities. The candidate should be capable of translating business requirements into technical solutions, contributing to architecture and design decisions, creating architectural diagrams, and guiding the team through the complete development lifecycle.

The successful candidate will combine
**technical leadership, hands-on development expertise, architecture/design skills, project ownership, and people management**
.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Leadership

* Lead a team of software developers and provide technical direction, mentoring, and guidance.
* Own the technical delivery of projects from requirements analysis through design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Participate actively in technical discussions, design reviews, code reviews, and solution planning.
* Establish and enforce coding standards, development best practices, design principles, and quality standards.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues and provide appropriate solutions.
* Guide developers in selecting appropriate technologies, frameworks, tools, and development approaches.
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for the development team and key stakeholders.
* Promote best practices around maintainability, scalability, security, performance, and reliability.

2. Greenfield / Application Development

* Demonstrated experience in
  **developing applications and projects from scratch**
  , including taking ownership of a new application from concept and requirements through production deployment.
* Design and develop scalable, maintainable, and secure enterprise applications.
* Participate in requirements analysis and convert business requirements into technical specifications and implementation plans.
* Define application structure, modules, components, interfaces, data flows, and integration points.
* Develop proof-of-concepts and technical prototypes where required.
* Establish development standards and technical foundations for new applications.
* Ensure applications are designed for scalability, performance, maintainability, and future extensibility.
* Lead the team in implementing complete end-to-end application solutions rather than limiting the role to customization or minor enhancements.

3. Software Architecture & Design

* Participate in and contribute to
  **solution architecture and application architecture**
  .
* Design technical solutions for complex business and technical requirements.
* Create and maintain architectural and technical design documentation.
* Develop and review architectural diagrams, including:
* High-Level Architecture (HLA)
* Low-Level Design (LLD)
* Application/component diagrams
* System context diagrams
* Sequence diagrams
* Data-flow diagrams
* Integration diagrams
* Deployment diagrams
* Evaluate architectural options and recommend appropriate solutions based on scalability, performance, security, maintainability, and cost.
* Define application components, interfaces, APIs, services, integrations, and technology dependencies.
* Work closely with architects, product owners, business stakeholders, DevOps, QA, and infrastructure teams.
* Identify technical risks and define mitigation strategies.
* Ensure architectural decisions are aligned with enterprise standards and business objectives.

4. Java / .NET Development

The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in
**either Java or .NET**
, with a willingness and ability to work with modern enterprise development practices.

Java

Experience may include:

* Core Java
* Spring / Spring Boot
* REST APIs and web services
* Microservices
* JPA / Hibernate
* SQL and relational databases
* Messaging/integration technologies
* Enterprise application development
* Unit and integration testing

**OR**

.NET

Experience may include:

* C#
* .NET / .NET Core / modern .NET
* ASP.NET / ASP.NET Core
* Web APIs
* Entity Framework
* REST APIs and web services
* Microservices
* SQL and relational databases
* Enterprise application development
* Unit and integration testing

The candidate should be comfortable understanding existing systems as well as
**designing and building new applications from the ground up**
.

5. SDLC & Engineering Practices

* Strong understanding and practical experience across the complete
  **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**
  .
* Participate in requirements gathering, estimation, technical design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Define development tasks, technical milestones, dependencies, and delivery plans.
* Ensure development activities follow established SDLC processes and organizational standards.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to coding and design standards.
* Promote automated testing, continuous integration, and continuous delivery practices.
* Identify opportunities to improve development processes, engineering practices, and delivery efficiency.
* Ensure appropriate technical documentation is maintained throughout the project lifecycle.

6. Agile Development

* Work effectively within
  **Agile/Scrum**
  development environments.
* Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Business Analysts, QA, and other stakeholders.
* Break complex requirements into manageable technical tasks and user stories.
* Provide technical estimates and contribute to sprint planning and release planning.
* Identify and manage technical dependencies and risks.
* Ensure the team maintains a sustainable pace while meeting quality and delivery expectations.
* Promote continuous improvement and Agile engineering practices.

7. Team Management & People Leadership

* Lead, mentor, coach, and develop a team of software engineers.
* Allocate work based on team members' skills, experience, and project priorities.
* Monitor individual and team performance and provide constructive feedback.
* Conduct regular technical mentoring and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Identify skill gaps and support team members in developing their technical capabilities.
* Encourage collaboration, ownership, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Support recruitment and technical evaluation of software developers when required.
* Build a high-performing engineering culture focused on quality and delivery.
* Resolve technical and interpersonal issues within the team effectively.
* Serve as a bridge between developers, management, architects, business teams, and other stakeholders.

8. Complex Project Delivery

* Lead development teams working on
  **complex, enterprise-scale, or technically challenging projects**
  .
* Break large and complex problems into manageable technical components.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and delivery challenges.
* Drive solutions for performance, scalability, integration, security, and reliability issues.
* Manage multiple technical priorities while maintaining delivery commitments.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve project dependencies.
* Ensure successful delivery of projects within agreed scope, quality, timelines, and technical standards.
* Take ownership of technical issues through to resolution.

9. Stakeholder Management

* Work closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, Project Managers, Solution Architects, Enterprise Architects, QA, DevOps, infrastructure, and support teams.
* Understand business objectives and translate them into practical technical solutions.
* Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Provide regular updates on technical progress, risks, dependencies, and issues.
* Participate in solution discussions, requirement clarification, technical workshops, and project planning.
* Manage expectations and communicate technical constraints and trade-offs clearly.

10. Quality, Security & Performance

* Ensure software is developed according to established quality standards.
* Promote clean code, SOLID principles, design patterns, reusable components, and maintainable architecture.
* Ensure appropriate unit, integration, system, and regression testing practices.
* Identify and address application performance issues.
* Consider security requirements throughout application design and development.
* Support secure coding practices and vulnerability remediation.
* Ensure applications are scalable and resilient for expected business volumes.
* Conduct technical and design reviews to identify potential quality and architectural issues early.

If you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It’s time for a career you can be proud of.

We are developing Manufacturing and Engineering AI solutions that help employees gain insights, access knowledge, and make decisions more efficiently. The Sr. Manager, Information Systems will lead the team responsible for delivering these capabilities, serving as the strategic and operational counterpart to the Portfolio manager.
  
  
This role owns product and delivery leadership for the team, translating business needs into clear priorities, roadmap direction, and executable requirements. You will manage the development team directly, drive cross-functional alignment, and ensure delivery is aligned to business outcomes, user needs, compliance expectations, and platform strategy.
  
  
This position requires strong familiarity with manufacturing and engineering technology environments and the modern data and AI stack that supports them. You will help guide solutions that integrate with manufacturing systems, industrial data sources, and enterprise AI platforms to enable chatbots, agents, workflow automation, and decision support across manufacturing and engineering functions.

* Serve as the product and delivery lead for the team, shaping strategy, priorities, and execution plans for AI-enabled manufacturing and engineering solutions.
* Translate manufacturing, operational, and business requirements into actionable product direction, delivery milestones, and team backlogs.
* Manage and develop the engineering team directly, including performance management, coaching, career development, and organizational health.
* Partner closely with the Principal Software Engineer to align product direction with architecture, platform design, and technical standards.
* Drive cross-functional alignment across manufacturing, engineering, product, security, compliance, operations, and enterprise technology stakeholders.
* Define and maintain the team roadmap, ensuring work is sequenced effectively and tied to measurable business outcomes.
* Lead requirements discovery, solution scoping, release planning, and stakeholder communications.
* Balance demand, capacity, and priorities across multiple initiatives, ensuring the team delivers predictably and sustainably.
* Champion adoption of the team’s solutions by ensuring they are usable, supportable, and aligned to real manufacturing and engineering workflows.
* Oversee operating rhythms such as planning, status reporting, risk management, dependency management, and governance reviews.
* Support production readiness and escalation management, ensuring the team can respond effectively to issues and maintain trust in delivered solutions.
* Contribute to standards for documentation, process, lifecycle management, and service ownership for AI products and platform capabilities.

* Manufacturing and Engineering systems and industrial data sources such as Maximo, CRIS, ERP, BIM, Capital Project portfolio management, EHSS etc
* Cloud and data platforms including AWS, Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Scala, Python, and SQL.

* Production engineering practices including APIs, microservices, CI/CD, DevOps, monitoring, and observability.
* Agile/SAFe delivery using JIRA, Confluence, and standard engineering collaboration tools.

* Master's / bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
* 13 to 17 years of experience in information systems, software delivery, product delivery, or technical program leadership.
* 5+ years of experience leading teams, including direct management of engineers or technical professionals.
* Demonstrated experience translating business needs into technology roadmaps, requirements, and execution plans.
* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving engineering, product, operations, security, compliance, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of software delivery processes, agile, SAFe, SDLC, release management, and production support.
* Experience managing priorities, dependencies, and trade-offs across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at multiple organizational levels.
* Familiarity with cloud-based platforms, enterprise integrations, and modern software development practices.
* Experience operating in a regulated or highly governed environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading product-oriented engineering teams supporting AI, automation, digital workplace, or enterprise platform solutions.
* Familiarity with agentic AI, conversational systems, workflow orchestration, or knowledge management platforms.
* Experience partnering with technical architects or principal engineers on platform strategy and solution design.

title: Manager, Software Development- .NET, Cloud
description:
**Opentext - The Information Company**
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
**AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.**
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Development Manager, you will provide engineering leadership and delivery ownership for the modernization of a monolithic .NET application into containerized modern .NET (.NET 8+) microservices deployed on Kubernetes (Google Cloud Platform/GKE). Partner with architecture, product, and QA to plan and execute the migration roadmap, manage staffing and delivery for the Backend/Platform team, and ensure on-time, high-quality delivery using Agile/Scrum practices.
  
  
**What The Role Offers**

* Own end-to-end delivery of the monolith-to-microservices modernization program for the Backend/Platform team
* Plan sprints, manage backlogs, and coordinate cross-team dependencies with the UI/Frontend team and QA
* Recruit, staff, mentor, and manage performance of Principal Architects, Lead/Senior/Engineers, and QA engineers
* Report progress, risks, and budget status to senior leadership; escalate and resolve blockers
* Drive adoption of engineering best practices: code review standards, GitLab CI/CD, test automation, and DevSecOps
* Champion the .NET Framework to modern .NET (.NET 8+) migration strategy and containerization/Kubernetes rollout plans
* Facilitate architecture and design reviews together with the Principal Architect

Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across Product, Architecture, and Operations
  
  
**What You Need To Succeed**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related discipline
* 10+ years overall engineering experience with 3+ years in an engineering management/leadership role
* Hands-on background in modern .NET (.NET 8+) application development and enterprise product delivery
* Proven track record managing complex modernization/migration programs (monolith-to-microservices a strong plus)
* Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, Artifactory, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)/Linux environments
* Strong Agile/Scrum delivery experience; excellent organization, communication, and planning skills
* Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills Experience leading WPF-to-web migration initiatives
* Exposure to AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot
* Content management & Capture (IDP) domain experience would be a plus
* Experience with Kubernetes on Linux in production environments (GCP/GKE)
* Exposure to GitLab CI/CD and Artifactory for build/artifact management
* Content management/enterprise information management & Capture (IDP) domain experience would be a plus

Experience with OpenText products would be a plus
  
  
OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us at hr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

title: IS Organizational Effectiveness Manager – R&D Commercialization and PPM
description:
The IS Organizational Effectiveness Manager is responsible for enabling effective delivery across multiple Digital Product Teams supporting R&D Commercialization and PPM through strong SAFe Agile execution, Release Train leadership, Scrum Master responsibilities, and Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) adoption.
  
  
This role serves as a hands-on delivery leader responsible for coordinating cross-product planning and execution, facilitating Agile ceremonies, managing dependencies and risks, improving delivery transparency, and enabling teams to consistently deliver measurable business value.
  
  
The role will partner closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, engineering teams, business stakeholders, and Agile/DPOM enablement partners to establish scalable ways of working across multiple product teams.
  
  
**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
**Release Train & Cross-Product Delivery**

* Serve as Release Train Engineer and delivery lead across multiple Digital Product Teams, coordinating integrated planning and execution across the product landscape.
* Establish and facilitate the operating cadence required to coordinate multiple teams, products, dependencies, releases, and shared resources.
* Lead preparation and facilitation of PI Planning, ART synchronization, product-level planning, Inspect & Adapt events, and other cross-team SAFe ceremonies.
* Maintain visibility into cross-team dependencies, risks, impediments, milestones, capacity, and delivery commitments.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Management to translate product roadmaps and business priorities into executable delivery plans.
* Drive resolution of delivery impediments and escalate systemic risks or decisions requiring leadership intervention.
* Coordinate with other Release Train Engineers, Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and delivery leaders where work spans ARTs, products, or organizational boundaries.

**Scrum Master & Team Delivery Responsibilities**

* Provide hands-on Scrum Master leadership for product teams as required while maintaining cross-team Release Train responsibilities.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Coach teams on effective backlog management, story readiness, estimation, capacity planning, prioritization, and definition of done.
* Help teams identify and remove impediments that affect delivery, quality, flow, or predictability.
* Promote team ownership, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Adapt Agile practices pragmatically based on team maturity, product needs, and organizational context rather than focusing solely on process compliance.

**Product Operating Model Enablement**

* Support maturation of Amgen's Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) & SAFe Agile frameworks across participating product teams.
* Help translate DPOM & SAFe Agile principles into practical delivery processes, roles, ceremonies, governance, and decision-making mechanisms.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Management to strengthen the connection between business outcomes, product roadmaps, prioritization, capacity, and technology delivery.
* Help teams evolve from project-oriented execution toward persistent, outcome-oriented digital product delivery.
* Clarify roles, decision rights, handoffs, and operating expectations across Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, engineering teams, and delivery roles.
* Partner with enterprise Agile and DPOM enablement teams to align local practices with evolving enterprise standards and strategy.

**Delivery Governance, Metrics & Reporting**

* Establish and maintain consistent Agile delivery practices and JIRA structures across participating product teams.
* Develop delivery reporting that provides Product Owners and leadership with clear visibility into roadmap execution, capacity, progress, dependencies, risks, and impediments.
* Use meaningful delivery and product metrics to assess flow, predictability, quality, throughput, risk, and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Facilitate regular delivery and program reviews with Product Owners and stakeholders.
* Ensure metrics support decision-making and improvement rather than becoming administrative reporting exercises.
* Support consistent tracking of product roadmap commitments, releases, milestones, and value drops.

**Agile Coaching & Continuous Improvement**

* Coach Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, engineering teams, and other stakeholders on effective SAFe, Agile, Lean, and product delivery practices.
* Assess team and Release Train maturity and identify practical opportunities to improve planning, execution, flow, collaboration, and predictability.
* Develop and promote reusable delivery practices, templates, playbooks, and standards that can scale across product teams.
* Foster shared learning and consistency while allowing teams flexibility based on product and delivery needs.
* Encourage experimentation and iterative improvement of the delivery operating model.

**Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Build strong working relationships with Product Owners, Product Management, business stakeholders, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, engineering teams, and enterprise enablement partners.
* Facilitate alignment when priorities, dependencies, resource capacity, or delivery expectations span multiple product teams.
* Communicate delivery progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and improvement opportunities clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
* Influence teams and stakeholders through facilitation, expertise, and data rather than formal reporting authority.
* Collaborate effectively across geographically distributed teams and time zones.

**Must-Have Skills**
**Required Functional Skills and Qualifications**

* Experience in Agile technology or digital product delivery, including hands-on experience as a Release Train Engineer, Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, Product Owner, or similar role.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating delivery across multiple Agile or Digital Product Teams.
* Strong working knowledge of SAFe, Scrum, Agile principles, product delivery, and continuous improvement.
* Hands-on experience facilitating PI Planning, Agile Release Train activities, Scrum ceremonies, dependency management, risk management, and cross-team planning.
* Experience establishing and managing Agile delivery processes and reporting through JIRA or comparable Agile lifecycle management tools.
* Demonstrated ability to identify delivery impediments and facilitate resolution across organizational and team boundaries.
* Strong facilitation, communication, stakeholder-management, and influencing skills.
* Ability to operate effectively through influence without direct people-management authority.
* Experience working with globally distributed technology and business teams.
* Ability to connect Agile delivery practices with product roadmaps, business outcomes, stakeholder value, and enterprise priorities.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience working within or transitioning toward a Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) or comparable product-centric technology operating model.
* SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE), SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Practice Consultant, or comparable Agile certification.
* Experience supporting multiple Digital Product Teams or an Agile Release Train simultaneously.
* Experience designing or improving Agile delivery operating models, governance structures, JIRA workflows, metrics, or reporting.

title: Control panel Project estimation
description:
# Job Description – Project Estimation Engineer (Control Panel Projects)

Full-Time

Taloja, Navi Mumbai

Company: Synergie Controls & Systems Pvt. Ltd.\

Department: Projects / Estimation\

Designation: Project Estimation Engineer – Control Panels\

Experience: 3–7 Years\

Reporting To: Estimation Manager / Operations Head

## 1. Job Purpose

Synergie Controls & Systems Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced Project Estimation Engineer specializing in electrical control panel manufacturing and industrial automation projects.

The candidate will be responsible for understanding customer enquiries, studying technical specifications, preparing detailed Bill of Materials (BOM), estimating project costs, preparing techno-commercial offers and coordinating with sales, design, purchase and project execution teams to ensure accurate and competitive quotations.

## 2. Key Responsibilities

A. Enquiry Study & Technical Evaluation

- Study customer enquiries, RFQs, technical specifications and tender documents.

- Understand electrical SLDs, control schematics, GA drawings and technical requirements.

- Identify project scope, exclusions, deviations and customer-specific requirements.

- Evaluate technical requirements for PLC, MCC, PCC, VFD and automation panels.

- Identify technical gaps and seek clarification from customers wherever required.

B. BOM Preparation & Cost Estimation

- Prepare detailed BOM for electrical control panels and automation projects.

- Select suitable electrical components based on technical specifications.

- Prepare component-wise cost estimation, including:

- Siemens PLC, HMI and I/O modules.

- Siemens VFDs and motor control equipment.

- MCCB, ACB, MCB, contactors and relays.

- Control transformers, SMPS and power supplies.

- Terminal blocks, cables, ducts and accessories.

- Enclosures, mounting plates and panel accessories.

- Busbars, copper components and electrical hardware.

- Calculate panel fabrication, assembly, wiring and testing costs.

- Estimate engineering, programming, commissioning and installation costs.

- Calculate project overheads, contingency, transportation and other applicable expenses.

- Ensure accurate costing and optimum material selection.

C. Panel Engineering & Design Coordination

- Coordinate with EPLAN design engineers for technical inputs and drawing requirements.

- Review panel GA drawings, electrical schematics and BOMs.

- Understand panel sizing, IP protection, form of separation and heat dissipation requirements.

- Evaluate Rittal TS8, VX and PS series enclosures and other panel enclosure requirements.

- Identify cost optimization opportunities without compromising quality and technical specifications.

D. Vendor Coordination & Procurement

- Obtain quotations from Siemens, Rittal and other electrical component suppliers.

- Coordinate with the purchase department for updated component prices.

- Compare vendor quotations and evaluate alternate makes.

- Maintain updated pricing databases for commonly used electrical components.

- Negotiate with vendors wherever required to achieve competitive project costing.

E. Commercial Offer Preparation

- Prepare detailed techno-commercial offers.

- Prepare cost sheets with material, labour, engineering and service costs.

- Calculate gross profit margins and selling prices.

- Prepare technical compliance statements and deviation lists.

- Define payment terms, delivery schedules, warranty and offer validity.

- Ensure quotations are submitted within the committed timeline.

- Support the sales team during customer negotiations and price revisions.

F. Project Handover & Coordination

- Conduct estimation handover meetings with the project execution team after order confirmation.

- Explain costing assumptions, scope of supply and technical specifications.

- Highlight critical components, delivery requirements and project risks.

- Coordinate with design, purchase, production and project teams to resolve technical and commercial queries.

## 3. Technical Knowledge & Skills Required

The candidate should have good knowledge of:

| Area | Required Knowledge |

| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |

| PLC Panels | Siemens S7-1200, S7-1500 |

| VFD Panels | Siemens Sinamics G120, S120 |

| MCC Panels | Motor feeders, DOL, Star-Delta, VFD feeders |

| PCC Panels | ACB, MCCB, busbar sizing |

| Automation | PLC, HMI, remote I/O, control systems |

| Electrical Components | Siemens, Schneider, ABB, L&T, Phoenix Contact |

| Enclosures | Rittal TS8, VX, PS Series |

| Drawings | SLD, GA, control schematics |

| Software | MS Excel, AutoCAD; EPLAN knowledge preferred |

## 4. Educational Qualification

- Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering.

- 3–7 years of relevant experience in electrical control panel estimation or industrial automation project costing.

- Experience in control panel manufacturing companies is preferred.

- Candidates with experience in industrial automation and Siemens products will be preferred.

## 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the Project Estimation Engineer will be evaluated based on:

| KPI | Performance Measurement |

| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |

| Estimation Accuracy | Actual project cost vs. estimated cost |

| Quotation Turnaround | Timely submission of quotations |

| BOM Accuracy | Minimum errors in BOM preparation |

| Cost Optimization | Identification of cost-saving opportunities |

| Gross Profit Margin | Achievement of targeted project GP |

| Vendor Coordination | Timely receipt of competitive quotations |

| Technical Compliance | Accuracy of technical specifications |

| Handover Quality | Complete and accurate project handover |

## 6. Behavioural Competencies

- Strong analytical and numerical skills.

- Good technical understanding of electrical control panels.

- Attention to detail and accuracy.

- Ability to work under tight quotation deadlines.

- Good communication and coordination skills.

- Commercial awareness and cost-conscious approach.

- Ownership and accountability for assigned enquiries.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple enquiries.

## 7. Job Location & Working Conditions

- Location: Synergie Controls & Systems Pvt. Ltd., Taloja, Navi Mumbai.

- Employment Type: Full-Time, On-site.

- Working Days: 6 Days a Week.

- Salary: As per experience and competency.

## 8. Expected Deliverables

The employee is expected to independently handle the following:

1. Study customer RFQs and prepare technical estimation.

2. Prepare complete BOM and cost sheets.

3. Obtain and compare supplier quotations.

4. Prepare techno-commercial offers.

5. Ensure estimation accuracy and profitability.

6. Submit quotations within committed timelines.

7. Maintain an updated estimation and component price database.

8. Coordinate with internal departments for smooth project handover.

## My recommendation for Synergie Controls

I recommend keeping this position focused on Project Estimation rather than general sales estimation.

The engineer should be capable of independently estimating the following types of projects:

- PLC & Automation Control Panels.

- MCC & PCC Panels.

- VFD / Drive Panels.

- Siemens PLC and Drive System Integration.

- Control Desks and Operator Consoles.

- Industrial Automation Upgradation and Retrofit Projects.

- Complete Electrical and Automation Projects for Rolling Mills and Steel Plants.

Important: During recruitment, conduct a practical estimation test. Give the candidate one PLC panel enquiry with a technical specification and ask them to prepare:

- Complete BOM.

- Component selection.

- Material costing.

- Panel fabrication and assembly costing.

- Engineering and testing charges.

- Final selling price with gross profit calculation.

This will help you identify candidates who can actually handle estimation independently rather than candidates who only know how to prepare quotations.

**Title: Senior Consultant, OT Cybersecurity**

Support clients in improving cybersecurity across OT, ICS, and industrial environments. The role will involve solution design and deployment, client engagement, project delivery, proposal support, and team coordination.

description:
**Company Description**
HRnest is a technology-driven HR solutions provider focused on transforming how organizations manage their people and processes. The company designs and integrates innovative HRMS platforms, payroll management, and compliance solutions to streamline HR operations. By combining advanced technology with practical HR expertise, HRnest helps businesses enhance the employee experience and adapt to a dynamic workforce landscape. The team is committed to driving digital transformation in HR, enabling organizations to operate more efficiently and make informed, data-backed decisions. Interested partners and clients can connect with HRnest at info@hrnest.co.

The Marketing Content Writer is a full-time, on-site role based in the Pune Division. This role is responsible for planning, writing, and optimizing marketing content across web pages, blogs, email campaigns, social media, and other digital channels to support brand awareness and lead generation. Daily tasks include conducting research on HR technology trends, developing content strategies aligned with marketing objectives, and producing clear, engaging copy tailored to different target audiences. * Experience creating content for B2B technology or HR/HRMS products is an advantage.

title: Manufacturing Engineering Specialist
description:
Imagine yourself…
  
  

* Growing your expertise and expanding your skillset with every project.
* Thriving in a supportive team environment that inspires you to strive for excellence.
* Joining a company with a proven track record of success and an exciting future.

At Trojan Technologies, you have the power to make it possible.
  
  
Trojan Technologies, a Veralto company, plays a vital role in making the various stages of the water treatment process more effective and efficient. Our products and services have applications across municipal wastewater, drinking water, environmental contaminant treatment, and residential water treatment, along with ultra-purification of water used in food and beverage manufacturing, pharmaceutical processing and semiconductor applications.
  
  
When you join the Trojan Technologies team and the broader Veralto network, you become part of a unique culture where purpose meets possibility: where the work we do makes an everyday impact on the world’s vital water resources, and where you’ll have the power to deepen your skillset, own your ambition, and fuel your career growth.
  
  
Take a moment to watch our video: The Power to Make Things Possible (https://vimeo.com/burnsmarketing/review/823050239/c5d19b300c)
  
  
We offer:
  
  

* Flexible working hours
* Professional onboarding and training options
* Powerful team looking forward to working with you
* Career coaching and development opportunities
* Health benefits

Reporting to the Manager, Manufacturing Engineering, the Manufacturing Engineering Specialist is responsible for Determining the optimal manufacturing methods and processes for producing company products from start-up, building the product line, through satisfactory production. This includes analyzing engineering design documents to establish manufacturing methods and processes to manufacture a component, creating conceptual sketches and initiating the design and building of required tooling. Describes outside vendor services needed for the manufacture of a component. Establishes outsourced vendor manufacturing & quality plans. drive improvement to product cost, quality and performance by utilizing Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) methodologies.
  
  
This position is part of the
*Manufacturing Team*
located in
*Pune*
and will be on-site work Model.
  
  
**In this role, a typical day will look like:**

* Troubleshoot manufacturing issues and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime.
* Develop and maintain detailed work instructions, manufacturing routings, and Weld Procedure Specifications (WPS) to ensure high-purity standards are consistently met.
* Support equipment setup, process adjustments, and operator training.
* Design new tooling, jigs and fixtures
* Develop, evaluate, and improve manufacturing methods for fabricating chambers from scratch including sheet metal cutting and CNC rolling.
* Specify, source, and commission new fabrication equipment, including automated welding cells, orbital welders, and electropolishing lines.
* Contribute to and lead engineering projects and initiatives, including new product introductions and process upgrades.
* Identify opportunities to improve safety, quality, and productivity.
* Participate in lean manufacturing activities such as 5S, kaizen events, and waste reduction projects.
* Collect and analyze production data to support decision‑making.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to implement improvements and resolve issues.
* Support and lead root‑cause investigations and CDT&R activities.
* Lead & execute Management of Change (MOC) process for Manufacturing Engineering related tasks.
* XIV. Partner with Quality Assurance to ensure vessels comply with relevant codes (e.g., ASME Section VIII, National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) standards, or regional pressure vessel regulations).
* XV. Occasional travel of up to 10% is required to support activities at other company sites, customer locations, or off-site facilities as part of the responsibilities of this role.

**Must-Have Technical Skills**

* Pressure vessel manufacturing experience (preferred), reactors fabrication
* Laser, plasma cutting, and CNC sheet metal bending knowledge
* TIG/GTAW welding experience and understanding of welding procedures
* CAD software proficiency (SolidWorks, AutoCAD)
* Manufacturing automation experience
* Lean Manufacturing and Kaizen implementation experience
* Root Cause Analysis and Continuous Improvement methodologies
* Mechanical Engineering degree/ Manufacturing Degree

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 3-5 years of manufacturing engineering experience.
* Strong hands-on exposure to fabrication, welding, and pressure vessel manufacturing.
* Experienced in automation projects and manufacturing process optimization.
* Skilled in Lean/VES tools, Kaizen events, and productivity improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and strong project execution capabilities.
* Able to collaborate effectively with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, and Engineering teams.

Trojan Technologies is proud to be part of the Water Quality segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto’s vibrant global network of 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment
*where purpose meets possibility*
: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you’ll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we’re Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™—and building rewarding careers along the way.

title: Senior Consultant - Strategic Transport & Mobility Advisory
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
Jacobs are seeking a Senior Consultant to join our Strategic Transport & Mobility Advisory team to support high-impact transport and mobility advisory projects across the region. If you are passionate about rethinking mobility, advising clients, and solving complex urban transport challenges through delivery transformation and innovation, this role offers an exciting platform to accelerate your career.
  
  
As a Senior Consultant, you will support the delivery of multidisciplinary transport and mobility advisory services, working alongside project leaders and cross-functional teams. Your responsibilities will include
  
  

* Supporting the delivery of strategic transport and mobility advisory project, including urban mobility strategies, public transport policy, EV/AV deployment plans, freight and logistics advisory, and transport-related feasibility studies.
* Supporting project tasks, developing client-ready outputs, and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. Supporting the development of policy frameworks, business cases, and implementation plans for public and private sectors.
* Conducting research and analysis on emerging mobility trends and technologies (e.g. smart mobility, MaaS, low-carbon transport, ITS)
* Support the management of stakeholder consultation activities and preparing reports, presentations, and briefing materials for high-level government and private clients.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in transport planning, urban planning, economics, engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in transport or mobility consulting, with exposure to strategic advisory projects.
* Ability to work across a variety of transport topics, such as urban mobility, integrated transport planning, policy development or freight and logistics.
* Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in developing high-quality reports, presentations and strategic insights for clients.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. title: Electromagnetic Capability (EMC) Engineer
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard-working mobility solutions. We’re making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!
  
  
**We are looking for Electromagnetic Capability (EMC) Engineer**
Are you a passionate and experienced EMC Engineer looking to make a significant impact on cutting-edge projects? Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where your expertise in electromagnetic compatibility ensures the reliability and performance of critical systems? Siemens is seeking a talented EMC Engineer with 4-6 years of experience to join our innovative team and contribute to the development of world-class solutions.
  
  
At Siemens, we're dedicated to pioneering technology that transforms industries and enriches lives. As an EMC Engineer, you'll play a crucial role in ensuring our products meet stringent electromagnetic compatibility standards, from initial design to final validation. If you're ready to apply your deep knowledge of EMC design, testing, and problem-solving to complex challenges, we encourage you to apply!.
  
  
**You’ll make a difference by**
As an Experienced EMC Engineer, you will be a key contributor to our product development lifecycle, ensuring electromagnetic compatibility across various systems. Your main responsibilities will include:
  
  

* EMC Design & Compliance:

+ Enforce and uphold EMC design and manufacturing rules throughout the product lifecycle.
+ Prepare detailed clause-by-clause analyses of customer specifications during the tender phase, including associated cost estimates.
+ Develop comprehensive EMC Transverse Requirements Specifications for projects, identifying EMC requirements and allocating them effectively to sub-systems.
+ Create detailed EMC Control Plans, defining EMC activities, deliverables, design requirements, and test strategies based on project EMC requirements.
+ Conduct thorough design verification, including general architecture, layout of subsystems, electrical interfaces, and HV/MV/LV cabling.

* EMC Testing & Validation:

+ Prepare precise EMC test specifications (both laboratory and field test plans).
+ Review and verify EMC test specifications and reports provided by subsystem suppliers.
+ Execute EMC tests on test benches and/or on-site, providing accurate and timely associated test reports.
+ Compile comprehensive EMC Compliance Files upon project completion.

* Problem Solving & Improvement:

+ Diagnose and resolve complex EMC problems encountered during projects.
+ Actively participate in the definition, development, and continuous improvement of EMC guidelines, processes, design rules, reference solutions, and return-on-experience documentation.
+ Contribute to the creation of design review checklists, project document templates, test specifications, and the evaluation of simulation tools and test instrumentation.
+ Propose and lead EMC R&D initiatives to advance our capabilities.

**Desired Skills:**
We're looking for a highly motivated individual with a solid foundation in EMC engineering and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Engineering (Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related field).
* Specialization or advanced coursework in Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC).
* Mandatory: 4-6 years of professional experience specifically within the EMC domain.
* Strong understanding of Power electronics, Electrotechnics, and relevant industry applications (e.g., Railways: Rolling Stock, Traction Equipment, Signaling, Communication equipment).
* In-depth knowledge of sources of electromagnetic disturbances and electromagnetic phenomena.
* Expertise in EMC design rules and their practical application, including earthing and bonding principles for electrical equipment on trains.
* Proficiency with relevant EMC standards (e.g., IEC, EN, ISO, FCC, CISPR, MIL-STD), with specific experience in the EN 50121 series (e.g., EN 50121-3-1, EN 50121-3-2) and other rolling stock standards highly preferred.
* Hands-on experience with EMC testing, including test procedures, test instrumentation, and practical testing methodologies.
* Familiarity with EMC numerical simulation tools and practices.
* Demonstrated experience in EMC project management and coordination.
* Advanced level of English (conversational, writing, and reading) for effective global collaboration.
* High degree of autonomy, proactivity, and reactivity.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical information, convince stakeholders, and synthesize findings.
* A collaborative mindset, eager to share information and experience within the EMC Network.

**Soft Skills**
**Join us and be yourself!**
We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
  
  
**Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.**
This role is based in Bangalore/Pune. You might be required to visit other locations within India and outside. In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting - and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.
  
  
Find out more about mobility at: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/mobility.html and about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers

description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
At Workday, we bring technical rigor, customer empathy, and a spirit of fun to enterprise software. Our support team underpins operational excellence across Workday's digital experience, AI/ML platform, and Agent Factory initiative. Workday’s Agent Factory is our internal engine that builds, trains, and deploys autonomous AI agents to execute complex HR and Finance workflows, including expense processing, hiring, and workforce scheduling. We partner with core engineering to eliminate bottlenecks, maintain high platform availability, and ensure system reliability for our global customer base.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a customer-focused Support Engineer to drive incident resolution, root-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimisation across Workday’s enterprise platform and autonomous AI agent workflows. In this high-visibility role, you will analyze system metrics, debug cloud-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, and manage critical customer escalations within strict SLAs. You will also partner directly with engineering and data science teams through feature iteration and optimisation. A key part of this role involves hands-on AI evaluation: analysing LLM outputs, reviewing conversation logs, and digging into system traces to spot failure modes and translate those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Enterprise SaaS & Functional Domain Expertise: Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise applications to validate AI responses and assist in troubleshooting functional processing errors.
* Hands-On AI Evaluation: Review LLM outputs, conversation logs, and execution traces to identify edge cases, hallucinations, and routine failure modes. Perform structured data labeling and report findings to senior engineering staff.
* Technical Troubleshooting & RCA: Assist in root-cause analysis for software defects and pipeline execution failures using monitoring tools like Kibana and Grafana, following established diagnostic runbooks.
* Cloud & LLM Diagnostics: Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.
* Incident & Queue Management: Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on-call rotations.
* Customer Communication: Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high-stakes escalations.
* Database & Code Diagnostics: Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
* Documentation & Team Collaboration: Maintain detailed investigation logs in Jira, ServiceNow, or Salesforce, help maintain team runbooks, and flag recurring issue trends to senior engineers and product teams.

**About You**
**Basic Qualifications (Required)**
Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.
  
  
Technical & Diagnostic Skills:
  
  

* Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
* Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command-line tools.

Cloud & Monitoring Systems:
  
  

* Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.

AI & LLM Exposure:
  
  

* Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.

Triage & Operations:
  
  

* Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.

Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).
* Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
* History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer-facing teams.
* Strong active problem-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi-tiered enterprise systems.

Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  
  
Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.

These elements are vital to providing continuous support to our global customer base. Your willingness to adapt to these scheduling requirements is crucial for the role.
  
  
In a structured team environment, you will be encouraged to engage in continuous learning and regular practice of existing product knowledge. As a Sr. Functional Analyst, you have a unique opportunity to grow professionally while significantly contributing to the success of our clients and the organization.

**Qualifications**
Education:
  
  
A Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent experience will be considered.

* 2+ years of relevant experience in supporting enterprise products, focusing on troubleshooting and resolving customer-reported issues.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proven ability to manage high-priority cases in a fast-paced, customer-centric environment.
* Hands-on experience in ERP support is highly preferred, including:

* Basic troubleshooting and resolving system-level issues related to performance and configuration.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Familiarity with debugging and troubleshooting in Unix/Linux and Windows environments.
* Basic knowledge of scripting (e.g., Shell) and SQL for issue diagnosis and resolution.
* Understanding of database management principles and system configurations.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality service.

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.

title: Process & Project Engineer (Water & Wastewater Treatment)
description:
About Us

Established in 2010 in Faridabad, Eco Pro Tech is an established manufacturer, supplier, and environmental engineering solutions provider specializing in industrial and domestic wastewater treatment systems. We deliver end-to-end solutions including Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP), Sewage Treatment Plants (STP), Reverse Osmosis (RO) systems, and environmental consultancy services across India.

Job Overview

We are looking for a technically proficient and detail-oriented
**Process & Project Engineer**
to join our core engineering team in Faridabad. In this role, you will lead AutoCAD drafting, technical proposal preparation, cost estimation, and process design for new ETP, STP, and RO projects, ensuring solutions meet regulatory norms and client requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* **Process & System Design:**
  Perform process sizing and design calculations for ETP, STP (MBBR/SBR/ASP), and RO/filtration systems.
* **AutoCAD Drafting:**
  Prepare detailed engineering drawings including Process Flow Diagrams (PFD), Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&ID), hydraulic flow sheets, and general plant layout drawings.
* **Cost Estimation & BOQ:**
  Prepare comprehensive Bills of Quantities (BOQ), costing sheets, and material estimates for mechanical, piping, and electromechanical equipment.
* **Design Proposals & Tenders:**
  Draft compelling techno-commercial proposals, tender submissions, and scope-of-work documents for prospective clients.
* **Vendor & Project Coordination:**
  Coordinate with internal fabrication teams and equipment vendors to verify technical specifications, component pricing, and project delivery schedules.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* **Education:**
  B.Tech / B.E. / Diploma in Chemical, Environmental, or Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience:**
  1–3 years of hands-on experience in design, estimation, and drafting for water and wastewater treatment systems (ETP / STP / RO). Energetic freshers with strong AutoCAD design projects in wastewater treatment are also welcome.
* **Software Proficiency:**
* **Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD (2D)**
  .
* Strong working knowledge of
  **MS Excel**
  (for estimation, BOQ, and costing templates) and MS Word.
* **Technical Knowledge:**
  Clear understanding of wastewater parameters (BOD, COD, TSS, TDS, pH), treatment technologies, pumping systems, and chemical dosing.

Benefits & Perks

* Direct exposure to end-to-end industrial turnkey projects.
* Opportunity to handle independent project estimation and system design.
* Friendly, growth-oriented engineering work culture.

title: BESS Analyst (Design & Estimations)/ BESS Manager – Design, Engineering & Cost Estimation
description:
**Company Description**
Established in 2002, ib vogt GmbH is specialized in the Development, Design and Engineering, Financing, EPC and Operation of solar power and provides turnkey solar power plant solutions to investors internationally.
  
  
As a manufacturer-independent integrated developer, the company focuses on tailor-made solar power plant solutions that maximize lifecycle performance and returns.
  
  
Since 2009, ib vogt has commissioned plants with a capacity of almost 2 Gigawatt. We employ over 840 specialists, in all areas of the solar power plant value chain in over 40 countries. The company operates internationally from offices in Spain Germany, Italy, Netherlands, France, Poland, USA, Australia, United Kingdom, Panama, India and Southeast Asia.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Description:**
We are seeking a highly motivated and technically proficient
**Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) Manager**
with 5–10 years of hands-on experience in the
**design, engineering, techno-commercial evaluation, and cost estimation**
of BESS solutions in India. The ideal candidate will bring a deep understanding of various BESS technologies, their application in hybrid renewable projects (Solar, Wind, or both), and strong cost modelling capabilities for systems ranging from
**1 MWh to 100 MWh**
.
  
  
This role is critical to evaluating BESS deployment for utility-scale projects, optimizing technical configurations, and supporting investment-grade proposals.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* Lead technical and financial feasibility assessments for BESS deployments integrated with solar, wind, or hybrid renewable energy projects.
* Drive battery sizing optimization based on project needs—such as peak shifting, load smoothing, frequency regulation, or energy arbitrage.
* Prepare and validate cost estimates including CAPEX, OPEX, EPC costs, commissioning, and lifecycle expenses.
* Develop Levelized Cost of Storage (LCOS) models for multiple BESS architectures (e.g., centralized vs distributed).
* Conduct system design using modelling tools, ensuring compliance with performance requirements and cost effectiveness.
* Collaborate with internal teams (engineering, BD, EPC, O&M) and external stakeholders (vendors, consultants) to align technical design and commercial goals.
* Evaluate and benchmark vendor offers for battery packs, PCS, EMS, and BoP equipment; provide Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis.
* Stay updated with policy, regulatory, and market developments impacting energy storage deployment in India (e.g., IEGC, CEA guidelines, SECI tenders).
* Support business development and proposal teams with techno-commercial inputs, tender documentation, and client presentations.
* Contribute to internal knowledge development, standardization of BESS cost libraries, and design templates.

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, or Energy Systems Engineering.
* Proficient in BESS technologies (Li-ion, Flow, LFP, NMC, etc.) and battery sizing logic for multiple use cases.
* Demonstrated experience in cost modelling using MS Excel, Python, or similar analytical tools.
* Working knowledge of simulation and system design software like HOMER, PVSyst, SAM, MATLAB, or similar.
* Familiarity with safety codes, international standards (e.g., UL 9540, NFPA 855, IEEE standards).
* Strong documentation, presentation, and communication skills.
* Understanding of Indian electricity market dynamics, ancillary services, peak tariffs, and storage tenders.

**Experience**

* 5–10 years of relevant experience in BESS design, costing, and system integration—preferably in Indian or South Asian market context.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Exposure to utility-scale BESS projects with >10 MWh capacity.
* Experience in pre-bid engineering for SECI, NTPC, or DISCOM storage tenders.
* Certification or training in energy storage or grid integration is a plus.

Additional Information
  
  
**We Offer You**

* A truly international working environment with colleagues from all over the world
* An open-minded, friendly and highly motivated team.
* Great opportunities for professional and personal development
* Interesting and challenging tasks
* Competitive remuneration (based on experience)

We believe that embracing diverse perspectives drives innovation and helps us better serve the global communities we operate in. As an equal opportunity employer, we provide employment opportunities without regard to age, ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy or maternity, marriage and civil partnership, or any other protected status.*

****Preferred Qualifications****

title: Product Engineer
description:
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We're looking for a
**Product Engineer**
to help define, promote, and deploy interface solutions for hardware-assisted acceleration using Veloce emulation and prototyping solutions. As part of our worldwide Veloce experts team, you'll work with leading-edge semiconductor and systems customers on pre- and post-silicon validation, verification, and software bring-up of complex SoC and FPGA designs. You'll leverage advances in co-emulation technologies and Veloce VirtuaLAB-based solutions, bringing strong technical expertise, leadership, and a passion for innovation to drive customer success.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Assist Application Engineers (AEs) and customers with the integration and debugging of interface solutions in a hardware-assisted verification environment.
* Create or support example designs for solutions that use QEMU-based test software.
* Develop and deliver technical training presentations to the Siemens field team and customers, focusing on interface solutions for Veloce emulation and prototyping platforms.
* Drive the adoption of Veloce technology at customer sites by applying hands-on technical expertise and working directly with customers to ensure successful technical outcomes.
* Deliver exceptional technical customer support to build strong relationships and ensure long-term customer satisfaction.
* Work closely with the Sales team to develop and execute strategies that expand the business.
* Provide product feedback and enhancement ideas to the product development teams.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues while working closely with team members to ensure customer success.
* Communicate customers' technical requirements to the Product Marketing team.
* Assist other engineers in the design, development, and implementation of large-scale solutions across multiple software products and hardware platforms.
* Provide business and technical feedback to software and hardware development teams.
* Prepare and deliver in-depth technical papers and presentations for customer management and technical conferences.
* Work independently on complex projects with minimal supervision, exercising sound judgment and discretion.

**Required Qualifications**
:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree with 5+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree with 3+ years of relevant experience.
* Familiarity with Verilog and SystemVerilog.
* Experience using UVM-based or SystemC-based verification environments.
* Understanding of one or more industry-standard interface protocols, such as PCIe, Ethernet, AMBA-based protocols, or memory interface protocols.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with memory interface protocols such as DDR5, LPDDR5/LPDDR6, HBM3/HBM4, and/or SPI NOR/NAND.
* Experience working with the DDR PHY Interface (DFI).
* Previous customer-facing experience, such as an Application Engineer at an emulation or prototyping systems provider.

**Why Siemens**
We are Siemens:
  
  
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.
  
  
You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
**Compensation & Benefits**
The primary locations for this opportunity are Cairo, Egypt and Noida, India. The applicable salary ranges for these locations are:
  
  
**Cairo, Egypt: $23, 900 - $47,800
  
  
Noida, India: ₹1,741,100 - ₹3,134,000 INR**
The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/
  
  
This position may also be posted in additional locations beyond those specified above. For such locations, the applicable salary ranges and benefits will be disclosed by the Talent Acquisition Partner at the time of initial contact, in accordance with local legal requirements.
  
  
**Our Commitment to You**
We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from all talented individuals. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: Senior Executive - Accounts
description:
Halma is a global group of life-saving technologies companies, driven by a clear purpose. We are an FTSE 100 company with headquarters in the UK and operations in 23 countries, including regional hubs in India, China, Brazil, and the US.

Our diverse group of nearly 50 global companies specialise in market leading technologies that push the boundaries of science and technology.

Halma India fulfils the potential of the region by harnessing the diverse talents, expertise, infrastructure, and operational resources. At Halma India, We have a team of over 280 professionals representing commercial, digital, business support group and support functions across our seven offices in India, two in Bengaluru and one each in Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Thanjavur, Vadodara, and Ahmedabad.

**Position Objective**
----------------------

The Senior Accounts Executive will ensure the financial records of Halma, specially on AR and Inventory, are maintained accurately in conformance to the accounting policies, internal controls and the statutory requirements and thereby minimizing financial risk the organization is exposed to. He / She will also be responsible to prepare and provide various reports and analysis.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Invoicing & Accounts Receivable**

* Ensure timely and accurate posting of customer receipts, invoices and credit notes in the ERP system.
* Manage and monitor customer credit limits in ERP in accordance with the credit policy.
* Maintain customer credit assessment reports and related trackers.
* Ensure export invoices are generated accurately and all applicable documents, including e-Invoices and e-Way Bills are prepared and issued on time.
* Ensure accurate preparation of recharge calculations and timely submission of OPCO invoices.
* Prepare and review Accounts Receivable ageing reports, proactively monitor overdue receivables and ensure timely closure of outstanding reconciling items.
* Coordinate with customers, Sales teams, and OPCO representatives to ensure timely collections and resolution of payment disputes.

### **Inventory Accounting and Records Maintenance**

* Coordinate periodic physical inventory verification and reconcile inventory variances with ERP records.
* Process inventory adjustment and write-off entries after obtaining necessary approvals.
* Perform periodic reconciliation of Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and purchase accounts to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Calculate and account for inventory obsolescence provisions and debtors provisions in accordance with company policies and accounting standards.

### **Product Pricing & SVB Compliances**

* Support business teams with product pricing calculations and ensure product pricing is accurately maintained and updated in ERP.
* Coordinate Special Valuation Branch (SVB) documentation, submissions, and compliance requirements.
* Maintain proper documentation and trackers for customs and SVB-related matters.

### **Audits & Book Closures**

* Prepare monthly Accounts Receivable schedules, reconciliations, and management reports and update the balances in Tagetik.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close activities within defined timelines.
* Provide required schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documents for statutory, internal, tax, and group audits.

### **Other Activities**

* Ensure EDPMS & GR Waivers are timely closed with bank as per RBI guidelines.
* Prepare various ad-hoc reports and maintain updated trackers.
* Ensure timely and accurate posting of necessary journal entries in the ERP system.
* Act as a backup for other activities related to other finance functions as and when required.

### **Process Improvement Initiatives**

* Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation within the Accounts Receivable function.
* Develop and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and process documentation.
* Support ERP enhancements, testing, and system improvement initiatives.
* Guide junior team members and contribute to knowledge sharing and process standardization.

**Critical Success Factors**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of accounting principles, accounting standards and indirect taxes.
* Good understanding of Accounts Receivable, inventory accounting, customs regulations, and import/export compliance.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems.
* Consistently delivers high-quality work within defined timelines.
* Communicating effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Proactive, flexible, and collaborative approach to achieving team and organizational objectives.

**Academic Qualification**
--------------------------

* CA Inter / CMA Inter with 1–2 years of experience in Finance & Accounts (post articleship).
* B.Com / M.Com with very good knowledge of accounting concepts and 5–6 years of experience in Finance & Accounts.
* Experience from Manufacturing or Trading companies, preferable.

**Experience**
--------------

* 3–4 years of experience in corporate accounting and taxation.
* Experience in ERP Accounting software and Automation Tools.

**Competencies**
----------------

* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and demonstrate ownership.
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Collaborative and adaptable approach with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Adheres to ethical standards and company policies.

Halma India is a Great Place to Work® certified organisation. Here’s why working with us is fulfilling:

  

**We offer a safe and respectful workplace**, where everyone can be who they ‘REALLY’ are, feel free to bring their whole selves to work and use their unique talents, knowledge, expertise, experiences, & backgrounds to create meaningful outcomes.

  

**We nurture entrepreneurial spirits** and empower them to think beyond the possibilities, to discover, shape and build their own unique stories. Our diverse businesses and operations provide fulfilling opportunities to grow as individuals and make an impact.

  

**We are simple, humble and approachable, and we believe in leadership at all levels** to bring our purpose to life. Everyone at Halma India makes an impact, and so do you when you join us!

Halma India is an equal opportunity employer, which means the base of our recruitment decisions is always on skills, competencies, attitudes, and values. We are committed to hiring from diverse backgrounds without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, marital status, disability status, sex, gender identity, or sexual orientation.

Location: Thane, Maharashtra
