Department: Front Office / Patient Administration

Reporting To: Clinic Manager / Lead Consultant

ABOUT ELITE DERMADENT

Elite Dermadent is a premier aesthetics and dental clinic in Thane specializing in integrated skin, hair, and advanced dental treatments. We combine clinical precision, state-of-the-art medical technology, and personalized hospitality to deliver exceptional patient care.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Front Desk Executive & Patient Care Coordinator serves as the initial and primary face of Elite Dermadent. This role oversees the complete patient journey—from inquiry and scheduling to in-clinic hospitality, billing, post-treatment follow-up, and service re-booking. The ideal candidate blends five-star hospitality with active patient relationship management, proactive treatment follow-ups, and ethical cross-selling/upselling across dermatology and dentistry services.

KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Patient Experience & Reception

- Welcome incoming patients and visitors with a warm, professional, and empathetic demeanor.

- Administer patient check-ins, record verification, medical history intake, and consent documentation.

- Maintain the front lounge, reception zone, and consultation waiting areas to ensure an immaculate, upscale aesthetic.

- Address patient queries regarding treatments, general procedures, and appointment wait times to ensure minimal delays.

2. Appointment Management & Patient Follow-Ups

- Manage clinic schedules for dermatologists, cosmetologists, and dental specialists using clinic practice management or ERP software.

- Coordinate room turns, doctor availability, and treatment equipment availability to prevent double-booking or downtime.

- Run structured post-treatment follow-up schedules: contact patients to check on recovery, procedural comfort, and homecare adherence.

- Actively track and recall patients for due maintenance sessions, periodic dental cleanings, skin treatment sittings, and follow-up consultations.

- Execute confirmation calls, reminder SMS/WhatsApp messages, and no-show re-engagement outreach.

3. Upselling, Cross-Selling & Revenue Growth

- Identify opportunities to upgrade individual consultations into comprehensive treatment packages (e.g., laser hair reduction packages, multi-step facial rejuvenation regimens, full-mouth rehabilitation).

- Cross-sell complementary clinical services across departments (e.g., recommending teeth whitening or smile aligners to aesthetic/bridal skin clients, and aesthetic dermatology to dental patients).

- Recommend prescribed post-procedure homecare products, professional sunscreens, oral hygiene kits, and cosmeceuticals at checkout.

- Educate patients on ongoing seasonal campaigns, annual dental memberships, and combo treatment plans.

4. Lead Conversion & Patient Communication

- Handle inbound calls, patient WhatsApp messages, and website inquiries with swift response times.

- Brief prospective clients on available service offerings (such as laser treatments, skin rejuvenation, hair restoration, teeth whitening, aligners, and root canals).

- Follow up on warm leads, consultation quotes, and pending treatment plans to facilitate booking conversions.

5. Billing, Cash Handling & Day-End Reporting

- Generate accurate invoices, treatment package receipts, and payment transactions across POS machines, UPI, net banking, and cash.

- Handle petty cash, register closures, and daily reconciliation sheets.

- Coordinate with insurance providers or third-party EMI/financing partners for dental or cosmetic packages.

6. Cross-Functional Coordination & Operations

- Liaise with clinical assistants, nurses, and doctors to ensure smooth room flow.

- Track and manage front-desk stationery, patient amenities, brochure displays, and over-the-counter homecare product inventory.

- Gather authentic patient reviews (such as Google Reviews) and feedback ratings prior to patient check-out.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

Education & Experience:

- Education: Graduate (Bachelor's degree in any stream) or Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) with relevant experience.

- Experience: 1–3+ years of experience as a Front Desk Executive, Client Coordinator, or Receptionist in a dermatology clinic, dental clinic, aesthetic center, or premium hospital setup.

- Track record in patient follow-ups, service upselling, retail cosmeceutical sales, or conversion of treatment plans is a distinct advantage.

Competencies & Technical Skills:

- Language Proficiency: Fluent in spoken and written English and Hindi. Working knowledge of Marathi is highly preferred for Thane clientele.

- Technical Savvy: Hands-on experience with Clinic Management Systems / ERP software (e.g., Practo, Clinicea, Lybrate, or similar), MS Excel, WhatsApp Business, and POS billing systems.

- Sales & Communication: Persuasive interpersonal skills with an ethical, patient-centric approach to upselling and cross-selling clinical care.

- Grooming & Presence: Well-groomed, articulate, punctual, and comfortable working in a high-touch aesthetic healthcare environment.

- Soft Skills: Active listening, objection handling, calm crisis-handling, multi-tasking under peak patient traffic, and customer-first orientation.

title: Sr. Tender Executive
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – TENDER EXECUTIVE

**Company:** Fitech Engineers Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Tendering & Commercial  
**Designation:** Tender Executive  
**Reporting To:** Tender Manager / Director  
**Location:** Taloja, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

1. Job Purpose

To independently manage the complete tendering process, from identifying suitable tender opportunities to bid submission, follow-up, order receipt and documentation, ensuring timely, accurate and commercially competitive bids for fire detection, fire protection and fire suppression systems.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Tender Identification and Monitoring

* Identify relevant tenders on GeM, CPPP, government e-procurement portals, PSU portals and private-sector customer portals.
* Monitor tenders from organisations such as ONGC, Indian Railways, defence establishments, government departments, refineries and industrial clients.
* Maintain a daily tender opportunity tracker with submission deadlines, estimated values and eligibility criteria.
* Download tender documents, corrigenda, amendments and technical specifications.

B. Tender Document Review

* Study the complete tender document, including technical specifications, scope of work, BOQ, commercial terms and eligibility requirements.
* Prepare tender summaries highlighting EMD, tender fees, turnover requirements, experience criteria, submission deadlines and other key conditions.
* Identify deviations, risks, disqualifying conditions and missing documents.
* Coordinate with the technical and commercial teams to clarify tender requirements.

C. Bid Preparation and Submission

* Prepare technical bids, commercial bids, price schedules and supporting documents.
* Compile company credentials, work orders, completion certificates, client lists, financial statements, GST, PAN, MSME and other statutory documents, as applicable.
* Coordinate the preparation of compliance statements, technical datasheets, product catalogues and deviation statements.
* Upload bids on the relevant portals and ensure successful submission before deadlines.
* Maintain a digital repository of submitted tenders and acknowledgement receipts.

D. Technical and Commercial Coordination

* Coordinate with engineering, procurement, accounts and sales teams for technical compliance and costing.
* Obtain quotations from vendors and suppliers wherever required.
* Prepare comparative statements, cost sheets and BOQ summaries.
* Obtain authorised approval for final prices, margins, deviations and commercial commitments before submission.
* Ensure no price bid or binding commercial commitment is submitted without the required approval.

E. Post-Tender Follow-Up

* Track tender opening dates, technical evaluation, clarifications, reverse auctions and price negotiations.
* Prepare replies to customer queries and submit additional documents within stipulated timelines.
* Monitor bid validity, EMD status, bank guarantees and tender-related deposits.
* Track results, L1/L2 status, purchase orders and unsuccessful bids.
* Maintain reasons for lost tenders and recommend corrective actions.

F. Documentation and MIS Reporting

* Maintain a complete, searchable record of tender documents, submissions, approvals, quotations and outcomes.
* Prepare daily and weekly tender status reports.
* Generate monthly MIS covering tender opportunities, bids submitted, orders won, bid value, conversion rate and reasons for losses.
* Maintain a calendar of critical deadlines and ensure timely internal reminders.
* Ensure compliance with applicable tender conditions and company procedures.

3. Qualifications and Experience

* Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Approximately 2–5 years of experience in tendering, preferably in fire protection, fire suppression, industrial equipment, engineering projects or MEP services.
* Experience with GeM, CPPP, government e-tendering portals and PSU tenders will be preferred.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PDF tools and online tender portals.
* Good written communication, document management and coordination skills.
* Knowledge of GST documentation, EMD, bank guarantees, BOQ preparation and commercial tender terms.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be assessed against the following measurable parameters:

* **On-time submission:** 100% of approved bids submitted before deadlines.
* **Submission accuracy:** Zero avoidable disqualifications due to documentation or procedural errors.
* **Tender coverage:** Timely identification and screening of relevant tender opportunities.
* **Compliance:** 100% adherence to the internal tender approval matrix.
* **Documentation:** Complete and updated tender records and MIS.
* **Follow-up:** Timely action on all tender clarifications, evaluations and customer communications.
* **Conversion tracking:** Regular reporting of technical qualification, commercial competitiveness and order conversion.
* **Process improvement:** Reduction in repetitive work through standard templates, checklists and reusable documentation.

Tender wins and conversion rates will be reviewed in the context of bid selection, pricing competitiveness and management-approved strategy.

5. Skills and Competencies

* Strong attention to detail and deadline management.
* Ability to read and interpret technical and commercial tender documents.
* Excellent coordination and follow-up skills.
* Proficiency in Excel trackers and document control.
* Commercial awareness and basic cost analysis.
* Integrity, confidentiality and adherence to approval procedures.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tenders simultaneously.

6. Authority and Limitations

The Tender Executive may independently identify tenders, prepare bid documents, coordinate with departments and submit bids after all required approvals have been obtained.

The Tender Executive shall not independently:

* Finalise or change bid prices, margins or discounts.
* Commit to technical deviations or contractual terms.
* Approve EMDs, bank guarantees or other financial commitments.
* Sign declarations or undertakings beyond delegated authority.
* Submit unapproved bids or make unauthorised commitments on behalf of the company.

7. Expected Outcome

The Tender Executive is expected to establish a systematic, accurate and deadline-driven tendering process that improves bid quality, reduces avoidable disqualifications, increases tender visibility and supports profitable business growth for Fitech Engineers Pvt. Ltd.

title: Applied AI Architect, Meta Enterprise Platform (India)
description:
As an Applied AI Architect for the Meta Enterprise Platform, you are the strategic technical advisor who helps enterprise customers understand the full potential of our Enterprise AI products (such as Model API) and design the right architectures to unlock that value. You combine deep knowledge of Generative AI with enterprise architecture expertise and effective communication skills to guide customers from initial discovery through successful deployment, ongoing adoption and expansion.This role combines pre-sales technical leadership with post-sales customer adoption and expansion. You will design scalable architectures, develop evaluation frameworks, create reference implementations, and serve as the technical authority that gives customers and internal stakeholders the confidence to purchase. You are the architect of the blueprint - ensuring the right technical foundation is in place before and during implementation. You will not just design architectures; you will help to deploy end-to-end AI solutions that drive actual AI usage such as API consumption and business ROI. You will own the customer's technical success from the initial scoping phase through to live production deployment, post-sales adoption and growth.  
  
  

### **Applied AI Architect, Meta Enterprise Platform (India) Responsibilities:**

* \*\*Technical Discovery & Solution Design\*\* - Partner with sales to deeply understand customer requirements, business context, and existing technology stacks. Translate these into clear, technically feasible AI solution architectures and integration plans
* \*\*Technical Account Ownership\*\* - Establish technical account plans covering current use cases, adoption milestones and agreed measures of value. Review API usage, technical account health and blockers. Qualify additional use cases and help build the technical case for expansion. Coordinate specialist input where needed and follow through on agreed actions
* \*\*AI Architecture Advisory\*\* - Serve as the primary technical advisor throughout the customer's AI / API adoption journey. Guide architecture decisions around LLM selection, RAG patterns, prompt engineering strategies, agentic workflow and tool use, data pipelines, and enterprise integration points
* \*\*Evaluation & Proof of Value\*\* - Design and guide customer evaluation frameworks (evals) to measure AI performance for specific use cases. Create compelling demos, reference architectures, and lightweight POCs that demonstrate practical value and feasibility. Agree acceptance criteria for quality, latency, cost and reliability, linking evaluation results to customer business goals and a decision on production deployment
* \*\*Enterprise Trust & Governance\*\* - Address enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements (SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR). Navigate complex sales lifecycles involving IT, Legal, Security, and executive stakeholders to build technical confidence
* \*\*Cross-Functional Collaboration\*\* - Act as the bridge between customers and internal Product, Engineering, and PMM teams. Gather technical feedback, identify common integration patterns, surface product gaps, and contribute field insights that shape the product roadmap and GTM strategy
* \*\*Thought Leadership & Enablement\*\* - Create technical content including architecture guides, best-practice documentation, and industry-specific solution briefs. Enable the broader sales and partner ecosystem with technical training and reusable assets
* \*\*Hands-on Solutions\*\* - Act as the primary technical owner for strategic accounts. Assist in the design, prototyping, and deployment planning for customer full-stack applications, RAG pipelines, and custom integrations using our AI APIs. Contribute reference implementations and technical reviews
* \*\*Rapid Prototyping\*\* - Translate customer business problems into concrete technical plans. Rapidly develop and iterate on functional proofs-of-concept (POCs) to demonstrate immediate value
* \*\*Production Implementation\*\* - Guide customers through the "Integration Wall." Navigate enterprise security, legacy databases, and complex infrastructures
* \*\*Technical Advisory\*\* - Serve as the subject matter expert on Generative AI architecture, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI security/guardrails for C-level executives and lead developers
* \*\*Travel\*\* - Flexibility to travel up to 30% of the time

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience engaging enterprise customers through the sales lifecycle, purchasing and deployment decisions, involving multiple stakeholders across IT, Security, Legal, and executive leadership
* Comfortable with Python and able to build lightweight demos, scripts, and reference implementations (not expected to write production-grade application code)
* Familiarity with the Generative AI ecosystem: APIs, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, vector databases, and evaluation frameworks. Ability to use LLM APIs to build and evaluate lightweight demos, prototypes and reference implementations
* Ability to design use-case-specific evaluation tests and assess quality, latency, cost and reliability against agreed customer requirements and business goals
* Experience planning and managing customer technical engagements, resolving blockers and coordinating customer and internal teams through evaluation, integration and adoption. A high degree of ownership, and the ability to thrive in highly ambiguous, fast-paced environments
* Experience communicating and translating complex AI/ML concepts for C-suite executives, IT leaders, engineering teams and non-technical business leaders while simultaneously working with customer engineering teams

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience with AI safety, responsible AI practices, and implementing guardrails for LLM applications in regulated industries
* Experience creating and delivering technical enablement programs for sales teams, partners, or customer communities
* Familiarity with enterprise security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, HIPAA) in the context of AI deployments
* Experience architecting AI/ML solutions at scale in enterprise environments, including model deployment, monitoring, and governance. Experience helping customers move from evaluation to live applications with measurable business value
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience with AI observability, evaluation frameworks (evals) assessing quality, latency, cost and reliability, and implementing enterprise-grade security guardrails for AI applications
* Hands-on experience building applications using AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) and familiarity with the Generative AI ecosystem (Vector Databases, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, tool use and frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

description:

1. Accounting & Financial Management

- Record daily sales, purchases, receipts, payments, expenses, and journal entries.

- Maintain accurate books of accounts in accordance with applicable accounting principles.

- Manage general ledger, customer accounts, supplier accounts, and intercompany transactions.

- Perform regular bank, cash, customer, and supplier reconciliations.

- Maintain accounts receivable and payable records and prepare ageing reports.

- Monitor outstanding payments, collections, and accounting discrepancies.

2. GST Compliance & Indian Taxation

- Prepare and verify GST workings, including input tax credit (ITC), output GST, reverse charge mechanism (RCM), and applicable GST rates.

- Prepare and reconcile GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B, and purchase register data.

- Reconcile books of accounts with GST portal data and identify discrepancies in input tax credit.

- Monitor GST compliance for sales, purchases, credit notes, debit notes, and applicable e-commerce transactions.

- Assist with GST return filing, annual returns, and related reconciliations, including GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C wherever applicable.

- Ensure proper documentation and accounting treatment for intra-state and inter-state transactions, exports, and applicable zero-rated supplies.

- Handle TDS calculations, deductions, deposit tracking, and preparation and reconciliation of TDS returns.

- Assist with income tax computations, advance tax workings, and other applicable statutory tax compliances.

- Coordinate with tax consultants and auditors for assessments, notices, reconciliations, and statutory requirements.

3. Sales Billing & E-commerce Reconciliation

- Prepare and issue accurate sales invoices, credit notes, and debit notes in compliance with GST invoicing requirements.

- Reconcile e-commerce and marketplace sales with settlement reports, bank receipts, and books of accounts.

- Account for sales returns, refunds, marketplace commissions, payment gateway charges, and other deductions.

- Reconcile GST on marketplace transactions with relevant settlement statements and tax reports.

- Prepare monthly sales reconciliation and outstanding payment reports.

4. Final Accounts & Financial Reporting

- Independently prepare Trial Balance, Profit & Loss Account, and Balance Sheet.

- Prepare supporting schedules and perform year-end adjustments, including accruals, provisions, prepayments, and depreciation.

- Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities.

- Ensure proper classification of expenses, assets, liabilities, revenue, and other financial transactions.

- Assist in the preparation of financial statements and audit schedules.

- Coordinate with internal and external auditors during statutory and financial audits.

5. MIS & Documentation

- Prepare monthly financial reports, expense summaries, and reconciliation statements.

- Maintain organised accounting records, invoices, tax documents, and supporting schedules.

- Identify and resolve discrepancies in accounting entries, GST data, and financial reports.

- Ensure compliance with internal financial controls and reporting deadlines.

**Requirements**

- Minimum 3 years of practical accounting experience.

- CA Intermediate/IPCC qualified or appeared; CA dropouts are welcome.

- Strong knowledge of Indian accounting principles and double-entry bookkeeping.

- Hands-on experience in GST compliance, return preparation, and input tax credit reconciliation.

- Practical knowledge of TDS, statutory compliance, and Indian taxation.

- Proven experience in preparing final accounts, including Trial Balance, Profit & Loss Account, and Balance Sheet.

- Experience in e-commerce or marketplace accounting and reconciliation will be preferred.

title: Costing & Estimation Manager
description:
**Industry: Aerospace & Precision Manufacturing**

***Location:***
*Sriperumbudur, Chennai, Tamilnadu, India.*

**About TASE**

***Trusted Aerospace Engineering (TASE)***
*is a global precision manufacturing company with over four decades of industry experience. With manufacturing facilities in the USA, India, and Europe, TASE delivers high-quality engineering and manufacturing solutions to customers worldwide, positioning itself as their trusted*
***Global Precision Manufacturing Technology Partner***
*.*

**Role Overview**

**We are seeking an experienced Cost & Estimation Manager**
to lead customer RFQ evaluations, product costing, quotation management, and cost optimization for aerospace precision-machined components. The role will drive estimation accuracy, pricing competitiveness, margin protection, and continuous improvement through strong collaboration with Sales, Engineering, Manufacturing, Sourcing, and Finance teams.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. RFQ & Quotation Management**

* Lead end-to-end RFQ evaluation, cost estimation, and timely submission of competitive customer quotations.
* Ensure accurate costing based on technical drawings, specifications, material requirements, machining cycles, and special processes.
* Maintain pricing consistency, cost traceability, and adherence to approval procedures.

**2. Costing & Pricing Strategy**

* Develop and maintain robust cost models covering raw materials, machining, tooling, subcontracting, overheads, and other manufacturing costs.
* Establish and periodically review machine-hour rates, overhead absorption, and pricing assumptions with Finance.
* Ensure quotations align with manufacturing capabilities, market conditions, and target profit margins.

**3. Supplier & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Partner with Sourcing/Purchase to validate supplier quotations, subcontracting costs, and material pricing.
* Collaborate with Sales and Engineering to assess RFQs, evaluate commercial risks, and improve quote-to-order conversion.
* Work closely with Manufacturing to validate cycle times, capacity assumptions, and process costs.

**4. Cost Performance & Margin Improvement**

* Monitor estimated versus actual costs for awarded parts and programs, identify variances, and drive corrective actions.
* Review manufacturing cost trends, highlight inefficiencies, and recommend actions to protect and improve margins.
* Analyze quotation wins and losses to strengthen pricing accuracy and competitiveness.

**5. Continuous Improvement & Cost Reduction**

* Support Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives through data-driven cost analysis.
* Identify opportunities to optimize material utilization, machining cycles, processes, and supplier costs.
* Track and validate cost savings and their impact on profitability.

**6. Team Leadership & Capability Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the costing team to ensure accurate, timely, and consistent RFQ execution.
* Standardize costing methodologies, estimation practices, and ERP discipline.
* Build strong cross-functional collaboration and a culture of cost ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Desired Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related discipline; relevant cost accounting or finance qualifications are an advantage.
* Proven experience in cost estimation, product costing, and RFQ management within aerospace, precision machining, or high-precision manufacturing.
* Strong understanding of engineering drawings, machining processes, cycle-time estimation, raw materials, tooling, and special processes.
* Experience in cost modelling, pricing strategy, supplier cost analysis, and margin management.
* Proficiency in ERP systems, Excel-based costing models, and data analysis.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, communication, and team leadership skills.
* Exposure to AS9100 quality systems and aerospace customer requirements is preferred.
* Existing industry relationships in aerospace, aviation, or medical components would be an advantage.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
* Opportunities to work with global customers and advanced precision manufacturing technologies.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* A collaborative, performance-driven work environment.

**Ready to make an impact?**

Join TASE and play a pivotal role in strengthening pricing competitiveness, driving cost excellence, and supporting profitable growth in the global aerospace and precision manufacturing industry.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. * Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

description:
**Industry: Aerospace & Precision Manufacturing**

**About TASE**

***Trusted Aerospace Engineering (TASE)***
*is a global precision manufacturing company with over four decades of industry experience. With manufacturing facilities in the USA, India, and Europe, TASE delivers high-quality engineering and manufacturing solutions to customers worldwide, positioning itself as their trusted*
***Global Precision Manufacturing Technology Partner***
*.*

**Role Overview**

**We are seeking an experienced Cost & Estimation Manager**
to lead customer RFQ evaluations, product costing, quotation management, and cost optimization for aerospace precision-machined components. The role will drive estimation accuracy, pricing competitiveness, margin protection, and continuous improvement through strong collaboration with Sales, Engineering, Manufacturing, Sourcing, and Finance teams.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. RFQ & Quotation Management**

* Lead end-to-end RFQ evaluation, cost estimation, and timely submission of competitive customer quotations.
* Ensure accurate costing based on technical drawings, specifications, material requirements, machining cycles, and special processes.
* Maintain pricing consistency, cost traceability, and adherence to approval procedures.

**2. Costing & Pricing Strategy**

* Develop and maintain robust cost models covering raw materials, machining, tooling, subcontracting, overheads, and other manufacturing costs.
* Establish and periodically review machine-hour rates, overhead absorption, and pricing assumptions with Finance.
* Ensure quotations align with manufacturing capabilities, market conditions, and target profit margins.

**3. Supplier & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Partner with Sourcing/Purchase to validate supplier quotations, subcontracting costs, and material pricing.
* Collaborate with Sales and Engineering to assess RFQs, evaluate commercial risks, and improve quote-to-order conversion.
* Work closely with Manufacturing to validate cycle times, capacity assumptions, and process costs.

**4. Cost Performance & Margin Improvement**

* Monitor estimated versus actual costs for awarded parts and programs, identify variances, and drive corrective actions.
* Review manufacturing cost trends, highlight inefficiencies, and recommend actions to protect and improve margins.
* Analyze quotation wins and losses to strengthen pricing accuracy and competitiveness.

**5. Continuous Improvement & Cost Reduction**

* Support Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives through data-driven cost analysis.
* Identify opportunities to optimize material utilization, machining cycles, processes, and supplier costs.
* Track and validate cost savings and their impact on profitability.

**6. Team Leadership & Capability Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the costing team to ensure accurate, timely, and consistent RFQ execution.
* Standardize costing methodologies, estimation practices, and ERP discipline.
* Build strong cross-functional collaboration and a culture of cost ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Desired Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related discipline; relevant cost accounting or finance qualifications are an advantage.
* Proven experience in cost estimation, product costing, and RFQ management within aerospace, precision machining, or high-precision manufacturing.
* Strong understanding of engineering drawings, machining processes, cycle-time estimation, raw materials, tooling, and special processes.
* Experience in cost modelling, pricing strategy, supplier cost analysis, and margin management.
* Proficiency in ERP systems, Excel-based costing models, and data analysis.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, communication, and team leadership skills.
* Exposure to AS9100 quality systems and aerospace customer requirements is preferred.
* Existing industry relationships in aerospace, aviation, or medical components would be an advantage.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
* Opportunities to work with global customers and advanced precision manufacturing technologies.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* A collaborative, performance-driven work environment.

**Ready to make an impact?**

Join TASE and play a pivotal role in strengthening pricing competitiveness, driving cost excellence, and supporting profitable growth in the global aerospace and precision manufacturing industry.

description:

Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Salesforce is currently seeking a Manager, Technical Consulting to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. Our Manager, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in managing, training, and building the careers of our technical consulting team. We are key players in this objective, as they can use Industry Cloud functionality to deliver customer requirements quickly with minimal customization.
  
  
In addition to people leadership, career coaching, and project oversight responsibilities for the team, you will build our Industries practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team.
  
  
This role is 50% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a technical architect to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s Industries Cloud.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* You’ll have up to 15 direct reports under your scope of responsibility.
* You will be required to deliver technical work (as a technical architect) on Industries projects at 50% utilization and balance that with leading your team of Technical Consultants, Architects, and Managers.
* You’ll be responsible for hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Consultants so they can implement successfully in turning the program design of our Solution Architects and Technical Architects into highest-quality solutions that meets the customers’ needs, ensuring continuous team enablement across modern AI coding environments.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture frameworks that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the Industries consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering model across your delivery team.
* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI elements securely, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce Industries Cloud, Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, and Experience Cloud, guiding teams on the effective use of AI development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to maintain delivery speed and code health.
* Ensure the success of these teams while securing the highest CSAT and business outcomes, focusing on Performance Evaluation & ROI by defining metric frameworks to measure the business value of client AI workloads.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party stakeholders.
* Establish trust with the customer’s leadership, promoting and/or implementing best practices with SFI and Salesforce.
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 10-15 years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors.
* 5+ years of people management experience.
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills.
* Expertise in one or multiples of → Salesforce Industries Cloud (Energy & Utilties), Sales/Service/Experience Cloud, and Vlocity OmniStudio or respective domain, with a foundational familiarity with Agentforce architectures being a plus.
* Integration Architecture (Must have)
* Platform Security (Must have)
* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security
* Sharing and Visibility (Must have)
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Architectural Design Patterns
* Apex Design Patterns (Must Have)
* Salesforce/Apex, Triggers, Lightning Flows, Lightning, LWC, and experience with modern web and mobile technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Components, others).
* Proficiency in English.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Salesforce Certification Preferred (Admin, Developer, Sales, and Service Clouds, Application Architect)
* OmniStudio Developer/Consultant
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, specifically keeping pace with AI-assisted delivery trends and data compliance practices.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration.
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems.
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue.
* Strong interpersonal skills - nurture effective working relationships with others.
* Exceptional analytical skills - experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation metrics, and outcomes.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Oracle CDP/Unity- Manager
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As an Oracle CDP/Unity Manager, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize operational efficiency through business application consulting. You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on working with Oracle's suite of applications and tools designed to manage the entire customer journey, from lead generation to revenue realization and customer satisfaction.
  
  
As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, marketing automation, and customer experience solutions to meet the specific needs of an organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, and marketing automation solutions to optimize client operations
* Analyzing client needs to develop tailored software solutions that enhance customer experience and satisfaction
* Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Oracle applications
* Managing the entire customer journey from lead generation to revenue realization using Oracle's suite of tools
* Building meaningful client connections and fostering relationships to understand and anticipate client needs
* Navigating complex situations and using critical thinking to solve problems and generate new ideas
* Upholding professional and technical standards, including PwC's code of conduct and independence requirements
* Utilizing analytical thinking to interpret data and inform insights and recommendations
* Collaborating with teams to deliver quality and strategic objectives in business application consulting
* Embracing change and leveraging digital tooling to enhance client service delivery

What You Must Have
  
  

* Overall experience of 8–12 years, with strong hands-on and leadership experience in Oracle Unity Customer Data Platform (CDP) implementations.
* Experience leading at least 2–3 end-to-end Oracle Unity/CDP implementations.
* Good working experience with Oracle Eloqua Marketing Automation, particularly integrations between Unity, Eloqua, CRM, and other enterprise applications.
* Strong experience in solution architecture, technical design, data modelling, integrations, delivery management, stakeholder management, and team leadership.
* Ability to lead teams comprising developers, consultants, administrators, data engineers, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Customer Data Platforms, Customer 360, CRM, Marketing Automation, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, Data Warehouses, and enterprise integrations.

**Role And Responsibilities**

* Lead the overall solution design, architecture, implementation, and support of Oracle Unity solutions.
* Work closely with business, marketing, sales, service, IT, data, and architecture teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Oracle Unity solutions.
* Own technical design decisions and ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, integration, data governance, and performance standards.
* Lead requirement-gathering and solution-design workshops and provide recommendations based on Oracle Unity capabilities and best practices.
* Review and approve technical requirements, solution design documents, integration specifications, source-to-target mappings, test strategies, deployment plans, and operational documentation.
* Manage multiple Unity workstreams and ensure delivery within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business expectations.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, training, feedback, and guidance to developers, consultants, administrators, and end business users.
* Perform solution and design reviews and establish reusable development, integration, and configuration standards.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, data-quality issues, integration challenges, and performance bottlenecks and drive them to resolution.
* Coordinate with Oracle Support and other vendors for product issues, enhancements, patches, and technical escalations.
* Work with marketing teams to define how customer segments and attributes from Oracle Unity can be activated through Oracle Eloqua campaigns and marketing programs.
* Manage key business and technology stakeholders, align priorities, and communicate scope, risks, dependencies, and delivery status for Oracle Unity initiatives.Build strong relationships across Marketing, Sales, Service, CRM, Data, Analytics, Security, Architecture, and Operations teams.
* Own the overall Oracle Unity solution architecture and define scalable, secure, reusable, and maintainable CDP solution patterns.Design end-to-end data ingestion, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, integration, and Customer 360 architecture across enterprise systems.
* Lead solution demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and capability showcases for Oracle Unity use cases and platform features.Present Customer 360, identity resolution, segmentation, intelligent attributes, dashboards, integrations, and activation flows to business and technical stakeholders.
* Support pre-sales activities including discovery sessions, solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and client presentations.Work with sales and delivery teams to define Unity solution approaches, scope, timelines, assumptions, integrations, and resource requirements.
* Manage resource planning, allocation, capacity, utilization, workload, and delivery commitments across multiple Oracle Unity projects and workstreams.Identify skill gaps, support hiring and onboarding, and drive training, cross-skilling, mentoring, and capability development within the team.

**Oracle Unity / CDP Technical Responsibilities**

* Design the overall Oracle Unity data architecture, including source systems, ingestion strategy, data models, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, and downstream integrations.
* Design and configure data feeds and ingestion jobs to bring customer, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and other enterprise data into Oracle Unity.
* Define and review source-to-target mappings between source systems, data warehouses, Oracle Unity, CRM, Marketing, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, and other downstream platforms.
* Configure and extend Oracle Unity data models based on business, reporting, analytical, and activation requirements.
* Maintain strong understanding of Oracle Unity data objects, relationships, attributes, metadata, and query capabilities.
* Design and configure Identity Resolution rules, including match rules, survivorship rules, master entity identification, and resolution of duplicate or conflicting customer records.
* Review and troubleshoot MCPS queries and optimize queries for performance and scalability.
* Design and create Intelligent Attributes and use them in calculations, segmentation, personalization, analytics, and activation use cases.
* Define and implement customer segmentation strategies using demographic, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and predictive attributes.
* Create, configure, and manage Data Science and Machine Learning models available within Oracle Unity and assess their applicability to business use cases.
* Configure and manage address validation, standardization, enrichment, and data-quality processes.
* Design and develop Customer 360 dashboards using rules, sub-rules, data source views, calculated attributes, and custom widgets.
* Develop dashboards for customer engagement, segmentation, campaign performance, customer behavior, and other business KPIs.
* Design and manage integrations between Oracle Unity and enterprise applications such as Oracle Sales, Salesforce, Oracle Service, Oracle Loyalty, Oracle Eloqua, Oracle Infinity, Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, Analytics platforms, and third-party systems.
* Strong understanding of Oracle Unity REST APIs, batch integrations, outbound activation mechanisms, webhooks, and integration patterns.
* Define and manage Access Control, users, roles, permissions, and security governance within Oracle Unity.
* Establish data-governance standards covering data ingestion, customer identity, data quality, data privacy, retention, consent, security, and downstream data activation.
* Monitor Unity ingestion jobs, data pipelines, identity-resolution processes, segmentation jobs, calculations, data-science processes, and integrations.
* Perform root-cause analysis and drive resolution of data-processing, integration, identity-resolution, API, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Review platform usage and recommend performance, scalability, and operational improvements.
* Define customer-data activation patterns to support Customer 360, personalization, lead generation, cross-sell, up-sell, churn management, customer engagement, and next-best-action use cases.

**Oracle Eloqua Exposure**

* Good understanding of Oracle Eloqua architecture, campaign management, contacts, custom objects, segments, forms, landing pages, and lead-nurturing programs.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with Oracle Eloqua for customer segmentation, campaign activation, audience synchronization, and marketing personalization.
* Understand the data flow between Unity, Eloqua, CRM/Salesforce/Oracle Sales, and other downstream marketing systems.
* Support marketing teams in using Unity customer attributes, Intelligent Attributes, and segments within Eloqua campaigns.
* Good understanding of Eloqua integrations, APIs, native connectors, and data synchronization mechanisms.
* Support troubleshooting of data synchronization, campaign activation, contact-management, and integration issues between Unity and Eloqua.
* Understand lead management, lead scoring, campaign responses, and lead hand-off processes between Eloqua and CRM systems.

**Integration And Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Oracle Unity REST APIs and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with:
* Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM
* Salesforce
* Oracle Service
* Oracle Loyalty
* Oracle Eloqua
* Oracle Infinity
* Data Warehouses
* Enterprise Data Lakes
* Analytics platforms
* External marketing and customer-engagement platforms
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, middleware, batch interfaces, scheduled integrations, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Good understanding of SQL/query concepts, data modelling, data transformation, and data-quality principles.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex integration, data-processing, API, identity-resolution, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Understanding of customer-data activation from Oracle Unity into Eloqua and other marketing channels.

**Leadership And Management Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage a team of Oracle Unity developers, consultants, administrators, and data specialists.
* Estimate effort, prepare delivery plans, allocate resources, and monitor project execution.
* Mentor team members and develop Oracle Unity technical capabilities through knowledge-sharing, technical sessions, and hands-on guidance.
* Review deliverables and ensure adherence to technical, documentation, security, integration, and architecture standards.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate project status, risks, dependencies, issues, and key technical decisions.
* Facilitate design workshops and technical discussions with business, enterprise architecture, security, integration, data, analytics, and infrastructure teams.
* Collaborate with marketing and Eloqua teams to define customer activation and campaign integration strategies.
* Support project planning, solution estimation, proposals, technical presentations, demos, and pre-sales activities when required.
* Identify opportunities to create reusable solutions, accelerators, frameworks, automation, and implementation best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement across Oracle Unity implementation, support, data governance, and operational processes.
* Act as the escalation point for complex Oracle Unity technical and functional issues.

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong understanding of Customer 360, Customer Data Platforms, customer identity, data unification, segmentation, personalization, and activation.
* Good understanding of Marketing Automation and Oracle Eloqua concepts.
* Understanding of customer consent, privacy, security, retention, and enterprise data-governance requirements.
* Experience designing enterprise-scale customer-data solutions with high data volumes and multiple source systems.
* Experience supporting customer-data activation across CDP, CRM, Eloqua, and digital marketing channels.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining delivery quality.
* Experience working with geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to communicate complex Oracle Unity and integration concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Senior Consultant - Strategic Transport & Mobility Advisory
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
Jacobs are seeking a Senior Consultant to join our Strategic Transport & Mobility Advisory team to support high-impact transport and mobility advisory projects across the region. If you are passionate about rethinking mobility, advising clients, and solving complex urban transport challenges through delivery transformation and innovation, this role offers an exciting platform to accelerate your career.
  
  
As a Senior Consultant, you will support the delivery of multidisciplinary transport and mobility advisory services, working alongside project leaders and cross-functional teams. Your responsibilities will include
  
  

* Supporting the delivery of strategic transport and mobility advisory project, including urban mobility strategies, public transport policy, EV/AV deployment plans, freight and logistics advisory, and transport-related feasibility studies.
* Supporting project tasks, developing client-ready outputs, and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. Supporting the development of policy frameworks, business cases, and implementation plans for public and private sectors.
* Conducting research and analysis on emerging mobility trends and technologies (e.g. smart mobility, MaaS, low-carbon transport, ITS)
* Support the management of stakeholder consultation activities and preparing reports, presentations, and briefing materials for high-level government and private clients.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in transport planning, urban planning, economics, engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in transport or mobility consulting, with exposure to strategic advisory projects.
* Ability to work across a variety of transport topics, such as urban mobility, integrated transport planning, policy development or freight and logistics.
* Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in developing high-quality reports, presentations and strategic insights for clients.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: SAP MM / MTD
description:
**Job Summary**
This hybrid role seeks a seasoned functional lead with eight to twelve years of experience in S4 HANA sales and logistics modules focusing on contracts billing revenue and advanced pricing. The role drives end to end order to cash solutions that optimize billing accuracy pricing flexibility and logistics execution. The individual will partner with business teams to refine processes for consumer goods and broader supply chain operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end to end design of S4 HANA contracts and agreements processes to ensure accurate lifecycle management from contract creation through renewal and closure while aligning with enterprise policies and compliance needs.
* Drive configuration and optimization of S4 HANA billing and revenue capabilities to improve invoice accuracy reduce revenue leakage and support transparent reporting for finance and business stakeholders.
* Oversee the implementation of S4 HANA advance pricing scenarios to support complex discount structures surcharges and promotions ensuring data integrity and consistent pricing decisions across channels.
* Coordinate process flows in S4 HANA advance order to cash to streamline order intake fulfillment and invoicing enabling faster cycle times and enhanced customer satisfaction.
* Manage functional design for S4 HANA sales BOM to support bundled offerings and kits ensuring accurate component mapping pricing and downstream impact on inventory and costing.
* Guide configuration and testing activities in S4 HANA basic logistic execute to strengthen delivery processing shipment management and goods issue so that physical flows align smoothly with system records.
* Collaborate with supply chain and consumer goods domain teams to translate business scenarios into robust S4 HANA solutions that improve forecast accuracy service levels and product availability.
* Provide detailed functional specifications for enhancements integrations and reports ensuring that technical teams can deliver stable solutions that maintain system performance and usability.
* Conduct fit gap analysis workshops with business partners to evaluate current processes identify improvement opportunities and recommend standardized S4 HANA practices that reduce complexity.
* Facilitate system testing cycles including unit testing integration testing and user acceptance testing to validate configurations and reduce defects before deployment to production environments.
* Mentor junior functional consultants by sharing best practices reusable templates and business insights to build team capability and ensure consistent solution quality across projects.
* Coordinate with change management teams to prepare training content process documentation and adoption plans helping end users embrace new ways of working with minimal disruption.

title: Control panel Project estimation
description:
# Job Description – Project Estimation Engineer (Control Panel Projects)

Full-Time

Taloja, Navi Mumbai

Company: Synergie Controls & Systems Pvt. Ltd.\

Department: Projects / Estimation\

Designation: Project Estimation Engineer – Control Panels\

Experience: 3–7 Years\

Reporting To: Estimation Manager / Operations Head

## 1. Job Purpose

Synergie Controls & Systems Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced Project Estimation Engineer specializing in electrical control panel manufacturing and industrial automation projects.

The candidate will be responsible for understanding customer enquiries, studying technical specifications, preparing detailed Bill of Materials (BOM), estimating project costs, preparing techno-commercial offers and coordinating with sales, design, purchase and project execution teams to ensure accurate and competitive quotations.

## 2. Key Responsibilities

A. Enquiry Study & Technical Evaluation

- Study customer enquiries, RFQs, technical specifications and tender documents.

- Understand electrical SLDs, control schematics, GA drawings and technical requirements.

- Identify project scope, exclusions, deviations and customer-specific requirements.

- Evaluate technical requirements for PLC, MCC, PCC, VFD and automation panels.

- Identify technical gaps and seek clarification from customers wherever required.

B. BOM Preparation & Cost Estimation

- Prepare detailed BOM for electrical control panels and automation projects.

- Select suitable electrical components based on technical specifications.

- Prepare component-wise cost estimation, including:

- Siemens PLC, HMI and I/O modules.

- Siemens VFDs and motor control equipment.

- MCCB, ACB, MCB, contactors and relays.

- Control transformers, SMPS and power supplies.

- Terminal blocks, cables, ducts and accessories.

- Enclosures, mounting plates and panel accessories.

- Busbars, copper components and electrical hardware.

- Calculate panel fabrication, assembly, wiring and testing costs.

- Estimate engineering, programming, commissioning and installation costs.

- Calculate project overheads, contingency, transportation and other applicable expenses.

- Ensure accurate costing and optimum material selection.

C. Panel Engineering & Design Coordination

- Coordinate with EPLAN design engineers for technical inputs and drawing requirements.

- Review panel GA drawings, electrical schematics and BOMs.

- Understand panel sizing, IP protection, form of separation and heat dissipation requirements.

- Evaluate Rittal TS8, VX and PS series enclosures and other panel enclosure requirements.

- Identify cost optimization opportunities without compromising quality and technical specifications.

D. Vendor Coordination & Procurement

- Obtain quotations from Siemens, Rittal and other electrical component suppliers.

- Coordinate with the purchase department for updated component prices.

- Compare vendor quotations and evaluate alternate makes.

- Maintain updated pricing databases for commonly used electrical components.

- Negotiate with vendors wherever required to achieve competitive project costing.

E. Commercial Offer Preparation

- Prepare detailed techno-commercial offers.

- Prepare cost sheets with material, labour, engineering and service costs.

- Calculate gross profit margins and selling prices.

- Prepare technical compliance statements and deviation lists.

- Define payment terms, delivery schedules, warranty and offer validity.

- Ensure quotations are submitted within the committed timeline.

- Support the sales team during customer negotiations and price revisions.

F. Project Handover & Coordination

- Conduct estimation handover meetings with the project execution team after order confirmation.

- Explain costing assumptions, scope of supply and technical specifications.

- Highlight critical components, delivery requirements and project risks.

- Coordinate with design, purchase, production and project teams to resolve technical and commercial queries.

## 3. Technical Knowledge & Skills Required

The candidate should have good knowledge of:

| Area | Required Knowledge |

| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |

| PLC Panels | Siemens S7-1200, S7-1500 |

| VFD Panels | Siemens Sinamics G120, S120 |

| MCC Panels | Motor feeders, DOL, Star-Delta, VFD feeders |

| PCC Panels | ACB, MCCB, busbar sizing |

| Automation | PLC, HMI, remote I/O, control systems |

| Electrical Components | Siemens, Schneider, ABB, L&T, Phoenix Contact |

| Enclosures | Rittal TS8, VX, PS Series |

| Drawings | SLD, GA, control schematics |

| Software | MS Excel, AutoCAD; EPLAN knowledge preferred |

## 4. Educational Qualification

- Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering.

- 3–7 years of relevant experience in electrical control panel estimation or industrial automation project costing.

- Experience in control panel manufacturing companies is preferred.

- Candidates with experience in industrial automation and Siemens products will be preferred.

## 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the Project Estimation Engineer will be evaluated based on:

| KPI | Performance Measurement |

| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |

| Estimation Accuracy | Actual project cost vs. estimated cost |

| Quotation Turnaround | Timely submission of quotations |

| BOM Accuracy | Minimum errors in BOM preparation |

| Cost Optimization | Identification of cost-saving opportunities |

| Gross Profit Margin | Achievement of targeted project GP |

| Vendor Coordination | Timely receipt of competitive quotations |

| Technical Compliance | Accuracy of technical specifications |

| Handover Quality | Complete and accurate project handover |

## 6. Behavioural Competencies

- Strong analytical and numerical skills.

- Good technical understanding of electrical control panels.

- Attention to detail and accuracy.

- Ability to work under tight quotation deadlines.

- Good communication and coordination skills.

- Commercial awareness and cost-conscious approach.

- Ownership and accountability for assigned enquiries.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple enquiries.

## 7. Job Location & Working Conditions

- Location: Synergie Controls & Systems Pvt. Ltd., Taloja, Navi Mumbai.

- Employment Type: Full-Time, On-site.

- Working Days: 6 Days a Week.

- Salary: As per experience and competency.

## 8. Expected Deliverables

The employee is expected to independently handle the following:

1. Study customer RFQs and prepare technical estimation.

2. Prepare complete BOM and cost sheets.

3. Obtain and compare supplier quotations.

4. Prepare techno-commercial offers.

5. Ensure estimation accuracy and profitability.

6. Submit quotations within committed timelines.

7. Maintain an updated estimation and component price database.

8. Coordinate with internal departments for smooth project handover.

## My recommendation for Synergie Controls

I recommend keeping this position focused on Project Estimation rather than general sales estimation.

The engineer should be capable of independently estimating the following types of projects:

- PLC & Automation Control Panels.

- MCC & PCC Panels.

- VFD / Drive Panels.

- Siemens PLC and Drive System Integration.

- Control Desks and Operator Consoles.

- Industrial Automation Upgradation and Retrofit Projects.

- Complete Electrical and Automation Projects for Rolling Mills and Steel Plants.

Important: During recruitment, conduct a practical estimation test. Give the candidate one PLC panel enquiry with a technical specification and ask them to prepare:

- Complete BOM.

- Component selection.

- Material costing.

- Panel fabrication and assembly costing.

- Engineering and testing charges.

- Final selling price with gross profit calculation.

This will help you identify candidates who can actually handle estimation independently rather than candidates who only know how to prepare quotations.
