title: Head BD & Distribution Alternates AIF - South
description: Head of Fundraising & Investor Relations, South – ChennaiVantrock Investment Managers LLPVantrock is a multi-product real assets platform. Not a warehousing fund. Logistics and industrial is the first strategy. Office, plotted sales, land, pre-leased and yielding assets, private credit, data centres and senior living follow behind it. This seat builds the distribution network for all of it in Chennai, Coimbatore, Kochi and the Tamil Nadu and Kerala markets.THE SEATEmployer: Vantrock Investment Managers LLP, the investment manager within Vantrock VenturesReports to: Chief Business Officer, Fundraising and Investor Relations. Until that seat is filled, directly to the Founder & CEO, who will build the franchise with the zonal team hands-onDirect reports: None at launch. A senior single-contributor seat with a very large number attachedLocation: Chennai, in office, with twelve to fifteen travel days a month across Chennai, Coimbatore, Kochi and the wider Tamil Nadu and Kerala marketsExperience: 10 to 16 yearsTeam structure, reporting lines, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the current plan and may change. Compensation is confirmed in the offer.ABOUT THE COMPANYVantrock is an operator-led real assets platform, and it is multi-product by design. Real assets only. Warehousing and industrial parks are the first strategy, not the platform, across the full chain: first mile, last mile, city-centre, dark-store and self-storage formats, and logistics-anchored mixed-use with distribution below and office above.Behind that first strategy sits the rest of the platform, launched in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back-office space, where our expertise transfers directly; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living. Each is a strategy in its own right, with its own pipeline and its own distributor relationships behind it. A candidate who reads this as a warehousing platform has read the first line and stopped.Three parts, kept separate. The founder's balance sheet takes the first risk: land is acquired, de-risked and approved on his capital before any investor commits. Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited develops and operates; Vantrock Investment Managers LLP underwrites every asset independently and answers to an independent Investment Committee. Assets enter at cost, with no founder premium. The platform earns only after its investors have.Founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder & CEO. Three institutional platforms built from zero, and the fourth now on his own capital. Across that career: India's largest industrial real estate exit, Rs 5,250 Cr to Blackstone; a fund platform taken from zero to about USD 1.4 billion in peak AUM in six years, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, Rs 2,775 Cr from roughly 1,000 investors through the channel, on India's first domestic warehousing AIF; 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor; 2,000+ acres acquired, all litigation-free; 200+ buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.Warehousing is where the founder is best known. It is not where this platform stops. That record is the anchor that opens the door in the channel. The mandate you would be selling is considerably wider than it.We hire number twos who want to become number one.THE PRODUCT SET YOU WOULD BE SELLINGThis is the part most candidates get wrong. You would not be carrying one product into the channel. You would be building a channel that carries a succession of products across real assets. The proposed set, built out in sequence as each is delivered and as approvals are obtained:– Industrial parks, logistics and warehousing– Office: suburban campuses, GCC and back-office space, starter and strata office– Plotted and industrial plot sales– Pre-leased and yielding assets– A land strategy– Private credit– Data centres and senior living– In time, listed or pooled vehicle formats including InvIT and REIT structuresMultiple product lines, one channel. That is why this is a franchise-building job rather than a product-selling job. An RM you certify on the first strategy sells the second, third and fourth without being recruited again.The intended route is a seeded AIF alongside deal-by-deal co-investment through CIV, co-investment PMS and other structures, subject to approvals. Seeded is the point: the operator puts assets in place before a fund launches, so much of the pipeline is de-risked on day one and no blind pool is raised. Two sales in one: a fund commitment into a visible pipeline, and larger co-investment tickets into named assets.WHY THIS ROLE EXISTSOwn the zone. Build the distribution and IFA network across Chennai, Coimbatore, Kochi and the wider Tamil Nadu and Kerala markets. Activate the RMs and advisers inside it, and convert that network into committed capital for the first strategy and into a channel that is ready when the office, plotted, land, credit and yielding strategies arrive behind it.Not a cold start. The platform brings an existing investor base, anchor commitments in place, and a founder known in the channel from two prior funds. The channel will take the meeting. What does not yet exist is the franchise: the empanelments, the certified RMs, the joint calls. There is no team to delegate that to in Year 1. Seniority here means credibility and judgment, not a desk.WHAT YOU WILL OWN– The network. National distributors' regional offices, regional distributors, IFAs and MFDs, DSAs, RIAs, multi-family offices and wealth-platform desks. Target 5 to 7 firms empanelled and live.– The full empanelment cycle, locally. First meeting to product committee to go-live, for both the fund and the co-investment routes. Empanel the platform, not a single product, so the next strategy does not start the cycle again.– Activation. Branch meetings, huddles and desk conversations until 35 to 50 RMs and IFAs have each placed at least one ticket.– Conversion. Joint client meetings as the core of the job. The pipeline from interest through contribution agreement to funds received.– The map, in the CRM, weekly. Investor relations in the zone after the close, with Fund Operations. The face of Vantrock in Chennai and Kerala.THIS IS A FRONT-FACING SEATYou do not sell to the distributors and stop. You sell with them. Accompany partners and their RMs to their clients and pitch yourself. Tell the story so an RM can repeat it under pressure. Host investor evenings, partner meets and site visits, speak where the channel meets the asset class, and be a named voice of the platform on LinkedIn.Approved material only. Nothing bespoke, nothing verbal-only, no return promises, ever.WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOREssential– 10 to 16 years in financial services, at least five in B2B or B2B2C distribution of PMS, AIF or mutual-fund products from the manufacturer's side, an AMC, alternatives manager or fund house. You have carried a distribution number and been paid against it.– Verifiable relationships with distributor product heads, national and regional distributors and the top IFA and MFD firms in Tamil Nadu and Kerala. You can name them, and they will take your call.– You have launched a product into the channel from scratch at least once, not only carried an established brand.– Third-party capital raised through the channel, stated as capital drawn, not assets influenced.– Graduate. MBA, PGDM, CA or CFA or equivalent. NISM as applicable.– Appetite for the road. Twelve to fifteen travel days a month is the job, not an exception to it.Advantageous– A real assets fund background. Not mandatory: a strong alternatives channel salesperson from equity, credit or PMS is often the superior hire, because channel sales is harder to teach than an asset class.– Experience carrying more than one product line into the same channel. This platform will ask you to do it repeatedly.– An AMC alternates or PMS desk. Co-investment tickets sold alongside a fund. Standing in the Chennai and Kerala markets, which are conservative, referral-driven and reward patience over pressure.COMPENSATION AND WEALTH CREATIONBenchmarked against the upper quartile, then deliberately weighted from take-home to wealth creation. Four parts, offered as a mix: fixed; a fundraising incentive on the capital you personally bring in, with a team component on the platform's total raise; a share in the platform's additional returns on strategies you help close; and ESOPs. Numbers in the first conversation.Prepared for recruitment only. Not an offer of, or invitation to invest in, any fund, scheme, security or interest, and not marketing of any investment product. The product lines, structures and routes described are proposed and indicative, subject to change and to all necessary SEBI and other regulatory approvals. The track record above relates to the founder's prior roles at other organisations, is not the track record of Vantrock, and is not indicative of future results. No return is stated or implied, and none may be quoted in connection with this search.9,112 plain, about 9,840 with formatting. That closes the set: CBO, North, East, West, South Bengaluru, South Chennai.Two things now stale against these six postings and not mine to edit: SEAT_ROSTER still carries the old titles and one South seat, and the parent seat's internal name is now Chief Business Officer rather than Head. Flagging both for the roster.

title: Client Manager - Personal Insurance
description:
**Company:**
------------

Marsh McLennan Agency

**Description:**
----------------

**The Job**

  

Marsh Agency’s Personal Insurance division is looking for a passionate and people-oriented service professional to develop, implement and deliver outstanding insurance and risk management customer service to our clients. Our ideal candidate is adept at providing exceptional customer service and supporting the needs of our clients, tailoring personal risk management solutions according to their client’s unique circumstances.

  

In your career at Marsh Agency, you’ll be given constant support, with a hands-on training program, consistent feedback and development, and work alongside driven and passionate sales professionals. We will give you access to mentorship, training, resources, and development to ensure your success, but you will need to supply the spirit. Our colleagues don’t stop short of excellence and are compelled to do what’s best for their clients, colleagues and communities.

  

From admin to accounting and everything in between, we believe our team is all in sales together. We're dedicated to representing our brand with excellence and integrity in every interaction. We collaborate with intention and know every one of us plays a vital role in our shared success.

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**

  

* **Work with customers and carriers** to handle incoming service requests. We will count on you to inform, educate, and make recommendations to clients, carriers and underwriters.
* **Manage new and renewal insurance marketing:** including negotiating with carriers, preparing presentation and proposal materials, collecting customer information and ordering insurance policies from carriers.
* **Analysis:** You can determine acceptability and placement of coverage and also provide customers with insurance coverage recommendations for improved or additional coverage.
* **Update customer information:** Ensure account data is accurately captured, entered and maintained in our agency management system.
* **Up sell & cross sell:** work with your colleagues to find and follow-through on up-sell and cross-sell opportunities.
* **Customer service:** ensure that you and your designated sales and service team provide effective and efficient customer service.
* **Plus** (the fine print): you’ll follow organization policies and procedures, sales and service standards and established workflows. You’ll ensure quality control through proper file documentation and maintenance. You’ll maintain confidentiality and be an all-around awesome member of our team.
  

**Who We’re Looking For**

  

* **You’re a client service advocate.** You’re passionate about delivering an exceptional level of customer service and support.
* **You’re ready to throw all stereotypes of “insurance”** out the window and love your job.
* **You’re smart.** You understand business and people.
* **You’re good with people,** even on the tough days. Good customer service is just part of who you are, and you love making people happy.
* **You’re team oriented.** You maintain positive relationships with your colleagues—and you enjoy it. You’re that person everyone can depend on to pay attention to details, to make deadlines, to be accurate and complete when interacting clients, colleagues and carriers.
* **You love to learn.** You’re earnest about improving and pursuing professional development.
* **You can adapt** —because our industry changes constantly and so do the needs of our clients. You’re good at staying on your toes.
* **You’re ready for a meaningful change.** No more corporate vanilla structure for you. (Yes, an insurance company really just said that.)
* **You embrace our core values:** accountability, balance, excellence, integrity, respect and humanity.
  

We know there are excellent candidates who might not check all of these boxes. Don't be shy. If you're close, we'd be very interested in meeting you.

  

**The Perks:**

  

We take pride in providing our colleagues with a competitive compensation package; we will honor all local and state salary thresholds. The base pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, and education. Additionally, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives, annual profit sharing and a benefits package that includes paid paternity/maternity leave, medical leave, 401K savings and other wellbeing programs. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis.

  

**Who** ***you*** **are is who** ***we*** **are.**

  

Marsh McLennan is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age background, disability, ethnic origin, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, veteran status (including protected veterans), or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please let us know by contacting reasonableaccommodations@mmc.com

description: Job DescriptionJob Description – Senior Presales ManagerJob TitleSenior Presales Manager / Lead Presales ConsultantDepartmentSales and PresalesReporting ToHead of Presales / Sales Director / Business Unit HeadLocation[Insert Location]Employment TypeFull-TimeExperience Required10–12 years of relevant experience in IT services, technology consulting, solution development, or presales.Role SummaryThe Senior Presales Manager will lead the development of customer-centric, technically sound, and commercially competitive solutions for strategic opportunities within the IT services business.The role requires strong experience in understanding complex customer requirements, designing end-to-end solutions, leading proposal and bid activities, developing commercial models, and presenting value propositions to senior customer stakeholders.The successful candidate will work closely with sales leaders, solution architects, delivery teams, technology partners, finance, legal, commercial, and executive management teams to improve deal quality, win probability, and business growth.Key Responsibilities Opportunity Qualification and Presales Strategy Partner with sales teams to qualify opportunities based on customer needs, strategic fit, competitive positioning, delivery capability, and commercial viability. Develop solutions covering areas such as application development, cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data and analytics, enterprise applications, managed services, automation, and digital transformation. Define the solution scope, architecture, operating model, implementation approach, delivery methodology, governance structure, and service management framework. Ensure alignment between customer requirements, proposed technologies, delivery capabilities, service levels, and commercial commitments. Review and validate solution designs, effort estimates, staffing models, transition plans, and implementation schedules. Promote the use of reusable solution components, accelerators, frameworks, and industry best practices. Proposal and Bid Management Lead the preparation and submission of high-quality technical and commercial proposals. Manage cross-functional bid teams involving sales, technology, delivery, finance, legal, procurement, HR, and partner organisations. Define proposal structure, response strategy, responsibilities, review cycles, and submission timelines. Develop executive summaries, solution narratives, transformation roadmaps, case studies, and differentiators. Ensure that all proposal responses are accurate, compliant, consistent, and aligned with customer expectations. title: Oracle CDP/Unity- Manager
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As an Oracle CDP/Unity Manager, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize operational efficiency through business application consulting. You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on working with Oracle's suite of applications and tools designed to manage the entire customer journey, from lead generation to revenue realization and customer satisfaction.
  
  
As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, marketing automation, and customer experience solutions to meet the specific needs of an organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, and marketing automation solutions to optimize client operations
* Analyzing client needs to develop tailored software solutions that enhance customer experience and satisfaction
* Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Oracle applications
* Managing the entire customer journey from lead generation to revenue realization using Oracle's suite of tools
* Building meaningful client connections and fostering relationships to understand and anticipate client needs
* Navigating complex situations and using critical thinking to solve problems and generate new ideas
* Upholding professional and technical standards, including PwC's code of conduct and independence requirements
* Utilizing analytical thinking to interpret data and inform insights and recommendations
* Collaborating with teams to deliver quality and strategic objectives in business application consulting
* Embracing change and leveraging digital tooling to enhance client service delivery

What You Must Have
  
  

* Overall experience of 8–12 years, with strong hands-on and leadership experience in Oracle Unity Customer Data Platform (CDP) implementations.
* Experience leading at least 2–3 end-to-end Oracle Unity/CDP implementations.
* Good working experience with Oracle Eloqua Marketing Automation, particularly integrations between Unity, Eloqua, CRM, and other enterprise applications.
* Strong experience in solution architecture, technical design, data modelling, integrations, delivery management, stakeholder management, and team leadership.
* Ability to lead teams comprising developers, consultants, administrators, data engineers, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Customer Data Platforms, Customer 360, CRM, Marketing Automation, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, Data Warehouses, and enterprise integrations.

**Role And Responsibilities**

* Lead the overall solution design, architecture, implementation, and support of Oracle Unity solutions.
* Work closely with business, marketing, sales, service, IT, data, and architecture teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Oracle Unity solutions.
* Own technical design decisions and ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, integration, data governance, and performance standards.
* Lead requirement-gathering and solution-design workshops and provide recommendations based on Oracle Unity capabilities and best practices.
* Review and approve technical requirements, solution design documents, integration specifications, source-to-target mappings, test strategies, deployment plans, and operational documentation.
* Manage multiple Unity workstreams and ensure delivery within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business expectations.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, training, feedback, and guidance to developers, consultants, administrators, and end business users.
* Perform solution and design reviews and establish reusable development, integration, and configuration standards.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, data-quality issues, integration challenges, and performance bottlenecks and drive them to resolution.
* Coordinate with Oracle Support and other vendors for product issues, enhancements, patches, and technical escalations.
* Work with marketing teams to define how customer segments and attributes from Oracle Unity can be activated through Oracle Eloqua campaigns and marketing programs.
* Manage key business and technology stakeholders, align priorities, and communicate scope, risks, dependencies, and delivery status for Oracle Unity initiatives.Build strong relationships across Marketing, Sales, Service, CRM, Data, Analytics, Security, Architecture, and Operations teams.
* Own the overall Oracle Unity solution architecture and define scalable, secure, reusable, and maintainable CDP solution patterns.Design end-to-end data ingestion, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, integration, and Customer 360 architecture across enterprise systems.
* Lead solution demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and capability showcases for Oracle Unity use cases and platform features.Present Customer 360, identity resolution, segmentation, intelligent attributes, dashboards, integrations, and activation flows to business and technical stakeholders.
* Support pre-sales activities including discovery sessions, solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and client presentations.Work with sales and delivery teams to define Unity solution approaches, scope, timelines, assumptions, integrations, and resource requirements.
* Manage resource planning, allocation, capacity, utilization, workload, and delivery commitments across multiple Oracle Unity projects and workstreams.Identify skill gaps, support hiring and onboarding, and drive training, cross-skilling, mentoring, and capability development within the team.

**Oracle Unity / CDP Technical Responsibilities**

* Design the overall Oracle Unity data architecture, including source systems, ingestion strategy, data models, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, and downstream integrations.
* Design and configure data feeds and ingestion jobs to bring customer, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and other enterprise data into Oracle Unity.
* Define and review source-to-target mappings between source systems, data warehouses, Oracle Unity, CRM, Marketing, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, and other downstream platforms.
* Configure and extend Oracle Unity data models based on business, reporting, analytical, and activation requirements.
* Maintain strong understanding of Oracle Unity data objects, relationships, attributes, metadata, and query capabilities.
* Design and configure Identity Resolution rules, including match rules, survivorship rules, master entity identification, and resolution of duplicate or conflicting customer records.
* Review and troubleshoot MCPS queries and optimize queries for performance and scalability.
* Design and create Intelligent Attributes and use them in calculations, segmentation, personalization, analytics, and activation use cases.
* Define and implement customer segmentation strategies using demographic, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and predictive attributes.
* Create, configure, and manage Data Science and Machine Learning models available within Oracle Unity and assess their applicability to business use cases.
* Configure and manage address validation, standardization, enrichment, and data-quality processes.
* Design and develop Customer 360 dashboards using rules, sub-rules, data source views, calculated attributes, and custom widgets.
* Develop dashboards for customer engagement, segmentation, campaign performance, customer behavior, and other business KPIs.
* Design and manage integrations between Oracle Unity and enterprise applications such as Oracle Sales, Salesforce, Oracle Service, Oracle Loyalty, Oracle Eloqua, Oracle Infinity, Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, Analytics platforms, and third-party systems.
* Strong understanding of Oracle Unity REST APIs, batch integrations, outbound activation mechanisms, webhooks, and integration patterns.
* Define and manage Access Control, users, roles, permissions, and security governance within Oracle Unity.
* Establish data-governance standards covering data ingestion, customer identity, data quality, data privacy, retention, consent, security, and downstream data activation.
* Monitor Unity ingestion jobs, data pipelines, identity-resolution processes, segmentation jobs, calculations, data-science processes, and integrations.
* Perform root-cause analysis and drive resolution of data-processing, integration, identity-resolution, API, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Review platform usage and recommend performance, scalability, and operational improvements.
* Define customer-data activation patterns to support Customer 360, personalization, lead generation, cross-sell, up-sell, churn management, customer engagement, and next-best-action use cases.

**Oracle Eloqua Exposure**

* Good understanding of Oracle Eloqua architecture, campaign management, contacts, custom objects, segments, forms, landing pages, and lead-nurturing programs.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with Oracle Eloqua for customer segmentation, campaign activation, audience synchronization, and marketing personalization.
* Understand the data flow between Unity, Eloqua, CRM/Salesforce/Oracle Sales, and other downstream marketing systems.
* Support marketing teams in using Unity customer attributes, Intelligent Attributes, and segments within Eloqua campaigns.
* Good understanding of Eloqua integrations, APIs, native connectors, and data synchronization mechanisms.
* Support troubleshooting of data synchronization, campaign activation, contact-management, and integration issues between Unity and Eloqua.
* Understand lead management, lead scoring, campaign responses, and lead hand-off processes between Eloqua and CRM systems.

**Integration And Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Oracle Unity REST APIs and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with:
* Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM
* Salesforce
* Oracle Service
* Oracle Loyalty
* Oracle Eloqua
* Oracle Infinity
* Data Warehouses
* Enterprise Data Lakes
* Analytics platforms
* External marketing and customer-engagement platforms
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, middleware, batch interfaces, scheduled integrations, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Good understanding of SQL/query concepts, data modelling, data transformation, and data-quality principles.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex integration, data-processing, API, identity-resolution, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Understanding of customer-data activation from Oracle Unity into Eloqua and other marketing channels.

**Leadership And Management Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage a team of Oracle Unity developers, consultants, administrators, and data specialists.
* Estimate effort, prepare delivery plans, allocate resources, and monitor project execution.
* Mentor team members and develop Oracle Unity technical capabilities through knowledge-sharing, technical sessions, and hands-on guidance.
* Review deliverables and ensure adherence to technical, documentation, security, integration, and architecture standards.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate project status, risks, dependencies, issues, and key technical decisions.
* Facilitate design workshops and technical discussions with business, enterprise architecture, security, integration, data, analytics, and infrastructure teams.
* Collaborate with marketing and Eloqua teams to define customer activation and campaign integration strategies.
* Support project planning, solution estimation, proposals, technical presentations, demos, and pre-sales activities when required.
* Identify opportunities to create reusable solutions, accelerators, frameworks, automation, and implementation best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement across Oracle Unity implementation, support, data governance, and operational processes.
* Act as the escalation point for complex Oracle Unity technical and functional issues.

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong understanding of Customer 360, Customer Data Platforms, customer identity, data unification, segmentation, personalization, and activation.
* Good understanding of Marketing Automation and Oracle Eloqua concepts.
* Understanding of customer consent, privacy, security, retention, and enterprise data-governance requirements.
* Experience designing enterprise-scale customer-data solutions with high data volumes and multiple source systems.
* Experience supporting customer-data activation across CDP, CRM, Eloqua, and digital marketing channels.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining delivery quality.
* Experience working with geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to communicate complex Oracle Unity and integration concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: CGT Lead
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Various outside weather conditions
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Drive the growth of Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Cell & Gene Therapy (CGT) business by enabling and leading integrated workflow selling across businesses.
  
  
The role will identify strategic CGT opportunities, understand customers’ scientific, process-development and manufacturing workflows, and bring together capabilities from across Thermo Fisher Scientific to create differentiated, end-to-end solutions.
  
  
A critical aspect of this role is the ability to
**influence without direct authority**
. The incumbent will work across multiple businesses, commercial teams, product specialists, application scientists, marketing, service and other functions to create alignment around customer opportunities and mobilize the right capabilities to win.
  
  
The role will act as a
**CGT workflow orchestrator**
, moving customer engagement beyond individual products toward integrated solutions spanning research, process development, clinical translation and commercial manufacturing.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**CGT Workflow Selling & Business Growth**

* Develop and execute the commercial strategy for growing Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Cell & Gene Therapy business across assigned markets and strategic customers.
* Identify and develop high-value opportunities where multiple Thermo Fisher businesses can participate in the customer workflow.
* Build a strong pipeline of integrated CGT workflow opportunities rather than relying primarily on individual product opportunities.
* Understand customer programs from early research and process development through clinical translation, scale-up and commercial manufacturing to identify opportunities across the workflow.
* Connect relevant capabilities across cell biology, cell culture, cell processing, gene editing, viral vector and plasmid workflows, bioprocessing, analytical technologies, instruments, consumables, reagents and services.
* Translate customer scientific and manufacturing challenges into integrated Thermo Fisher value propositions.
* Drive penetration and share of wallet within strategic CGT customers through broader workflow adoption.
* Maintain strong commercial discipline around pipeline development, opportunity progression, forecasting and execution.

**One Thermo Fisher – Cross-Business Leadership**

* Serve as the commercial integrator for CGT opportunities across Thermo Fisher Scientific businesses.
* Bring together Business Units, commercial teams, Technical Sales Specialists, Application Scientists, Product Management, Marketing, Service and other relevant stakeholders around priority CGT opportunities.
* Establish a clear opportunity strategy and define how different businesses can collectively address the customer’s workflow.
* Create alignment across businesses on customer priorities, value propositions, engagement strategy and execution.
* Ensure individual product discussions are connected wherever appropriate into a broader CGT workflow and customer strategy.
* Identify gaps or overlaps between businesses and facilitate decisions that enable a coordinated One Thermo Fisher approach.
* Act as the internal voice of the CGT customer, ensuring customer workflow requirements and emerging needs are understood across relevant businesses.

**Influence Without Authority**
Success in this role will depend heavily on the ability to
**lead through influence rather than organizational authority**
.
  
  
The incumbent will:
  
  

* Build credibility and trusted relationships with commercial and business leaders across Thermo Fisher Scientific.
* Influence Business Units and sales teams to collaborate on opportunities that span organizational boundaries.
* Create alignment among stakeholders who may have different priorities, objectives and reporting structures.
* Mobilize resources across businesses without necessarily having direct control over those resources.
* Establish shared objectives and mutual accountability around strategic CGT opportunities.
* Navigate a complex matrix organization and resolve competing priorities through collaboration, data, customer insight and business rationale.
* Build internal advocacy for CGT opportunities and secure commitment from relevant stakeholders.
* Facilitate decisions and maintain momentum across complex opportunities involving multiple internal and customer stakeholders.
* Demonstrate strong executive presence, stakeholder management, negotiation and influencing skills.

**Strategic Customer Leadership**

* Develop strong relationships with biotechnology, biopharmaceutical, CDMO, academic, translational research and other organizations participating in the Cell & Gene Therapy ecosystem.
* Engage senior scientists, R&D leaders, process-development teams, manufacturing leaders, procurement teams and business executives.
* Develop a deep understanding of customers’ therapeutic pipelines, technology platforms, manufacturing strategies, capacity expansion plans and long-term priorities.
* Build multi-year strategic account and workflow plans for priority CGT customers.
* Identify opportunities for broader strategic partnerships extending beyond individual product transactions.
* Lead complex, high-value opportunities involving multiple Thermo Fisher businesses and multiple customer stakeholders.
* Conduct strategic business reviews and workflow discussions with key customers.

**Scientific & Workflow Leadership**

* Develop strong understanding of evolving Cell & Gene Therapy technologies, modalities, manufacturing platforms and customer workflow challenges.
* Maintain working knowledge across cell therapy, gene therapy, gene editing, viral vectors, plasmids, regenerative medicine and other relevant advanced-therapy areas.
* Engage customers in scientifically credible, workflow-oriented discussions.
* Enable commercial teams to move from product selling to consultative, workflow-based and outcome-oriented selling.
* Translate scientific and technology developments into actionable commercial opportunities.
* Partner with Business Units, application teams, R&D and Product Management to communicate unmet customer needs and emerging workflow requirements.
* Support scientific forums, workshops, seminars, roundtables and customer innovation discussions that strengthen Thermo Fisher Scientific’s position within the CGT ecosystem.

**Commercial Enablement & Opportunity Leadership**

* Work alongside divisional and regional commercial teams to identify, qualify and progress strategic CGT opportunities.
* Coach and enable sales teams on CGT workflows, customer discovery, consultative selling and cross-business opportunity development.
* Support teams in mapping customer workflows, stakeholders, decision-making processes and competitive positions.
* Develop compelling integrated value propositions for complex customer opportunities.
* Facilitate opportunity strategy sessions involving relevant businesses and specialists.
* Establish mechanisms to track major cross-business CGT opportunities and ensure clear actions, ownership and follow-through.
* Review pipeline quality, customer engagement and competitive activity and drive corrective actions where required.

**Market Development & Strategic Insights**

* Continuously assess the CGT market, including scientific developments, therapeutic pipelines, manufacturing investments, technology shifts, funding trends and evolving customer needs.
* Identify emerging workflow opportunities and areas where Thermo Fisher Scientific can create differentiated value through its combined portfolio.
* Translate market and customer intelligence into recommendations for commercial strategy, portfolio development, marketing and customer engagement.
* Provide structured feedback to business and regional leadership regarding customer requirements, competitive threats and emerging opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for strategic collaborations and ecosystem partnerships where appropriate.

**Education & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Engineering, Pharmacy, Cell Biology, Immunology or a related scientific discipline.
* Advanced scientific qualification such as a PhD is advantageous.
* MBA or equivalent business/commercial qualification is desirable but not mandatory.

**Experience**

* Typically 15+ years of progressive experience in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biopharma, Cell & Gene Therapy, Bioprocessing or related industries.
* Strong understanding of the Cell & Gene Therapy ecosystem and associated research, process-development, manufacturing and analytical workflows.
* Significant experience in commercial leadership, business development, strategic account management, technical sales or market development.
* Demonstrated experience selling or developing complex workflow solutions involving multiple technologies, product categories or business units.
* Proven experience managing complex, high-value, multi-stakeholder commercial opportunities.
* Demonstrated ability to engage senior scientific, technical, manufacturing, commercial, procurement and executive stakeholders.
* Experience operating successfully within a complex matrix organization where outcomes depend on influence rather than direct authority.
* Proven record of building alignment and driving execution across multiple businesses and functions.

**Key Competencies**
**Influence Without Authority**
Exceptional ability to create alignment, gain commitment and drive execution across teams and businesses that do not directly report to the role.
  
  
**Workflow & Solution Selling**
Ability to understand complex customer workflows and connect multiple Thermo Fisher capabilities into differentiated customer solutions.
  
  
**CGT Scientific & Commercial Acumen**
Strong understanding of Cell & Gene Therapy technologies, customer workflows, business drivers and market dynamics.
  
  
**Cross-Business Collaboration**
Ability to operate effectively across organizational boundaries and create a One Thermo Fisher approach to strategic opportunities.
  
  
**Strategic Customer Leadership**
Ability to understand customer strategy beyond individual product requirements and build long-term, multi-level relationships.
  
  
**Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management**
Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and influencing capabilities with both internal and external senior stakeholders.
  
  
**Commercial Execution**
Strong opportunity management, account planning, forecasting, prioritization and execution discipline.
  
  
**Learning Agility**
Ability to rapidly understand emerging CGT technologies and translate scientific developments into commercial opportunities.
  
  
**Key Measures of Success**
Success in this role will be measured through:
  
  

* Sustainable growth of the Cell & Gene Therapy business.
* Growth and quality of the cross-business CGT workflow opportunity pipeline.
* Revenue generated through integrated / multi-business CGT opportunities.
* Increased penetration and share of wallet within strategic CGT customers.
* Number and quality of customers adopting broader Thermo Fisher workflow solutions.
* Effectiveness of cross-business collaboration and One Thermo Fisher execution.
* Ability to mobilize internal stakeholders and resources through influence without direct authority.
* Development of strategic customer relationships and executive-level engagement.
* Forecast accuracy and disciplined progression of strategic opportunities.
* Ability to translate emerging CGT customer needs and market trends into actionable growth opportunities.

title: Consulting Project Management
description:

Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs.

Our organization is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI. We take pride in embodying Microsoft's mission of empowerment, promoting a growth mindset, inspiring excellence, and fostering a culture of inclusivity where everyone is encouraged to share their unique perspectives and be their authentic selves. By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to life-changing innovations that impact billions of people worldwide.

The ISD Consulting Project Management Manager (CPMM) is responsible for driving delivery excellence across a portfolio of consulting engagements in ASEAN, ensuring consistent governance, predictable financial outcomes, high customer satisfaction, and strong Consulting Project Manager (CPM) capability.

The CPMM leads and develops a team of CPMs and partners closely with Customer Success Access Managers, Architects, Sales, and Delivery Leadership to deliver on ISD delivery commitments and enable ISD expansion and consumption impact through disciplined execution and customer‑centric delivery practices.

In addition, the CPMM also acts as a senior delivery management executive for key customer accounts, directly accountable on the program execution, escalations, stakeholder management and financial Profit and loss of the porgram, leading the project team members, and collaborating with cross-functional units to deliver impactful outcomes to our customers.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

Key Accountabilities:

1. Portfolio Delivery & Governance  
Own end‑to‑end delivery health across a portfolio of ISD consulting projects within ASEAN.  
Establish and enforce standard delivery governance, including Project health reporting, Customer and internal Steering Committees, Executive escalations and corrective actions. Proactively identify systemic delivery risks and drive early intervention across projects.

2. Financial & Commercial Accountability  
Accountable for portfolio‑level financial performance, including forecast accuracy, cost control, and margin protection.  
Partner with CPMs to manage Sub‑contractor and partner costs, Scope, change control, and delivery‑driven financial risks, and ensure clean project closure and financial hygiene. Act as a trusted partner to Finance and Delivery Leadership on delivery‑related financial matters.

3. People Leadership & Capability Development  
Directly manage, coach, and develop a team of Consulting Project Managers (CPMs) across ASEAN.  
Drive improvements in Delivery discipline and planning quality, Escalation effectiveness, Customer communication and reporting maturity. Build future readiness by strengthening bench depth, succession, and capability uplift across the CPM community.

4. Customer & Stakeholder Leadership  
Act as a senior escalation point for complex delivery challenges and at‑risk engagements. Lead customer conversations related to Delivery recovery, Governance reset, Confidence and trust restoration. Partner with Customer Success Account Managers (CSAM) and Architects to ensure delivery remains aligned to customer outcomes and value realization.

5. Expansion & Consumption  
Enable consistent account expansion motion & behaviors across the CPM team, ensuring delivery insights translate into business opportunities. Ensure CPMs identify expansion signals through delivery milestones and customer rhythms  
Execute disciplined handoffs to CSAMs / Sellers using ISD processes and tools. Reinforce a delivery‑led growth mindset across the ASEAN portfolio.

6. Cross‑Functional Collaboration  
Internal: ISD Leadership, CSAMs, Architects, Sales, Finance, Partner Management  
External: Customer sponsors and executives, delivery partners, system integrators

Success Measures:  
Predictable portfolio delivery outcomes;  
Improved financial health and forecast accuracy;  
Strong customer satisfaction and delivery confidence;  
Increased maturity and consistency of CPM practices;  
Tangible Expansion Opportunity contributions enabled through delivery excellence

 **Qualifications**

Required Qualifications (RQs)

* Bachelor's Degree in related field AND 8+ years of experience in customer‑facing consulting delivery, program/project management, or digital transformation, including responsibility for complex, multi‑workstream engagements;
* 2+ years of experience managing multiple projects or a delivery portfolio, with accountability for delivery outcomes beyond a single engagement;
* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, and development of project/program managers or equivalent roles;
* Proven ability to operate in a matrixed, cross‑functional environment, partnering effectively with Sales, Engineering, Finance, and Customer Success stakeholders;

title: Multiple openings
description:
**Company Description**
Fanwizz is a startup sports management organization lead by experienced industry professionals that focuses on innovation and bold ideas in Sports Management, Sports IP and sports content.

The company believes in going the extra mile and taking unconventional approaches to lead from the front in the sports industry. With a strong conviction to succeed, Fanwizz is committed to creating unique, out-of-the-box initiatives that shape the future of sports properties and experiences. Team members are encouraged to think creatively, take ownership, and contribute to pioneering projects in a dynamic environment.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time role based in New Delhi. Multiple openings are available in Operations and Sales & Marketing. Day-to-day responsibilities may include coordinating sports events and projects, supporting sports IP development, collaborating on content and campaigns, managing stakeholder communications, and contributing to strategic planning. Team members will work closely with colleagues to execute initiatives, track performance, and ensure that projects are delivered on time and align with the organization’s goals in sports management and content.

**Operations**

**Manager Operations – OP1**

The role will involve planning and managing day-to-day operations across Fanwizz projects and properties. The candidate should be comfortable handling multiple responsibilities, coordinating with different teams and ensuring that work is delivered on time.

**Executive Operations – OP2**

The Executive Operations role will support the planning and execution of ongoing projects. Responsibilities will include coordination, follow-ups, documentation, vendor and stakeholder communication, and general operational support.

**Office Assistant – OP3**

The Office Assistant will support the smooth running of the office and assist the team with administrative and day-to-day requirements and mange the Front Office.

**Sales & Marketing**

**Manager Sales & Marketing – SM1**

The role will involve driving business opportunities, developing relationships with potential partners and clients, and supporting the company’s sales and marketing initiatives. The candidate should be confident in dealing with people and taking ownership of commercial responsibilities.

**Executive Sales & Marketing – SM2**

The Executive will support the sales and marketing team in identifying opportunities, preparing proposals and presentations, following up with clients and assisting with campaigns and business development activities.

**Executive Relationships – SM3**

The role will focus on maintaining and developing relationships with clients, partners and other stakeholders. The candidate will be responsible for regular communication, coordination and follow-ups to ensure strong professional relationships.

**Qualifications**

We are looking for candidates with relevant education and/or work experience for the respective positions.

\* Good communication and interpersonal skills are essential.

\* Candidates should be organised, responsible and able to work independently when required.

\* A willingness to learn and take on responsibilities beyond a fixed job description will be valued.

\* Previous experience in sports, events, sales, marketing, operations or stakeholder management will be an advantage, depending on the role.

\* Candidates applying for managerial positions should have relevant experience in managing teams, projects or business responsibilities.

\* A genuine interest in sports and the sports business ecosystem would be an added advantage.

title: Lead – Field Operations & Partnerships
description:
**About NinjaHelp**

Finding trusted help for your home (an elder-care attendant, a nanny, a cook) is still one of the most stressful, word-of-mouth, cash-only searches in urban India. Families struggle to trust who walks through their door, and workers rarely get fair, dependable work.

NinjaHelp is changing that. We’re building the technology layer for India’s household help market: verified worker profiles, smart matching, partner management and simple monthly payments. Families get trusted help in days, not weeks. Our worker app, Saathi, already supports six Indian languages. We work with a growing network of partner agencies across Delhi-NCR, with Bangalore and Mumbai next.

We’re a small team led by leaders from Paytm, MakeMyTrip, Goibibo and Flipkart, and we’re building the operations engine that makes all of this work on the ground.

**The role**

You’ll own field operations and partnerships in Delhi-NCR: the people, partners and processes that turn a family’s request into a trusted worker at their door. You’ll build the playbook here, then take it to new cities. This is a hands-on leadership role: you’ll be in the field as much as in spreadsheets.

**What you’ll do**

* **Grow and manage our partner agency network:**
  identify, pitch and onboard agencies; run document checks and compliance; drive them on service levels through our Priority Partner programme.
* **Build worker supply:**
  run onboarding drives with partners and community networks; get workers onto Saathi with complete, verified profiles.
* **Own fulfilment end to end:**
  from a family’s request to matching, trial and a successful start. Track time-to-fill, trial success and replacement rates, and fix what breaks.
* **Run the family experience on the ground:**
  home visits, escalations and replacement conversations, with a high bar for trust and safety.
* **Build and lead the field team:**
  hire, train and manage field executives; set targets, routines and reviews.
* **Shape the product:**
  work with our tech team on the operations console, partner portal and Saathi app, turning field insight into features.
* **Launch new cities:**
  document what works in Delhi-NCR and lead the playbook for our 2027 city launches.

**You’ll be a great fit if you have**

* 3–6 years in supply, partner or field operations at a marketplace or consumer platform: home services, mobility, food or quick commerce, travel supply, seller onboarding, or hyperlocal fulfilment.
* A track record of building and managing a partner or supplier network, with numbers to show it.
* Experience leading a small field team and running operations on metrics.
* Comfort on the ground: you’re as effective at an agency office in Dwarka as on a call with a family in Golf Course Road.
* Fluency in Hindi and English. Bengali, Nepali, Assamese or Odia is a strong plus.
* High ownership, integrity and calm under pressure. You’ll be dealing with people’s homes and livelihoods.

**Why join now: early equity, real ownership**

* **Early-team ESOPs.**
  You’ll be among our first team members and receive stock options from our earliest grants, at today’s valuation. Equity granted this early is where the meaningful upside sits if we execute, and you’ll be one of the people executing.
* **Build from zero to one.**
  No inherited playbook: the operating system you design becomes the template for every city we launch.
* **Direct access to leadership.**
  You’ll work closely with the founders and have a real say in how the company is built.
* **A problem that matters.**
  Every match you make means a family gets trusted help and a worker gets fair, dependable work.
* **Room to grow.**
  As we expand, this role is built to grow into heading operations across cities.

**Compensation:**
competitive fixed salary plus early-team ESOPs.

**To apply:**
apply here with your CV and a short note on the toughest partner or supply network you’ve built, and what the numbers looked like.

title: Innovation Programs Lead, APJ Innovation and Engagement
description:
**Description**
The APJ Innovation and Engagement team is the pulse of innovation for AWS in the region. We design and deliver innovation experiences that bring Amazon's culture and technology to life — helping senior executives reimagine what's possible and chart a path from idea to production. Beyond delivery, we shape innovation strategy for APJ: identifying emerging technology trends, understanding how they intersect with customer needs across diverse markets, and translating that into experiences that drive real business outcomes. Our team works across 14 countries spanning vastly different industries, stages of cloud maturity, and competitive landscapes. We partner closely with field sales, solutions architecture, and specialist teams to activate customers and ensure every engagement moves the needle. We are builders at heart — constantly evolving our content, mechanisms, and delivery models to stay ahead of the pace of change in AI and technology innovation. We're looking for a customer-obsessed Innovation Program Lead to drive customer impact through our innovation experiences — using Amazon culture and technology to help enterprise customers discover, invent, and build their way to production. This role is about delivering tangible business outcomes, helping customers realize value from their technology and AI investments by combining the best of how Amazon innovates with the power of AWS technology. You'll facilitate executive engagements, activate customers in partnership with field sales teams, build scalable mechanisms across our top customers, and lead the development of next-generation content. The nature of innovation is ever-changing, and this role requires someone who is deeply adaptable and energized by that pace of change.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Customer Impact through Business, Technology & Culture Transformation
* Lead and facilitate executive-level innovation sessions that bring Amazon's culture of innovation — Working Backwards, customer obsession, bias for action — to life for customers. Create an environment where senior leaders engage deeply with new possibilities and leave with clear business outcomes in mind.
* Apply first-principles thinking to understand customers' most pressing challenges and translate those into actionable AI-driven solution pathways. Help customers adopt Amazon's innovation methods alongside AWS technology to drive real business results.
* Own the customer journey beyond the engagement — work closely with field sales teams to activate customers, drive solution adoption, and accelerate the path from idea to measurable business outcomes in production.
* Mechanisms & Operational Excellence
* Design and implement scalable engagement frameworks. Leverage AI to streamline processes — from session preparation to insight capture — ensuring every customer interaction generates reusable learnings.
* Build the ability to scale innovation experiences across our top customers in the region, ensuring consistent quality and impact at volume while delivering business outcomes.
* Build strong operating interlocks with field sales teams, solutions architects, and partner organizations. Establish a clear operating model that makes it frictionless for account teams to activate customers into innovation experiences.
* Codify what works. Develop playbooks, templates, and tooling that enable other markets to replicate successful engagement patterns as the model expands across the region.
* Content Leadership
* Build next-generation content modules focused on generative AI, agentic systems, and applied AI — grounded in Amazon's culture of innovation and maintained as a portfolio that is modular, industry-adaptable, and technically current.
* Elevate the delivery experience — integrate AI to personalize content in real-time, generate dynamic demonstrations, and create immersive customer experiences that bring Amazon culture and technology together in a way that sets us apart in the region.
* The nature of innovation is ever-changing. Maintain a forward-looking content roadmap, monitor industry signals, competitive moves, and customer patterns — and adapt quickly to ensure our offerings remain relevant as technology evolves.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
* Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
* Strong first-principles problem-solving ability — comfortable deconstructing ambiguous customer challenges into clear action plans that deliver business outcomes
* Strong ability to apply AI/ML capabilities to solve business problems and drive transformation outcomes, engaging both technical and business audiences on generative AI, agentic systems, and applied AI
* Track record of driving measurable customer business outcomes in partnership with field sales teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience operating across APJ markets with sensitivity to regional and cultural nuances
* Consulting background with experience advising senior leaders on technology-led business transformation
* Passion for Amazon's culture of innovation and ability to translate it into customer-facing experiences
* Hands-on experience applying AI tools to business problems and customer engagement workflows

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:

* Lead the end-to-end application packaging lifecycle from requirements gathering through deployment, maintenance, and retirement.

* Design and implement application assignment strategies, deployment rings, dependencies, supersedence relationships, and targeting methodologies.

* Investigate application installation issues, operating system behavior, registry settings, services, user profiles, and device configuration problems.
* Utilize Event Viewer, logging tools, PowerShell diagnostics, and endpoint management tools to perform root cause analysis.
* Support Windows feature updates, cumulative updates, and application validation activities.

* Participate in on-call support and escalation activities as required.
* Maintain familiarity with Microsoft security baselines, audit requirements, and endpoint security controls.
* Develop and maintain documentation required to support internal and external audit activities.
* Monitor vendor portals, technical advisories, and release communications for software updates, patches, vulnerabilities, and lifecycle announcements.
* Partner with Information Security teams to ensure packaged applications comply with organizational security standards and regulatory requirements.
* Other activities as may be assigned by your manager

**Qualifications/ Requirements**

* Associate’s degree in related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Experienced support staff with 5+ years of relevant experience.
* 5+ years of experience in Enterprise Application Packaging and Deployment.
* Strong hands-on experience with:



* Microsoft Intune
* PowerShell Scripting
* PSAppDeployToolkit (PSADT)
* MSI, EXE, and MSIX Packaging
* Win32 Application Deployment
* Application Detection and Remediation Methods
* Advanced knowledge of Windows 10 and Windows 11 administration.
* Experience troubleshooting enterprise application deployment and endpoint management issues.
* Strong understanding of application lifecycle management and software deployment best practices.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with Microsoft Endpoint Manager / Intune.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Windows Autopilot.
* Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* Experience with Windows Autopatch.
* Familiarity with Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and Windows 365 Cloud PC environments.
* Experience with software asset management, inventory management, and license compliance.
* Knowledge of endpoint security controls, application control technologies, and endpoint hardening practices.
* Experience supporting enterprise environments with 1,000+ endpoints.
* Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to research and resolve a wide variety of endpoint and application-related technical issues.
* Ability to learn new technologies quickly and adapt to changing business requirements.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

title: Digital & IT Team Lead
description:
**Position Summary**
**MAIN DUTIES:**

* Lead JDE, RFGen, Power BI, RPA, and related IT services for FCG divisions in India, ensuring alignment with division objectives, corporate IT standards, and performance SLAs.
* Partner with functional, manufacturing, and global teams to understand business needs and translate them into IT roadmaps, project portfolios, annual budgets, and five‑year strategic plans.
* Design, implement, and maintain best‑practice infrastructure, security, data governance, and SOX‑compliant processes (including access controls, change management, backup/disaster recovery, and vulnerability remediation).
* Oversee lifecycle management of key systems (JDE, Power BI, RPA, and related platforms), including enhancements, integrations, and security hardening.
* Govern the design, development, and support of Power BI dashboards and reports, and identify, develop, and deploy RPA use cases to drive automation and process efficiency.
* Support resolution of critical incidents and complex technical problems, providing logical analysis of technical queries in an aerospace manufacturing environment.
* Interact directly with internal customers to review, understand, and document business requirements, processes, and workflows; develop written and visual requirements, process flows, and gap analyses.
* Analyse complex data using statistical and technical techniques/queries to support decision‑making, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Guide the development and assist in the management and implementation of IT systems and services, determining division‑level versus enterprise‑level solutions in collaboration with corporate IT.
* Provide information and guidance to promote understanding and maximize the benefit of technology systems; communicate IT plans, priorities, risks, and decisions, managing customer expectations effectively.
* Recruit, develop, and retain a high‑performing IT organization; lead talent development, coaching, succession planning, and strategic workforce planning.
* Guide and train location and country team members in technical business skills, systems, and processes; develop training materials and deliver one‑on‑one and classroom training.
* Deliver concise functional specifications (functional hierarchy, workflows, business rules, interfaces, data analysis and mapping, and open issues) to stakeholders and development teams.
* Evaluate unplanned requests, determine appropriate priority and action, manage multiple priorities through effective organization and communication, and support cost‑optimization efforts.
* Promote a culture of safety, ethics, quality, and continuous improvement within the IT organization and across divisional stakeholders, staying abreast of new Digital and IT innovations and assessing their applicability for Parker India.

**Responsibilities**

* Service Delivery & Operations Accountable for reliable, secure, and SOX‑compliant operation of JDE, Power BI, RPA, and related IT services for FCG, meeting agreed SLAs for availability, performance, and support.
* Business Alignment & Roadmapping Ensure IT strategies, roadmaps, and project portfolios are aligned with division, country, group, and corporate business objectives.
* Infrastructure, Security & Compliance Own implementation of best‑practice infrastructure, cybersecurity, data governance, and compliance processes, including access controls, change management, disaster recovery, and vulnerability remediation.
* Analytics, Automation & Process Improvement Drive adoption of Power BI analytics and RPA automation to improve visibility, efficiency, and quality of business processes, particularly in aerospace manufacturing environments.
* Incident & Problem Management Own the resolution of critical incidents and complex technical problems, ensuring effective root cause analysis, timely recovery, and prevention of recurrence.
* Requirements, Design & Specifications Accountable for accurate capture and documentation of business requirements, process flows, gap analyses, and functional specifications that guide solution design and delivery.
* Data & Decision Support Ensure effective use of data analysis, statistical techniques, and technical queries to support business decisions, performance management, and continuous improvement.
* Stakeholder & Customer Management Maintain strong relationships with internal customers and stakeholders, ensuring clear communication of IT decisions, impacts, priorities, and expectations.
* Solution Governance (Division vs. Enterprise) Define, in collaboration with corporate IT, which solutions are division‑level versus enterprise‑level and ensure consistent governance, standardization, and reuse.
* Training & Knowledge Transfer Ensure development and delivery of effective training and documentation so that location and country teams can successfully use and support IT systems and processes.
* Demand, Change & Priority Management Govern intake, evaluation, and prioritization of planned and unplanned IT requests, balancing resources and managing multiple priorities to deliver committed outcomes.
* Culture, Safety & Ethics Champion Parker’s values by promoting a culture of safety, ethics, quality, and continuous improvement across the IT organization and divisional stakeholders

**Qualifications**
**Education & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required.
* Relevant professional certifications desirable (e.g., ITIL, PMP/Prince2, COBIT, Azure/Cloud, data/analytics, security).

**Experience**

* Typically, 8–12 years of progressive experience in IT, including significant experience in manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience supporting and enhancing JDE in an operational/plant context.
* Hands‑on experience with Power BI (data modelling, reports, dashboards) and RPA concepts/tools.
* Proven track record in leading IT projects and initiatives, including requirements gathering, design, testing, deployment, and change management.
* Experience in IT infrastructure, security, and SOX/compliance‑driven environments.
* Prior people‑management or team‑lead experience strongly preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of ERP processes (e.g., finance, supply chain, manufacturing, quality) and JDE modules relevant to manufacturing.
* Proficiency in Power BI, including data modelling, DAX, and integration with operational and financial data sources.
* Understanding of RPA concepts, architectures, and typical use cases (tools experience is an advantage).
* Solid understanding of IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud, endpoints), cybersecurity principles, and disaster recovery.
* Ability to analyse complex datasets using statistical and technical queries (SQL or similar).
* Familiarity with ITIL / service management practices (incident, problem, change, release).

**Business & Analytical Skills**

* Strong ability to analyse business processes, perform gap analysis, and translate requirements into functional specifications and process flows.
* Capable of logical analysis of simple to complex technical queries in a manufacturing setting and driving root‑cause resolution.
* Demonstrated capability to manage multiple priorities, evaluate unplanned requests, and set appropriate priorities and actions.
* Financial acumen to participate in budgeting, business cases, and cost/benefit analysis.

**Leadership & Interpersonal Skills**

* Proven ability to lead and develop a high‑performing team; strong coaching, feedback, and people‑development skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics in business language.
* Strong influencing skills to align diverse stakeholders (business, manufacturing, corporate IT, vendors) around common solutions and standards.
* Effective planning and organizational skills with a structured, disciplined approach to delivery.

**Personal Attributes**

* Customer‑focused mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for service quality.
* High integrity and commitment to Parker’s values of safety, ethics, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Proactive, self‑driven, and comfortable working in a dynamic, matrixed, and global environment.
* Willingness to stay current with Digital and IT innovations and apply them pragmatically to create business value.

title: Animal Rescue & Field Operations Manager (Animal Shelter)
description:
**ABOUT US:**

Sarvoham Welfare Trust is a charitable organization dedicated to the welfare of under-privileged animals in Bangalore, India. Sarvoham was established in April 2017 by co-founders Haris Ali & Madhusmita Sahu with a vision to create an inclusive eco-system that co-exists with animals providing them a respectable life that contributes to the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) frameworks and Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs’) for the planet.

Over the past 9 years, Sarvoham has grown from a small charity effort to a well-established animal welfare organization. We have rescued more than 3500 street animals, and provide a shelter for more than 200 dogs.

Sarvoham means the harmony between all elements of nature, both human and non-human, and the organization is guided by the spirit of harmonious coexistence.

**ROLE PURPOSE:**

Sarvoham Welfare Trust stands at a defining moment in its journey to create a more compassionate world for animals and seeks to expand its impact by building a sustainable ecosystem of partnerships and philanthropy that will enable many more lives to be saved and transformed.

The Animal Rescue Manager is a key role responsible that will lead and coordinate the end-to-end rescue operations for animals in distress — receiving and triaging rescue calls, dispatching field teams, ensuring safe and humane handling/transport of injured or at-risk animals, coordinating with veterinary staff for immediate medical care, and maintaining records and protocols so rescues are handled consistently, safely, and in compliance with animal welfare standards. The role essentially bridges the gap between the public reporting an animal in need and the organization's veterinary and shelter operations, ensuring rescues are timely, well-documented, and aligned with the organization's broader animal welfare mission.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Rescue Operation Planning:**

* Develop comprehensive plans for rescue operations based on specific needs and requirements.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure alignment and support for rescue efforts.

**Emergency Response:**

* Respond promptly to animal rescue and distress calls, dispatching the ambulance as needed.
* Prioritize urgent situations and coordinate ambulance services accordingly.

**Ambulance Coordination:**

* Coordinate scheduling of ambulance services for the release of recovered pets.
* Ensure timely and efficient transport of animals to their destinations.

**Follow-up and Resolution:**

* Follow up on unresolved rescue cases, providing necessary assistance until satisfactorily resolved.
* Close cases once resolved and ensure proper documentation.

**Community Engagement:**

* Solicit Google reviews from individuals involved in rescue operations, fostering positive feedback and community engagement.

**Resource Mobilization:**

* Identify and mobilize necessary resources for successful rescue missions.
* Liaise with suppliers and partners to procure required resources in a timely manner.

**Team Coordination:**

* Lead and coordinate rescue teams, providing guidance and support to ensure smooth execution of tasks.
* Undertake a range of administrative tasks to ensure staffing requirements and obligations are maintained, including approving timesheets, monitoring call queues, and managing work breaks.

**Risk Assessment and Mitigation:**

* Conduct thorough risk assessments before each rescue operation.
* Develop strategies to mitigate risks and ensure the safety of rescue teams and individuals in distress.

**Communication and Liaison:**

* Maintain open communication with relevant teams, coordinating activities and facilitating cooperation.

**Pet Owner Assistance:**

* Assist pet owners in understanding and navigating the helpline number’s IVR system, addressing queries, and providing guidance.
* Keep pet owners informed about the status of the ambulance until the animal is safely picked up.

**Logistics Management:**

description:
