***Global Precision Manufacturing Technology Partner***
*.*

**Role Overview**

**We are seeking an experienced Cost & Estimation Manager**
to lead customer RFQ evaluations, product costing, quotation management, and cost optimization for aerospace precision-machined components. The role will drive estimation accuracy, pricing competitiveness, margin protection, and continuous improvement through strong collaboration with Sales, Engineering, Manufacturing, Sourcing, and Finance teams.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. RFQ & Quotation Management**

* Lead end-to-end RFQ evaluation, cost estimation, and timely submission of competitive customer quotations.
* Ensure accurate costing based on technical drawings, specifications, material requirements, machining cycles, and special processes.
* Maintain pricing consistency, cost traceability, and adherence to approval procedures.

**2. Costing & Pricing Strategy**

* Develop and maintain robust cost models covering raw materials, machining, tooling, subcontracting, overheads, and other manufacturing costs.
* Establish and periodically review machine-hour rates, overhead absorption, and pricing assumptions with Finance.
* Ensure quotations align with manufacturing capabilities, market conditions, and target profit margins.

**3. Supplier & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Partner with Sourcing/Purchase to validate supplier quotations, subcontracting costs, and material pricing.
* Collaborate with Sales and Engineering to assess RFQs, evaluate commercial risks, and improve quote-to-order conversion.
* Work closely with Manufacturing to validate cycle times, capacity assumptions, and process costs.

**4. Cost Performance & Margin Improvement**

* Monitor estimated versus actual costs for awarded parts and programs, identify variances, and drive corrective actions.
* Review manufacturing cost trends, highlight inefficiencies, and recommend actions to protect and improve margins.
* Analyze quotation wins and losses to strengthen pricing accuracy and competitiveness.

**5. Continuous Improvement & Cost Reduction**

* Support Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives through data-driven cost analysis.
* Identify opportunities to optimize material utilization, machining cycles, processes, and supplier costs.
* Track and validate cost savings and their impact on profitability.

**6. Team Leadership & Capability Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the costing team to ensure accurate, timely, and consistent RFQ execution.
* Standardize costing methodologies, estimation practices, and ERP discipline.
* Build strong cross-functional collaboration and a culture of cost ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Desired Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related discipline; relevant cost accounting or finance qualifications are an advantage.
* Proven experience in cost estimation, product costing, and RFQ management within aerospace, precision machining, or high-precision manufacturing.
* Strong understanding of engineering drawings, machining processes, cycle-time estimation, raw materials, tooling, and special processes.
* Experience in cost modelling, pricing strategy, supplier cost analysis, and margin management.
* Proficiency in ERP systems, Excel-based costing models, and data analysis.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, communication, and team leadership skills.
* Exposure to AS9100 quality systems and aerospace customer requirements is preferred.
* Existing industry relationships in aerospace, aviation, or medical components would be an advantage.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
* Opportunities to work with global customers and advanced precision manufacturing technologies.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* A collaborative, performance-driven work environment.

**Ready to make an impact?**

Join TASE and play a pivotal role in strengthening pricing competitiveness, driving cost excellence, and supporting profitable growth in the global aerospace and precision manufacturing industry.

Category manager for Global Professional Services
  
  
Category Manager - Global Professional Services Sourcing
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Category Manager - Global Professional Services Sourcing is accountable for developing and executing the global sourcing strategy for external professional services. The role partners with business, technology and functional stakeholders to shape demand, run competitive sourcing processes, negotiate strong commercial outcomes, establish fit-for-purpose contracts and statements of work, and improve supplier performance.
  
  
Category Scope
  
  
Consulting and advisory services; technology and engineering professional services; project-based services; implementation services; specialist services; staff augmentation for the indirect sourcing category where in scope; and related managed or outcome-based engagements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Category Strategy and Planning
  
  

* Develop, maintain and execute a global category strategy aligned with business priorities, technology roadmaps and financial objectives.
* Analyse spend, demand, supplier concentration, market dynamics, rate structures and regional delivery models to identify opportunities and risks.
* Build and manage a multi-year sourcing pipeline, including renewals, new requirements, consolidation initiatives and supplier transitions.
* Design preferred-supplier, panel and governance models that improve buying channels, transparency and control.

Strategic Sourcing and Negotiation
  
  

* Lead end-to-end RFIs, RFPs, RFQs and competitive negotiations for complex professional-services requirements.
* Partner with stakeholders to convert business needs into clear scopes, deliverables, evaluation criteria and commercial models.
* Develop supplier evaluation frameworks covering capability, delivery, commercials, risk, sustainability and cultural fit.
* Negotiate competitive rate cards, discounts, volume tiers, productivity commitments, payment terms, indexation, travel and expense rules, and other commercial protections.
* Recommend sourcing decisions using fact-based analyses, total-cost considerations and clearly documented trade-offs.

Contract and Statement of Work Governance
  
  

* Lead the commercial development and review of master agreements, statements of work, amendments and change requests in partnership with Legal and relevant control functions.
* Ensure each engagement has clear scope, deliverables, milestones, acceptance criteria, service levels, pricing, resource assumptions, governance and change-control provisions.
* Promote the appropriate use of fixed-price, milestone-based, time-and-materials, capacity, managed-service and outcome-based models.
* Identify and prevent scope ambiguity, uncontrolled change, rate leakage, weak acceptance provisions and inappropriate dependency on named resources.

Supplier and Performance Management
  
  

* Own commercial relationships with strategic professional-services suppliers and maintain effective executive-level engagement.
* Establish supplier scorecards, business reviews and improvement plans covering cost, quality, delivery, responsiveness, innovation and contractual compliance.
* Lead or support resolution of supplier performance issues, commercial disputes and escalations.
* Drive supplier rationalisation, capability development and continuous improvement while maintaining appropriate competition and resilience.

Governance, Risk and Reporting
  
  

* Distinguish appropriately between professional services, staff augmentation, contingent labour, managed services and outsourced services, escalating classification or compliance concerns when required.
* Ensure sourcing activity follows company policies, delegated authority, competition requirements, data protection, information security and applicable regulatory expectations.
* Maintain accurate reporting on spend under management, sourcing pipeline, contract and SOW expirations, savings, cost avoidance, risks, decisions and supplier issues.

**Required Experience And Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement or category management, with substantial ownership of professional-services spend in a global or complex organisation.
* Demonstrated success leading complex RFx processes and negotiating high-value professional-services agreements and statements of work.
* Strong understanding of consulting, technology, engineering or other knowledge-based service delivery models, including onshore, nearshore and offshore structures.
* Proven ability to interpret rate cards, resource pyramids, utilisation assumptions, project economics and total cost of ownership.
* Experience managing strategic suppliers, performance reviews, improvement plans and commercial escalations.
* Strong contract and commercial acumen, with practical knowledge of scope, acceptance, service levels, change control, intellectual property, confidentiality, liability and termination concepts.
* Strong analytical capability and proficiency with spend, pipeline, savings and supplier-performance data.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, supply chain, technology or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships and work effectively with diverse stakeholders across functions, cultures, geographies and levels of seniority, adapting communication and influencing styles to achieve alignment and drive decisions.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in technology, engineering, telecommunications, media, manufacturing or another multinational environment.
* Experience establishing preferred-supplier programmes, global rate cards, offshore delivery models or outcome-based services.
* Familiarity with e-sourcing, contract lifecycle management, spend analytics and supplier-management platforms.
* Experience working across cultures, regions and time zones.
* MBA in related fields.

title: IS Organizational Effectiveness Manager – R&D Commercialization and PPM
description:
The IS Organizational Effectiveness Manager is responsible for enabling effective delivery across multiple Digital Product Teams supporting R&D Commercialization and PPM through strong SAFe Agile execution, Release Train leadership, Scrum Master responsibilities, and Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) adoption.
  
  
This role serves as a hands-on delivery leader responsible for coordinating cross-product planning and execution, facilitating Agile ceremonies, managing dependencies and risks, improving delivery transparency, and enabling teams to consistently deliver measurable business value.
  
  
The role will partner closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, engineering teams, business stakeholders, and Agile/DPOM enablement partners to establish scalable ways of working across multiple product teams.
  
  
**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
**Release Train & Cross-Product Delivery**

* Serve as Release Train Engineer and delivery lead across multiple Digital Product Teams, coordinating integrated planning and execution across the product landscape.
* Establish and facilitate the operating cadence required to coordinate multiple teams, products, dependencies, releases, and shared resources.
* Lead preparation and facilitation of PI Planning, ART synchronization, product-level planning, Inspect & Adapt events, and other cross-team SAFe ceremonies.
* Maintain visibility into cross-team dependencies, risks, impediments, milestones, capacity, and delivery commitments.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Management to translate product roadmaps and business priorities into executable delivery plans.
* Drive resolution of delivery impediments and escalate systemic risks or decisions requiring leadership intervention.
* Coordinate with other Release Train Engineers, Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and delivery leaders where work spans ARTs, products, or organizational boundaries.

**Scrum Master & Team Delivery Responsibilities**

* Provide hands-on Scrum Master leadership for product teams as required while maintaining cross-team Release Train responsibilities.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Coach teams on effective backlog management, story readiness, estimation, capacity planning, prioritization, and definition of done.
* Help teams identify and remove impediments that affect delivery, quality, flow, or predictability.
* Promote team ownership, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Adapt Agile practices pragmatically based on team maturity, product needs, and organizational context rather than focusing solely on process compliance.

**Product Operating Model Enablement**

* Support maturation of Amgen's Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) & SAFe Agile frameworks across participating product teams.
* Help translate DPOM & SAFe Agile principles into practical delivery processes, roles, ceremonies, governance, and decision-making mechanisms.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Management to strengthen the connection between business outcomes, product roadmaps, prioritization, capacity, and technology delivery.
* Help teams evolve from project-oriented execution toward persistent, outcome-oriented digital product delivery.
* Clarify roles, decision rights, handoffs, and operating expectations across Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, engineering teams, and delivery roles.
* Partner with enterprise Agile and DPOM enablement teams to align local practices with evolving enterprise standards and strategy.

**Delivery Governance, Metrics & Reporting**

* Establish and maintain consistent Agile delivery practices and JIRA structures across participating product teams.
* Develop delivery reporting that provides Product Owners and leadership with clear visibility into roadmap execution, capacity, progress, dependencies, risks, and impediments.
* Use meaningful delivery and product metrics to assess flow, predictability, quality, throughput, risk, and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Facilitate regular delivery and program reviews with Product Owners and stakeholders.
* Ensure metrics support decision-making and improvement rather than becoming administrative reporting exercises.
* Support consistent tracking of product roadmap commitments, releases, milestones, and value drops.

**Agile Coaching & Continuous Improvement**

* Coach Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, engineering teams, and other stakeholders on effective SAFe, Agile, Lean, and product delivery practices.
* Assess team and Release Train maturity and identify practical opportunities to improve planning, execution, flow, collaboration, and predictability.
* Develop and promote reusable delivery practices, templates, playbooks, and standards that can scale across product teams.
* Foster shared learning and consistency while allowing teams flexibility based on product and delivery needs.
* Encourage experimentation and iterative improvement of the delivery operating model.

**Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Build strong working relationships with Product Owners, Product Management, business stakeholders, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, engineering teams, and enterprise enablement partners.
* Facilitate alignment when priorities, dependencies, resource capacity, or delivery expectations span multiple product teams.
* Communicate delivery progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and improvement opportunities clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
* Influence teams and stakeholders through facilitation, expertise, and data rather than formal reporting authority.
* Collaborate effectively across geographically distributed teams and time zones.

**Must-Have Skills**
**Required Functional Skills and Qualifications**

* Experience in Agile technology or digital product delivery, including hands-on experience as a Release Train Engineer, Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, Product Owner, or similar role.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating delivery across multiple Agile or Digital Product Teams.
* Strong working knowledge of SAFe, Scrum, Agile principles, product delivery, and continuous improvement.
* Hands-on experience facilitating PI Planning, Agile Release Train activities, Scrum ceremonies, dependency management, risk management, and cross-team planning.
* Experience establishing and managing Agile delivery processes and reporting through JIRA or comparable Agile lifecycle management tools.
* Demonstrated ability to identify delivery impediments and facilitate resolution across organizational and team boundaries.
* Strong facilitation, communication, stakeholder-management, and influencing skills.
* Ability to operate effectively through influence without direct people-management authority.
* Experience working with globally distributed technology and business teams.
* Ability to connect Agile delivery practices with product roadmaps, business outcomes, stakeholder value, and enterprise priorities.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience working within or transitioning toward a Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) or comparable product-centric technology operating model.
* SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE), SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Practice Consultant, or comparable Agile certification.
* Experience supporting multiple Digital Product Teams or an Agile Release Train simultaneously.
* Experience designing or improving Agile delivery operating models, governance structures, JIRA workflows, metrics, or reporting.
* Experience working across digital product, software engineering, data, analytics, and/or AI product teams.
* Experience facilitating organizational change from project-based technology delivery toward persistent product teams and outcome-oriented delivery.

title: Manager V&A Transformation Initiatives
description:
**Job Description Summary: Manager, V&A Transformation Initiatives**
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As Manager – V&A Transformation Initiatives, you will be at the forefront of solving the US Value & Access team’s biggest challenges using cutting edge technology. The AIN Transformation team will be viewed as an “innovation engine”, constantly testing and refining analytics solutions to address customer needs and opportunities alongside business partners.
  
  
In your role as a manager, you’ll be expected to combine a deep understanding of access data and analytics with experience in developing and deploying advanced machine learning, operational research, semantic analysis, and statistical methods to uncover structure in large data sets. Together with 2-4 associates you lead, you will be responsible for building and testing solutions for targeted business challenges. This will include application of advanced machine learning, operational research, semantic analysis, and statistical methods to uncover structure in large data sets.
  
  
The ideal candidate for this position will understand the business challenges that US Value & Access teams face and will have with a track record of success in applying that knowledge to build, deploy, and refine high impact advanced analytics tools.
  
  
This role will report to the Senior Manager, V&A Transformation Initiatives and will work in close collaboration with leaders of the Strategy & Innovation Team in the United States Access Analytics & Insights organization in India.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Accountable to drive full lifecycle of data science projects delivery and ability to guide data scientists in shaping the developing the solution and act as a subject matter expert in solving development and commercial questions
* Assume the role of business owner and manage the Proprietary AI engine built to optimize Copay
* Ensure models are trained with the latest data and meet the SLA expectations
* Manage AI tool’s road map, working with a global cross functional team
* Work in technical teams in development, deployment, and application of applied analytics, predictive analytics, and prescriptive analytics.
* Utilize technical skills such as hypothesis testing, machine learning and retrieval processes to apply statistical and data mining techniques to identify trends, create figures, and analyze other relevant information.
* Perform exploratory and targeted data analyses using descriptive statistics and other methods.
* Model/analytics experiment and development pipeline leveraging MLOps.
* Oversee efforts of 2-4 associates, including setting performance standards, managing their staffing, and monitoring performance
* Collaborate with technical teams to translate the business needs into technical specifications, particularly focusing on AI-driven automation and insights.
* Develop and integrate custom applications, intelligent dashboards, and automated workflows that incorporate AI capabilities to enhance decision-making and efficiency.

**What We Expect Of You**
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.
  
  
Basic Qualifications
**:**

* Master’s degree in computer science, statistics or STEM majors with a minimum of 6 years of Information Systems experience OR
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, statistics or STEM majors with a minimum of 8 years of Information Systems experience.
* Foundational understanding of US pharmaceutical ecosystem and Patient support services offerings and other standard data sets including claims, prescription, EMR
* Experience with one or more analytic software tools or languages like R and Python
* Strong foundation in machine learning algorithms and techniques
* Experience in statistical techniques and hypothesis testing, experience with regression analysis, clustering and classification

Preferred Qualifications
**:**

* Experience in MLOps practices and tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow); Experience in DevOps tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD)
* Proficiency in Python and relevant ML libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn)
* Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills; Ability to learn quickly; Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Experience with data engineering and pipeline development
* Knowledge of NLP techniques for text analysis and sentiment analysis
* Experience in analyzing time-series data for forecasting and trend analysis
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
* Experience with Databricks platform for data analytics and MLOps

Professional Certifications
  
  

* Any AWS Developer certification (preferred)
* Any Python and ML certification (preferred)

Soft Skills:
  
  

* Initiative to explore alternate technology and approaches to solving problems.
* Skilled in breaking down problems, documenting problem statements, and estimating efforts.
* Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams
* High degree of initiative and self-motivation.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully.
* Team-oriented, with a focus on achieving team goals

**What You Can Expect Of Us**
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.
  
  
In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.

title: Senior Expert, Material Science Project Leader
description:
**Summary**
As a Materials Science Project Lead, you will provide scientific and project leadership for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) crystallization and finishing process-development activities, as well as solid-form activities performed at strategic external partners in India. You will define strategies, provide technical direction, critically evaluate experimental plans and results, and ensure that externally executed work delivers scientifically sound, robust and scalable solutions for our development projects.
  
  
You will apply your subject-matter expertise to direct and scientifically oversee laboratory studies performed by strategic external partners. Your principal technical focus will be crystallization and API finishing processes, including sieving, milling and micronization, with particular emphasis on ensuring successful scale-up from laboratory to pilot-plant and manufacturing environments.
  
  
Based in India, you will be an integral member of our global Materials Science organization and collaborate closely with colleagues and subject-matter experts in India, Switzerland and China. You will combine technical depth with strong external-partner project leadership, ensuring effective scientific alignment, knowledge exchange and delivery across organizational and geographic boundaries.
  
  
As a core contributor to the External Partner and Supply Management Team, you will build effective scientific relationships with strategic external partners, maintain oversight of project execution, and connect externally performed activities with internal project strategies, stakeholders and governance forums. The role may involve travel within India to partner sites according to project needs.
  
  
**About The Role**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead Materials Science activities at strategic external partners in India, defining development strategies, experimental plans for API crystallization and finishing step processes, and solid form development.
* Provide subject-matter expertise in crystallization process optimization, robustness, scale-up and transfer, and in finishing technologies including sieving, milling and micronization.
* Scientifically oversee external laboratory work, critically reviewing protocols, data, conclusions and technical reports, and guiding troubleshooting and risk mitigation.
* Assess particle and powder properties of APIs to ensure suitability for subsequent drug product processing.
* Collaborate with global Materials Science colleagues, represent the function in project and governance forums, and ensure scientific alignment and knowledge exchange.
* Bridge between drug substance and drug product during technical development, whilst ensuring full business alignment with other line functions and project sub-teams.

**Essential Requirements**

* PhD in a relevant scientific or engineering discipline, or a relevant master's degree with minimum 5 years of industry experience. Chemical Engineer with 8-14 years of experience.
* Relevant industrial experience and strong subject-matter expertise in API crystallization and finishing process development including process optimization robustness and scale-up.
* Strong knowledge of sieving, milling or micronization and of relevant particle and powder characterization.
* Experience in planning, overseeing and directing laboratory development activities at external partners, reviewing and assessing data, and turning results into clear technical recommendations
* Ability to provide scientific direction, constructively challenge stakeholders and guide troubleshooting in complex projects.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with strong communication, influencing and cross-cultural collaboration skills.

**Why Novartis:**
Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture
  
  
**Benefits and Rewards:**
Learn about all the ways we’ll help you thrive personally and professionally.

title: FinCrime Operations Team Lead - Screening
description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
**Role & Job Purpose**
As a FinCrime Operations Team Lead - Sanctions you will develop and oversee the daily operations of a team of FinCrime Operations Analysts or Specialists. Your primary purpose is to ensure the effective mitigation of financial crime risks associated with Wise's customers, while maintaining a strong focus on operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and a customer-centric approach. You will foster a high-performing team, drive operational excellence, and act as a subject matter expert in KYC/AML/Fraud/Screening and financial crime prevention. You will be responsible for ensuring your team meets performance targets, maintains or elevates quality standards, and contributes to a culture of continuous improvement within the FinCrime Operations organization.
  
  
The FinCrime Operations Team Lead is a dual-focused leader, combining strong people leadership with domain and operational expertise. You will be instrumental in building and refining processes that prioritise customer impact while maintaining focus on the evolving risks within the financial services industry, specific product vulnerabilities, and the requirements set by regulations and partners. This includes supporting the development of compliant and scalable processes and possessing an understanding of financial crime risks associated with our customers, products, and tooling.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership**
You will lead by example, driving a customer-focused mindset across your team and the wider fincrime organization. You are instrumental in fostering a high-performance, results-driven culture defined by strong ownership and accountability. This involves building and nurturing high-performing teams that value knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and adaptability in our change-oriented environment. Fincrime Operations Team Lead demonstrates strong capabilities in timely conflict resolution and fosters open communication and guides effective mediation to ensure a positive working environment. You should be visible and actively engaged in team management. Your focus is on unifying the team behind shared goals (and wider FinCrime/servicing strategies) and driving collective actions.
  
  
**People management**
Coach and develop a strong team of FinCrime Operations Analysts or Specialists with varying levels of experience, providing tailored guidance, and taking swift, decisive action to manage performance issues effectively, ensuring sustained excellence and growth. Provide regular, constructive, and actionable feedback to your direct reports. Coach and mentor team members to support their growth, develop their skills, and help them reach their full potential. Design and manage performance or development plans in identified areas. Conduct career map check-ins and make recommendations for demotions, promotions, salary raises, and other role related decisions.
  
  
**Operational management**
You will oversee the daily operations of the team, ensuring adherence to relevant regulations and internal policies and processes. Identify and propose opportunities for process and tooling improvements. Collaborate with central functions and other operational teams as needed to increase operational efficiency or to ensure effective cross-team collaboration on joint initiatives. Provide guidance and support on complex, high-risk cases and escalations. Be on top of timely admin related tasks including but not limited to scheduling, training, hiring, interviewing, organising team activities, and others.
  
  
**Performance management**
Measure team and individual KPIs and ensure performance targets and quality standards are consistently met while maintaining focus on customer experience and adherence to internal guidelines. Drive high-quality results for both the team and individuals, continuously enhancing overall quality outcomes. Conduct timely quality reviews, ensuring high decision accuracy and effectively communicate the importance of quality assurance. Conduct regular and impactful one on one coaching sessions (usually on a weekly or biweekly basis), provide clear and actionable feedback. Ensure tasks are managed timely and aligned with the team’s goals. Run team meetings to ensure that your team is kept up to date with the latest information, share best practices and enhance overall team spirit. Addresses underperformance promptly through coaching and setting SMART goals, and ensures all interventions are well-documented. Understand and be able to articulate how to move key metrics at team and individual level through efficient performance and task management.
  
  
**Expertise sharing**
Be a subject matter expert in financial crime areas with the ability to obtain and maintain sufficient subject matter expertise required to train, develop and coach your team. Maintain a comprehensive understanding of our regulatory obligations, internal policies, domain-specific processes and best practices. Apply a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Perform and support deep dives, understand root causes of problematic cases and propose solutions to senior leadership. Assist senior leadership with reviews and developing our processes, task management and in other operational areas as requested to ensure compliant and effective servicing function
  
  
**Issue Management and Escalation**
Escalate tooling or processing incidents, high-risk customer issues, control weaknesses, or other material problems to direct leadership in a timely and informative manner, following established protocols.
  
  
**Planning and execution**
Be accountable for driving your direct team's performance outcomes, ensuring key performance indicators (KPIs) are consistently met and enhanced. Possess strong knowledge of team processes and tooling, leveraging data to support initiative execution. This involves taking full ownership of your team's results, setting targets for improvement, and providing insights to stakeholders. Set and progress towards goals, adeptly identifying and resolving blockers or issues, whether performance or metric-related, to optimize output and results.
  
  
**Stakeholder management and communication**
Collaborate closely with stakeholders ensuring clear communication and coordination of actions. Your initiatives and reports are well documented and you choose the right platforms to communicate to a wider audience in a timely manner. The documentation has a clear scope and includes potential impact in different areas. You can communicate confidently with difficult stakeholders on varied operational or domain related topics. Proactively work on improving cross-team communication and collaboration, acting as the liaison between different layers of the organization and your own team. Employ impactful and inspiring communication skills, unifying individuals behind shared goals, and leverage strong presentation skills to convey vision and progress.
  
  
**Other:**
Perform additional tasks as assigned by your lead, demonstrating adaptability and a proactive approach. This includes actively participating in meetings, trainings, workshops, and internal events to support broader team and company objectives.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
  
  
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
  
  
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Consulting Project Management
description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs.
  
  
Our organization is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI. We take pride in embodying Microsoft's mission of empowerment, promoting a growth mindset, inspiring excellence, and fostering a culture of inclusivity where everyone is encouraged to share their unique perspectives and be their authentic selves. By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to life-changing innovations that impact billions of people worldwide.
  
  
The ISD Consulting Project Management Manager (CPMM) is responsible for driving delivery excellence across a portfolio of consulting engagements in ASEAN, ensuring consistent governance, predictable financial outcomes, high customer satisfaction, and strong Consulting Project Manager (CPM) capability.
  
  
The CPMM leads and develops a team of CPMs and partners closely with Customer Success Access Managers, Architects, Sales, and Delivery Leadership to deliver on ISD delivery commitments and enable ISD expansion and consumption impact through disciplined execution and customer‑centric delivery practices.
  
  
In addition, the CPMM also acts as a senior delivery management executive for key customer accounts, directly accountable on the program execution, escalations, stakeholder management and financial Profit and loss of the porgram, leading the project team members, and collaborating with cross-functional units to deliver impactful outcomes to our customers.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Accountabilities:
  
  

* Portfolio Delivery & Governance

Own end‑to‑end delivery health across a portfolio of ISD consulting projects within ASEAN.
  
  
Establish and enforce standard delivery governance, including Project health reporting, Customer and internal Steering Committees, Executive escalations and corrective actions. Proactively identify systemic delivery risks and drive early intervention across projects.
  
  

* Financial & Commercial Accountability

Accountable for portfolio‑level financial performance, including forecast accuracy, cost control, and margin protection.
  
  
Partner with CPMs to manage Sub‑contractor and partner costs, Scope, change control, and delivery‑driven financial risks, and ensure clean project closure and financial hygiene. Act as a trusted partner to Finance and Delivery Leadership on delivery‑related financial matters.
  
  

* People Leadership & Capability Development

Directly manage, coach, and develop a team of Consulting Project Managers (CPMs) across ASEAN.
  
  
Drive improvements in Delivery discipline and planning quality, Escalation effectiveness, Customer communication and reporting maturity. Build future readiness by strengthening bench depth, succession, and capability uplift across the CPM community.
  
  

* Customer & Stakeholder Leadership

Act as a senior escalation point for complex delivery challenges and at‑risk engagements. Lead customer conversations related to Delivery recovery, Governance reset, Confidence and trust restoration. Partner with Customer Success Account Managers (CSAM) and Architects to ensure delivery remains aligned to customer outcomes and value realization.
  
  

* Expansion & Consumption

Enable consistent account expansion motion & behaviors across the CPM team, ensuring delivery insights translate into business opportunities. Ensure CPMs identify expansion signals through delivery milestones and customer rhythms
  
  
Execute disciplined handoffs to CSAMs / Sellers using ISD processes and tools. Reinforce a delivery‑led growth mindset across the ASEAN portfolio.
  
  

* Cross‑Functional Collaboration

Internal: ISD Leadership, CSAMs, Architects, Sales, Finance, Partner Management
  
  
External: Customer sponsors and executives, delivery partners, system integrators
  
  
**Success Measures**
Predictable portfolio delivery outcomes;
  
  
Improved financial health and forecast accuracy;
  
  
Strong customer satisfaction and delivery confidence;
  
  
Increased maturity and consistency of CPM practices;
  
  
Tangible Expansion Opportunity contributions enabled through delivery excellence
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications (RQs)
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in related field AND 8+ years of experience in customer‑facing consulting delivery, program/project management, or digital transformation, including responsibility for complex, multi‑workstream engagements;
* 2+ years of experience managing multiple projects or a delivery portfolio, with accountability for delivery outcomes beyond a single engagement;
* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, and development of project/program managers or equivalent roles;
* Proven ability to operate in a matrixed, cross‑functional environment, partnering effectively with Sales, Engineering, Finance, and Customer Success stakeholders;

**Preferred Qualifications (PQs)**

* 10+ years of experience in consulting, large‑scale delivery transformation, or enterprise program leadership, preferably across multiple customers or geographies.
* Experience managing delivery financials, including forecasting, cost control, margin protection, and project closure discipline, and partner / subcontractor management across different markets.
* Experience enabling delivery‑led growth outcomes, such as identifying expansion signals, partnering on opportunity handoffs, or supporting pipeline creation through delivery insights.
* Agile certification, Scrum Master, Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), or Professional Scrum Master One (PSM1) certification

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Manager, Engineering  (Platform Engineering)
description:
**About ScienceLogic…**
ScienceLogic is redefining IT operations for the modern enterprise. Our AIOps platform empowers organizations to achieve Autonomic IT — where systems are self-healing, self-optimizing, and seamlessly aligned with business outcomes. We help enterprises and service providers gain unified visibility across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, automate workflows, and unlock performance at scale.
  
  
We’re accelerating digital transformation through the power of automation, AI, and analytics — giving IT and business leaders the tools to deliver superior customer experiences, drive efficiency, and innovate with confidence.
  
  
**Work Location: Hyderabad**
**What We're Looking For...**
ScienceLogic is hiring a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead our Platform Engineering team in Hyderabad. This role will manage a ten-person team responsible for the infrastructure, systems, and test automation that our SkylarOne hybrid cloud monitoring platform runs on. You will report to the Director of Product Engineering (India), with a dotted line to the Sr. Director of Engineering (US), and you'll sit on the India engineering leadership team. This role is ideal for an experienced engineering leader who enjoys staying close to technical decision-making while building organizational scale. You'll provide leadership across platform modernization, reliability, and operational excellence while developing future team leaders and strengthening the team's management structure.
  
  
**Who We Are...**
ScienceLogic scored a leadership position in the “Forrester Wave” AI Observability report. We are a global, growing software company reinventing the way companies manage their hybrid cloud data and systems by driving operational and business insights from the extensive data types contained in the SkylarOne data lake with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing...**
You'll lead a ten-person team comprised of full-time employees and contractors, covering the following day-to-day:
  
  

* Owning technical direction and architecture for SkylarOne platform modernization, including OS migrations, cloud infrastructure, and system reliability.
* Managing delivery across systems engineering, DevOps/test infrastructure, and networking, staying hands-on with design reviews, troubleshooting, and code/config review while delegating as the team grows.
* Developing future leaders within the organization and building an effective management and technical leadership structure that supports team growth and scale.
* Partnering with the QA Engineering Manager, the Solutions Engineering Manager, and India-based Product Owners to align platform work with product and quality roadmaps.
* Owning hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development for direct reports.
* Representing the India platform team in planning and reviews with Mahesh Hanumanula and other US engineering leadership.
* Driving infrastructure cost optimization and rightsizing across on-premises (VMware) and AWS environments.
* Participating in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and driving continuous improvement in system operations and release readiness.

**Qualities you possess...**
**Must Have**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of engineering experience, including at least 3 years leading engineering teams. People-management experience is required for this role, not a nice-to-have.
* Demonstrated experience growing a team's structure, hiring into a growing org, and ideally building or mentoring a first layer of team leads.
* A hands-on background in systems engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering: comfortable reviewing architecture, debugging production issues, and making infrastructure decisions rather than just relaying them.
* Strong understanding of Linux administration, automation, and cloud infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, routing) sufficient to guide a networking specialist on the team.
* Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices (e.g., Terraform, Jenkins).
* Comfortable operating across a matrixed reporting structure and collaborating with stakeholders in different time zones.

**Good To Have**

* AWS experience or certification.
* Scripting or programming experience (Python, Golang, or Bash).
* Exposure to AI-driven development practices or AI coding assistants.

title: Oracle CDP/Unity- Manager
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. As an Oracle CDP/Unity Manager, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize operational efficiency through business application consulting. You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on working with Oracle's suite of applications and tools designed to manage the entire customer journey, from lead generation to revenue realization and customer satisfaction.
  
  
As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, marketing automation, and customer experience solutions to meet the specific needs of an organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, and marketing automation solutions to optimize client operations
* Analyzing client needs to develop tailored software solutions that enhance customer experience and satisfaction
* Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Oracle applications
* Managing the entire customer journey from lead generation to revenue realization using Oracle's suite of tools

* Navigating complex situations and using critical thinking to solve problems and generate new ideas
* Upholding professional and technical standards, including PwC's code of conduct and independence requirements
* Utilizing analytical thinking to interpret data and inform insights and recommendations
* Collaborating with teams to deliver quality and strategic objectives in business application consulting
* Embracing change and leveraging digital tooling to enhance client service delivery

What You Must Have
  
  

* Overall experience of 8–12 years, with strong hands-on and leadership experience in Oracle Unity Customer Data Platform (CDP) implementations.
* Experience leading at least 2–3 end-to-end Oracle Unity/CDP implementations.
* Good working experience with Oracle Eloqua Marketing Automation, particularly integrations between Unity, Eloqua, CRM, and other enterprise applications.
* Strong experience in solution architecture, technical design, data modelling, integrations, delivery management, stakeholder management, and team leadership.
* Ability to lead teams comprising developers, consultants, administrators, data engineers, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Customer Data Platforms, Customer 360, CRM, Marketing Automation, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, Data Warehouses, and enterprise integrations.

**Role And Responsibilities**

* Lead the overall solution design, architecture, implementation, and support of Oracle Unity solutions.
* Work closely with business, marketing, sales, service, IT, data, and architecture teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Oracle Unity solutions.
* Own technical design decisions and ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, integration, data governance, and performance standards.
* Lead requirement-gathering and solution-design workshops and provide recommendations based on Oracle Unity capabilities and best practices.
* Review and approve technical requirements, solution design documents, integration specifications, source-to-target mappings, test strategies, deployment plans, and operational documentation.
* Manage multiple Unity workstreams and ensure delivery within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business expectations.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, training, feedback, and guidance to developers, consultants, administrators, and end business users.
* Perform solution and design reviews and establish reusable development, integration, and configuration standards.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, data-quality issues, integration challenges, and performance bottlenecks and drive them to resolution.
* Coordinate with Oracle Support and other vendors for product issues, enhancements, patches, and technical escalations.
* Work with marketing teams to define how customer segments and attributes from Oracle Unity can be activated through Oracle Eloqua campaigns and marketing programs.
* Manage key business and technology stakeholders, align priorities, and communicate scope, risks, dependencies, and delivery status for Oracle Unity initiatives.Build strong relationships across Marketing, Sales, Service, CRM, Data, Analytics, Security, Architecture, and Operations teams.
* Own the overall Oracle Unity solution architecture and define scalable, secure, reusable, and maintainable CDP solution patterns.Design end-to-end data ingestion, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, integration, and Customer 360 architecture across enterprise systems.
* Lead solution demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and capability showcases for Oracle Unity use cases and platform features.Present Customer 360, identity resolution, segmentation, intelligent attributes, dashboards, integrations, and activation flows to business and technical stakeholders.
* Support pre-sales activities including discovery sessions, solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and client presentations.Work with sales and delivery teams to define Unity solution approaches, scope, timelines, assumptions, integrations, and resource requirements.
* Manage resource planning, allocation, capacity, utilization, workload, and delivery commitments across multiple Oracle Unity projects and workstreams.Identify skill gaps, support hiring and onboarding, and drive training, cross-skilling, mentoring, and capability development within the team.

**Oracle Unity / CDP Technical Responsibilities**

* Design the overall Oracle Unity data architecture, including source systems, ingestion strategy, data models, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, and downstream integrations.
* Design and configure data feeds and ingestion jobs to bring customer, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and other enterprise data into Oracle Unity.
* Define and review source-to-target mappings between source systems, data warehouses, Oracle Unity, CRM, Marketing, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, and other downstream platforms.
* Configure and extend Oracle Unity data models based on business, reporting, analytical, and activation requirements.
* Maintain strong understanding of Oracle Unity data objects, relationships, attributes, metadata, and query capabilities.
* Design and configure Identity Resolution rules, including match rules, survivorship rules, master entity identification, and resolution of duplicate or conflicting customer records.
* Review and troubleshoot MCPS queries and optimize queries for performance and scalability.
* Design and create Intelligent Attributes and use them in calculations, segmentation, personalization, analytics, and activation use cases.
* Define and implement customer segmentation strategies using demographic, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and predictive attributes.
* Create, configure, and manage Data Science and Machine Learning models available within Oracle Unity and assess their applicability to business use cases.
* Configure and manage address validation, standardization, enrichment, and data-quality processes.
* Design and develop Customer 360 dashboards using rules, sub-rules, data source views, calculated attributes, and custom widgets.
* Develop dashboards for customer engagement, segmentation, campaign performance, customer behavior, and other business KPIs.
* Design and manage integrations between Oracle Unity and enterprise applications such as Oracle Sales, Salesforce, Oracle Service, Oracle Loyalty, Oracle Eloqua, Oracle Infinity, Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, Analytics platforms, and third-party systems.
* Strong understanding of Oracle Unity REST APIs, batch integrations, outbound activation mechanisms, webhooks, and integration patterns.
* Define and manage Access Control, users, roles, permissions, and security governance within Oracle Unity.
* Establish data-governance standards covering data ingestion, customer identity, data quality, data privacy, retention, consent, security, and downstream data activation.
* Monitor Unity ingestion jobs, data pipelines, identity-resolution processes, segmentation jobs, calculations, data-science processes, and integrations.
* Perform root-cause analysis and drive resolution of data-processing, integration, identity-resolution, API, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Review platform usage and recommend performance, scalability, and operational improvements.
* Define customer-data activation patterns to support Customer 360, personalization, lead generation, cross-sell, up-sell, churn management, customer engagement, and next-best-action use cases.

**Oracle Eloqua Exposure**

* Good understanding of Oracle Eloqua architecture, campaign management, contacts, custom objects, segments, forms, landing pages, and lead-nurturing programs.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with Oracle Eloqua for customer segmentation, campaign activation, audience synchronization, and marketing personalization.
* Understand the data flow between Unity, Eloqua, CRM/Salesforce/Oracle Sales, and other downstream marketing systems.
* Support marketing teams in using Unity customer attributes, Intelligent Attributes, and segments within Eloqua campaigns.
* Good understanding of Eloqua integrations, APIs, native connectors, and data synchronization mechanisms.
* Support troubleshooting of data synchronization, campaign activation, contact-management, and integration issues between Unity and Eloqua.
* Understand lead management, lead scoring, campaign responses, and lead hand-off processes between Eloqua and CRM systems.

**Integration And Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Oracle Unity REST APIs and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with:
* Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM
* Salesforce
* Oracle Service
* Oracle Loyalty
* Oracle Eloqua
* Oracle Infinity
* Data Warehouses
* Enterprise Data Lakes
* Analytics platforms
* External marketing and customer-engagement platforms
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, middleware, batch interfaces, scheduled integrations, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Good understanding of SQL/query concepts, data modelling, data transformation, and data-quality principles.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex integration, data-processing, API, identity-resolution, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Understanding of customer-data activation from Oracle Unity into Eloqua and other marketing channels.

**Leadership And Management Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage a team of Oracle Unity developers, consultants, administrators, and data specialists.
* Estimate effort, prepare delivery plans, allocate resources, and monitor project execution.
* Mentor team members and develop Oracle Unity technical capabilities through knowledge-sharing, technical sessions, and hands-on guidance.
* Review deliverables and ensure adherence to technical, documentation, security, integration, and architecture standards.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate project status, risks, dependencies, issues, and key technical decisions.
* Facilitate design workshops and technical discussions with business, enterprise architecture, security, integration, data, analytics, and infrastructure teams.
* Collaborate with marketing and Eloqua teams to define customer activation and campaign integration strategies.
* Support project planning, solution estimation, proposals, technical presentations, demos, and pre-sales activities when required.
* Identify opportunities to create reusable solutions, accelerators, frameworks, automation, and implementation best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement across Oracle Unity implementation, support, data governance, and operational processes.
* Act as the escalation point for complex Oracle Unity technical and functional issues.

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong understanding of Customer 360, Customer Data Platforms, customer identity, data unification, segmentation, personalization, and activation.
* Good understanding of Marketing Automation and Oracle Eloqua concepts.
* Understanding of customer consent, privacy, security, retention, and enterprise data-governance requirements.
* Experience designing enterprise-scale customer-data solutions with high data volumes and multiple source systems.
* Experience supporting customer-data activation across CDP, CRM, Eloqua, and digital marketing channels.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining delivery quality.
* Experience working with geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to communicate complex Oracle Unity and integration concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Senior CQV Engineer
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area.
  
  
The role will require the leadership of an experienced, energetic, and committed Senior CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals.
  
  
The person should have experience of leading a team of CQV engineers for a project and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle from SLIA generation through to OQ completion. The lead will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations.
* To prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan.
* Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level.
* Track progress of C&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.
* Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities.
* Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards.
* Provide leadership in team meetings and facilitate problem-solving discussions to ensure project milestones are met.
* Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and external vendors to drive project success.
* Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management.
* Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule.
* Well versed with risk-based approaches to C&Q (e.g., ASTM E2500, ISPE)
* Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies.
* Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C&Q.
* Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports.
* Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems.
* Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design.
* Review vendor documents (CTOPs/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements.
* Ensures C&Q non-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner.
* Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews.
* Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site.
* Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction.
* System Startup activities

**Working Conditions**

* The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities.
* Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements.
* Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm., M. Pharm., B.Tech or BE or MSc.
* 10-15 year’s experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing.
* Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects.
* Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project.

**Technical Skills**

* Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis.
* In-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations.
* Experience with process validation and computer system validation.
* Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta-V, 800xA, etc.
* Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage.
* Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Director- R&D Technical Head
description:
**Responsibilities**
Technical Leadership & Strategy (40%)
  
  
  

* Define and own the end-to-end chip design strategy, methodology, and technology roadmap across all design verticals — SoC, Analog, Digital, Product & Test Engineering, Design Packaging, Verification and DFT.
* Establish design standards, best practices, and quality benchmarks to ensure silicon correctness, power-performance-area (PPA) targets, and first-silicon success rates.
* Evaluate and adopt state-of-the-art EDA toolchains (Cadence, Synopsys, Siemens EDA) and emerging design methodologies to maintain competitive advantage.
* Provide architectural guidance on SoC partitioning, IP integration, mixed-signal co-design, and design-for-manufacturability (DFM) across advanced process nodes.

Team Management & People Leadership (30%)
  
  
  

* Directly manage all vertical leads and engineering managers SoC, Analog, Digital, Product & Test Engineering, Design Packaging, Verification and DFT.
* Set clear goals, conduct regular reviews, and create individual development plans to build a high-performing, future-ready engineering organization.
* Drive talent acquisition strategy in partnership with HR; define technical interview frameworks and competency benchmarks for senior engineering hires.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning across a team of 12–20+ direct and indirect reports.

Project Monitoring & Cross-Vertical Coordination (15%)
  
  
  

* Engage regularly with all vertical leaders and project managers to understand project status, interdependencies, resource constraints, and technical risks.
* Supervise and monitor all active R&D projects from architecture definition through tapeout, ensuring milestones are met and technical blockers are resolved promptly.
* Facilitate cross-functional design reviews, tapeout readiness reviews, and silicon bring-up planning sessions to align all engineering verticals.
* Serve as the primary technical escalation point for critical design issues, guiding root-cause analysis and resolution across SoC, analog, digital, physical, and DFT domains.

Stakeholder Communication & Reporting (10%)
  
  
  

* Prepare and present comprehensive R&D project status reports, technical risk assessments, and resource utilization dashboards to senior leadership.
* Interface with global counterparts, foundry partners (e.g., TSMC, GlobalFoundries), and IP vendors to optimize design flows and process node qualifications.

Other Duties (5%)
  
  
  

* Champion R&D innovation initiatives; evaluate emerging technologies such as advanced packaging, chiplets, AI-driven EDA, and next-generation process nodes.
* Support IP strategy, design reuse frameworks, and internal knowledge management across the India R&D center.
* Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned by executive leadership.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, VLSI Design, or a closely related field; Master’s degree (M.E. / M.Tech / M.S.) strongly preferred.
* 20+ years of progressive experience in the semiconductor / VLSI industry, with a minimum of 5 years in a senior engineering leadership or technical management role.
* Proven, hands-on expertise across the complete chip design flow: SoC Architecture, Physical Design, Analog Design, Product & Test Engineering, Design Packaging, Verification Digital RTL Design, and DFT.
* Demonstrated experience managing and delivering multiple concurrent chip design projects from specification through GDS tapeout.
* Deep proficiency with industry-standard EDA tools: Cadence Innovus/Virtuoso, Synopsys Design Compiler/IC Compiler/PrimeTime.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English with demonstrated ability to present complex technical concepts to executive stakeholders.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience in leading R&D organizations of 25+ engineers across geographically distributed teams.
* Exposure to advanced packaging technologies (2.5D/3D IC, chiplet architectures) and multi-die integration methodologies.
* Familiarity with AI/ML-assisted EDA flows and next-generation design automation trends.
* Prior experience with automotive-grade semiconductor design (AEC-Q100, ISO 26262 / ASIL compliance) or high-reliability industrial semiconductor products.
* Strong publication record or patents in semiconductor design, device physics, or related fields.
* Experience working with global foundry partners (TSMC, GlobalFoundries) on advanced process node qualification and PDK evaluation.
* Demonstrated track record in building and scaling engineering teams; prior exposure to HR processes including headcount planning, compensation benchmarking, and performance management.
