title: Operations Manager – ( B.Tech / B.E. Immediate Joiner)
description:
**Company:** Octaga Green Power and Sugar Co. Ltd.  
**Industry:** Alcohol Manufacturing / Alcobev / Distillery  
**Job Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, On-Site  
**Experience Required:** 4–15+ Years  
**Salary:** ₹15,000–₹40,000 per month, depending on experience and suitability  
**Qualification:** B.Tech / B.E. – Mandatory  
**Reporting To:** Management / Senior Management

1. About the Role

Octaga Green Power and Sugar Co. Ltd. is looking for a technically qualified, experienced and disciplined Operations Manager to oversee the end-to-end operational activities of its alcohol manufacturing and alcobev business.

The candidate will be responsible for coordinating finished-goods management, excise documentation, warehouse operations, inventory control, transportation, dispatch, vehicle tracking and distribution through CSD (Canteen Stores Department) and retail channels.

This is a hands-on operational role requiring strong technical understanding, practical logistics experience, compliance awareness, team management and the ability to coordinate effectively with manufacturing plants, warehouse teams, transporters, distributors and senior management.

The ideal candidate must possess a **B.Tech / B.E. degree**, along with substantial experience in operations, supply chain, logistics or warehouse management. Candidates with practical experience in alcohol manufacturing, distilleries, alcobev or beverage distribution will be strongly preferred.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. End-to-End Operations Management**

* Oversee daily operational activities involving finished goods, warehousing, dispatch, transportation and distribution.
* Coordinate with manufacturing, production, packaging, quality, excise, sales, warehouse and accounts teams.
* Ensure finished products move from the manufacturing plant to the designated destination safely, legally and on time.
* Develop and implement operational procedures, reporting systems and accountability measures.
* Monitor daily activities and resolve operational bottlenecks independently.

**B. Excise and Statutory Compliance**

* Maintain practical knowledge of excise procedures, permits, passes and documentation required for the movement of alcoholic beverages.
* Coordinate with internal excise personnel, consultants and relevant authorities wherever required.
* Verify that all mandatory approvals and documentation are in place before dispatch.
* Maintain accurate records of production, stock, dispatch and transportation of alcoholic products.
* Monitor applicable state-wise regulatory requirements affecting the movement and sale of alcohol.
* Ensure compliance with company SOPs and applicable statutory requirements.

**C. State-Wise Labelling and Packaging Compliance**

* Understand state-wise alcohol labelling and packaging requirements across India.
* Verify labels, MRP, statutory declarations, markings and packaging specifications for the relevant market.
* Coordinate with production, packaging, quality, excise and sales teams to meet state-specific requirements.
* Ensure incorrect, damaged or non-compliant stock is not dispatched.
* Monitor changes in applicable labelling requirements and communicate them to the relevant teams.

**D. Transportation, Logistics and Vehicle Tracking**

* Plan and coordinate transportation of finished products to warehouses, distributors, CSD locations and retail markets.
* Coordinate with transporters, drivers, logistics vendors and distribution partners.
* Track vehicles from dispatch until final delivery.
* Monitor vehicle location, route, delivery status, delays and deviations.
* Plan efficient routes considering distance, delivery schedules, operational risks and applicable restrictions.
* Immediately address and escalate vehicle breakdowns, accidents, route deviations and transportation delays.

**E. Dispatch and Delivery Management**

* Verify product details, dispatch quantities, vehicle information and documentation before loading.
* Ensure proper loading, sealing, handling and transportation of finished alcohol products.
* Track shipments until successful delivery.
* Obtain and maintain proof of delivery (POD) and supporting documents.
* Investigate shortages, damages, breakages, pilferage and delivery discrepancies.
* Coordinate with warehouse and accounts teams to resolve dispatch and delivery issues.

**F. Quality Checks Before and After Dispatch**

* Coordinate with production and quality teams to ensure finished products are inspected before dispatch.
* Verify bottles, cartons, labels, packaging, batch details and overall product condition.
* Ensure damaged or incorrectly labelled products are not released for dispatch.
* Monitor complaints relating to leakage, breakage, shortages, incorrect quantities and packaging damage.
* Coordinate investigations and corrective actions with the relevant departments.
* Maintain records of quality-related complaints and delivery discrepancies.

**G. Warehouse and Inventory Management**

* Monitor finished-goods inventory and daily stock movement.
* Maintain accurate records of opening stock, production receipts, dispatches, returns, damages and closing stock.
* Conduct regular physical stock verification and reconcile discrepancies.
* Prevent pilferage, unauthorized stock movement and inventory losses.
* Ensure proper stacking, identification, storage and stock rotation.
* Coordinate with warehouse personnel to maintain accurate inventory records and operational discipline.

**H. CSD and Retail Distribution**

* Coordinate operational activities related to CSD and retail distribution channels.
* Ensure the correct products, quantities, labels and documentation are supplied to the respective markets.
* Monitor pending orders, dispatches, deliveries and market requirements.
* Coordinate with distributors and logistics partners to ensure timely supply.
* Resolve operational issues affecting product availability and delivery schedules.

**I. Vendor and Transporter Management**

* Develop and maintain effective working relationships with transporters and logistics vendors.
* Coordinate transportation arrangements, rates and service requirements with management.
* Monitor transporter performance, delivery timelines and handling standards.
* Maintain records of vendors, transporters, vehicles and service performance.
* Address repeated delays, route deviations, poor handling and delivery-related issues.

**J. Team Management and Operational Discipline**

* Supervise warehouse, dispatch, logistics and operational support staff.
* Allocate responsibilities and establish clear reporting structures.
* Ensure adherence to company SOPs, documentation standards and operational procedures.
* Review pending deliveries, stock positions, vehicle movements and operational issues regularly.
* Train and guide staff on documentation, stock handling and operational practices.
* Maintain discipline, accountability and timely reporting across teams.

**K. Crisis Management and Risk Control**

* Handle operational emergencies involving transportation, stock discrepancies, documentation and delivery delays.
* Develop contingency plans for critical dispatches and shipments.
* Identify risks relating to inventory loss, pilferage, transportation and compliance.
* Take timely corrective action and escalate significant issues to senior management.
* Ensure continuity of operations during unexpected disruptions.

3. MIS and Reporting Responsibilities

The Operations Manager must prepare, maintain and review the following reports:

* Daily dispatch and delivery report
* Finished-goods stock and inventory report
* Vehicle tracking and transportation report
* Pending orders and delivery status report
* Proof-of-delivery report
* Warehouse stock reconciliation report
* Damage, shortage and discrepancy report
* State-wise dispatch report
* Excise documentation and permit status report
* CSD and retail supply status report
* Transporter performance report
* Operational issues and escalation report

The candidate must be comfortable preparing reports in Excel and maintaining accurate operational records for management review.

4. Mandatory Educational Qualification

* **B.Tech / B.E. degree is compulsory.**
* Candidates with an engineering background and practical operational experience will be preferred.
* Additional qualifications in supply chain management, logistics, operations or industrial management will be an advantage.
* Candidates without a B.Tech / B.E. degree will not meet the mandatory educational requirement.

5. Experience and Industry Background

* Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in operations, logistics, transportation, supply chain or warehouse management.
* Strong preference for candidates with experience in alcohol manufacturing, alcobev, distilleries or beverage distribution.
* Experience in FMCG distribution or other regulated manufacturing industries may be considered if the candidate has relevant operational exposure.
* Practical experience in excise documentation, alcohol movement permits, state-wise labelling and distribution compliance is strongly preferred.
* Experience coordinating multiple locations, warehouses, transporters and distribution networks will be an advantage.
* Retired defence personnel with a B.Tech / B.E. degree and relevant operational experience may also be considered.

6. Required Knowledge and Technical Skills

The candidate should possess practical knowledge of:

* Alcohol manufacturing and alcobev operations
* Excise procedures, permits, passes and statutory documentation
* State-wise alcohol labelling and packaging requirements
* Finished-goods warehouse management
* Stock control, inventory reconciliation and loss prevention
* Transportation planning, route management and vehicle tracking
* Dispatch, delivery verification and proof-of-delivery documentation
* CSD and retail distribution operations
* Vendor and transporter management
* MS Excel, MIS preparation and operational reporting
* SOP implementation, team coordination and operational risk management

7. Key Skills and Competencies

* Strong leadership and decision-making abilities
* Excellent planning, coordination and follow-up skills
* High levels of discipline, integrity and accountability
* Strong documentation and reporting capabilities
* Problem-solving and crisis-management skills
* Ability to manage multiple operational activities simultaneously
* Practical, hands-on approach to resolving issues
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities
* Effective communication with plant teams, vendors, transporters and senior management

8. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Timely and accurate dispatches and deliveries
* Compliance with applicable excise and statutory documentation requirements
* Accuracy of stock records and inventory reconciliation
* Reduction in shortages, damages, breakages and pilferage
* Effective vehicle tracking and transporter performance
* Timely closure of pending deliveries and operational issues
* Accuracy and timeliness of MIS reports
* Warehouse discipline and adherence to SOPs
* Effective coordination with CSD, retail and distribution partners

9. Important Candidate Requirement

**This is not a general office-based Operations Manager position.**

We require a technically qualified professional who can take complete operational ownership of the following process:

**Manufacturing → Finished Goods → Quality Check → Excise Documentation → Warehouse → Dispatch → Transportation → Vehicle Tracking → CSD / Retail Delivery → Delivery Verification → Stock Reconciliation**

The candidate must be comfortable coordinating with manufacturing plants, warehouses, transporters, distributors, excise-related teams and senior management. Practical operational knowledge and the ability to ensure execution on the ground are essential.

10. Working Conditions

* Full-time, on-site position based in Mumbai.
* Regular coordination with manufacturing plants, warehouses, distributors and transporters.
* Travel to plants, warehouses, markets and other operational locations may be required.
* Coordination outside standard working hours may occasionally be necessary depending on dispatch schedules and operational requirements.

11. Application Process

Interested candidates should share their updated CV on WhatsApp.

**HR WhatsApp:** 8788339043

Please mention **“Operations Manager – Alcobev”** while applying.

**Mandatory:** B.Tech / B.E. qualification and relevant operational experience.

Pay: ₹8,900.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Manager Business Planning
description:
The role will have end-to-end responsibility for footwear business planning, production planning, commercial governance, factory capacity planning, vendor management, merchandising coordination, tooling planning, and delivery performance across the India business.

The footwear business is increasingly dependent on an optimal combination of imports and local manufacturing to meet changing business, compliance, quality, cost, and availability requirements. In this environment, the role will be responsible for developing a clear understanding of current and future production capacity, identifying potential supply constraints, and proactively aligning production plans with business requirements.

The position will work closely with Category, Merchandising, Planning, Sourcing, Finance, Supply Chain, Quality, Product Development, Operations, and manufacturing partners to ensure that the business has the right product, at the right cost, in the right quantity and at the right time.

The ideal candidate should bring strong footwear industry experience, commercial acumen, analytical capability and a strong understanding of production planning, factory operations, vendor management, and business planning.

**Designation:**
Senior Manager

**Department:**
Category – Footwear

**Function:**
Business Planning & Commercials

**Reports To:**
Director – Category (Footwear)

**Experience:**
12+ Years

**Qualification:**
FDDI / NIFT preferred; Post-Graduation in Footwear, Business Planning, Supply Chain, Production Planning, Merchandising or a related discipline preferred

**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Planning & Commercial Governance
* Drive the overall business planning for the Footwear Category across India, ensuring alignment with business strategy, channel requirements, and financial objectives.
* Develop and maintain the annual, seasonal, and monthly footwear business plans in alignment with category and channel requirements.
* Understand the business dynamics and commercial requirements across Retail, MBO, Distribution, E-commerce, and other relevant channels.
* Translate sales plans and business requirements into actionable buying, production, and supply plans.
* Drive OTB planning and governance, ensuring that all buying decisions are aligned with approved budgets, business plans, and commercial objectives.
* Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained before commitments or buys are placed.
* Define and govern the Annual Footwear Buy Plan, including import and local production requirements.
* Monitor business performance against planned buys, sales, inventory, margin, and cost objectives.
* Partner with Finance and Category teams to ensure alignment between business plans and financial targets.
* Identify commercial risks and opportunities and provide timely recommendations to the leadership team.
* Margin, COGS & Commercial Management
* Drive governance of agreed Gross Margin (GM%) deliverables for the Footwear business.
* Plan and monitor COGS as a percentage of MRP for each season and across relevant product/channel segments.
* Analyze cost structures and identify opportunities for improving product economics and overall business profitability.
* Work closely with sourcing, merchandising, and manufacturing teams to identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality, product standards or delivery timelines.
* Monitor cost movements arising from local manufacturing, imports, production efficiencies, tooling, and other commercial factors.
* Evaluate the financial impact of production and supply decisions and provide recommendations to the Category leadership.
* Track commercial deviations against approved plans and ensure timely corrective action.
* Support scenario planning for changes in demand, production capacity, cost, lead times, and business requirements.
* Production Planning & Factory Capacity Management
* Own the production planning framework for locally manufactured footwear.
* Develop a clear view of current and future factory capacity, production output, and available manufacturing capability.
* Align factory capacity with seasonal business requirements, sales orders, and agreed production plans.
* Monitor factory production output against the agreed plan and proactively identify capacity constraints.
* Work closely with factories to optimize production schedules based on business priorities.
* Manage production planning challenges arising from changing demand, quality requirements, compliance requirements, raw material availability, and factory constraints.
* Develop alternate production scenarios where planned output is at risk.
* Ensure production plans are realistic, achievable, and aligned with required delivery dates.
* Establish regular production planning reviews with manufacturing partners.
* Drive weekly and monthly production planning and dispatch reviews.
* Factory & Vendor Performance Management
* Establish and maintain vendor/factory performance scorecards covering key operational and commercial parameters.
* Track and improve key KPIs including:
* OTIF – On-Time In-Full delivery
* On-time production completion
* Dispatch adherence
* Production output
* Capacity utilization
* Quality performance
* Production lead time
* Plan adherence
* Commercial compliance
* Identify underperforming factories/vendors and develop corrective action plans.
* Work with vendors to resolve production and delivery challenges and escalate critical issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Conduct regular factory reviews to evaluate production performance, capacity, constraints, and upcoming requirements.
* Undertake visits to production facilities as required to review production planning, manufacturing progress, and dispatch readiness.
* Ensure factories have clear visibility of business requirements and agreed production priorities.
* Drive accountability among vendors for committed timelines and deliverables.
* Merchandising & Product Planning Coordination
* Partner closely with the Footwear Merchandising and Category teams to translate assortment and sales requirements into actionable production and buying plans.
* Ensure production planning is aligned with seasonal assortment requirements and approved sales orders.
* Monitor product-level requirements and identify potential supply gaps.
* Coordinate with merchandising teams on product availability, production status, and delivery timelines.
* Ensure that changes in product requirements, quantities or timelines are communicated to factories in a timely manner.
* Support business decisions related to local production versus imports based on capacity, cost, lead time, quality, and business requirements.
* Provide commercial and operational inputs into seasonal planning and range-building discussions.
* Tooling Planning & Management
* Own the planning and governance of footwear tooling requirements in alignment with sales orders and production plans.
* Ensure tooling requirements are identified and communicated sufficiently in advance to avoid production delays.
* Track tooling development and readiness against agreed production timelines.
* Coordinate with relevant product development, merchandising, sourcing, and factory teams to ensure tooling availability.
* Identify tooling-related risks and escalate potential impact on production or delivery timelines.
* Establish visibility of tooling requirements across seasons and future production plans.
* Imports & Local Manufacturing Planning
* Develop an optimal planning approach for the import and locally manufactured footwear portfolio.
* Evaluate business requirements and recommend the appropriate sourcing/manufacturing mix.
* Consider factors such as:
* Factory capacity
* Production lead time
* Product availability
* COGS
* Quality requirements
* Compliance requirements
* Tooling requirements
* Demand and sales plans
* Delivery commitments
* Proactively identify situations where local production capacity may not be sufficient and recommend alternate supply solutions.
* Support the Category leadership team with data-driven recommendations on production versus import decisions.
* Business Analytics, Reporting & MIS
* Develop and maintain robust business planning and production tracking tools to provide timely visibility to the Category and leadership teams.
* Prepare detailed and actionable analytics covering:
* Business plan vs. actual
* Buy plan vs. actual
* OTB utilization
* Production plan vs. actual
* Factory capacity
* Production output
* OTIF performance
* Dispatch status
* COGS and margin
* Vendor performance
* Tooling readiness
* Supply risks
* Ensure all reports are supported by accurate, timely and reliable data.
* Provide clear insights, risks, and recommended actions, rather than only reporting historical performance.
* Establish weekly and monthly reporting mechanisms for leadership review.
* Develop dashboards that provide forward-looking visibility on production and supply risks.
* Highlight deviations early and ensure ownership and closure of action points.
* Process, SOP & Governance
* Develop and strengthen SOPs, processes and governance mechanisms for business planning, production planning, factory reporting and vendor management.
* Standardize planning and reporting practices across factories and business stakeholders.
* Ensure factories follow agreed reporting formats, timelines, and planning processes.
* Establish clear escalation mechanisms for production, capacity, quality, and delivery risks.
* Drive process discipline and ensure adherence to agreed procedures.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and increased planning efficiency.
* Align factory processes with relevant global requirements, processes, and best practices.
* Facilitate effective communication between India factories and the global team.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration

**Work Closely With Internal And External Stakeholders Including**

* Category – Footwear
* Merchandising
* Planning
* Sourcing
* Supply Chain
* Finance
* Quality
* Product Development
* Retail
* E-commerce
* Distribution
* Operations
* Global/Regional Teams
* Local Manufacturing Partners
* Vendors and Factories

Ensure that all stakeholders have timely visibility of business plans, production requirements, risks, changes, and delivery commitments.

* Team Leadership & Capability Building
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 4 direct reports.
* Establish clear goals, responsibilities, and performance expectations for the team.
* Build strong analytical, planning, and commercial capabilities within the team.
* Encourage ownership, accountability, and proactive problem-solving.
* Review team performance through structured business reviews and KPI tracking.
* Develop succession capability and ensure adequate functional coverage.
* Create a culture of urgency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Key Performance Indicators**

The role will be measured against a combination of business, commercial, operational, and planning KPIs, including:

**Business & Commercial**

* Annual/seasonal business plan adherence
* OTB utilization and governance
* GM% achievement
* COGS% to MRP
* Buy plan adherence
* Commercial savings/optimization initiatives

**Production & Supply**

* Production plan adherence
* Factory capacity utilization
* On-time production completion
* OTIF performance
* On-time dispatch percentage
* Production lead-time adherence
* Reduction in production-related business risks

**Vendor Management**

title: Store Manager
description:
**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
**​**
  
As a Store Manager, you’ll oversee the entire customer experience, ensuring high visual and commercial standards that align with global strategies and your store’s local context. Acting in line with our values, you’ll drive both your success and the company’s success.

You will:

* Lead your store team to deliver an outstanding customer experience while promoting and selling our products.
* Stay informed about your store’s strengths, opportunities, and competitors, with a strong understanding of the local market and customer needs.
* Analyse sales performance, set goals, and create plans to optimize results, profits, and stock levels.
* Manage scheduling and store maintenance efficiently, aligning with sales budgets and commercial priorities.
* Recruit, onboard, and develop your team while fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture that promotes growth and innovation.
* Stay updated on fashion trends, customer preferences, and competitors to maintain a competitive edge.
* Represent yourself and the brand positively during all customer interactions.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH​**

Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers experience our brand firsthand. As part of the dynamic Store Team, every role—from Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers and Visual Merchandisers to Assistant Store Managers, Cash Office Responsible, and Delivery Responsible in larger stores—contributes to creating an inspiring and welcoming environment. You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.​

**WHO YOU ARE​**

*We are looking for people with…*
​

* Experience in retail management and operations.

* A proven track record of strong leadership, with a passion for coaching and developing teams while exemplifying company values and culture.
* Proven results using customer centric reporting and tools.
* Expertise in sales planning, analysis, and follow-up.

*And people who are…*
​

* Strong and confident leaders who inspire, coach, and develop their teams with integrity.
* Motivated to create great customers experiences while promoting and driving sales.
* Ambitious and motivated by performance, competition, and achieving goals.
* Analytical problem-solvers with excellent communication skills and a knack for working with numbers and statistics.
* Flexible and solution oriented.
* Passionate about fashion trends, commerciality, and visual presentation, with a keen awareness of competitors.

**WHO WE ARE​**

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

​We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

​
**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​**
  
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

* We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability.
* We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years.
* We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
* You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits.
* We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness for self and family.
* You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M group.
* We offer 5 days of working in a week to have great work life balance.

**JOIN US​**

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

​Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

*\*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.*

**Qualifications**

**What you need to succeed :**

To be successful in the role as Store Manager, we believe you have proven leadership skills with high level of trust and integrity, clear vision, goals and result driven with a deep interest in developing people.

* 5+ years management / store management experience in a customer facing environment
* Previous experience of leading and managing teams
* Knowledge and passion for driving goals forward
* Has a passion for profitability and people
* Has a customer first mindset

**Additional Information**

To manage the high volume of applications for roles with leadership responsibilities, we use an online assessment method. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies to predefined criteria set by H&M Group.

After completing the assessment, you’ll have the opportunity to share feedback and ask questions.

If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment\_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact your application. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.

As a senior Collections leader, you will drive collection effectiveness, cash flow optimization, credit risk mitigation, compliance, and operational excellence across global customer portfolios. title: Assistant Manager, Information Systems
description:

**What Will You Do**

* Deliverables & Governance: Manage operational and project deliverables, track progress, identify risks and dependencies, and ensure high-quality outcomes in line with organizational standards and processes.
* Issue Resolution & Continuous Improvement: Drive root cause analysis, implement corrective actions, and identify opportunities for process optimization, automation, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Communication & Relationship Management: Leverage strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively engage stakeholders, facilitate decision-making, and build productive relationships across technical and business teams.

**What You Bring**

* Technical Expertise: Strong hands-on experience in Microsoft technologies, including .NET Framework/.NET Core, C#, ASP.NET, and related development tools and frameworks.
* Software Design Principles: Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP/OOPS), design patterns, SOLID principles, and software engineering best practices.
* Database Skills: Strong knowledge of SQL and relational database technologies, including database design, query optimization, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Cloud & DevOps Expertise: Experience working with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and/or AWS, along with CI/CD pipeline implementation and deployment automation using Azure DevOps and related DevOps tools.
* Microservices Architecture: Experience designing, developing, and supporting microservices-based applications, APIs, and distributed systems.
* System Development Lifecycle: Proven experience across the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, release management, and production support.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify root causes and implement effective, scalable, and sustainable solutions.
* Collaboration & Communication: Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively partner with Information Systems teams, business stakeholders, affiliates, and vendors.
* Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading teams, coordinating cross-functional initiatives, managing deliverables, and driving successful projects and operational outcomes.
* Industry Experience: Minimum 10 years of experience in software development, application support, and enterprise systems delivery within a technology-driven environment.
* Leadership Experience: Minimum 3+ years of experience in leadership role, managing teams, driving project delivery, overseeing operational activities, and mentoring technical professionals.
* Enterprise Technology Experience: Experience working with Microsoft technology stacks, cloud platforms, microservices architecture, CI/CD practices, and large-scale enterprise applications.
* B.Tech. in Computer Science or equivalent degree.
* Experience in the BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance) domain.
* Certification in cloud technologies such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Additional certifications in .NET and Azure DevOps

title: Customer Support Manager (Food Tech Background Only)
description:
**Experience:**
6–8+ Years

CTC: Upto 4.5LPA

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

About Gintaa

At
**Gintaa**
, we’re redefining how Indians order food. With our focus on affordability, exclusive restaurant partnerships, and hyperlocal logistics, we aim to scale across India’s Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities. We’re backed by a mission-driven team and expanding rapidly – now’s the time to join the core tech leadership and build something impactful from the ground up.

Role Overview

The Customer Support Manager will be responsible for the
**end-to-end management of customer support operations**
, including team performance, escalations, SLA adherence, quality, reporting, restaurant menu management, process improvement, and cross-functional coordination.

The role will also be responsible for ensuring that restaurant menus displayed on the Gintaa app are
**accurate, updated, complete, and aligned with information provided by restaurant partners**
, helping ensure a smooth ordering experience for customers.

Key ResponsibilitiesCustomer Support Operations

* Own and manage day-to-day customer support operations across calls, chat, email, and other support channels.
* Ensure customer queries, complaints, refunds, order-related issues, and escalations are resolved within defined SLAs.
* Monitor ticket volumes, response and resolution times, backlog, ageing, and overall support performance.
* Ensure adequate manpower planning, shift management, workload allocation, and support coverage.
* Establish strong operational discipline across the customer support function.

Restaurant Menu Management

* Own and oversee the
  **restaurant menu management process within the Gintaa app**
  .
* Ensure restaurant menus are accurately created, uploaded, updated, and maintained on the platform.
* Coordinate with restaurant partners and internal teams for menu updates, additions, deletions, and corrections.
* Ensure accuracy of
  **item names, descriptions, categories, pricing, variants/add-ons, availability, and other menu information**
  provided by restaurants.
* Manage menu-related requests and ensure updates are completed within defined turnaround times.
* Conduct periodic menu audits to identify incorrect, outdated, duplicate, or incomplete information.
* Ensure temporarily or permanently unavailable items are appropriately updated based on information received from restaurant partners.
* Track and resolve menu-related customer complaints, including incorrect pricing, unavailable items, missing items, and discrepancies between restaurant information and the app.
* Maintain appropriate processes and quality checks to minimise menu-related errors that could impact orders or customer experience.
* Monitor menu update volumes, accuracy, pending requests, and turnaround times.
* Work with Product and Technology teams to identify opportunities to make menu creation and management more efficient and scalable.

Team Leadership & Performance Management

* Lead, mentor, and develop the customer support team to consistently deliver high-quality customer experiences.
* Define and monitor individual and team KPIs, productivity, quality, and SLA performance.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and feedback discussions.
* Identify training requirements across customer support and restaurant menu management processes.
* Build a culture of accountability, customer obsession, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Escalation & Complaint Management

* Own critical and high-priority customer escalations and ensure timely closure.
* Establish and manage an effective escalation matrix across functions.
* Conduct root-cause analysis of recurring complaints and identify systemic issues impacting customers.
* Coordinate with relevant internal stakeholders for resolution of complex cases.
* Reduce repeat complaints through corrective and preventive actions.

Customer Experience & Process Improvement

* Identify customer journey gaps and recommend solutions to improve the overall experience.
* Analyse Voice of Customer (VoC), CSAT, complaint trends, menu-related issues, and support interactions to generate actionable insights.
* Drive initiatives to reduce customer effort, repeat contacts, escalations, and resolution time.
* Identify opportunities for process automation, self-service, FAQs, chatbots, and knowledge management.
* Develop and continuously improve SOPs, workflows, response templates, menu management processes, escalation processes, and support policies.

Cross-functional & Restaurant Partner Coordination

* Work closely with
  **Restaurant Operations, Product, Technology, Finance, Marketing, and other relevant teams**
  to resolve customer and restaurant-related issues.
* Coordinate with restaurant partners regarding menu corrections, pricing updates, availability, and other operational requirements.
* Represent customer and restaurant support requirements in internal discussions.
* Highlight recurring product, menu, payment, order, or operational issues to relevant stakeholders.
* Partner with Product and Technology teams to improve customer-facing, restaurant-facing, and support workflows.

Reporting & Governance

* Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly customer support and menu management dashboards/MIS.
* Monitor operational and customer experience metrics.
* Conduct regular reviews of support performance, menu accuracy, escalations, complaint categories, and root causes.
* Present key customer insights, operational challenges, and improvement initiatives to management.
* Ensure adherence to internal processes, customer service standards, and defined SLAs.

Key Performance Indicators

The role will be measured against metrics including:

* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
* SLA adherence
* First Response Time (FRT)
* Average Resolution Time (ART)
* First Contact Resolution (FCR)
* Ticket backlog and ageing
* Escalation and repeat contact rates
* Quality scores
* Team productivity
* Complaint reduction
* **Menu accuracy**
* **Menu update turnaround time**
* **Pending menu update requests**
* **Menu-related complaint/error rate**
* **Restaurant partner issue-resolution turnaround time**
* **Overall operational efficiency**

Skills & Competencies

* Strong leadership and people-management capabilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer and restaurant partner orientation.
* Ability to handle complex and sensitive escalations.
* Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis capabilities.
* Understanding of customer support operations, SLAs, quality, and workforce management.
* Ability to manage high-volume operational activities requiring accuracy and attention to detail.
* Data-driven approach with strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
* Strong stakeholder and restaurant partner management skills.
* Hands-on experience with CRM/ticketing platforms and customer support tools.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets.

Candidate Profile

* **6–8+ years of experience**
  in Customer Support, Customer Experience, Customer Service Operations, Restaurant Operations, or related functions.
* At least 4
  **–6+ years of experience managing or supervising a customer support/operations team**
  .
* Proven experience managing customer escalations, SLAs, support quality, and team performance.
* Experience in
  **food delivery, food-tech, e-commerce, quick commerce, marketplace, consumer internet, or technology-driven businesses**
  is strongly preferred.
* Prior exposure to
  **restaurant menu/catalogue management, restaurant operations, merchant support, or catalogue operations**
  will be a strong advantage.
* Experience coordinating directly with restaurant/merchant partners and cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrated experience in process improvement and customer experience initiatives.
* Graduate in any discipline; postgraduate qualification will be an advantage.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for an operations-focused customer support leader who combines
**customer empathy, people leadership, attention to detail, and strong execution**
.

The successful candidate should be comfortable taking end-to-end ownership across
**customer support, restaurant menu management, escalations, team performance, SLAs, restaurant coordination, and process improvement**
.

The individual will play an important role in ensuring that customers receive reliable support while restaurant information and menus on the Gintaa app remain accurate and up to date, contributing to a seamless ordering experience.

title: Senior Manager -Enggineering
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O&M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Wind Turbine Generator (WTG)**
**:**
Adani Wind Turbine Generators (WTG) is a leading player in the renewable energy sector, specializing in the design, manufacturing, and installation of high-performance wind turbine systems. With a commitment to sustainability, Adani WTGs deliver efficient and reliable energy solutions, contributing to clean power generation across global markets.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Lead - Electrical drives the design, integration, and validation of turbine electrical systems, ensuring high performance, reliability, and compliance with industry standards. The role focuses on SCADA integration, subsystem validation, thermal management, and power quality optimization, addressing compatibility challenges and ensuring efficient load distribution. It leads the testing and maintenance of critical components like converters, transformers, and generators to align with performance goals. The role supports field operations, conducts root cause analyses for subsystem failures, and implements corrective actions to improve reliability. Additionally, it collaborates with cross-functional teams to refine designs and ensure manufacturability, contributing to long-term operational efficiency.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Subsystem-Level Electrical Design**

* Lead the end-to-end design and optimization of turbine electrical subsystems, focusing on high-performance inverters, control circuits, and transformer interfaces for reliable grid integration.
* Optimize nacelle cabling layouts to reduce electromagnetic interference (EMI), minimize power losses, and improve thermal management in compact spaces.
* Design redundant electrical pathways to enhance fault tolerance and ensure continuous turbine operation under extreme conditions.

**Integration of Electrical and SCADA Systems**

* Coordinate the seamless integration of electrical components with SCADA platforms, ensuring real-time data capture, fault detection, and rapid response mechanisms.
* Resolve compatibility issues between SCADA software and electrical subsystems, focusing on synchronization of monitoring with turbine control logic.
* Develop protocols for optimized data flow, ensuring minimal latency and reliable system feedback loops.

**Component Validation and Testing**

* Manage comprehensive testing protocols for turbine electrical components, including insulation resistance, power converter efficiency, and transformer load handling.
* Collaborate with instrumentation teams to ensure accurate sensor placement and calibration, capturing critical performance metrics.
* Supervise fault simulation tests, such as grid fault ride-through (FRT) events, to validate subsystem behavior under adverse conditions.

**Power Conversion Optimization**

* Oversee optimization of power conversion systems by implementing harmonic distortion mitigation strategies and fine-tuning inverter control parameters.
* Analyze power quality metrics to ensure adherence to grid compliance standards, focusing on voltage stability and transient response performance.

**Failure Analysis and Corrective Actions**

* Conduct root cause failure analysis (RCFA) for electrical subsystem failures, such as converter overheating or generator insulation breakdown.
* Define and implement corrective actions, including design modifications for improved thermal management and enhanced material selection for reliability.
* Develop reliability improvement plans, integrating predictive maintenance schedules into operational workflows.

**Collaboration with Instrumentation Teams**

* Work closely with instrumentation engineers to configure and validate sensors for monitoring voltage, current, and thermal performance across components.
* Ensure SCADA-integrated data acquisition systems provide accurate and actionable insights into subsystem performance.
* Lead troubleshooting efforts for sensor-related issues, ensuring minimal disruption to turbine monitoring and control.

**Grid Interface and Compliance**

* Analyze grid connection points to validate voltage stability and ensure compliance with international standards, such as IEC 61400-21.
* Develop real-time voltage and frequency regulation algorithms to support grid stability during transient and steady-state operations.

**Thermal and Power Loss Analysis**

* Conduct detailed thermal performance studies for converters, transformers, and cabling, focusing on heat dissipation efficiency and thermal stability under varying loads.
* Analyze power loss patterns in nacelle wiring, identifying hotspots and proposing improved layouts or materials to enhance efficiency.
* Validate thermal simulations with field data to ensure subsystem performance aligns with design expectations.

**Technical Reporting and Documentation**

* Prepare detailed technical reports highlighting subsystem performance evaluations, failure analyses, and actionable recommendations for improvement.
* Document testing procedures, validation protocols, and outcomes for traceability during audits and certifications.

**Mentorship and Guidance**

* Mentor junior engineers in advanced topics, such as harmonic distortion analysis and thermal management in high-voltage systems.
* Conduct regular technical reviews of team deliverables to ensure alignment with project requirements and quality standards.
* Develop training modules focusing on the latest advancements in electrical engineering and renewable energy technologies.

**Key Stakeholders - Internal**

* Head - Engineering
* Head - Electrical Engineering
* Electrical Engineer
* OMS Engineering & Support - Electrical
* Nacelle Plant Support Engineer - Electrical
* Lead - Blade Process Engineering
* Lead - Testing & Certification
* Lead - Grid Compliance
* Lead - Performance Management
* Lead - Load Simulation
* Lead - Mechanical Drive Train
* Manufacturing Teams
* QA Teams

**Key Stakeholders - External**

* Electrical Component Suppliers
* Testing and Commissioning Agencies
* Grid Compliance Consultants
* Certification Bodies

**Qualifications**
**Educational Background:**

* BE in Electrical Engineering or related discipline.

**Work Experience**

* 8+ years in designing, testing, and optimizing electrical systems, including power converters and transformers. Experience with failure analysis, thermal management, and compliance verification is essential.

**Industry Knowledge**

* Expertise in load management, harmonics mitigation, and SCADA systems. Familiarity with IEC standards and advanced simulation tools is required.

title: Senior Analyst - Project Controlling
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
  
  
Could you be the full-time Senior Analyst - Project Controlling in Bangalore we’re looking for?
  
  
**Your future role**
Take on a new challenge and apply your meticulous financial management and analytical expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside dedicated, strategic, and innovative teammates.
  
  
You'll deliver critical financial insights and support to our project teams, fostering sound economic management and optimizing project financial targets. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (Project Managers, Work Package Owners, Accounting Team), ensure control of project results, and much more.
  
  
You’ll specifically take care of the precision of financial project data, uphold compliance with financial standards, and proactively manage risks and opportunities.
  
  
We’ll look to you for:
  
  

* Validate Manufacturing BOM (mBOM) financials to support project EAC (Estimate at Completion)
* Perform detailed root cause analysis of mBOM gaps (line-by-line explanation)
* Ensure alignment between BOM, EAC, actuals, and “To Be Engaged” costs
* Manage risks, savings, and opportunities across projects
* Conduct monthly reviews of BOM evolution by subsystem, material category, and supplier
* Maintain financial index database for inflation tracking and cost analysis
* Ensure consistency across budget, forecast, and actual project figures
* Act as business partner to Project Procurement and Project Finance teams
* Analyze monthly actual costs vs forecast and identify variances
* Support cost forecasting and timing with Procurement teams
* Coordinate with Supply Chain for cost monitoring and progress tracking
* Review purchase price variance (PPV) and material rate variances
* Own and manage SAP/GSI transactions and reporting tools (e.g., QlikView, BI tools)
* Monitor extra costs, claims, and liaise with Claims department
* Track and forecast revenue, gross margin, and cost-to-completion
* Ensure strong procurement/material control and governance processes
* Validate cost assumptions, QCD performance, and tender-stage costing
* Drive cost optimization initiatives (cost reduction / “cost killing”)
* Monitor WIP, cost performance vs targets, and financial accuracy of project data
* Provide financial reporting, KPIs, and benchmarking (cost, productivity, delivery)
* Identify cost drift and productivity risks; propose mitigation actions
* Ensure compliance with internal rules, processes, and project control standards
* Support management with reliable financial insights and ad-hoc reporting

**All About You**
We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
  
  

* Min qualification : CA or CMA.
* Experience or understanding of Project Controlling / Costing / Corporate Finance
* Knowledge of financial management systems, notably SAP
* Familiarity with MS Excel
* A certification in finance or a related field is a plus
* Robust analytical and presentation skills
* Resilience and adaptability in the face of change

**Things you’ll enjoy**
Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
  
  

* Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with the latest financial management tools and practices
* Collaborate with transverse teams and supportive colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of transportation
* Utilise our flexible and dynamic working environment
* Steer your career in whichever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning programs
* Progress towards leadership and advanced specialist roles
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
**Important to note**
As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: FinOps Engineer
description:
**Blessing Softtech (Fonazo) | Pune, Maharashtra | Full-time | On-site**

Blessing Softtech is hiring a
**FinOps Engineer**
to run the financial operations behind Fonazo, our AI-powered voice agent and subscription platform.

You will own the money path end to end for every Fonazo client: subscription billing, payment gateways, reconciliation, collections, refunds and revenue reporting. Every invoice billed correctly, every payment collected on time, every settlement accounted for.

**Experience:**
4+ years

**Qualification:**
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, FinTech, Commerce, Accounting or a related field

**Location:**
Pune, work from office

**Joining:**
Immediate joiners preferred

Key Responsibilities

**Subscription Billing and Revenue**

* Run end-to-end subscription billing for Fonazo clients, including recurring payments, plans, renewals, upgrades, downgrades, cancellations and plan changes.
* Track MRR, ARR, customer lifetime value, churn and subscription growth.
* Ensure correct calculation of prorated billing, discounts, promotional offers, taxes and fees.
* Identify billing discrepancies and revenue leakage, find the root cause and fix it.

**Payment Gateways**

* Manage operations across gateways such as Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Braintree, Checkout.com and similar providers.
* Configure and monitor gateway settings, transaction workflows, settlement schedules, payment methods and recurring billing.
* Track success rates, declined transactions, gateway fees, refunds and settlement discrepancies by provider.
* Work with engineering on integration issues, API billing errors, webhook failures and transaction status mismatches.
* Evaluate gateways on pricing, supported currencies, geographic coverage and settlement timelines.

**Reconciliation and Settlement**

* Reconcile gateway transactions, invoices, customer payments, refunds and bank settlements daily, weekly and monthly.
* Verify gross transaction values, processing fees, taxes, net settlements and disputed transactions.
* Resolve discrepancies between gateways, internal billing, accounting records and bank statements.
* Monitor settlement delays, failed payouts, duplicate transactions and payment reversals.
* Maintain ledgers, transaction registers, settlement reports and audit-ready documentation.

**Client Financial Operations**

* Own billing, collections and account-level financial records for multiple Fonazo clients.
* Prepare client-wise statements covering revenue, collections, failed payments, refunds, gateway charges and net settlements.
* Resolve client billing disputes, payment failures, invoice discrepancies and refund requests.
* Communicate clearly and on time with clients about failed payments, pending dues and billing changes.

**Refunds, Chargebacks and Disputes**

* Manage refunds, chargebacks, reversals and disputed transactions within company and gateway policy.
* Collect evidence and work with payment providers to close disputes on time.
* Monitor chargeback ratios, refund trends and fraud indicators.
* Set procedures for refund approvals, transaction verification and dispute escalation.

**Reporting, MIS and Analytics**

* Produce daily, weekly and monthly MIS on subscription revenue, collections, transaction volumes, failed payments, refunds and settlements.
* Build dashboards for MRR, ARR, churn, renewal rate, payment success rate, outstanding receivables and revenue leakage.
* Analyse gateway fees, client profitability, transaction costs and contribution margins.
* Automate reporting with Excel, SQL, Power BI or similar tools.

**Financial Controls and Compliance**

* Set internal controls for billing, refunds, settlements, revenue recognition and financial adjustments.
* Maintain audit trails, approval workflows and supporting documents for reviews and audits.
* Support PCI DSS, tax, data protection and payment provider requirements across relevant markets.
* Monitor suspicious transactions, duplicate charges, unauthorised refunds and fraud indicators.

**Product and Engineering Coordination**

* Translate financial requirements into specifications for plans, billing logic, invoices, retries, refunds and settlement workflows.
* Validate gateway integrations, subscription lifecycle events and billing calculations at each release.
* Test payment APIs, webhook events, recurring billing, failed-payment recovery and refund workflows.
* Identify automation opportunities that reduce manual reconciliation and scale with client volume.

**Payment Optimisation and Planning**

* Analyse failed and declined transactions and address their causes.
* Run dunning, automated retries, renewal reminders and failed-payment recovery.
* Reduce involuntary churn and processing costs.
* Support revenue forecasting, cash flow planning, collection projections and month-end close.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Strong understanding of subscription billing, recurring payments, payment processing and revenue reconciliation.
* Hands-on experience with one or more payment gateways such as Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Braintree, Checkout.com, Worldpay, 2Checkout, Square, Payoneer or Amazon Pay.
* Experience with subscription lifecycle management, invoicing, payment retries, refunds, chargebacks and settlement reconciliation.
* Knowledge of financial reporting, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, gateway fees and cash flow management.
* Advanced Excel skills, including PivotTables, lookup functions and financial reporting.
* Experience building dashboards and MIS reports in Power BI, Tableau or similar tools.
* Working knowledge of SQL and financial data analysis is preferred.
* Understanding of payment gateway APIs, webhooks and transaction statuses is an advantage.
* Familiarity with accounting or ERP systems and automated billing platforms is preferred.
* International payments, multi-currency transactions, cross-border settlements and tax treatment are an advantage.

Experience and Education

* 4+ years in FinOps, subscription finance, payment operations, billing and reconciliation, or FinTech financial operations.
* Hands-on experience with payment gateways and recurring subscription payment systems.
* Experience managing financial operations for multiple clients, accounts or subscription products.
* SaaS, AI products, voice agent platforms or other recurring-revenue business experience is highly desirable.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, FinTech, Commerce, Accounting, Business Administration or a related discipline is required.
* Master's degree or relevant certifications are preferred or advantageous.

How You Will Be Measured

* Accuracy and timeliness of subscription billing and reconciliation.
* Reduction in unresolved settlement discrepancies and unaccounted transactions.
* Payment success rate and failed-payment recovery.
* Speed of collections, refund processing and dispute resolution.
* Accurate, on-time MIS reports and dashboards.
* Lower gateway costs and less preventable revenue leakage.
* Effectiveness of billing automation and process improvements.
* Compliance with internal controls and audit requirements.

Why Join Fonazo?

* Work on the financial operations of an AI-powered voice agent and subscription platform.
* Own end-to-end billing, payments, reconciliation and revenue operations.
* Collaborate with finance, product, engineering and customer support teams.
* Help build scalable financial processes for a growing multi-client platform.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should send their
**CV / Resume**
to hr@blessingsofttech.com, along with a short note describing the hardest reconciliation problem they have solved.

Please include:

* Transaction volume handled.
* Payment gateways involved.
* What was breaking or causing the reconciliation issue.
* How you identified the root cause and fixed it.

**Experience:**
4+ years

**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, On-site

**Joining:**
Immediate joiners preferred

**Company:**
Blessing Softtech (Fonazo)

title: Accounts Associate
description:
Role Summary
  
  
The Accounts Executive will manage day-to-day accounting, GST and TDS compliance, marketplace reconciliations and MIS reporting, while coordinating with external CAs and auditors to ensure timely, accurate statutory filings and financial closing.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Coordinate with external Chartered Accountants (CAs) for GST, TDS, income tax, audits and other statutory compliances.
* Prepare and reconcile data for GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, verify ITC against GSTR-2B, and support annual filing of GSTR-9 / 9C.
* Calculate TDS, support quarterly TDS filing and maintain related documentation.
* Handle day-to-day accounting, including bank reconciliation, vendor and customer reconciliations, ledger scrutiny and maintenance of books of accounts.
* Manage accounts payable and receivable, including vendor invoice processing, payment follow-ups, outstanding tracking and timely recording of transactions.
* Reconcile e-commerce and quick-commerce settlements for Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and other platforms. Verify sales, commissions, deductions, returns, debit notes, credit notes and payment settlements.
* Prepare monthly MIS reports, expense statements, financial summaries and other management reports.
* Assist in monthly and annual financial closing and ensure the accuracy of accounting records.
* Provide CAs and external auditors with financial data, reconciliations, ledgers and supporting documents for audits and tax filings.
* Ensure timely completion of statutory compliances, reconciliations and submission of financial information to management.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* B.Com / M.Com or equivalent (CA Inter or MBA Finance is a plus).
* 2–4 years of experience in accounts, with hands-on GST and TDS exposure.
* Experience in D2C, FMCG, e-commerce or retail preferred.

**Skills Required**

* Working knowledge of Tally, or similar accounting software.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills (pivots, VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP) for reconciliations.
* Good understanding of GST, TDS and basic income tax.
* Understanding of marketplace settlements and quick-commerce billing.
* Attention to detail, ownership, timely follow-up and clear communication.

title: Project Leader - TMT
description:
**ABOUT US:**

Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services. 

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:**

You will be a part of Technology, Media & Telecommunications CoE (TMT CoE) in BCN’s Consulting Services and work closely with TMT experts and case teams for solving management questions for the clients and developing industry perspective and products. The CoE serves leading companies across domains such as Wireline and Wireless Telecommunication, Cable and Satellite, Media, Software, Semiconductors, Hardware, Technology, CSPs, and IT Services. The team is primarily focused on collaborating with practice/case teams on the development and deployment of industry specific analytical products to answer strategic questions of Bain’s TMT clients.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* Day to day management of 4-5 team members
  1. Lead a group of Analysts and Associates to execute projects with limited guidance from the Manager
  2. Understand client context, situation and business problem – translate that into actionable research problems
  3. Create workplan, provide guidance to junior team members, and review outputs to ensure high quality delivery to the clients
  4. Showcase proficiency in identifying and using analytical tools such as Alteryx and Tableau to improve quality and team efficiency
  5. Proactively resolve problems, remove roadblocks, escalate issues as needed
* Own and maintain client relationships
  1. Engage with stakeholders on a broad range of TMT topics, bringing personal experience and parallels from industry knowledge
  2. Manage client and team meetings and deliver clear and professional presentations to the team/team manager and Partners
  3. Understand client needs and situations and adapt to project expectations
* Exert strong positive influence over hiring, developing and retaining top talent 
  1. Coach and provide actionable feedback to the team members to ensure their professional development
  2. Deliver performance reviews, recommend ratings
  3. Participate in hiring activities to onboard top talent
  4. Acts as a role model and brand ambassador of the Bain culture

**ABOUT YOU:**

* Relevant work experience in the range of 5-8 years (for undergraduates) and 3-6 years (for post-graduates), preferably in providing internal/external strategic consulting in areas related to telecom, media and technology
* Minimum 2 years of experience in directly managing and coaching teams
* Strong inclination to make sense and develop expertise in ever-changing field of technology
* Exceptional communication skills to drive senior client/stakeholder level discussions
* Excellent analytical skills with hands on experience on tools such as Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; Exposure to Alteryx, Tableau, Python/SQL is a plus
* Comfortable looking for data through sources such as Refinitiv, Gartner, IDC, Factiva, etc.
* Fast and eager learner – ready to ramp up on newer problems and topics
* Collaborative working style, maturity to lead by example and demonstrated ability to motivate team members
* Determined with can-do attitude and willing to roll-up the sleeves and show the way

 

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK:**

We are proud to be
consistently recognized
as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for
diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents

title: Chief Financial Officer, ( Foreign University, India Campus)
description:
**Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Foreign University, India Campus**
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
Location: Gurugram India
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) will provide strategic and operational financial leadership from the outset for Foreign University’s new India campus. The campus will operate in India as a joint venture with Emeritus, and the role will involve a high degree of operational independence.The CFO will be responsible for financial strategy, planning and budgeting, regulatory compliance, financial reporting, taxation, financial risk management, capital planning, and the development of robust financial systems and controls. The role will ensure compliance with applicable Indian regulations while maintaining alignment with Foreign University’s financial governance and reporting requirements, working closely with the university finance leadership team and the JVC Board.The CFO will work closely with university leadership, governing bodies, regulators, government authorities, auditors, legal advisors, banking partners, and stakeholders across India and Foreign University.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Financial Strategy and Operational Performance
* Establish finance systems, policies, processes, controls, and reporting frameworks.
* Develop and implement the financial strategy for establishing and operating the India campus.
* Lead long-term financial modelling covering enrolments, fee structures, operating costs, investments, and campus growth.
* Lead the implementation and ongoing development of finance systems and reporting tools.
* Oversee budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, taxation, statutory reporting, and internal and external audits.
* Establish and oversee procurement, purchasing, and contract governance frameworks to ensure transparency, value for money, and compliance with institutional requirements.
* Evaluate funding, investment, partnership, leasing, and other financial models to support long-term sustainability.
* Develop financially sustainable models for student enrolments, research, industry partnerships, executive education, and other revenue streams.
* Build and lead a high-performing finance team through effective workforce planning, talent development, succession planning, and a culture of accountability and financial discipline.
* Provide strategic financial advice and insights to senior leadership and governing committees.
* Governance, Risk and Compliance
* Establish strong financial governance, internal controls, fraud prevention, and risk management frameworks.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian education, corporate, taxation, foreign exchange, and financial regulations.
* Ensure appropriate alignment with international financial reporting requirements, including IFRS where applicable.
* Manage cross-border financial arrangements, foreign currency exposure, banking relationships, taxation, and financial risk.
* Maintain strong relationships with Indian regulators, government bodies, auditors, banks, and professional advisors.
* Support the Board in maintaining effective financial governance.
* Leadership Responsibilities
* Build and lead a high-performing finance team through effective workforce planning, talent development, succession planning, and a culture of accountability and financial discipline.
* Provide strategic financial advice and insights to senior leadership and governing committees.
* Coach leaders across the business to improve financial literacy and decision-making.

**Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. (Essential)
* Professional qualification such as CA, CPA, ACCA, CFA, or equivalent. (Essential)
* 10+ years of senior financial leadership experience, preferably in complex, regulated, or international organisations. (Essential)
* Experience in financial strategy, governance, budgeting, risk management, compliance, and financial reporting. (Essential)
* Strong knowledge of Indian taxation, regulatory, and financial frameworks. (Essential)
* Experience in international expansion, cross-border operations, or multinational organisations. (Desirable)
* Experience of working within higher education, transnational education, international campuses, or similarly complex regulated environments. (Essential)
* Experience managing significant capital projects and operational budgets. (Essential)
* Experience of developing long-term financial models and sustainability plans. (Essential)
* Experience of working with governing boards, Finance Committees, and Audit & Risk Committees. (Essential)
* Strong strategic thinking, commercial judgement, analytical ability, and stakeholder management skills. (Essential)
* High integrity, sound judgement, and ability to work effectively across cultures and jurisdictions. (Essential)
* Ability to communicate complex financial information to non-financial stakeholders. (Essential)
* Ability to influence strategic decision-making at executive and governing board level. (Essential)

**Key Relationships**

* Head of Institution / India Campus Head
* University Governing Board / Council
* Audit & Risk Committee
* Parent University Finance Leadership
* Senior Academic and Professional Leadership
* Internal and External Auditors
* Government Authorities and Regulators
* Legal, Tax, and Professional Advisors
* Banking and Financial Partners
