title: BESS Analyst (Design & Estimations)/ BESS Manager – Design, Engineering & Cost Estimation
description:
**Company Description**
Established in 2002, ib vogt GmbH is specialized in the Development, Design and Engineering, Financing, EPC and Operation of solar power and provides turnkey solar power plant solutions to investors internationally.
  
  
As a manufacturer-independent integrated developer, the company focuses on tailor-made solar power plant solutions that maximize lifecycle performance and returns.
  
  
Since 2009, ib vogt has commissioned plants with a capacity of almost 2 Gigawatt. We employ over 840 specialists, in all areas of the solar power plant value chain in over 40 countries. The company operates internationally from offices in Spain Germany, Italy, Netherlands, France, Poland, USA, Australia, United Kingdom, Panama, India and Southeast Asia.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Description:**
We are seeking a highly motivated and technically proficient
**Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) Manager**
with 5–10 years of hands-on experience in the
**design, engineering, techno-commercial evaluation, and cost estimation**
of BESS solutions in India. The ideal candidate will bring a deep understanding of various BESS technologies, their application in hybrid renewable projects (Solar, Wind, or both), and strong cost modelling capabilities for systems ranging from
**1 MWh to 100 MWh**
.
  
  
This role is critical to evaluating BESS deployment for utility-scale projects, optimizing technical configurations, and supporting investment-grade proposals.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* Lead technical and financial feasibility assessments for BESS deployments integrated with solar, wind, or hybrid renewable energy projects.
* Drive battery sizing optimization based on project needs—such as peak shifting, load smoothing, frequency regulation, or energy arbitrage.
* Prepare and validate cost estimates including CAPEX, OPEX, EPC costs, commissioning, and lifecycle expenses.
* Develop Levelized Cost of Storage (LCOS) models for multiple BESS architectures (e.g., centralized vs distributed).
* Conduct system design using modelling tools, ensuring compliance with performance requirements and cost effectiveness.
* Collaborate with internal teams (engineering, BD, EPC, O&M) and external stakeholders (vendors, consultants) to align technical design and commercial goals.
* Evaluate and benchmark vendor offers for battery packs, PCS, EMS, and BoP equipment; provide Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis.
* Stay updated with policy, regulatory, and market developments impacting energy storage deployment in India (e.g., IEGC, CEA guidelines, SECI tenders).
* Support business development and proposal teams with techno-commercial inputs, tender documentation, and client presentations.
* Contribute to internal knowledge development, standardization of BESS cost libraries, and design templates.

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, or Energy Systems Engineering.
* Proficient in BESS technologies (Li-ion, Flow, LFP, NMC, etc.) and battery sizing logic for multiple use cases.
* Demonstrated experience in cost modelling using MS Excel, Python, or similar analytical tools.
* Working knowledge of simulation and system design software like HOMER, PVSyst, SAM, MATLAB, or similar.
* Familiarity with safety codes, international standards (e.g., UL 9540, NFPA 855, IEEE standards).
* Strong documentation, presentation, and communication skills.
* Understanding of Indian electricity market dynamics, ancillary services, peak tariffs, and storage tenders.

**Experience**

* 5–10 years of relevant experience in BESS design, costing, and system integration—preferably in Indian or South Asian market context.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Exposure to utility-scale BESS projects with >10 MWh capacity.
* Experience in pre-bid engineering for SECI, NTPC, or DISCOM storage tenders.
* Certification or training in energy storage or grid integration is a plus.

Additional Information
  
  
**We Offer You**

* A truly international working environment with colleagues from all over the world
* An open-minded, friendly and highly motivated team.
* Great opportunities for professional and personal development
* Interesting and challenging tasks
* Competitive remuneration (based on experience)

*At ib vogt, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone can thrive. We believe that embracing diverse perspectives drives innovation and helps us better serve the global communities we operate in. As an equal opportunity employer, we provide employment opportunities without regard to age, ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy or maternity, marriage and civil partnership, or any other protected status.*
*We strive to create an accessible recruitment process for all candidates and are happy to discuss reasonable accommodations to support your application. As a global company, we acknowledge that accessibility provisions may vary by location depending on local infrastructure and legal requirements. If you have a disability or require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know - we will do our best to support you.*

Global Compliance establishes the framework and standards, the Regional Compliance Officer oversees APJ implementation and escalation, and local entities retain statutory responsibilities. Under the three-lines model, the first line owns risks, controls and remediation; the second line, Compliance, independently oversees and challenges risk management; and the third line, Internal Audit, provides independent assurance.

* Ensure suspicious activity escalation and reporting arrangements are documented, timely and aligned to the requirements of the relevant jurisdiction and financial intelligence unit.
* Coordinate AML/CFT and sanctions risk assessments, control testing, quality assurance, issue management, management information and trend analysis across the region.
* Represent APJ compliance requirements in AML technology design, configuration, data requirements, user acceptance testing, implementation and post-implementation assurance.
* Monitor regulatory developments, enforcement themes and FATF/APG-related changes relevant to the assigned markets and translate them into proportionate actions.

* Maintain effective governance, escalation and decision records.
* Broader compliance risk management
* Oversee regional compliance risk assessments and risk-based monitoring.
* Advise on products, credit and leasing activities, customer communications and business change.
* Coordinate third-party compliance due diligence and oversight.
* Manage breach escalation, investigations, remediation and systemic improvements.
* Deliver compliance training and coordinate with other assurance functions while preserving independence.
* Stakeholder leadership and compliance culture
* Work closely with HPEFS Legal on regulatory guidance interpretation, application and co-ordination of external third parties as needed
* Provide independent compliance advice and challenge to APJ leadership.
* Build effective relationships across regional, country and control functions.
* Reinforce first-line ownership and accountability for compliant execution.
* Promote consistent regulatory interpretation and evidence-based decisions.

**What You Need To Bring**

* Degree in Law, Finance, Business, Economics or a related field; relevant postgraduate qualification or professional certification desirable.
* Approximately five years’ compliance experience in regulated financial services, including multi-jurisdictional APJ exposure.
* Experience in regulatory governance, licence obligations, regulatory engagement, risk assessment, monitoring, remediation and management reporting.
* Practical knowledge of AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC/CDD/EDD, beneficial ownership, PEP controls and suspicious activity escalation.
* Ability to implement consistent regional standards while addressing local regulatory requirements.
* Experience with technology-enabled compliance processes, data and reporting.
* Ability to work independently and influence effectively within a matrix organisation.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong regulatory judgement, integrity and ability to provide independent challenge.
* Ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical controls and procedures.
* Strong analytical, communication and senior-level reporting skills.
* Effective programme, project and action-management capability.
* Ability to work effectively across APJ jurisdictions and cultures.
* Fluent business English; relevant APJ language skills desirable.

**Indicative success measures**

* Timely completion of regulatory obligations, filings and supervisory actions.
* Effective and consistent AML/KYC oversight and escalation.
* Delivery of the compliance monitoring plan and timely remediation.
* Timely, practical compliance advice on products and business change.

Reduction in repeat findings, overdue actions and preventable incidents.

title: General Manager Contract
description:
**About Krisala Developers**

Krisala Developers is one of Pune’s fastest-growing real estate developers, known for delivering thoughtfully designed residential, commercial, township and plotted developments. Built on a foundation of quality, innovation, customer-centricity, and timely delivery, Krisala is rapidly expanding across Pune and the rest of Maharashtra with a vision to redefine urban living through landmark projects.

Join Us in Building the Future of Real Estate

At Krisala Developers, we foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous growth, empowering our people to create meaningful impact while building rewarding careers.

**Job Title**
–
**General Manager – Contracts**

**Location – Pune**

**Job Description-**

We are looking for an experienced and strategic
**General Manager – Contracts**
to lead the Contracts function for our real estate projects. The role will be responsible for managing the complete contract lifecycle, including tendering, bid evaluation, contract finalization, contract administration, vendor and contractor management, variations, claims, and commercial risk management.

The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in construction and real estate contracts, along with a thorough understanding of project costing, commercial terms, and statutory requirements. This leadership role will work closely with Engineering, Projects, Planning, Procurement, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to ensure effective commercial governance and timely execution across multiple projects.

**Roles & Responsibilities-**

* Lead and manage the end-to-end Contracts function across multiple residential, commercial and township projects
* Drive the complete contract lifecycle, including tendering, bid evaluation, negotiations, contract finalization, issuance, administration, and closure
* Review and finalize commercial and contractual terms with contractors, vendors, consultants, and other project partners
* Develop and implement robust contracting processes, policies, and governance frameworks to ensure commercial control and compliance
* Manage contract variations, change orders, claims, disputes, extensions of time, and other contractual matters
* Work closely with Engineering, Projects, Planning, Procurement, Finance, and Legal teams to ensure alignment between project execution and contractual commitments
* Monitor project contracts to identify commercial, contractual, and execution risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies
* Drive cost optimization and value engineering initiatives while maintaining quality, timelines, and contractual compliance
* Lead commercial negotiations with key contractors and vendors to achieve favourable business outcomes
* Establish strong MIS, reporting, and review mechanisms for senior management on contract performance, risks, claims, and key commercial matters
* Lead, mentor, and develop the Contracts team while driving accountability, efficiency, and continuous improvement

**Must-Have Skills-**

* 18-20 years of experience in Contracts and Commercial Management within the Real Estate or Construction industry
* Strong expertise in tendering, bid evaluation, contract negotiation, contract administration, and contract finalization
* Experience in managing contracts for large-scale residential, commercial, high-rise and/or township projects
* Strong understanding of BOQs, rate analysis, project costing, budgeting, and commercial terms
* Hands-on experience in managing variations, claims, change orders, disputes, and contractual risks
* Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills with contractors, vendors, consultants, and internal teams
* Proven leadership experience in managing and developing high-performing teams
* Strong analytical, commercial, and problem-solving abilities

**Preferred Skills-**

* Experience working with a reputed Real Estate Developer or large Construction organization
* Exposure to managing multiple projects simultaneously
* Knowledge of relevant construction contracts, statutory requirements, and industry best practices
* Experience with SAP and contract/project management tools
* Exposure to cost optimization and value engineering initiatives

**Educational Background-**

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from an AICTE-approved and/or UGC-recognized institution
* Postgraduate qualification in Construction Management, Project Management, Contracts Management, or a related discipline will be an added advantage

**Why Join Krisala Developers?**

* Opportunity to work with one of Pune’s fastest-growing real estate developers
* Collaborative and growth-oriented work culture
* Group Health Insurance Coverage
* Group Term Life Insurance
* Personal Accident Insurance Coverage
* Provident Fund & Statutory Benefits
* Leadership exposure and career advancement opportunities
* Opportunity to contribute to landmark residential, commercial, township and plotted developments

**Interested?**

If you're looking to be part of a growth-driven organization that values innovation, ownership, and excellence, we'd love to hear from you.
